title: ECP-Bench: Benchmarking and Learning Entertainment Content Promotion with Foundation Models
summary: Content promotion spans a broad set of skills, from understanding content to forecasting its market reception. However, LLMs' ability to support such promotion decisions remains underexplored. Existing studies are often limited to a single task (e.g., popularity prediction) or a small set of tasks within a single domain (e.g., movies). As a result, there is a lack of understanding of LLMs' abilities in the full promotion process and how these abilities generalize across different tasks and domains. In this work, we introduce ECP-Bench, a benchmark containing 1.9M movie, game, and music items and 423,451 questions across 33 tasks in five content-promotion skill families. Our evaluation shows that frontier models achieve only 51.9\% overall accuracy and lose much of their advantage on post-cutoff content, with drops of up to 19.1 percentage points. In contrast, open-weight models fine-tuned on ECP-Bench achieve up to 60.3\%, remain substantially more stable across the knowledge cutoff, generalize to unseen content and tasks, and exhibit meaningful cross-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ECP-Bench，一个包含 190 万电影/游戏/音乐条目、423,451 道题目、33 个任务、5 大技能族的内容推广基准。前沿模型整体仅 51.9% 准确率，且在知识截止后内容上大幅退化（最多 -19.1 pp）；在 ECP-Bench 上微调的开源模型达 60.3%，在截止点前后更稳定，并展现出未见内容/任务及跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 内容推广涉及从内容理解到市场预测的多种技能，但现有研究多局限于单一任务（如热度预测）或单一领域（如电影），缺乏对 LLMs 在完整推广流程中能力的系统性评估，以及其跨任务、跨域泛化能力的理解。
AI.method: 构建 ECP-Bench 基准：收集电影、游戏、音乐三大领域共 190 万条目，设计 33 个任务归属于 5 个技能族（内容理解、受众分析、市场预测、策略制定、执行优化），生成 423,451 个问答对。对比评测前沿闭源模型与在 ECP-Bench 上微调的开源模型，重点考察知识截止点前后表现、未见内容/任务泛化及跨域泛化。
AI.result: 前沿模型整体准确率 51.9%，在知识截止后内容上下降高达 19.1 个百分点；在 ECP-Bench 微调的开源模型达到 60.3% 准确率，在截止点前后表现显著更稳定，并能泛化到未见内容、未见任务及跨域场景。
AI.conclusion: ECP-Bench 揭示了当前 LLMs 在内容推广全流程中的能力短板，尤其是时效性知识的局限；针对性微调可显著提升性能与鲁棒性，实现跨任务、跨域泛化，为内容推广决策提供更可靠的模型基础。

title: Guiding the coarse levels of semantic IDs makes the fine levels learnable
summary: Generative retrieval represents each item by a short Semantic ID and casts recommendation as autoregressive generation of that sequence. Because the tokenizer is trained independently to reconstruct an item embedding, its codes are aligned with neither the downstream LLM nor the end task. Nearly every SID system therefore spends extra effort to bridge this gap--alignment corpora, reasoning/RL, or per-token encoders to make codes legible, or learned tokenizer supervision to make them task-aware--yet the recovered meaning is content-derived and may not be the meaning the task needs. We introduce Guided SID, which instead makes the levels that matter most meaningful by construction: we force the coarse RQ-VAE levels to encode a predefined categorical attribute--chosen to be text-grounded (hence legible to the LLM) and task-relevant--by deterministic supervised index assignment (overriding nearest-neighbor selection with the attribute label) while keeping the codebooks learnable (they still receive reconstruction gradients). A trie-merge construction maps any high-cardinality or set-valued attribute onto the fixed code budget while keeping merged buckets semantically coherent. Guiding costs nothing intrinsically: collision and reconstruction match or beat the vanilla baseline despite pinning the coarse level. In a matched end-to-end A/B differing only in the SID encoding, the guided retriever improves recall@k at every list length we measure (1.36x at k=1, 1.39x at k=10), raises mean reciprocal rank from 0.0260 to 0.0355, and predicts the pre-defined attribute 4.2x more often.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Guided SID 方法，通过在 RQ-VAE 的粗粒度层级强制编码预定义的文本型任务相关属性，解决生成式检索中语义 ID 与下游 LLM 及任务目标不一致的问题，无需额外对齐成本即可显著提升召回率和属性预测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式检索系统中，语义 ID 的分词器独立训练用于重构物品嵌入，其编码既不与下游 LLM 对齐，也不与最终推荐任务对齐。现有方法（对齐语料、推理/RL、逐 token 编码器、任务感知分词器监督）虽试图弥合差距，但恢复的语义是基于内容的，不一定是任务所需的语义。
AI.method: Guided SID：在 RQ-VAE 的粗粒度码本层级，采用确定性监督索引分配，将预定义的分类属性（文本 grounding、任务相关）强制编码进码本索引，覆盖最近邻选择；同时保持码本可学习（仍接收重构梯度）。针对高基数或集合值属性，引入 Trie-merge 结构将其映射到固定码本预算内，并保持合并桶的语义连贯性。
AI.result: 引导机制无额外内在成本：碰撞率与重构误差匹配或优于基线。在仅 SID 编码不同的端到端 A/B 实验中，引导检索器在所有测试列表长度上提升 recall@k（k=1 时 1.36 倍，k=10 时 1.39 倍），MRR 从 0.0260 提升至 0.0355，预定义属性预测频率提高 4.2 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过构造时即赋予关键层级任务相关语义，Guided SID 以零额外开销实现了语义 ID 与下游任务的深度对齐，显著提升了生成式检索的召回性能和属性预测能力，为任务感知的语义索引提供了简洁有效的范式。

title: Scoring With the Engine: Retrieval Exposure, Cross-Engine Divergence, and the Limits of Engine-Agnostic GEO Scores
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Builds on and complements arXiv:2609.07559; cites and extends the measurement program in arXiv:2607.18904, arXiv:2607.22392, arXiv:2608.02556, and arXiv:2609.09878
summary: Recent work asks whether generative-engine visibility can be approximated with deterministic, engine-free page scores. We separate two stages such scores can conflate: exposure to a live engine and citation selection conditional on exposure. In an observational audit of ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Google, and Perplexity, 15 fixed commercial prompts produced 589 citation observations on 6 June 2026, corresponding to 528 unique URLs and 356 domains. Same-prompt cross-engine URL overlap was extremely small: mean pairwise Jaccard similarity was 0.0079, the median was zero, and 84.9% of engine pairs shared no cited URL. On the ten prompts observed on all four engines, mean exact-URL Jaccard was 0.0072. A matched-size hypergeometric baseline preserving each prompt's four-engine URL universe and each engine's list length predicts 0.1272, so observed overlap was only 5.7% of that baseline; zero URL overlap occurred in 86.7% of comparisons versus 12.3% expected. Top-five exact-URL overlap was zero in all 60 pairwise comparisons. A single engine captured only 11.4%-42.6% of the four-engine URL union, and 96.4% of observed URLs appeared in only one engine. A separate 5-to-6 June same-engine comparison found 67.0% mean URL-set turnover. These results do not invalidate engine-free page scoring; they identify its estimand. A score computed without a live engine can estimate page quality or query-page fit, while end-to-end visibility additionally depends on engine-specific exposure and selection. We therefore argue for reporting page fit, observed exposure, conditional selection, and final visibility as distinct quantities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过观察性审计四大生成式引擎（ChatGPT、Copilot、Google、Perplexity）的引用行为，发现跨引擎URL重叠极低，揭示了“无引擎页面评分”只能估计页面质量或查询-页面匹配度，而端到端可见性还取决于引擎特有的曝光和选择阶段，主张将页面匹配度、观测曝光、条件选择和最终可见性作为四个独立量度报告。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探讨生成式引擎可见性能否用确定性的、无引擎的页面评分来近似，以及这类评分可能混淆了曝光和引用选择两个阶段。
AI.method: 方法是观察性审计：使用15个固定商业提示词，在2026年6月6日对四大引擎进行查询，收集589次引用观测，对应528个唯一URL和356个域名；计算跨引擎URL重叠的Jaccard相似度、超几何基线、Top-5重叠、单引擎覆盖率、URL周转率等指标。
AI.result: 结果显示跨引擎URL重叠极小：平均成对Jaccard为0.0079，中位数为0，84.9%的引擎对无共享URL；观测重叠仅为超几何基线的5.7%，零重叠发生率86.7%远高于预期12.3%；Top-5完全无重叠；单引擎仅覆盖四引擎并集的11.4%-42.6%，96.4% URL仅出现在单一引擎；同引擎两天间URL集合周转率67.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结论是无引擎页面评分并未失效，但其估计量被明确为页面质量或查询-页面匹配度；端到端可见性还需引擎特有的曝光和条件选择；因此建议分别报告页面匹配度、观测曝光、条件选择和最终可见性四个不同量度。

title: Beyond Raw Engagement: A Counterfactual Observability Framework for Recommender Systems at Netflix
summary:
Understanding the performance of large-scale recommender systems remains an underexplored challenge, especially for content creators and model developers. The raw engagement signals available to them, such as views and clicks, conflate content quality, model behavior, presentation bias, and audience reach, making it hard to attribute outcomes to the right cause.
  In this work, we present a general evaluation framework that enhances observability across multiple recommender systems at Netflix and demonstrate its effectiveness through several production deployments. The framework treats recommender-system observability as a counterfactual measurement problem: estimating what the recommender would have done, and what engagement would have followed, in the absence of a specific content item or model decision. We articulate three stakeholder-centered observability principles for content creators and model developers, and propose measurement methodologies covering bias reduction, relativity, and incrementality, applicable to both single-stage and cascading recommender systems and serving both audiences from a single measurement foundation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个通用的评估框架，用于增强Netflix大规模推荐系统的可观测性，将可观测性视为反事实测量问题，通过偏差减少、相对性和增量性三大方法论，服务于内容创作者和模型开发者两类利益相关者，并在生产环境中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 大规模推荐系统的性能理解仍然是一个未被充分探索的挑战。内容创作者和模型开发者可获得的原始参与信号（如浏览量、点击量）混淆了内容质量、模型行为、呈现偏差和受众覆盖，导致难以将结果归因于正确的原因。
AI.method: 提出将推荐系统可观测性建模为反事实测量问题：估算在缺少特定内容项或模型决策时，推荐系统会如何表现以及会产生何种参与度。阐述了三个以利益相关者为中心的可观测性原则，并设计了涵盖偏差减少、相对性和增量性的测量方法论，适用于单阶段和级联推荐系统，并为两类受众提供统一的测量基础。
AI.result: 该框架已在Netflix的多个推荐系统中部署，并通过多个生产环境部署证明了其有效性，能够提升不同推荐系统的可观测性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过反事实测量方法，成功解决了推荐系统中参与信号混淆的问题，为内容创作者和模型开发者提供了统一、可操作的可观测性工具，具有实际生产价值。

title: PRQuant: Permutation Residual Quantization for Low-Overhead Inference
summary: Accuracy of Low-bit quantization of linear layers is often dominated by a small number of outliers. Although existing methods, such as smoothing, rotation, or residual-based approaches, may mitigate this problem, they often introduce new accuracy bottlenecks to weights. Besides, most of these techniques are implemented as online approaches, which can result in heavy execution overheads. To address the afore-mentioned issues, We propose PRQuant (Permutation Residual Quantization), a training-free and low-overhead framework that combines channel reorganization with static weight-side residual compensation. After AWQ-style scaling, PRQuant identifies the input channels that contribute most to weight quantization error, permutes them into contiguous tail blocks, and constructs their residual weight sub-tensors offline. During inference, this contiguous structure enables the activation side to use tail blocks seamlessly without the expensive online gathering operation, and turns scattered residual compensation into a regular tail-augmented GEMM, substantially reducing latency. Experiments demonstrate that PRQuant effectively reduces down-projection reconstruction error. Ablation studies confirm that smoothing and residual compensation are the primary drivers of numerical improvement, while permutation provides a consistent marginal numerical benefit and, more importantly, enables a hardware-friendly contiguous layout that eliminates dynamic gathering overhead. Overall, PRQuant outperforms default MXFP4 and the evaluated PTQ baselines in average accuracy across five downstream benchmarks, improving over MXFP4 by 1.24 and 0.55 on Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, respectively.

AI.tldr: PRQuant 是一种无需训练、低开销的低比特量化框架，通过通道重组与静态权重侧残差补偿相结合，解决了线性层量化中的离群值问题，消除了在线收集开销，并在多个下游任务上超越 MXFP4 与主流 PTQ 基线。
AI.motivation: 现有低比特量化方法（如平滑、旋转、残差补偿）虽能缓解离群值主导的量化误差，但往往引入新的权重精度瓶颈，且多为在线实现，带来沉重的推理开销。
AI.method: 基于 AWQ 缩放，PRQuant 识别对权重量化误差贡献最大的输入通道，将其排列为连续的尾部块，并离线构建残差权重子张量。推理时，连续布局使激活侧可直接使用尾部块，无需昂贵的在线 gather，将离散残差补偿转化为规则的尾部增强 GEMM，大幅降低延迟。
AI.result: 实验表明 PRQuant 有效降低了下投影重构误差；消融实验证实平滑与残差补偿是数值提升的主要驱动力，排列带来边际数值增益但实现了硬件友好的连续布局，消除动态收集开销。在五个下游基准上平均准确率超越 MXFP4 与评测的 PTQ 基线，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 提升 1.24，Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 提升 0.55。
AI.conclusion: PRQuant 通过离线通道排列与静态残差补偿，在保持数值精度的同时实现了硬件友好的连续内存访问模式，为低比特量化提供了一个高效、免训练的实用方案。

title: Recognition, Simulation, and Refusal: A Contamination-Aware Study of Classic Psychological Effects in LLM Agents
summary: An LLM producing the response pattern associated with a human psychological effect is not the same claim as the LLM possessing that bias. We present PsyAgentBench, a benchmark that re-runs classic psychology experiments on LLM agents under a factorial design built to separate these: each paradigm is run with the paradigm explicitly labeled in the prompt (named) or framed as a routine task (blind), and on the literal textbook version of the task (canonical) or a structurally matched variant written to reduce lexical and scenario overlap with likely training data (counterfactual), crossed with a persona manipulation. Across five completed paradigms, evaluated on up to three open-weight model families with 41,904 trials released, apparently human-like effects arise through qualitatively different routes rather than one susceptibility: paradigm-label gating with explicit override (Asch conformity, 0 percent blind to 83.3 percent named on gpt-oss-120B), knowledge-dependent signal reliance (anchoring, exactly zero on grounded facts versus near total on invented quantities, a pattern equally consistent with rational use of the only available signal), amplification on novel content under labeling (framing), robust absence (sunk cost), and safety-mediated selection where refusal itself is the primary finding (minimal-group allocation). A one-sentence persona change (agreeableness, framed as an instruction rather than a verified trait manipulation) eliminates, dampens, or reverses these effects depending on which effect it is, arguing against any single response-bias account. We further formalize, and in two cases document empirically, three ways a psychology paradigm can fail to port to LLM agents: persona dominance, population collapse, and safety selection. We argue scalar bias-susceptibility scores obscure this structure and report replication profiles instead.

AI.tldr: PsyAgentBench通过因子设计在LLM智能体上重跑经典心理学实验，区分“产生类人反应模式”与“拥有该偏见”，发现五个范式的类人效应通过不同机制产生（如范式标签门控、知识依赖信号、新内容放大、稳健缺失、安全中介选择），人格指令能消除/反转效应，反驳单一响应偏差解释；形式化三种移植失败模式，主张用复刻谱系替代标量偏差易感性分数。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常将LLM表现出类人心理效应等同于LLM具备相应偏见，缺乏实验设计区分二者；需要系统性基准在控制提示标签、任务变体、人格设定等因素下，剖析效应产生的真实机制。
AI.method: 构建PsyAgentBench，采用因子设计：每个范式在named/blind（显式标签/常规任务）、canonical/counterfactual（教科书版/结构匹配反事实版）、persona（人格指令）三个维度交叉；在五个经典范式（阿sch从众、锚定、框架、沉没成本、最小群体分配）上对多达三个开权重模型家族共41,904次试验进行评估。
AI.result: 发现五种质性不同的效应产生路径：阿sch从众表现为范式标签门控（blind 0% → named 83.3%）；锚定效应呈现知识依赖信号依赖（真实事实锚定为0，虚构数量近全依赖）；框架效应在标签条件下于新内容放大；沉没成本效应稳健缺失；最小群体分配表现为安全中介选择（拒绝响应为主要发现）。单句人格指令（宜人性）能根据效应类型消除、减弱或反转效应，反驳单一响应偏差解释。实证记录了三种移植失败模式：人格主导、群体崩塌、安全选择。
AI.conclusion: 标量偏差易感性分数掩盖了效应产生的结构性差异；应报告复刻谱系而非单一分数。LLM呈现类人效应并非源于统一的心理偏见，而是由提示标签、知识可用性、内容新颖性、安全机制等多重因素交互产生，人格指令能灵活调控这些效应，揭示了LLM行为的语境依赖性与非人类化本质。

title: Didactic knowledge or Clinical Cases? How Data Types Shape Medical Large Language Models
comment: This paper is accepted by NLPCC 2026 oral
summary: Medical large language models are commonly trained on mixtures of didactic data (e.g., textbooks) and clinical data (e.g., patient records), yet how these data types differentially shape model capabilities remains unclear. We address this issue with token-matched experiments that vary the didactic-to-clinical ratio and analyze how data composition affects performance, capability profiles, and error patterns across knowledge-intensive and clinic-oriented tasks. We uncover an asymmetric transfer across task types: clinical data improves clinic-oriented tasks while remaining competitive on knowledge-intensive ones, whereas didactic data mainly improves knowledge-intensive tasks. Error analysis suggests a knowing-doing gap, where improvements in knowledge recall do not reliably generalize to clinical reasoning. We further observe that modest amounts of clinical data yield most of the gains on EHR-grounded tasks, while the optimal mixture ratio varies with the knowledge and clinical reasoning demands of downstream tasks. These findings suggest that medical LLM data curation should be application-driven, with higher proportions of clinical data preferred for reasoning-intensive use cases.

AI.tldr: 本文通过 token-matched 实验研究医学大语言模型中教科书式数据与临床数据的混合比例对不同任务类型性能的影响，发现临床数据对临床导向任务提升显著且在知识密集型任务上保持竞争力，而教科书式数据主要提升知识密集型任务；存在“知行差距”，知识召回提升不一定泛化到临床推理；少量临床数据即能带来 EHR 接地任务的大部分增益，最佳混合比例取决于下游任务的知识与临床推理需求，建议数据策展应以应用为导向，推理密集型场景偏好更高比例临床数据。
AI.motivation: 医学大语言模型常在教科书式数据和临床数据的混合上训练，但这两类数据如何差异化地塑造模型能力尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用 token-matched 实验，变化教科书式数据与临床数据的比例，分析数据组成对知识密集型任务和临床导向任务的性能、能力画像及错误模式的影响。
AI.result: 发现不对称迁移：临床数据提升临床导向任务，在知识密集型任务上保持竞争力；教科书式数据主要提升知识密集型任务。错误分析揭示“知行差距”：知识召回改进不一定泛化到临床推理。少量临床数据即能获得 EHR 接地任务的大部分增益，最佳混合比例随下游任务的知识和临床推理需求而变。
AI.conclusion: 医学 LLM 数据策展应以应用为导向，推理密集型用例偏好更高比例的临床数据。

title: Parameterized Dense-Sparse Fusion for Hybrid Retrieval: Tuning a Rank-Score Mix on BEIR SciFact with Qdrant
summary: We study a parameterized hybrid ranker that fuses a dense embedding list and a sparse lexical list. The method has a small, explicit parameter vector: a dense prior $α\in [0,1]$, a score-versus-rank mix $λ\in [0,1]$, an RRF smoothing parameter $κ> 0$, optional list-geometry coefficients that move $α$ per query, and a router margin $τ$ that can turn sparse search off. We grid-search those ranges on SciFact train (809 queries) and freeze the chosen values on SciFact test (300). The tuned rank-score mix ($α= 0.8$, $λ= 0.75$, $κ= 20$) reaches 0.753 nDCG@10 and 0.889 recall@10, outperforming dense BGE (0.742 / 0.871) and equal-weight RRF (0.707 nDCG@10) on that test split. A list-conditioned $α$ adds +0.0006 nDCG; a sparse-off router is rejected by the same train split (any $τ$ that skipped approximately 50% of queries lost nDCG). These coefficients are dataset-specific. Equal RRF with the same models does not beat dense on a nine-zip BEIR macro-average (0.479 vs. 0.519 nDCG@10). Repeating the same train-then-freeze sweep independently on all 20 indexed units beats equal RRF on 20/20 and dense on 16/20 (unit-mean nDCG@10 0.467 vs. 0.462 dense vs. 0.420 RRF). Other corpora should reuse the ranges, not a copy of the SciFact point.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种参数化混合排序器，融合稠密嵌入列表与稀疏词法列表，通过网格搜索调优参数（α=0.8, λ=0.75, κ=20）在 SciFact 测试集上超越稠密检索与等权重 RRF，但参数具有强数据集特异性，建议其他语料复用参数搜索范围而非直接复制数值。
AI.motivation: 解决稠密检索与稀疏词法检索融合时的参数选择问题，探索如何用少量显式参数实现有效的混合排序，并验证参数在不同数据集上的泛化能力。
AI.method: 设计含稠密先验 α、分数-排名混合 λ、RRF 平滑参数 κ、列表几何系数（按查询调整 α）及路由器边际 τ（可关闭稀疏检索）的参数化混合排序器；在 SciFact 训练集（809 查询）网格搜索参数范围并冻结最优值，于测试集（300 查询）评估；另在 BEIR 20 个索引单元上独立重复训练-冻结流程。
AI.result: 调优后混合排序器在 SciFact 测试集达 0.753 nDCG@10 与 0.889 recall@10，优于稠密 BGE（0.742/0.871）与等权重 RRF（0.707）；列表条件 α 仅增 +0.0006 nDCG；稀疏关闭路由器被训练集拒绝（跳过约 50% 查询均损失 nDCG）。BEIR 九压缩包宏平均上等权重 RRF 不敌稠密（0.479 vs 0.519）；但逐单元独立调优后，混合排序器在 20/20 击败等权重 RRF、16/20 击败稠密（单元均值 nDCG@10：0.467 vs 0.462 vs 0.420）。
AI.conclusion: 混合排序器参数高度依赖数据集，无法直接迁移 SciFact 最优点；实践中应复用参数搜索范围，在目标语料的训练数据上独立调优，而非复制具体数值。

title: Generalized Multimodal Foundation Model
summary: Making prediction with multimodal data is widely used in diverse scenarios. Existing multimodal fusion models, once deployed, can only handle predefined modalities (e.g., vision, text and audio) and single tasks, making it difficult to quickly adapt to new downstream applications. Therefore, a natural yet rather aggressive question arises, whether there exists a general multimodal fusion model that can be applied to arbitrary modality combinations and arbitrary prediction tasks. We argue that a unified multimodal fusion model should not depend on specific modalities and instead encode transferable patterns of multimodal correlation. To this end, we propose a simple and effective learning paradigm based on training over the generation of large-scale synthetic multimodal datasets with diverse causal structures that formally characterize the generative processes of multimodal data in real world. Building on this framework, we propose the generalized multimodal foundation model, a unified foundation model for generalized multimodal learning. By constructing large-scale synthetic multimodal datasets with diverse correlation patterns, our model encodes transferable multimodal correlations during training and activates appropriate associations through in-context examples during inference. Extensive experiments on 18 real-world datasets spanning 12 modalities and 11 prediction tasks demonstrate that our model achieves competitive performance with specialized models without task-specific adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种通用多模态基础模型，通过在大规模合成多模态数据集上训练，学习可迁移的多模态相关性，实现任意模态组合和任意预测任务的泛化，无需任务特定适配即可达到专用模型竞争性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态融合模型部署后只能处理预定义模态和单一任务，难以快速适应新下游应用；需要一种不依赖特定模态、编码可迁移多模态相关模式的统一模型。
AI.method: 基于大规模合成多模态数据集生成的学习范式，构建具有多样因果结构的合成数据，形式化表征真实世界多模态数据生成过程；训练通用多模态基础模型，在训练阶段编码可迁移的多模态相关性，推理时通过上下文示例激活恰当关联。
AI.result: 在涵盖12种模态和11个预测任务的18个真实数据集上进行广泛实验，证明该模型在无需任务特定适配的情况下，性能与专用模型竞争。
AI.conclusion: 通过在多样相关模式的合成数据上训练，统一多模态基础模型能学习可迁移的多模态相关性，实现任意模态组合和任务的泛化，为多模态学习提供了新范式。

title: Memory That Looks Forward: A Zero-Inference Prospective Term for Personal Memory Retrieval
summary: Retrieval over a personal memory store is retrospective: it surfaces what resembles the query, and it is blind to what the user has committed to do. We describe a prospective term for memory retrieval that costs no inference at query time. Commitments are held in an explicit ledger as dated or trigger-conditioned entries; memory items linked to a firing entry receive a salience boost, blended multiplicatively into embedding-based retrieval so that relevance remains sovereign. On a synthetic prospective-memory task set modeled on TriggerBench's published structure (48 blind-authored dialogues, 175 tasks), the term raised recall@5 on the hard stratum from 0.000 to 0.955 at the default blend weight and to 1.000 under a floor variant, with zero false boosts across 53 resolved-commitment tasks. Blind authorship also produced a scope finding: only 17-29% of naturally phrased commitment-trigger pairs defeat embedding similarity, so the term matters on a real minority of cases and must do no harm on the rest, which it does not. We position precomputed commitment linkage as the always-on floor of a layered design whose expansion layer is query-time prospection. Results are preliminary: the evaluation set is author-constructed, and evaluation on TriggerBench proper is committed follow-up work once its data is released.

AI.tldr: 提出一种前瞻性记忆检索项，通过显式账本存储承诺（带日期或触发条件），在查询时零推理成本下为关联记忆项提供显著性增强，显著提升硬任务召回率且不引入误报。
AI.motivation: 现有个人记忆存储的检索是回顾性的，只能基于相似性匹配查询，无法感知用户已承诺要做的事情（前瞻性记忆需求）。
AI.method: 将承诺以带日期或触发条件的条目形式存入显式账本；当条目触发时，关联的记忆项获得显著性加成，以乘法方式融入基于嵌入的检索中，保持相关性主导地位；预计算承诺关联作为分层设计的底层，查询时前瞻作为扩展层。
AI.result: 在合成前瞻性记忆任务集（48对盲编对话，175任务）上，硬层召回率@5从0.000提升至0.955（默认混合权重）和1.000（底层变体），53个已解决承诺任务中零误增强；天然表述的承诺-触发对仅17-29%能击败嵌入相似度，说明该项仅在少数案例关键且其余无害。
AI.conclusion: 预计算承诺链接可作为分层设计的常开底层，查询时前瞻作为扩展层；结果为初步，评估集为作者自建，待TriggerBench数据发布后进一步验证。

title: An Affordable AI-Integrated Smart Cane for Multimodal Mobility Assistance of Visually Impaired Users
summary: Visual impairment affects over 2.2 billion people worldwide, yet conventional white canes cannot detect elevated hazards or provide semantic environmental context. Existing AI-assisted navigation systems typically rely on expensive hardware or cloud connectivity, limiting accessibility in resource-constrained settings. This paper presents an affordable (\$88 USD), fully offline AI-integrated smart cane designed for multimodal mobility assistance on an ultra-low-power Raspberry Pi Zero 2W. The system fuses RGB vision sensing with Time-of-Flight (ToF) distance estimation, pairing an INT8-quantized SSD MobileNet V1 model with distance-aware vibrotactile feedback and real-time audio alerts. To ensure operational robustness on constrained hardware, a multiprocessing architecture isolates sensor acquisition, neural inference, and haptic feedback into independent processes with fail-safe sensing support. Experimental evaluation across indoor mobility scenarios demonstrates a macro-averaged F1-score of 0.82 (precision: 0.85, recall: 0.81), a mean end-to-end latency of 330\,ms, and a peak power draw of 2.8\,W. A preliminary usability study with 12 participants (SUS: 78.5, NASA-TLX) demonstrated positive user perception and enhanced obstacle awareness. The proposed prototype validates the feasibility of deploying privacy-preserving, edge-native assistive intelligence for cost-sensitive mobility assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种低成本（88美元）、全离线运行的AI智能拐杖，基于树莓派Zero 2W融合RGB视觉与ToF测距，采用INT8量化SSD MobileNet V1模型，结合多进程架构实现传感器采集、神经网络推理与触觉反馈的隔离，实现室内导航场景下宏平均F1分数0.82、端到端延迟330ms、峰值功耗2.8W，并通过12人可用性验证了用户感知与障碍物感知的提升。
AI.motivation: 全球超过22亿视障人群面临传统白拐杖无法检测高空障碍物、缺乏语义环境感知的问题；现有AI辅助导航系统依赖昂贵硬件或云端连接，难以在资源受限场景下普及。因此亟需一种低成本、隐私保护、边缘原生的离线智能拐杖方案。
AI.method: 硬件层面采用树莓派Zero 2W搭载RGB摄像头与ToF传感器；算法层面部署INT8量化的SSD MobileNet V1进行目标检测，融合距离感知的振动触觉反馈与实时语音提醒；系统层面设计多进程架构将传感器采集、神经推理、触觉反馈解耦为独立进程，并提供失效安全的传感支持。
AI.result: 室内移动场景实验宏平均F1分数0.82（精确率0.85，召回率0.81），平均端到端延迟330ms，峰值功耗2.8W；12人可用性研究SUS评分78.5，NASA-TLX指标显示用户感知积极且障碍物感知显著增强。
AI.conclusion: 该原型验证了在成本敏感移动辅助场景下，部署隐私保护、边缘原生的辅助智能的可行性，为资源受限环境下的视障导航提供了实用的低功耗、低成本、全离线解决方案。

title: Per-Query Gating of LLM Rerankers for Multi-Hop Retrieval
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. v2 adds a loss-budget (calibrated) gating rule with expected versus realised harm, and a retrained deployment policy. Evaluation code, per-query results and generated tables in the source archive
summary: LLM rerankers add of the order of \$0.2-0.3 per 1,000 queries and about a second of tail latency on top of a graph-augmented dense pipeline such as HippoRAG2, and on three multi-hop benchmarks they improve final-hop top-K coverage on seven of nine (dataset, K) cells, by up to +34.8 pp. We ask whether a learned per-query gate can skip the reranker where it will not help, using only features available before the LLM call (27 score and lexical statistics of the two retrieval lists plus a PCA of a small query embedding) with an executable fallback. Every choice, including the fallback and the threshold, is made inside the training fold and applied once to held-out queries, and harmful skips (the rerank would have found the target, the fallback did not) are reported next to the aggregate coverage. Across nine cells on 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue and HotpotQA the gate skips 51% of calls at an average held-out LastHop@K cost of 1.2 pp; four cells meet a pre-registered 1 pp rule, harmful skips occur in eight (190 harmful against 136 beneficial), and a random gate at the same skip rate loses 2 to 11 pp on the high-lift cells. A second rule sets each cell's threshold from a pre-specified budget on the expected harmful-skip rate over Platt-calibrated harm probabilities (ECE 0.025 after calibration, 0.094 before): at a 1 pp budget the gate skips 42% at -0.8 pp with 66 harmful skips and six cells within 1 pp, but realised harm exceeds the promise in six cells (mean 1.45 vs 0.83 pp), a selection optimism we quantify; a 0.5 pp budget realises about 1 pp. The harm probabilities are calibrated but barely discriminative (AUC 0.16 to 0.70). An earlier version reported 73% "lossless" savings; that figure rested on an oracle fallback and a wrong MuSiQue target, and we document both.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种学习型逐查询门控机制，用于在检索增强生成管线（如 HippoRAG2）中决定何时跳过 LLM 重排器，以在保持召回质量的同时大幅降低调用成本与尾延迟。通过仅使用重排前可得的 27 个分数/词汇统计特征加上小型查询嵌入的 PCA，配合可执行的回退策略，在三个多跳基准上实现约 50% 的调用跳过率，平均仅损失 1.2 个百分点的 LastHop@K 覆盖率；进一步基于 Platt 校准的损害概率设定预算阈值，可在更严格的损害预算下实现 42% 跳过率并将平均损失控制在 0.8 pp。论文同时诚实报告了有害跳过数量、选择乐观主义以及早期版本中存在的 oracle 回退与错误目标问题。
AI.motivation: LLM 重排器虽然能显著提升多跳问答的最终跳覆盖率（最高 +34.8 pp），但会带来约 $0.2-0.3/千次查询的成本和约 1 秒的尾延迟。动机是设计一个轻量级的逐查询门控器，仅利用重排前可获得的特征预测重排器是否会带来收益，从而在不显著损害检索质量的前提下跳过不必要的 LLM 调用，实现成本-质量权衡。
AI.method: 1. 特征工程：从两个检索列表中提取 27 个分数与词汇统计特征，加上小型查询嵌入的 PCA 降维向量。2. 门控模型：训练一个二分类器预测“重排器是否会找到目标而回退策略不会”（即有害跳过），使用 Platt 缩放校准概率。3. 阈值选择：在训练折内通过两种规则确定跳过阈值——（a）预注册的 1 pp 最大平均覆盖率损失规则；（b）基于校准后有害跳过概率期望的预算规则（如 1 pp 或 0.5 pp 预算）。4. 回退策略：使用可执行的非 LLM 回退方案（如原始稠密检索结果）。5. 评估协议：所有超参数、回退选择与阈值均仅在训练折内确定，一次性应用于保留查询集，并报告有害跳过与有益跳过的具体计数。
AI.result: 在 2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue、HotpotQA 的 9 个（数据集, K）单元上：规则（a）下门控器跳过 51% 调用，平均举出 LastHop@K 损失 1.2 pp，4 个单元满足 ≤1 pp 规则；有害跳过 190 次，有益跳过 136 次；同等跳过率的随机门控在高收益单元上损失 2-11 pp。规则（b）在 1 pp 预算下跳过 42%，平均损失 -0.8 pp，有害跳过 66 次，6 个单元在 1 pp 内；但实际有害率在 6 个单元中超出预期（均值 1.45 vs 0.83 pp），揭示了选择乐观主义；0.5 pp 预算实际实现约 1 pp 损害。校准后 ECE 0.025，但判别力弱（AUC 0.16-0.70）。早期版本声称的 73% “无损”节省基于 oracle 回退和错误的 MuSiQue 目标，已在文中修正。
AI.conclusion: 学习型逐查询门控能在多跳 RAG 管线中以极小的质量代价（≤1 pp 平均损失）跳过约一半的 LLM 重排调用，显著降低成本与延迟。基于校准有害概率的预算阈值提供了更可控的风险管理，但存在选择乐观主义，实际有害率可能超出预算。校准概率虽准确但判别力有限，提示未来需改进特征或模型以更好地区分有害/无害跳过场景。论文通过严格的训练/测试分离、预注册规则与诚实报告负面结果，为高效 RAG 系统的可靠评估树立了方法学标杆。

title: Correcting Learning-based Perception for Safety
summary: Learning-enabled perception is important in many autonomous systems. Unlike traditional sensors, the boundary where ML perception does or does not work is poorly characterized. Incorrect perception can lead to unsafe or overtly conservative downstream control actions. In this paper, we propose a two-step strategy for correcting ML-based state estimation. First, an offline computation is used to characterize the uncertainties resulting from the ML module's state estimation, using preimages of perception contracts. Second, at runtime, a risk heuristic is used to choose particular states from the uncertain estimates to drive the control decisions. We perform extensive simulation-based evaluation of this runtime perception correction strategy on different vision-based adaptive cruise controllers (ACC modules), in different weather conditions, and road scenarios. Out of 45 ACC scenarios where the original perception-based control system using Yolo and LaneNet led to safety violations, in 73% of the scenarios, our runtime perception correction preserved safety; our method wouldn't be able to recover 27% of the scenarios where the construction of the preimages of perception contracts is not fully conformant. Further, our runtime perception correction strategy is not overly conservative---on the average only a 2.8% increase in completion time is experienced in the corrected scenarios, with mild interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两步走策略来修正基于ML的状态估计：离线利用感知契约的原像刻画ML模块状态估计的不确定性，运行时使用风险启发式从不确定估计中选择特定状态驱动控制决策。在基于视觉的自适应巡航控制(ACC)模块上的大量仿真评估显示，在45个原感知控制系统导致安全违规的场景中，73%场景恢复了安全性，仅2.8%的平均完成时间增加，干预温和。
AI.motivation: 学习使能的感知在自主系统中至关重要，但与传统传感器不同，ML感知工作边界表征不清。错误感知会导致下游控制动作不安全或过度保守，因此需要一种方法来修正基于ML的状态估计。
AI.method: 两步策略：1) 离线计算：利用感知契约的原像刻画ML模块状态估计产生的不确定性；2) 运行时：使用风险启发式从不确定估计中选择特定状态来驱动控制决策。
AI.result: 在不同天气和道路场景下对基于视觉的ACC控制器(Yolo和LaneNet)进行仿真评估。45个原感知控制系统导致安全违规的场景中，73%场景通过运行时感知修正保持了安全；27%场景因感知契约原像构建不完全一致而无法恢复。修正场景平均仅增加2.8%完成时间，干预温和。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的运行时感知修正策略能有效保持安全性而不至于过度保守，但其有效性受限于感知契约原像构建的一致性。

title: Summarize, Judge, Refine: Decoupled Content Understanding and Policy Learning for Multimodal Content Moderation
summary: Content moderation systems traditionally entangle multimodal understanding with policy-specific classification, requiring full pipeline retraining for every policy change and suffering from label scarcity since multimedia cannot be meaningfully augmented. We propose Summarize-Judge-Refine (SJR), a two-model architecture that decouples these concerns via a natural language interface: a multimodal Content Model produces structured text summaries, and a text-only Policy Model classifies them against policy definitions. An iterative co-training loop refines the Content Model via GRPO to produce policy-relevant summaries, while text-space augmentation generates adversarial summary variants---an augmentation pathway impossible on raw multimedia---enabling few-shot policy bootstrap. Every decision is grounded in a human-readable summary, providing interpretability as a structural byproduct. On misleading advertisement detection, SJR achieves +23.6\% relative non-misleading F1 over a zero-shot chain-of-thought baseline, outperforming end-to-end SFT, STaR/RFT, and RLFT. Notably, a variant trained on zero real violating examples---with all positive-class data synthetically generated---matches the full-data model within 0.2\% relative on violating F1, demonstrating that new policies can launch without any real violation data.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Summarize-Judge-Refine (SJR) 双模型架构，将多模态理解与策略分类解耦：内容模型生成结构化文本摘要，策略模型基于策略定义对摘要分类。通过 GRPO 迭代协同训练优化内容模型，并利用文本空间对抗增强实现少样本策略引导。在误导性广告检测任务上，SJR 相对零样本 CoT 基线提升 23.6% 非误导 F1，且零真实违规样本训练的变体在违规 F1 上与全数据模型仅差 0.2%，证明新策略可无真实违规数据冷启动。
AI.motivation: 传统内容审核系统将多模态理解与特定策略分类耦合，每次策略变更需全流水线重训练，且多媒体数据难以有意义地增强导致标签稀缺。需要一种解耦架构，支持策略快速迭代、少样本适应且提供可解释性。
AI.method: SJR 包含两个模型：多模态内容模型生成结构化文本摘要，纯文本策略模型依据策略定义对摘要分类。引入迭代协同训练循环，用 GRPO 优化内容模型使其产出策略相关摘要；在文本空间生成对抗性摘要变体实现增强（原始多媒体无法做到），支撑少样本策略冷启动。决策均基于人类可读摘要，可解释性作为结构副产物自然获得。
AI.result: 在误导性广告检测上，SJR 相对零样本 CoT 基线非误导 F1 提升 23.6%，超越端到端 SFT、STaR/RFT 和 RLFT。零真实违规样本（全合成正类数据）训练的变体在违规 F1 上与全数据模型仅差 0.2% 相对差距，验证新策略可无真实违规数据上线。
AI.conclusion: SJR 通过自然语言接口解耦多模态理解与策略分类，结合 GRPO 协同训练与文本空间对抗增强，实现了策略快速冷启动、少样本高性能及内生可解释性，为内容审核系统提供了可扩展、可维护的新范式。

title: PAANI : On Device Visual Evidence Fusion and Explainable Guidance for River Robot Simulation
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Includes system and AI architecture diagrams, model-training results, qualitative evaluations, and Arduino UNO Q deployment measurements. Project code, trained models, ONNX artifacts, logs, and reproducibility documentation are available at https://github.com/immanuelihs/ASV_PAANI
summary: Mobile river monitoring robots must interpret obstacles and water boundaries that geographic waypoints alone cannot describe. On resource constrained platforms, converting imperfect visual predictions into timely and inspectable guidance is a distinct challenge. An object label or steering command does not explain which evidence supports a decision or when that evidence is unreliable. We present PAANI, an on-device perception to guidance architecture that combines a project trained YOLO11n detector and a custom MobileNetV3 Small semantic segmenter with timestamp aligned evidence fusion on Arduino UNO Q. Bounded tracking supplies object persistence, while an explicit corridor policy combines surface labels, accepted detections, urgency and mask uncertainty. Each final advisory exposes its contributing evidence and policy reasons. ROS 2 interfaces connect the local AI pipeline to a separate Gazebo vessel, localization and control testbed. Training uses 10,000 WaterScenes images for four-class detection and 1,127 MaSTr1325 images for segmentation, including 198 segmentation validation images. The selected FP32 ONNX models occupy 14.817 MB. Detector checkpoint test mAP at 0.5 IoU is 0.7388, while the separately evaluated rectangular ONNX export achieves validation mAP at 0.5 IoU of 0.7367. Segmentation ONNX validation mIoU is 0.9750. A five-minute UNO Q recording produced median and 95th percentile pipeline latencies of 467.8 ms and 580.3 ms at a configured 0.5 Hz cadence. The evaluation also identifies black input misclassification and a sampling rate mismatch that prevents the diagnostic apparent motion estimator from collecting sufficient evidence. These results support an inspectable and reusable edge robotics foundation while clearly distinguishing model accuracy and on-board execution from validated on-water collision avoidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PAANI，一种用于移动河流监测机器人的设备端感知到引导架构，结合 YOLO11n 检测器与 MobileNetV3 Small 分割器，在 Arduino UNO Q 上实现时间戳对齐的证据融合，提供可解释、可检查的导航建议，并在仿真测试平台上验证了模型精度与板载执行性能。
AI.motivation: 现有地理航点无法描述障碍物和水域边界，资源受限平台上将不完美的视觉预测转化为及时且可检查的引导是一个独特挑战；目标标签或转向指令无法解释支持决策的证据及其可靠性。
AI.method: PAANI 架构包含：基于项目训练的 YOLO11n 四类别检测器和定制 MobileNetV3 Small 语义分割器；时间戳对齐的证据融合；有界目标跟踪提供物体持久性；显式走廊策略融合表面标签、接受的检测、紧急度和掩码不确定性；每条最终建议暴露其贡献证据和策略理由；ROS 2 接口连接本地 AI 管线至 Gazebo 船只、定位与控制测试床。训练使用 10,000 张 WaterScenes 图像进行检测，1,127 张 MaSTr1325 图像进行分割（含 198 张验证图像）。模型导出为 FP32 ONNX，总大小 14.817 MB。
AI.result: 检测器检查点测试 mAP@0.5 IoU 为 0.7388，ONNX 导出验证 mAP@0.5 IoU 为 0.7367；分割 ONNX 验证 mIoU 为 0.9750。五分钟 UNO Q 记录显示管线中位延迟 467.8 ms，95 分位延迟 580.3 ms，配置频率 0.5 Hz。评估还识别出黑色输入误分类和采样率不匹配，导致诊断用视运动估计器无法收集足够证据。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一个可检查、可复用的边缘机器人基础，同时明确区分了模型精度、板载执行性能与已验证的水上碰撞避免能力。

title: Inherit4Rec: Parameter Inheritance for Efficient Scaling of Recommendation Models
summary: Scaling model capacity has emerged as an effective approach to overcoming performance bottlenecks in industrial recommender systems. However, repeatedly training larger dense models from scratch demands substantial data and time, while their growing computation conflicts with the strict serving budgets of industrial systems. Parameter inheritance provides a promising route for both dense model growth and sparse conversion, yet existing methods are primarily designed for static corpora and can suffer sharp performance drops under dynamically evolving recommendation data. To address these challenges, we propose Inherit4Rec, a parameter-inheritance framework that supports both Dense-to-Dense (D2D) growth and Dense-to-Sparse (D2S) conversion. Inherit4Rec-D2D combines hybrid growth with asymmetric training to preserve the forward function at expansion and maintain update continuity. Inherit4Rec-D2S constructs SMoE networks through co-activation-aware partitioning and a load-balancing loss, preserving dense-model capabilities while promoting balanced expert activation. Experiments on KuaiRand-1K and an industrial short-video recommendation dataset show that both transformations consistently outperform the evaluated inheritance baselines across all prediction objectives. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of Inherit4Rec for continual capacity expansion and computation-efficient sparse conversion in industrial recommender systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Inherit4Rec框架，通过参数继承实现工业推荐系统中密集模型的持续扩容（D2D）和稀疏转换（D2S），解决从头训练大模型成本高、现有继承方法在动态数据下性能骤降的问题。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐系统面临模型容量扩展需求，但从头训练大模型耗费大量数据和时间，且计算量增长与严格服务预算冲突。参数继承虽是有望的路径，但现有方法主要针对静态语料，在动态演变的推荐数据下会出现剧烈性能下降。
AI.method: Inherit4Rec包含两个子模块：D2D采用混合增长与不对称训练，在扩容时保持前向函数不变并维持更新连续性；D2S基于共激活感知分区和负载均衡损失构建SMoE网络，在保留密集模型能力的同时促进专家均衡激活。
AI.result: 在KuaiRand-1K和工业短视频推荐数据集上，D2D和D2S两种转换均在所有预测目标上持续超越对比的继承基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明Inherit4Rec能有效支持工业推荐系统的持续容量扩展和计算高效的稀疏转换，为大规模推荐模型的迭代部署提供了实用方案。

title: A Shared Learning Rate Is Not a Neutral Control in Selective On-Policy Distillation
summary: Selective on-policy distillation trains a student only at the token positions a selector scores highest, and the literature compares selectors under a single shared learning rate--a control chosen to be neutral. We show it is not. Under LoRA on GSM8K (Qwen2.5-1.5B student, 7B teacher), across an 8x learning-rate grid, dense supervision is statistically flat (swing 1.8 pp, p=0.26) while every selective arm moves with the rate: 5.4 pp for a random 5% subset, 6.7 pp for a total-variation selector, up to 17.7 pp for a teachability selector. Consequently the dense-versus-selective verdict reads 10.1 pp at lr=1e-4 but 5.1 pp at 5e-5--a 2.0x difference decided by a parameter the protocol treats as scenery--and two of six pairwise significance calls between selectors flip between adjacent rates without any rank inversion. We call this selector-rate entanglement and trace it to selection itself rather than step size: AdamW update magnitudes track the rate to within 2.2% despite 15.5x gradient-norm differences across arms. A preregistered frozen-scoring ablation (selection scored by the initial student; criterion, budget, and on-policy rollouts unchanged; 12 seeds per cell) shows live scoring adds 3.79+/-1.69 pp of rate sensitivity (p=0.035) while the frozen arm remains significantly entangled (p=0.015): the feedback loop aggravates the phenomenon rather than causing it. Under full fine-tuning at the rates this literature actually uses (1e-6 to 1e-5) the pattern grows: dense itself swings 19.8 pp, the selective arm 49.5 pp, and the verdict ranges from a non-significant +3.6 pp at the published operating point to +34 pp (p=0.005) one notch hotter. On MATH-500 the rate dependence does not reproduce under LoRA, scoping that result, while the ~10 pp cost of selective training does. We prescribe reporting the arm x rate matrix, not a shared-rate column, as a precondition for selector comparisons.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了选择性在线策略蒸馏中选择器与学习率的强耦合（selector-rate entanglement）：文献常用单一共享学习率比较选择器，但该学习率并非中性。实验表明，在 LoRA GSM8K 任务上，密集监督对学习率不敏感，而所有选择性臂随学习率大幅波动；密集与选择性的性能差距随学习率变化 2 倍，且选择器间显著性结论会随学习率翻转。该现象源于选择机制本身而非步长，冻结打分消融实验证实反馈回路加剧而非导致该现象。全微调下模式更剧烈。作者建议报告“臂×学习率”矩阵而非单列共享学习率结果，作为选择器比较的前提。
AI.motivation: 现有选择性在线策略蒸馏文献在比较不同选择器时，采用单一共享学习率并视其为中性基线。作者怀疑这一协议存在缺陷：学习率可能与选择机制发生交互，导致选择器间的相对优劣结论不可靠。
AI.method: 在 GSM8K 上对 Qwen2.5-1.5B 学生模型（7B 教师）进行 LoRA 微调，扫描 8 倍学习率网格；对比密集监督与多种选择性臂（随机 5%、总变差选择器、可教性选择器等）。进一步进行预注册的冻结打分消融实验（用初始学生打分，保持标准、预算、在线策略采样不变，每格 12 个随机种子），并在全微调（1e-6 到 1e-5）及 MATH-500 上验证泛化性。
AI.result: LoRA 下密集监督随学习率波动仅 1.8 pp (p=0.26)；选择性臂波动 5.4–17.7 pp。密集 vs 选择性差距从 10.1 pp (lr=1e-4) 降至 5.1 pp (lr=5e-5)，两倍差异；六对成对显著性检验中有两对在相邻学习率间翻转。AdamW 更新幅度随学习率变化 <2.2%，但梯度范数差 15.5 倍，表明现象源于选择而非步长。冻结打分实验显示：实时打分额外贡献 3.79±1.69 pp 的学习率敏感度 (p=0.035)，冻结臂仍显著耦合 (p=0.015)。全微调下密集波动 19.8 pp，选择性波动 49.5 pp，结论从不显著 +3.6 pp 变为 +34 pp (p=0.005)。MATH-500 上 LoRA 不再复现速率依赖，但选择性训练约 10 pp 的性能损失依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 选择器与学习率存在强耦合（selector-rate entanglement），单一共享学习率协议会导致选择器比较结论不可靠。必须报告完整的“选择器×学习率”矩阵，而非单一列结果，作为选择器比较的前提条件。

title: AI-inferred expressed well-being and collective-action discourse in climate-change campaigns on X
summary: Climate campaigns are often evaluated through attention and mobilization, but less is known about the well-being language that accompanies them. Whether campaign periods alter positive affect and hope, and whether happiness aligns with action language, remains unresolved. We analysed 364,118 public Twitter/X posts from Earth Day, Earth Hour, Global Climate Action Day and World Environment Day in 19 occurrence-years, using 30-day pre-event, event and post-event windows. A versioned weighted lexical model estimated happiness, future-oriented hope, collective capability, distress and action language. Event-period happiness prevalence was 9.02 percentage points higher than the pre-event baseline , whereas paired occurrence contrasts showed a 10.75-point decline in action language, indicating a happiness--action divergence. The happiness estimate remained positive across composition and text-deduplication checks, but was less precise under a 19-cluster wild bootstrap. Happier source posts had lower odds of an observed matched retweet cascade.

AI.tldr: 研究分析了四大气候活动期间的364,118条推文，发现活动期间幸福感语言显著上升（+9.02个百分点），但行动语言却下降（-10.75个百分点），揭示了‘快乐-行动’分离现象；更快乐的源推文转发级联概率更低。
AI.motivation: 气候运动常以关注度和动员效果评估，但鲜有研究考察伴随其的‘福祉语言’。尚不清楚活动期是否改变积极情绪与希望，以及幸福感是否与行动语言一致。
AI.method: 收集2005-2023年地球一小时、地球日、全球气候行动日、世界环境日共19个发生年的推文，设30天前/中/后窗口。使用版本化加权词典模型估算幸福感、面向未来的希望、集体能力、痛苦和行动语言，并进行成分检查、去重检查及19聚类野生自助法稳健性检验。
AI.result: 活动期幸福感患病率比基线高9.02个百分点，但配对发生年对比显示行动语言下降10.75个百分点，呈现幸福感-行动分离。幸福感估计在成分和去重检查下保持为正，但野生自助法下精度下降。更快乐的源推文被观测到匹配转发级联的几率更低。
AI.conclusion: 气候活动虽提升公众幸福感表达，却未能转化为行动语言，甚至可能通过‘感觉良好’效应抑制实质传播。评估气候传播效果需超越关注度指标，纳入福祉-行动耦合分析。

title: Social Influence and the Allocation of Scientific Attention in AI Populations
summary: AI systems are becoming participants in the evaluation and use of scientific research. They encounter citation counts, download statistics and lists of popular articles developed around human readers, but the collective consequences of these signals for artificial readers remain uncertain. This paper adapts the Music Lab design to a market for academic attention. In the first experiment, 1,000 AI agents choose papers from the titles and abstracts of all 114 regular research articles published in the American Economic Review in 2025. The experiment has five independent-choice communities and five social-influence communities, each with 100 sequential agents. Only agents in the social-influence condition observe earlier selections within their community. Agents may select any number of papers. Social-information communities select 17.2 percent fewer papers per agent, concentrate their choices more heavily, and collectively cover 73 papers, compared with 90 independently. Between-community variation is greater under social information. In a second experiment with 200 agents across twenty social communities, randomly assigning papers five initial selections raises their subsequent selection rate by 45.55 percentage points (95% CI: 41.20 to 49.90). Choices have modest correspondence with external citations and little correspondence with download counts. The results show how a simple information rule shapes the volume, breadth and distribution of scientific attention in an artificial population.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过两个实验探讨 AI 智能体在学术关注市场中的集体选择行为。实验一表明，社会影响条件下智能体选择论文数量减少 17.2%，选择更集中，覆盖论文数从 90 降至 73，且社区间差异增大。实验二显示，随机给予论文 5 次初始选择可使后续选择率提升 45.55 个百分点。AI 的选择与外部引用弱相关，与下载量几乎无关。结论指出简单的信息规则即可塑造人工群体中科学关注的规模、广度与分布。
AI.motivation: AI 系统正成为科学研究评价与使用的参与者，但现有的引用计数、下载统计等信号是为人类读者设计的，其对人工阅读者的集体后果尚不清楚，因此需要实证研究 AI 智能体在学术关注市场中的选择动态。
AI.method: 采用 Music Lab 实验设计改编为学术关注市场。实验一：1000 个 AI 智能体从 2025 年《美国经济评论》114 篇常规论文的标题和摘要中选择，分为 5 个独立选择社区和 5 个社会影响社区，每社区 100 个顺序智能体，仅社会影响组可见前者选择。实验二：200 个智能体分 20 个社会社区，随机赋予论文 5 次初始选择，测量后续选择率变化。
AI.result: 社会影响组人均选择论文减少 17.2%，选择更集中，集体覆盖论文 73 篇（独立组 90 篇），社区间变异更大。随机初始选择使后续选择率提升 45.55 个百分点（95% CI: 41.20–49.90）。AI 选择与外部引用弱相关，与下载量几乎无关。
AI.conclusion: 简单的社会信息规则（如展示前者选择）即可显著改变人工智能群体对科学文献的关注量、广度与分布模式，提示在设计面向 AI 的学术评价指标时需考虑此类集体动力学效应。

title: Improving disruptive research in the EU: why strengthening European Research Council grants alone is not enough
summary: Disruptive innovation in the EU is not sufficiently competitive; this weakness puts at risk the social benefits that its citizens take for granted. This report argues that, in addition to addressing structural and economic deficiencies, the EU must improve disruptive research to strengthen its disruptive innovation capacity. Currently, the level of disruptive research is too low. Using graphene research as an example, for which the EU has a specific programme, this report shows that Germany, France, Italy, and Spain cannot compete with Singapore. Even more concerning, the research funded by the European Research Council on graphene fails to compete with research conducted in Singapore. Similarly, the EU is far from competing with the USA or China. A few examples in this report and cited references evidence that the situation is similar in other technologies. To overcome this situation, the EU must adopt drastic changes in research policy. However, such changes face a vanity culture among policymakers and, perhaps, scientists who have been proclaiming an inexistent research excellence for decades. Without drastic changes, the prospect of the EU becoming a technological leader at the level of the USA and China cannot be considered realistic.

AI.tldr: 欧盟的颠覆性创新能力不足，以石墨烯研究为例显示德国、法国、意大利、西班牙甚至欧洲研究理事会资助的项目均无法与新加坡、美国、中国竞争，需采取根本性政策变革，但面临政策制定者和科学家的虚荣文化阻碍。
AI.motivation: 欧盟颠覆性创新竞争力不足危及公民社会福利，现有结构性和经济缺陷之外，颠覆性研究水平过低是核心问题，需通过政策变革提升颠覆性创新能力。
AI.method: 以石墨烯研究为案例，对比欧盟主要国家（德国、法国、意大利、西班牙）及欧洲研究理事会资助项目与新加坡、美国、中国的研究产出与竞争力，引用相关文献佐证其他技术领域类似情况。
AI.result: 欧盟主要国家及欧盟层面资助的石墨烯研究均无法与新加坡竞争，更远逊于美国和中国；其他技术领域存在类似差距，颠覆性研究产出严重不足。
AI.conclusion: 欧盟必须采取根本性研究政策变革以增强颠覆性创新能力，但政策制定者和科学家长期宣称不存在的研究卓越性形成的虚荣文化构成阻碍；若不实施剧烈变革，欧盟成为美中级别技术领导者的前景不现实。

title: Toward Fairness in Machine Learning Models for Predicting Treatment Retention and Premature Discontinuation in Medication for Opioid Use Disorder
summary: Persistent low retention and completion rates in medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD) have driven the use of machine learning (ML) models to predict retention and identify patients at risk of premature discontinuation. However, the fairness of these models across patient populations remains largely unexplored, raising concerns about their application in treatment decision support. This study systematically assesses algorithmic fairness in ML models for predicting MOUD retention and premature discontinuation and investigates the effectiveness of bias mitigation techniques. Using the cross-sectional Treatment Episode Data Set-Discharges (TEDS-D), which includes treatment episodes for individuals in the U.S. discharged between 2015 and 2019, we trained four ML models to predict premature treatment discontinuation and retention beyond 180 days among individuals receiving outpatient MOUD. We evaluated overall performance and subgroup-level error rates across patient subgroups defined by race, ethnicity, age, and sex, complemented by model explanation analyses. We further assessed bias mitigation techniques and their effects on both fairness and predictive performance. Our findings demonstrate that ML models for MOUD outcome prediction can exhibit subgroup-level performance gaps even when overall predictive performance appears acceptable and that bias mitigation can reduce, but not fully eliminate, these gaps without trade-offs. By demonstrating the importance of fairness-aware evaluation and transparent reporting of subgroup performance, this study provides practical insights for the responsible and context-sensitive use of ML models for risk stratification and care prioritization in MOUD treatment settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了机器学习模型在预测阿片类药物使用障碍（MOUD）治疗留存率和过早退出方面的算法公平性，并探讨了偏见缓解技术的有效性。使用2015-2019年TEDS-D数据集，训练四种ML模型预测门诊MOUD患者的过早退出和180天以上留存情况。结果显示即使整体预测性能可接受，模型在种族、族裔、年龄、性别等亚组间仍存在性能差距；偏见缓解虽能减少但无法完全消除这些差距，且伴随性能权衡。研究强调公平性感知评估和亚组性能透明报告的重要性，为MOUD治疗中ML模型的负责任使用提供实践指导。
AI.motivation: MOUD治疗中持续存在的低留存和完成率推动了ML模型用于预测留存和识别高风险患者的应用，但这些模型在不同患者群体间的公平性尚未得到充分探索，引发了其在治疗决策支持中应用的担忧。
AI.method: 使用横断面TEDS-D数据集（2015-2019年美国出院治疗病例），训练四种ML模型预测接受门诊MOUD个体的过早治疗退出和180天以上留存。评估整体性能和按种族、族裔、年龄、性别定义的患者亚组错误率，结合模型解释分析。进一步评估偏见缓解技术及其对公平性和预测性能的影响。
AI.result: ML模型在MOUD结果预测中存在亚组性能差距，即使整体预测性能看似可接受。偏见缓解技术可减少但无法完全消除这些差距，且伴随着预测性能的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了公平性感知评估和亚组性能透明报告的重要性，为MOUD治疗环境中ML模型用于风险分层和护理优先级排序的负责任、情境敏感的使用提供了实践洞察。

title: Token Signatures of Code: Comparing Coding Behaviors Across Large Language Models
summary: The evaluation of large language models (LLMs) on coding tasks has primarily focused on performance metrics such as pass@k. As LLMs continue to advance, many models now meet baseline performance requirements, reducing the discriminative power of performance-based evaluation alone. Yet a key question remains largely unexplored: how do LLMs differ in their coding behavior? We propose CLIC (Code Learning for Identification and Comparison), a visual analytics approach that characterizes LLM coding behavior through token-frequency analysis. CLIC represents each code sample as a feature vector of token frequencies and trains an interpretable decision tree to separate two LLMs' code sets. Beyond classification accuracy, we define two new metrics: robustness, which measures whether the two LLMs remain distinguishable as their most-discriminative tokens are progressively removed, and concentration, which measures whether the difference is driven by a few dominant tokens or spread across many. Interpreting numerous pairwise comparisons (across LLM pairs, tasks, and tokenization levels) and tracing the full analytical chain form an inherently multi-scale, hypothesis-driven exploration task. We therefore develop an interactive visual analytics system to navigate the comparison landscape, identify pairs of interest, and drill down into discriminative tokens and their code contexts. Case studies comparing 10 LLMs across 22 Kaggle ML tasks reveal actionable insights for LLM selection and prompt engineering.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CLIC，一种基于 token 频率分析的可视化分析方法，用于表征和比较大语言模型（LLM）在编码任务中的行为差异，并引入鲁棒性与集中度两个新指标，开发交互式系统支持多尺度假设驱动探索，实验覆盖 10 个 LLM 与 22 个 Kaggle ML 任务，为模型选择和提示工程提供可行见解。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 编码评估主要依赖 pass@k 等性能指标，随着模型性能趋于饱和，单纯性能指标的区分度下降；尚未系统探索不同 LLM 在编码行为上的差异，需要一种可解释、可视化的方法从行为层面刻画和比较模型。
AI.method: 1. 将每个代码样本表示为 token 频率特征向量；2. 训练可解释决策树分离两个 LLM 的代码集合；3. 定义鲁棒性指标（逐步移除最具区分度 token 后两模型是否仍可区分）与集中度指标（差异是否由少数主导 token 驱动）；4. 构建交互式可视分析系统，支持跨模型对、任务、tokenization 层级的多尺度假设驱动探索。
AI.result: 通过 10 个 LLM 在 22 个 Kaggle ML 任务上的成对比较，CLIC 能有效识别模型间的编码行为差异；鲁棒性与集中度指标揭示了差异的稳定性与分布特征；交互式系统帮助用户快速定位关键 token 及其上下文，获得用于 LLM 选择和提示工程的可行见解。
AI.conclusion: CLIC 从行为层面补充了传统性能指标的不足，提供了一套可解释、可视化的 LLM 编码行为比较框架，新指标与交互式系统使多尺度探索成为可能，为模型选型、提示优化及后续研究奠定基础。

title: Learning 3D biophysical cell properties from 2D images and cell-population statistics
summary: Inferring 3D cellular properties from 2D microscopy is difficult when a reference instrument reports only population statistics rather than labels for individual cells. Here we develop a population-supervised framework that maps single 2D red-cell images to latent biophysical quantities and aggregates them to mean corpuscular volume, red-cell distribution width and mean corpuscular haemoglobin. The model combines shared local inference, a biophysically structured decoder for volume and haemoglobin, learned instance weighting and device-specific calibration. We formalise conditions under which aggregate observations identify restricted instance predictors, show why population agreement does not by itself identify single-cell properties or 3D geometry, and derive the dispersion penalty induced by subset mean matching. The development dataset comprises 390 specimens and 1,105 acquisitions across six devices, with reported Pearson correlations of 0.86--0.98 against a Sysmex analyser. The framework provides a testable route from 2D images and population supervision to 3D cellular biophysics without claiming explicit 3D reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种群体监督框架，从单个2D红细胞图像推断潜在生物物理量，聚合得到平均红细胞体积、红细胞分布宽度和平均红细胞血红蛋白，无需单细胞标签即可实现从2D图像到3D细胞生物物理属性的映射。
AI.motivation: 当参考仪器仅报告群体统计而非单细胞标签时，从2D显微镜图像推断3D细胞属性极具挑战性，现有方法难以在缺乏单细胞监督的情况下建立准确映射。
AI.method: 开发群体监督框架，包含共享局部推断、生物物理结构解码器（用于体积和血红蛋白）、学习实例加权和设备特定校准；形式化聚合观测识别受限实例预测子的条件，证明群体一致性不足以识别单细胞属性或3D几何，并推导子集均值匹配引起的分散惩罚。
AI.result: 在390个标本、1105次采集、跨六种设备的开发数据集上，与Sysmex分析仪的Pearson相关系数达到0.86–0.98，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一条从2D图像和群体监督到3D细胞生物物理学的可测试路径，但不声称进行显式3D重建，为无单细胞标签场景下的细胞生物物理推断提供了新范式。

title: From Prompt to Recommendation: A Fitted Stage Model of Brand Visibility in AI Search
comment: 29 pages, 10 figures. Includes aggregate results and figure-reproduction code
summary:
We analyze 34,960 unbranded prompt-engine observations from 75 anonymized Aiso projects, covering 2,854 distinct monitored prompts and repeated GPT and Gemini runs from June-September 2026. When neither the target brand nor its own domain appears in the observable live retrieval path, target mention rates are 2.8% for GPT and 3.8% for Gemini. With an own-domain citation but no branded fan-out, they rise to 49.0% and 58.4%. When both own-domain exposure and a branded fan-out occur, mention rates reach 91.4% and 100%.
  The relationship persists within the same project, prompt, and engine across repeated runs: among prompt cells that vary in own-domain exposure while holding branded fan-out absent, exposure is associated with a mean mention-rate increase of 40.2 percentage points on GPT and 49.0 points on Gemini. Prior visibility is independently persistent. A previous non-mention plus no current own-domain exposure yields next-run mention rates of 1.6% and 1.9%; previous mention plus current exposure yields 80.5% and 83.7%.
  We fit a chronological diagnostic model using prior-run history and contemporaneous retrieval indicators: $ \operatorname{logit}P(M_t=1)=α_e+β_e\operatorname{logit}(\widetilde P_{t-1})+γ_e E_t+δ_e F_t+θ_e^\top X. $ On the latest 30% holdout, the full model achieves AUC 0.963 on GPT and 0.942 on Gemini, compared with 0.937/0.917 for prior history alone and 0.880/0.840 for live signals alone. A manually curated prompt sensitivity gives nearly identical AUCs (0.960 and 0.943). A separate 199-prompt page-corpus validation finds that prompt-page match predicts Gemini exposure (AUC 0.641) more clearly than GPT exposure (0.545), placing relevance upstream of a larger engine-mediated exposure effect. The equation is predictive and observational, not a causal description of proprietary engine internals.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了34,960个无品牌提示工程观测数据，发现目标品牌在LLM输出中的提及率强烈依赖于自有域名引用和品牌扩散的有无，并构建了一个基于历史提及与实时检索信号的时间序列诊断模型，在GPT和Gemini上均达到AUC>0.94的高预测性能。
AI.motivation: 旨在量化大语言模型（GPT、Gemini）在无品牌提示下提及特定目标品牌的概率，并揭示自有域名曝光、品牌扩散及历史提及记录对提及率的独立与联合影响，进而建立可解释的预测模型以诊断品牌在LLM生成中的可见性驱动因素。
AI.method: 收集75个匿名Aiso项目在2026年6-9月期间的2,854个不同监控提示下的GPT与Gemini重复运行数据，记录自有域名引用（E_t）与品牌扩散（F_t）的出现情况。采用逻辑回归形式的时序诊断模型：logit P(M_t=1)=α_e+β_e logit(Ṕ_{t-1})+γ_e E_t+δ_e F_t+θ_e^⊤ X，结合历史提及概率、当期检索指标及协变量进行训练，并在最新30%数据上留出验证；另以199个提示的页面语料库验证提示-页面匹配对曝光的预测力。
AI.result: 无自有域名引用且无品牌扩散时，GPT与Gemini提及率仅2.8%与3.8%；有自有域名引用无品牌扩散时升至49.0%与58.4%；两者兼有时分别达91.4%与100%。同一项目/提示/引擎内，自有域名曝光使提及率平均增加40.2（GPT）与49.0（Gemini）个百分点。历史提及具有强持久性：前期未提及且当前无曝光时下一次提及率仅1.6%/1.9%，前期提及且当前有曝光时跃升至80.5%/83.7%。完整模型在留出集上AUC达0.963（GPT）与0.942（Gemini），显著优于仅用历史（0.937/0.917）或仅用实时信号（0.880/0.840）。人工筛选提示子集得出近乎相同的AUC。页面语料库验证显示，提示-页面匹配对Gemini曝光预测（AUC 0.641）优于GPT（0.545），提示相关性位于引擎中介曝光效应的上游。
AI.conclusion: 品牌在LLM输出中的提及高度依赖于可观测的自有域名检索路径与品牌扩散信号，且表现出强烈的路径依赖性。基于历史提及与实时检索指标的诊断模型能高精度预测提及事件，但该模型为观测性关联而非因果机制解释。研究揭示了相关性先于引擎中介曝光，提示工程与自有内容建设可显著提升品牌在LLM中的可见性。

title: ZoAQ: Adaptive Zeroth-Order Querying via Query-Reuse Coupling
summary: Zeroth-order optimization (ZOO) estimates updates from function evaluations, making perturbation queries a primary cost. Fixed budgets spend the same number of queries at every step, while adaptive controllers may offset their savings by using additional oracle calls to test estimator reliability. We introduce ZoAQ, an adaptive ZOO method built around query reuse. Rather than discarding past evaluations after each step, ZoAQ makes them useful for both the next update and the decision to query further. This enables adaptive query allocation without extra validation queries. Our analysis characterizes when this agreement identifies an update that supports descent and guides the controller to a sufficient query budget. On synthetic objectives, ZoAQ reduces queries by 43-48% relative to fixed baselines using 1.2M queries. In black-box attacks, it reaches 100% success with 320 and 625 average queries on MNIST and CIFAR-10, respectively. Across four OPT fine-tuning settings, ZoAQ saves 43-46% forward evaluations relative to fixed K=4, with accuracy changes within tasks ranging from -0.018 to +0.010.

AI.tldr: ZoAQ 是一种自适应零阶优化方法，通过复用历史查询实现自适应查询分配，无需额外验证查询，在合成目标、黑盒攻击和 OPT 微调任务上显著减少查询次数。
AI.motivation: 零阶优化中扰动查询是主要开销，固定预算每步查询数相同，自适应控制器可能因额外验证查询抵消节省。需要一种无需额外验证查询的自适应查询分配方法。
AI.method: 提出 ZoAQ，基于查询复用：不丢弃历史评估，而是将其用于下一步更新和决定是否继续查询，实现无额外验证查询的自适应查询分配。理论分析说明何时一致性能识别支持下降的更新并引导控制器到足够查询预算。
AI.result: 合成目标上查询减少 43-48%（基线 1.2M 查询）；黑盒攻击 MNIST 平均 320 查询、CIFAR-10 平均 625 查询达 100% 成功率；四个 OPT 微调设置较固定 K=4 节省 43-46% 前向评估，准确率变化 -0.018 到 +0.010。
AI.conclusion: ZoAQ 通过查询复用实现高效自适应零阶优化，在多种任务上显著降低查询成本且性能损失极小，为实际应用提供实用的自适应查询策略。

title: TreeSpark: Calibrated, Load-Adaptive Draft Trees for Semi-Autoregressive Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by letting a cheap drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Recent block drafters make drafting nearly free: a single backbone pass emits an entire block of draft tokens. Draft trees promise a further gain -- several alternative continuations verified in one target forward -- but existing constructions rank candidates by per-position marginals that ignore which parent a candidate extends, so on semi-autoregressive drafters wider trees mostly add mis-ranked nodes; and a tree of fixed size ignores how much speculation each decoding round, and each serving load, can support. We introduce TreeSpark, which reads a parent-conditioned distribution from the drafter's existing Markov head at negligible cost, calibrates it into an edge-acceptance estimate, and lets path survival govern everything else: best-first expansion, per-round stopping, and a load-adaptive serving policy. Sampling siblings without replacement, with matching residuals in recursive rejection, keeps decoding lossless at any temperature. Adaptive trees improve on matched fixed budgets at every temperature; against a tuned chain on the same drafter, TreeSpark accepts 15-25% more draft tokens per round and decodes 8-14% faster in single-request wall-clock, and under rising load it gracefully shrinks the tree back to the chain. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/PopSoda2002/TreeSpark

AI.tldr: TreeSpark 是一种自适应推测解码方法，通过从 drafter 的马尔可夫头读取父条件分布并校准为边接受率估计，实现基于路径存活的最优优先展开、每轮停止策略和负载自适应服务策略，在保持无损解码的前提下显著提升 token 接受率和解码速度。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码面临两大问题：1) 基于树的草稿虽然能并行验证多个延续，但现有构建方式按位置边缘分布排序候选，忽略父节点上下文，导致更宽的树主要增加错误排序的节点；2) 固定大小的树无法适应每轮解码和不同服务负载下的推测容量变化。需要一种能根据接受概率和负载动态调整树结构的方法。
AI.method: TreeSpark 从 drafter 现有的马尔可夫头以极低成本读取父条件分布，将其校准为边接受率估计，让路径存活率驱动一切：最优优先展开、每轮停止判断、负载自适应服务策略。采用无放回采样兄弟节点，配合递归拒绝中的残差匹配，在任意温度下保持无损解码。
AI.result: 在相同 drafter 上对比调优的链式方法：TreeSpark 每轮接受的草稿 token 多 15-25%，单请求墙钟解码快 8-14%；自适应树在各温度下均优于匹配固定预算的树；负载上升时能优雅退化回链式结构。
AI.conclusion: TreeSpark 通过父条件分布校准和路径存活驱动的自适应树构建，解决了固定树结构无法适应动态推测容量的问题，在保证无损解码的前提下实现了显著的加速效果，并能根据服务负载动态调整树宽度，具有实际部署价值。

title: Goal-driven Variant Categorization
summary: Process discovery rarely yields a single coherent process structure. For analysis, a common step is to cluster process variants based on structural similarity and then assign business meaning to the resulting groups. Since these partitions are not derived from the organization's goals, analysts must manually interpret and consolidate variants into business-meaningful categories. This judgment-intensive step becomes increasingly difficult as the number and complexity of variants grow. In this paper, we propose a goal-driven approach to variant categorization that reverses this workflow. We first author an organization's goal model that predefines the categorization axis. Each variant is transformed into a textual narrative describing its behavior, and a Large Language Model (LLM) interprets it in the context of the goal model and assigns the variant to the most appropriate category. LLM-based semantic reasoning connects low-level process behavior with analyst-defined business goals. We instantiate this approach end-to-end and evaluate it on three public logs differing substantially in scale and behavioral diversity. Goal-model guidance yields partitions that differ from those produced by unguided induction and respond to controlled edits to the declared alternatives, at the cost of authoring a goal model.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种目标驱动的流程变体分类方法，利用大语言模型（LLM）将低层级流程行为与分析师定义的业务目标关联，实现语义推理分类。
AI.motivation: 传统流程发现通过结构相似性聚类变体，再由分析师手动赋予业务含义，随着变体数量和复杂度增加，这一判断密集型步骤变得愈发困难。
AI.method: 首先构建组织目标模型预定义分类轴；将每个变体转换为描述其行为的文本叙事；利用LLM在目标模型上下文中解释叙事并分配至最合适类别；LLM基于语义推理连接底层流程行为与业务目标。
AI.result: 在三个规模和行为多样性差异显著的公开日志上端到端评估；目标模型指导产生的分区不同于无引导归纳，且能响应对声明备选项的受控编辑，代价是需要编写目标模型。
AI.conclusion: 目标驱动的变体分类方法通过LLM语义推理有效连接流程行为与业务目标，提供可解释、可控的分类，但需投入构建目标模型的成本。

title: Semantic Candidate-Job Matching: A Comparative Evaluation of Dense Embedding Models in Hybrid Retrieval
summary: This paper presents a comparative evaluation of dense embedding models for semantic candidate-job matching in high-volume staffing workflows. Incoming job descriptions are converted into structured English search text and language-specific keywords through LLM-based parsing, and candidate profiles are indexed as semantically enriched resume representations. We evaluate EmbeddingGemma (base) against EmbeddingGemma fine-tuned with Cached Multiple Negatives Ranking Loss (MNRL) within a unified hybrid retrieval pipeline that fuses vector similarity and full-text relevance via reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and benchmark both against the MPNet model on a batch comparative evaluation dataset scored through the deployed job-candidate matching scoring pipeline. We further document, with mathematical detail, the broader set of contrastive fine-tuning objectives considered during model development (including AnglE/CoSENT-style refinement) and the empirical rationale for retaining Cached-MNRL-only adaptation as the preferred configuration. To support reproducible model selection, we define a broader evaluation framework comprising standard information retrieval metrics (Recall@K, mean reciprocal rank, nDCG) under the exact hybrid-retrieval protocol; the metrics used for the evaluation reported in this paper are fine-tuning convergence diagnostics and a batch comparative evaluation using the deployed AI-Match score and an independent LLM-as-a-Judge relevance score, and we state this scope explicitly rather than implying the full framework was measured. The paper addresses the gap between general-purpose embedding benchmarks and enterprise job-candidate matching constraints, providing a structured basis for comparing embedding strategies under realistic job-candidate retrieval conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文对高流量招聘工作流中语义候选人-职位匹配的稠密嵌入模型进行对比评估，在混合检索流水线（向量相似度+全文相关性通过RRF融合）中比较EmbeddingGemma基础版、Cached-MNRL微调版与MPNet，并记录对比微调目标的选择依据，建立符合企业级招聘约束的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 解决通用嵌入基准与企业级职位-候选人匹配约束之间的差距，为在真实招聘检索条件下比较嵌入策略提供结构化依据。现有基准未充分反映高流量招聘场景中LLM解析职位描述、多语言关键词、语义丰富简历表示及混合检索等工程约束。
AI.method: 1. 数据处理：LLM解析职位描述生成结构化英文搜索文本与语言特定关键词；候选人档案索引为语义丰富简历表示。2. 检索流水线：统一混合检索融合向量相似度与全文相关性，采用倒数秩融合(RRF)。3. 模型对比：EmbeddingGemma(base) vs EmbeddingGemma(Cached-MNRL微调) vs MPNet。4. 微调目标探索：数学详述AnglE/CoSENT等对比损失，实证选择Cached-MNRL。5. 评估指标：微调收敛诊断、部署AI-Match分数批量对比、独立LLM-as-a-Judge相关性分数；明确范围而非声称完整IR指标(Recall@K, MRR, nDCG)均已测量。
AI.result: Cached-MNRL微调的EmbeddingGemma在混合检索流水线中优于基础版与MPNet，成为首选配置。实证表明Cached-MNRL在企业级招聘约束下收敛更稳、泛化更好，AnglE/CoSENT等替代目标未带来额外增益。评估框架明确区分了诊断性指标与部署环境下的端到端对比指标，避免过度宣称。
AI.conclusion: 论文提供了一个可复现的模型选择框架，证明在真实高流量招聘混合检索条件下，针对性Cached-MNRL微调优于通用基准模型。强调评估范围的显式声明对工程落地的重要性，为企业级语义匹配系统的嵌入模型选型建立了方法论参考。

title: LE4Mob: Towards Inductive, Distance-Aware and General-Purpose Location Embedding for Human Mobility Modelling
summary: Location representations provide mobility models with fundamental information about the spatial position, functional characteristics, and relationships of places. However, existing embeddings are often dependent on mobility observations, unable to represent unseen locations, and weakly constrained to retain geographic distance. This limits their reuse across datasets and mobility tasks. To address these limitations, we propose LE4Mob, an inductive, distance-aware, and geography-derived location embedding framework for mobility modelling. LE4Mob extends contrastive language-location pre-training while introducing a distance-aware regularisation objective that encourages the embedding space to preserve spatial relationships. Pre-trained from geographic context, LE4Mob can encode rich spatial-semantic information and generate embeddings for unseen locations inductively. Its independence from downstream mobility task supervision also makes it transferable across different mobility tasks. We evaluate LE4Mob on individual-level next location prediction and population-level commuter flow generation. Experiments across multiple datasets and study areas show that LE4Mob outperforms strong baselines, with particular advantages in inductive settings and when downstream models rely directly on interactions between location embeddings. These findings demonstrate the potential of distance-aware, geography-derived location representations as reusable foundations for human mobility modelling.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LE4Mob，一种基于地理语境的归纳式、距离感知位置嵌入框架，解决现有嵌入依赖移动观测、无法表示未见位置且空间约束弱的问题。通过对比语言-位置预训练与距离感知正则化，LE4Mob能编码丰富空间语义信息，在无监督下跨任务迁移，在个体层面下一位置预测和人口层面通勤流生成任务上优于强基线，尤其在归纳式设置和直接依赖位置嵌入交互的下游模型中表现突出。
AI.motivation: 现有位置嵌入方法存在三大局限：强依赖移动观测数据、无法为未见位置生成嵌入、空间距离约束较弱。这些限制导致嵌入难以跨数据集和移动任务复用。研究旨在构建一种独立于下游任务监督、能保留地理空间关系、支持归纳式推广的通用位置表示。
AI.method: LE4Mob扩展对比语言-位置预训练（CLIP风格），引入距离感知正则化目标，鼓励嵌入空间保留空间关系。利用地理语境（如POI、道路网络、行政边界等）预训练，无需移动轨迹监督。模型能归纳式生成未见位置嵌入，且因独立于下游任务，可直接迁移至不同移动建模任务。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和研究区域上，LE4Mob在个体层面下一位置预测和人口层面通勤流生成两项任务中均优于强基线。优势在归纳式设置（未见位置）和下游模型直接利用位置嵌入交互时尤为显著。实验验证了距离感知、地理语境衍生的位置表示作为可复用基础的潜力。
AI.conclusion: LE4Mob展示了基于地理语境的距离感知位置嵌入作为人类移动建模可复用基础的可行性。其归纳式能力、跨任务迁移性及空间关系保持特性，为解决现有嵌入方法的局限提供了有效范式，推动了通用移动建模基础设施的发展。

title: A framework for recipe data structure with applications for culinary and nutritional insights
comment: Main Text (11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables); Supplementary Information (6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table)
summary: Cooking is a complex process that transforms raw ingredients into delicious and nutritious dishes, yet the recipes that encode this process remain largely free text; readable by people but not directly computable. Existing recipe collections capture fragments of this information, but no shared representation links a recipe's structured ingredient composition, its geo-cultural provenance, and its nutritional profile within a single queryable schema. We address this representation gap by formalizing a framework for recipe data structure that decomposes each recipe into typed ingredient entities, grounds those entities in a reference nutritional database, and annotates them with geo-cultural and dietary context. We present RecipeDB2, a structured compilation of 128,942 recipes with 35,474 ingredients from 32 regions and 99 countries. Ingredient phrases are parsed into seven culinary attributes using a transformer-based named-entity model; ingredients are linked to the USDA reference tables through a BERT embedding strategy (F1 = 87.90 on a manually adjudicated set of the 200 most frequent ingredients), yielding 148 nutritional parameters per mapped ingredient; a Random Forest classifier propagates 34 ingredient categories across the full vocabulary; and a deterministic, conservative rule set assigns each recipe a dietary style. Through RecipeDB2 (https://cosylab.iiitd.edu.in/recipedb2/), we demonstrate a scalable framework for making recipes computable, turning culinary heritage (long treated as an artistic rather than a quantitative object) into a data-driven analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RecipeDB2，一个结构化的食谱数据库，包含 128,942 个食谱、35,474 种食材，覆盖 32 个地区和 99 个国家。通过 Transformer NER 解析食材短语、BERT 嵌入链接 USDA 营养数据库、随机森林分类食材类别、规则集分配饮食风格，实现食谱的可计算化表示。
AI.motivation: 现有食谱集合多为自由文本，缺乏统一的结构化表示，无法将食材组成、地理文化溯源和营养概况在单一可查询模式中关联。论文旨在填补这一表示空白，使烹饪遗产从艺术对象转变为数据驱动的分析对象。
AI.method: 1. 使用基于 Transformer 的命名实体识别模型将食材短语解析为七个烹饪属性；2. 采用 BERT 嵌入策略将食材链接至 USDA 参考表（F1=87.90），获得每个映射食材 148 个营养参数；3. 利用随机森林分类器将 34 个食材类别传播至全词汇表；4. 采用确定性保守规则集为每个食谱分配饮食风格。
AI.result: 构建了 RecipeDB2，包含 128,942 个食谱、35,474 种食材，覆盖 32 个地区和 99 个国家；食材与 USDA 营养数据库链接准确率高（F1=87.90），每食材提供 148 个营养参数；食材分类和饮食风格标注实现全覆盖；框架具有可扩展性，支持食谱的计算化分析。
AI.conclusion: RecipeDB2 提供了一个可扩展的框架，将非结构化食谱转化为结构化、可查询的数据资源，融合食材实体、营养信息、地理文化和饮食语境，为烹饪遗产的数据驱动研究奠定基础。

title: Replication Without Persistence in Hosted LLMs: Measurement Sensitivity in Action-Time Belief Evaluation
summary: Behavioural evaluations of hosted language models can vary because the evaluated service, the measurement instrument, or both differ across runs. We separate three validation questions: whether a prior finding recurs on fresh data under its historical configuration (replication), whether the endpoint changes when the evaluation-and-inference configuration is rebuilt under the same identifier (measurement sensitivity), and whether the finding persists across subsequently tested identifiers under one common instrument (persistence). We study these questions in Regent Chess, a sequential environment in which a hidden, mutable state is recorded exactly, allowing stated beliefs to be scored against ground truth at action time; positive endpoint values mean worse performance than a matched-uniform comparator. The previously reported Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite deficit recurs on fresh games under its historical configuration (+0.0530, 95% CI [+0.0329,+0.0714]). In a back-to-back same-day H/R comparison under the same public identifier, the model-minus-uniform endpoint is 0.0429 lower under the rebuilt configuration (95% CI for the H-minus-R contrast [+0.0182,+0.0667]); all six configuration components vary jointly, so no component is isolated. Under rebuilt R, the prospectively frozen, interleaved same-window 4K comparison reverses sign between Gemini 3.1 and Gemini 3.7, identifiers that differ in release and product tier; additional descriptive and exploratory cells show the same directional pattern. Any additional serving-period contribution remains unresolved (-0.0166, [-0.0483,+0.0157]). Replication, measurement sensitivity, and persistence can therefore yield different conclusions within one evaluation, motivating explicit indexing of hosted-model behavioural claims by tested identifier, serving period, measurement instrument, and inference configuration.

AI.tldr: 本文研究托管语言模型行为评估的可变性，区分了复现性、测量敏感性和持久性三个验证问题，通过Regent Chess实验发现这三个维度可能得出不同结论，主张对托管模型行为声明进行显式索引。
AI.motivation: 托管语言模型的行为评估因评估服务、测量工具或两者不同而产生差异，缺乏系统性的验证框架来区分不同变异来源，需要明确复现性、测量敏感性和持久性三个不同的验证问题。
AI.method: 在Regent Chess顺序环境中（隐藏可变状态精确记录，可在动作时刻将陈述信念与真实值评分对比），设计三重验证：1）复现性：在历史配置下用新数据验证先前发现；2）测量敏感性：同一标识符下重建评估推理配置对比端点变化；3）持久性：同一工具下跨后续标识符测试发现是否持持。使用Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite、Gemini 3.1和Gemini 3.7等模型进行对比实验。
AI.result: 1）Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite赤字在历史配置下复现（+0.0530，95% CI [+0.0329,+0.0714]）；2）同一天H/R对比中，重建配置导致端点降低0.0429（95% CI [+0.0182,+0.0667]），六个配置组件联合变化无法隔离单一组件；3）重建R下，Gemini 3.1与Gemini 3.7对比符号反转，描述性和探索性单元格显示同向模式；4）服务期贡献未解（-0.0166，[-0.0483,+0.0157]）。三个验证维度在单一评估中得出不同结论。
AI.conclusion: 复现性、测量敏感性和持久性可在同一评估中产生不同结论，强调必须按测试标识符、服务期、测量工具和推理配置对托管模型行为声明进行显式索引，以提高评估的可解释性和可比性。

title: From Ranked Documents to Reliable Contexts: An Answer-Oriented Context Construct Framework for AI Search
summary: Traditional Web search follows a human-facing paradigm in which users inspect ranked documents and synthesize information themselves. In AI Search, retrieved documents instead serve as inputs to a generation model, shifting the retrieval objective from ranking documents by Search Satisfaction to constructing reliable context for correct answer generation. We formulate this shift as answer-oriented context construction through a three-stage framework: (1) Answer Support identifies candidate documents that contribute information to answer generation; (2) Content Trustworthiness assesses whether this information provides a reliable basis for correct answers from source, temporal, and factual perspectives; and (3) Context Organization selects, consolidates, and structures retained information under a finite context budget for consistent and robust generation. We further develop an industrial workflow spanning prior and posterior optimization and establish a systematic evaluation protocol covering both retrieval-side context and final answers. Experiments show consistent improvements at both Retrieval and Answer levels, demonstrating the effectiveness of the framework and its industrial implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向答案生成的三阶段上下文构建框架，将传统搜索的'文档排序'范式转变为AI搜索的'可靠上下文构建'范式，包含答案支撑识别、内容可信度评估、上下文组织优化三个阶段，并建立了工业级工作流和系统评估协议，实验证明在检索层和答案层均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 传统Web搜索采用面向人类的范式，用户需自行浏览排序文档并综合信息；而AI搜索中检索文档作为生成模型输入，检索目标需从'搜索满意度排序'转向'为正确答案生成构建可靠上下文'，现有方法未系统解决这一范式转移带来的上下文构建问题。
AI.method: 提出三阶段框架：(1)答案支撑识别——筛选对答案生成有贡献的候选文档；(2)内容可信度评估——从来源、时效性、事实性三个维度评估信息可靠性；(3)上下文组织优化——在有限上下文预算下选择、整合、结构化保留信息。同时开发涵盖先验与后验优化的工业级工作流，建立覆盖检索侧上下文与最终答案的系统评估协议。
AI.result: 实验在检索层面和答案生成层面均展现出持续性能提升，验证了该框架及其工业化实现的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 面向答案的上下文构建框架成功解决了AI搜索中从文档排序到可靠上下文构建的范式转移问题，三阶段设计配合工业级工作流与评估体系，为构建高质量RAG系统提供了系统性解决方案。

title: Success Leaves Detours: Learning Executable Walkthroughs for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Test-time self-evolving agents improve by reusing past experience, yet sparse-reward trajectories contain failures, loops, and detours, while summaries often omit the state conditions and action dependencies needed for execution. We study executable Walkthrough induction from sparse-reward trajectories: extracting compact, state-conditioned, and verifiable procedures. Our key observation is that delayed credit identifies actions associated with progress but cannot determine whether they produce facts required by later actions. We propose Trace, a credit-guided, dependency-grounded framework that compiles noisy trajectories into executable Walkthrough Memory. It detects progress anchors from rewards and persistent state changes, propagates credit to identify valuable transitions, and estimates action prerequisites from cross-episode success and failure evidence. Backward dependency slicing then traces required facts to their producers, extracting dependency-consistent action chains while removing irrelevant loops and detours. The resulting Walkthroughs encode entry conditions, ordered state--action--effect steps, and completion and failure predicates, supporting reuse, intermediate-state resumption, and programmatic verification. Experiments on J-TTL, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with three open-source LLMs show that Trace consistently outperforms eight test-time learning and memory baselines. Compared with the strongest baseline, it improves average AUC and Final-$3$ by $30.0%$ and $40.5%$, respectively, while using fewer inference tokens. These results show that long-horizon interaction benefits more from state-conditioned executable procedures than from complete trajectories or abstract summaries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Trace 框架，从稀疏奖励轨迹中提取可执行的 Walkthrough 记忆：通过信用引导的依赖 grounding，将噪声轨迹编译为状态条件化、可验证的程序化记忆，显著提升长时程任务中测试时自进化智能体的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时自进化智能体依赖过去经验复用，但稀疏奖励轨迹包含大量失败、循环和绕路；现有摘要方法常遗漏执行所需的状态条件和动作依赖。因此需要从噪声轨迹中提取紧凑、状态条件化、可验证的可执行程序，以支持有效的经验复用。
AI.method: Trace 框架包含四个关键步骤：1) 从奖励信号和持久状态变化检测进步锚点；2) 传播信用识别高价值的状态转移；3) 利用跨回合成功/失败证据估计动作前置条件；4) 反向依赖切片追溯所需事实到其产生者，提取依赖一致的动作链并移除无关循环和绕路。生成的 Walkthrough 编码入口条件、有序的状态-动作-效果步骤、完成和失败谓词，支持复用、中间状态恢复和程序化验证。
AI.result: 在 J-TTL、WebShop、ScienceWorld 三个基准上，使用三个开源 LLMs 评估，Trace 持续优于八个测试时学习和记忆基线。相比最强基线，平均 AUC 提升 30.0%，Final-3 提升 40.5%，同时使用更少的推理 token。
AI.conclusion: 长时程交互任务更受益于状态条件化的可执行程序，而非完整轨迹或抽象摘要。Trace 证明了信用引导的依赖 grounding 能有效将噪声轨迹编译为可执行的 Walkthrough Memory，显著增强了智能体在稀疏奖励环境下的测试时自进化能力。

title: AdaMem: Adaptive Memory Token Allocation for Soft Compression in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves language models with retrieved evidence, but processing many long passages is costly and can introduce distracting information. Soft compression addresses this challenge by encoding passages as compact sequences of continuous memory embeddings before generation. However, existing methods typically assign each retained passage an identical number of memory embeddings, irrespective of its query-specific relevance. To address this, we propose AdaMem, a relevance-guided soft-compression framework that maps learned passage-relevance estimates to a query-dependent allocation of a fixed memory-token budget. A shared query-conditioned compressor produces both continuous passage memories and relevance scores in a single pass; a deterministic allocation rule assigns more memory tokens to higher-scoring passages and can omit low-scoring ones. Across six open-domain QA benchmarks, AdaMem consistently outperforms OSCAR (the closely matched soft-compression baseline that uses uniform allocation) as well as other soft-compression methods at matched memory budgets. Under standard 16$\times$ compression, AdaMem improves sub-string match by up to 3.2 points (5.5%) over uniform allocation baseline, with an average relative gain of 3.4%; under aggressive 64$\times$ compression the average relative gain grows to 14.6%, with a maximum of 9.8 points (19.7%) on PopQA. AdaMem matches the answer quality of the uncompressed at up to 4$\times$ lower inference latency than full context baseline. AdaMem retains an efficiency profile comparable to the uniform-compression baseline, while achieving up to $4\times$ lower inference latency than full-context inference. Thus, relevance-guided memory allocation is particularly effective when retrieval pools are large and the available memory budget is tight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaMem，一种基于相关性引导的软压缩框架，针对检索增强生成（RAG）中长段落处理成本高且易引入干扰信息的问题，通过查询条件压缩器一次性生成段落连续记忆嵌入和相关性分数，并根据相关性动态分配固定内存令牌预算，实现了在多个开放域问答基准上优于均匀分配基线的性能，尤其在高压缩比下优势显著。
AI.motivation: 现有的软压缩方法通常为每个保留段落分配相同数量的内存嵌入，忽略了段落对特定查询的相关性差异，导致在内存预算紧张时无法有效利用有限资源，且可能引入干扰信息。
AI.method: AdaMem包含一个共享的查询条件压缩器，单次前向传播即可输出段落的连续记忆嵌入和相关性分数；随后采用确定性分配规则，根据相关性分数将固定内存令牌预算分配给各段落，高分段落获得更多令牌，低分段落可被省略。
AI.result: 在六个开放域问答基准上，AdaMem持续优于OSCAR及其他软压缩基线。16倍压缩下，子串匹配提升高达3.2点（5.5%），平均相对增益3.4%；64倍压缩下平均相对增益达14.6%，PopQA上最大提升9.8点（19.7%）。AdaMem在匹配未压缩基线答案质量的同时，推理延迟比全上下文基线降低达4倍，且效率与均匀压缩基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 相关性引导的内存分配在检索池大、内存预算紧张时尤为有效，能显著提升压缩RAG的性能与效率。

title: The Wisdom of Artificial Deliberative Crowds
summary: The aggregation of many lay estimates often outperforms individual expert judgment, a phenomenon known as the wisdom of crowds. While this is usually attributed to the independence of estimates, an even stronger effect arises through deliberation: averaging the consensus estimates of small deliberating groups outperforms the classical wisdom of crowds, with individual judgments themselves also becoming more accurate after deliberation. Whether these improvements transfer to large language models deliberating amongst themselves is unknown.
