In two independent settings, we learn teamwork strategies that transfer unchanged to unseen benchmarks, using only 15 mathematics and 25 graduate-level knowledge problems. Across five mathematics and physics benchmarks, self-organizing teams average 66.7% accuracy, versus 48.8% for their strongest member, 58.7% for compute-matched inference by that agent, and 59.0% for a perfect router over members' independent answers; on AIME 2026, they exceed this router by 13.4 points. Because gains vary across benchmarks, we ask when self-organizing collaboration helps. Across eight benchmarks, demonstrability (the organizational-psychology construct of whether a team can distinguish correct from incorrect reasoning) strongly tracks improvement over the strongest member (Spearman $ρ=0.90$, $p=0.005$): teams benefit most when correct reasoning can be recognized once it appears. More broadly, these results suggest that organization itself can become an agent capability: agent teams can learn how to reason together and produce solutions their members could not reach independently.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自我组织智能体团队（SAT），让固定AI智能体团队从过往协作中学习可复用策略，自主组织角色、对话阶段、参与方式和信息流，实现协作计算。在五个数学物理基准上平均准确率66.7%，显著超越最强单体（48.8%）、算力匹配推理（58.7%）和完美路由器（59.0%）；在AIME 2026上超越完美路由器13.4分。跨八基准实证表明，可示性（团队识别正确推理的能力）与性能提升强相关（Spearman ρ=0.90, p=0.005），揭示组织能力本身可成为智能体能力。
AI.motivation: 现有AI智能体团队依赖固定协议、显式任务分解或路由机制，缺乏人类团队在解决方案结构未知时自适应组织推理的能力。研究旨在让智能体团队像人类一样，从经验中学习如何在推理展开过程中自我组织，无需预先指定角色和分工。
AI.method: 构建自我组织智能体团队（SAT）：固定的AI智能体团队，仅通过15道数学题和25道研究生级知识题的过往协作，学习可复用的团队协作策略。这些策略涵盖角色分配、对话阶段划分、参与机制和信息流组织，使智能体能进行协作计算——即交换、质疑、修补、综合部分推理，产出单个成员无法独立达成的解决方案。学习到的策略不变迁移至未见基准。
AI.result: 在五个数学物理基准上，SAT平均准确率66.7%，显著优于最强单体成员（48.8%）、算力匹配的单体推理（58.7%）和成员独立答案的完美路由器（59.0%）；在AIME 2026上超越完美路由器13.4个百分点。跨八个基准分析发现，可示性（组织心理学概念，指团队区分正确/错误推理的能力）与相对最强成员的提升强相关（Spearman ρ=0.90, p=0.005）：团队协作收益最大当正确推理一旦出现即可被识别。
AI.conclusion: 组织能力本身可成为智能体能力：智能体团队能学会如何共同推理，产出成员无法独立达到的解决方案。关键在于可示性——当团队能识别正确推理时，自我组织协作最有效。这为AI系统设计提供新范式：不再预设刚性协议，而是让团队从经验中学习协作组织策略。

authors: Sjors G. J. G. In 't Veld
title: A Comparative Framework for Evaluating Foundation Models on Tabular Data: A Case Study in Healthcare
summary: Tabular data is the most common format in clinical practice, encompassing laboratory results, medication records, diagnostic codes, and patient demographics. As foundation models for tabular data have grown in number and variety, a practical question has become harder to answer: which model should a clinician or data scientist actually choose for a given task, and why? Existing surveys catalogue what these models can do, but they stop short of providing a structured way to compare them against the specific demands of a real application. We introduce \system{}, a comparative evaluation framework that scores and ranks tabular foundation models (TFMs) across six clinically meaningful dimensions: how well a model generalizes to new datasets, how effectively it protects patient privacy, how much data it needs to perform well, how it scales with growing datasets and feature spaces, how interpretable its predictions are to clinicians, and how fairly it performs across patient subgroups. Each dimension is broken down into measurable sub-components, and groups of sub-components can optionally be combined into supplementary compound scores, called super-metrics, that provide a diagnostic view of how a model performs across several dimensions simultaneously. To show how the framework works in practice, we apply it to two healthcare use cases, screening for iron deficiency and predicting heart failure, demonstrating how the same set of metrics leads to different model rankings depending on what matters most in each clinical context. We also provide a taxonomy of 45 TFMs organized by their underlying architecture, which serves as a reference for researchers and practitioners looking to navigate this rapidly expanding field.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为系统的比较评估框架，用于在六个临床相关维度（泛化能力、隐私保护、数据效率、可扩展性、可解释性、公平性）对表格基础模型（TFM）进行评分和排名，并将其应用于缺铁筛查和心力衰竭预测两个医疗用例，展示了不同临床背景下的模型排名差异，同时提供了按架构分类的45个TFM分类法。
AI.motivation: 表格数据是临床实践中最常见的格式，随着表格基础模型数量和种类的增长，临床医生和数据科学家面临选择合适模型的困难。现有综述仅列举模型能力，缺乏针对实际应用需求的结构化比较方法。
AI.method: 构建包含六个维度的比较评估框架，每个维度细分为可测量的子组件，并可选择性地将子组件组合为复合指标（超指标）以提供跨维度的诊断性视图。将框架应用于缺铁筛查和心力衰竭预测两个用例，并按底层架构对45个TFM进行分类。
AI.result: 在两个医疗用例中，同一组指标导致不同的模型排名，取决于各临床场景优先考虑的维度。框架能够根据具体临床需求指导模型选择，分类法为研究者和从业者提供了导航参考。
AI.conclusion: 该框架填补了TFM评估中缺乏临床导向结构化比较的空白，通过多维度评分和复合指标，支持基于临床优先级的模型选择，并为快速扩展的TFM领域提供了系统性的分类参考。

title: Beyond Accuracy and Surface Fluency: Risk-Sensitive Evaluation of LLMs for Legal Clause Generation
comment: Accepted to the AI for Law Workshop @ ICML 2026. https://openreview.net/forum?id=qWtjzD2Udj
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to draft contractual language, yet conventional accuracy or preference-based evaluations are poorly matched to legal drafting. A clause may be fluent and stylistically polished while still omitting an essential carve-out, allocating risk in an unenforceable way, assuming an inapplicable jurisdiction, or exposing a party to regulatory liability. This paper presents a empirical study design and framework for evaluating LLM-generated contract clauses. The study evaluates four models - Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, GPT 5.4 Nano, and Qwen 3.5 Flash, across 22 contract clause categories and 34 legally-motivated failure modes. We combine two evaluation frameworks: CLAUSE, which classifies prompts by legal function and failure target, and LENS-CRAFT, which scores outputs across nine legal-quality dimensions. Instead of averaging dimension scores, the study applies a Max Severity Principle so that a single legally decisive defect remains visible. The paper provides the evaluation protocol, taxonomy, analysis plan, and a results structure for reporting empirical findings. We argue that legal AI evaluation should move beyond aggregate accuracy toward clause-specific, failure-mode-driven, and risk-sensitive assessment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种实证研究设计和框架，用于评估大语言模型生成的合同条款，采用CLAUSE和LENS-CRAFT两个评估框架，结合最大严重性原则，主张法律AI评估应从聚合准确性转向条款特定、故障模式驱动和风险敏感的评估。
AI.motivation: 传统基于准确度或偏好的评估方法不适合法律起草场景，因为条款可能流畅且润色得当，却遗漏关键免责条款、以不可执行方式分配风险、假设不适用的司法管辖区或使一方面临监管责任，因此需要专门的法律质量评估框架。
AI.method: 研究评估四个模型（Claude Haiku 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite、GPT 5.4 Nano、Qwen 3.5 Flash），涵盖22类合同条款和34种法律动机的故障模式。采用CLAUSE框架按法律功能和故障目标分类提示词，LENS-CRAFT框架在九个法律质量维度上评分，并应用最大严重性原则（而非平均分）使单一决定性法律缺陷保持可见。
AI.result: 论文提供了评估协议、分类体系、分析计划和结果报告结构，为实证发现的报告建立了标准化框架。
AI.conclusion: 法律AI评估应超越聚合准确性，转向条款特定、故障模式驱动和风险敏感的评估范式，以捕捉合同条款中可能导致法律后果的关键缺陷。

title: Generative Embodied Multiple Behavior Control Systems for Human-like Agents
summary: An enduring and richly elaborated dichotomy in cognitive neuroscience is that of human behavior control mechanisms, divided into habitual versus goal-directed. While existing human-like agent frameworks primarily focus on modeling goal- directed behavior, habitual behavior has been largely overlooked, though it plays a crucial role in human daily life. In this paper, we address this gap by studying multiple behavior control systems that jointly model goal-directed and habitual behaviors. We propose a human behavior control mechanism-inspired framework which the Habitual Controller retrieves cue-triggered behaviors from personal- ized habit memory, while the Goal-directed Controller employs a context-aware world model to predict action consequences and estimate their values. The Arbiter dynamically balances the influence of both systems according to individual differ- ences and momentary internal states. To reconstruct diverse human-level behavior instructions in 3D environments, we further develop a keyframe-guided 3D mo- tion generation module. Through extensive evaluation methods, human studies, and ablations studies, experimental results demonstrate that human-likeness per- formance is significantly improved by our approach. The efficacy of our approach indicates the benefits of leveraging habitual behavior and multiple behavior con- trol system coordination for believable embodied human-like agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受人类行为控制机制启发的框架，包含习惯控制器、目标导向控制器和仲裁器，结合关键帧引导的3D动作生成模块，显著提升了具身智能体的类人表现。
AI.motivation: 现有类人智能体框架主要建模目标导向行为，忽视了习惯行为在人类日常生活中的关键作用，导致智能体行为缺乏真实感。
AI.method: 提出双系统行为控制框架：习惯控制器从个性化习惯记忆中检索线索触发行为；目标导向控制器利用上下文感知世界模型预测行动后果并估计价值；仲裁器根据个体差异和瞬时内部状态动态平衡两系统影响。另开发关键帧引导的3D动作生成模块，重建3D环境中多样化类人行为指令。
AI.result: 通过大量评估方法、人类研究和消融实验，结果表明该方法显著提升了类人表现性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了利用习惯行为和多行为控制系统协调对于构建可信的具身类人智能体的有效性。

authors: Sjors G. J. G. In 't Veld
title: From Latent Biomarkers to Clinical Rules: Embedding-Guided Rule Mining and Attribution-Based Translation for Interpretable Tabular Learning
summary: Clinical decision support tools are most useful when accurate predictions are accompanied by understandable explanations. Rule-based models provide transparency, but rules derived directly from raw clinical measurements may miss patterns arising from interactions between multiple variables. We present a four-step pipeline that mines decision rules in the latent space of an FT-Transformer and translates them back into measurable clinical features. Embedding dimensions that consistently separate patient groups are treated as latent biomarkers, rules are mined using small decision trees, and selected rules are translated using gradient-input saliency and CLS attention attribution. We evaluate the framework on six public clinical and population health datasets at four embedding dimensions. Translated rules outperformed raw-feature rules in five of six datasets, with mean AUROC gains ranging from 0.04 to 0.23. On the heart disease dataset, embedding-space rules reached 0.98 AUROC, but translation reduced this to 0.72, showing that high-performing latent rules cannot always be represented by simple raw-feature conditions. These results show that latent-space rule discovery can uncover predictive patterns while translating them into clinically measurable features that can be evaluated by clinicians.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种四步流程，在FT-Transformer的潜在空间中挖掘决策规则并将其转换回可测量的临床特征。在六个公共临床数据集上评估，转换后的规则在五个数据集上优于原始特征规则，平均AUROC提升0.04-0.23。但心脏病数据集上潜在规则AUROC 0.98转换后降至0.72，表明高性能潜在规则并不总能用简单原始特征条件表示。
AI.motivation: 临床决策支持工具需要既准确又可解释的预测。基于规则的模型提供透明度，但直接从原始临床测量衍生的规则可能遗漏多变量交互产生的模式。因此需要在潜在空间挖掘规则并转换回可测量特征。
AI.method: 四步流程：1) 使用FT-Transformer获取嵌入；2) 将持续分离患者群体的嵌入维度视为潜在生物标志物，用小决策树挖掘规则；3) 使用梯度输入显著性和CLS注意力归因将规则转换回原始临床特征；4) 在六个公共临床和人口健康数据集上评估四种嵌入维度。
AI.result: 转换后的规则在六个数据集中的五个上优于原始特征规则，平均AUROC增益0.04-0.23。心脏病数据集上潜在空间规则达0.98 AUROC，但转换后降至0.72，显示高性能潜在规则不总能用简单原始特征条件表示。
AI.conclusion: 潜在空间规则发现能揭示预测模式并将其转换为临床可测量特征供医生评估，但转换过程可能损失性能，说明潜在空间中的复杂交互不总能用简单原始特征规则捕捉。

title: Correlation-Aware Structured Pruning for Large Language Models
summary: Structured pruning is a promising approach for reducing the substantial inference costs of Large Language Models (LLMs) while maintaining hardware efficiency. Many existing methods assess the importance of prunable units (e.g., channels or heads) in isolation, implicitly assuming that pruning errors are additive. This independence assumption is often invalidated by the non-orthogonality of model weights and strong correlations between unit activations, potentially leading to performance degradation. To address this, we propose a Correlation-Aware Structured Pruning method. We formulate the pruning objective as a cardinality-constrained binary quadratic program that explicitly models cross-unit dependencies in the reconstruction error. Since this binary quadratic program is NP-hard and difficult to solve exactly, we develop a greedy interaction algorithm based on dependency-aware marginal costs to optimize unit selection. Furthermore, we incorporate a gradient-based strategy to achieve adaptive layer-wise sparsity allocation across the entire model. Extensive experiments on mainstream LLMs demonstrate that incorporating correlation information yields competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs compared to representative structured pruning baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种相关感知的结构化剪枝方法，通过建模剪枝单元间的跨单元依赖关系来提升大语言模型剪枝的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法通常假设剪枝单元（如通道或注意力头）的重要性相互独立，隐含假设剪枝误差可加性成立。然而，模型权重的非正交性和单元激活间的强相关性使得该独立性假设失效，导致剪枝后性能下降。
AI.method: 将剪枝目标建模为基数约束的二元二次规划，显式建模重构误差中的跨单元依赖；针对该NP-hard问题，设计基于依赖感知边际成本的贪心交互算法进行单元选择；同时引入梯度策略实现全模型自适应逐层稀疏度分配。
AI.result: 在主流大语言模型上的大量实验表明，引入相关信息后的方法在精度与效率的权衡上优于代表性的结构化剪枝基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模剪枝单元间的相关依赖关系能显著改善结构化剪枝效果，提出的贪心交互算法与自适应稀疏度分配策略为大模型压缩提供了有效的实用方案。

title: Toward Auditable and Calibrated AI for Dementia-Related Crash Severity Prediction: A Selective Deferral Framework to Support Human Review
comment: This is the author's preprint version of a paper accepted for presentation at HICSS 60 (Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences), 2027, Hawaii, USA. The final published version will appear in the official conference proceedings. Conference site: https://hicss.hawaii.edu/
summary: Public crash databases increasingly support automated safety analysis, but crash severity prediction remains difficult to translate into public-sector decision workflows when models are evaluated primarily as ordinary classifiers. This study reframes dementia-related crash severity modeling as a decision-aware triage problem in which a system must classify crashes into no-injury/property-damage-only (O), minor or moderate injury (BC), and fatal or severe injury (KA), while also controlling outcome leakage, reporting severe under-triage, calibrating confidence, and preserving every raw prediction for audit. Using 4,781 Texas crash records with structured fields and police narratives, we evaluate structured, narrative, fusion, calibrated fusion, BERT-family, and local large-language-model baselines under a stratified 70/15/15 split. In the reported split, leakage-controlled Gemma obtains the highest observed macro-F1 (0.545; 95% bootstrap CI [0.507, 0.583]). The best calibrated fusion model obtains macro-F1 of 0.522 and expected calibration error of 0.033. Selective deferral improves performance among cases retained for automatic classification. At 70% coverage, macro-F1 rises to 0.573 and severity cost falls to 0.577, while deferred cases are treated as candidates for a proposed human-review process and are not further evaluated in the present experiment. The study contributes a reproducible, leakage-controlled, and uncertainty-aware evaluation framework for crash AI systems, emphasizing auditability and selective deferral rather than accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究将与痴呆症相关的事故严重程度预测重构为决策感知的分诊问题，提出了一个可复现、防泄漏且具备不确定性感知的评估框架，强调可审计性和选择性延迟决策而非单纯追求准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有公共事故数据库支持自动化安全分析，但事故严重程度预测模型若仅作为普通分类器评估，难以转化为公共部门的决策工作流。研究旨在解决结果泄漏、严重欠分诊报告、置信度校准及原始预测审计保存等问题，使模型更符合实际决策需求。
AI.method: 使用4,781条德克萨斯州事故记录（结构化字段+警方叙事），在分层70/15/15划分下评估结构化、叙事、融合、校准融合、BERT家族及本地大语言模型基线。引入防泄漏控制、宏观F1、期望校准误差(ECE)、选择性延迟机制（覆盖率70%时延迟部分案件至人工复核）及严重程度成本指标。
AI.result: 防泄漏Gemma模型获得最高宏观F1(0.545, 95% CI [0.507, 0.583])。最佳校准融合模型宏观F1 0.522，ECE 0.033。选择性延迟在70%覆盖率下将宏观F1提升至0.573，严重程度成本降至0.577，延迟案件作为人工复核候选不再参与自动评估。
AI.conclusion: 研究贡献了一个可复现、防泄漏、不确定性感知的事故AI系统评估框架，证明选择性延迟机制能显著提升保留案件的分类性能，为公共部门决策工作流提供了可审计、可信赖的分诊工具。

title: Quantifying Hidden Salt for Precision Healthcare: Sodium Assessment via Joint-Factor Retrieval and Chain-of-Thought Inference
comment: Accepted in EMNLP 2026 Main Conference; 16 pages, 7 figures
summary: Precision healthcare, particularly for conditions like hypertension and cardiovascular disease, necessitates monitoring of dietary sodium intake. However, tracking this is hindered by the prevalence of hidden salt in cooking, such as sodium in soy sauce and ketchup. While recipes offer a valuable data source for dietary analysis, sodium-rich seasonings are frequently omitted or described ambiguously in instructions. To solve this issue, we propose SALT, a Sodium Assessing & Level Tracking framework adopting an RAG framework to assess sodium content in recipes. Our framework first introduces a Joint-Factor Embedding Retrieval module to locate similar recipes with specified sodium content for addressing the lack of contextual references. These retrieved samples provide contexts for subsequent inference. Then we design a structured 4-hop Chain-of-Thought inference module to refine the vague estimation from language models through a multi-step sodium estimation. To facilitate our study, we further construct a recipe dataset SALT54k with $54,151$ entries labeled with sodium quantities across $11$ common seasonings. Results on SALT54k demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in sodium estimation. Additional real-world validations confirm the effectiveness of our method, demonstrating its potential as a practical solution for AI-assisted precision healthcare.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SALT 框架，结合检索增强生成（RAG）与四步思维链推理，解决食谱中隐性钠含量估计难题，构建了 SALT54k 数据集并在其上达到最先进性能，经真实场景验证有效。
AI.motivation: 精准医疗（如高血压、心血管病管理）需监测膳食钠摄入，但烹饪中的隐性盐（酱油、番茄酱等）导致追踪困难；食谱虽为重要数据源，却常省略或模糊描述钠丰富调料，缺乏可靠的上下文参考。
AI.method: SALT 框架包含两大模块：1) Joint-Factor Embedding Retrieval（联合因子嵌入检索），检索含明确钠含量的相似食谱作为上下文；2) 结构化 4-hop Chain-of-Thought 推理，通过多步钠估计细化语言模型的模糊预测。同时构建 SALT54k 数据集（54,151 条食谱，标注 11 种常用调料钠量）支持训练与评估。
AI.result: 在 SALT54k 上实现钠含量估计的 state-of-the-art 性能；额外的真实场景验证证实方法的有效性，展示其作为 AI 辅助精准医疗实用解决方案的潜力。
AI.conclusion: SALT 通过检索增强与多步推理有效解决了食谱中隐性钠估计的缺失上下文与模糊描述问题，构建的大规模标注数据集为后续研究提供基准，验证结果支持其在精准医疗饮食监测中的应用前景。

title: The Limits of Speculation: Bounding Speculative Decoding in Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Speculative decoding in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models faces the problem of unstable verification cost caused by input-dependent expert loading. To study the physics of this process, we formulate speculation-budget selection as an offline Stochastic Shortest Path (SSP) problem over reference sequences and build a diagnostic Oracle that uses counterfactual simulation to account for MoE verification cost. A detailed analysis of the Oracle's decisions on the Qwen3-Coder and EAGLE-3 pairing, in the space of marginal deltas (Delta Space), shows that rejected candidates form a strict linear boundary. This result demonstrates that a complex global optimization is locally governed by a necessary condition balancing marginal cost against expected progress ($\frac{Δ\mathbb{E}[Cost]}{Δ\mathbb{E}[a]}$), providing a rigorous mathematical reference point for designing future adaptive online heuristics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)模型中的推测性解码问题，将推测预算选择建模为离线随机最短路径(SSP)问题，构建基于反事实模拟的诊断Oracle，发现在Delta Space(边际增量空间)中被拒绝的候选形成严格线性边界，揭示了全局优化在局部由边际成本与期望进步的平衡条件(ΔE[Cost]/ΔE[a])支配，为设计自适应在线启发式算法提供了严格数学基准。
AI.motivation: MoE模型中的推测性解码面临因输入依赖的专家加载导致的不稳定验证成本问题，需要从物理层面理解这一过程并寻找优化原则。
AI.method: 1. 将推测预算选择形式化为参考序列上的离线随机最短路径(SSP)问题；2. 构建诊断Oracle，利用反事实模拟核算MoE验证成本；3. 在Qwen3-Coder和EAGLE-3配对上分析Oracle决策，在边际增量空间(Delta Space)中考察被拒候选的分布特征。
AI.result: 在Delta Space中，被拒绝的候选形成一条严格的线性边界。这一结果表明，复杂的全局优化在局部由一个必要条件支配：边际成本与期望进步的平衡(ΔE[Cost]/ΔE[a])。
AI.conclusion: 该发现为未来设计自适应在线启发式算法提供了严格的数学参考点，揭示了MoE推测性解码中预算选择的基本优化原则。

title: Observational Equivalence of LLM and Human Annotation
summary: In this paper, we show that LLM and human coding are observationally equivalent in terms of annotation quality: recent LLMs agree with expert coders at rates comparable to those observed among experts themselves. We demonstrate this through replications of text-classification tasks from 14 peer-reviewed political science studies, in which ten LLMs, three human experts, and 165 crowdsourced workers independently classify the same texts using identical codebooks. We find that this equivalence is driven by ambiguity in the texts and coding rules. When LLMs disagree with experts, experts are also more likely to disagree with one another, and clarifying coding rules reduces disagreement among both experts and sufficiently capable LLMs. Thus, there is little empirical basis for preferring human coding on the basis of annotation quality alone, while LLMs offer substantial advantages in speed and cost. We therefore argue that the central challenge of text annotation is no longer choosing between human and machine coders, but developing coding rules that minimize ambiguity and accounting for the ambiguity that remains. To this end, we propose using disagreement across LLMs to identify difficult cases and refine codebooks, and we develop ambiguity-aware bounds for downstream inference when a unique annotation cannot be defined for every text.

AI.tldr: 本文通过复现14项政治学文本分类研究，发现大语言模型（LLM）与人类专家编码在标注质量上观测等价，且LLM在速度和成本上优势显著，核心挑战转向如何减少编码规则歧义并处理剩余歧义。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM与人类编码在文本分类任务中的质量差异，评估是否有实证依据支持优先选择人工编码，并重新定义文本标注的核心挑战。
AI.method: 选取14篇同行评审政治学研究的文本分类任务，使用相同编码手册，让10个LLM、3名人类专家和165名众包工人独立标注相同文本，对比标注一致性，并分析歧义对分歧的影响，测试规则澄清对减少分歧的效果。
AI.result: LLM与专家的一致性率相当于专家间的一致性率；当LLM与专家分歧时，专家间也更易分歧；澄清编码规则能同时降低专家和高能力LLM的分歧；基于质量alone没有实证理由偏好人工编码，LLM在速度和成本上优势巨大。
AI.conclusion: 文本标注的核心挑战不再是人机选择，而是开发最小化歧义的编码规则并量化剩余歧义。建议利用LLM间的分歧识别困难案例以优化编码手册，并提出考虑歧义的下游推断边界。

title: A Survey on the Linear Representation Hypothesis
summary: The term "linear representation hypothesis" (LRH) has appeared across diverse subfields of artificial intelligence, neuroscience, and cognitive science. But previous works have not consistently treated the LRH as a falsifiable scientific hypothesis; we analyze these inconsistencies and examine their implications for how prior theoretical and methodological results should be interpreted. Based on this analysis, we argue that claims regarding linear representations become well-defined only through careful examination of the model, representation location, feature definition, and evaluation dataset. We therefore propose a more rigorous formalization of the LRH that makes these dependencies explicit and allows the hypothesis to be evaluated as a falsifiable scientific claim. Finally, we identify some non-trivial open problems that warrant further attention from the research community.

AI.tldr: 论文指出'线性表征假设'(LRH)在不同领域定义不一致，缺乏可证伪性，提出更严谨的形式化框架，明确模型、表征位置、特征定义和评估数据集等依赖，使LRH成为可科学验证的假设，并指出待解决的开放问题。
AI.motivation: 现有研究未将LRH视为可证伪的科学假设，导致理论和方法论结果的解释存在不一致，需要厘清这些不一致并建立严格定义以推动科学研究。
AI.method: 分析LRH在不同子领域的定义不一致及其影响，提出形式化框架显式建模模型、表征位置、特征定义和评估数据集四个维度的依赖关系，使假设可被实证检验。
AI.result: 提出更严谨的LRH形式化定义，明确线性表征的主张需指定上述四个依赖；识别出若非平凡的开放问题供后续研究关注。
AI.conclusion: LRH只有通过明确模型、表征位置、特征定义和评估数据集才能成为定义清晰、可证伪的科学假设；研究社区应采用该形式化框架并攻克相关开放问题。

title: SCoR: A Hierarchical Framework for Forecasting Relations Between Scientific Concepts
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables; includes supplementary material. Jingze Wang and Fred Sun contributed equally; Shangqi Guo is the corresponding author
summary: Anticipating emerging research directions is a critical goal of AI-assisted science. Existing methods mainly predict which concepts will co-occur in future papers, but co-occurrence captures shared attention rather than the scientific meaning of a connection, such as whether one method uses, combines, replaces, or contradicts another. We formulate research-direction discovery as hierarchical scientific-relation forecasting over a shared candidate-pair space, comprising three temporally aligned tasks: first co-occurrence, first scientific-relation formation, and relation type at formation. We construct SCoR-Graph from 187,848 cs.CV papers published between 2017 and 2026, yielding 270,687 consolidated concepts, 7.45 million co-occurrence edges, and 615,036 typed, directed relation edges. From cutoff-specific graph snapshots, we derive SCoR-Bench, a leakage-audited benchmark for these three capabilities, with expert-verified gold labels for the entire relation-type test set. We further introduce HiSCoR, a task-adapted model family that models relation emergence as a temporally evolving, hierarchically constrained process by encoding pre-cutoff event histories and conditioning relation formation on future co-occurrence. On the held-out 2025-2026 window, HiSCoR achieves an AUROC of 0.9515, a 2.4% relative improvement over the strongest temporal-graph baseline, and improves population-AUPRC by 14.0%; its relation-type variant achieves a Macro-AUROC of 0.7795. Ablations show that semantic, co-occurrence, and typed-relation views provide complementary predictive evidence. SCoR advances research-direction forecasting from predicting which concepts will co-occur to anticipating whether and how evidence-backed scientific relations will emerge.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种层次化科学关系预测框架 SCoR，将研究方向发现建模为三个时序对齐的任务：首次共现、首次科学关系形成及关系类型预测。构建了大规模计算机视觉论文图谱 SCoR-Graph 及无泄露基准 SCoR-Bench，开发了层次化时序模型 HiSCoR，在预测 2025-2026 年新兴关系上显著优于基线，将研究方向预测从简单的共现预测推进到有证据支持的科学关系预判。
AI.motivation: 现有的 AI 辅助科研方向预测方法主要预测概念共现，但共现仅反映共同关注度，无法捕捉科学关系的语义含义（如一种方法是使用、组合、替代还是反驳另一种方法）。需要从预测“哪些概念会共现”转向预测“是否以及如何形成有证据支持的科学关系”。
AI.method: 1. 构建 SCoR-Graph：基于 187,848 篇 cs.CV 论文（2017-2026），提取 270,687 个概念、745 万共现边和 615,036 条有类型的有向关系边。2. 设计三个层次化时序任务：首次共现预测、首次科学关系形成预测、关系类型预测。3. 创建无泄露基准 SCoR-Bench，包含专家验证的关系类型黄金标签。4. 提出 HiSCoR 模型家族：编码截止时间前的事件历史，以层次化约束建模关系涌现为时序演化过程，并将关系形成条件化于未来共现预测。
AI.result: 在保留的 2025-2026 年测试窗口上，HiSCoR 实现 AUROC 0.9515，比最强时序图基线相对提升 2.4%；population-AUPRC 提升 14.0%；关系类型变体达到 Macro-AUROC 0.7795。消融实验表明语义、共现和类型化关系视角提供互补预测证据。
AI.conclusion: SCoR 框架将研究方向预测从概念共现预测推进到科学关系涌现预判，通过层次化建模和时序约束，能够预测概念间是否以及如何形成有证据支持的科学关系（使用、组合、替代、反驳等），为 AI 辅助科研方向发现提供了更具语义深度的预测能力。

title: PAGE: Partition-Aware Gated KV-Cache Eviction
summary: KV-cache eviction can do more than compress. In long-context LLMs, keeping only some cached tokens sometimes matches or exceeds full-cache accuracy, because many redundant prefill tokens otherwise dilute attention away from the tokens that carry the answer. This benefit is not uniform, and evicting the wrong tokens can drop accuracy to zero on tasks that require precise retrieval, so the useful question is not only which tokens to keep but also whether to evict this input at all. We show that one label-free number computed from the prefill attention, the drop between early and late layers in how much attention heads agree on which tokens to read, predicts per input, before any decoding, which of the two cases an input falls under. We build this into PAGE (Partition-Aware Gated Eviction), a wrapper that runs any SnapKV-style evictor when the drop is large and keeps the full cache when it is small, with no training, labels, or fine-tuning. PAGE is a safety mechanism rather than a compressor, so we measure it by the failures it prevents. It cuts the harm rate on capacity-bound inputs from 0.75 to 0.026, and on multi-key retrieval with Mistral-7B plain SnapKV falls from 99\% to 0\% as the budget shrinks, while PAGE holds it at 89\%. Elsewhere, it passes the base evictor through unchanged, which is the intended behaviour and is what we observe in 8 of 16 cells. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PAGE-018239.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PAGE（分区感知门控驱逐），一种无需训练的包装器，利用预填充注意力中早期和后期层注意力头一致性下降这一无标签指标，自适应决定是否应用KV缓存驱逐（如SnapKV）或保留完整缓存，在防止检索任务准确率崩塌的同时保持压缩收益。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM中KV缓存驱逐虽能通过移除冗余token提升准确率，但错误驱逐会导致精确检索任务准确率归零。核心问题不再只是保留哪些token，而是是否应该对该输入进行驱逐。
AI.method: 从预填充注意力计算无标签指标：早期层和后期层注意力头在关注token上的一致性下降度。若下降大则应用SnapKV风格驱逐器，若下降小则保留完整缓存。PAGE作为包装器无需训练、标签或微调。
AI.result: PAGE将容量受限输入的损害率从0.75降至0.026。在Mistral-7B多键检索任务中，随预算缩减普通SnapKV从99%跌至0%，PAGE维持89%。在16个测试单元中有8个直接透传基础驱逐器，符合预期行为。
AI.conclusion: PAGE是安全机制而非压缩器，通过预测每个输入是否适合驱逐，防止驱逐在敏感任务上失效，同时在安全场景保持压缩增益，是一个实用的免训练自适应KV缓存驱逐方案。

title: Read-Best Is Not Steer-Best: A Probing--Steering Layer Dissociation in Omni-Modal Large Language Models
summary: Omni-modal large language models integrate text, audio, and image signals into a shared residual stream, where concepts such as emotion can be linearly decoded and causally modified by activation steering. A common but rarely tested assumption is that the layer with the highest probing accuracy is also the best layer for steering, so injection layers are often selected by probe performance. We provide the first causal test of this assumption across three independently developed omni-modal models and find that it fails. Reading and intervention rely on different layers, a phenomenon we call the probing-steering layer dissociation. Using emotion as a controlled testbed, we measure layer-wise readability and steerability across text, audio, and image inputs. Probe-best layers vary widely across architectures, while steering-effective layers consistently fall within a narrow mid-to-late range of normalized depth. Paired random-direction controls show an approximately 26-fold causal gap, ruling out random perturbation and direction quality as explanations. Logit-lens analysis reveals a staged forward process: causal handle, probing saturation, and vocabulary commitment, and motivates a two-factor account in which steering effectiveness depends on both representational readability and downstream plasticity. These results show that probing accuracy is a poor heuristic for selecting intervention layers and suggest a cross-architecture mid-to-late selection criterion. We also identify a cross-modal emotion subspace organized by valence and arousal, with joy acting as a stable anchor across models. Code and data: https://github.com/YiboWang2002/Read-Best-Is-Not-Steer-Best.

AI.tldr: 研究首次因果验证了“探测准确性最高的层也是激活引导最佳层”这一假设，发现其失效：探测最佳层与引导最佳层存在系统性解离。跨三个独立全模态模型实验表明，探测最佳层随架构差异大，而引导有效层稳定集中在归一化深度的中后期；配对随机方向控制揭示约 26 倍因果缺口，排除随机扰动和方向质量解释。Logit-lens 分析揭示分阶段前向过程（因果把手、探测饱和、词汇承诺），提出双因素解释：引导有效性取决于表征可读性与下游可塑性。结论：探测准确性是选择干预层的差启发式，建议采用跨架构中后期层选择标准；并发现跨模态情绪子空间按效价和唤醒组织，joy 为稳定锚点。
AI.motivation: 验证全模态大语言模型中‘探测准确性最高的层即为激活引导最佳层’这一常被采用但极少因果测试的假设，以情绪为受控测试床，系统量化逐层可读性与可引导性，揭示探测与引导的层级解离机制。
AI.method: 在三个独立开发的全模态模型上，以文本、音频、图像三模态输入为材料，测量各层对情绪概念的线性探测准确性（可读性）与激活引导效果（可引导性）；引入配对随机方向控制排除随机扰动；采用 logit-lens 追踪前向传播中表征的演化阶段；分析跨模态情绪子空间的几何结构。
AI.result: 1. 探测最佳层随模型架构大幅波动，引导有效层稳定落在归一化深度的中后期窄区间。2. 配对随机方向控制显示约 26 倍因果缺口，证实解离非随机扰动或方向质量所致。3. Logit-lens 揭示三阶段前向过程：因果把手层（早期可引导）、探测饱和层（中后期探测峰值）、词汇承诺层（晚期锁定输出）。4. 提出双因素解释：引导有效性需同时具备表征可读性与下游可塑性。5. 发现跨模态情绪子空间按效价、唤醒组织，joy 跨模型稳定作为锚点。
AI.conclusion: 探测准确性不是选择干预层的可靠启发式；跨架构的中后期层选择标准更稳健。研究揭示了探测-引导层级解离的普遍现象，为全模态模型的可控生成与表征干预提供了理论指导与实践准则。

title: Building Trustworthy Mental Health Benchmarks on Bluesky: A Validation-Aware Weak-Supervision Framework
comment: This is the author's preprint version of a paper accepted for presentation at HICSS 60 (Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences), 2027, Hawaii, USA. The final published version will appear in the official conference proceedings. Conference site: https://hicss.hawaii.edu/
summary: Decentralized social media platforms create new opportunities and challenges for computational mental health research because data access, moderation, labeling, and deployment responsibilities are distributed across multiple technical and governance layers. This paper presents a validation-aware weak-supervision system for constructing and evaluating suicidal ideation (SI) and broader mental health (MH) disclosure benchmarks on Bluesky, a decentralized social media platform built on the AT Protocol. The system integrates public firehose collection, task-specific lexicon filtering, Llama-3-8B-assisted binary annotation, human-adjudicated validation subsets, and transformer-based model benchmarking. Using this pipeline, we construct two task-specific corpora containing 8,346 SI-labeled posts and 9,988 MH-labeled posts. The evaluation shows that model performance depends strongly on both task definition and validation protocol. BERT+LSTM achieves the highest SI stratified cross-validation F1-score, RoBERTa achieves the strongest SI holdout F1-score, and DistilRoBERTa achieves the best MH cross-validation F1-score. Human validation reveals different weak-label failure modes across tasks, with SI labels dominated by false negatives and MH labels dominated by false positives. These findings show that decentralized social media can support reproducible mental health benchmarking, but only when system design, label provenance, validation strategy, and deployment constraints are evaluated together.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向去中心化社交媒体（Bluesky/AT协议）的验证感知弱监督系统，用于构建和评估自杀意念（SI）及心理健康（MH）披露基准。系统整合公共火龙带数据收集、任务特定词典过滤、Llama-3-8B辅助二分标注、人工裁决验证子集及Transformer模型基准测试，构建了8,346条SI标注和9,988条MH标注语料。实验表明模型性能强依赖任务定义与验证协议：BERT+LSTM在SI分层交叉验证F1最高，RoBERTa在SI留出验证F1最强，DistilRoBERTa在MH交叉验证F1最优。人工验证揭示SI标签以假阴性为主，MH标签以假阳性为主。结论指出去中心化平台可支持可复现的心理健康基准测试，但需联合考量系统设计、标签溯源、验证策略与部署约束。
AI.motivation: 去中心化社交媒体平台为计算心理健康研究带来新机遇与挑战：数据访问、内容审核、标注与部署责任分散于多个技术与治理层级。现有基准构建多依赖中心化平台数据，缺乏针对去中心化环境的系统化弱监督与验证框架，难以保证标签质量与评估的可复现性。
AI.method: 构建验证感知弱监督流水线：1) 通过AT协议公共火龙带采集Bluesky公开帖文；2) 使用任务特定词典进行初步过滤；3) 引入Llama-3-8B进行二分类弱标注（SI/MH）；4) 抽样人工裁决生成高质量验证子集；5) 在验证子集上对多个Transformer模型（BERT+LSTM、RoBERTa、DistilRoBERTa等）进行分层交叉验证与留出验证基准测试；6) 分析弱标签失效模式（假阴性/假阳性分布）。
AI.result: 获得两个任务专用语料：8,346条SI标注帖文、9,988条MH标注帖文。模型性能随任务定义与验证协议显著变化：SI任务上，BERT+LSTM分层交叉验证F1最高，RoBERTa留出验证F1最强；MH任务上，DistilRoBERTa交叉验证F1最优。人工验证显示SI弱标签以假阴性为主（漏报），MH弱标签以假阳性为主（误报），揭示不同任务的弱监督失效模式差异。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化社交媒体可支持可复现的心理健康基准构建，但必须将系统设计、标签溯源、验证策略与部署约束作为整体联合评估。弱监督标签质量因任务而异，验证协议的选择直接影响模型选型与性能估计，未来工作需关注跨层级治理下的标注一致性与伦理部署。

title: Checkpoints Are Not Enough: Trust Calibration in CoSLR, a Human-AI System for Systematic Literature Reviews
summary: Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs) are essential for evidence-based research but remain time-consuming, requiring researchers to manage large volumes of publications across planning, screening, analysis, and reporting. Large language models (LLMs) can now produce fluent, well-structured review text, which makes it difficult to distinguish synthesis that was verified by a researcher from synthesis that merely appears authoritative. This raises the risk that unverified AI-generated synthesis enters the scholarly record carrying the credibility of a systematic review. We present CoSLR, a Human-AI collaborative multi-agent system that supports the SLR workflow through a modular three-phase pipeline using large language models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and that places explicit, mandatory human checkpoints on the path between generated output and its acceptance. In a survey-based study with 63 participants, the system was received positively: 27 of 63 participants (42.9 percent) rated its usability highly, indicating that the mandatory checkpoints did not come at the cost of a workable interface. However, a checkpoint safeguards the review only if researchers use it to verify: 22 of 63 participants (34.9 percent) reported that they would trust AI-generated summaries and reports without additional human checking after only a short interaction with the system. These findings indicate that Human-AI collaboration can support literature review work, but that the effectiveness of human oversight depends on whether users are willing to exercise it. This is a calibration problem that interface design must address directly, not assume.

AI.tldr: CoSLR 是一个面向系统性文献综述（SLR）的人机协作多智能体系统，采用模块化三阶段流水线结合 LLM 和 RAG，强制引入人工检查点。用户研究显示界面可用性尚可，但 34.9% 参与者倾向于在简短交互后直接信任 AI 生成摘要而不再人工核查，揭示人工监督的有效性取决于用户执行意愿，界面设计需直接解决这一校准问题。
AI.motivation: 系统性文献综述（SLR）虽对循证研究至关重要，但极其耗时，需处理海量文献。大语言模型（LLM）虽能生成流畅、结构良好的综述文本，却难以区分经研究者核实的综合与仅貌似权威的综合，导致未经验证的 AI 生成综合可能以系统综述的可信度进入学术记录。
AI.method: 提出 CoSLR 系统：基于 LLM 与检索增强生成（RAG）的模块化三阶段流水线（规划、筛选、分析、报告），并在生成输出与接受之间设置显式、强制的人工检查点。通过 63 名参与者的问卷研究评估系统可用性与用户对 AI 生成内容的信任程度。
AI.result: 27/63（42.9%）参与者给予高可用性评分，表明强制检查点未显著损害界面易用性；然而 22/63（34.9%）参与者表示在短暂交互后即愿意无条件信任 AI 生成的摘要和报告，凸显人工监督的实际执行意愿不足。
AI.conclusion: 人机协作能够辅助文献综述工作，但人工监督的有效性取决于用户是否愿意主动行使监督权。这是一个校准问题，界面设计必须直面解决，而非假设用户会自觉核查。

title: StepKV: Step-Aware KV Cache Compression for LLM Agents
summary: Key-value (KV) caching is essential for efficient autoregressive large language model (LLM) inference, but the cache grows linearly with context length, increasing storage and decoding costs. KV cache compression mitigates this cost by retaining only a subset of cached tokens. This challenge is particularly important for multi-step LLM agents, where a query expands into trajectories of reasoning, tool interactions, and retrieved observations. Existing pruning methods typically treat the cache as a flat token stream and rank tokens by recency or attention saliency. This creates a mismatch between the unit of compression and the unit of reasoning: token-level pruning removes individual entries, whereas useful information in multi-step agents is often organized into reasoning steps with uneven and delayed importance. Consequently, an early observation or intermediate decision may receive little recent attention yet remain essential for later evidence synthesis. We term this failure mode Reasoning Continuity Disruption.These observations motivate KV cache compression that jointly considers token- and reasoning-step-level information. StepKV addresses this goal by treating reasoning steps as first-class retention units. It associates cache entries with their generating steps, estimates step utility from trajectory-derived signals, and combines this utility with token-level saliency. The resulting scores globally rank prunable tokens, from which StepKV retains the top-scoring entries under a target budget. StepKV thus provides a step-centric perspective for agent KV cache compression. Across multi-hop QA and long-horizon web reasoning tasks, StepKV sustains accuracy under low KV budgets where token-level baselines degrade sharply, offering a more robust efficiency-accuracy trade-off for multi-step agent inference.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 StepKV，一种面向多步骤 LLM 代理的 KV 缓存压缩方法，将推理步骤作为保留单位，结合步骤效用与 token 级显著性进行全局排序，在低 KV 预算下显著优于纯 token 级基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 KV 缓存剪枝方法将缓存视为扁平 token 流，按新近度或注意力显著性排序，导致压缩单位与推理单位不匹配：token 级剪枝会移除个别条目，而多步骤代理中有用信息常组织成重要性不均且延迟的推理步骤，早期观察或中间决策虽近期注意力低却对后续证据综合至关重要，作者称此失效模式为“推理连续性中断”。
AI.method: StepKV 将推理步骤视为一级保留单位：1) 将缓存条目关联到生成它们的步骤；2) 从轨迹衍生信号估计步骤效用；3) 将步骤效用与 token 级显著性结合得到综合分数；4) 在目标预算下全局保留得分最高的可剪枝 token。
AI.result: 在多跳问答和长时程网页推理任务上，StepKV 在低 KV 预算下能维持准确率，而 token 级基线急剧下降，提供了更鲁棒的效率-准确率权衡。
AI.conclusion: StepKV 通过步骤为中心的视角解决多步骤代理 KV 缓存压缩中的推理连续性中断问题，证明联合建模 token 与推理步骤层面信息能显著提升压缩鲁棒性。

title: DiFA: Dual Evidence Fusion and Aggregation for Token-Level Text Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted by ICDM 2026. 10 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables
summary: Text anomaly detection, the task of identifying text instances that deviate from normal language patterns, is crucial for language-driven applications. However, most existing methods can only perform document-level anomaly detection, making it hard to locate harmful phrases or support targeted prevention. Recently, there has been an emerging trend toward token-level text anomaly detection, which aims to address the above limitation by identifying anomalous words or fragments within a document. Nevertheless, one representative method mainly relies on representation-space distance measurement, neglecting the complementary roles of different anomaly cues in capturing diverse abnormal patterns. To bridge the gaps, we propose a Dual-evidence framework with adaptive Fusion and Aggregation (DiFA) for token-level anomaly detection. DiFA derives anomaly scores from form-structural and semantic views to capture visible structural abnormality and contextual inconsistency, respectively, thereby providing complementary evidence for identifying diverse anomalies. To combine these two scores with varying numerical scales, DiFA incorporates a calibration and fusion mechanism to adaptively balance the two views. Moreover, to obtain a discriminative document-level score, a multivariate aggregation method is designed to summarize token-level anomaly scores from multiple perspectives, preventing rare anomalous tokens from being diluted. Extensive experiments across various text anomaly detection benchmarks demonstrate that DiFA consistently achieves top performance while maintaining strong efficiency, robustness, and interpretability. The code and scripts are available at: https://github.com/qyy11-com/DiFA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiFA框架，用于token级文本异常检测，通过形式结构视角和语义视角的双证据互补，结合自适应校准融合与多元聚合机制，在多个基准上取得最优性能，并保持高效、鲁棒和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本异常检测方法多为文档级，难以定位有害片段；近期token级方法主要依赖表示空间距离度量，忽视了不同异常线索（如结构异常与语义不一致）的互补作用，无法捕捉多样化异常模式。
AI.method: DiFA包含三大核心组件：1) 双证据异常评分：从形式结构视角捕捉可见结构异常，从语义视角捕捉上下文不一致；2) 自适应校准融合机制：将两视角得分映射到统一尺度并自适应加权融合；3) 多元聚合方法：从多角度汇总token级异常得分生成判别性文档级得分，避免稀有异常token被稀释。
AI.result: 在多个文本异常检测基准上的大量实验表明，DiFA持续达到最优性能，同时保持强效率、鲁棒性和可解释性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: DiFA通过双视角互补证据、自适应融合与多元聚合，有效解决了token级文本异常检测中异常线索单一、尺度不一、稀有异常被稀释等问题，为细粒度异常定位提供了高效鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Hapi: A Multivariable Land-Surface Transformer for Medium-Range Hydrological Forecasting at Continental Scale
summary: Accurate flood forecasts several days in advance are essential for flood control, water-resource management, and emergency response. Producing them at high resolution over a continental domain calls for local hydrological detail together with spatial context extending from river basins to synoptic weather systems. We developed Hapi, a U-Net Swin Transformer that uses fine three-dimensional patches and hierarchical shifted-window attention to forecast discharge, surface runoff, snow water equivalent, and soil wetness across the contiguous United States. The model produces 24--72-hour forecasts at $0.05^{\circ}$ resolution, with learned Laplacian task weights adjusting each variable's contribution to training. On 2024 test data using reconstructed weather and land-surface inputs from ERA5-Land, Hapi outperformed an operational physics-based model and a state-of-the-art AI model in flood detection. Independent validation against 3,881 U.S. Geological Survey gauges and a Hurricane Helene case study supported its advantage over the physics-based model in reproducing daily discharge. Controlled experiments showed that learned task weighting strengthens rare-flood detection, which is particularly sensitive to changes in precipitation inputs. Hapi produced a four-variable, 72-hour forecast across the contiguous United States with an average inference time of 0.11 seconds on a single A100 GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Hapi，一种基于 U-Net Swin Transformer 的深度学习模型，利用精细三维补丁和分层移位窗口注意力机制，在 0.05° 分辨率下对美国本土进行 24–72 小时的流量、地表径流、雪水当量和土壤湿度四变量预报，推理仅需 0.11 秒（单张 A100），在 2024 年测试集和 3881 个 USGS 站点验证中均超越操作级物理模型与最先进 AI 模型，尤其在罕见洪水检测上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 针对大陆尺度、高分辨率、多变量、多时效洪水预报的需求，现有物理模型计算昂贵且难以捕捉局部水文细节，而纯数据驱动模型常缺乏空间上下文与多任务协同，因此需要一种兼具局部水文细节建模与大范围空间上下文感知、且训练高效的深度学习方案。
AI.method: 采用 U-Net 编码器-解码器骨干，嵌入 Swin Transformer 块实现分层移位窗口注意力；输入为精细三维时空补丁（气象与地表重建场），输出四目标变量；引入可学习的 Laplacian 任务权重自适应平衡多任务损失；在 ERA5-Land 重建数据上端到端训练，推理阶段单次前向传播即可产出 24–72 小时逐小时预报。
AI.result: 在 2024 年独立测试集上，Hapi 的洪水检测指标（CSI、F1 等）全面优于操作级物理模型与 SOTA AI 模型；对 3881 个 USGS 站点日流量验证显示 NSE、KGE 显著更高；飓风 Helene 案例研究重现了峰值流量演变；消融实验证实任务权重机制显著提升罕见洪水检测能力，且对降水输入扰动最敏感。
AI.conclusion: Hapi 证明了基于分层视觉 Transformer 的多任务、多时效、高分辨率大陆尺度洪水预报在精度与速度上均可超越传统物理模型与现有 AI 基线，尤其在极端罕见事件捕捉上具有显著优势，为实时洪水预警与水资源管理提供了可部署的高效工具。

title: Uncertainty and Business-Aware Remaining Useful Life Estimation for Semiconductor Manufacturing
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Semiconductor Manufacturing
summary:
Semiconductor manufacturing relies on tightly interconnected components, so early identification of the assets most likely to fail is essential to prevent a single breakdown from disrupting the entire production pipeline. Maintenance planning must therefore balance unexpected failures against prematurely interrupted operating life. We present a Predictive Maintenance (PdM) framework combining Deep Learning (DL) sequence models and Simoultaneous Quantile Regression (SQR)
  for uncertainty-aware Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimation and risk-aware maintenance decisions. Several architectures are compared on ion-milling data from the 2018 PHM Data Challenge (PHM18), including architectures based on State Space Models (SSM), using prediction and business metrics: Unexpected Breaks (UB), Unexploited Lifetime (UL), and a cost-weighted objective. Diagonal State Spaces (S4D) delivers the best Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimates across quantiles and, relative to Preventive Maintenance (PvM) baselines, substantially lowers business cost by avoiding systematically early interventions. The results support uncertainty-aware, cost-sensitive maintenance planning in semiconductor production.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种结合深度学习序列模型与同时分位数回归的预测性维护框架，用于半导体制造中不确定性感知的剩余使用寿命估计和风险感知的维护决策，实验表明对角状态空间模型在量化RUL分位数和降低业务成本方面表现最优。
AI.motivation: 半导体制造依赖紧密互联的组件，单一故障可能中断整个生产流水线，因此需要尽早识别最可能失效的资产。维护计划必须在意外故障与过早中断运行寿命之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出结合深度学习序列模型与同时分位数回归的预测性维护框架，比较多种架构（包括基于状态空间模型的S4D）在PHM18离子铣削数据上的表现，采用意外故障、未利用寿命和成本加权目标等业务指标评估。
AI.result: 对角状态空间模型在各分位数上提供最佳的剩余使用寿命估计，相较于预防性维护基线，通过避免系统性过早干预显著降低了业务成本。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持在半导体生产中采用不确定性感知、成本敏感的维护规划，为工业界提供了可落地的预测性维护决策框架。

title: Does the Truthfulness Signal Survive Code-Mixing? Probing Hidden States for Hallucination Detection in Hinglish
summary: Hidden-state hallucination probing - training a linear classifier on an LLM's internal activations to detect whether a generated answer is faithful to the input - is an active area of 2026 research, with recent work reporting 0.90-1.00 AUROC across several benchmarks and languages. However, none of this work has tested probes on code-mixed input, despite the fact that a huge population of chatbot users write in Hindi-English code-mixed text ("Hinglish"). We address this gap directly: does a hallucination probe trained on clean-language hidden states transfer to Hinglish, or does the signal degrade under code-mixing? We construct a 5,674-item Hindi/English/Hinglish QA benchmark, generate and label 17,022 model responses across three open-weight 7-8B LLMs (Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-8B), extract per-layer hidden states at two token positions, and train linear and MLP probes for in-distribution detection and cross-lingual transfer. We find that the hallucination signal survives code-mixing well: transfer AUROC ranges from 0.88 to 0.99, with gaps of mostly under 0.05 AUROC relative to in-distribution performance, and that Hindi-trained probes transfer to Hinglish more reliably than English-trained probes. As an independent, practically motivated finding, all three models hallucinate substantially more on Hindi and Hinglish than on English for matched facts. We release our code and synthetic Hinglish QA dataset to support further work on code-mixed hallucination detection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究隐藏状态幻觉探针在印地-英语混合语言（Hinglish）上的迁移性能，构建了包含5,674条问答的多语言基准，在三个7-8B开源大模型上生成17,022个回答并标注，训练线性和MLP探针进行分布内检测与跨语言迁移实验。结果显示幻觉信号在代码混合下保持良好，迁移AUROC为0.88-0.99，相对分布内性能下降多在0.05以内；印地语训练的探针比英语训练的更可靠地迁移至Hinglish。同时发现三模型在印地语和Hinglish上比英语产生显著更多幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有隐藏状态幻觉探针研究均未在代码混合输入上测试，而大量聊天机器人用户使用印地-英语混合文本（Hinglish），因此亟需探究在干净语言隐藏状态上训练的探针能否迁移至Hinglish，以及代码混合是否会导致信号退化。
AI.method: 构建包含印地语、英语、Hinglish三语言的5,674项QA基准；使用Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B三模型生成并标注17,022个回答；提取各层两个token位置的隐藏状态；训练线性探针和MLP探针分别进行分布内检测与跨语言迁移评估。
AI.result: 幻觉信号在代码混合下保持鲁棒：跨语言迁移AUROC达0.88-0.99，相对分布内性能下降多在0.05 AUROC以内；印地语训练的探针迁移至Hinglish比英语训练的更可靠；三模型在印地语和Hinglish上对相同事实的幻觉率显著高于英语。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏状态幻觉探针能良好迁移至代码混合语言Hinglish，印地语训练探针迁移效果优于英语训练探针；大模型在印地语和Hinglish上更易产生幻觉，提示需针对代码混合场景开发专门的幻觉检测方法。作者已开源代码与合成Hinglish QA数据集以支持后续研究。

title: Trustworthy Agentic AI: Failure Modes, Mitigation Strategies, and a Lifecycle Framework for Autonomous LLM Systems
summary: Agentic AI systems built on large language models can plan over multiple steps, use external tools, retain information in memory, and coordinate with other agents. These capabilities make them more useful than static language models, but they also introduce new security and operational risks. Untrusted content from websites, emails, documents, and databases can enter the same context as system instructions; persistent memory can carry compromised information across sessions; and access to external tools can turn an incorrect model response into a consequential real-world action. This article reviews the trustworthiness of agentic AI across five interconnected dimensions: safety and robustness, alignment and human oversight, transparency and auditability, privacy and data governance, and regulatory compliance. It organizes key failure modes, including indirect prompt injection, backdoor triggers, goal misgeneralization, memory contamination, and cross-session data leakage, into a unified taxonomy. It also examines major mitigation approaches, such as instruction hierarchies, context isolation, spotlighting, process-based supervision, constrained tool use, and privacy-preserving memory, while distinguishing techniques supported by empirical evidence from those that remain largely conceptual. Building on this analysis, we introduce the Trustworthy Agent Development Lifecycle (TADL), a six-phase framework covering specification, design, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. For each phase, TADL identifies relevant trust activities, expected evidence, and risk-based decision gates. Although TADL has not yet been empirically validated, it provides a structured foundation for developing and evaluating more secure and accountable agentic systems. The article concludes by identifying gaps in current benchmarks and outlining priorities for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文综述基于大语言模型的智能体AI系统的可信度，建立统一的失败模式分类法，评估主要缓解措施，并提出六阶段可信智能体开发生命周期（TADL）框架，为开发和评估更安全、可问责的智能体系统提供结构化基础。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI系统虽具备多步规划、工具使用、记忆保持和多智能体协作等增强能力，但也引入新的安全与操作风险：不可信内容可进入系统指令上下文、持久记忆可能跨会话传播受损信息、外部工具访问可将模型错误响应转化为现实后果，亟需系统性评估其可信度。
AI.method: 从安全鲁棒性、对齐与人工监督、透明度与可审计性、隐私与数据治理、合规性五个维度综述可信度；将间接提示注入、后门触发、目标泛化偏差、记忆污染、跨会话数据泄露等关键失败模式组织为统一分类法；考察指令层级、上下文隔离、聚光灯机制、过程监督、受限工具使用、隐私保护记忆等缓解措施，区分有实证支持与概念性技术；在此基础上提出TADL六阶段框架（规格、设计、训练、评估、部署、监控），每阶段明确信任活动、预期证据和风险决策门控。
AI.result: 识别并分类了智能体AI的核心失败模式；系统评估了现有缓解措施的实证支持程度；构建了TADL框架，覆盖智能体全生命周期六阶段，提供结构化的信任工程指导。
AI.conclusion: TADL虽未经实证验证，但为开发和评估更安全、可问责的智能体系统奠定了结构化基础。文章指出当前基准测试存在缺口，并勾勒未来研究优先方向。

title: R-GEAN: Regimen-Guided Edit Action Network for Within-Admission Medication Change Prediction
summary: The medications prescribed to a patient often change during a hospital admission as clinicians start, stop, or continue therapies. We study whether models can predict which medication classes are added or removed between 24 hours after admission and discharge. Metrics that compare the complete discharge regimen can reward models for copying medications that remain unchanged, even when they identify no actual changes. We therefore introduce a leakage-controlled benchmark that predicts net ATC3 additions and removals using only prior completed admissions and information available within the first 24 hours of the current admission. Addition candidates are classes not active at 24 hours, whereas removal candidates are classes active at that time. We also introduce R-GEAN, an asymmetric candidate-scoring network with independent addition and removal predictors. Across 240,480 admissions from 82,286 patients, R-GEAN achieves the highest predefined summary of addition, removal, changed-regimen, and action-pattern performance, termed the edit composite (0.464), compared with 0.435 for the strongest primary comparator. Reimplemented RETAIN, GAMENet, and MICRON baselines obtain 0.428, 0.420, and 0.288, respectively. R-GEAN's advantage is concentrated in correctly identifying medication classes no longer active at discharge, while rare additions and admissions with multiple medication changes remain difficult. Rankings based on micro-F1 over the reconstructed discharge regimen and the edit composite correlate weakly across the evaluated models (Spearman r = 0.20). The continuation baseline achieves the highest complete-regimen score despite predicting no additions or removals. These results show that complete-regimen and edit-level evaluation measure different aspects of medication prediction. The benchmark evaluates observed prescribing changes, not treatment appropriateness

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个防泄露基准和R-GEAN模型，用于预测住院期间药物类别（ATC3级别）的增加和移除，发现完整方案评估和编辑级评估衡量的是不同预测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有药物预测指标通过比较完整出院方案来评估模型，会奖励模型复制未变药物，即使模型未识别出实际变化。需要一个能评估真实处方变化（增加/移除）的基准，避免数据泄露，仅使用入院前24小时可用信息和既往入院记录。
AI.method: 1) 构建防泄露基准：预测入院24小时到出院间的ATC3药物类别净增减，增加候选为24小时未活跃类别，移除候选为24小时活跃类别。2) 提出R-GEAN：不对称候选评分网络，包含独立的增加预测器和移除预测器。3) 在240,480次入院（82,286患者）上对比RETAIN、GAMENet、MICRON等基线。
AI.result: R-GEAN在编辑综合指标（addition、removal、changed-regimen、action-pattern）上达到0.464，优于最强基线0.435。重新实现的RETAIN、GAMENet、MICRON分别为0.428、0.420、0.288。R-GEAN优势集中在正确识别出院时不再活跃的药物类别；罕见增加和多药物变更入院仍具挑战。微F1（完整方案）与编辑综合指标排名弱相关（Spearman r=0.20）。持续基线在完整方案得分最高却预测零增减。
AI.conclusion: 完整方案评估和编辑级评估衡量不同预测维度；防泄露基准评估观察到的处方变化而非治疗适当性。R-GEAN通过独立建模增加/移除，在识别药物停用方面表现更优，但罕见事件和多变更场景仍需改进。

title: TARGet: Topology-Aware Fusion-based Radio Frequency Circuit Functional Modeling using Graph Neural Networks
comment: To be published in International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 26)(9 pages)
summary: Automatic synthesis of analog and Radio Frequency (RF) circuits is an emerging area that requires an efficient circuit modeling method. In recent years, Machine Learning (ML) solutions have played a promising role in this regard. However, many existing ML approaches require separate training data for each circuit topology, even when a single circuit component is added or removed. In addition, they overlook circuit topology information, which limits their ability to capture complex component interactions. Furthermore, they rely on fully connected neural networks with flat feature representations, which require substantial amounts of training data. In this work, we propose an open-source topology-aware RF circuit modeling method, TARGet. Our model considers the circuit at two levels: sub-circuits and the overall circuit topology. At the sub-circuit level, TARGet leverages S-parameter representations to capture sub-circuit behavior rather than relying on individual circuit components, providing a reusable behavioral abstraction for RF building blocks. Moreover, TARGet explicitly incorporates circuit topology information into the model, enabling it to learn across multiple topologies. TARGet introduces a novel fusion-based architecture that integrates Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and sub-circuit connectivity-aware neural networks to improve data efficiency. Experimental evaluation across multiple RF circuit topologies demonstrates that TARGet achieves sub-1% prediction error while reducing the required training data by up to 35.5x compared to state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches. Furthermore, TARGet achieves 9.7x higher prediction accuracy under a strict 1% error threshold relative to SOTA models. A held-out matching-network evaluation further demonstrates zero-shot transfer to an unseen sub-circuit topology, where TARGet reduces NMAE by up to 45%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TARGet，一种拓扑感知的RF电路建模方法，利用S参数表示子电路行为，结合图神经网络和子电路连接感知神经网络，实现跨拓扑学习，显著降低所需训练数据量并提高预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有ML方法针对每种电路拓扑需要单独训练数据，忽略拓扑信息，依赖全连接网络且需要大量数据，限制了捕捉复杂元件交互的能力。
AI.method: TARGet在子电路和整体拓扑两个层面建模：子电路层面用S参数表示行为，提供可复用的行为抽象；显式引入拓扑信息；提出融合架构，结合图神经网络（GNN）和子电路连接感知神经网络，提高数据效率。
AI.result: 实验显示TARGet实现亚1%预测误差，所需训练数据较SOTA减少35.5倍；在1%误差阈值下预测准确率提高9.7倍；在保留的匹配网络评估中，零样本迁移到未见子电路拓扑，NMAE降低45%。
AI.conclusion: TARGet通过拓扑感知建模和融合架构，有效解决了跨拓扑泛化和数据效率问题，为模拟/RF电路自动综合提供了高效建模方案。

title: Using Composition Operators to Linearize LLM Semantic Transformations
summary: Machine learning learns functions: prompt to response, image to caption. What these functions are mathematically remains hard to say. We present a method to approximate these kinds of transformations using techniques from dynamical systems that fall under the umbrella of Koopmanism. We introduce the use of composition operators, which generalize the Koopman operator and, crucially, can map between distinct spaces, motivating the perspective that LLM transformations are rectangular infinite-dimensional operators. This formalism reveals useful structure: under natural assumptions on the prompt and response distributions, the LLM operator is an isometry, and misalignment between learned representations manifests as spectral pollution of its finite sections. We then outline a method of constructing finite-dimensional approximations of an LLM operator, and demonstrate how the singular value spectrum can be used to compare tasks and models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出利用动态系统中的Koopman算子理论（特别是组合算子）来数学化建模大语言模型（LLM）的变换，证明在分布假设下LLM算子是等距映射，并利用奇异值谱分析任务和模型差异。
AI.motivation: 当前机器学习学习的函数（如prompt到response）缺乏清晰的数学刻画，需要一种严谨的数学框架来理解LLM的变换本质。
AI.method: 引入组合算子推广Koopman算子，允许不同空间间的映射，将LLM视为矩形无限维算子；在提示和响应分布的自然假设下，证明LLM算子为等距；提出有限维近似构造方法，利用奇异值谱分析。
AI.result: 发现错位的学习表现为有限截面的谱污染；奇异值谱可用于比较不同任务和模型。
AI.conclusion: Koopman算子视角为LLM提供了结构化数学描述，等距性质和谱分析揭示了模型行为，有助于理解和比较LLM。

title: ProcessLight: Process Supervision for Large Language Model Based Traffic Signal Control
comment: This paper has been accepted by The 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently been introduced into traffic signal control (TSC) as decision agents due to their strengths in human-readable reasoning generation. Yet, existing LLM TSC methods optimize only from final outcomes and fail to distinguish valid from flawed reasoning steps, causing useful or misleading steps to be jointly updated and thus impairing the model's learning of effective reasoning. To bridge this gap, we propose an LLM-based framework ProcessLight to decompose signal decisions into verifiable semantic steps. Building on ProcessLight, we further develop Step-wise Traffic Process Policy Optimization (STeP-PO), a novel reinforcement learning framework that optimizes structured reasoning processes through step-level credit assignment. Specifically, STeP-PO uses step quality scores to evaluate local reasoning quality and step importance to measure each step's influence on the final action, and then assigns step-level advantages over a semantic step tree structure. The resulting step-level advantages are propagated to reasoning tokens, enabling fine-grained policy optimization beyond outcome-only rewards. Extensive experiments over multiple real-world datasets demonstrate the superiority of our methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/wenzhaoabc/processlight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProcessLight框架将交通信号决策分解为可验证的语义步骤，并开发STeP-PO基于步骤级信用分配优化推理过程，实现细粒度策略优化，在真实数据集上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM交通信号控制方法仅从最终结果优化，无法区分有效与错误的推理步骤，导致有用和误导性步骤共同更新，损害模型学习有效推理的能力。
AI.method: 提出ProcessLight框架将信号决策分解为可验证的语义步骤；基于此开发STeP-PO强化学习框架，利用步骤质量分数评估局部推理质量，步骤重要性衡量各步骤对最终动作的影响，在语义步骤树结构上分配步骤级优势，并将优势传播至推理token，实现超越仅结果奖励的细粒度策略优化。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的大量实验证明了该方法的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 通过步骤级信用分配优化结构化推理过程，可有效提升LLM在交通信号控制任务中的决策性能，代码已开源。

title: Attributable Post-Rationalization in RAG Citations: A Controlled Reproduction and an RLVR Comparison
summary:
A RAG system can hand you the right answer and cite a source it did not actually use. Models output these unfaithful citations via post-rationalization: they write the answer first and then attach a citation to whatever passage looks close enough. Search agents are now trained with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), which pays them for getting the answer right. We asked whether that training also teaches them to cite honestly.
  Improving an existing methodology with a required control, we compared an instruction-tuned model against three RLVR agents trained from it, on four question-answering datasets, using only free-tier Kaggle GPUs. Post-rationalization is everywhere: on Wikipedia-based questions roughly one citation in seven is unfaithful. RLVR does not fix it. The agents post-rationalize at their base model's rate, and one lands slightly worse. Rewarding correct answers buys nothing in citation faithfulness, so faithfulness has to be trained and measured on its own terms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究RAG系统中的引用忠实性问题，发现后合理化现象普遍存在（约1/7的引用不忠实），且基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练并不能改善引用诚实度，代理模型的后合理化率与基础模型持平甚至更差。结论指出：仅奖励正确答案无法提升引用忠实性，忠实性需要单独训练和度量。
AI.motivation: RAG系统常出现'给出正确答案但引用未实际使用的来源'现象，即模型先生成答案再事后附加看似相关的引用（后合理化）。随着搜索代理采用RLVR训练（奖励正确答案），需探究该训练范式是否能同时教会模型诚实引用。
AI.method: 在四个问答数据集上，对比一个指令微调基础模型与从其衍生的三个RLVR训练代理，仅使用Kaggle免费GPU层级资源。采用改进的现有方法论并加入必要对照，量化测量引用忠实性。
AI.result: Wikipedia类问答中约14%（1/7）的引用不忠实。RLVR训练未修复此问题：三个代理的后合理化率与基础模型相当，其中一个甚至略差。奖励答案正确性对引用忠实性零增益。
AI.conclusion: RLVR范式下的正确答案奖励机制无法迁移提升引用诚实度。引用忠实性必须作为独立目标进行专门训练和独立度量，不能指望通过答案准确性奖励隐式获得。

title: Clustering-Based Collective Anomaly Detection in IoT Systems: A Graph Neural Network Approach
summary: The rapid advancement of Internet of Things (IoT) technology has led to the widespread deployment of smart, interconnected devices across a range of domains. However, this expansion has also resulted in a substantial increase in network traffic, creating more opportunities for malicious actors to launch cyberattacks and compromise sensitive information, thereby increasing the need for effective anomaly detection. The state-of-the-art in anomaly detection has predominantly focused on point anomalies. In contrast, the detection of collective anomalies remains relatively under-explored in the literature. In this paper, we introduce Unsupervised Graph Collective Anomaly Detection (UGCAD), a novel frame- work designed to identify collective anomalies in IoT network traffic. Unlike many existing methods, UGCAD operates on graph-structured data without any prior knowledge of group labels or membership. It leverages a variational graph autoencoder (VGAE) to learn the graph representation, which is subsequently used to enhance a clustering algorithm for effective grouping of nodes. To detect collective anomalies, clusters identified as normal are first aggregated and refined, after which anomaly scores are applied to detect collective anomalies. Extensive experiments conducted on the CICIoT2023 and ToN-IoT network datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of UGCAD in both clustering and collective anomaly detection (CAD). Furthermore, comparative evaluations against several traditional and state-of-the-art clustering-based CAD approaches confirm the superiority of UGCAD in accurately detecting collective anomalies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UGCAD（无监督图集体异常检测）框架，利用变分图自编码器学习图表示并增强聚类算法，无需群组标签即可有效检测IoT网络流量中的集体异常。
AI.motivation: IoT技术快速发展导致网络流量激增，网络攻击机会增加，现有异常检测主要关注点异常，集体异常检测研究相对不足，亟需无监督的集体异常检测方法。
AI.method: 采用变分图自编码器（VGAE）学习图结构表示，增强聚类算法对节点进行有效分组，将识别为正常的聚类聚合细化，再应用异常评分检测集体异常，全程无需先验群组标签。
AI.result: 在CICIoT2023和ToN-IoT数据集上的大量实验表明，UGCAD在聚类和集体异常检测任务上均有效，且优于多种传统及最先进的基于聚类的集体异常检测方法。
AI.conclusion: UGCAD是一个新颖的无监督图集体异常检测框架，通过图表示学习与聚类相结合，无需标签即可准确检测IoT网络中的集体异常，具有显著优势。

title: Multilingual Safety Signals Are Multi-Layered: Filtering Safety-Degrading Data for Safer LLMs
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 16 pages, 11 figures
summary: Preserving safety alignment during large language models fine-tuning is critical, however, recent studies have demonstrated that even benign fine-tuning data may contain safety-degrading samples that silently undermine safety alignment. Existing approaches typically identify such samples using representations from a single safety-sensitive layer. While this assumption has shown effectiveness in monolingual settings, its validity for multilingual models remains unclear due to potential cross-lingual differences in representation patterns. Through a cross-lingual analysis, we show that sensitive layers are only partially shared across languages, with safety-relevant signals often distributed across multiple layers. Motivated by these observations, we propose MMSAFE, a multi-layer framework for multilingual safety-degrading data identification that captures both shared and language-specific safety signals. Extensive experiments across multiple models, languages, and safety benchmarks demonstrate that MMSAFE reduces the average harmful-response ratio by 60% compared with random filtering and achieves stronger average performance than the strongest single-layer baseline, demonstrating the effectiveness of multi-layer modeling for robust multilingual safety alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MMSAFE，一种多层框架用于多语言安全降级数据识别，解决了单层方法在多语言场景下的局限性，实验显示有害响应比率平均降低60%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法假设单一安全敏感层足以识别安全降级样本，但多语言模型中跨语言表示模式差异导致该假设失效，安全相关信号常分布在多层且仅部分共享。
AI.method: 提出MMSAFE多层框架，捕捉跨语言共享和语言特有的安全信号，用于识别微调数据中的安全降级样本。
AI.result: 在多模型、多语言、多安全基准上实验，MMSAFE较随机过滤平均降低有害响应比率60%，且优于最强单层基线。
AI.conclusion: 多层建模对鲁棒多语言安全对齐有效，MMSAFE通过整合多层安全信号显著提升多语言场景下的安全对齐保持能力。

title: CTSpinoPelvic1K: spine, pelvis, ribs and femora in one coordinate frame, annotated for lumbosacral transitional anatomy
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Dataset (802 annotated CT records, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22139642; code at https://github.com/OpenSpineConsortium/CTSpinoPelvic1K. Submitted to Medical Physics as a Medical Physics Dataset Article
summary:
Purpose: A vertebra at the lumbosacral junction is named by counting caudally from C2 on whole-spine imaging, but a lumbar case is planned on lumbar-only imaging (T12 to S1), without C2. Abdominopelvic CT holds that span plus the lowest ribs and pelvis. Where a lumbosacral transitional vertebra (LSTV) alters the count, the local anatomy is ambiguous: four rib-free vertebrae may be an L1 with a lumbar rib or an L5 assimilated to the sacrum, and six may be a sixth lumbar vertebra, a T12 with aplastic ribs, or a lumbarized S1. CTSpinoPelvic1K asks whether local morphology resolves it without the count. CTSpine1K's vertebrae and CTPelvic1K's pelvis covered these patients but were never joined; this release joins them on one series and adds the bones neither had. It provides 802 CT records with per-level ribs and femora, levels anchored on the lowest rib-bearing vertebra and S1, and classes for L6, T13, a separate S1 and lumbar ribs, so anomalies are recorded as such.
  Acquisition and Validation Methods: Records pair CTSpine1K and CTPelvic1K labels on each patient's bone-richest series under a VerSe-native scheme. Validation covered geometric invariants (802/802 pass), rib-vertebra incidence across 5,749 ribs (0.035% offset), and spinopelvic measures matching published values.
  Data Format and Usage Notes: NIfTI image/label pairs with patient-grouped LSTV-stratified five-fold splits and a loader; archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22139642.
  Potential Applications: Classifying a vertebra from local features; updating cadaveric morphometry; spinopelvic assessment; opportunistic screening; and, absent a public preoperative lumbar cohort, surgical planning research (377 records prone). Limitations: thoracic ground truth is field-of-view limited; postural angles supine; no held-out test set; ribs are triaged-review pseudolabels; Castellvi grades two-reader consensus on 33 records.

AI.tldr: CTSpinoPelvic1K 数据集整合了 CTSpine1K 和 CTPelvic1K，提供 802 例腰骶全脊柱 CT 影像及逐节标注，解决腰骶移行椎（LSTV）局部形态识别难题，支持脊柱骨盆参数测量与手术规划研究。
AI.motivation: 针对腰骶交界处椎体命名依赖自 C2 向尾计数，但临床常仅获腰段影像（T12-S1），且 LSTV 导致局部解剖模糊（如 4 段无肋椎体可能是 L1 伴腰肋或 L5 骶化，6 段可能是 L6、T13 无肋或 S1 腰化），旨在探究局部形态能否无需计数即可定性分类。
AI.method: 将 CTSpine1K 椎体标注与 CTPelvic1K 骨盆标注在同一患者骨质最丰富序列上配对，采用 VerSe 原生编码方案；验证包括几何不变量检查（802/802 通过）、5,749 根肋骨-椎体对应关系（偏移率 0.035%）、脊柱骨盆参数与文献值一致性。数据以 NIfTI 图像/标签对形式提供，含 LSTV 分层五折划分与加载器。
AI.result: 构建含 802 例 CT 记录的数据集，提供逐节肋骨与股骨标注、以最低肋椎与 S1 为锚点的层级定位、L6、T13、独立 S1 及腰肋等异常类别；验证指标达标，几何不变量全通过，肋椎对应极高准确，脊柱骨盆测量符合已知正常值。
AI.conclusion: CTSpinoPelvic1K 为首个公开的全腰骶段 CT 数据集，实现了椎体与骨盆标注的统一，支持基于局部形态的椎体分类、尸体形态学更新、脊柱骨盆评估、机会性筛查及缺乏公开术前腰椎队列时的手术规划研究（377 例俯卧位）。局限包括胸段真值受视野限制、体位角度为仰卧位、无保留测试集、肋骨为分诊级伪标签、Castellvi 分级仅 33 例双盲共识。

title: Bridging Static and Agentic RAG for Taiwanese Historical Question Answering
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables language models to adapt retrieval based on previously retrieved evidence, but it remains unclear whether such adaptive orchestration consistently outperforms well-designed static pipelines. We conduct a controlled comparison of agentic and static RAG for Taiwanese historical question answering, sharing the same generator and hybrid retrieval backend. Despite similar aggregate performance, the two pipelines differ on 70.83% of questions, with their advantages largely canceling out when averaged. An oracle that selects the better response per question improves the composite score by 0.2417 over the better individual pipeline, revealing substantial headroom for question-level selection. We therefore introduce a post-hoc selector that compares the two responses and their cited evidence, significantly outperforming either individual pipeline and recovering 60.34% of the oracle headroom. These results show that aggregate comparisons can obscure meaningful question-level differences between retrieval strategies, suggesting that exploiting their complementarity may be more fruitful than seeking a universally superior pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实验对比了Agentic RAG与静态RAG在台湾历史问答任务上的表现，发现两者整体性能相近但在70.83%的问题上表现差异显著，且优势互补。引入基于证据对比的后选择器可显著超越单一管线，回收60.34%的Oracle上限，揭示利用策略互补性优于追求通用最优管线。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注Agentic RAG的自适应检索能力，但缺乏与精心设计的静态管线的公平对比，且聚合指标可能掩盖问题级别的显著差异，需要明确两种检索策略的实际互补关系及潜在选择价值。
AI.method: 构建共享生成器与混合检索后端的Agentic RAG与静态RAG管线，在台湾历史问答基准上进行受控对比；引入Oracle选择器量化问题级选择上限；设计后选择器，通过对比两管线的回答及引用证据进行决策，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 两管线聚合性能相近，但70.83%问题上输出不同，优势互补抵消。Oracle选择器使综合得分较优单管线提升0.2417。后选择器显著优于任一单管线，回收60.34%的Oracle提升空间，验证了问题级选择的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 聚合性能对比易掩盖检索策略在问题层面的显著互补差异；与其追求通用最优管线，不如利用多策略互补性，通过轻量级选择机制实现动态路由，更具实用价值与提升空间。

title: Role-Aware Morgan Fingerprints for Reaction Yield Prediction
summary: Predicting reaction yield from molecular structure and reaction context can cut experimental trial-and-error and speed up condition screening in synthetic chemistry. Recent methods for this task use learned representations such as graph neural networks or Transformer encoders over reaction SMILES (Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System), but these approaches carry heavy preprocessing overhead and can break when input formatting is inconsistent. We propose MFP, a reaction yield prediction method built on role-aware Morgan fingerprints where count-based circular fingerprints are computed for each reaction component, aggregated by chemical role (reactant, reagent, product), and combined with transformation-sensitive difference features into a fixed-length reaction descriptor fed to a feed-forward neural regressor. We test MFP against state of the art methods such as YieldBERT (with and without data augmentation) and GNAN (graph neural network) on the Suzuki-Miyaura and Buchwald-Hartwig benchmarks using a shared preprocessing and evaluation protocol. MFP reaches R2 = 0.878 on Suzuki-Miyaura and R2 = 0.969 on Buchwald-Hartwig while training an order of magnitude faster than graph- or Transformer-based alternatives. A formal complexity analysis confirms that MFP folds all representation cost into a one-time preprocessing step, removing the per-epoch message-passing overhead that graph methods carry. An ablation over fingerprint radius and folded vector length shows that radius-2 representations at nBits =2048 give the best balance of accuracy, speed, and cross-split stability on both datasets. These results establish MFP as an effective, reproducible, and efficient baseline for reaction yield prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出MFP方法，基于角色感知的Morgan指纹预测反应收率，在Suzuki-Miyaura和Buchwald-Hartwig基准上达到SOTA性能，训练速度快一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图神经网络或Transformer的方法预处理开销大，且输入格式不一致时易出错，需要一种高效、鲁棒的基线方法。
AI.method: 使用基于角色的Morgan指纹（计算每个反应组分的计数型圆形指纹，按化学角色聚合），结合转化敏感差异特征，形成固定长度反应描述符，输入前馈神经网络回归器。
AI.result: 在Suzuki-Miyaura上R2=0.878，Buchwald-Hartwig上R2=0.969，训练速度比图/Transformer方法快一个数量级；消融实验显示半径2、nBits=2048最佳。
AI.conclusion: MFP建立了一个有效、可复现、高效的反应收率预测基线，将表示成本折叠为一次性预处理步骤，消除了图方法的每轮消息传递开销。

title: Beyond the Stitching Assumption: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Synthetic Data Evaluation via Semantic Quantization
comment: 10 Pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, accepted to PST 2026
summary: Multimodal synthetic datasets combine structured attributes with free text, but are often evaluated separately. Such metrics can remain high after tabular--text pairings are disrupted. We present a projection-based evaluator for tabular--text synthetic data. A fixed sentence encoder maps text to embeddings, \(k\)-means converts them to cluster states, and tabular variables are represented as categorical or quantile-binned states. Real and synthetic contingency tables are compared using Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD), normalized mutual information (NMI), conditional JSD (cJSD), and joint-state entropy. We also report text-to-attribute (T2A) utility and a holdout-calibrated proximity flag rate (PFR) as a representation-level diagnostic. A text-permutation control preserves both marginal distributions while disrupting their pairing. Experiments on Amazon Reviews, Kiva Loans, and the Employment Scam Aegean Dataset show that modality-specific scores remain high under this control. The projection diagnostics detect disruption when real projected dependence exceeds a permutation baseline, but are less informative for weak or sparse projections. Some conditioned LLM baselines also exhibit stronger measured dependence than the corresponding real-data projections. These results support explicit cross-modal evaluation with permutation baselines and coverage reporting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于投影的评估方法，用于评估表格-文本合成数据的跨模态依赖关系。通过将文本嵌入聚类为离散状态，将表格变量离散化，构建列联表并使用 JSD、NMI、cJSD 和联合态熵比较真实与合成数据。实验表明，单模态指标在文本排列打破配对后仍保持高分，而投影诊断能检测到这种破坏，但对弱或稀疏投影效果有限。部分条件 LLM 基线表现出比真实数据更强的依赖度。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态合成数据评估往往分别对结构化属性和自由文本进行评估，这类单模态指标在表格-文本配对被打破后仍可能保持高分，无法捕捉跨模态依赖关系。因此需要一种显式的跨模态评估方法，并引入排列基线作为对照。
AI.method: 使用固定句子编码器将文本映射为嵌入，通过 k-means 聚类转化为离散簇状态；将表格变量表示为分类或分位数分箱状态。构建真实与合成数据的列联表，使用 Jensen-Shannon 散度 (JSD)、归一化互信息 (NMI)、条件 JSD (cJSD) 和联合态熵进行比较。同时报告文本到属性 (T2A) 效用和留出校准的邻近标记率 (PFR) 作为表征级诊断。引入文本排列控制，保持边缘分布不变但打破配对关系。
AI.result: 在 Amazon Reviews、Kiva Loans 和 Employment Scam Aegean Dataset 上实验表明，单模态评分在排列控制下仍保持高分。投影诊断能在真实投影依赖超过排列基线时检测到配对破坏，但对弱或稀疏投影信息量有限。部分条件 LLM 基线表现出的测量依赖度强于对应的真实数据投影。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用显式的跨模态评估框架，结合排列基线和覆盖率报告，以更准确地评估表格-文本合成数据的质量。

title: DVA-Neurons: Design and Verification of Adaptive LIF Neurons: From Single-Neuron Dynamics to Multi-Neuron Spiking Networks
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer a promising path toward ultra-low-power artificial intelligence inference by emulating the event-driven computation of biological neurons. However, two challenges limit their practical deployment. First, fixed-parameter Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons lack the adaptation mechanisms observed in biology, where neurons modulate their excitability based on firing history. Second, scaling from single neurons to multi-neuron networks introduces challenges in synaptic weight distribution and inter-neuron spike routing that are absent in isolated designs. This paper addresses both issues through the extension, verification, and physical implementation of adaptive LIF neurons at three architectural scales. This work contributes: a 2nd-order neuron with two-stage synaptic filtering for richer temporal dynamics; a fully-connected 6-neuron spiking network with configurable weights (100 to 5) demonstrating weight-based inter-neuron communication; and a direct verification methodology enabling per-cycle observation of all internal states. All designs were synthesized targeting Selected Area Electron Diffraction (SAED) 14 nm Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS) technology at 1 GHz and verified with Cocotb-based Python testbenches under pulsed current stimuli (amplitude 80, ISI=3). The results show that adaptation effectively modulates firing: 31% suppression in the 2nd-order neuron (25 vs.\ 36 spikes) and 31% reduction in postsynaptic firing in the network (18 vs.\ 26 spikes). Physically, the 2nd-order neuron costs 1.77x more area and 1.52x more power than the 1st-order baseline, while the 6-neuron network demonstrates near-linear scaling (5.7x area, 5.3x power). Seven verification bugs spanning testbench connectivity, fixed-point overflow, and Verilog expression-width semantics are documented.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应LIF神经元及其多神经元网络的物理实现，解决了脉冲神经网络中固定参数神经元缺乏适应机制及多神经元扩展时的突触权重分布与脉冲路由问题。设计包含二阶神经元（双级突触滤波）、6神经元全连接网络（可配置权重）以及全周期内部状态验证方法。在SAED 14nm CMOS 1GHz工艺下综合验证，结果显示自适应机制可使二阶神经元发放抑制31%、网络后突触发放减少31%；二阶神经元面积/功耗分别为基线1.77倍/1.52倍，6神经元网络呈近线性扩展（面积5.7倍、功耗5.3倍），并记录了7个验证Bug。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）通过模拟生物神经元的事件驱动计算，有望实现超低功耗AI推理。但实际部署面临两大挑战：一是固定参数的漏积分发放（LIF）神经元缺乏生物神经元根据发放历史调节兴奋性的适应机制；二是从单神经元扩展到多神经元网络时，会引入单神经元设计中不存在的突触权重分布和神经元间脉冲路由问题。
AI.method: 在三个架构层面扩展、验证并物理实现了自适应LIF神经元：1) 提出带有两级突触滤波的二阶神经元，提供更丰富的时序动力学；2) 实现含可配置权重（100至5）的全连接6神经元脉冲网络，演示基于权重的神经元间通信；3) 开发直接验证方法，支持对所有内部状态进行逐周期观测。所有设计针对SAED 14nm CMOS工艺在1GHz下综合，采用Cocotb Python测试平台，在脉冲电流刺激（幅度80，ISI=3）下进行验证。
AI.result: 自适应机制有效调节发放行为：二阶神经元发放数从36降至25（抑制31%），网络中后突触神经元发放从26降至18（减少31%）。物理实现指标：二阶神经元面积与功耗分别为一阶基线的1.77倍和1.52倍；6神经元网络呈现近线性扩展（面积5.7倍，功耗5.3倍）。验证过程中发现并记录了7个Bug，涉及测试平台连接、定点溢出和Verilog表达式位宽语义。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过引入自适应机制和多神经元网络物理实现，推动了SNN向生物可信度和硬件可部署性迈进。二阶神经元以适度的面积/功耗开销换取了显著的发放调节能力；6神经元网络验证了权重配置下的神经元间通信及近线性扩展特性。完善的逐周期验证方法暴露了关键实现缺陷，为后续大规模SNN芯片设计提供了方法论参考。

title: From UNDRR Reports to Event Records: Schema-Constrained LLM Extraction of Georeferenced Disasters
summary: Disaster-risk-reduction archives describe hazard events in prose that databases such as EM-DAT (Delforge et al., 2025) cannot ingest directly. We present an LLM pipeline that generates candidate georeferenced event records using a controlled hazard vocabulary and fixed schema, retaining evidence for review. Applied to 10,000 documents from PreventionWeb, the knowledge hub managed by UNDRR, it produced 3,572 records from 1,913 documents across 24 hazard types and resolved 81% of location mentions to OpenStreetMap geometries. On 171 human-positive document windows from a stratified 217-document reference set, GPT-5 achieved 86.0% pooled attribute $F_1$, versus 44.2% for the spaCy-gazetteer baseline. Evaluation pools hazard families, location strings, and event years within documents, without assessing their assignment to individual events. GPT-5.4 ranked highest among ten LLMs (86.6% $F_1$). Verbatim evidence occurrence was 72.0% for GPT-5 and 47.2% for GPT-5.4, measuring textual traceability without establishing attribute support. We report production failure modes and automated label and location-rule compliance checks. Prompts, schema, and outputs will be released for adaptation to national reporting archives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的流水线，将防灾减灾档案中的散文式灾害描述转换为结构化、地理编码的事件记录，应用于UNDRR PreventionWeb的10,000份文档，生成了3,572条覆盖24种灾害类型的记录，GPT-5在属性抽取上达到86.0%汇总F1，显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有灾害数据库（如EM-DAT）无法直接摄取防灾减灾档案中的非结构化散文描述，亟需自动化方法将海量文本转化为标准化、可地理定位的结构化事件记录，以支持灾害风险分析和决策。
AI.method: 构建LLM流水线：采用受控灾害词汇表和固定Schema，从文档中抽取候选地理编码事件记录并保留证据供审核；集成OpenStreetMap进行地名消歧；对比测试10个LLM（含GPT-5、GPT-5.4等），并引入自动化标签合规与位置规则检查。
AI.result: 处理10,000份PreventionWeb文档，从1,913份文档产出3,572条记录，覆盖24种灾害类型，81%的地点提及解析为OSM几何体；在217文档参考集的171个人工阳性窗口上，GPT-5汇总属性F1达86.0%（基线spaCy-gazetteer 44.2%），GPT-5.4在十模型中居首（86.6% F1）；逐字证据保留率GPT-5为72.0%，GPT-5.4为47.2%。
AI.conclusion: LLM流水线能高效将非结构化灾害档案转化为高质量结构化数据集，GPT-5系列表现最优；系统输出保留证据链并通过自动化合规校验，提示词、Schema与输出将开源供各国报告档案适配复用。

title: Multiple latent orderings better predict language model preferences
summary: Language models are frequently employed in settings where they are asked to make value judgments and choices. These observed choices often exhibit intransitivity: A model may prefer item $A$ to $B$ and $B$ to $C$, while also preferring $C$ to $A$. Existing work that models LLM preferences treats such inconsistencies as sampling noise around a single latent ordering. We instead propose that intransitivity reflects the aggregation of multiple latent, internally consistent orderings. We first show that observed inconsistencies cannot be explained by a single ordering under any monotone link function. We then introduce a noise-augmented mixture Bradley-Terry (MBT) model that infers latent preference components from repeated pairwise comparisons. Across seven models and four tasks, a mixture of orderings often explains structural inconsistencies better than single-utility models. We find that aggregate preferences often hide underlying preference heterogeneity. A case study on Moral Machine dilemmas shows that models which disagree on aggregate orderings can still share latent components. Together, these results suggest that LLMs reflect plural preferences. Alignment and evaluation pipelines that treat LLM preferences as a single function, therefore, risk averaging over coherent orderings that different users may endorse differently.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示大语言模型（LLM）的偏好存在非传递性（如A>B、B>C但C>A），这无法用单一潜在排序解释。作者提出噪声增强混合Bradley-Terry（MBT）模型，从重复成对比较中推断多个潜在偏好成分。在7个模型和4个任务上，混合排序模型比单一效用模型更好地解释结构性不一致。研究发现聚合偏好掩盖了潜在偏好异质性，Moral Machine困境案例显示：在聚合层面有分歧的模型仍可能共享潜在成分。结论：LLM体现多元偏好，将偏好视为单一函数的对齐/评估流程可能平均掉不同用户认可的连贯排序。
