AI.motivation: 现有研究将LLM偏好中的非传递性视为围绕单一潜在排序的采样噪声。作者认为非传递性实则反映了多个内部一致的潜在排序的聚合，旨在揭示并建模这种偏好多元性。
AI.method: 首先证明：在任何单调链接函数下，观测到的非传递性均无法用单一潜在排序解释。进而提出噪声增强混合Bradley-Terry（MBT）模型，利用重复成对比较数据推断多个潜在偏好成分（各自内部传递），并量化其混合比例。
AI.result: 跨7个模型、4个任务实验表明：混合排序模型显著优于单一效用模型，能更好地捕捉结构性不一致。聚合层面的偏好掩盖了底层偏好异质性。Moral Machine道德困境案例研究发现：在聚合排序上存在分歧的模型，仍可能共享相同的潜在偏好成分。
AI.conclusion: LLM的偏好具有多元性（plural preferences），而非单一函数。将LLM偏好视为单一效用函数的对齐与评估流程，有将不同用户可能分别认可的多个连贯排序‘平均化’的风险，需开发能识别并保留潜在偏好成分的新方法。

title: Do Language Models Know Their Own Constraints?
summary: We ask whether behavioral constraints acquired through post training remain explicitly reportable. Using constrained recipe generation as a testbed, five banned ingredients enforced via LoRA fine tuning of Llama 3.1 8B Instruct we compare supervised fine tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) against an untrained baseline on a four tier Constraint Awareness Benchmark. Averaged over three seeds, both methods raise behavioral compliance from 4% to about 90% while reducing explicit constraint reporting below the untrained model (0.48/5 to 0.16/5 for SFT, 0.07/5 for GRPO) and eroding retained third person knowledge (93% to 36% for SFT, 14% for GRPO; p less than 0.01 between methods). Contrary to our initial hypothesis, the reward based signal is the more destructive of the two: a reward that penalizes banned ingredient tokens regardless of framing learns a context independent suppression rather than a self directed constraint. A context conditioned reward designed to teach the self to other distinction fails, collapsing toward inclusion in both framings. Probing prompt time hidden states recovers per ingredient avoidance at 83.8% (layer 24 MLP), but only 6.4 points above a per ingredient base rate predictor (77.4%), and the model's own verbal self report is more accurate still (87.8%). A positive control adding explicit self description examples does not restore reporting. The failure is therefore specific to enumerating constraints on request, not a general loss of access to them.

AI.tldr: 本文研究后训练（微调）获得的行为约束是否仍可被模型显式报告。通过在食谱生成任务中强制禁止五种食材，对比SFT和GRPO两种微调方法，发现两者虽显著提升行为合规率（从4%至90%），但严重降低模型显式报告约束的能力（SFT从0.48/5降至0.16/5，GRPO降至0.07/5）及保留的第三人称知识（SFT从93%降至36%，GRPO降至14%）。GRPO基于奖励的信号破坏性更强，学到的是上下文无关的抑制而非自我导向的约束。探测隐藏状态可恢复部分成分避免信息，但模型自身口头自我报告更准确。显式添加自我描述示例无法恢复报告能力，说明失效特定于按需枚举约束，而非普遍丧失访问权。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型在后训练（如SFT、RLHF）中习得的行为约束，是否仍保持可被模型显式陈述（explicitly reportable）的能力。即：模型在遵守约束的同时，能否在被问及时准确列举这些约束？
AI.method: 以约束食谱生成为测试床，强制禁止五种食材。使用Llama 3.1 8B Instruct，分别进行监督微调（SFT）和组相对策略优化（GRPO）微调，并与未训练基线对比。构建四层级约束感知基准（Constraint Awareness Benchmark），测量行为合规率、显式约束报告能力、保留的第三人称知识。此外探测提示时隐藏状态（layer 24 MLP）以恢复成分避免信息，并设置添加显式自我描述示例的正向对照实验。
AI.result: 1. 行为合规率：SFT和GRPO均从4%提升至约90%。2. 显式约束报告：未训练模型0.48/5，SFT降至0.16/5，GRPO降至0.07/5。3. 第三人称知识保留：未训练93%，SFT降至36%，GRPO降至14%（p<0.01）。4. GRPO的奖励信号学到的是上下文无关的抑制，而非自我导向约束；设计教导自我-他者区分的上下文条件奖励失效，导致两种框架均倾向包含禁用成分。5. 隐藏状态探测恢复成分避免准确率83.8%（层24 MLP），仅比基线预测器（77.4%）高6.4点；模型自身口头自我报告更准（87.8%）。6. 正向对照（添加显式自我描述示例）未恢复报告能力。
AI.conclusion: 后训练获得的行为约束虽能高合规执行，但模型失去显式枚举这些约束的能力。基于奖励的GRPO比SFT破坏性更大，导致约束内化为无上下文敏感的抑制机制。模型内部表征仍保留约束信息（可通过探测部分恢复），且模型自身口头报告优于探测器，但显式添加自我描述示例无法修复按需报告失效。这表明失效特定于“按需枚举约束”这一元认知能力，而非普遍丧失对约束知识的访问。

title: From Research Frontier to Laboratory Bench: Design of a Four-Tier Experimental Teaching System for Multimodal Medical Image Intelligent Diagnosis
summary: Undergraduate programmes in intelligent medical engineering are expanding, yet laboratory curricula lag behind the multimodal, long-tailed, and distributionally shifting realities of clinical AI. This design paper presents an advanced experimental teaching system that translates an ongoing multimodal deep learning research project on endometrial carcinoma into a structured undergraduate lab sequence. We identify three educational gaps (modality, authenticity, and deployment) and derive four pedagogical principles from constructive alignment, experiential learning, the research teaching nexus, and the CDIO framework. The curriculum comprises four progressive tiers plus an engineering layer, with 32 laboratory units over 64 contact hours, delivered via a custom virtual clinical workstation using de-identified multi-institutional data. Each tier maps to a specific technical bottleneck, prerequisite coursework, and criterion-referenced deliverables. Data governance, safety, and assessment protocols are specified. Learning outcome data will be collected across two implementation cycles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将子宫内膜癌多模态深度学习研究项目转化为本科生结构化实验教学体系的设计，旨在解决智能医学工程本科实验课程滞后于临床AI多模态、长尾分布和分布偏移现实的问题。
AI.motivation: 智能医学工程本科专业扩展迅速，但实验室课程滞后于临床AI的多模态、长尾分布和分布偏移特性，存在模态、真实性和部署三大教育鸿沟，亟需基于建设性对齐、体验式学习、教研融合及CDIO框架的教学改革。
AI.method: 基于建设性对齐、体验式学习、教研融合和CDIO框架衍生出四大教学原则，设计包含四个递进层级及工程层的课程体系，共32个实验单元、64学时，采用定制虚拟临床工作站及去标识化多机构数据，每层级对应特定技术瓶颈、先修课程和标准参照交付物，并制定数据治理、安全及评估协议。
AI.result: 构建了完整的多模态深度学习实验教学体系，涵盖数据治理、模型训练、部署验证全流程，计划通过两个实施周期收集学习成效数据以验证教学有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该教学体系有效弥合了本科实验教学与临床AI前沿研究的差距，为智能医学工程专业提供了可复制的教学改革范式，后续将通过实证数据进一步验证教学成果。

title: Explainable Recommendations at Scale: LLM Rationales for YouTube Music Artist Discovery
summary: Modern music streaming platforms face a persistent tradeoff: exploiting familiar content versus driving the exploration of novel items. While users frequently desire discovery, they hesitate to select unknown artists over proven favorites. Providing transparent, natural language rationales that explain why an unexplored item is recommended lowers this barrier. However, while Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at this nuanced explainability, their real-time deployment is severely bottlenecked by prohibitive inference costs and computational overhead. In this paper, we present an industry case study of a decoupled recommendation architecture that successfully scales exploration without compromising latency. Our system isolates LLM inference asynchronously offline, pre-computing personalized candidate pools of undiscovered artists alongside tailored rationales. Large-scale online A/B experiments validate our design. We demonstrate that combining LLM-backed recommendations with these explanatory rationales significantly reduces the trust barrier for new content, yielding statistically significant improvements in both user exploration and overall engagement on the discovery surfaces.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种解耦推荐架构，通过离线异步预计算LLM生成的个性化未探索艺术家候选池及解释理由，解决了实时部署LLM的高推理成本问题，在线A/B实验显著提升了用户探索和整体参与度。
AI.motivation: 音乐流媒体平台面临熟悉内容利用与新颖内容探索的权衡，用户虽渴望发现但因信任障碍犹豫选择未知艺术家；LLM虽擅长生成自然语言解释，但实时推理成本高、延迟大，难以直接部署。
AI.method: 采用解耦推荐架构，将LLM推理离线异步化，预计算个性化的未发现艺术家候选池及定制化解释理由，在线阶段仅需快速检索和展示，避免实时推理开销。
AI.result: 大规模在线A/B实验验证，结合LLM推荐与解释理由显著降低新内容信任障碍，在发现界面上用户探索行为和整体参与度均获统计学显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 离线预计算LLM生成的解释性推荐可有效规模化探索，同时保持低延迟，为工业界大规模推荐系统提供可行的探索-利用平衡方案。

title: Industrial Kinematic Trajectory Model (IKTM): Coordinate-Free Autoregressive Generator
summary: Mobility simulation supports logistics, safety, and communications planning in industrial environments such as ports, mines, and airports. Existing trajectory models, however, rely on absolute coordinates, road-network tokens, or semantic zones: representations that are site-specific and not well suited to unstructured industrial terrain. We introduce the Industrial Kinematic Trajectory Model (IKTM), a coordinate-free trajectory generator that represents industrial vehicle motion through kinematic sequences (speed and heading change) with no absolute spatial reference. IKTM uses an autoregressive causal transformer with probabilistic mixture heads and extends our prior coordinate-free Markovian model with deep sequence modelling and an explicit duration-conditioning signal. Trained on one site and evaluated zero-shot on three unseen sites, it matches the small-turn shape of the empirical turn-rate distributions of held-out telematics; across all four sites, the per-site mean Jensen-Shannon divergence over 100 sampling seeds spans approximately 0.035-0.050 bits under an oracle-length duration-target protocol and approximately 0.032-0.042 bits under a fully zero-shot prior-length protocol, with similar ranges whether out-of-distribution (OOD) duration targets are drawn from each held-out site's empirical length distribution or from the Site A prior. Both protocols stay above the metric's sampling-noise floor (<=0.0049 bits). Paired by site, the oracle-length values are 5.3-6.0x lower than those of a re-implementation of our prior Markovian model under the same 1 Hz protocol. Termination is duration-conditioned rather than spatial: rollouts stop on 100% of trials with a length-tracking error of +0.0 +/- 0.0 s against the sampled target (100 of 100 exactly on target; N=100, T=0.2, untouched in-distribution test split).

AI.tldr: 本文提出工业运动学轨迹模型（IKTM），一种无坐标轨迹生成器，通过运动学序列（速度和航向变化）表示工业车辆运动，无需绝对空间参考。采用自回归因果Transformer配合概率混合头，扩展了先前的无坐标马尔可夫模型。在单一站点训练，在三个未见站点上零样本评估，能匹配经验转向率分布，Jensen-Shannon散度低，终止基于时长条件而非空间，精度高。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹模型依赖绝对坐标、路网令牌或语义区域，这些表示是特定站点的，不适合非结构化工业地形。需要一种无坐标、可泛化的工业车辆运动建模方法。
AI.method: 提出IKTM，使用自回归因果Transformer，带有概率混合头，显式条件化时长信号。表示为运动学序列（速度、航向变化），无绝对空间参考。扩展了先前的无坐标马尔可夫模型，引入深度序列建模。
AI.result: 在单站点训练，三个未见站点零样本评估下，每站点平均Jensen-Shannon散度约0.035-0.050比特（预言时长协议）和0.032-0.042比特（全零样本先验时长协议），均高于采样噪声底线（≤0.0049比特）。与先前马尔可夫模型相比，预言时长值降低5.3-6.0倍。终止基于时长条件，100%试验中长度跟踪误差为+0.0±0.0秒。
AI.conclusion: IKTM实现了无坐标、可泛化的工业车辆轨迹生成，能在未见工业场景中零样本迁移，准确捕捉运动学分布特征，终止控制精确，优于先前基于马尔可夫的方法。

title: Is Imagination Derived from Hallucination? A Cross-Taxonomy Evaluation of Imagination and Hallucination in Large Language Models
summary: Imagination performs as a high-level function of large language models (LLMs) which determines the potential of how an LLM creates unseen or creative content. While existing works have built a rich family of creativity benchmarks for this ability, they only measure how far an output departs from common answers and never check whether the departure is licensed by the prompt. Moreover, hallucination, the closest neighbor of imagination, is always measured in a separate pipeline on different generations, so the influential claim that imagination and hallucination stem from the same generative mechanism has never been directly testable. In this paper, we propose Whiteboard, the first LLM imagination evaluation benchmark. Its design follows the authoritative cognitive instruments developed to measure human imagination: seven mechanism-grounded imagination subtypes are adapted from classic paradigms, then crossed with ten support-boundary hallucination subtypes and scored jointly on the same generation. Different from previous creativity or hallucination benchmarks, Whiteboard gates every imagination score with an explicit support check and computes both axes deterministically through an auditable atom matrix, with no LLM judge on the primary path. The full Whiteboard item bank contains 1,660 prompts; on its shared 80-item anchor set, we evaluate 79 state-of-the-art LLMs and validate the instrument against 13,280 human judgments. Additionally, we further explore whether imagination derives from the same generative tendency as hallucination and what key factors shape it. Our analysis indicates a counterintuitive correlation between hallucination and imagination: Most of the subtype couplings are negative, every one of the anchor items reproduces the negative coupling on its own.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Whiteboard基准，首次联合评估大语言模型的想象力与幻觉，采用认知科学启发的七种想象子类型与十种幻觉子类型交叉设计，在同一生成上通过显式支持检查和可审计原子矩阵进行确定性评分，评估79个最先进模型并经13,280个人工判断验证。结果发现想象力与幻觉呈反直觉的负相关，多数子类型耦合为负，且每个锚点项目均复现负耦合。
AI.motivation: 现有创造力基准仅衡量输出偏离常见答案的程度，未检查偏离是否由提示授权；幻觉评估通常在独立流程中对不同生成进行，导致“想象力与幻觉源于同一生成机制”这一关键主张从未被直接检验。
AI.method: 设计Whiteboard基准：1) 从经典认知范式改编七种机制落地的想象子类型；2) 与十种支持边界幻觉子类型交叉；3) 在同一生成上联合评分，每个想象分数由显式支持检查把关；4) 通过可审计原子矩阵确定性计算两轴分数，主路径不使用LLM裁判。包含1,660个提示，共享80项锚点集评估79个SOTA模型，并对照13,280个人工判断验证工具效度。
AI.result: 在锚点集上，想象力与幻觉呈显著负相关：大多数子类型耦合为负，每个锚点项目单独考察均复现负耦合。这一反直觉结果挑战了两者源于同一生成倾向的假设。
AI.conclusion: 想象力与幻觉并非源于同一生成机制，而是呈现负向关系。Whiteboard提供了首个可审计、机制落地的联合评估框架，为理解LLM高层认知功能提供了新工具和实证证据。

title: ISA-Bench: A Benchmark for Computational Reasoning Across Instruction Set Architectures
summary: Large language model code generation benchmarks primarily evaluate well-resourced languages like Python and Java, where models benefit from abundant training data. They provide limited evidence about reasoning in unfamiliar computational models: deriving arithmetic from a single subtract instruction, coordinating parallel programs across communicating nodes, or wiring logic gates into circuits. We present ISA-Bench, a benchmark of programming games with constrained instruction sets. For each game we provide a full execution stack (parser, VM, and verifier), enabling automated evaluation with structured feedback for iterative refinement. Reasoning models achieve higher average solve rates than code-specialized and general-purpose models, but unfamiliar syntax remains a major source of failure. Models solve more tasks with iterative feedback, though the gains vary substantially across architectures. We introduce a reasoning--execution gap (REG) analysis that reveals a recurring disconnect between identifying a plausible computational strategy and expressing it as a correct program in the target ISA. Code is open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了ISA-Bench，一个针对受限指令集编程游戏的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在陌生计算模型中的推理能力，发现推理模型表现优于代码专用模型和通用模型，但语法不熟悉是主要失败原因，并引入了推理-执行差距(REG)分析揭示策略识别与正确程序表达之间的脱节。
AI.motivation: 现有的代码生成基准主要评估Python、Java等资源丰富的语言，模型受益于大量训练数据，缺乏对陌生计算模型（如单减法指令推导算术、跨通信节点协调并行程序、逻辑门组合电路）推理能力的评估。
AI.method: 构建ISA-Bench基准，包含多个受限指令集的编程游戏，为每个游戏提供完整的执行栈（解析器、虚拟机、验证器），支持自动化评估并提供结构化反馈以实现迭代优化。
AI.result: 推理模型平均解题率高于代码专用模型和通用模型，但陌生语法仍是主要失败来源；迭代反馈能提升解题数量，但不同架构提升幅度差异大；引入推理-执行差距(REG)分析，揭示了识别合理计算策略与在目标ISA中正确表达为程序之间的反复出现的脱节。
AI.conclusion: ISA-Bench为评估模型在受限指令集下的推理能力提供了新基准，强调了推理-执行差距的重要性，并展示了迭代反馈在缩小该差距中的作用，代码已开源。

title: Q-TIE: A Lightweight and Generalizable Re-ranking Framework for Temporal Information Retrieval
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code: https://github.com/ssoy0701/Q-TIE
summary: Temporal Information Retrieval (TIR) has been increasingly critical given the rise of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Since temporally mismatched evidence can be highly misleading, TIR aims to retrieve documents that are both semantically and temporally relevant to a query. Two TIR paradigms have emerged - temporal retrievers and temporal re-rankers - differing in how temporal relevance is modeled. While these paradigms provide complementary strengths, our analysis reveals that each alone falls short of robust TIR: temporal retrievers provide flexible query understanding via learned representations, but often fail to explicitly account for temporal constraints; temporal re-rankers can enforce such constraints more explicitly, but often rely on predefined re-ranking rules. To address this, we propose Q-TIE, a re-ranking framework based on learned Temporal Intent Extraction (TIE). By introducing a TIE model that maps each query's temporal constraint into a unified interval representation (i.e., $\langle t_{start}, t_{end} \rangle$), Q-TIE generalizes beyond predefined rules via model-based learning while explicitly modeling temporal constraints as a separate signal - jointly achieving what each paradigm typically trades off. Experiments demonstrate that Q-TIE consistently outperforms existing TIR methods with stronger generalizability across temporal query types, and provides a lightweight yet effective add-on for temporally-aware RAG pipelines. Code: https://github.com/ssoy0701/Q-TIE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Q-TIE框架，一种基于学习型时间意图抽取（TIE）的重排序方法，解决了时间信息检索（TIR）中时间检索器和时间重排序器各自权衡的问题：前者缺乏显式时间约束建模，后者依赖预定义规则。Q-TIE通过TIE模型将查询的时间约束映射为统一区间表示，实现了基于模型学习的显式时间约束建模。
AI.motivation: 随着检索增强生成（RAG）的兴起，时间信息检索（TIR）变得至关重要。时间错配的证据极具误导性，TIR旨在检索既语义又时间相关的文档。现有两大范式——时间检索器和时间重排序器——各有优劣：时间检索器通过学习表示提供灵活查询理解，但常无法显式处理时间约束；时间重排序器虽能显式强制约束，但常依赖预定义重排序规则，泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 提出Q-TIE重排序框架，核心是时间意图抽取（TIE）模型。TIE模型将每个查询的时间约束映射为统一区间表示 ⟨t_start, t_end⟩，以此替代预定义规则，实现基于模型学习的显式时间约束建模。该框架作为轻量级插件可集成到时间感知RAG管道中。
AI.result: 实验表明，Q-TIE在各类时间查询上持续超越现有TIR方法，展现出更强的泛化能力，且作为轻量级组件有效增强了时间感知RAG管道的性能。
AI.conclusion: Q-TIE通过学习型时间意图抽取，成功融合了时间检索器的灵活查询理解与时间重排序器的显式约束建模优势，克服了两者各自的局限性，为时间信息检索提供了更鲁棒、泛化性更强的解决方案。

title: Contrastive World Models
summary: World models trained via pixel reconstruction can struggle in visually complex environments, where irrelevant information dominates the objective and distract the model from information relevant to planning and control. We present Contrastive World Models, an approach for learning latent dynamics models without pixel reconstruction. Building on Dreamer, we replace observation reconstruction in the standard world model objective with a Deep InfoMax-like lower bound that maximizes the mutual information between state-action sequences and local patch features of future observations, encouraging state representations to retain information that is predictive of the future without requiring the model to reconstruct visually irrelevant details. We evaluate our approach in small-scale experiments across three settings of increasing visual complexity. Our method matches Dreamer and a momentum prediction baseline in the default setting, and substantially outperforms both once distractors or natural video backgrounds are introduced, while also training more efficiently by removing the pixel decoder entirely. Our approach is general and makes minimal assumptions beyond access to state-action sequences and future observations. These results suggest that contrastive, infomax-based objectives are a principled and promising direction for building world models that are robust to visual nuisance factors, a property particularly relevant for transferring model-based RL agents to the real world.

AI.tldr: 提出对比世界模型，用互信息最大化替代像素重建，在视觉复杂环境中表现优于Dreamer且训练更高效。
AI.motivation: 像素重建目标在视觉复杂环境中会被无关信息主导，分散模型对规划和控制相关信息的关注，需要一种不依赖像素重建的世界模型学习方法。
AI.method: 基于Dreamer框架，将观测重建目标替换为Deep InfoMax风格的下界，最大化状态-动作序列与未来观测局部patch特征之间的互信息，使状态表示保留预测未来的信息而无需重建视觉无关细节。
AI.result: 在三个视觉复杂度递增的设置中实验：默认设置下与Dreamer和动量预测基线持平；引入干扰因子或自然视频背景时显著优于两者；移除像素解码器后训练效率更高。
AI.conclusion: 对比式、基于InfoMax的目标是构建对视觉干扰因素鲁棒的世界模型的 principled 且有前景的方向，这对将基于模型的RL智能体迁移到真实世界尤为重要。

title: Beyond Raw Context Transfer: Representation-based Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) by grounding generation in external knowledge. However, most existing RAG frameworks assume a centralized retrieval corpus, which is often impractical in sensitive domains such as healthcare, where data are inherently distributed and raw content cannot be directly shared across institutions. Recent efforts on decentralized RAG primarily follow prompt-based paradigms that exchange raw, human-readable retrieved content, leading to substantial inference-time computational overhead and direct exposure of retrieved information. To address these limitations, we propose Representation-based Federated RAG (FedRepRAG), a decentralized RAG framework that keeps raw documents at their owning clients and exchanges only compact latent representations during cross-client retrieval. To integrate retrieved knowledge, we introduce a collaboratively trained projector that converts retrieval embeddings into generator-compatible representation tokens for a frozen LLM/VLM backbone. Experiments across decentralized visual question answering (VQA) and question answering (QA) benchmarks show that FedRepRAG consistently outperforms direct inference and local retrieval baselines while substantially reducing retrieval-context length and inference-time computational overhead compared with raw-context transfer. Further analyses confirm the importance of query-relevant retrieved representations and characterize the residual representation-level leakage associated with representation exchange. Overall, FedRepRAG provides an effective and efficient framework for federated RAG without transferring raw retrieved content.

AI.tldr: FedRepRAG 是一种联邦检索增强生成框架，通过交换紧凑的潜在表示而非原始文档，解决了分散式敏感领域（如医疗）中数据隐私与计算开销的矛盾，在冻结的 LLM/VLM 主干上通过协作训练的投影器整合检索知识，实现了更优的效果与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 框架假设中心化检索语料库，不适用于医疗等敏感领域，因为数据天然分布式且原始内容不可跨机构共享。现有去中心化 RAG 多采用基于提示的范式交换原始人类可读内容，导致推理时计算开销大且直接暴露检索信息。
AI.method: 提出 Representation-based Federated RAG (FedRepRAG)：原始文档保留在拥有它们的客户端，跨客户端检索时仅交换紧凑的潜在表示。引入协作训练的投影器，将检索嵌入转换为生成器兼容的表示令牌，输入冻结的 LLM/VLM 主干进行生成。
AI.result: 在去中心化视觉问答 (VQA) 和问答 (QA) 基准上，FedRepRAG 持续优于直接推理和本地检索基线，同时相比原始上下文传输大幅减少检索上下文长度和推理时计算开销。进一步分析确认了查询相关检索表示的重要性，并表征了表示交换带来的残余表示级泄露。
AI.conclusion: FedRepRAG 为联邦 RAG 提供了一个有效且高效的框架，无需传输原始检索内容即可实现跨机构知识整合，兼顾隐私保护、计算效率与生成质量。

title: When Should a VLM Look? Paying Only for Visual Calls That Were Needed and Used
comment: 30 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Preprint under review
summary: Vision-language agents that crop and zoom are trained with rewards that credit a successful tool call, yet a successful call does not show that the model needed to look or used the pixels it received. On our cold-start checkpoint only 10% to 12% of visual calls were both needed and used, and released agents make spurious calls 36% to 87% of the time on individual benchmarks. Outcome rewards, judge rewards, and branch probes each observe one side of this failure, and about two thirds of what an outcome reward pays goes to calls that were neither needed nor used. CounterCredit asks both questions of every image-returning call at its realized pre-call state, using the policy's own gold-answer score. A decision value compares the realized visual branch with answering immediately; an evidence value compares the returned crop with random same-size patches substituted into the same call. A call verified on both earns cashback and every other executed call pays rent; the price is bounded so that every correct trajectory outranks every wrong one, and a dual-channel GRPO advantage keeps the price in its own units. From the same cold start, prompt pool, and budget, CounterCredit reaches 89.5% on V*, 80.2% on HR-Bench-4K, and 76.4% on HR-Bench-8K, 6.3 to 9.4 points above outcome-only GRPO at 1.78 against 1.84 calls per question, and lowers the spurious-call rate to 31% to 36%, the lowest among the agents evaluated. The same recipe lifts a Qwen3-VL-8B base from 75.4 to 80.8 on average.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CounterCredit方法，解决视觉语言代理中工具调用（裁剪/缩放）的虚假调用问题。通过决策价值和证据价值双重验证每个视觉调用，仅在调用既必要又有效时给予奖励，否则惩罚。实验显示在多个基准上显著提升性能并降低虚假调用率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言代理使用结果奖励训练工具调用，但成功调用不代表模型真正需要观察或使用了接收的像素。冷启动检查点仅10%-12%的视觉调用既必要又被使用，发布的代理在基准上虚假调用率高达36%-87%。结果奖励、裁判奖励和分支探针各自只观察失败的一面，约三分之二的结果奖励支付给了既不必要也未被使用的调用。
AI.method: CounterCredit在每个返回图像的调用的实际预调用状态下提出两个问题，使用策略自身的金标答案分数：1) 决策价值：比较实际视觉分支与立即回答；2) 证据价值：比较返回的裁剪与随机同尺寸补丁替换后的同一调用。同时通过双重验证的调用获得现金返还，其他执行调用支付租金；价格有界确保每条正确轨迹排名高于错误轨迹，双通道GRPO优势保持价格在自身单位内。
AI.result: 相同冷启动、提示池和预算下，CounterCredit在V*上达89.5%，HR-Bench-4K上80.2%，HR-Bench-8K上76.4%，比仅结果GRPO高6.3-9.4分，平均每问题调用数1.78对1.84。虚假调用率降至31%-36%，为评估代理中最低。同方法将Qwen3-VL-8B基座平均分从75.4提升至80.8。
AI.conclusion: CounterCredit通过双重价值验证机制有效解决了视觉工具调用中的虚假调用问题，显著提高了视觉语言代理的性能和调用效率，为基于工具的视觉推理提供了更可靠的奖励信号设计。

title: UniK: Universal Knowledge Perception for Digital and Physical AI
summary: Two transformative classes of AI systems are reshaping how organizations operate: \textit{digital AI}, which reasons over enterprise knowledge to power chatbots and agent workflows; and \textit{physical AI}, which learns to control robots and autonomous systems from video, gameplay, and sensor telemetry. Both face the same foundational bottleneck: raw knowledge at scale, spanning heterogeneous modalities, locked in private corpora that existing AI infrastructure cannot access reliably or efficiently. We propose \textit{Universal Knowledge Perception (UniK)} as a common platform for both classes, covering the full knowledge lifecycle (ingestion, enrichment, indexing, retrieval, and continuous evaluation) across modalities from rich text and video to molecular data and sensor telemetry. We present UniK, built on Polymath Retrieval (multi-index fusion over automatically enriched indices) with no task-specific fine-tuning. Across five digital AI domains (medical literature, open-domain QA, chemistry, legal video proceedings, and government open data) UniK combined with an open-source 70-billion-parameter model consistently matches or outperforms frontier proprietary LLMs that are orders of magnitude larger: 76\% RAG accuracy on government data versus 47\% for GPT-5; 77.9\% on medical QA without fine-tuning; topping all open-source chemistry pipelines. We show that the same infrastructure directly addresses the data curation, indexing, and retrieval challenges facing physical AI world model training, where the knowledge problem is harder but structurally identical.

AI.tldr: 论文提出通用知识感知(UniK)平台，解决数字AI和物理AI面临的共同瓶颈：大规模异构模态知识被锁定在私有语料库中，现有基础设施无法可靠高效访问。UniK基于Polymath检索（多索引融合+自动丰富索引），覆盖知识全生命周期，无需任务特定微调，在五个数字AI领域用开源70B模型匹敌或超越专有大模型，同时直接适用于物理AI世界模型训练的数据挑战。
AI.motivation: 数字AI（推理企业知识驱动聊天机器人和智能体工作流）和物理AI（从视频、游戏、传感器遥测学习控制机器人和自主系统）两大变革性AI系统面临相同基础瓶颈：跨异构模态的大规模原始知识被锁定在私有语料库中，现有AI基础设施无法可靠高效地访问这些知识。
AI.method: 提出通用知识感知(UniK)平台，基于Polymath检索技术——多索引融合结合自动丰富索引，覆盖知识全生命周期（摄入、丰富、索引、检索、持续评估），支持从富文本、视频到分子数据和传感器遥测的多模态数据，且无需任务特定微调。
AI.result: 在五个数字AI领域（医学文献、开放域问答、化学、法律视频程序、政府开放数据），UniK结合开源70B参数模型持续匹敌或超越量级更大的专有前沿LLM：政府数据RAG准确率76%对比GPT-5的47%；医学问答无微调达77.9%；在所有开源化学流程中排名第一。同一基础设施也直接解决物理AI世界模型训练面临的数据策划、索引和检索挑战。
AI.conclusion: UniK作为统一平台同时服务于数字AI和物理AI，通过Polymath检索实现跨模态知识的高效获取和利用，证明了结构相同的知识问题可用通用基础设施解决，为两大类AI系统的规模化部署提供了关键基础设施支撑。

title: OpenBlock: Constructive and Verified Content Generation for Adaptive Tile-Matching Games
summary: Tile-matching puzzle games serve hundreds of millions of players, yet the content-generation algorithms that decide which pieces to present at each turn remain proprietary, and no open platform exists for studying adaptive difficulty in this genre. We present an adaptive tile-matching platform whose central algorithmic contribution is a dual-track content-generation architecture: a deterministic rule-based generator that is always available, and an optional learned generator, both subject to a common verification gate that establishes, by exhaustive sequential-placement search, that every delivered piece set is fully placeable so the learned track can never degrade the constructive-feasibility guarantee of the rule track. A self-play reinforcement-learning placement agent, supervised by auxiliary tasks that expose per-shape placeability to shared representations, is used to diagnose the game's dominant failure mode: at high board fill, long-bar pieces lose the majority of their legal placements. Across 234,000+ self-play episodes the agent reaches a 35.6\% win rate (median score 4,200), and controlled simulation shows that at board fill rates of 70--75\%, 33--56\% of long-bar pieces have no legal placement, while spawn difficulty distributions are statistically indistinguishable between won and lost games---evidence that board-state degeneration, not content difficulty, drives late-game failure. Head-to-head ablations show that per-shape placeability supervision---not aggregate difficulty features---drives the representation gain, and a 14-day online gray rollout (48,000 players; sample-ratio verified, CUPED-adjusted) lifts day-1 retention by 1.8 percentage points and session duration by 7\% over the rule track alone, quantifying the neural track's asymmetric upside in live play.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种自适应贴纸匹配游戏平台，核心是双轨内容生成架构：确定性规则生成器与可选学习生成器，配合共享验证门（穷举序列放置搜索）保证所有生成拼块完全可放置。通过自博弈强化学习智能体（辅以逐形状可放置性监督）诊断失效模式，发现高棋盘填充率下长条拼块合法位置锐减是主要失败原因。实验表明：自博弈234k+回合达35.6%胜率；70-75%填充率时33-56%长条拼块无合法位置；生成难度分布在胜负局间无显著差异，证实棋盘状态退化而非内容难度驱动后期失败。消融实验确认逐形状可放置性监督而非聚合难度特征驱动表征增益。14天在线灰度实验（48k玩家）显示日留存提升1.8个百分点、会话时长提升7%，量化了神经轨道的非对称收益。
AI.motivation: 解决贴纸匹配游戏内容生成算法长期闭源、缺乏开放平台研究自适应难度的问题。旨在构建可验证的自适应难度平台，同时保证生成拼块的构造可行性（即每个拼块组合必有合法放置序列），为后续难度自适应与玩家体验优化提供可控基础设施。
AI.method: 1. 双轨内容生成架构：确定性规则生成器（始终可用）+ 可选学习生成器，二者输出均经统一验证门——穷举序列放置搜索——确保完全可放置，学习轨道永不降级规则轨道的可行性保证。2. 自博弈强化学习放置智能体：引入辅助任务，将逐形状可放置性信号注入共享表征，用于诊断游戏主导失效模式。3. 受控仿真与消融实验：对比逐形状可放置性监督与聚合难度特征的表征增益。4. 在线灰度实验：样本比例验证、CUPED调整，评估神经轨道对日留存与会话时长的因果提升。
AI.result: 自博弈234,000+回合中智能体胜率35.6%（中位数分数4,200）。棋盘填充率70-75%时，33-56%的长条拼块无合法放置位置。生成难度分布在胜负局间统计不可区分，证据指向棋盘状态退化而非内容难度导致后期失败。消融实验显示逐形状可放置性监督（而非聚合难度特征）驱动表征增益。14天灰度实验（48,000玩家）使日留存提升1.8个百分点、会话时长提升7%，量化了学习轨道在实战中的非对称正向收益。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了首个可验证、可自适应的贴纸匹配内容生成平台，双轨架构在保证构造可行性前提下引入学习生成器，实测显著提升核心运营指标。研究揭示后期失败根因在于棋盘状态退化导致特定形状（长条）可放置性崩塌，而非生成难度分布偏移；逐形状可放置性监督是表征学习的关键。这为该品类游戏的难度自适应、内容生成透明化及玩家体验优化提供了算法与实证基础。

title: MechaTerp-TRACE: A Novel Approach for Component Ablation Analysis in Language Models
summary: Interpretability research on large language models has produced accounts of factual recall in feed-forward layers and of token relationships in self-attention, but little work offers a unified way to compare the causal contribution of different architecture components to a model's output. We introduce MechaTerp (the Mechanistic Interpretability suite) -TRACE (subset for Teacher-forced Registry of Ablated Component Effects), an architecture and study that measures how much each registered component of a language model supports the production of a named entity. TRACE ablates one component at a time and measures the resulting change in the output distribution at a fixed answer token, so component types from whole transformer blocks down to individual neurons and output logits can be compared on a common scale. We apply it to thirteen instruction-tuned dense decoder models spanning five families and one to thirty billion parameters, ablating 49,656 components across 48 medical and 42 general-knowledge prompts. We find that the components carrying the most effect are the same few, positionally fixed components in every model, regardless of which entity a prompt asks about, and that once these are removed, the remaining support is close to evenly spread in eleven of the thirteen models. Apparent localisation of entity knowledge is therefore largely attributable to generic generation machinery, which has direct consequences for methods that assume entity knowledge sits in a findable place, including targeted knowledge editing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MechaTerp-TRACE框架，通过消融实验统一量化不同架构组件对实体生成的因果贡献，发现实体知识表面定位主要源于通用生成机制而非特定知识存储。
AI.motivation: 现有研究分别解释了前馈层中的事实回忆和自注意力中的标记关系，但缺乏统一方法比较不同架构组件对模型输出的因果贡献。
AI.method: 提出TRACE方法，逐个消融注册组件（从整个Transformer块到单个神经元和输出logits），测量固定答案标记处输出分布的变化，在13个指令微调模型上消融49,656个组件，跨越48个医学和42个通用知识提示。
AI.result: 发现承载最大效应的组件是每个模型中相同的少数位置固定组件，与查询实体无关；移除这些组件后，剩余支持在11/13模型中近乎均匀分布。
AI.conclusion: 实体知识的表面定位主要归因于通用生成机制，这对假设实体知识位于可定位位置的方法（如针对性知识编辑）有直接影响。

title: Beyond Linear Context: Graph-Guided Evidence Navigation for Long-Novel Reasoning with a Local 9B Language Model
comment: 10 pages, 11 figures, 2 tables. Code, graph data and an interactive demo: https://github.com/fuxiaoji/novel-graph-lab
summary: Long-context models read a novel the way a person reads a printout: one token after another, in narrative order, with the whole history competing for a fixed budget of attention. A detective does not work that way. They sort what happened when, and they keep a map of who relates to whom, so a clue from chapter one can meet a question asked at the end of the book. We test whether a frozen knowledge graph can give a small local model that same freedom. Thirty detective novels and 234 multiple-choice questions are answered by one fixed qwen3.5:9b reader under nine conditions: five graph routes, a recent-window baseline, whole-book compression, ordinary vector retrieval, and a question-only control. The strongest graph route reaches 53.85% (126/234) against 46.15% for the recent window, 51.28% for compression, 51.71% for vector retrieval and 40.17% for question-only. On the subset that no model can answer without the book, the graph route reaches 42.86%. None of the fifteen graph-baseline contrasts survives Holm correction, so we present the result as exploratory evidence about a design. Two structural findings survive scrutiny better than the headline number: annotated evidence concentrates in the topological core of these graphs (2.35x enrichment, pooled), and the two graph-building pipelines differ so much in annotation coverage (16% versus 73% of clue paragraphs) that pooled accuracy alone would hide which bottleneck is being measured.

AI.tldr: 本文探索冻结知识图谱是否能赋予小型语言模型类似侦探的长程推理能力，在侦探小说多项选择任务中，最佳图谱路由准确率53.85%，虽优于基线但未通过Holm校正；两项结构性发现更稳健：证据集中于图谱拓扑核心（富集2.35倍），且两种图谱构建流水线的标注覆盖率差异巨大（16% vs 73%），提示汇总准确率会掩盖真实瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 长上下文模型按叙事顺序线性阅读，注意力预算固定，难以像侦探那样跨章节关联线索；作者希望测试冻结知识图谱是否能为小模型提供相同的自由度，实现跨文档的结构化推理。
AI.method: 使用30部侦探小说和234道多项选择题，固定读取模型为qwen3.5:9b，对比九种条件：五种图谱路由、近期窗口基线、全书压缩、普通向量检索、仅问题控制组；评估准确率并进行Holm校正，分析证据在图谱中的拓扑分布及两种图谱构建流水线的标注覆盖率差异。
AI.result: 最佳图谱路由达53.85%（126/234），优于近期窗口46.15%、压缩51.28%、向量检索51.71%、仅问题40.17%；在必须依赖原书的子集上图谱路由达42.86%。十五次图谱-基线对比均未通过Holm校正，结果为探索性证据。两项结构性发现：证据在图谱拓扑核心富集2.35倍（合并统计）；两种图谱构建流水线的线索段落标注覆盖率分别为16%和73%，汇总准确率会掩盖瓶颈所在。
AI.conclusion: 冻结知识图谱为小模型提供长程推理的探索性证据，但统计显著性不足。更有价值的是发现证据集中于图谱核心，且图谱构建流水线的覆盖率差异巨大，提示未来工作应关注图谱构建质量而非仅追求汇总准确率。

title: When More Evidence Hurts: Publication-Bias Drift and Principled Stopping for Biomedical Causal Search
summary: Automated biomedical evidence synthesis depends on retrieving published studies, but the biomedical literature is systematically skewed toward positive findings. Deeper retrieval can therefore make a system \emph{more} likely to falsely infer benefit when the true effect is null. We formalise this phenomenon as \emph{evidence drift} and prove that, under a standard publication-bias model, the false-positive probability on null-effect queries follows a strictly increasing large-sample envelope in retrieval depth, approaching one. Empirically, on a held-out test set of 140 Cochrane-derived queries, drift rises monotonically from 7.9\% to 15.7\% as the retrieval budget grows from 3 to 20 steps, and concentrates in the null-effect class. We present DACG-agent, a drift-aware causal-graph agent that incrementally builds a causal knowledge graph from PubMed abstracts and applies a two-layer stopping policy with complementary roles: a KL-divergence monitor that detects posterior convergence (the accuracy layer), and a Bradley--Terry process reward model (PRM) whose online decline detection halts retrieval once evidence quality peaks (the efficiency layer). Against full-budget retrieval, DACG-agent reduces evidence drift from 15.7\% to 6.4\% and improves null-effect accuracy by 21 percentage points (40.0\%$\to$61.4\%) while using 67\% fewer retrieval steps; overall accuracy rises from 61.4\% to 69.3\% (95\% CI 61--77). A simulation confirms the drift result transfers from the analysed vote-counting aggregator to the deployed noisy-OR one.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了生物医学文献检索中的「证据漂移」现象：由于发表偏倚导致正面结果过度代表，增加检索深度反而会提高空效应查询的假阳性率。作者提出了 DACG-agent，一种具备因果知识图谱构建与双层停止策略的智能体，能在显著降低检索步数的同时，大幅抑制证据漂移并提升空效应查询的准确率。
AI.motivation: 自动化生物医学证据综合依赖文献检索，但生物医学文献系统性偏向正面发现（发表偏倚）。深度检索会放大这种偏倚，导致在真实效应为零的查询上错误推断获益的概率随检索深度单调上升，趋近于 1。这种现象被称为「证据漂移」，严重威胁证据综合的可靠性。
AI.method: 1. 形式化证明：在标准发表偏倚模型下，空效应查询的假阳性概率随检索深度严格单调增加。2. 实证验证：在 140 个 Cochrane 来源的查询上测量漂移随预算（3→20 步）从 7.9% 升至 15.7%。3. 提出 DACG-agent：增量构建因果知识图谱，采用双层停止策略——KL 散度监测后验收敛（准确度层）与 Bradley-Terry 过程奖励模型在线检测证据质量峰值（效率层）。
AI.result: DACG-agent 将证据漂移从 15.7% 降至 6.4%，空效应准确率提升 21 个百分点（40.0%→61.4%），检索步数减少 67%，整体准确率从 61.4% 提升至 69.3%（95% CI 61–77）。仿真实验确认漂移结论可从分析用的投票计数聚合器迁移至部署用的 noisy-OR 聚合器。
AI.conclusion: 证据漂移是发表偏倚在深度检索下的必然后果，单纯增加检索深度会损害证据综合质量。DACG-agent 通过因果图谱建模与双层自适应停止机制，在大幅提升效率的同时有效遏制漂移，为可靠的自动化生物医学证据综合提供了实用范式。

title: Beyond Task Completion: Training Capable and Safe Computer-Use Agents
comment: Corrected an author name typo in the metadata; manuscript unchanged
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have made rapid progress in completing complex tasks through graphical user interfaces, yet post-training centered on task success alone does not induce reliable safety behavior. A reliable CUA must condition its execution on risk: it should complete ordinary benign tasks, avoid environmental hazards and continue when a safe completion path remains, and refuse when the goal is harmful or no safe path exists. To learn this conditional policy, we develop Safety and Capability Optimization for Policy Execution (SCOPE), which jointly post-trains a CUA for task-execution capability and safety-aware decision making. To provide aligned training data for this joint objective, we further introduce SCOPE-Gen, an automated pipeline that synthesizes verifiable capability tasks and converts them into paired environment-risk variants while preserving their original goals. Using the resulting tasks, we construct SATraj-OS, a trajectory dataset comprising capability demonstrations, safe continuations, and explicit refusals. SCOPE first learns from all three trajectory types through supervised fine-tuning and then further improves task completion through online reinforcement learning. Starting from Qwen3.5-9B, SCOPE-RL achieves a 54.17% task success rate on OSWorld and a 64.30% attack-avoidance rate on OS-BLIND, yielding the best aggregate capability--safety score of 58.80% among the evaluated agents. Ablations reveal asymmetric but complementary roles for the two forms of safety supervision: refusal trajectories account for most of the attack-avoidance gain, whereas risk-handling trajectories preserve greater task utility at comparable attack-avoidance levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SCOPE 框架，通过联合后训练实现计算机使用智能体（CUA）的任务执行能力与安全感知决策的平衡。引入 SCOPE-Gen 自动化流水线生成成对的环境风险变体任务，构建 SATraj-OS 轨迹数据集（含能力演示、安全继续、显式拒绝），先用监督微调再用在线强化学习优化。在 Qwen3.5-9B 基座上，SCOPE-RL 在 OSWorld 达到 54.17% 任务成功率，在 OS-BLIND 达到 64.30% 攻击规避率，综合能力-安全得分 58.80% 居评测智能体之首。消融实验显示：拒绝轨迹贡献了大部分攻击规避增益，而风险处理轨迹在同等攻击规避水平下更好地保持了任务效用。
AI.motivation: 现有 CUA 后训练仅关注任务成功率，未能诱导可靠的安全行为。可靠的 CUA 需要根据风险条件化执行策略：完成普通良性任务、避开环境危险并在存在安全完成路径时继续、在目标有害或无安全路径时拒绝。因此需要一种联合优化任务能力与安全决策的后训练方法，并配套生成对齐的训练数据。
AI.method: 1. 提出 SCOPE（Safety and Capability Optimization for Policy Execution）联合后训练框架。2. 开发 SCOPE-Gen 自动化流水线：合成可验证的能力任务，并将其转换为保持原始目标的成对环境风险变体。3. 构建 SATraj-OS 轨迹数据集，包含三类轨迹：能力演示、安全继续、显式拒绝。4. 两阶段训练：先在三类轨迹上进行监督微调，再通过在线强化学习进一步提升任务完成能力。基座模型为 Qwen3.5-9B。
AI.result: SCOPE-RL 在 OSWorld 基准上达到 54.17% 任务成功率，在 OS-BLIND 基准上达到 64.30% 攻击规避率，综合能力-安全聚合得分 58.80%，为评测智能体中最高。消融实验揭示两类安全监督的非对称互补作用：拒绝轨迹贡献了大部分攻击规避增益；风险处理轨迹在可比的攻击规避水平下保留了更多任务效用。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE 通过联合后训练与自动化数据生成，成功实现了 CUA 在任务能力与安全感知决策上的双重优化。拒绝轨迹与风险处理轨迹分别在安全性与效用上发挥互补作用，为构建可靠、安全的计算机使用智能体提供了有效范式。

title: A Multi-Agent Pipeline for Source-Grounded Synthetic Note Generation from Longitudinal Structured EHR
comment: Accepted at the FMSD Workshop, ICML 2026
summary: Structured EHR is abundant but sparse, coded, and difficult to use directly for note-centric clinical modeling. We present MedNotes, a multi-agent synthetic data generation pipeline that converts longitudinal structured EHR into source-grounded clinical note representations under explicit quality control. MedNotes treats structured-data-to-text synthesis as a closed-loop agentic process: a generator proposes a note, evaluator agents diagnose factual, coverage, structural, and hallucination-related failures, and a router accepts, revises, or rejects the draft. On 1,485 EHRSHOT encounters, MedNotes achieves a 91.4% pass rate, with mean factual accuracy of 0.980, completeness of 99.1%, structural fidelity of 0.761, and 0.028 critical hallucinations per encounter. Iterative refinement improves acceptance from 69.4% to 91.4%. The resulting synthetic corpus improves downstream CPT prediction and paragraph-level section prediction when combined with limited real data.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MedNotes 多智能体合成数据生成管道，将纵向结构化 EHR 转换为源头可追溯的临床笔记表示，通过生成器-评估器-路由器闭环实现高质量合成，显著提升下游临床预测任务性能。
AI.motivation: 结构化 EHR 数据虽丰富但稀疏、编码化且难直接用于以笔记为中心的临床建模，需将其转换为高质量、可追溯的临床文本表示以支持下游任务。
AI.method: MedNotes 采用多智能体闭环流程：生成器基于结构化 EHR 提出临床笔记草稿；多个评估器智能体分别诊断事实性、覆盖度、结构保真度及幻觉等失败模式；路由器根据评估结果决定接受、修订或拒绝草稿，并迭代优化直到通过质量控制。
AI.result: 在 1,485 个 EHRSHOT 就诊记录上，MedNotes 达到 91.4% 通过率，平均事实准确率 0.980、完整性 99.1%、结构保真度 0.761、关键幻觉率 0.028 次/就诊；迭代优化使接受率从 69.4% 提升至 91.4%；合成语料结合有限真实数据显著改善下游 CPT 预测和段落级章节预测任务。
AI.conclusion: MedNotes 通过多智能体闭环质量控制，实现了从结构化 EHR 到高质量临床笔记的可靠转换，生成的合成数据能有效补充真实数据不足，提升临床预测建模性能，为 EHR 数据的文本化利用提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: AgentRouter: Heterogeneous Model Routing for Cost-Optimal Multi-Step Agentic Workflows
comment: Accepted at the AgenticUQ Workshop, ICML 2026. Camera-ready version
summary: Enterprise agentic systems that route every trajectory step to a frontier model waste 60-80% of their inference budget on subtasks that smaller models handle equally well. Existing routing solutions optimize single-turn query assignment but ignore a property unique to agentic workflows: subtask complexity varies widely within a single trajectory. A planning step may require frontier-class reasoning while a subsequent formatting step needs only a 7B model. We formalize step-level model routing as a sequential assignment problem over agent trajectories and propose AgentRouter, a lightweight classifier (12M parameters, <5ms overhead per step on an A100 GPU) that maps each trajectory step to one of four model tiers using five features extractable at routing time. Trained on 50,000 annotated agent trajectory steps spanning planning, coding, research, and data analysis tasks, AgentRouter achieves 72% cost reduction relative to frontier-only baselines, retaining 97.3% of frontier-only quality (less than 3% degradation in end-to-end task completion); per-step routing accuracy reaches 91% on minimal-complexity steps and 85% on efficient-tier steps, with 76-82% on the harder mid-range and frontier tiers. On the same benchmarks, RouteLLM and FrugalGPT (applied per-step) achieve only 31% and 44% cost reduction respectively, because their single-turn training signal misses trajectory-level quality dependencies.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了AgentRouter，一种轻量级分类器（12M参数，<5ms开销），用于企业级智能体系统中的步级模型路由，将每个轨迹步骤映射到四个模型层级之一，在保持97.3%前沿模型质量的同时实现72%成本降低，显著优于现有单轮路由方法。
AI.motivation: 现有企业级智能体系统将每个轨迹步骤都路由到前沿模型，浪费了60-80%的推理预算在小模型同样能处理的子任务上。现有路由方案仅优化单轮查询分配，忽视了智能体工作流特有的属性：单个轨迹内子任务复杂度差异巨大（规划步骤需要前沿级推理，后续格式化步骤仅需7B模型）。
AI.method: 将步级模型路由形式化为智能体轨迹上的序列分配问题。提出AgentRouter，一个12M参数的轻量级分类器（在A100 GPU上每步<5ms开销），利用路由时可提取的五个特征，将每个轨迹步骤映射到四个模型层级之一。在涵盖规划、编码、研究和数据分析任务的50,000个标注智能体轨迹步骤上训练。
AI.result: 相较于纯前沿模型基线，AgentRouter实现72%成本降低，保持97.3%质量（端到端任务完成率下降<3%）。各层级步级路由准确率：最低复杂度步骤91%，高效层级85%，中等和前沿层级76-82%。同基准下，RouteLLM和FrugalGPT（按步应用）仅分别达到31%和44%成本降低，因其单轮训练信号错失轨迹级质量依赖。
AI.conclusion: AgentRouter通过步级路由有效解决了智能体轨迹内子任务复杂度动态变化的独特挑战，在大幅降低推理成本的同时保持任务质量，超越了仅针对单轮优化的现有路由方法，为企业级智能体系统的成本效益部署提供了实用方案。

title: Ascent: An Agentic System over the Model Context Protocol for Real-World Clinical Data Analysis
summary: Answering epidemiological questions from real-world clinical data requires medical coding, schema-aware SQL, and validation of implicit choices about populations, denominators, and time. We present Ascent, an agentic system that exposes medical coding, question answering, and cohort analysis through a shared Model Context Protocol tool surface for standardized and native schemas. We introduce EpiTrap, a dataset testing whether systems avoid recognized pharmacoepidemiological errors, and compare a fixed pipeline with agents across models and orchestrators. With capable models, agents improve accuracy over the fixed pipeline by an average of 27 and 20 percentage points on native and standardized schemas, respectively. These gains require more tool calls and longer runtimes. Experience from real projects highlights the system's value for feasibility assessment, diagnostic iteration, and expert-guided analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ascent智能体系统，通过Model Context Protocol统一医疗编码、问答和队列分析功能，并引入EpiTrap数据集评估系统避免药物流行病学错误的能力。实验显示智能体在原生和标准化模式下分别比固定流程提升27和20个百分点准确率，但需要更多工具调用和更长运行时间。
AI.motivation: 解决从真实临床数据回答流行病学问题时面临的医疗编码、模式感知SQL编写、以及人口/分母/时间等隐性选择验证等挑战，需要一个标准化、可扩展的系统来支持专家分析。
AI.method: 开发Ascent智能体系统，暴露医疗编码、问答、队列分析工具；构建EpiTrap数据集测试药物流行病学错误规避能力；对比固定流程与智能体在不同模型和编排器下的表现。
AI.result: 在强模型下，智能体在原生模式和标准化模式下分别比固定流程平均提升27和20个百分点准确率；代价是工具调用次数增加和运行时间延长。实际项目经验验证了系统在可行性评估、诊断迭代和专家引导分析中的价值。
AI.conclusion: Ascent智能体系统通过统一工具接口和智能编排，显著提升了真实世界临床数据流行病学分析的准确性，尽管计算开销增加，但为专家提供了有价值的可行性评估、迭代诊断和指导分析能力。

title: Gaussian Process Decorrelation for Spatiotemporal Deep Learning-Based Snow Water Equivalent Prediction
summary:
In the Western United States, snowmelt is essential to the agricultural industry in addition to being a key source of municipal drinking water. Consequently, accurate snowpack forecasting is critical for water policy and management. Automated Snow Telemetry (SNOTEL) stations provide accurate daily measurements of snow water equivalent (SWE) that exhibit strong correlations in space and in time. We tackle the problem of predicting future SWE values across the SNOTEL network.
  Specifically, we use a Gaussian Process-based linear transformation to remove spatial correlations before training a long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network on the decorrelated SWE data. This approach allows the LSTM to learn a clean temporal signal at each station. We show that this separation of spatial and temporal components yields better predictive success than multiple baseline models.
  Furthermore, we incorporate conformal prediction to quantify uncertainty in the resulting SWE forecasts, providing a distribution-free approach to illustrate a potential framework for establishing predictive intervals for spatiotemporal data. Together, accurate point forecasts and distribution-free uncertainty quantification provide a framework for SWE accumulation forecasting on subseasonal scales or projecting SWE with future data while motivating and supporting future work in predicting a large-scale, spatiotemporally complete SWE map.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于高斯过程去相关的LSTM模型预测SNOTEL站点的积雪水当量(SWE)，并结合共形预测实现无分布假设的不确定性量化，优于基线模型，为次季节尺度SWE预测提供框架。
AI.motivation: 美国西部农业和市政用水高度依赖融雪，准确的积雪储量预测对水资源管理至关重要。SNOTEL站点提供的SWE数据具有强时空相关性，需同时建模空间和时间依赖以提升预测精度。
AI.method: 先用高斯过程线性变换消除SWE数据的空间相关性，再在去相关数据上训练LSTM神经网络学习各站点的纯时间信号；最后引入共形预测对预测结果进行无分布假设的不确定性量化，构建预测区间。
AI.result: 该时空分离建模方法在多个基线模型中取得最优预测性能；共形预测提供的预测区间具有分布自由的覆盖保证，验证了不确定性量化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 精准的点预测与分布自由的不确定性量化相结合，为次季节尺度SWE累积预测及未来数据条件下的SWE投影提供了实用框架，并为大尺度时空完整SWE图谱预测奠定基础。

title: Monocultural Biases: Correlated biases in large language models lead to unequal systemic exclusion rates in hiring
summary: Employers are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) to automate their hiring process. This paper investigates the risk of monocultural biases, in which the widespread deployment of large language models homogenizes biases across the labor market, leading to greater systemic exclusion for certain demographic groups. For ten LLMs, we measure hiring biases across their base and post-trained versions to identify which stage, pre-training or post-training, lead to monocultural biases. We find that, compared to their base models, post-trained models are 3.6% less likely to callback older applicants. This negative shift occurs in eight of the ten models that we evaluate. Post-trained models have much more correlated decisions than base models which is likely driven by human capital traits like skills or college major. However, greater consensus among models increases global systemic exclusion rates from 5.6% to 17.3% and exacerbates demographic inequalities, with intersectional systemic exclusion rates ranging from 12.2% to 21.7% for post-trained models. We find that this inequality is primarily driven by age-based discrimination that is exacerbated in post-training. These results indicate that while post-training techniques may improve models' abilities to select the best applicants, they may raise systemic inequality risks for those at the margin by uniformly introducing new biases.

AI.tldr: 论文研究大语言模型在招聘自动化中的单一文化偏见风险，发现后训练模型比基础模型更不倾向于回拨年长申请人，且模型间决策相关性更高，导致系统性排除率从5.6%上升至17.3%，交叉系统性排除率达12.2%-21.7%，主要由年龄歧视驱动。后训练虽可能提升选人能力，但会统一引入新偏见，加剧边缘群体的系统性不平等。
AI.motivation: 雇主越来越多地使用大语言模型自动化招聘流程，但广泛部署可能导致偏见在劳动力市场中同质化，形成单一文化偏见，使特定人口群体面临更大的系统性排除风险。本文旨在量化这种风险，并区分预训练与后训练阶段对单一文化偏见的贡献。
AI.method: 对十个大语言模型的基础版本和后训练版本进行招聘偏见测量，比较两者在回拨决策上的差异，分析模型间决策相关性，计算全局系统性排除率和交叉系统性排除率，并识别驱动不平等的主要人口学因素。
AI.result: 后训练模型比基础模型少3.6%回拨年长申请人，10个模型中有8个呈现负向偏移。后训练模型决策相关性显著更高，可能由人力资本特征（技能、专业）驱动。模型共识增加使全局系统性排除率从5.6%升至17.3%，交叉系统性排除率达12.2%-21.7%，不平等主要源于后训练中加剧的年龄歧视。
AI.conclusion: 后训练技术虽可能提升模型甄选最佳申请人的能力，但通过统一引入新偏见（尤其是年龄歧视），显著增加了边缘群体的系统性不平等风险，提示在招聘自动化中需审慎评估后训练模型的公平性影响。

title: A Compact Stance-Indexed Anterior-Posterior COP Representation for Parkinson's Disease Classification from Plantar VGRF
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures; supplementary material is included in the same PDF
summary: Parkinson's disease alters gait and bilateral coordination, but machine-learning performance also depends on how continuous gait signals are represented. This study investigates whether preserving anterior-posterior center-of-pressure (AP-COP) information at fixed locations across normalized stance provides a compact and informative representation of plantar-force gait signals. Bilateral vertical ground reaction force recordings from 165 participants in the Gait in Parkinson's Disease Database were evaluated using repeated fully nested participant-level cross-validation. We propose AP-COP10, comprising AP-COP position and bilateral asymmetry across five stance windows. AP-COP10 achieved an AUC of 0.894 and outperformed three harmonized literature-derived COP representations under the same evaluation pipeline. The complementary 25 non-AP-COP descriptors alone achieved an AUC of 0.856, while the complete 35-feature representation achieved 0.908. Removing AP-COP10 from the complete representation produced a statistically supported loss in discrimination, whereas adding the complementary descriptors to AP-COP10 yielded only a small, unsupported improvement. Feature competition indicated that the most informative stance-indexed descriptors were concentrated in early and early-mid stance, while source-study holdout and sensor-perturbation analyses supported the robustness of the representation. These findings indicate that stance-indexed AP-COP retains discriminative information that is not readily recovered by broader engineered gait descriptors, supporting compact and interpretable representations for machine-learning analysis of pathological gait.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出AP-COP10（跨五个站立相窗口的前后向足底压力中心位置及双侧不对称性）作为足底力步态信号的紧凑表示，在帕金森病步态分类中实现AUC 0.894，优于三种文献来源的COP表示。完整的35特征表示达到AUC 0.908，但移除AP-COP10会导致统计学显著的判别力下降，而添加互补描述符仅带来微小且不显著的改进。最具信息量的描述符集中在早期和早中期站立相，且该表示在跨研究保留和传感器扰动分析中表现出鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病改变步态和双侧协调性，但机器学习性能还取决于连续步态信号的表示方式。研究旨在探究在归一化站立相中固定位置保留前后向足底压力中心（AP-COP）信息，是否能提供足底力步态信号的紧凑且信息丰富的表示。
AI.method: 使用来自帕金森病步态数据库165名参与者的双侧垂直地面反作用力记录，采用重复的完全嵌套参与者级交叉验证进行评估。提出AP-COP10，包含五个站立相窗口内的AP-COP位置和双侧不对称性。在相同评估流水线下与三种协调的文献来源COP表示进行比较。同时测试了25个非AP-COP互补描述符、完整的35特征表示，并进行特征竞争分析、来源研究保留分析和传感器扰动分析。
AI.result: AP-COP10实现AUC 0.894，优于三种文献来源的COP表示。25个非AP-COP互补描述符单独达到AUC 0.856，完整35特征表示达到0.908。从完整表示移除AP-COP10导致统计学支持的判别力损失，而向AP-COP10添加互补描述符仅产生微小且无统计学支持的改进。特征竞争显示最具信息量的站立相索引描述符集中在早期和早中期站立相。来源研究保留和传感器扰动分析支持该表示的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 站立相索引的AP-COP保留了更广泛工程步态描述符难以恢复的判别信息，支持用于病理步态机器学习分析的紧凑且可解释的表示。

title: CleanScore: Black-Box Benchmark Audits with Negative Controls and Sensitivity Bounds
comment: 43 pages, 15 figures, 21 tables. Item bank, code and pre-registrations released
summary: Public benchmark scores may reflect skill, prior exposure to the questions, or both, and for most models the training data are unknown. We present CleanScore, a black-box audit using scored outputs only. Each benchmark question becomes a parent item with one public form and two independently written fresh forms preserving its numbers, facts and answer. The audit reports an interval for the public-form advantage rather than a verdict, and a private negative-control bank with an explicit transport radius separates exposure from ordinary form mismatch. A registered controlled-exposure experiment detects planted exposure and stays quiet under fresh-form exposure. A registered audit of five open models on 200 GSM8K and 200 ARC-Challenge items finds no exposure-consistent advantage, bounding surface-form inflation below five points. Registered positive controls then bound what such a null can mean. Leaking an item raises accuracy on paraphrases the model never saw almost as much as on the leaked wording, leaving 52% to 110% of the effect invisible to a paraphrase audit. On ARC a planted 49-point advantage shows an observable gap of -0.020, and about 20 points survive rewriting stem and options, across four training seeds. A surface-form null bounds far less than the phrase contamination audit implies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CleanScore，一种基于黑盒审计的方法，用于检测基准测试中的数据污染/暴露问题。通过构建包含公开形式和两个独立重写形式的父项目，并结合私有负控制银行和注册实验，该方法能量化公开形式优势区间而非二元判定。实验发现五个开源模型在GSM8K和ARC-Challenge上无暴露一致性优势，表面形式膨胀低于5分；但正向控制显示泄露项目对未见改写的影响几乎与泄露措辞相当，52%-110%的效应对改写审计不可见，表面形式零结果束缚力远弱于短语污染审计暗示。
AI.motivation: 公共基准分数可能反映模型技能、先前接触题目，或两者兼有，且多数模型训练数据未知。现有污染审计方法（如改写审计）存在盲区，无法可靠区分真实暴露与普通形式不匹配，且对泄露后泛化到改写形式的效应不敏感。需要一种能量化暴露优势区间、分离暴露与形式不匹配、并校准审计敏感度的黑盒方法。
AI.method: CleanScore黑盒审计框架：1) 每个基准问题构建为父项目，包含一个公开形式和两个独立重写的新鲜形式（保留数字、事实和答案）；2) 报告公开形式优势的置信区间而非二元裁决；3) 引入私有负控制银行及显式传输半径，分离暴露效应与普通形式不匹配；4) 注册受控暴露实验验证检测力：植入暴露可被检出，新鲜形式暴露保持静默；5) 对五个开源模型在200道GSM8K和200道ARC-Challenge题目上进行注册审计；6) 注册正向控制（植入泄露）校准零结果的含义。
AI.result: 1) 五模型审计未发现暴露一致性优势，表面形式膨胀被束缚在5分以内。2) 正向控制显示：泄露项目使模型在从未见过的改写上准确率提升，幅度几乎等同于泄露措辞本身，导致52%-110%的效应对改写审计不可见。3) ARC上植入49分优势仅显示-0.020可观测差距，重写题干和选项后仍有约20分效应存活（跨四个训练种子）。4) 表面形式零结果的束缚力远弱于短语污染审计所暗示。
AI.conclusion: CleanScore提供了一种严谨的黑盒审计范式，能量化而非二元判定暴露优势，并通过负/正向控制校准审计灵敏度。研究揭示了改写审计的根本局限：数据泄露产生的泛化效应使得大部分污染对改写形式不可见，表面形式清洗不足以保证基准完整性。这要求重新评估基准污染检测标准，并呼吁采用更稳健的审计方法论。

title: DPTM-DT: Dual-Pretrained Transformer Multitask Representation Learning for Drug-Target Prediction
summary: Drug-target relation prediction supports candidate screening, drug repositioning, and mechanism analysis. Existing models often use incomplete drug or protein representations, model cross-modal interactions shallowly, or train affinity regression and interaction classification separately, although these tasks describe closely related views of the same drug-target pair. This paper presents DPTM-DT, a dual-pretrained Transformer framework for multitask drug-target prediction. DPTM-DT combines GROVER molecular graph embeddings, ESM protein language-model embeddings, and CTD physicochemical descriptors, then exchanges drug-target information through bidirectional cross-modal attention. A shared pair representation is used for continuous affinity regression, high-affinity binary classification, and six-level affinity classification. Experiments on Davis and KIBA cover random 80/20 and DeepDTA-style standard splits. On the random 80/20 split, DPTM-DT achieves MSE/CI values of 0.193/0.917 on Davis and 0.120/0.918 on KIBA. It also reports binary AUPR/MCC values of 0.727/0.654 and 0.798/0.689, and six-class Macro-F1/Top-2 values of 0.800/0.932 and 0.815/0.962 on Davis and KIBA, respectively. Across the reported regression, binary classification, and multiclass classification settings, DPTM-DT achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods. Results under the standard split show the same relative trend. Ablations indicate that dual target representation, gated fusion, and cross-modal attention each contribute to the final performance. Code and supplementary materials are available at: anonymous.4open.science/r/DPCM-DT-74E0.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DPTM-DT，一种双预训练Transformer框架，用于多任务药物-靶点关系预测。融合GROVER分子图嵌入、ESM蛋白语言模型嵌入和CTD理化描述符，通过双向跨模态注意力交互药物-靶点信息，利用共享对表示同时进行亲和力回归、高亲和力二分类和六分类。在Davis和KIBA数据集上，该模型在回归、二分类和多分类任务上均取得最优整体性能，消融实验验证了双靶点表示、门控融合和跨模态注意力的贡献。
AI.motivation: 现有药物-靶点预测模型常存在药物/蛋白表示不完整、跨模态交互建模浅层、回归与分类任务分离训练等问题，而这些任务描述的是同一药物-靶点对的密切相关视角，亟需统一框架联合建模。
AI.method: DPTM-DT采用双预训练Transformer架构：药物侧使用GROVER分子图嵌入，蛋白侧使用ESM蛋白语言模型嵌入，辅以CTD理化描述符；通过双向跨模态注意力机制实现药物-靶点信息深度交互；引入门控融合模块整合多源表示；最终共享的药物-靶点对表示同时用于亲和力回归、高亲和力二分类和六级亲和力分类三个任务的多任务联合训练。
AI.result: 在随机80/20划分上，Davis数据集MSE/CI为0.193/0.917，KIBA为0.120/0.918；二分类AUPR/MCC分别为0.727/0.654和0.798/0.689；六分类Macro-F1/Top-2分别为0.800/0.932和0.815/0.962。在DeepDTA标准划分下呈现相同优势趋势。在回归、二分类、多分类所有设置中均超越对比方法。消融实验表明双靶点表示、门控融合、跨模态注意力均显著提升性能。
AI.conclusion: DPTM-DT通过整合预训练分子/蛋白表示、跨模态注意力交互及多任务联合学习，有效解决了现有模型表示不足、交互浅层、任务割裂的问题，在药物-靶点亲和力预测的回归与分类任务上均达到最优水平，为药物筛选、药物重定位及机制分析提供了更强有力的计算工具。

title: OptiSkill: A Hierarchical and Evolving SkillBank for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
summary: Automated operations research (OR) modeling requires LLMs to translate natural-language decision problems into correct mathematical programs. Existing methods can improve individual formulations, but they often solve problems in isolation, retaining little reusable experience and repeating similar formulation errors. Prior memory-based approaches store examples, thoughts, or insights as references, while OR modeling requires reusable formulation skills that transfer across problem narratives and guide concrete modeling decisions. We propose OptiSkill, a skill-augmented framework that builds a hierarchical and evolving SkillBank for LLM-based OR modeling. SkillBank stores solver-verified experience as reusable skills, with Global Strategies for problem-level formulation skeletons and Step Experiences for local error-prevention rules. It is further refined through stable batch-level test-time evolution, where candidate skills are incorporated only after validation. Experiments on eight OR modeling benchmarks show that OptiSkill improves formulation accuracy across LLM backbones, outperforms strong agentic baselines, and gains further by expanding SkillBank coverage and reliability. Code and data are available at https://github.com/rachhhhing/OptiSkill

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OptiSkill，一个基于技能的框架，用于提升 LLM 在运筹学建模任务中的表现。通过构建层次化、可进化的 SkillBank，存储求解器验证过的可复用技能（全局策略和步骤经验），并在测试时通过批量验证稳定地更新技能库，显著提升了建模准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多针对单个问题进行建模优化，缺乏跨问题的可复用经验积累，导致重复犯类似错误。虽然记忆增强方法存储示例或思考，但运筹建模需要可迁移的建模技能，能指导具体的建模决策。
AI.method: 提出 OptiSkill 框架，包含：1) SkillBank：层次化技能库，包含全局策略（问题级建模骨架）和步骤经验（局部防错规则）；2) 求解器验证机制：仅存储经求解器验证的正确经验；3) 批量级测试时进化：候选技能经验证后才纳入技能库，保证稳定性。
AI.result: 在八个运筹建模基准上实验表明，OptiSkill 能跨 LLM 主干模型提升建模准确率，超越强 Agent 基线，且随着 SkillBank 覆盖面和可靠性扩大，性能进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: OptiSkill 通过层次化、可验证、可进化的技能库机制，有效解决了 LLM 运筹建模中经验复用不足和错误重复的问题，为自动化建模提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Adaptive Physics-Informed Neural Networks for the Blasius Boundary-Layer Problem
summary:
Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a mesh-free approach
  for solving differential equations, but their performance can depend
  strongly on loss weighting, collocation placement, and optimization
  strategy. This study develops an adaptive PINN framework for the Blasius
  boundary-layer equation using gradient-norm-based adaptive loss
  weighting, nonuniform and residual-based collocation, and sequential
  Adam--L-BFGS optimization. In the representative run using the
  architecture $[1,100,100,1]$, the model predicts
  $f''(0)=0.3320762918$, compared with the high-accuracy benchmark
  $0.332057336215$, giving an absolute error of
  $1.896\times10^{-5}$. The final weighted loss is
  $6.789\times10^{-8}$, and the predicted stream-function, velocity, and
  shear profiles agree closely with an independent numerical
  boundary-value solution. A separate full-training architecture study
  shows that the two-hidden-layer model achieves the smallest wall-shear
  error among the four tested architectures, $1.629\times10^{-6}$,
  whereas the deepest network attains the smallest weighted objective
  but a substantially larger wall-shear error. Compared with the
  previously reported PINN value $f''(0)=0.33165$, the representative
  run reduces the wall-shear error by approximately a factor of $21.5$.
  The results show that the combined adaptive training framework can
  achieve high accuracy for the Blasius problem and that weighted loss
  alone is insufficient for identifying the most physically accurate
  PINN. Because the adaptive components are applied jointly, their
  individual contributions cannot be isolated from the present results
  and would require a controlled ablation study for separate assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应物理信息神经网络(PINN)框架求解Blasius边界层方程，结合基于梯度范数的自适应损失加权、非均匀与残差基配置点策略、以及顺序Adam-L-BFGS优化。在[1,100,100,1]架构下，壁面剪切应力预测值f''(0)绝对误差仅1.896e-5，较先前PINN结果降低约21.5倍。架构研究显示两隐藏层模型实现最小壁面剪切误差(1.629e-6)，而最深网络虽加权损失最小但壁面剪切误差显著更大，表明仅靠加权损失无法识别物理上最准确的PINN。
AI.motivation: PINNs虽提供无网格求解微分方程的方法，但其性能强烈依赖于损失加权、配置点放置和优化策略。针对Blasius边界层方程这一经典流体力学问题，现有PINN方法在壁面剪切应力预测精度上仍有提升空间，且缺乏系统的自适应训练框架来协同优化这些关键因素。
AI.method: 开发自适应PINN框架，包含三大核心组件：(1) 基于梯度范数的自适应损失加权，动态平衡各损失项贡献；(2) 非均匀与残差基配置点策略，在边界层区域加密采样并根据残差自适应调整；(3) 顺序Adam-L-BFGS优化，先用Adam全局搜索再用L-BFGS精细收敛。网络架构为[1,100,100,1]两隐藏层结构，并对比测试了四种不同深度架构。
AI.result: 代表性运行中，f''(0)预测值0.3320762918与基准值0.332057336215绝对误差1.896e-5，最终加权损失6.789e-8。流函数、速度和剪切应力剖面与独立数值边界值解高度吻合。架构消融显示两隐藏层模型壁面剪切误差最小(1.629e-6)，最深网络虽加权目标最小但壁面剪切误差显著更大。较先前PINN值0.33165，壁面剪切误差降低约21.5倍。加权损失单独不足以识别物理上最准确的PINN。
AI.conclusion: 组合自适应训练框架可为Blasius问题实现高精度求解，但加权损失 alone不足以作为物理准确性的唯一指标。由于自适应组件联合应用，其个体贡献无法从现有结果中分离，需通过受控消融研究进一步评估各组件独立效应。

title: Fairness Beyond Anonymization? Demographic Leakage in German LLM-Generated Resumes
comment: Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026 Workshop on Bias and Fairness in AI [BIAS 2026@ ECML/PKDD]
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into AI-assisted hiring pipelines, including automated resume generation and screening. Under the EU AI Act, the hiring domain is classified as high-risk, making fairness and transparency critical requirements. Existing work has primarily focused on explicit hiring decisions, while less attention has been paid to whether generated resumes themselves encode recoverable demographic information. In this work, we conduct a two-stage audit of demographic leakage in German-language LLM-generated resumes. First, we use ChatGPT (GPT-4o-mini), Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, and multiple scales of the open-weight Qwen 3 model family (4B, 8B, and 14B) to generate resumes from real anonymized job-matching profiles, systematically varying gender- and ethnicity-associated names while holding qualifications constant. Second, we simulate a downstream resume screening scenario, where the generated resumes are first anonymized and gender-neutralized, before demographic leakage classifiers are trained on the resulting texts. We find that, despite these interventions, classifiers reliably distinguish between resumes generated with male and female names. This leakage is not driven by overtly gendered wording, but by subtle differences in the usage of semantically equivalent, formally gender-neutral terms in German. In contrast, ethnicity-related leakage remains comparatively weak across models. Our findings demonstrate that apparently neutral resume generation can still preserve highly predictive demographic signals, raising concerns about anonymization-based fairness interventions in multilingual AI hiring pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了德语LLM生成简历中的人口统计学信息泄露，发现即使经过匿名化和性别中性化处理，分类器仍能通过细微的语言差异可靠区分男性/女性名字生成的简历，而种族相关泄露较弱。
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI法案将招聘领域列为高风险，公平性和透明度至关重要。现有研究主要关注显性招聘决策，较少关注生成的简历本身是否编码了可恢复的人口统计学信息。
AI.method: 两阶段审计：第一阶段，使用ChatGPT (GPT-4o-mini)、Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite及Qwen 3模型族(4B/8B/14B)基于真实匿名职位匹配档案生成简历，系统性变更性别/种族关联名字且保持资质不变。第二阶段，模拟下游筛选场景：先对生成的简历进行匿名化和性别中性化，再在处理后的文本上训练人口统计学泄露分类器。
AI.result: 尽管经过干预，分类器仍能可靠区分男性和女性名字生成的简历。泄露源于德语中语义等价、形式上性别中性词汇的使用差异，而非显性性别化措辞。种族相关泄露在各模型中均相对较弱。
AI.conclusion: 表面中性的简历生成仍可能保留高度预测性的人口统计学信号，引发对多语言AI招聘管道中基于匿名化的公平性干预措施的担忧。

title: PINNForge: Execution-Grounded Evolutionary Design of Physics-Informed Neural Networks for PDE Solving via Large Language Models
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) require coordinated choices over network representation, sampling, loss construction, and optimization, while effective configurations often vary substantially across partial differential equations (PDEs). Existing automated PINN design methods can search candidate configurations, but information revealed during actual training is still used mainly for evaluation rather than to improve subsequent design, leading to repeated trial-and-error and inefficient use of training budget. We propose PINNsForge, an LLM-driven evolutionary framework for execution-feedback-based automated PINN design. PINNsForge generates diverse candidate configurations from PDE-related prior knowledge, evaluates them through actual training, and feeds high-performing designs together with accumulated execution evidence back to the LLM. Guided by observed optimization behavior, the LLM then refines, recombines, and explores coupled PINN design components, forming a continual cycle of generation, execution, feedback, and evolution. Unlike one-shot search or evaluation-only feedback, PINNsForge progressively converts training experience into improved design decisions for the target PDE. Across 25 PDE benchmarks, PINNsForge achieves the lowest mean MSE on 24 tasks compared with RoPINN, PINNsFormer, and PINNsAgent. Ablation studies further confirm the importance of the PDE knowledge base, execution feedback, and evolutionary search: removing these components increases the mean MSE to 3.74$\times$, 12.10$\times$, and 10.10$\times$ that of the full PINNsForge, respectively.

AI.tldr: PINNsForge 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）驱动的进化框架，用于自动化物理信息神经网络（PINN）设计。它通过结合 PDE 先验知识、实际训练执行反馈和进化搜索，实现配置的持续生成、评估、反馈和进化，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 PINN 自动化设计方法主要将训练信息用于评估而非改进后续设计，导致重复试错和训练预算利用低效。PINN 配置需协调网络表示、采样、损失构造和优化，且最佳配置随 PDE 变化大，因此需要一种能将训练经验转化为改进设计决策的方法。
AI.method: PINNsForge 从 PDE 相关先验知识库生成多样化候选配置，通过实际训练评估，将高性能设计及累积执行证据反馈给 LLM。LLM 基于观测到的优化行为，对耦合的 PINN 设计组件进行细化、重组和探索，形成生成-执行-反馈-进化的持续循环。
AI.result: 在 25 个 PDE 基准任务中，PINNsForge 在 24 个任务上实现最低均方误差（MSE），优于 RoPINN、PINNsFormer 和 PINNsAgent。消融实验表明，移除 PDE 知识库、执行反馈和进化搜索会使平均 MSE 分别增加至完整 PINNsForge 的 3.74 倍、12.10 倍和 10.10 倍。
AI.conclusion: PINNsForge 通过 LLM 驱动的进化机制，有效利用执行反馈将训练经验转化为针对目标 PDE 的改进设计决策，克服了单次搜索和仅评估反馈的局限，实现了 PINN 自动化设计的显著性能提升。

title: Correlation-Guided Flow Matching with Annealed Masking for Spatial Transcriptomics Generation
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) provides spatially resolved gene expression profiling but remains expensive, motivating the prediction of ST from histology images. Generative models have emerged as a mainstream paradigm for ST prediction due to their ability to model the conditional distribution of gene expression and capture its inherent stochasticity. However, these methods typically treat genes as independent prediction targets and overlook the intrinsic gene-gene interactions in biological systems, which limits their ability to preserve biologically meaningful co-expression patterns. We argue that gene-gene interactions, which reflect shared pathways and regulatory mechanisms, are essential for generating numerically accurate and biologically coherent ST profiles. In this paper, we propose CorrFlow, a correlation-guided flow matching framework for histology-to-ST prediction that explicitly models gene-gene dependencies through two complementary mechanisms. First, we introduce an annealed masked flow matching strategy, where subsets of genes are progressively masked following a timestep-dependent annealing schedule, encouraging the model to infer masked genes conditioned on the remaining genes and promoting joint conditional modeling beyond per-gene marginal estimation. Second, we devise a gene graph-regularized optimization scheme that integrates prior knowledge from the STRING database and data-driven co-expression estimated by WGCNA to construct a gene affinity graph, which enforces both local consistency and global smoothness in the predicted expression. Extensive experiments across 12 datasets show that CorrFlow achieves the best average PCC and HPCC among evaluated methods, leading to more biologically coherent ST predictions.

AI.tldr: CorrFlow是一个基于相关性引导的流匹配框架，用于从组织学图像预测空间转录组学，通过退火掩码流匹配和基因图正则化显式建模基因-基因依赖，在12个数据集上取得最佳平均PCC和HPCC。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组学（ST）昂贵，激励从组织学图像预测ST。生成模型虽能建模条件分布捕捉随机性，但通常将基因视为独立预测目标，忽略生物系统中内在的基因-基因相互作用，限制了保留生物学上有意义的共表达模式的能力。基因-基因相互作用反映共享通路和调控机制，对生成数值准确且生物学连贯的ST谱至关重要。
AI.method: 提出CorrFlow，包含两个互补机制：1) 退火掩码流匹配策略，按时间步依赖的退火调度渐进式掩码基因子集，鼓励模型在剩余基因条件下推断被掩码基因，促进联合条件建模而非单基因边际估计。2) 基因图正则化优化方案，整合STRING数据库先验知识和WGCNA数据驱动共表达构建基因亲和力图，强制预测表达的局部一致性和全局平滑性。
AI.result: 在12个数据集上的大量实验表明，CorrFlow在评估方法中达到最佳平均PCC（皮尔逊相关系数）和HPCC（高变基因皮尔逊相关系数），带来更生物学连贯的ST预测。
AI.conclusion: CorrFlow通过显式建模基因-基因依赖，解决了现有方法忽略基因相互作用的问题，实现了数值准确且生物学连贯的空间转录组学预测。

title: The Situated Identity Test: Distinguishing Persistent Cognitive Identity from Persona Imitation
comment: 28 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables; open-source benchmark and reference implementation available at https://github.com/openkedge/sitbench
summary: Large language models can convincingly adopt personas, recall past dialogues, and weave rich autobiographies. Yet this conversational eloquence conceals a fundamental attribution problem: looking the part does not mean having lived the life. Two individuals can share identical public profiles--the same age, hometown, occupation, and personality traits--while possessing entirely distinct private histories, relationships, and acquired skills. When conditioned solely on that shared profile, an agent lacks the information required to determine which lineage is correct. We introduce the Situated Identity Test (SIT), an architecture-independent framework that evaluates whether an agent's behavior is functionally attributable to a specific developmental lineage. Grounded identity requires both appropriate knowledge of recorded experiences and appropriate ignorance of ungrounded ones, bounded by what the identity has actually acquired rather than what its underlying foundation model knows. We prove that any policy conditioned solely on a compressed profile is bounded by an average situated validity of at most 1/m across m colliding life histories on lineage-discriminative queries (at most 50% for paired lineages). We instantiate this framework in SITBench, an evaluation suite designed for 25 profile-collision pairs (50 distinct lineages) across 10,000 planned probes and nine architectural configurations. Supported by an open-source reference implementation, deterministic test fixtures, and empirical pilot evaluations on frontier foundation models (GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5), we formalize the failure modes of persona prompting under profile collision and provide an assurance harness for evaluating episodic continuity, structured state, and epistemic boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出情境身份测试（SIT）框架，解决大语言模型在相同公开画像下无法区分不同私人生命史的根本归因问题。证明仅基于压缩画像的策略在m个碰撞生命史上的平均情境有效性上界为1/m，并构建SITBench评测套件（25组画像碰撞对、50条不同血统、10,000个探针、9种架构配置），在前沿模型上验证了人设提示在画像碰撞下的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能令人信服地采用人设、回忆对话、编织自传，但这种对话流畅性掩盖了根本归因问题：外表像不等于经历过。两个个体可共享完全相同的公开画像（年龄、家乡、职业、性格特征），却拥有截然不同的私人历史、关系和习得技能。仅条件于共享画像的代理缺乏判断哪条血统正确所需的信息。
AI.method: 提出与架构无关的情境身份测试（SIT）框架，要求基础身份同时具备：对记录经历的适当知识、对无依据经历的适当无知，边界由身份实际习得内容而非底层基础模型知识决定。理论证明：任何仅条件于压缩画像的策略，在m个碰撞生命史的血统判别查询上，平均情境有效性至多为1/m（配对血统至多50%）。实例化为SITBench评测套件，包含25组画像碰撞对（50条不同血统）、10,000个计划探针、9种架构配置，提供开源参考实现、确定性测试固件，并在GPT-5.6 Sol与Claude Opus 5上进行实证试点评测。
AI.result: 形式化了人设提示在画像碰撞下的失效模式；建立了评估情景连续性、结构化状态和认知边界的保证工具；实证评测显示前沿基础模型在SITBench上表现出显著的情境归因失败，验证了理论上界。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭公开画像无法支撑可归因的情境身份；必须引入经历记录、情景记忆或结构化状态机制来界定认知边界。SIT框架与SITBench为评估和改进代理的情境身份一致性提供了理论基础与标准化测试平台。

title: Spatial-Interactor: Learning Spatial Reasoning through Interaction with the Observable Physical World
summary: Spatial reasoning is essential for vision-language models (VLMs) to understand and act in the physical world. Reasoning in dynamic environments requires VLMs to perceive local state transitions caused by object motion and viewpoint changes and integrate them over long trajectories to maintain an updated spatial state, yet existing VLMs remain limited in both capabilities. Current spatial training primarily focuses on static questions about object attributes and spatial relations, providing limited direct supervision for state transitions; in contrast, interaction trajectories naturally connect a preceding observation, an action, and a subsequent observation, offering direct supervision for local state transitions, while complete trajectories reveal dependencies among consecutive transitions. We therefore introduce Spatial-Interactor, a framework that trains VLMs to model physical-world state transitions through interaction, organizing this learning process into a three-level curriculum covering L1 passive world-state transitions, L2 active self-state transitions, and L3 long-horizon interaction trajectories. Accordingly, we construct the Learning from Spatial Interaction dataset (LSI-108K) from simulated and real interaction trajectories, with tasks aligned with the objective of each level. Our two-stage training strategy applies Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to L1 and L2 for local transition modeling, and On-Policy Distillation (OPD) then uses privileged self-distillation: a teacher branch given segment-level transition descriptions supervises the student's on-policy CoT, helping the student learn to integrate consecutive transitions over L3 long trajectories. Experiments across multiple VLMs and spatial benchmarks show consistent gains in local transition modeling and long-horizon integration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spatial-Interactor框架，通过三级课程学习（被动世界状态转移、主动自我状态转移、长时程交互轨迹）训练视觉语言模型建模物理世界状态转移，构建LSI-108K数据集，采用两阶段训练策略（SFT用于局部转移建模，OPD用于长轨迹整合），在多个VLM和空间基准上显著提升局部转移建模和长时程整合能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在动态环境中的空间推理能力受限：难以感知由物体运动和视角变化引起的局部状态转移，也难以在长轨迹上整合这些转移以维持更新的空间状态。现有空间训练主要关注静态物体属性和空间关系问题，缺乏对状态转移的直接监督。交互轨迹天然连接先前观测、动作和后续观测，为局部状态转移提供直接监督，完整轨迹揭示连续转移间的依赖关系。
AI.method: 1. 三级课程学习：L1被动世界状态转移（观察外部物体运动），L2主动自我状态转移（自我视角变化），L3长时程交互轨迹（连续转移整合）。2. 构建LSI-108K数据集，包含仿真和真实交互轨迹，任务与各级目标对齐。3. 两阶段训练：第一阶段在L1/L2上进行监督微调（SFT）学习局部转移建模；第二阶段在L3上采用策略蒸馏（OPD），教师分支给定片段级转移描述，监督学生分支的在线CoT推理，学习整合连续转移。
AI.result: 在多个视觉语言模型和空间推理基准上实验，Spatial-Interactor在局部状态转移建模和长时程转移整合任务上均取得一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过交互轨迹的三级课程学习和两阶段训练策略，可以有效提升VLM对物理世界状态转移的建模能力，解决动态环境下空间推理的局部感知与长时程整合难题。

title: WildfireSpreadBench: The Metric Decides the Model in Wildfire Spread Prediction
summary: Machine learning is being increasingly used to predict where active wildfires will burn the following day, helping inform evacuation boundaries and containment lines. Most models are evaluated using Average Precision (AP), which summarizes performance across all decision thresholds, although acting on a forecast requires choosing one. We benchmarked five discriminative architectures and one generative model on WildfireSpreadTS using a shared evaluation pipeline and two input configurations. We found that model rankings varied depending on whether performance was measured by AP or by threshold-dependent metrics like F1 and IoU. The highest-AP model flagged 4 to 5 times the area that burned and ranked fifth of six on F1 and IoU, and the most recall-heavy model flagged 16 to 23 times. Models with more usable predictions had AP scores 24 to 37 lower. Across architectures, we identified three distinct prediction profiles: over-predicting, balanced, and under-predicting, which AP alone could not distinguish. Expanding the input from 7 to 23 channels changed AP by 0.03 on average, against a 0.21 to 0.24 spread across architectures. These results show AP alone can favor models whose predictions are poorly suited for operational wildfire forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了六种机器学习模型在野火蔓延预测任务上的表现，发现平均精度（AP）这一常用指标无法区分过度预测、平衡预测和预测不足三种预测模式，且最高AP模型在实际操作指标（F1、IoU）上表现较差，提示AP可能误导操作性野火预报模型选择。
AI.motivation: 机器学习越来越多地用于预测野火次日蔓延范围，以辅助疏散边界和围堵线制定。现有模型多采用AP评估，但实际决策需选定单一阈值，AP汇总了所有阈值性能，可能无法反映模型在操作阈值下的实际效用。
AI.method: 在WildfireSpreadTS数据集上，使用统一评估流程对比五种判别式架构和一种生成式模型，测试两种输入配置（7通道与23通道），除AP外引入F1、IoU等阈值依赖指标，并分析预测面积与实烧面积比率。
AI.result: 模型在AP与F1/IoU上的排名不一致：最高AP模型预测面积为实烧面积4-5倍，在F1和IoU上排名第六中的第五；最偏向召回的模型预测面积为16-23倍。具有实用预测的模型AP比最高模型低24-37。跨架构识别出过度预测、平衡、预测不足三种模式，AP无法区分。输入通道从7增至23仅使AP平均变化0.03，远小于架构间0.21-0.24的差异。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖AP评估会青睐预测结果不适合操作性野火预报的模型；实际部署需结合阈值依赖指标和预测面积比率，综合考量模型的预测模式与操作效用。

title: The Role of AI in Online Reviews
summary: The rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) creates new opportunities for strategic content generation on online platforms, including potentially harmful forms of manipulation that may undermine platform effectiveness and reshape platform dynamics. However, measuring such activity is difficult because AI-generated content is rarely directly observable. We introduce an empirical approach that leverages discrete LLM supply shocks - abrupt changes in model prices and capabilities, and contrasts verified with non-verified reviews to identify changes in platform activity associated with generative AI supply improvements. We apply this approach to more than 13 million reviews from Trustpilot, one of the leading online platforms for business reviews. A robust finding is that following LLM supply shocks, unverified reviews shift toward greater negativity: more 1-stars, fewer 5-stars, and lower ratings, with effects driven primarily by new model releases and concentrated among firms with the lowest and highest review volumes, suggesting that strategic AI use may reshape platform competition dynamics. We further find that LLM supply shocks trigger short, concentrated bursts of review activity. Together, these findings suggest that generative AI is already reshaping how reputation and competition operate on online platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大语言模型（LLM）供给冲击（价格和能力的突变）以及已验证与未验证评论的对比，实证分析了生成式 AI 对 Trustpilot 平台评论的影响。结果显示，LLM 供给冲击后，未验证评论显著变得更负面（1 星增多、5 星减少、整体评分下降），效应主要由新模型发布驱动，且集中在评论量极低和极高的企业中；同时冲击引发短期、集中的评论活动爆发。表明生成式 AI 已在重塑在线平台的声誉机制与竞争格局。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型的快速普及，战略性 AI 生成内容在在线平台上激增，可能破坏平台效能并改变竞争动态。但 AI 生成内容难以直接观测，衡量此类活动极具挑战。本文旨在开发一种实证方法，利用离散的 LLM 供给冲击来识别生成式 AI 对平台活动的因果影响。
AI.method: 采用差分差分框架，利用 LLM 价格和能力的突变（供给冲击）作为外生变化，对比已验证（Verified）与未验证（Unverified）评论在冲击前后的变化。数据覆盖 Trustpilot 超过 1300 万条评论，通过事件研究和异质性分析（按企业评论量分组）识别 AI 生成内容的战略使用模式。
AI.result: 1. LLM 供给冲击后，未验证评论显著向负面转移：1 星评论增加，5 星评论减少，平均评分下降。2. 效应主要由新模型发布驱动，而非价格变化。3. 负面效应集中在评论量最低和最高的企业，暗示战略性 AI 使用可能重塑平台竞争。4. 冲击还引发短期、集中的评论活动爆发。
AI.conclusion: 生成式 AI 已开始重塑在线平台上的声誉机制与竞争动态。未验证评论的负面化倾向及活动爆发表明，企业或竞争对手可能利用 LLM 进行战略性内容生成（如刷差评、操纵声誉），平台需开发相应检测与治理手段以维护生态公平。

title: Enforcing Narrative Reliability and Epistemic Pacing in LLM-Driven Detective Games via Structured Knowledge Trees
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) enable open-ended dialogue in interactive games, but their non-deterministic outputs make it difficult to preserve authorial control, factual consistency, and the intended sequence of information disclosure. These challenges are particularly significant in detective games, where premature revelation or fabricated details can undermine the logic of player progression. We present a Structured Knowledge Tree architecture coupled with a tri-agent LLM pipeline for controlling dialogue in an open-ended interrogation game. The system separates knowledge retrieval, dialogue generation, and response verification to ensure that the virtual suspect reveals only information permitted by the current narrative state. We evaluate the approach through The Interrogation of Adrian Gale, a playable detective-game testbed, and a formal user study examining hallucination reduction, adherence to authored disclosure sequences, and perceived logical progression. Our results demonstrate that the structured architecture reduces critical hallucinations by 64.78% and entirely prevents premature narrative disclosure. While the strict mechanical constraints introduced usability trade-offs regarding forced conversational reveals, the system successfully enforces rigorous epistemic pacing and provides players with a clear, subjective sense of progression toward solving the case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构化知识树架构配合三智能体LLM管线，用于控制开放式审讯游戏中的对话，将知识检索、对话生成、响应验证分离，确保虚拟嫌疑人仅按当前叙事状态允许的信息披露。实验表明关键幻觉减少64.78%，完全阻止过早叙事披露，虽引入可用性权衡，但成功实现严格的认知节奏控制并给玩家清晰的解案进展感。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在交互式游戏中实现开放式对话，但其非确定性输出导致作者控制、事实一致性和信息披露序列难以保证。在侦探游戏中，过早揭露或捏造细节会破坏玩家推进逻辑，亟需一种能强制约束叙事节奏和知识披露的架构。
AI.method: 提出结构化知识树架构与三智能体LLM管线：将知识检索、对话生成、响应验证三个模块解耦，知识树编码叙事状态允许的披露规则，三智能体分别负责按规则检索知识、生成自然语言回复、验证回复是否违反披露约束，形成闭环控制。
AI.result: 在可玩测试床《Adrian Gale审讯》及正式用户研究中，该架构使关键幻觉减少64.78%，完全阻止过早叙事披露，成功强制执行认知节奏，玩家主观感受到清晰的解案进展感；但严格机械约束带来可用性权衡，表现为强制性对话揭露感较强。
AI.conclusion: 结构化知识树与三智能体管线有效解决LLM开放式对话中的作者控制、事实一致性与披露序列问题，虽牺牲部分对话自然度，但为侦探类游戏提供了可靠的叙事节奏保障，验证了显式知识结构与模块化验证机制在叙事驱动交互中的价值。

title: SegTSim: A Big Data Driven Segmented Temporal Simulation Framework for Heterogeneous Multivariate Systems
