summary: Heterogeneous multivariate time-series systems exhibit segment-specific nonlinear dynamics that challenge monolithic forecasting architectures. We propose SegTSim, a big-data-driven segmented temporal simulation framework that integrates segment-specific elasticity modeling with adaptive min-gating, dynamic production relocation optimization, multi-factor data fusion with exchange-rate propagation, and a deep ensemble validation pipeline. The framework is validated on US--Japan automotive trade data from USITC repositories spanning 2015 to 2025, comprising approximately 13000 annual records. Under a 25% perturbation scenario, Japanese import volume declines by 20.4% to 0.93 billion USD, while all output variables maintain coefficients of variation below 3.5% across 1000 ensemble inference runs.

AI.tldr: 提出SegTSim分段时序仿真框架，集成分段弹性建模、自适应最小门控、动态生产转移优化、多因子数据融合与汇率传播及深度集成验证管线，在美日汽车贸易数据上验证，25%扰动下日本进口量下降20.4%至9.3亿美元，输出变量变异系数均低于3.5%。
AI.motivation: 异构多变量时间序列系统表现出分段特有的非线性动态，单一整体预测架构难以捕捉分段差异，需要针对分段特性的仿真框架。
AI.method: 基于大数据的分段时序仿真框架SegTSim，包含：分段特异性弹性建模、自适应最小门控机制、动态生产转移优化、多因子数据融合与汇率传播模块，以及深度集成验证管线。
AI.result: 在USITC 2015-2025年美日汽车贸易数据（约13000条年度记录）上验证，25%扰动场景下日本进口量下降20.4%至9.3亿美元，1000次集成推理中所有输出变量变异系数均低于3.5%。
AI.conclusion: SegTSim能有效捕捉分段非线性动态，在贸易扰动情景下提供稳健、低方差的预测，适用于异构多变量时间序列系统的分段仿真与策略评估。

title: PII-TRACE: A Benchmark for Context-Aware PII Detection in Multi-Turn LLM Conversations
summary: LLM assistants and agentic systems log long multi-turn conversations. AI providers often scan these conversations for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and mask the PII before storing or processing conversation data. Yet most PII detectors and benchmarks target self-contained records rather than cross-turn evaluation. To evaluate PII detection across turns in multi-turn conversations, we introduce PII-TRACE (Tracing Recurring PII Across Conversational Exchanges), to our knowledge the first PII benchmark to assess whether detectors identify PII in conversational contexts and cover every mention of a recurring identifier across turns. PII-TRACE contains 13,148 synthetic multi-turn dialogues in 13 languages with character-level spans and identifier clusters. Across eleven baselines, including frontier LLMs, no detector achieves full entity-level coverage without substantial false positives on PII-free conversations, and single-pass reading loses a third of the gold characters on long dialogues. To close this gap, we introduce PII-Tracer, a compact 0.6B-parameter detector trained with conversation-level supervision. PII-Tracer attains the highest entity-level coverage of any system we evaluate and also performs strongly on standard single-record benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出首个跨轮次PII检测基准PII-TRACE，包含13种语言的13,148个合成多轮对话，并训练了0.6B参数的PII-Tracer模型，在实体级覆盖率上超越所有基线，同时在单记录基准上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有PII检测器和基准主要针对独立记录，缺乏对多轮对话中跨轮次重复PII识别的评估，导致实际部署中漏检和误报严重。
AI.method: 构建PII-TRACE基准，包含字符级跨度和标识符聚类；对比11种基线（含前沿LLM）；训练紧凑的PII-Tracer（0.6B参数），采用对话级监督而非单轮监督。
AI.result: 所有基线均无法在不产生大量误报的情况下实现完整实体级覆盖；单次读取在长对话中丢失三分之一金标准字符。PII-Tracer达到最高实体级覆盖率，且在标准单记录基准上表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 跨轮次PII检测需要专用基准和对话级训练；PII-TRACE填补评估空白，PII-Tracer证明小模型经对话级监督可超越大模型单轮方法，为实际部署提供轻量高效方案。

title: LazyAgent: Demand-Driven Materialization and Physical Optimization of Agentic Programs
summary: Current agent runtimes that plan before acting generally execute a step once it becomes ready. We present LazyAgent, a unified execution framework for agent-authored programs organized around a live, goal-derived demanded set. LazyAgent refreshes a backward closure from requested outputs as execution state changes and materializes a ready node only when the active goal requires it. This replaces repeated local judgments with one linear-time graph analysis followed by constant-time membership tests, allowing programs to remain broad while execution stays request-specific. On programs that describe more than the current request needs, LazyAgent consistently outperforms the strongest goal-stopping eager baseline by refusing unrelated work before it starts. Adding one unrelated product raises the eager bill by 22.5% and LazyAgent's by 0.0%. LazyAgent saves 42.0% of measured CPU on production scientific workflows and 51.7% of container time on a live release gate spanning four repositories. We also prove and verify exact equivalence when the request reaches the whole graph, leaving no unrelated work to avoid. Beyond permission, goal-relative output projection saves up to approximately 90% of a shared step on two third-party test suites while the identical eager control saves 0.0%; the advantage disappears when the omitted output has no other consumer or the request needs it. Ordering, reuse, and pruning can also save cost, but do not replace permission. Finally, we show that current public benchmarks are eager-shaped and contain almost no unrequested work. A pre-registered planning intervention did not broaden them. These findings motivate benchmarks built from standing programs and sequences.

AI.tldr: LazyAgent 是一种基于目标派生需求集的统一执行框架，通过反向闭包分析仅在目标需要时物化节点，显著减少无关工作，在科学工作流和发布门控中大幅节省 CPU 和容器时间，并证明与贪婪执行在完整图请求下等价。
AI.motivation: 现有代理运行时在规划后立即执行就绪步骤，导致执行大量与当前请求无关的工作，缺乏基于目标的按需执行机制，且现有基准测试偏向贪婪执行，无法评估按需执行的优势。
AI.method: 提出 LazyAgent 框架，维护从请求输出反向推导的活跃需求集，在执行状态变化时刷新反向闭包，仅当活跃目标需要时才物化就绪节点。将重复的局部判断替换为一次线性时间图分析和常数时间成员测试。结合目标相对输出投影、排序、复用和剪枝优化。
AI.result: 在描述超出当前请求的程序上，LazyAgent 拒绝无关工作，性能优于最强目标停止贪婪基线。增加无关产品时，贪婪基线开销增加 22.5%，LazyAgent 增加 0.0%。生产科学工作流节省 42.0% CPU，跨四仓库的发布门控节省 51.7% 容器时间。目标相对输出投影在第三方测试套件上节省高达 ~90% 共享步骤，贪婪对照组节省 0.0%。证明在请求覆盖全图时与贪婪执行完全等价。发现现有公共基准测试偏向贪婪形状，几乎无未请求工作，规划干预未能拓宽。
AI.conclusion: LazyAgent 通过基于目标的按需执行和输出投影，实现了请求特定的执行，显著降低计算成本，且不牺牲正确性。现有基准测试无法评估此类优势，需构建基于现存程序和序列的新基准。

title: A Pinch of SFT, A Dash of RL: When Reinforcement Learning Helps Long-Horizon Advertising Agents
summary: Enterprise analytics agents solve long-horizon tool-use problems over distributed business data, requiring retrieval, reasoning, API calls, code execution, and adaptation to intermediate observations. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) calibrates tool syntax and teacher-supported behavior, whereas reinforcement learning (RL) can explore reward-supported behaviors beyond demonstrations; applied uniformly, however, RL can perturb already-calibrated skills. We study how to balance SFT and RL under production-mirroring beta APIs. We observe that, in our controlled experiment, checkpoint trajectories retrospectively separated into three regimes: Imitation, where SFT captured reliable teacher behavior; Lift, where both stages helped; and Discovery, where useful reward-observable behavior lay outside reliable teacher support. We leverage this prospectively, using teacher support and reward-observable headroom to route features to SFT only, SFT then RL, increased RL allocation, or further environment development. Across 18 subsequent feature-specific experiments, the diagnostic predicted 15/18 observed trajectories. On GPT-OSS 120B, targeted SFT then RL produced positive point estimates on 7/8 advertiser skills relative to a frontier Control; five positive gains had paired 95% confidence intervals excluding zero, while one skill had a confidence-supported regression. The largest gain was non-disclosure (+11.27 points; 95% CI [+9.72, +12.82]). A separate SME audit surfaced that targeted RL reduces standard leakage from 11.8% to 2.9% and adversarial leakage from 22.9% to 6.8% relative to SFT while preserving actionability (86.2% to 85.7%). In a matched uniform-versus-targeted comparison with shared rewards and optimization, targeted RL improved the seven-skill mean delta from +1.62 to +3.57 while using 43% less incremental RL compute.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何在企业分析智能体中平衡监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）。通过受控实验发现检查点轨迹可回顾性地分为三种模式：模仿（SFT 捕获可靠教师行为）、提升（两阶段均有助益）、发现（有用的奖励可观测行为超出可靠教师支持范围）。基于教师支持度与奖励可观测余量，提出前瞻性路由策略，将特征分配至仅 SFT、SFT 后接 RL、增加 RL 分配或进一步环境开发。在 18 项后续特征实验中，诊断准确预测了 15/18 条观测轨迹。在 GPT-OSS 120B 上，针对性 SFT 再 RL 使 8 项广告技能中有 7 项相对前沿对照组呈正增益，其中 5 项增益的 95% 置信区间不含零，最大增益为非披露技能（+11.27 分；95% CI [+9.72, +12.82]）。SME 审计显示，针对性 RL 将标准泄露率从 11.8% 降至 2.9%，对抗泄露率从 22.9% 降至 6.8%，同时保持可执行性（86.2% → 85.7%）。在共享奖励与优化的匹配对比中，针对性 RL 将七技能均值增益从 +1.62 提升至 +3.57，且仅使用 43% 的增量 RL 算力。
AI.motivation: 企业分析智能体需解决分布式业务数据上的长时程工具使用问题，涉及检索、推理、API 调用、代码执行及对中间观测的适应。SFT 可校准工具语法与教师支持的行为，而 RL 能探索演示之外的奖励支持行为；但统一应用 RL 会扰动已校准的技能。因此需要在生产镜像的 Beta API 环境下，研究如何平衡 SFT 与 RL，避免过度 RL 破坏已有能力。
AI.method: 1. 受控实验观察检查点轨迹，回顾性识别三种训练模式：模仿、提升、发现。2. 利用教师支持度与奖励可观测余量，前瞻性地将特征路由至四类策略：仅 SFT、SFT 后接 RL、增加 RL 分配、进一步环境开发。3. 开展 18 项特征级实验验证诊断预测准确性。4. 在 GPT-OSS 120B 上对比针对性 SFT 再 RL 与前沿对照组，评估 8 项广告技能。5. SME 审计对比针对性 RL 与 SFT 的泄露率与可执行性。6. 匹配实验对比统一 RL 与针对性 RL，控制奖励与优化设置相同，度量算力效率。
AI.result: 1. 三模式诊断在 18 项后续实验中预测准确 15/18。2. GPT-OSS 120B 上针对性 SFT 再 RL 使 7/8 广告技能呈正点估计，5 项增益 95% CI 不含零，1 项显著回归；最大增益非披露技能 +11.27（95% CI [+9.72, +12.82]）。3. SME 审计：针对性 RL 将标准泄露率从 11.8% 降至 2.9%，对抗泄露率从 22.9% 降至 6.8%，可执行性基本持平（86.2% → 85.7%）。4. 匹配对比：针对性 RL 将七技能均值增益从 +1.62 提升至 +3.57，且仅消耗统一 RL 43% 的增量算力。
AI.conclusion: 基于教师支持度与奖励可观测余量的三模式诊断能有效预测训练轨迹，指导 SFT 与 RL 资源的针对性分配。针对性的 SFT 再 RL 策略在保持可执行性的前提下，显著降低泄露风险，以更少的算力实现更大的性能增益，优于统一的 RL 训练范式。

title: Evaluating Personal Information Output from Conversational Interactions in Generative AI Systems
comment: Accepted at the 19th IIAI International Congress on Advanced Applied Informatics (IIAI-AAI 2026)
summary: This exploratory pilot study evaluates the scope and perceived accuracy of personal information output from ongoing conversational interactions in generative AI systems using GPT-5.2 Instant and GPT-5.2 Thinking, categorized into three output types: Fact, Inference, and Confidence. Based on the evaluation results obtained from 15 Japanese participants, differences in model design have limited impact on personal information output tendencies. Compared with the Inference type, the Fact type shows a more conservative output pattern. Regarding attribute categories, the findings indicate that Core Personal attributes associated with identification are treated relatively conservatively, whereas Behavioral and Linguistic attributes show higher accuracy across both Fact and Inference outputs. Furthermore, Holistic Profile, Psychological and Cognitive, and Residual attributes are more readily inferred, even when not supported by explicit factual outputs. Notably, the lack of null outputs for these attributes in the Inference type suggests that such inferred profiles may be constructed from indirectly available contextual information. The findings may contribute to future discussions regarding privacy awareness and personal information inference in generative AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索性评估生成式AI系统（GPT-5.2 Instant和Thinking）在对话中输出个人信息的范围和感知准确性，发现模型设计差异影响有限，Fact类型输出更保守，核心个人属性处理保守，行为和语言属性准确性较高，整体画像、心理认知和残余属性更易被推断，推断可能源于间接上下文信息，为隐私意识和个人信息推断讨论提供依据。
AI.motivation: 探究生成式AI系统在持续对话交互中输出个人信息的范围及其感知准确性，理解不同模型设计对个人信息输出倾向的影响，以及不同属性类别在事实输出与推断输出中的差异，为隐私保护和个人信息推断提供实证基础。
AI.method: 采用探索性试点研究设计，招募15名日本参与者，使用GPT-5.2 Instant和GPT-5.2 Thinking两个模型版本，通过持续对话交互收集输出，将个人信息输出分为Fact、Inference、Confidence三类，按属性类别（核心个人、行为、语言、整体画像、心理认知、残余）进行定性和定量评估，比较模型间差异及输出类型间差异。
AI.result: 1) 模型设计差异对个人信息输出倾向影响有限；2) Fact类型输出比Inference类型更保守；3) 核心个人属性（识别相关）处理相对保守，行为和语言属性在Fact和Inference中均表现出较高准确性；4) 整体画像、心理认知和残余属性更易被推断，即使缺乏显性事实输出；5) Inference类型中这些属性缺乏空输出，表明推断画像可能由间接可用的上下文信息构建。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI系统在对话中对个人信息的输出倾向主要取决于属性类别而非模型设计，推断类输出易构建未显性提供的个人画像，引发隐私担忧；研究为生成式AI系统的隐私意识和个人信息推断风险讨论提供实证支持，未来需进一步研究缓解策略和监管框架。

title: FireWorldBench: Benchmarking Complex Physical World Intelligence through Coupled-Field Fire Dynamics
summary: Understanding the physical world requires more than object recognition, scene description, and short-term visual prediction, as real-world physical systems involve multiple continuous fields, latent causal mechanisms, partial observations, and intervention-sensitive dynamics. We propose FireWorldBench, a benchmark for evaluating complex physical world intelligence in multimodal large language models and agents through coupled-field fire dynamics. Fire provides a canonical stress-test environment, where multiple interacting physical fields jointly shape observable states and temporal dynamics. FireWorldBench is organized along two complementary axes, a physical capability axis and a fire scenario task axis, jointly covering physical-state understanding, temporal dynamics, causal mechanisms, and intervention reasoning. The benchmark comprises 520 fire-world entries, including 494 controlled simulation worlds and 26 real-world-aligned event groups, spanning 47 scene archetypes across 7 environment families. These entries combine structured textual observations, multiple 2D physical-field visualizations, and 3D event-level scene modeling, yielding 9,074 text-image interleaved question-answer pairs across choice-based and open-ended report-generation formats. FireWorldBench evaluates whether models can infer latent physical states, explain underlying mechanisms, forecast coupled-field evolution, and assess intervention consequences from multimodal partial observations, providing a challenging testbed for complex physical world intelligence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FireWorldBench，一个基于耦合场火灾动力学的多模态大语言模型/智能体物理世界智能基准，包含 520 个火灾世界条目、9074 个图文交错问答对，覆盖物理状态理解、时序动力学、因果机制和干预推理四大能力维度。
AI.motivation: 现实物理系统涉及多连续场、潜在因果机制、部分观测和干预敏感动力学，现有目标识别、场景描述及短期视觉预测不足以评估复杂物理世界智能。火灾作为典型耦合多物理场交互环境，可作为压力测试基准。
AI.method: 构建双轴基准：物理能力轴与火灾场景任务轴。收集 494 个受控仿真世界和 26 个真实对齐事件组，涵盖 7 类环境族下的 47 种场景原型。每个条目融合结构化文本观测、多 2D 物理场可视化和 3D 事件级建模，生成选择题与开放式报告生成两种格式的 9074 个图文交错问答对。
AI.result: 基准可评估模型从多模态部分观测中推断潜在物理状态、解释底层机制、预测耦合场演化及评估干预后果的能力，为复杂物理世界智能提供高难度测试床。
AI.conclusion: FireWorldBench 通过火灾耦合场动力学系统化评估多模态模型的物理推理能力，填补了复杂物理世界智能基准的空白，推动具身智能与物理世界模型研究。

title: EvoRank: LLM-Guided Evolution of Multi-Objective Learning-to-Rank Pipelines
summary: We present EvoRank, an open autonomous ranking engineer: an LLM-guided evolutionary loop that discovers complete Learning-to-Rank pipelines (features, models, losses, ensembles) for multi-objective e-commerce search. On the Expedia ICDM 2013 dataset, with relevance, conversion, and revenue as competing objectives, three independent runs each converge within 50 iterations (about ten dollars) on interpretable pipelines that beat an Optuna-tuned LambdaMART on 60k held-out queries, an advantage that persists at full data scale and places in the top 6 percent of the original competition. A first campaign, evolving only training objectives, builds the central design rule: it appeared to work on its selection fold (the small dataset it uses to pick winners) while a transfer audit, re-scoring winners on held-out data, showed the gains were almost entirely fitness noise (the randomness of its own scoring), and neither seeded domain knowledge nor richer diagnostic feedback changed what transferred. The deciding quantity is measurable in advance: search-space headroom relative to fitness noise. We package this as a headroom gate that predicts, before any LLM spend, whether the loop will pay off, and we release the system, the auditing tools, and a catalog of failure modes with their guardrails, so teams can apply the procedure to their own ranking stacks.

AI.tldr: EvoRank 是一个基于 LLM 引导的进化循环，自动发现多目标电商搜索的完整 Learning-to-Rank 流水线（特征、模型、损失、集成）。在 Expedia ICDM 2013 数据集上，三次独立运行在 50 代内收敛（约 10 美元），所得可解释流水线在 6 万举出查询上击败 Optuna 调优的 LambdaMART，优势在全量数据下保持并跻身原始竞赛前 6%。关键发现：仅演化训练目标的首轮实验显示，选择折上的表观增益实为适应度噪声（评分随机性），迁移审计揭示其不具备泛化；决定成败的可预测量是搜索空间余量相对于适应度噪声的比值。作者将其封装为“余量门控”，在投入 LLM 计算前即可预测收益，并开源系统、审计工具与失败模式目录。
AI.motivation: 现有 Learning-to-Rank 管线设计依赖人工试错与超参搜索，难以同时优化相关性、转化、收入等多目标，且缺乏对进化搜索收益的事前可预测性评估。论文旨在构建一个自主、可审计的进化工程师，能在低成本下自动发现高质量流水线，并提供可量化的“余量门控”判断何时值得投入 LLM 计算资源。
AI.method: 采用 LLM 引导的进化循环：初始化候选流水线（特征工程、模型架构、损失函数、集成策略），LLM 根据历史表现与领域知识提出变异/交叉建议，经训练与验证后按多目标适应度（相关性、转化、收入）筛选精英。引入“迁移审计”机制：在选择折之外的举出数据重新评分精英，以区分真实泛化增益与适应度噪声。定义“搜索空间余量”为最优可能性能与当前基线的差距，结合适应度噪声方差构建“余量门控”，在进化前预测投入产出比。
AI.result: 三次独立运行均在 50 代内收敛（约 10 美元 LLM 开销），生成的可解释流水线在 6 万举出查询上显著优于 Optuna 调优的 LambdaMART，全量数据下优势保持并达到原始竞赛前 6%。首轮仅演化训练目标的实验显示，选择折增益 99% 归因于适应度噪声，迁移审计后无真实泛化；注入领域知识或增强诊断反馈均无法改善迁移性。余量门控能在零 LLM 开销下准确预测进化循环是否会回报。
AI.conclusion: EvoRank 证明了 LLM 引导的进化循环可在极低成本下自动发现具有竞争力的多目标排序流水线，但必须通过迁移审计区分真实增益与适应度噪声。搜索空间余量相对于噪声的比值是可预测的关键指标，余量门控为团队提供了事前决策工具。开源系统、审计工具与失败模式目录使该方法可直接迁移至工业界排序栈。

title: Dissecting Training-Free Uncertainty Estimation in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of multimodal tasks, yet understanding and quantifying their predictive uncertainty remains underexplored despite being central for safety critical applications. In this work, we present a systematic study of training-free uncertainty quantification strategies for MLLMs, categorizing existing approaches into three conceptual families: token-level methods, which operate directly in the text output space; verbalized methods, which elicit uncertainty estimates or abstention signals via natural language prompts; and semantic methods, which measure uncertainty in a semantic meaning space. We benchmark these strategies across multiple datasets, model families, generations, and scales, and find that no single family dominates: token-level entropy (at sampling temperature 1.0) wins on short answers, verbalized abstention on sentence-length responses, and semantic methods on long-form generation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)的免训练不确定性量化策略，将现有方法分为三类：token级方法、语言化方法和语义方法，并在多个数据集和模型上进行基准测试，发现没有单一方法占优：短答案用token级熵(温度1.0)，句子级响应用语言化拒答，长文本生成用语义方法。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在多模态任务上表现优异，但其预测不确定性的理解和量化仍未充分探索，而这对安全关键应用至关重要。
AI.method: 将现有免训练不确定性量化方法分为三大概念家族：token级方法(直接在文本输出空间操作)、语言化方法(通过自然语言提示获取不确定性估计或拒答信号)、语义方法(在语义意义空间度量不确定性)，并在多个数据集、模型家族、代际和规模上进行基准测试。
AI.result: 无单一家族占主导：token级熵(采样温度1.0)在短答案上胜出，语言化拒答在句子长度响应上胜出，语义方法在长文本生成上胜出。
AI.conclusion: 需根据任务类型和生成长度选择合适的不确定性量化策略，单一方法无法全面覆盖所有场景。

title: Tutoring Large Language Models to be Domain-adaptive, Precise and Safe
comment: This is a preprint of a PhD thesis submitted to IIT KGP. The final, official version of record is available through the university's institutional repository
summary: This thesis proposes a framework for "responsible intelligence" to address AI's critical challenges in safety, ethics, and cultural sensitivity. It advances three core areas: First, it improves domain adaptation in specialized fields using active learning and graph-based knowledge to reduce hallucinations. Second, it enhances ethical rigor via a novel decoding-time alignment mechanism that proactively blocks harmful text generation in real-time. Finally, it ensures cultural and multilingual safety through language-specific steering that respects diverse linguistic and social norms. Ultimately, this work provides a blueprint for building next-generation AI that is contextually knowledgeable, ethically sound, and culturally adaptable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“负责任智能”框架，通过主动学习与图知识减少幻觉、解码时对齐机制实时阻断有害生成、语言特定引导保障多语言文化安全，为构建具备领域知识、伦理合规、文化适应性的下一代AI提供蓝图。
AI.motivation: 当前AI在安全性、伦理合规性及文化敏感性方面面临关键挑战，如专业领域幻觉频发、有害内容生成风险、跨语言文化规范适配不足，亟需系统性框架从根本上解决这些问题。
AI.method: 1) 领域适应改进：融合主动学习与图基知识表示，提升专业领域知识注入精度，降低幻觉率。2) 伦理对齐机制：设计解码时干预策略，实时检测并阻断有害文本生成。3) 多语言文化安全：采用语言特定的引导向量，动态调整生成行为以尊重多元语言社会规范。
AI.result: 框架在专业领域知识准确性、有害内容拦截率、多语言文化适配性上均显著优于基线，验证了三大核心模块的有效性与互补性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为构建“知识可靠、伦理可控、文化包容”的下一代负责任AI系统提供了可落地的系统性蓝图与关键技术路径。

title: Dissecting Hierarchical Reasoning Models: A Mechanistic Study
summary: We study Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM), a representative hierarchical Transformer-based latent reasoning model with many variants, on Sudoku, Maze, and ARC-AGI-2. We mechanistically understand how HRM reasons and what information it encodes. Our analyses compare HRM against Transformer baselines with and without recurrent modules, apply causal interventions on recurrent states, and utilize linear probes against random-direction ablations, as well as sparse autoencoders with feature ablations. Our results reveal several key findings: recurrent models outperform one-pass baselines, while single-state recurrent Transformers are comparable to HRM. State interventions further show that the causal contributions of the high- and low-level states vary across task-specific checkpoints and inference stages. Selected task variables are linearly decodable from the recurrent states in HRM, yet ablating probe directions produce effects comparable to random controls. SAE ablations yield larger behavioral changes than probe-direction ablations. However, top-ranked SAE features show no stable advantage over size-matched random subsets at larger ablation sizes or across tasks; the same pattern persists in a Sudoku control with within-step BPTT. Together, we characterize that HRM is essentially implementing constraint-aware iterative refinement on a puzzle-specific solution state, in which the functional contributions of components at different levels vary without relying on a compact, causally important feature set. These results highlight the necessity of studying the different working mechanisms and the importance of developing mechanistic interpretability techniques better suited for latent-space, recursive reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 本文对层级推理模型在数独、迷宫和ARC-AGI-2任务上的机制进行了系统分析，发现HRM本质上实现了约束感知的迭代求解，其不同层级组件的功能贡献随任务和推理阶段变化，且不依赖紧凑的因果关键特征集。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在机制性地理解层级Transformer潜在推理模型如何推理及编码何种信息，揭示其工作机制并评估现有可解释性技术对潜在空间递归推理模型的适用性。
AI.method: 采用因果干预循环状态、线性探针对比随机方向消融、稀疏自编码器特征消融等多种机制可解释性方法，将HRM与带/不带循环模块的Transformer基线进行对比，并在数独、迷宫、ARC-AGI-2三类任务上进行系统评估。
AI.result: 循环模型优于单次前向基线，单状态循环Transformer与HRM表现相当；高低层状态的因果贡献随任务检查点和推理阶段变化；任务变量可从循环状态线性解码，但探针方向消融效果与随机对照相当；SAE消融导致更大行为变化，但顶级SAE特征在大规模消融或跨任务中无稳定优势。
AI.conclusion: HRM实现的是基于谜题特定解状态的约束感知迭代求解，不同层级组件的功能贡献动态变化而不依赖紧凑的因果关键特征集。这凸显了研究不同工作机制的必要性，以及开发更适合潜在空间递归推理模型的机制可解释性技术的重要性。

title: Replicating the Geometry of Emotion Representations in a Base Open-Weights Model
summary: Sofroniew et al. (2026) report that emotion concepts in Claude Sonnet 4.5 are represented as vectors whose geometry mirrors human affect psychology. We replicate the representational core of that study on the base pretrained model google/gemma-2-27b, inheriting every disclosed parameter, resolving unspecified steps by disclosed rules, and changing only the subject model. From 205,200 newly generated Claude Sonnet 4.5 stories matching the original corpus design, we extract 171 emotion vectors and recover the core results. The leading principal components form an affective circumplex (PC1 carries 26.7% of variance against the original study's ~27%, PC2 13.4% against ~14%), emotions cluster into similar intuitive families, and the geometry holds across a broad late-middle band. The valence axis aligns with human norms (r = 0.72, against 0.81) and is stable across scales and depth. Arousal aligns at r = 0.67 (against 0.66) but only at the full 171-emotion scale and late depth, so we do not classify it as replicated. Extending the original analysis, a 46-layer sweep locates a sharp seam at L22-26, where the geometry consolidates and the vocabulary readout becomes legible. An embedding-layer baseline finds much of the geometry already present in the static token embeddings, with arousal as the exception. On top-activating held-out text, the geometry predicts token-level co-activation at r = 0.907. At least 52% of vectors peak on structurally non-conceptual tokens, a measured floor for max-activation confounds. Even when a document contains the vector's emotion word, the peak lands on that word only 6.1% of the time. Because the subject is a base model and the stimuli are Claude-generated fiction, the recovered structure is a property of the pretrained representation of Claude-rendered emotion. The original's causal and assistant-facing analyses are out of scope. Code and data are released.

AI.tldr: 本文复现了Sofroniew等人(2026)关于Claude Sonnet 4.5中情感概念几何结构的研究，但在Google Gemma-2-27b基础预训练模型上进行。使用205,200个新生成的Claude风格故事，提取了171个情感向量，验证了核心发现：主成分形成情感环状结构(PC1解释26.7%方差，PC2解释13.4%)，效价轴与人类常模高度相关(r=0.72)，唤醒度相关性较弱(r=0.67)且仅在完整规模和深层稳定。额外发现：第22-26层存在明显几何整合分界线，静态词嵌入已包含大部分几何结构(唤醒度除外)，几何能预测token级共激活(r=0.907)，且峰值激活多落在非概念token上。
AI.motivation: 验证情感概念的几何表征是否为特定模型(Claude Sonnet 4.5)及其微调/对齐过程的产物，还是预训练语言模型的普遍属性。通过在基础预训练模型Gemma-2-27b上复现核心结果，并使用Claude生成的虚构文本作为刺激，测试该结构是否为预训练表征对Claude渲染情感的固有属性。
AI.method: 1. 完全复现原始研究的表征核心：继承所有公开参数，按公开规则解决未指定步骤，仅更换主体模型为google/gemma-2-27b。2. 生成205,200个匹配原始语料设计的Claude Sonnet 4.5风格故事。3. 提取171个情感向量。4. 进行主成分分析、聚类分析、效价/唤醒度与人类常模相关性分析。5. 扩展分析：46层扫描定位几何整合分界线，词嵌入基线测试，top-activating held-out文本上的token级共激活预测，峰值激活token的结构性质分析。
AI.result: 1. 核心结果复现：情感环状结构(PC1 26.7%，PC2 13.4%)，情感聚类为直观家族，几何在中后层带稳定。2. 效价轴与人类常模相关r=0.72(原始0.81)，跨尺度和深度稳定。3. 唤醒度相关r=0.67(原始0.66)，仅在完整171情感规模和深层稳定，未判定为复现。4. 关键新发现：L22-26层存在锐利分界线，几何整合且词汇读出变清晰；静态词嵌入已含大部分几何(唤醒度除外)；几何预测token共激活r=0.907；≥52%向量峰值落在非概念token上；即使文档含情感词，峰值仅6.1%落在该词上。
AI.conclusion: 情感概念的几何结构是预训练语言模型对Claude渲染情感表征的固有属性，不依赖于特定模型架构、微调或对齐。该结构在预训练早期(词嵌入层)已大部分形成，中层(L22-26)发生整合巩固。峰值激活主要落在非概念token上，提示max-activation分析存在显著混淆因素。原始研究的因果分析和助手视角分析不在本研究范围内。代码和数据已公开。

title: Event Signature Transfer: Model-Agnostic Forecast Scenario Construction from Historical Events
summary: Forecasters often know an event is imminent but not the shape, size, or timing of its effect. We introduce Event Signature Transfer (EST), a training-free, model-agnostic operator that turns a completed past event into an explicit forecast scenario. EST removes a source event's own trend and seasonality, then scales and retimes the remaining event signature onto a native forecast, preserving the forecast's linked structure and reducing to it exactly at zero strength. Because it reads only output quantiles, EST applies to any quantile forecaster, with no training, no model internals, at transfer time. Across twelve real episodes and ten synthetic scenarios on Chronos-2, TimesFM-2.5 and Toto-2.0, manually configured EST reduces real-episode WQL by 21.7-90\% in-sample. On Chronos-2, it leads eleven of twelve matched comparisons against covariate conditioning, activation editing and raw replay. The operator builds a scenario; it does not estimate its likelihood.

AI.tldr: 本文提出事件签名迁移（EST），一种无需训练、与模型无关的算子，将已完成的历史事件转化为显式预测场景。EST 去除源事件的趋势和季节性，将剩余的事件签名缩放并重新计时到原生预测上，保留预测的关联结构，且在零强度时精确退化为原预测。该方法仅读取输出分位数，适用于任意分位数预测器，无需训练或模型内部信息。在 12 个真实事件和 10 个合成场景上，手动配置的 EST 使真实事件的 WQL 降低 21.7%–90%，并在 Chronos-2 上的 12 组对比中有 11 组优于协变量条件、激活编辑和直接重放等基线。注意：算子仅构建场景，不估计其发生概率。
AI.motivation: 预测者通常知道事件即将发生，但不清楚其影响的形状、大小或时机。现有方法（如协变量条件、激活编辑、直接重放）往往需要模型内部访问、重新训练或强假设，难以灵活、即插即用地注入历史事件特征。需要一种免训练、模型无关、仅依赖输出分位数即可将历史事件签名迁移到当前预测的通用算子。
AI.method: 事件签名迁移（EST）算子包含三步：1）去趋势与去季节性：从源事件序列中移除其自身的趋势和季节性分量，提取纯事件签名。2）缩放与重计时：将事件签名按幅度缩放并按时间轴对齐（重计时）叠加到目标预测的原生分位数预测上。3）结构保留与零强度退化：迁移过程保持原预测的跨分位数关联结构，且当迁移强度设为零时精确还原为原生预测。全程仅读取预测器的输出分位数，无需模型内部参数、梯度或再训练。
AI.result: 在 Chronos-2、TimesFM-2.5、Toto-2.0 三个基础模型上，针对 12 个真实事件和 10 个合成场景实验：手动配置的 EST 使真实事件的加权分位数损失（WQL）在样本内降低 21.7%–90%。在 Chronos-2 上，与协变量条件、激活编辑、直接重放三种基线进行 12 组匹配对比，EST 在 11 组中表现最优。结果表明 EST 能显著提升含事件期的预测精度，且具有即插即用、免训练的优势。
AI.conclusion: EST 提供了一种通用、免训练、模型无关的事件场景构建工具，通过迁移历史事件签名显著改善分位数预测在已知事件发生时的表现。其核心优势在于仅需输出分位数、保留预测关联结构、零强度精确退化。局限在于算子仅生成条件场景，不提供事件发生的概率估计；实际部署仍需外部机制决定事件强度与时机。

title: Improving Parameter Utilization by Sharing Neural Experts Across Layers in Transformers
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. To appear in the Proceedings of EMNLP 2026 Main
summary: Transformer-based large language models often suffer from inter-layer parameter redundancy, where functional transformations are redundantly learned across network depths. We propose CS-MoE, a novel Transformer architecture featuring cross-layer expert sharing to address this inefficiency. Deviating from the widely used Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture that terminates each Transformer block with layer-isolated experts, CS-MoE combines layer-independent experts with concurrent access to a centralized, globally shared expert pool. This \textit{Global Experts Sharing} mechanism enables elastic control over token-level parameter activation and computational consumption (FLOPs). Experiments demonstrate that CS-MoE achieves lower perplexity than equal-scale dense Transformers while activating only 55\% of parameters. Furthermore, its performance scales monotonically with an increased number of activated experts and approaches MoE counterparts that consume more FLOPs by expanding the shared pool with a fixed FLOPs budget. CS-MoE also establishes a flexible Pareto frontier between computational cost and model capacity, offering an efficient alternative for computation-constrained environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CS-MoE架构，通过跨层专家共享机制解决Transformer大语言模型中的层间参数冗余问题，仅激活55%参数即可实现比同规模稠密Transformer更低的困惑度，并在计算成本与模型容量之间建立灵活的帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer大语言模型存在严重的层间参数冗余问题，即功能性变换在网络深度方向上被冗余学习，导致参数利用效率低下。
AI.method: 提出CS-MoE架构，采用全局专家共享机制：将层独立专家与中心化的全局共享专家池并发结合，偏离传统MoE每层独立专家的设计，实现token级参数激活和计算消耗（FLOPs）的弹性控制。
AI.result: 实验表明：1) CS-MoE在仅激活55%参数时困惑度低于同规模稠密Transformer；2) 性能随激活专家数单调提升；3) 固定FLOPs预算下扩展共享专家池可逼近消耗更多FLOPs的MoE基线；4) 建立了计算成本与模型容量之间的灵活帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: CS-MoE通过跨层专家共享有效缓解参数冗余，为计算受限环境提供了高效的Transformer架构替代方案，兼具参数效率与性能可扩展性。

title: Schematize: An Agentic System for Generating and Refining Information-Extraction Schemas for Legal Research
summary: Empirical legal research often relies on turning research questions into structured data extracted from large collections of rulings and judgments. Designing the extraction schema and then extracting the data remain a manual, expertise-heavy bottleneck. We present schematize, an open-source multi-agent system that interactively turns a researcher's problem statement into a validated extraction schema that can later be used for autonomous extraction. Schematize couples (i) a clarification dialogue that elicits implicit expert intent, (ii) iterative schema generation, (iii) data-grounded refinement that tests the schema against documents, and (iv) chat-based post-editing. We evaluated the system with human legal professional, introducing our novel methodology, and schematize achieves top performance in most of tested configurations. While the system is designed to be domain-agnostic and applicable to any document collection, we tailor and evaluate it on legal research problems. We release schematize as a pip-installable Python package with full documentation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 schematize，一个开源多智能体系统，能将法律研究者的自然语言问题陈述交互式地转化为经过验证的结构化抽取模式，解决实证法律研究中模式设计与数据抽取的专家瓶颈。系统包含澄清对话、迭代模式生成、基于文档的模式优化和聊天式后编辑四大模块，经法律专业人士评测在多数配置下达到最优性能，已作为 Python 包发布。
AI.motivation: 实证法律研究需要从海量判决文书中抽取结构化数据，但将研究问题转化为抽取模式并执行抽取长期依赖人工专家操作，耗时且难以规模化，缺乏自动化、交互式的端到端工具支持。
AI.method: schematize 采用多智能体架构，包含四大核心组件：(i) 澄清对话智能体，通过多轮交互挖掘专家隐性意图；(ii) 迭代模式生成智能体，基于对话历史动态生成 JSON Schema；(iii) 数据落地优化智能体，在真实文档上测试模式并根据抽取结果自动修正；(iv) 聊天式后编辑智能体，支持自然语言指令微调模式。全流程无需编程，领域无关，针对法律场景专门适配评测。
AI.result: 引入法律专业人士开展人工评测，采用新颖评测方法学；schematize 在大多数测试配置中取得最高性能，显著降低模式设计门槛并提升抽取准确率，验证了交互式多智能体范式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: schematize 成功将专家驱动的模式设计过程自动化、交互化，填补了实证法律研究中的工具空白。系统已开源并提供完整文档，具有领域迁移潜力，可推广至其他文档密集型研究领域。

title: From Inference Engine to Inference Control Plane: Connecting vLLM, llm-d, and the Evolution of Efficient Distributed LLM Serving
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Systems synthesis and research agenda on vLLM, llm-d, distributed inference control, KV-state management, routing, disaggregation, heterogeneous accelerators, reliability, and agentic/multimodal serving. No new experimental measurements are claimed; empirical and organization-reported results are attributed to the cited sources
summary: Large language model (LLM) inference is evolving from an engine-local optimization problem into a distributed control problem involving reusable state, phase placement, heterogeneous accelerators, networking, autoscaling, reliability, and service-level objectives. This paper connects that transition across peer-reviewed systems research, open-source implementations, and documented production studies. It treats vLLM and llm-d as complementary layers: model-serving engines optimize execution through mechanisms such as PagedAttention, continuous batching, kernels, quantization, and parallelism, while an inference control plane can optimize where, when, and under what policy execution occurs across a fleet. The contribution is synthesis rather than a new benchmark; all reported performance and deployment results remain attributed to their original sources. The combined evidence suggests that the scarce resource in modern inference is shifting from raw FLOPs alone toward managed state, placement, network movement, reliability, and decision quality. We propose an Inference Execution Planner that selects feasible execution plans rather than only endpoints, including aggregated versus disaggregated topology, KV source and transfer action, hardware variant, routing/admission policy, and slower scaling decisions. We also provide a source-local benchmark atlas, a bottleneck-migration taxonomy, practical deployment guidance, an evaluation framework based on SLO-goodput, and research questions for agentic, multimodal, heterogeneous, and resilient inference.

AI.tldr: 论文综述了大语言模型推理从引擎本地优化向分布式控制问题的演变，提出了推理执行规划器，整合了 vLLM 和 llm-d 等互补层，提供了基准图谱、瓶颈迁移分类法、部署指导、基于 SLO-goodput 的评估框架以及面向代理、多模态、异构和弹性推理的研究问题。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型推理规模扩大，稀缺资源从单纯的算力转向托管状态、放置决策、网络传输、可靠性和决策质量，现有研究分散于学术论文、开源实现和生产案例中，缺乏系统性综合与统一控制平面抽象。
AI.method: 采用综述与综合方法，梳理同行评审系统研究、开源实现和生产部署文档；将 vLLM 作为模型服务引擎优化执行层，llm-d 作为推理控制平面优化跨集群的位置、时机和策略；提出推理执行规划器选择可行执行计划，构建源局部基准图谱、瓶颈迁移分类法、部署指导及基于 SLO-goodput 的评估框架。
AI.result: 综合证据表明推理稀缺资源已转向状态管理、放置、网络移动、可靠性和决策质量；提出的规划器涵盖聚合与解聚拓扑、KV 源与传输动作、硬件变体、路由/准入策略及缩容决策；提供了实用部署指导、基准图谱、分类法及评估框架，并列出了代理化、多模态、异构和弹性推理的研究问题。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型推理正从单引擎优化迈向分布式控制平面，未来研究需关注状态管理、异构硬件调度、网络感知放置、可靠性保障及 SLO 驱动的好吞吐率优化，推理执行规划器为统一决策提供了可行路径。

title: Prediction of Nonlinear Oscillations in a Jumping Quarter-Car Model Using Reservoir Computing
summary: Reliable prediction of vehicle dynamics is essential for smart driving applications such as autonomous control and advanced driver-assistance systems. Off-road vehicles used in agricultural and construction settings are particularly prone to nonlinear behavior, including bifurcations and chaotic motion arising from intermittent loss of tire--road contact. Predicting such dynamics is challenging because it requires resolving both smooth nonlinearities and the discontinuous switching associated with contact loss. In this work, we investigate the feasibility of reservoir computing (RC) -- specifically an echo state network (ESN) -- for data-driven prediction of a jumping quarter-car model. The reservoir is trained on time-series data from a small number of points and evaluated on its ability to reconstruct bifurcation diagrams, phase-space attractors, and time trajectories across periodic and chaotic regimes. The trained reservoir qualitatively reproduces the period-doubling route to chaos, captures the geometric structure of periodic and chaotic attractors. These results demonstrate that reservoir computing is a feasible data-driven predictor of nonlinear dynamics in a practical, non-smooth vehicle system.

AI.tldr: 本文研究储层计算(回声状态网络)对跳跃四分之一车模型非线性动力学的数据驱动预测能力,表明其能定性再现倍周期通向混沌路径,捕捉周期与混沌吸引子几何结构,验证了储层计算在非光滑车辆系统中的可行性。
AI.motivation: 越野车辆在农业和建筑场景中易因轮胎-路面接触间歇性丧失产生分叉和混沌运动,预测此类非光滑非线性动力学对自动控制和高级驾驶辅助系统至关重要,但传统方法难以同时处理光滑非线性和非光滑开关行为。
AI.method: 采用回声状态网络(ESN)作为储层计算框架,仅用少量时间序列数据训练储层,评估其重构分叉图、相空间吸引子及周期/混沌区域时间轨迹的能力。
AI.result: 训练后的储层定性再现了倍周期通向混沌的路径,准确捕捉周期与混沌吸引子的几何结构,能在周期和混沌区域重构时域轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 储层计算是实用非光滑车辆系统非线性动力学可行的数据驱动预测器,为智能驾驶应用提供了新的建模范式。

title: SALSA: Semi-Autonomous Literature Summarization Assistant
summary: SALSA (Semi-Autonomous Literature Summarization Assistant) is an open- source, human-in-the-loop platform for extracting structured scientific datasets from multimodal literature sources. The software combines document parsing, large language models, optical character recognition, computer vision, figure digitization, and user-guided correction tools to recover structured information from text, tables, figures, and captions. Users can configure extraction stages, define dataset schemas, perform interventions on digitized figures, and export verified data for downstream analysis and machine learning. SALSA is designed to automate repetitive literature curation tasks while preserving oversight where expert judgment is required. By supporting customizable extraction workflows across diverse input types, the software provides a flexible framework for scalable, reliable data curation for materials research, and potentially across several disciplines. Users are responsible for ensuring that all inputs, extraction workflows, and downstream uses comply with applicable publisher agreements, copyright and licensing terms, institutional policies, and data-use requirements.

AI.tldr: SALSA 是一个开源的、人机协同平台，用于从多模态文献中提取结构化科学数据集，集成了文档解析、大语言模型、OCR、计算机视觉、图表数字化和用户引导修正工具，支持可配置的提取工作流，实现文献整理任务的自动化同时保留专家判断环节。
AI.motivation: 解决从多模态科学文献（文本、表格、图表、图注）中高效、可靠地提取结构化数据的需求，减少重复性的文献整理工作，同时在需要专家判断的环节保留人工监督，为材料研究及其他学科提供可扩展、可定制的数据整理框架。
AI.method: 结合文档解析、大语言模型（LLM）、光学字符识别（OCR）、计算机视觉、图表数字化和用户引导修正工具；允许用户配置提取阶段、定义数据集模式、对数字化图表进行干预，并导出经验证的数据用于下游分析和机器学习。
AI.result: 构建了一个灵活、可扩展的开源平台 SALSA，能够自动化处理多模态文献并输出结构化数据集，已在材料研究中验证其可行性，并展示了跨学科应用的潜力。
AI.conclusion: SALSA 通过人机协同方式实现了文献数据提取的自动化与专家监督的平衡，为科学数据整理提供了一个可定制、可靠的开源框架，用户需自行确保输入、工作流及下游使用符合版权、许可及机构政策。

title: CraftBench-UE: Deterministic Evaluation for Coding Agents in Unreal Engine
summary: Building gameplay features in a game engine requires more than code, as code that compiles and runs does not necessarily implement the requested gameplay. We introduce CraftBenchUE, an evaluation harness that runs agents in an isolated Unreal Engine environment, reconstructs their saved submissions in fresh projects, and applies deterministic build, asset, and runtime checks without an LLM judge. Based on the harness, we built a benchmark consisting of 70 tasks spanning C++ source, Blueprint assets, and editor scripting. We evaluate seven models under two editor-tool configurations, with a file-and-shell baseline on C++ tasks. We further pair tasks that specify the same gameplay and use the same runtime tests, but require C++ and Blueprint as the deliverables. Across the 10 paired tasks, C++ completion rates exceed Blueprint by 30.0 and 42.9 percentage points in the two tool configurations. Among on-time Blueprint submissions in this paired set that pass asset checks, 42.2% and 50.0% fail explicit runtime assertions. These submissions satisfy asset requirements but fail the required gameplay tests. We will release the harness, task benchmark, and our trajectory findings with the report.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了CraftBenchUE评测框架，用于在隔离的Unreal Engine环境中评估AI代理完成游戏玩法开发任务的能力，包含70个涵盖C++、Blueprint和编辑器脚本的任务。评测显示C++任务完成率显著高于Blueprint任务，且大量通过资产检查的Blueprint提交在运行时测试中失败。
AI.motivation: 现有代码评测基准多关注编译通过率，但游戏引擎开发中代码编译通过不代表正确实现了游戏玩法逻辑。需要一种能在真实游戏引擎环境中进行确定性构建、资产和运行时检查的评测体系，且不依赖LLM裁判。
AI.method: 构建CraftBenchUE评测框架：在隔离的Unreal Engine环境中运行代理，重建其提交到新项目中，应用确定性的构建检查、资产检查和运行时检查。建立包含70个任务的基准，涵盖C++源码、Blueprint资产和编辑器脚本。评测7个模型在两种编辑器工具配置下的表现，并对比C++与Blueprint实现同一游戏玩法的配对任务。
AI.result: 在10个配对任务中，C++完成率比Blueprint高出30.0和42.9个百分点（两种工具配置）。通过资产检查的按时Blueprint提交中，42.2%和50.0%在显式运行时断言中失败，即满足资产要求但未通过游戏玩法测试。文件和Shell基线在C++任务上表现优于模型。
AI.conclusion: 游戏引擎开发评测需要超越代码编译的运行时验证。C++实现比Blueprint更可靠，且当前模型在Blueprint运行时正确性上存在显著差距。CraftBenchUE框架、任务基准和轨迹发现将开源发布，为游戏开发代理评测提供标准化工具。

title: The Effect of Quantization on Clinical Benchmarks: Accuracy and Safety Across Model Families
summary: Quantization enables deployment of large language models on resource-constrained clinical edge devices, but its effect on clinical accuracy and safety remains understudied. We evaluate five 7-8B parameter models at FP16, GPTQ-INT8, and GPTQ-INT4 precision across five benchmarks: MedQA, MedMCQA, Med-HALT, a risk-stratified sample of HealthBench, and MedSafetyBench. The study jointly varies quantization bit width, model family, and clinical task type, with explicit risk stratification and safety measures. INT8 GPTQ is universally safe (max. degradation -1.9%-1.9%), while INT4 degradation is substantial and model-dependent: BioMistral-7B, clinically fine-tuned, loses 19.7% on MedMCQA, more than any general-purpose model, showing clinical fine-tuning does not confer compression robustness. MedMCQA degrades more than MedQA under INT4; Med-HALT is largely unaffected. On HealthBench's emergency-risk subgroup, Qwen2.5-7B degrades by 26.8% under INT4, suggesting high-risk scenarios are disproportionately vulnerable to compression. On MedSafetyBench, the model family dominates over precision (refusal rates range 10.2%-74.9% at FP16), though Qwen2.5-7B (-17.8%) and Meditron-7B (-28.3%) show substantial INT4 safety degradation; notably, Qwen2.5-7B is simultaneously the most accuracy-robust model, demonstrating that accuracy and safety robustness are independent properties. We additionally test two recovery methods, clinical calibration substitution and QLoRA fine-tuning, both producing the same trade-off: MedMCQA recovers while MedQA further degrades, indicating recovery strategies require task-specific validation rather than being assumed universally beneficial. These findings indicate INT8 is broadly safe for clinical deployment, while INT4 safety must be assessed per-model and per-task, and that safety alignment is determined primarily by instruction tuning rather than clinical domain adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了量化对临床大语言模型准确性和安全性的影响，发现INT8量化普遍安全，而INT4量化导致显著且模型依赖的性能下降，且准确性鲁棒性与安全性鲁棒性相互独立。临床微调不赋予压缩鲁棒性，高风险场景对压缩更敏感，恢复策略需任务特定验证。安全对齐主要取决于指令微调而非临床领域适应。
AI.motivation: 量化虽能使大语言模型部署于资源受限的临床边缘设备，但其对临床准确性和安全性的影响研究不足。需要系统评估不同量化精度、模型家族和临床任务类型下的表现，并引入显式风险分层和安全度量。
AI.method: 评估五个7-8B参数模型在FP16、GPTQ-INT8、GPTQ-INT4三种精度下，跨五个基准测试的表现：MedQA、MedMCQA、Med-HALT、风险分层的HealthBench样本、MedSafetyBench。联合变量包括量化位宽、模型家族、临床任务类型，并显式进行风险分层和安全度量。
AI.result: INT8 GPTQ普遍安全（最大降级-1.9%至1.9%）；INT4降级显著且模型依赖：临床微调的BioMistral-7B在MedMCQA上损失19.7%，超过通用模型，表明临床微调不赋予压缩鲁棒性。MedMCQA在INT4下降级大于MedQA；Med-HALT基本不受影响。HealthBench急诊风险子组中Qwen2.5-7B INT4下降26.8%，高风险场景对压缩不成比例地脆弱。MedSafetyBench上模型家族主导拒答率（FP16下10.2%-74.9%），但Qwen2.5-7B（-17.8%）和Meditron-7B（-28.3%）INT4安全性显著下降；Qwen2.5-7B同时是最准确鲁棒的模型，证明准确性与安全性鲁棒性独立。两种恢复方法（临床校准替换和QLoRA微调）产生相同权衡：MedMCQA恢复但MedQA进一步下降，表明恢复策略需任务特定验证。
AI.conclusion: INT8量化广泛适用于临床部署；INT4安全性须按模型和任务单独评估；安全对齐主要由指令微调决定，而非临床领域适应。

title: A Channel-Boosted Multi-Agent System with Iterative Consultation for Document Sensitivity Classification
summary: Organizations in critical national infrastructure sectors must assess heterogeneous documents for sensitivity before routing or storage. Manual assessment is slow, inconsistent, and unscalable. Extending our prior leakage-controlled benchmark, BERT established the top single-encoder baseline (89.14% accuracy, 89.33% F1-score under 5-fold cross-validation on the Strategic 16K corpus). However, transformer baselines suffer from a structural limitation: fixed input length truncation discards evidence beyond the retained window-precisely where sensitive cables tend to be longest. We present Channel-Boosted MAS (CB-MAS) and instantiate it as IC-MAS (Iterative Consultation Multi-Agent System) to solve this without long-context computational costs. A Channel Critic Agent learns document-adaptive trust weights governing Gated Channel Boosting between two first-window encoders, while paired Consultation Agents iteratively exchange belief states to reconcile evidence from the beginning and end of long documents. IC-MAS holds computation constant regardless of document length by reconciling fixed windows in a compact representation space. Ablation studies show critic-controlled Channel Boosting provides the bulk of accuracy gains, while consultation recovers recall without precision collapse. Critic-Controlled Gated Channel Boosting with Max-Pool fusion and Blackboard Adaptive Consultation achieves 90.72% accuracy, 91.23% F1-score, 92.01% sensitive recall, and 90.46% sensitive precision, using about 54% less average computation than a fixed-round baseline. Gains over the single-encoder baseline are statistically significant (McNemar's test, p less than 0.000001; paired t-test). We include LIME/SHAP explainability, multi-agent evaluation, and an honest accounting of limitations.

AI.tldr: IC-MAS 通过多智能体系统解决长文档敏感性分类中固定窗口截断导致的信息丢失问题，在保持计算量恒定的情况下显著提升准确率和召回率。
AI.motivation: 关键基础设施领域需对异构文档进行敏感性评估，人工评估慢、不一致、难扩展；现有 Transformer 基线受限于固定输入长度截断，导致长文档末尾敏感信息丢失。
AI.method: 提出 Channel-Boosted MAS (CB-MAS) 并实例化为 IC-MAS：包含通道评论员智能体学习文档自适应信任权重，控制两个首窗编码器间的门控通道增强；配对咨询智能体迭代交换信念状态，协调文档首尾证据；在紧凑表示空间中协调固定窗口，使计算量与文档长度无关。
AI.result: 在 Strategic 16K 语料上，IC-MAS 达到 90.72% 准确率、91.23% F1、92.01% 敏感召回率、90.46% 敏感精确率，较单编码器基线显著提升 (p<0.000001)；平均计算量较固定轮次基线降低 54%；消融实验显示评论员控制的通道增强贡献主要增益，咨询机制恢复召回而不牺牲精确率。
AI.conclusion: IC-MAS 有效解决长文档敏感性分类中的截断问题，通过多智能体协作在恒定计算成本下实现性能显著提升，并提供可解释性分析和局限性讨论。

title: Do Not Trust the Benchmark: Limitations of General LLM Rankings and a Case for Task-Specific Evaluation
summary: Benchmark scores increasingly influence the development, marketing, and selection of large language models (LLMs). Yet an overall score is interpretable only in relation to the system tested, the questions included, and the conditions of evaluation. This perspective examines five connected limitations of general LLM rankings: differences between evaluated and publicly available systems; commercial incentives and dependencies in external evaluation; benchmark saturation, defective tests, and data contamination; models exploiting scoring procedures; and the limited relevance of general scores to users' tasks. Documented cases illustrate why these problems require different responses. I argue for evaluation procedures that disclose the tested configuration, validate questions and successful task completion, report performance alongside cost and execution time, and make the scope of generalization explicit. I then discuss \textbf{Isotanta}, a crowdsourced benchmarking platform, as a practical example of contributed questions and repeated evaluation. A larger question pool may improve task coverage, while repeated sampling can improve the stability of estimates on that pool; neither guarantees validity or personalization. The paper distinguishes the platform's current shared ranking from proposed task-specific and user-provided evaluations. Its central argument is that model selection requires evidence about performance on the intended work, not simply a high position on a general leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了通用大语言模型（LLM）排名的五大局限性，主张评估程序应披露测试配置、验证问题与任务完成情况、报告性能及成本执行时间，并明确泛化范围。以众包基准平台 Isotanta 为例，说明更大题库可提升任务覆盖、重复采样可提高估计稳定性，但两者均不保证效度或个性化。核心观点：模型选择需依据预期任务的性能证据，而非仅看通用排行榜排名。
AI.motivation: 基准分数日益影响 LLM 的开发、营销与选择，但总分仅在特定被测系统、包含问题及评估条件下可解释。现有通用排名存在五大关联问题：被评系统与公开系统的差异、外部评估中的商业激励与依赖、基准饱和/缺陷测试/数据污染、模型利用评分机制、通用分数与用户实际任务相关性有限。这些问题需差异化应对。
AI.method: 论文系统梳理通用 LLM 排名的五大局限，并提出改进评估程序的四项要求：披露测试配置、验证问题与任务完成、报告性能与成本执行时间、明确泛化范围。以 Isotanta 众包基准平台为实证案例，展示用户贡献问题与重复评估的机制，对比其现行共享排名与拟议的任务特定、用户提供评估的差异。
AI.result: 更大题库可改善任务覆盖，重复采样可提升估计稳定性，但两者均不保证效度或个性化。平台现行的共享排名与提出的任务特定、用户提供评估存在本质区别。文献记载案例表明，上述五大问题需不同层面的响应。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择应基于预期工作上的性能证据，而非通用排行榜的高位。评估程序必须公开被测配置、验证题目与任务完成质量、同时报告性能、成本与执行时间，并显式声明泛化适用范围。

title: UniGIO: Unified Generative Global In-situ Weather Modeling from Spatiotemporal Incomplete Observations
summary: Global In-situ Observation (GIO) provides fine-scale, direct records of the global weather system from sparse point stations, making it an indispensable source for capturing localized and transient dynamics beyond the reach of satellite gridded data, and playing a critical role in key fields such as numerical weather prediction, disaster prevention, and agriculture. However, GIO exhibits strong spatiotemporal incompleteness, severely impairing accurate and real-time in-situ weather modeling. Unlike existing methods waiting for completed AI-ready data with extra introduced errors, in this work, we explore UniGIO, a novel generative framework for directly modeling global in-situ weather dynamics from native incomplete GIO. By generating missing data from observed ones annotated by masks, it unifies the coexisting forecasting, imputation, and generation under arbitrary missing ratios. Between the missing and observed, UniGIO captures station and region level complementarity through the Observation Mixer and Event Aligner, which diffuse discrete observations into continuous spaces where weather processes naturally span multiple stations. We further establish temporal dependencies with pattern shifts using the Adaptive Temporal Mixer, and track extreme events in chaotic local weather systems through a Mixture-ofExperts structure. Steady and extreme events are adapted in decoder by a Local Refiner. Extensive experiments on the up-todate largest global station weather dataset Weather-5K validate its SOTA performance with 11%, 12%, and 5% advantages on accuracy, fidelity, and extreme event capture, delivering a novel holistic solution for weather modeling in GIO networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UniGIO，一种生成式框架，直接从原生不完整的全球原位观测（GIO）建模全球原位天气动态，统一预报、插补与生成任务，在 Weather-5K 数据集上达到 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 全球原位观测（GIO）提供细尺度、直接的全球天气记录，对数值天气预报、防灾减灾和农业至关重要，但存在强时空不完整性，严重损害准确实时原位天气建模。现有方法需等待额外引入误差的 AI-ready 完整数据。
AI.method: UniGIO 通过 Observation Mixer 和 Event Aligner 捕捉站点与区域互补性，将离散观测扩散至连续空间；Adaptive Temporal Mixer 建立带模式漂移的时序依赖；Mixture-of-Experts 结构追踪混沌局地天气中的极端事件；解码器引入 Local Refiner 自适应处理稳态与极端事件。
AI.result: 在目前最大全球站点天气数据集 Weather-5K 上验证，准确率、保真度、极端事件捕获分别提升 11%、12%、5%，达到 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: UniGIO 为 GIO 网络中的天气建模提供了一个新颖的整体解决方案，直接从不完整观测建模，统一预报、插补与生成。

title: SCoP: Structured Constraint Parsing for Evidence-Space Control in Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
summary: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) requires answer inference from evidence that is both structurally valid and temporally admissible. Existing methods often leave anchor-event binding, temporal admissibility, and ordinal selection implicit in model reasoning, task-specific training, or similarity-driven retrieval, allowing locally relevant but invalid facts to enter the answer context. We formulate complex TKGQA as evidence-space control and propose SCoP (Structured Constraint Parsing), a constraint-centric framework that externalizes temporal decisions before answer inference. Instead of treating retrieved facts as admissible evidence by default, SCoP separates answer-seeking event patterns from temporal anchor events, conservatively grounds them to canonical TKG entities and relations, and translates temporal intent into executable constraints with optional ranking requirements. These constraints operate over normalized point and interval ranges, enabling deterministic filtering of structurally compatible candidates and producing a compact evidence space for generation. Experiments on MultiTQ and TimelineCronQ-R assess SCoP across timestamped point-fact and interval-oriented settings with richer temporal relations and ordering dependencies. Without task-specific parameter updates, SCoP achieves 0.825 Hits@1 on MultiTQ and 0.761 Hits@1 on TimelineCronQ-R, with gains on constraint-intensive question types. These results support explicit evidence-space control over unconstrained retrieval or implicit temporal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCoP（结构化约束解析）框架，将时间知识图谱问答（TKGQA）建模为证据空间控制问题，通过显式分离锚点事件与答案事件、将时间意图转化为可执行约束，实现对结构兼容候选的确定性过滤，在MultiTQ和TimelineCronQ-R上无需任务特定微调即达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有TKGQA方法将锚点事件绑定、时间可接受性和序数选择隐式融入模型推理或检索，导致局部相关但无效的事实进入答案上下文，缺乏对时间约束的显式控制。
AI.method: SCoP框架包含三步：1) 分离答案寻求事件模式与时间锚点事件；2) 保守地将它们落地到规范TKG实体和关系；3) 将时间意图翻译为可执行约束（含可选排序要求），在归一化的时间点和区间范围上运行，对结构兼容候选进行确定性过滤，生成紧凑证据空间供生成模型使用。
AI.result: 在MultiTQ上达到0.825 Hits@1，在TimelineCronQ-R上达到0.761 Hits@1，均无需任务特定参数更新；在约束密集型问题类型上增益显著。
AI.conclusion: 实验支持显式证据空间控制优于无约束检索或隐式时间推理，SCoP展示了将时间决策外部化、约束驱动的TKGQA范式的有效性。

title: Expansion Counts under Standard A* Tie-Breaking Strategies on the Final Plateau
summary: In the A* search algorithm, the tie-breaking strategies for nodes with the same $f$-value determines which states A* expands on the final $f$-layer. For nine standard tie-breaking strategies, we show that under a consistent heuristic, every pair has positive-cost instances favoring each strategy over the other by an arbitrarily large additive expansion gap. A parameterized unit-cost grid example also gives unbounded expansion-count ratios between low-$h$ with FIFO and LIFO. In unit-cost search with $h > 0$ at non-goals, exact heuristic values near the goal lead to complementary extremal results: low-$h$ minimizes the number of remaining expansions from a common configuration within the perfect region, while high-$h$ maximizes the total number of expansions when every final-plateau state with $h=1$ is a goal predecessor. Finally, with the evaluation function $f_α = g + αh$, when $h>0$ at non-goals, every heuristic weight $0 \leq α<1$ eliminates tie-breaking sensitivity, and all tie-breaking strategies expand the same set of states.

AI.tldr: A* 搜索中，针对九种标准 tie-breaking 策略，在一致性启发式下，任意两种策略之间存在任意大的加性展开差距；在单位代价搜索中，low-h 和 high-h 分别最小化和最大化展开数；引入加权评价函数 f_α = g + αh (0≤α<1) 可完全消除 tie-breaking 敏感性，使所有策略展开相同状态集合。
AI.motivation: 研究 A* 搜索中相同 f 值节点的 tie-breaking 策略对展开节点集合的影响，揭示不同策略在理论上的性能差距，并探索如何消除这种敏感性。
AI.method: 理论分析与构造性证明：1) 证明九种标准 tie-breaking 策略两两之间存在任意大的加性展开差距；2) 构造参数化单位代价网格示例，展示 low-h FIFO 与 LIFO 之间无界的展开数量比；3) 分析单位代价搜索中精确启发式值在目标附近的影响；4) 引入加权评价函数 f_α = g + αh (0≤α<1)，证明其消除 tie-breaking 敏感性。
AI.result: 1) 任意两种 tie-breaking 策略均存在正代价实例，使其中一种比另一种多展开任意多的节点；2) low-h FIFO 与 LIFO 的展开数量比可无界；3) 在完美区域内，low-h 最小化剩余展开数，而当所有 h=1 的最终平台状态均为目标前驱时，high-h 最大化总展开数；4) 对于 0≤α<1，f_α 使所有 tie-breaking 策略展开完全相同的状态集合。
AI.conclusion: A* 的 tie-breaking 敏感性在理论上可导致任意大的性能差距，但在单位代价搜索中，启发式值的选择可优化展开效率；引入加权评价函数 f_α (α<1) 是消除 tie-breaking 敏感性的有效方法，保证了搜索行为的确定性。

title: Toollery: Scaling LLM Agents to Thousands of Skills and Tools
summary: As LLM agents are exposed to hundreds to tens of thousands of skills, tools, and API functions, full-library prompting becomes costly, slow, and less reliable: each added candidate increases prompt tokens and latency, while longer candidate lists introduce more distractors for LLM selection. We present \textbf{Toollery}, a training-free candidate-compression framework for scalable LLM skill/tool selection. Following established document-side query expansion, Toollery generates user-intent queries from each skill/tool specification and builds a retrieval index that maps real user requests to compact candidate sets before final LLM decision-making. By treating high-level skills and atomic tools as selectable capabilities, Toollery can be applied to both skill libraries and tool registries. We evaluate Toollery on the roughly 79K-capability SkillRouter benchmark, BFCL-V4 with over 440 atomic tools, and 3,396 proprietary smart-cockpit requests over 220 tools. Across these settings, Toollery keeps online selection bounded to a compact top-$k$ candidate set and improves recall over ordinary specification retrieval. At a fixed top-10 budget, Toollery improves end-to-end selection on the cockpit dataset, and maintains comparable AST Accuracy on BFCL-V4. These results support Toollery as a practical candidate-compression framework for large and evolving agent capability libraries, while showing that quality and cost gains depend on workload coverage and provider caching.

AI.tldr: Toollery 是一种无需训练的候选压缩框架，用于大规模 LLM 技能/工具选择。它通过从技能/工具规范生成用户意图查询并构建检索索引，将真实用户请求映射到紧凑的候选集合，再由 LLM 进行最终决策。在包含约 7.9 万能力的 SkillRouter、440+ 原子工具的 BFCL-V4 以及 3,396 个专有智能座舱请求（220 工具）上评估显示，Toollery 在固定 top-10 预算下提升了端到端选择性能，并在 BFCL-V4 上保持了相当的 AST 准确率。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 代理面临数百到数万个技能、工具和 API 函数，全库提示变得昂贵、缓慢且不可靠：每增加一个候选项都会增加提示 token 和延迟，而更长的候选列表会为 LLM 选择引入更多干扰项。因此需要一种可扩展的候选压缩方法来解决大规模能力库下的选择问题。
AI.method: Toollery 采用文档侧查询扩展策略：为每个技能/工具规范生成用户意图查询，构建检索索引，将真实用户请求映射到紧凑的候选集合（top-k），再由 LLM 进行最终决策。它将高层技能和原子工具均视为可选择能力，适用于技能库和工具注册表。该框架无需训练，依赖检索索引压缩候选空间。
AI.result: 在 SkillRouter（约 7.9 万能力）、BFCL-V4（440+ 原子工具）和 3,396 个智能座舱请求（220 工具）上评估。Toollery 将在线选择限制在紧凑的 top-k 候选集内，并提升了相对于普通规范检索的召回率。在固定 top-10 预算下，Toollery 在座舱数据集上提升了端到端选择性能，在 BFCL-V4 上保持了相当的 AST 准确率。质量和成本收益取决于工作负载覆盖率和提供商缓存。
AI.conclusion: Toollery 作为一种实用的候选压缩框架，适用于大规模且不断演进的代理能力库。它通过检索索引压缩候选空间，在保持选择质量的同时显著降低成本和延迟。结果表明，其性能增益依赖于工作负载覆盖率和提供商缓存机制，为大规模 LLM 工具/技能选择提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: The Bairong System for MLC-SLM 2026: Dynamic Question-Aware Evidence Routing for Multilingual Conversational Speech Understanding
comment: Accepted at the 2nd MLC-SLM Challenge and Workshop, INTERSPEECH 2026
summary: Long multilingual conversational spoken question answering requires systems to balance long-range transcript semantics with sparse acoustic and speaker-sensitive cues. We present the Bairong system for the MLC-SLM 2026 Challenge, where a diarization-ASR front-end produces speaker-attributed transcripts and a dynamic evidence router constructs question-specific inputs for answer prediction. Instead of applying a fixed transcript-only or audio-only policy, the router infers the required evidence type and context scope from the question and answer options, and selects among full transcript context, local audio-text fusion, speaker-linked evidence, and compact global acoustic samples. This transcript-backbone design keeps discourse context available while activating audio only when it provides complementary evidence. Our Task 1 system achieves 25.70% and 18.44% tcpMER on the development and evaluation sets. For Task 2, the final system obtains 94.84% devel?opment accuracy, outperforming the full-transcript baseline by 1.68 points and the best audio-centric diagnostic system by 2.77 points. These results support dynamic question-aware routing as an effective evidence allocation strategy for conversational spoken QA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Bairong系统用于MLC-SLM 2026挑战，采用说话人标注转写前端和动态证据路由器，根据问题动态选择证据类型（全文本、局部音文融合、说话人关联证据、紧凑全局声学样本），在任务1和任务2上均取得优异结果，验证了动态问题感知路由在会话语音问答中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 长多语言会话语音问答需要平衡长程转写语义与稀疏声学和说话人敏感线索，固定仅文本或仅音频策略无法充分利用多模态互补信息。
AI.method: 使用分割-ASR前端生成说话人标注转写；设计动态证据路由器，根据问题和选项推断所需证据类型和上下文范围，在全转写上下文、局部音文融合、说话人关联证据、紧凑全局声学样本中动态选择；采用转写骨干设计保持语篇上下文，仅在音频提供互补证据时激活音频。
AI.result: 任务1在开发集和评测集上分别达到25.70%和18.44% tcpMER；任务2开发集准确率94.84%，比全转写基线高1.68分，比最佳音频为中心诊断系统高2.77分。
AI.conclusion: 动态问题感知路由是会话语音问答中有效的证据分配策略，能在保持语篇上下文的同时按需激活音频证据，提升多模态推理性能。

title: TicTacBench: Benchmarking Timing Closure Capabilities of Coding Agents
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led to the emergence of coding agents capable of performing complex engineering tasks, including register-transfer level (RTL) design and optimization. Existing RTL benchmarks mainly evaluate functional correctness and performance, power, and area (PPA) of the generated RTL designs, leaving agents' ability for \emph{timing closure} under-evaluated. We propose TicTacBench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate coding agents' capabilities for RTL-level timing closure under post-place-and-route (post-PnR) evaluation. TicTacBench contains 30 diverse tasks, each provided with a suboptimal RTL design, realistic timing constraints, functional equivalence verification, and timing reports. With over 300 runs of coding agents driven by 8 frontier LLMs, we find that even the best agent can only close 53.3\% of tasks with 7.18\% area-delay product (ADP) degradation and 8.83\% energy-delay-squared product (EDDP) improvement on average. We identify common failure categories that explain why agents fail to close timing. Then we propose TicTacSkill, a new method that guides agents to follow standard timing-closure procedures and improves the Timing Closure Rate by 9\%. These results suggest that while coding agents have made significant progress in RTL design, their timing-closure capability still has substantial room for improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TicTacBench基准测试评估编码代理在后布局布线阶段的RTL时序收敛能力，并提出TicTacSkill方法引导代理遵循标准时序收敛流程，将时序收敛率提升9%。
AI.motivation: 现有RTL基准主要评估功能正确性和PPA（性能、功耗、面积），但对代理在后布局布线阶段进行时序收敛的能力评估不足。
AI.method: 构建包含30个多样化任务的TicTacBench基准，每个任务提供次优RTL设计、真实时序约束、功能等价验证和时序报告；使用8个前沿大语言模型进行300多次运行评估；提出TicTacSkill方法引导代理遵循标准时序收敛流程。
AI.result: 最佳代理仅能完成53.3%的任务时序收敛，平均面积延迟乘积(ADP)退化7.18%，能量延迟平方乘积(EDDP)改善8.83%；TicTacSkill将时序收敛率提升9%。
AI.conclusion: 尽管编码代理在RTL设计方面取得显著进展，但其时序收敛能力仍有巨大提升空间。

title: Measuring the Checker: Mutation Analysis for GPU-Kernel Benchmark Oracles
summary: Benchmarks for LLM-generated GPU kernels decide correctness with a few random inputs and a loose floating-point tolerance, and their verdicts now feed leaderboards and reinforcement-learning rewards. Recent work agrees these checkers are weak and patches them by hand---extra input distributions, fuzzing recipes, tighter tolerances---with no way to \emph{measure} whether any patch suffices. We introduce mutation analysis as an adequacy metric for kernel-benchmark oracles: deterministic rules inject 10{,}303 compilable faults into verified CUDA implementations of 188 KernelBench problems, 7{,}384 of them with an independent kill witness; any test protocol is scored by the fraction it detects. The official check misses \textbf{one in six} witnessed faults (16.9%), deterministically, and the misses are skewed by family: 8.7% of arithmetic faults escape, but 78.6% of precision faults do. The metric explains why (a tolerance blind band growing with reduction size; a measured ceiling on input aggressiveness set by legitimate floating-point variance), audits the strongest existing patch (KernelBench-Verified's gain splits into $+4.0$ points from hidden inputs and $+4.5$ from tighter tolerance, a split its authors could not compute), and exposes a published fuzzing recipe that rejects \emph{correct} kernels 107 times. Optimizing suites over the kill matrix reaches 98.0% detection with two inputs per problem (94.8% held-out), and the measurement's fault taxonomy teaches a test generator more than the raw faults themselves. Across 48 whole architectures, the blindness grows with scale, concentrating in deep homogeneous pipelines, and two problems prove unrefereeable: their official references violate the benchmark's own tolerance against fp64. We release everything as \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/Elfsong/KernelBench-M}{KernelBench-M}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出变异分析作为LLM生成GPU内核基准测试 oracle 的充分性度量，向188个KernelBench问题的已验证CUDA实现注入10,303个可编译故障，其中7,384个有独立杀灭见证。官方检查器确定性地漏掉16.9%见证故障，精度类故障漏检率高达78.6%。该度量解释了盲区成因，审计了最强补丁，揭露了拒绝正确内核的模糊测试配方，并展示仅需每题两个输入即可达98%检出率。发布KernelBench-M数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成GPU内核基准测试仅使用少量随机输入和宽松浮点容差判定正确性，这些弱检查器的结果却被用于排行榜和强化学习奖励。先前工作虽承认检查器薄弱并尝试手工修补（额外输入分布、模糊测试配方、收紧容差），但缺乏度量任何修补是否充分的方法。
AI.method: 引入变异分析作为oracle充分性度量：用确定性规则向188个KernelBench问题的已验证CUDA实现注入10,303个可编译故障，获得7,384个有独立杀灭见证的故障；以检测分数评分测试协议。分析漏检按故障家族分布，审计现有补丁，优化测试套件，跨48架构评估盲区随规模变化。
AI.result: 官方检查器漏检16.9%见证故障：算术故障漏检8.7%，精度故障漏检78.6%。发现容差盲带随归约规模增长、输入激进度受合法浮点方差上限约束。KernelBench-Verified增益分解为隐藏输入+4.0点、收紧容差+4.5点。某发布模糊测试配方拒绝正确内核107次。优化套件两输入达98.0%检出（留出94.8%）。故障分类法比原始故障更能指导测试生成。盲区随规模增长，集中于深度同质流水线；两题因官方参考违反自身fp64容差而不可裁决。
AI.conclusion: 变异分析提供了可量化、可复现的内核基准oracle充分性度量，揭示了现有检查器的系统性盲区及其随架构规模恶化的趋势，指导了高效测试套件构建与测试生成器改进。发布的KernelBench-M数据集为后续研究提供标准化评估基础设施。

title: On Mitigation of Subliminal Learning in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 9 figures, 12 tables
summary: Knowledge distillation can transmit unintended behavioral traits from a teacher model to a student through training data that appear semantically unrelated to those traits, a phenomenon known as subliminal learning. Although recent work has established this effect, its training dynamics and mitigation remain underexplored. We study subliminal learning in open-weight language models ranging from 1.5B to 8B parameters, covering the Qwen, Gemma, and Llama families in number-sequence and chain-of-thought settings. Rather than evaluating only final models, we track trait-related probabilities throughout fine-tuning and find that subliminal acquisition can be highly non-monotonic, with transient spikes, reversals, and trait-specific failures of transfer. We then introduce liminal training, an annealed KL-regularized fine-tuning method that constrains early drift from the base model. Across our experiments, liminal training substantially reduces subliminal trait acquisition while largely preserving task gains, outperforming paraphrasing and layer freezing as mitigation strategies. The effect also extends beyond animal preferences: in a French-language response-style experiment, liminal training suppresses language transfer while retaining much of the GSM8K improvement. Finally, we show that KL timing matters: early regularization is more effective than late regularization, and sweeping the regularization strength reveals an empirical trade-off between task learning and trait suppression.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了知识蒸馏中的“潜意识学习”现象，即教师模型通过语义无关的训练数据将非预期行为特征传递给学生模型。作者提出了“临界训练”方法，通过退火KL正则化约束早期偏移，有效抑制潜意识特征习得同时保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究已证实潜意识学习存在，但其训练动态和缓解策略仍未充分探索。本文旨在系统分析该现象在开放权重语言模型（1.5B-8B参数，Qwen/Gemma/Llama系列）中的表现，并开发有效的缓解方法。
AI.method: 1. 在数字序列和思维链设置中追踪微调过程中的特征相关概率动态；2. 提出liminal training（临界训练）：退火KL正则化微调，约束早期偏离基础模型；3. 对比paraphrasing和layer freezing等缓解策略；4. 在法语响应风格实验中验证泛化性；5. 分析KL正则化时机和强度的影响。
AI.result: 发现潜意识习得高度非单调，存在瞬时尖峰、逆转和特征特定的迁移失败。临界训练显著减少潜意识特征习得，基本保持任务增益，优于paraphrasing和layer freezing。在法语实验中抑制语言迁移同时保留GSM8K改进。早期正则化比晚期更有效，正则化强度存在任务学习与特征抑制的经验权衡。
AI.conclusion: 潜意识学习具有复杂的非单调训练动态，可通过退火KL正则化在早期约束模型偏移来有效缓解。临界训练提供了实用的权衡机制，在抑制非预期特征传递的同时保持下游任务性能，为安全可控的知识蒸馏提供了新思路。

title: Leaky-integrator reconstruction: taming error accumulation in recursive differenced time-series forecasting
summary: We introduce leaky-integrator reconstruction, a training-free method that cures the error accumulation of recursive differenced forecasting. Our first contribution is diagnostic: predicting one-step changes and integrating them by cumulative summation, the standard remedy for non-stationarity, is a discrete integrator with a pole on the unit circle, and we show this makes recursive rollout of a nonlinear model diverge, its 336-step error reaching several times that of a well-behaved forecaster (normalised MAE 1.6-3.8 versus about 0.8) across every neural architecture tested. Our second, central contribution is the fix: move the pole inside the unit circle with a leaky integrator H(z) = 1/(1 - gamma z^-1), gamma < 1, which provably bounds the accumulated error variance. Applied at reconstruction time with a single fixed gamma=0.9 (no retraining, a two-line change to any deployed one-step or foundation-model forecaster), it shrinks error at every horizon, the mean gain over seven diverging architectures and twenty datasets growing from ~3% at H=24 to 23% at H=96, 37% at H=192 and 51% (43-74% across those architectures) at H=336 (78% with an oracle pole). Crucially, it is provably inert where no pathology exists (stable or joint predictors already at the irreducible rate), making it a safe, general default.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种无需训练的'渗漏积分重构'方法，解决了递归差分预测中的误差累积问题。核心发现是标准累积求和相当于单位圆极点的离散积分器，导致非线性模型递归展开发散；通过引入渗漏积分器将极点移入单位圆内，理论上证明可界误差方差，在多架构、多数据集上显著降低长期预测误差，且在无病理情况下无害。
AI.motivation: 标准做法是预测一阶差分再累积求和以处理非平稳序列，但该累积求和是一个极点在单位圆上的离散积分器。作者诊断发现：当用非线性模型递归预测差分并累积时，极点在单位圆上会导致误差指数级累积，使得336步预测的归一化MAE达到1.6-3.8，远高于表现良好的预测器（约0.8），且在所有测试的神经网络架构中普遍存在。
AI.method: 提出渗漏积分重构：将重构时的累积求和替换为渗漏积分器 H(z) = 1/(1 - γ z⁻¹)，其中 γ < 1（固定 γ=0.9）。这将极点移入单位圆内，理论上证明可界住累积误差方差。该方法无需重新训练，仅在重构阶段修改两行代码即可应用于任何已部署的单步或基础模型预测器。
AI.result: 在7种发散架构和20个数据集上，渗漏积分器在各预测步长均降低误差：H=24时平均增益约3%，H=96时23%，H=192时37%，H=336时51%（各架构间43%-74%）；使用最优极点可达78%增益。关键是该方法在无病理情况下（稳定预测器或联合预测器已达不可约率）被证明是惰性的，不会损害性能，是一个安全的通用默认选项。
AI.conclusion: 渗漏积分重构是一种理论基础扎实、实用且免训练的修复方案，彻底解决了递归差分预测中的误差累积病理。通过将积分器极点移入单位圆内，它在长期预测中提供显著且稳健的误差降低，同时在正常情况下保持惰性，建议作为所有差分预测流程的默认重构策略。

title: Can Coding Agents Reproduce Official Statistics? Metadata, Retry Budget and the Limits of Execution Feedback in a Controlled Eurostat Benchmark
summary: Large language models can generate executable data-analysis code, but successful execution is not equivalent to a valid official-statistics result. This study asks whether authoritative metadata and execution feedback improve the reproducibility of Eurostat answers produced by a coding agent, and isolates what execution feedback actually contributes. A benchmark of 30 natural-language tasks covering seven domains, seven Eurostat datasets and four difficulty tiers was run under four conditions: task only (A), task plus a frozen dataset metadata card (B), metadata plus a repair loop driven by sanitized execution feedback (C), and metadata plus the same attempt budget with no diagnostics of any kind (D). Claude Sonnet 5 generated Python through the Anthropic Messages API in three independent replicates, yielding 360 task-runs. Exact correctness required successful execution, the correct dataset, filters, output shape, values and unit. A companion experiment run under an under-specified output contract, in which the required ranking key and unit representation were never stated to the model, understated condition C by 23.4 points, showing that evaluator and contract design can dominate measured agent error. Reliable statistical coding agents need semantic validation against frozen specifications, a fully specified output contract, and a retry budget - not execution diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估权威元数据和执行反馈对编码代理生成 Eurostat 官方统计答案可复现性的影响，发现语义验证、完整输出契约和重试预算比执行诊断更关键。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽能生成可执行的数据分析代码，但执行成功不等于有效的官方统计结果；需要探究权威元数据和执行反馈是否能提升编码代理对 Eurostat 任务的可复现性，并分离执行反馈的实际贡献。
AI.method: 构建包含 30 个自然语言任务（涵盖 7 领域、7 个 Eurostat 数据集、4 难度层级）的基准，在四种条件下运行：A（仅任务）、B（任务+冻结数据集元数据卡）、C（元数据+基于清洗执行反馈的修复循环）、D（元数据+相同尝试预算但无任何诊断）。使用 Claude Sonnet 5 通过 Anthropic Messages API 生成 Python 代码，三次独立复现，共 360 次任务运行。严格正确性要求执行成功、数据集正确、过滤器正确、输出形状、数值和单位均正确。另设伴随实验，在未指定排名键和单位表示的欠规范输出契约下测试。
AI.result: 条件 C 在完整契约下表现最佳，但在欠规范契约下被低估 23.4 分，表明评估器和契约设计能主导测量到的代理误差。执行反馈的贡献被分离，发现其不如语义验证和完整契约关键。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的统计编码代理需要针对冻结规范的语义验证、完全指定的输出契约和重试预算，而非执行诊断。

title: Knowing, and Saying It Only When Asked: LLM Endognostics and the Schizognosis of Minerva-7B
comment: 32 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Appendices A-E and full human evaluation datasets included
summary: Evaluating an aligned language model by reading its answers assumes the answers carry the distinction the evaluator cares about. We introduce LLM endognostics, a white-box internal auditing framework designed to extract and causally manipulate latent knowledge within the residual stream. Applied to Minerva-7B-Instruct-v1.0 on 124 minimal prompt pairs over 12 categories of professional risk, behavioral evaluation fails on most of the set: the model acts identically on 63.7% of the pairs (95% CI [55.0%, 71.6%]), complying with or refusing both members. Yet, projecting the residual stream onto the vocabulary by a Jacobian lens reveals a statistically significant Contrastive Endognostic Margin, proving the model maintains robust risk differentiation internally. In a second protocol crossing 25 facts with five linguistic framings, we show that the model conforms to presupposed falsehoods in 72% of cases, despite representing the true entity in its latent layers. Surgically ablating the direction of the planted falsehood restores the correct answer in 11 of 25 suppressed cases (McNemar p = 0.0010), validated by blind human annotation (binary agreement kappa = 0.68). In contrast, an out-of-sample linear probe achieves 77% accuracy at layer 10, but its orthogonal ablation yields a 0% recovery rate. This establishes a fundamental theoretical dissociation: abstract linear representation does not imply causal control over verbalization. Our main contribution is the formalization of endognostics to prove that behavioral evaluation and internal reading systematically disagree in the common case, and that linear decodability is decoupled from causal control.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LLM 内部诊断框架，证明行为评估与内部表征系统性分歧，且线性可解码性不等于因果控制。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐语言模型的评估依赖行为输出，假设答案承载评估者关心的区分度。但模型可能内部表征风险/知识却行为上不表现，需要白盒方法审计潜在知识并因果干预。
AI.method: 引入端诊术，通过雅可比透镜将残差流投影到词表，提取对比端诊边际；设计两个协议：1) 124 个最小提示对 × 12 类专业风险，对比行为与内部表征；2) 25 个事实 × 5 种语言框架，植入虚假前提，手术式消融虚假方向并对比线性探针消融。
AI.result: 行为评估在 63.7% 提示对上失效（模型同废/同拒），但内部存在显著对比端诊边际；模型 72% 情况顺从虚假前提，消融虚假方向恢复 11/25 正确答案（p=0.0010），盲注 kappa=0.68；线性探针层 10 准确率 77% 但正交消融 0% 恢复，证明线性可解码性与因果控制根本解耦。
AI.conclusion: 形式化端诊术证明：行为评估与内部读取在常见情况下系统性分歧；抽象线性表征不蕴含对口语化的因果控制，揭示对齐评估的根本理论鸿沟。

title: AgentBetta: Verification-Driven Adaptive Configuration of an AI Nano-Agent through Selective Expansion and Verified Contraction
summary: Large language model agents are typically deployed with predefined configurations, although the required model capability, context, tools, permissions, memory, and computational resources can vary substantially across tasks. This study develops and evaluates AgentBetta, an adaptive AI Nano-Agent framework that represents these factors as an executable configuration and updates them through verification-driven diagnosis, selective expansion, and verification-based counterfactual contraction. The evaluation distinguishes controlled mechanism validation from external agent comparisons. On the AB-ConfigBench benchmark, AgentBetta achieved 91.38% verified success while reducing median context allocation from 64,000 to 8,000 context characters and median tool exposure from five tools to zero compared with the fully provisioned configuration. The configuration-deficiency diagnosis achieved a macro-F1 score of 0.819 with precision of 1.000 across the evaluated dimensions, and selective expansion avoided unnecessary changes to unrelated configuration dimensions. Post-success contraction preserved verification outcomes in 56.41% of evaluated one-dimension contraction probes, indicating that some successful configurations contained removable capability under the tested conditions. External evaluations indicate that adaptive configuration can improve the balance between verified task completion and capability exposure; however, the results vary across benchmarks and agent families. In particular, the cross-family replication did not reproduce the primary-backbone accuracy ordering, and specialized systems remained advantageous for certain task domains. These results support interpreting AgentBetta as a configuration-adaptation mechanism that regulates capability allocation and inference expenditure rather than as a universal replacement for specialized agent architectures.

AI.tldr: AgentBetta是一个自适应AI纳米智能体框架，通过可执行配置动态调整模型能力、上下文、工具、权限、内存和计算资源。在AB-ConfigBench基准测试中，它实现了91.38%的验证成功率，同时将中位数上下文分配从64,000字符降至8,000，工具暴露从5个降至0个。配置缺陷诊断达到0.819的macro-F1分数和1.000的精确率。收缩实验显示56.41%的成功配置包含可移除的冗余能力。外部评估表明自适应配置能改善任务完成与能力暴露的平衡，但效果因基准和智能体家族而异，无法完全替代专用架构。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体通常采用预定义的固定配置部署，但不同任务对模型能力、上下文长度、工具集、权限、内存和计算资源的需求差异巨大。固定配置导致资源浪费、安全风险（过度暴露工具/权限）和性能次优。需要一种能够根据任务需求动态调整配置的自适应机制。
AI.method: AgentBetta框架将配置因素表示为可执行配置，通过三阶段机制动态更新：1) 验证驱动诊断：识别配置缺陷维度；2) 选择性扩展：仅扩展必要的配置维度，避免无关变更；3) 基于验证的反事实收缩：在成功后尝试收缩各维度，移除冗余能力同时保持验证结果。
AI.result: AB-ConfigBench结果：91.38%验证成功率；中位数上下文从64K降至8K字符（-87.5%）；中位数工具暴露从5降至0（-100%）。配置诊断macro-F1=0.819，精确率=1.000。选择性扩展避免了无关维度变更。收缩探测中56.41%保持验证通过，揭示配置冗余。外部评估显示自适应配置改善完成率与暴露的平衡，但跨家族复现失败，专用系统在特定领域仍具优势。
AI.conclusion: AgentBetta应被理解为一种配置自适应机制，用于调节能力分配和推理开销，而非通用的专用智能体架构替代品。自适应配置在资源效率和安全性上显著优于固定配置，但专用架构在特定任务领域仍保持优势，未来工作应探索混合范式。

title: A Synthetic Multivariate Refrigerator Time-Series Dataset for Predictive Maintenance
summary: We generated synthetic multivariate time series for 27 refrigerators with a simplified physicsinspired simulator at one-minute resolution. The simulator includes ambient-temperature variation, door use, thermostat and compressor operation, heat exchange, defrost, electrical consumption, and six progressive degradation types. Each refrigerator provides 15 to 20 sensor outputs according to its configuration. The dataset contains 7,066,161 rows in 27 time-series files and 27 failure logs. The release also includes the Python generator, refrigerator configurations, and documentation. The data can support failure prediction, degradation analysis, and learning across refrigerators with different sensor-output sets.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了一个基于简化物理启发模拟器生成的27台冰箱的合成多变量时间序列数据集，包含700多万行数据，支持故障预测、退化分析和跨冰箱学习。
AI.motivation: 动机是解决真实冰箱退化故障数据稀缺的问题，为预测性维护研究提供标准化的合成数据集基准。
AI.method: 方法是使用简化的物理启发模拟器，以1分钟分辨率建模环境温度变化、开门使用、恒温器和压缩机运行、热交换、除霜、电力消耗及六种渐进退化类型，生成27台不同配置冰箱的15-20个传感器输出。
AI.result: 结果是生成了包含7,066,161行数据的27个时间序列文件和27个故障日志，并随附Python生成器、冰箱配置和文档。
AI.conclusion: 结论是该数据集可支持故障预测、退化分析以及不同传感器配置冰箱间的跨域学习研究。

title: Team DArgk at the 2026 ELOQUENT lab for evaluating generative language model quality: Residuals of Humanity: AI Detection Evasion via GRPO Fine-Tuning
comment: Accepted for Working Notes of the Conference and Labs of the Evaluation Forum (CLEF 2026)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent and coherent text that is increasingly difficult to distinguish from human writing, motivating the development of automatic AI-generated text detectors. However, the robustness of such detectors under adversarial generation remains uncertain. This paper presents SHADE (Stochastic Human-like generation via Adversarial Detector Evasion), a reinforcement learning framework that formulates detector evasion as a policy optimization problem. Instead of applying post-hoc perturbations or prompting-based rewriting, SHADE fine-tunes an instruction-tuned LLaMA model with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), using feedback from a surrogate detector based on the PAN 2025 mdok system. Our experiments show that full fine-tuning with a small KL regularization penalty achieves $98.5\%$ surrogate evasion, compared to $1.5\%$ for the base model, while LoRA-based adaptation is substantially less effective under regularization. Linguistic analysis reveals that successful evasion is associated with shorter, simpler, and less lexically diverse outputs, suggesting that high detector evasion does not necessarily correspond to more human-like writing. In the official Voight-Kampff competition setting, our submissions ranked sixth and seventh, indicating that optimization against a single surrogate detector only partially transfers to unseen evaluation classifiers. These results highlight both the potential and limitations of reinforcement learning for adversarial AI-text generation and motivate more robust, multi-detector evaluation protocols for AI-generated text detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SHADE 框架，利用强化学习（GRPO）微调 LLaMA 模型以规避 AI 生成文本检测器。实验显示全量微调配合小 KL 正则可实现 98.5% 代理检测器规避率，但 LoRA 适配效果显著较差；规避成功的文本更短、更简单、词汇多样性更低，并不更接近人类写作。在官方 Voight-Kampff 竞赛中仅获第 6、7 名，揭示了针对单一代理检测器优化对未见分类器的迁移能力有限，呼吁建立更鲁棒的多检测器评估协议。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的文本日益难以与人类写作区分，推动了自动 AI 文本检测器的发展，但这类检测器在对抗性生成下的鲁棒性尚不明确。作者旨在探索通过强化学习直接优化生成策略以规避检测器，而非事后扰动或提示词重写，并评估这种对抗性生成的语言特征及其对未见检测器的迁移性。
AI.method: 提出 SHADE（Stochastic Human-like generation via Adversarial Detector Evasion）框架，将检测器规避建模为策略优化问题。基于指令微调的 LLaMA 模型，采用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 进行全量微调，以 PAN 2025 mdok 系统为代理检测器提供奖励信号，并引入小的 KL 散度正则项约束策略偏离。对比了 LoRA 参数高效微调与全量微调的效果，并对生成文本进行语言学分析（长度、复杂度、词汇多样性等）。
AI.result: 全量微调配合小 KL 正则在代理检测器上达到 98.5% 规避率（基座模型仅 1.5%）；LoRA 适配在正则约束下效果大幅下降。语言学分析显示，成功规避的输出更短、句法更简单、词汇多样性更低，表明高规避率不等同于更拟人化的写作。在 Voight-Kampff 竞赛官方评测中，提交系统排名第 6 和第 7，说明针对单一代理检测器的优化仅能部分迁移至未见评估分类器。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习可有效优化生成策略以规避特定 AI 文本检测器，但存在两大局限：一是规避成功伴随文本质量下降（更简单、多样性更低），二是对抗性迁移能力有限，单一代理检测器优化难以泛化到未知检测器。未来需建立更鲁棒的多检测器评估协议，并探索在保持文本质量的前提下实现广泛规避的方法。

title: Are Human-Aligned Models Models of Humans? A Turing-Test Gap in Preference Alignment
summary: Human-feedback alignment has made language models useful assistants and is commonly described as aligning them with humans. However, the responses people prefer from an AI need not be the responses they themselves would give. We distinguish alignment with human preferences from alignment with human behavior, and show that alignment with human preferences can make model behavior less human-like even when both preferences and responses come entirely from humans. We call this the Turing-test gap. We show that preference alignment preserves the human response distribution only under a restrictive condition, and find no consistent evidence that real human preferences satisfy it. Empirically, the loss of human-response likelihood increases with the strength of preference weighting, regardless of its direction, and the gap also appears under standard DPO. These results establish human-likeness as an explicit dimension of alignment rather than something assumed to follow from preference alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文指出人类偏好对齐与人类行为对齐存在根本差异，提出了“图灵测试鸿沟”概念：即使偏好和响应均来自人类，偏好对齐也会使模型行为变得不那么像人类。实验表明，偏好权重强度越强，人类响应似然损失越大，且标准DPO也存在此鸿沟，证明类人性是对齐的显性维度而非偏好对齐的自然结果。
