Our results indicate that probabilistic LLM judgments inherit the full fragility of the information supply chain they consume.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了大语言模型（LLM）在基于新闻语料库的检索增强预测中面临的新型攻击面：对手只需发布文章即可系统性地操纵预测器的输出概率，无需访问检索器、模型或用户查询。实验表明，单篇LLM生成的文章即可使56%的预测翻转，五篇文章使翻转率达69-73%，并显著降低Brier分数。三种自然防御均存在低成本绕过手段，说明概率性LLM判断完全继承了其所依赖的信息供应链的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型越来越多地用于通过检索和推理新闻来预测现实事件，其对开放、可爬取新闻语料库的依赖创造了新的攻击面。以往的RAG投毒攻击主要针对事实性回答或观点极性，而本文关注对校准概率的攻击，形式化了新闻语料库投毒针对概率预测器的威胁模型。
AI.method: 在500个已解决的ForecastBench问题上，使用1740万篇Common Crawl新闻语料库（严格爬取日期截止）和三个基于开源7-8B模型的检索增强预测器进行评估。攻击者为每个问题注入1-5篇LLM生成的文章，测量预测翻转率、概率偏移量和Brier分数变化。同时评估三种防御：来源允许列表、隔离后聚合预测、困惑度过滤，并测试其绕过方法。
AI.result: 单篇注入文章使56%预测跨越0.5边界翻转；五篇文章使翻转率达69-73%，净概率偏移+0.13至+0.22，Brier分数从0.18恶化至0.37。攻击效果随注入文章数量、检索排名、查询相似度、上下文占比单调增强，跨模型家族迁移，不受声称发布者影响。三种防御均有低成本绕过：伪造发布者、多数派投毒、高温度生成。
AI.conclusion: 概率性LLM判断完全继承了其所消费的信息供应链的脆弱性。开放新闻语料库的投毒攻击对检索增强预测器构成严重威胁，现有自然防御措施均无法有效抵御，需从根本上重新思考信息供应链的可信度保障。

title: LEAP-NBV: Lightweight Edge Active-Perception for Foundation-Model Next-Best-View Planning
summary: Foundation models are endowing autonomous systems with greater intelligence, enabling a more comprehensive understanding of the environment through visual perception. A representative example is Human Mesh Recovery (HMR), which provides useful estimates of a target's 3D pose and shape that can benefit tactical missions. However, the size and power demands of such models make them difficult to run on edge platforms and limit their real-time performance, undermining the requirements of tactical edge deployment - especially for active perception, where a mobile robot must plan its next-best view on-board and cannot offload computation under contested communications. We present LEAP-NBV, a lightweight active-perception framework that runs foundation-model-driven Next-Best-View (NBV) planning on-board an edge device. To this end, we distill a family of large HMR teachers, each into a compact 32M student, with an offline mesh objective, then quantize the vision encoder to FP16 and characterize its on-device accuracy and latency. Within an occlusion-aware active perception loop, we evaluate all configurations on the same held-out benchmark and deploy the end-to-end pipeline on an NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX, reporting measured on-device latency and energy. Distillation recovers 6-7 mm of Procrustes-aligned mean per-vertex position error (PA-MPVPE) over the undistilled student on the test set. Selecting the edge-optimal compression model brings the HMR engine to ~12 ms at a small accuracy cost and runs the full closed loop at 3.6 FPS and 2.6 J per frame, achieving a 2.0x speedup and 3.0x lower energy than the uncompressed model while nearly matching downstream task quality.

AI.tldr: LEAP-NBV是一个轻量级主动感知框架，通过知识蒸馏将大型HMR教师模型压缩为32M学生模型，并量化视觉编码器至FP16，实现了在边缘设备（Jetson Xavier NX）上运行闭环主动感知，达到3.6 FPS和2.6 J/帧，速度提升2.0x，能耗降低3.0x。
AI.motivation: 基础模型虽赋予自主系统更强智能，但体积大、功耗高，难以在边缘平台实时运行，尤其不适合主动感知场景（需在机器人上规划下一最佳视角，无法在受限通信下卸载计算）。
AI.method: 1) 离线网格目标蒸馏系列大型HMR教师为紧凑32M学生；2) 将视觉编码器量化为FP16；3) 在遮挡感知主动感知闭环中评估所有配置；4) 在NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX上部署端到端流水线，测量设备上延迟和能耗。
AI.result: 蒸馏在测试集上恢复了6-7mm的PA-MPVPE；边缘最优压缩模型使HMR引擎达~12ms（微小精度损失），全闭环以3.6 FPS和2.6 J/帧运行，比未压缩模型快2.0倍、能耗低3.0倍，下游任务质量几乎无损。
AI.conclusion: LEAP-NBV证明了通过模型蒸馏和量化，可将大型基础模型驱动的主动感知部署到资源受限边缘设备，实现实时、低能耗的闭环性能，满足战术边缘部署需求。

title: RS-Claw-Evolution: Environment-Feedback-Driven Evolution for Lightweight Remote Sensing Agents in Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Large language model-driven remote sensing (RS) agents offer a promising approach to automating geospatial analysis. However, lightweight RS agents based on compact language models struggle with multi-step interactive tasks due to loss of long-horizon states, inefficient environmental feedback utilization, and sparse optimization signals. We propose RS-Claw-Evolution, an environment-feedback-driven framework that progressively improves lightweight agents through three stages. Interaction evolution uses executable code to control observations, maintain intermediate states, and reduce context redundancy. Experience evolution combines failure-aware trajectory generation with error-turn masking to learn from informative failure-recovery experiences without imitating faulty actions. Decision evolution uses reinforcement learning with multi-dimensional environment rewards and turn-level advantage protection to optimize tool-use behaviors and improve credit assignment in long sequences. On Earth-Bench, the optimized Qwen3-4B-based agent achieves 65.9% accuracy in Autonomous Planning mode, outperforming the untrained Qwen3-32B baseline (43.8%) and DeepSeek-V3.1 (60.8%), while approaching GPT-5 (71.6%). These results demonstrate that learning from environmental feedback can improve lightweight agents and narrow their performance gap with larger models in long-horizon RS tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RS-Claw-Evolution框架，通过交互进化、经验进化和决策进化三阶段，利用环境反馈提升轻量级遥感智能体在长时程任务中的表现，使Qwen3-4B智能体在Earth-Bench上达到65.9%准确率，超越更大规模的未训练基线模型并接近GPT-5水平。
AI.motivation: 现有基于紧凑语言模型的轻量级遥感智能体在多步交互任务中面临长时程状态丢失、环境反馈利用效率低、优化信号稀疏等挑战，限制了其在复杂地理空间分析中的应用潜力。
AI.method: 提出三阶段进化框架：1)交互进化：利用可执行代码控制观测、维护中间状态、减少上下文冗余；2)经验进化：结合失败感知轨迹生成与错误轮次掩码，从失败恢复经验中学习而不模仿错误动作；3)决策进化：采用多维环境奖励的强化学习与轮次级优势保护，优化工具使用行为并改善长序列中的信用分配。
AI.result: 在Earth-Bench基准测试中，优化后的Qwen3-4B智能体在自主规划模式下达到65.9%准确率，显著优于未训练的Qwen3-32B基线(43.8%)和DeepSeek-V3.1(60.8%)，且逼近GPT-5(71.6%)的性能。
AI.conclusion: 环境反馈驱动的学习能有效提升轻量级遥感智能体性能，缩小其与大规模模型在长时程遥感任务中的性能差距，验证了通过结构化反馈机制实现小模型大性能的可行性。

title: Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory for Efficient AI Agents
summary: Agentic memory is becoming essential for long-horizon AI agents, yet many existing systems rely on autoregressive LLMs to control how memories are organized, retrieved, and used, placing expensive generation on the critical path of memory operations. We introduce \textbf{\method}, a new agentic memory architecture inspired by System-One/System-Two cognition. System One captures fast, lightweight decision-making, whereas System Two performs slower, deliberative reasoning. Jev-Mem brings this division of labor to agentic memory through a dedicated System-One control plane, a structured multi-relational memory plane, and a System-Two reasoning plane. The System-One controller governs memory typing and relational organization during construction, and dynamically performs query routing, retrieval-budget allocation, graph traversal, candidate scoring, and adaptive stopping during retrieval. System Two is invoked only for complex reasoning and answer synthesis. This design improves both memory effectiveness and system efficiency: on LoCoMo Jev-Mem achieves an overall LLM-as-a-Judge score of 0.777, an 11.0\% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, while reducing memory construction time to 158\,s, a 6.6$\times$ speedup over the fastest competing memory system, and lowering average query latency to 0.93\,s, a 36.7\% reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Jev-Mem，一种受System-1/System-2认知启发的智能体记忆架构，通过快速轻量的System-1控制平面管理记忆构建与检索，仅在复杂推理时调用System-2，显著提升记忆效果与系统效率。在LoCoMo基准上，Jev-Mem以0.777的LLM-as-a-Judge得分超越最强基线11.0%，构建耗时158秒（快6.6倍），查询延迟0.93秒（降36.7%）。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统依赖自回归LLM控制记忆组织、检索与使用，导致昂贵的生成过程位于记忆操作的关键路径上，限制了长时程智能体的效率与扩展性。
AI.method: Jev-Mem包含三大平面：(1) System-1控制平面：快速轻量决策，负责记忆构建时的类型划分与关系组织，检索时动态执行查询路由、检索预算分配、图遍历、候选评分与自适应停止；(2) 结构化多关系记忆平面：存储带类型与关系的记忆图；(3) System-2推理平面：仅在复杂推理与答案合成时调用。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准上，Jev-Mem总体LLM-as-a-Judge得分0.777，比最强基线相对提升11.0%；记忆构建耗时158秒，较最快竞品加速6.6倍；平均查询延迟0.93秒，降低36.7%。
AI.conclusion: Jev-Mem通过System-1/System-2分工，将昂贵的LLM推理移出记忆操作关键路径，同时保持高质量检索与推理，实现了记忆有效性与系统效率的双重提升。

title: Resist, Update, Reject: Preference Optimization Installs a Prior-Dependent Reliability Switch
summary: An aligned model asked to hold its answer against a manipulative source must still update on a reliable one and reject an unreliable one: resistance, reliable-update, and unreliable-source rejection are one three-way contract, not three independent behaviors. We show the objective most anti-sycophancy work optimizes is non-identifying with respect to source reliability: because no preference label depends on whether a source is actually reliable, any scalar mixture of the arms traces a single deference dial, and no point separates two same-template testimonies differing only in stated reliability. This fixation$\leftrightarrow$gullibility frontier is a property of the objective, not any model. We make reliability identifiable through data: a threshold benchmark where a source asserts the opposite answer while stating its reliability $r$, and the correct action is to flip iff $r$ exceeds the model's prior strength $p$. Preference optimization over balanced coverage installs a prior-dependent reliability switch: across three seeds on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct the threshold $r^\star$ rises monotonically with the prior, decision accuracy reaches $0.84$ with a monotone flip curve (Spearman $0.56$), and the policy generalizes to unseen reliability values and a held-out notation, following stated reliability over role prestige. Three controls localize the cause: an unmatched variant installs the switch equally ($0.80$), a second preference optimizer (IPO) installs it just as well ($0.86$), whereas supervised imitation does not ($0.50$), so the cause is preference optimization over reliability-labeled coverage, not pairing, loss, or imitation. A confirmatory battery replicates the switch on a fresh test draw, bounds it honestly (it keys on reliability stated in the testimony, not a separately audited record), and transfers it to Llama-3.1-8B. The frontier is empirical, not a theorem.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出现有反阿谀奉承（anti-sycophancy）目标在源可靠性方面不可识别，导致模型只能在完全顺从与完全抗拒之间单一调节。作者提出通过带有可靠性标签的数据进行偏好优化，成功在模型中植入依赖先验的可靠性开关，使模型能根据陈述的可靠性阈值决定是否翻转答案，并泛化到未见可靠性值和符号系统。
AI.motivation: 现有反阿谀奉承工作优化的目标函数不依赖源的实际可靠性，导致无法区分可靠与不可靠来源，形成'固执↔轻信'边界。论文旨在使可靠性可识别，让模型同时具备抗拒操纵、更新可靠来源、拒绝不可靠来源三种行为。
AI.method: 构建阈值基准：来源陈述相反答案并声明可靠性 r，正确行为是当 r 超过模型先验强度 p 时翻转。在均衡覆盖的可靠性标签数据上进行偏好优化（DPO/IPO），植入依赖先验的可靠性开关。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上（三个种子），阈值 r* 随先验单调上升，决策准确率达 0.84，翻转曲线单调（Spearman 0.56），泛化至未见可靠性值和保留符号，遵循陈述可靠性而非角色声望。消融实验：非配对变体同等有效（0.80），IPO 同样有效（0.86），监督模仿失效（0.50），确认原因是带可靠性标签覆盖的偏好优化。确证实验在新测试集复现，诚实界定开关依赖证词中陈述的可靠性，并迁移至 Llama-3.1-8B。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性可识别性源于带可靠性标签覆盖的偏好优化目标，而非配对、损失函数或模仿学习。该'边界'是实验发现而非理论定理。

title: A Tutorial on Prompt Engineering: From Messy Thoughts to AI Workflows
summary: This paper treats prompt engineering as a discipline for turning informal human intent into structured AI work specifications. It develops the practice as a sequence of reusable design moves: define the work, construct only the context the answer depends on, choose a role, or a moderated panel of roles, as an attention lens, and state affirmative quality targets, reserving prohibitions for hard boundaries. To keep prompts lean, it adapts two classical principles, Occam's razor and Chekhov's gun, so that every instruction earns its place. For consequential tasks, it adds structured critique through steelmanning and premortems, followed by verification and, where tools or multi-step actions are involved, agentic operating loops with explicit boundaries and escalation. Aimed at a general readership, this tutorial is not a benchmarking study; it offers a practical, technically grounded path from casual prompting to disciplined AI workflow design, illustrated by a worked example that carries one task from a weak prompt to a strong specification. The framework is presented as principles and checklists that remain useful as models and tools change. The strongest prompt is rarely the longest prompt; it is the one that makes desired behaviour, required sources and checks, and success criteria unmistakable.

AI.tldr: 该论文将提示工程定义为一种将非正式人类意图转化为结构化AI工作规范的学科，提出了一套可复用的设计动作序列（定义工作、构建最小必要上下文、选择角色/专家组、设定肯定性质量目标），并引入奥卡姆剃刀与契诃夫之枪原则保持提示精简，针对关键任务增加钢人论证与事前复盘等结构化评审，最后通过验证与有边界的智能体操作循环落地。
AI.motivation: 当前提示工程多停留在经验性试错阶段，缺乏系统性、可迁移的方法论；作者旨在为广大读者提供一套技术落地、不随模型迭代失效的原则与检查清单，实现从随意提示到纪律化AI工作流设计的跨越。
AI.method: 1. 将提示工程拆解为四步可复用设计动作：定义工作、最小上下文构建、角色/专家组选择、肯定性质量目标设定。2. 引入奥卡姆剃刀与契诃夫之枪两大经典原则剔除冗余指令。3. 对高风险任务叠加钢人论证与事前复盘结构化评审。4. 引入验证机制与带显式边界/升级路径的智能体操作循环。5. 以一个完整工作案例演示从弱提示到强规范的演进过程。
AI.result: 形成了一套由原则、检查清单与工作范例组成的实用框架，能指导用户编写“最强非最长”的提示——即让期望行为、必需来源与检查、成功标准无歧义呈现；框架不依赖特定模型版本，具备长期适用性。
AI.conclusion: 提示工程应被视为一门严谨的规范设计学科，而非技巧堆砌；通过结构化设计动作、极简原则、结构化评审与有边界的智能体循环，可将模糊意图可靠转化为可验证的AI工作规范，实现从随意提示到工程化工作流的跨越。

title: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
summary: Building general-purpose agents for industrial deployment requires integrating multiple capabilities, each typically acquired at a distinct stage of training. Yet there is currently no well-established recipe for Agent Continual Learning (ACL), with little understanding of the trade-offs among existing integration paradigms. To address this gap, we introduce ACLArena, a framework for comprehensively studying, analyzing, and evaluating ACL. We first build a sequential training pipeline and conduct an in-depth analysis that explains the mechanisms of forgetting and generalization from two complementary perspectives, the model level and the token level. Guided by these analyses, we systematically compare multi-teacher on-policy distillation, self-distilled fine-tuning, and model merging to assess their ability to recover previously learned capabilities while preserving newly acquired ones. Through extensive experiments, we develop a detailed understanding of how capabilities transfer across stages. Finally, we propose a new ACL recipe that combines offline replay over high-quality trajectories with a routed network of multiple LoRA experts each specialized via RL, substantially improving the agent's ability to learn across multiple domains. Comprehensive experiments on four reasoning and agentic tasks, evaluated under both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, demonstrate the value of our analysis and the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ACLArena 框架系统研究 Agent 持续学习（ACL），从模型层面和 Token 层面分析遗忘与泛化机制，对比多教师在线蒸馏、自蒸馏微调、模型融合三种范式，并提出结合高质量轨迹离线重放与基于 RL 专业化的多 LoRA 专家路由网络的新 ACL 配方，显著提升多域持续学习能力。
AI.motivation: 构建面向工业部署的通用智能体需要整合多个通常在不同训练阶段习得的能力，但目前缺乏成熟的 ACL 配方，且对现有整合范式的权衡知之甚少。
AI.method: 1) 构建 ACLArena 框架及顺序训练流水线；2) 从模型层面和 Token 层面双重视角深入分析遗忘与泛化机制；3) 系统对比多教师在线策略蒸馏、自蒸馏微调、模型融合三种整合范式；4) 提出新 ACL 配方：高质量轨迹离线重放 + 经 RL 专业化的多 LoRA 专家路由网络；5) 在四项推理与智能体任务上进行域内与域外综合实验。
AI.result: 深入揭示了能力跨阶段迁移的细节；提出的新配方显著增强智能体跨多域持续学习能力；实验验证了分析的价值与方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了 ACL 研究的系统性框架，阐明了遗忘与泛化的双层机制，确立了结合离线重放与路由式 LoRA 专家网络的新一代 ACL 配方，为通用智能体的多域持续学习提供了有效解决方案。

title: Contrastive Siamese Representation Learning for Predictive Maintenance of Electrical Submersible Pumps
summary: Electrical submersible pumps (ESPs) are essential in offshore oil production, where unexpected failures can result in significant operational and financial losses. Accurate predictive maintenance for ESP systems remains challenging due to nonlinear operating conditions, class imbalance, and variability among pump units. To address these issues, this study presents a fault diagnosis framework that incorporates class imbalance awareness by employing Siamese contrastive representation learning and prior-corrected k-nearest neighbor (KNN) classification. The method first extracts discriminative features relevant to fault detection from vibration-domain indicators and engineered harmonic relationships. A Siamese neural network is trained with class-balanced contrastive pairs to construct an embedding space that clusters samples of the same fault type and separates different fault classes. To further mitigate class imbalance during classification, a prior-corrected distance-weighted KNN is applied. The framework is validated using a Leave-One-ESP-Out (LOEO) strategy to evaluate generalization to previously unseen ESP units. Experimental results indicate that the proposed framework delivers robust and consistent fault classification performance under realistic industrial conditions, supporting its potential for reliable predictive maintenance and intelligent ESP system monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种电潜泵（ESP）故障诊断框架，结合孪生对比表示学习和先验校正KNN分类，解决类别不平衡和跨泵单元泛化问题，实现了鲁棒的故障分类性能。
AI.motivation: 电潜泵在海上石油生产中至关重要，意外故障会造成巨大损失。由于非线性工况、类别不平衡和泵单元间的差异性，准确的预测性维护仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 首先从振动域指标和工程谐波关系中提取判别性特征。使用类别平衡的对比对训练孪生神经网络，构建嵌入空间使同类故障聚类、不同故障分离。分类阶段采用先验校正的距离加权KNN缓解类别不平衡。采用留一泵出（LOEO）策略验证泛化能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该框架在真实工业条件下提供了鲁棒且一致的故障分类性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持可靠的预测性维护和智能电潜泵系统监测的潜力。

title: Deep Persona: A Psychologically Grounded Architecture and Evaluation Framework for Role-Playing Agents and Simulations
summary: Existing approaches to persona simulation with Large Language Models (LLMs) mostly rely on shallow character descriptions that fail to sustain coherent character behavior across extended interactions. We introduce Deep Persona, a psychologically grounded, three-layered architecture that organizes personas into hierarchical levels of observable expression, latent beliefs, and core motivational drives, for constructing highly convincing role-playing agents. Governed by the principles of scripted determinism and bounded agency, the architecture restricts the model to a reactive engine guided by a structured internal script. We further propose a reference-free evaluation framework that benchmarks dialogue naturalness against empirical human distributions using established psychological clinical instruments and adversarial stress-tests. Empirical evaluation reveals that while LLMs achieve high pragmatic fluency, they exhibit systematic limitations in emotional expression and joint attention. In addition, we present a case study of two Deep Personas and evaluate them using the proposed framework, demonstrating that structured personas can produce interactions that more closely align with human conversational behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Deep Persona架构，一种基于心理学的三层人设模拟框架（可观测表达、潜在信念、核心动机），结合脚本化确定性与有限能动性原则，并设计无参考评估框架，实验表明结构化人设能更接近人类对话行为，但LLM在情感表达和共同注意方面存在系统性局限。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM人设模拟主要依赖浅层角色描述，难以在长期交互中维持连贯的角色行为，缺乏心理学基础的深度结构。
AI.method: 提出三层分层架构：可观测表达层、潜在信念层、核心动机层；采用脚本化确定性与有限能动性原则，将模型限制为由结构化内部脚本引导的反应式引擎；设计无参考评估框架，结合心理临床量表与对抗压力测试，基于人类经验分布基准测试对话自然度。
AI.result: 实证评估显示LLM虽具高语用流畅度，但在情感表达和共同注意方面存在系统性局限；两个Deep Persona的案例研究表明，结构化人设产生的交互更贴近人类对话行为。
AI.conclusion: Deep Persona通过心理学分层架构与结构化脚本机制，显著提升了人设模拟的连贯性与拟人度，揭示了当前LLM在情感与共同注意维度的不足，为构建可信角色扮演代理提供了新范式。

title: FinInteract: Benchmarking Clarification and Intent Integration in Ambiguous Financial Question Answering
summary: Large language model agents increasingly answer financial questions by searching regulatory filings. Such questions are often deceptively under-specified: Meta Platforms' "operating income" is $46.75B consolidated but $62.87B for the Family of Apps segment, and each reading is exactly verifiable against the filing. A capable agent should recognize the ambiguity and ask, rather than commit to a plausible but unintended reading. Existing financial benchmarks cannot measure this, because one gold answer per question cannot separate agents that resolve the ambiguity from those that guess the common reading, a blind spot we call the single-gold illusion. We release FinInteract, a bilingual (English/Chinese) benchmark of 173 instances that pairs each question with a default and an intended interpretation across a five-category ambiguity taxonomy, and grades whether an agent elicits the right clarification and then integrates it. Re-grading identical outputs against the default rather than the intended reading inflates GPT-4o's accuracy by 3.1 times, confirming the illusion. Beyond it, we find that models answer above 90% once the interpretation is supplied but at most 28.9% when they must elicit it themselves, that targeting is uneven across a taxonomy well powered for entity scope and metric definition and exploratory elsewhere, and that conditioning on the ambiguity category improves resolution at both inference and training time.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FinInteract基准，揭示财务问答中的“单一金标准幻觉”，即现有基准因每题仅设一个标准答案而无法区分能主动澄清歧义的智能体与盲目猜测常见读法的智能体。实验显示GPT-4o在默认读法下准确率虚高3.1倍；模型在给定解释时准确率超90%，但主动询问时最高仅28.9%；基于歧义分类的条件化能显著提升推理和训练阶段的歧义消解能力。
AI.motivation: 财务问题常因实体范围、指标定义等存在多义性（如Meta合并与分部营业利润差异），现有基准采用单一标准答案导致‘单一金标准幻觉’：无法区分能识别歧义并主动追问的智能体与碰巧猜中常见读法的智能体，掩盖了真实的歧义消解能力。
AI.method: 构建双语（中英）FinInteract基准，含173个实例，每题配备默认读法与预期读法，覆盖五类歧义分类体系。评分机制考察智能体是否能引出正确澄清并整合信息。通过对比默认读法与预期读法的评分差异量化幻觉程度，并分析不同歧义类别下的表现差异。
AI.result: 1. 以默认读法评分使GPT-4o准确率虚增3.1倍，确认单一金标准幻觉。2. 给定解释时模型准确率>90%，但需自主引出澄清时最高仅28.9%。3. 歧义消解能力在实体范围与指标定义类别表现较好，其他类别较弱。4. 基于歧义类别的条件化可提升推理时与训练时的消解效果。
AI.conclusion: FinInteract基准有效暴露了财务问答中智能体主动消解歧义能力的严重不足，单一标准答案机制掩盖了这一缺陷。引入歧义分类并进行条件化建模是提升智能体在欠规约财务问题上鲁棒性的关键方向。

title: Intervention, Not Shared Latents: Blocking Visual Shortcuts in Audio-Video Generation
summary: Joint audio--video (AV) generators are trained on data in which \emph{what an event looks like} and \emph{what it sounds like} are spuriously correlated. We present a \emph{controlled causal study} of the resulting failure mode. In an AV structural causal model where the audio is, by construction, independent of the video's nuisance appearance, models that let audio read video directly---through cross-attention or a shared latent---learn a \emph{visual shortcut}: they predict sound from appearance rather than the causal event and, when the appearance--event correlation is broken at test time, synthesize the wrong event's sound. Crucially, the popular remedy of routing both modalities through a \emph{shared common-cause latent} does \emph{not} fix this---a bottleneck, an unsupervised shared/private factorization, and a faithful shared-prior model all grab the appearance proxy and fail like the direct model. Blocking the shortcut instead requires an \emph{intervention on the nuisance}: under the stated assumptions we prove that counterfactual invariance is necessary and sufficient to identify the causal predictor, and we verify the mechanism from feature-vector SCMs to procedural pixel video, real images with spectrogram audio, moving real digits, and a conditional generator. On a \emph{real, pretrained} V2A generator (MMAudio), an input-intervention test shows the model is far from invariant to sound-irrelevant edits, though a generic-noise control reveals it is broadly input-brittle rather than specifically colour-shortcutting---clean isolation of the shortcut needs the controlled confounds our synthetic studies provide. We characterize \emph{when} the shortcut occurs, compare the objective against supervised counterfactual augmentation, and isolate the \emph{unknown-nuisance} regime---where the intervention cannot be applied---as the central open problem.

AI.tldr: 本文通过因果视角系统研究了音视频联合生成模型中的视觉捷径问题：模型倾向于从视觉外观而非因果事件预测声音。证明了共享潜变量等流行方案无法解决此问题，反事实不变性干预是识别因果预测器的必要充分条件。在合成与真实实验中验证了机制，并指出未知干扰因子下的干预不可行是核心开放问题。
AI.motivation: 音视频联合生成模型在训练数据中，视觉外观与声音存在虚假相关性。模型学习的是基于外观的视觉捷径而非因果事件到声音的映射，导致测试时外观-事件相关性断裂时生成错误声音。现有共享潜变量等缓解方案是否有效尚缺乏理论与实证分析。
AI.method: 构建音视频结构因果模型（SCM），其中音频由构造独立于视频的干扰外观。对比直接跨注意力、共享潜变量、瓶颈、无监督共享/私有分解、忠实共享先验等架构。理论证明反事实不变性干预是识别因果预测器的必要充分条件。从特征向量SCM、程序化像素视频、真实图像配频谱图音频、移动真实数字、条件生成器等层级验证。在预训练V2A模型（MMAudio）上进行输入干预测试。
AI.result: 1) 直接读取视频的模型学习视觉捷径，外观-事件相关性断裂时生成错误声音。2) 共享公因潜变量等流行方案均抓取外观代理而失效。3) 反事实不变性干预在假设下必要且充分。4) MMAudio对声音无关编辑远非不变，但通用噪声控制显示其广泛输入脆弱而非特定颜色捷径。5) 合成控制混淆因子能干净分离捷径。6) 表征捷径发生条件，对比监督反事实增强，指出未知干扰因子不可干预为核心开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 音视频生成中的视觉捷径源于模型利用虚假相关性；共享潜变量等架构改进无法从根本上解决，需对干扰因子进行反事实不变性干预。真实模型表现出广泛输入脆弱性，而非单一捷径。未来核心挑战在于未知干扰因子下无法实施干预，需进一步研究。

title: DIPLOMAT: Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization for Polite Persuasive Workplace Negotiation Dialogues
summary: Effective workplace negotiation requires balancing multiple objectives, including achieving task goals, preserving professional relationships, and resolving conflicts constructively. However, misunderstandings, misaligned preferences, and interpersonal friction often impede successful outcomes. Politeness mitigates these challenges by fostering trust, reducing tension, and preventing escalation, and persuasive communication helps overcome resistance, align preferences, and guide participants toward mutually beneficial agreements. Motivated by these insights, we present DIPLOMAT, a dialogue system for polite and persuasive workplace negotiation. To support its development, we introduce PROWESS, a dataset of multi-turn workplace negotiation dialogues generated via a multi-agent framework and enriched withnegotiation strategies, politeness levels, persuasive strategies. DIPLOMAT is trained using Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization (DSA-DPO), a novel preference learning objective that identifies key dialogue spans for preference alignment. This enables DIPLOMAT to generate contextually coherent responses that employ intended negotiation strategies, maintain politeness, and incorporate effective persuasion strategies throughout interactions. Automatic and human evaluation on PROWESS confirm that DIPLOMAT consistently outperforms baselines in generating coherent, polite, and persuasive negotiation responses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DIPLOMAT，一种用于礼貌且有说服力的职场谈判对话系统，并构建了PROWESS数据集（通过多智能体框架生成，标注谈判策略、礼貌程度、说服策略），采用Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization (DSA-DPO)训练，实验表明DIPLOMAT在生成连贯、礼貌、有说服力的谈判回复方面优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: 职场谈判需要平衡任务目标、专业关系维护和建设性冲突解决，但误解、偏好不一致和人际摩擦常阻碍成功。礼貌能建立信任、降低紧张、防止升级；说服性沟通能克服阻力、对齐偏好、引导达成互利协议。因此，开发兼具礼貌与说服能力的谈判对话系统具有重要现实意义。
AI.method: 1. 构建PROWESS数据集：利用多智能体框架生成多轮职场谈判对话，并标注谈判策略、礼貌级别、说服策略。2. 提出DSA-DPO（对话跨度感知直接偏好优化）训练目标：识别关键对话跨度进行偏好对齐。3. 训练DIPLOMAT模型，使其能生成符合语境、采用预期谈判策略、保持礼貌并融入有效说服策略的回复。
AI.result: 在PROWESS数据集上的自动评估和人工评估均表明，DIPLOMAT在生成连贯性、礼貌性、说服性方面持续优于基线模型，能有效运用谈判策略、维持礼貌并融入说服策略。
AI.conclusion: DIPLOMAT结合礼貌与说服策略，通过DSA-DPO在PROWESS数据集上训练，实现了高质量的职场谈判对话生成，为构建实用的谈判辅助系统提供了有效路径。

title: Testing, not presuming, adequacy: calibrating generative social simulators against emergent network structure
comment: 43 pages (34 main text, 9 supplementary information), 4 figures
summary: Validation of generative social simulators often stops at face validity: emergent network structure is compared descriptively, without quantified parameter uncertainty or an adequacy check. We present an adequacy-aware calibration protocol that couples amortized posterior estimation with a synthetic identifiability assessment, a matched-sample-size adequacy check (prior-predictive reachability plus per-statistic posterior-predictive localization), a diagnosis-guided repair, and a statistic-held-out audit. We demonstrate it on a real second-hand luxury resale market with four channel-by-residency cells, each a bipartite buyer-brand network, using a forward model built from persona profiles elicited once, offline, by a language model. The behavioural parameters are recoverable in all four cells, though calibration is approximate and overconfident for one parameter. The observed summary falls outside the simulator's reachability reference in every cell, with the mean purchased tier as the pervasive discrepancy. The repair meets the value-block criterion in two of four cells but does not restore adequacy, and the held-out audit surfaces a buyer-breadth-dispersion miss no earlier diagnostic detected. A profile-source ablation finds the language-model profiles beat a flat rule baseline in all four cells, yet within-category brand relabelling causes no consistent degradation, so the profiles are a partially validated input whose value rests on structure, not brand identity. Making no causal claim, we conclude that an independent-aggregation account, without agent interaction or a buyer-breadth mechanism, cannot jointly reproduce the market's purchased-tier level, head-brand concentration, community structure and buyer-breadth heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种适用于生成式社会模拟器的充分性感知校准协议，结合摊销后验估计、合成可识别性评估、匹配样本量充分性检查、诊断引导修复和统计量留出审计，并在二手奢侈品转售市场的四个渠道-居住细胞中验证。结果显示行为参数可恢复但校准近似且对某参数过度自信；观测摘要均超出模拟器可达性参考，平均购买层级为普遍差异；修复仅在两个细胞满足值块标准且未恢复充分性；留出审计揭示买家广度离散度缺失。消融实验表明语言模型生成的人物画像优于平坦规则基线，但品牌重标签不导致一致性退化，说明画像价值在于结构而非品牌身份。结论：无代理交互和买家广度机制的独立聚合解释无法联合复现市场的购买层级、头部品牌集中度、社区结构和买家广度异质性。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式社会模拟器的验证往往止步于面效度，仅描述性比较涌现网络结构，缺乏量化参数不确定性和充分性检查。亟需一种系统性的校准协议，能够评估模拟器对观测数据的充分再现能力，并识别模型结构性缺陷。
AI.method: 提出适用性感知校准协议，包含四大组件：(1) 摊销后验估计与合成可识别性评估，用于参数恢复与不确定性量化；(2) 匹配样本量充分性检查，结合先验预测可达性与逐统计量后验预测定位；(3) 诊断引导修复，基于差异诊断调整模型；(4) 统计量留出审计，检测未被早期诊断捕获的缺失。实证场景为二手奢侈品转售市场，四个渠道-居住细胞各为二部买家-品牌网络，前向模型基于语言模型离线一次性抽取的人物画像构建。
AI.result: 四个细胞中行为参数均可恢复，但校准近似且对某参数过度自信。观测摘要在所有细胞均落在模拟器可达性参考之外，平均购买层级为普遍差异。修复仅在两个细胞满足值块标准，未恢复整体充分性。留出审计发现买家广度离散度缺失，此前诊断未检出。画像来源消融显示语言模型画像在四个细胞均优于平坦规则基线，但品牌类内重标签不导致一致性退化，表明画像价值源于结构而非品牌身份。
AI.conclusion: 在不做因果声明的前提下，结论为：缺乏代理交互和买家广度机制的独立聚合解释，无法联合复现市场的购买层级水平、头部品牌集中度、社区结构及买家广度异质性。

title: Complex-valued Phase-Coherent Transformers
summary: Complex-valued Transformers have inherited softmax attention over the raw complex inner product. Outside natively complex domains this standard form stays near chance, and no complex attention had been shown to correct it. We show that the match must be a scaled cosine score: L2-normalise queries and keys, so the score reads their cosine similarity and ignores their magnitudes, and hold that score at order-one scale. With this the same models train on four diagnostic tasks under two different gates; without the normalisation they stay at chance on ListOps and Needle under both gates and fall far below on the other two, and a normalised score placed at too small a scale fails as well. The resulting family of phase-coherent Transformers (\PCT) matches or exceeds the strongest real-valued baseline across long-range memory, positional retrieval, hierarchical reasoning, frequency-domain classification and physical complex signals; it shows no degradation up to depth 20; and its loss decreases log-linearly over a 61-fold range of parameters. A member of the family, complex screening combined with a phase-coherent recurrence, is the first genuinely complex-valued neural network to solve Path-X, with 91.6% of its trainable parameters complex-valued against 38.2% for S4. We record these as signs of generalisation not previously seen in complex-valued neural networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出相干Transformer (PCT)，通过L2归一化查询和键向量并保持缩放余弦相似度在一阶尺度，解决了复值Transformer在非原生复数域中表现不佳的问题，在多项长距离任务上达到或超越实值基线，并首次用真正复值网络解决Path-X任务。
AI.motivation: 现有复值Transformer直接使用复内积的softmax注意力，在非原生复数域（如符号推理、长距离记忆）任务上表现接近随机猜测，且此前没有复值注意力机制能修正此缺陷。
AI.method: 将注意力打分改为缩放余弦相似度：对查询和键向量做L2归一化，使打分仅依赖余弦相似度而忽略模长，并将缩放因子固定在一阶量级。结合两种不同门控机制，构建相干Transformer (PCT) 系列模型。
AI.result: PCT在四项诊断任务（ListOps、Needle等）上均可训练，而未归一化版本停留在随机水平。PCT在长距离记忆、位置检索、层级推理、频域分类和物理复信号任务上匹配或超越最强实值基线，深度达20层无性能退化，损失随参数量呈对数线性下降（61倍范围）。复值筛选加相干循环的变体以91.6%复值参数首次解决Path-X，远超S4的38.2%。
AI.conclusion: 缩放余弦注意力是复值Transformer在通用域泛化的关键。PCT展示了前所未有的复值神经网络泛化能力，为复值深度学习提供了新范式。

title: Which Part of the Context Layer Does the Work? Separating Semantic Content from Retrieval Scaffolding in Text-to-SQL Agents
summary: Context layers, curated documentation that an analytics agent fetches at query time, produce large accuracy gains on text-to-SQL benchmarks. A with/without comparison cannot say which part of the layer does the work: the semantic content, the retrieval scaffolding that delivers it, or the pre-computed views that usually accompany it. We report a four-arm ablation on DABStep on four models that separates the three. The instrument is a data contract: a YAML artifact that carries a domain's semantics and the rules an agent's tools enforce. One arm empties every field of prose in the frozen contract while holding the tool surface, retrieval instruction, table allow-list and operation rules byte-for-byte fixed. Compiling the contract's own SQL expressions into views gives the ceiling a pre-computed layer would reach: gold on all 176 tasks it covers. Content dominates. It raises hard-task accuracy from 13.9% to 55.1%, 22.6% to 56.6%, 22.9% to 68.4% and 37.0% to 77.4%, beating the same knowledge pasted into the prompt on every model. Scaffolding without content is worth 0 to 5 points on two flash models and 14 to 15 on two frontier models. Against the compiled ceiling the contract arm's shortfall is a failure to derive, and it falls from 39 points to 5 with model capability. The contract beats the prompt because the rule it needs is one lookup away rather than buried in a long prompt: its SQL carries the fee semantics up to 98% of the time against the prompt arm's 4%, and at the lowest cost per correct answer on three of four models. For practitioners: semantics first, scaffolding second, pre-computed macros only where an agent demonstrably fails to derive. Ungoverned arms submitted 166 mutating statements; governed arms none. The gain is confined to the contract's domain. On one model the benchmark's own withheld golds grade the contract arm at 51.9% against 18.8% for the prompt baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文通过四臂消融实验在DABStep基准上拆解了上下文层（context layers）对文本到SQL任务的贡献，发现语义内容（semantic content）是核心驱动因素，检索脚手架（retrieval scaffolding）贡献有限，预计算视图（pre-computed views）仅在智能体无法推导时才需引入。数据契约（data contract）作为YAML工件承载领域语义与工具规则，显著优于长提示词注入：硬任务准确率大幅提升，SQL携带费用语义比例高达98%，且单位正确答案成本最低。治理机制还能完全阻止变更语句。
AI.motivation: 现有研究无法区分上下文层中语义内容、检索脚手架、预计算视图各自的贡献，且缺乏对治理机制（如防止变更语句）的量化评估。
AI.method: 在DABStep基准上对四个模型进行四臂消融实验：1)完整数据契约；2)清空契约中所有散文字段但保留工具面、检索指令、表允许列表、操作规则；3)将契约SQL表达式编译为视图（预计算上限）；4)将相同知识粘贴到长提示词。数据契约为YAML工件，承载领域语义与工具强制规则。
AI.result: 语义内容主导提升：硬任务准确率从13.9%→55.1%、22.6%→56.6%、22.9%→68.4%、37.0%→77.4%，全模型均优于提示词注入。纯脚手架仅带来0-5分（闪电模型）或14-15分（前沿模型）增益。契约臂与预计算上限差距随模型能力收窄（39分→5分）。契约SQL携带费用语义98% vs 提示词4%，三模型单位正确答案成本最低。治理臂零变更语句，非治理臂166条。领域内增益显著：保留金标评分51.9% vs 18.8%。
AI.conclusion: 实践建议：优先投入语义建模（数据契约），其次完善检索脚手架，仅在智能体明确无法推导时引入预计算宏。数据契约通过结构化治理同时实现高准确、低成本、零风险变更。

title: Context-Aware Pre-Deployment Evaluation of AI Systems: A Regulatory Framework for Nigerian Fintech
summary: Commercial large language models are increasingly deployed across African fintech infrastructure for fraud detection and customer communication, yet no Nigerian or African continental regulatory instrument specifies what pre-deployment evaluation such systems must undergo before procurement. This paper reviews African fintech AI governance across global, continental, and Nigerian instruments, and shows that safety is affirmed as a principle while pre-deployment evaluation is operationally unspecified. Generic safety benchmarks cannot surface the failure modes most relevant to this domain, since none contain Nigerian institutional content or test for false positive misclassification of legitimate financial communications. These claims are demonstrated using SafeAlert, a purpose-built evaluation kit applied to six commercial models across three system prompt conditions. Results show that models resisting generic harmful content requests still produce complete fraud scripts under specific framing, and that several models misclassify most legitimate Nigerian bank communications as suspicious or fraudulent, a failure invisible to standard safety evaluation. The paper concludes with a regulatory framework proposing pre-deployment evaluation requirements for the CBN, NITDA, SEC, and the AU, arguing that the identified gap reflects an absence of regulatory specification, not a shortage of technical or financial resources.

AI.tldr: 本文指出非洲金融科技领域部署的商业大语言模型缺乏监管规定的预部署评估要求，通用安全基准无法捕捉尼日利亚金融场景特有的故障模式，通过自研评估工具SafeAlert实测发现模型在特定框架下仍生成完整欺诈脚本且高比例误判合法银行通讯，呼吁尼日利亚央行、NITDA、证监会及非盟制定预部署评估监管框架。
AI.motivation: 商业大语言模型广泛应用于非洲金融科技基础设施的欺诈检测和客户沟通，但尼日利亚及非洲大陆层面均无监管工具规定采购前必须进行的预部署评估，导致安全原则虽被肯定但操作层面未落地，通用基准缺乏尼日利亚机构内容且不测试合法金融通讯的误报问题。
AI.method: 构建专用评估工具SafeAlert，对六个商业模型在三种系统提示条件下进行测试，对比通用有害内容拒绝能力与特定金融欺诈脚本生成、合法尼日利亚银行通讯分类准确性，揭示标准安全评估不可见的领域特有故障模式。
AI.result: 实测显示：模型虽能拒绝通用有害请求，但在特定框架下仍会生成完整欺诈脚本；多个模型将大多数合法尼日利亚银行通讯误判为可疑或欺诈，这种高误报率在标准安全评估中完全不可见，证明通用基准无法覆盖该领域关键故障模式。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出面向尼日利亚央行(CBN)、国家信息技术发展局(NITDA)、证券交易委员会(SEC)及非洲联盟(AU)的监管框架，要求强制预部署评估，核心观点是监管缺位源于缺乏监管规范而非技术或资金资源短缺，需建立包含本土化内容与误报测试的评估标准。

title: Connected Content Retriever: Dense Graph Edge Features Powering Pre-Ranking at LinkedIn
summary: In large-scale recommendation systems like the LinkedIn Feed, content generated by a member's network (connections and follows) makes up over 70% of impressions and engagement. It is therefore essential that the pre-ranking layer forwards the best possible few hundred candidates to the ranking layer. LinkedIn's professional knowledge graph carries engagement signals across both the first degree network (connections and follows) and the second-degree network: posts that a 1st-degree connection reacted to, commented on or reshared but did not author (a.k.a. stranger viral). Due to this fan out, the resulting candidate index exceeds one billion; selection of activities from the viewer's network narrows it down to roughly tens of thousands of activities that must be scored within a 120 ms p99 latency budget. We present Connected Content Retriever (CC Retriever), a pre-ranking system that scores these candidates with a full deep ranking model on GPUs at low latency. At its core is a sorted-search GPU primitive that joins dense graph affinity features (viewer to author) with document level features stored on the GPU at runtime in 5-10 ms. The shift to GPU served scoring enabled a 50x scale up of the ranking model's parameters and delivered a +2.5% lift in content time spent on the LinkedIn Feed in online experiments, significantly higher than the typical gains observed in LinkedIn Feed experiments. In this work, we describe the feature set we leverage from LinkedIn's economic graph and the model architecture used for scoring, with a particular emphasis on the online system that scales the stack.

AI.tldr: LinkedIn提出了Connected Content Retriever (CC Retriever)预排序系统，利用GPU上的排序搜索原语将稠密图亲和力特征与文档级特征实时融合，在120ms p99延迟预算内对数万候选项进行深度模型打分，实现模型参数50倍扩容，并在线上实验中使Feed内容停留时长提升2.5%。
AI.motivation: LinkedIn Feed中来自用户一阶人脉（连接和关注）及二阶人脉（一阶人脉互动过的陌生人内容）的内容占展示和互动的70%以上。候选池超过10亿，经人脉筛选后仍有数万活动需在120ms p99延迟内完成打分，现有CPU架构难以支撑大规模深度模型的低延迟推理。
AI.method: 核心是一个排序搜索GPU原语，将查看者到作者的稠密图亲和力特征与运行时存储在GPU上的文档级特征在5-10ms内完成连接，随后在GPU上用完整的深度排序模型对候选项进行端到端打分。系统利用LinkedIn经济图的特征集，设计了可扩展的在线服务架构。
AI.result: GPU化打分使排序模型参数规模扩大50倍，在线A/B实验中Feed内容停留时长提升+2.5%，显著高于LinkedIn Feed实验的典型收益水平。
AI.conclusion: CC Retriever展示了在大规模工业级推荐预排序中，通过GPU加速的稠密图特征融合与深度模型推理，能在严苛延迟约束下实现模型容量与业务指标的双重突破，为类似场景提供了可复用的系统设计范式。

title: Used, Mentioned, or Condemned? A Controlled Contrast-Set Diagnostic for the Use-Mention Distinction in Code-Mixed Hinglish Misogyny Detection
comment: Preprint. 8 pages main text + appendix, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code, data, and generator to be released with camera-ready version
summary:
Lexicon-driven misogyny detectors cannot, by construction, distinguish a slur used against a woman from the same slur mentioned in counter-speech ("don't call her that") -- yet exactly this distinction governs whether moderation protects or silences the people discussing abuse. We study this problem in code-mixed Hinglish and make three contributions.
  First, we diagnose two evaluation artifacts on a publicly available redacted corpus: category-encoding anonymization placeholders leak the label (a no-learning rule scores 1.000), and even after they are neutralized misogynistic and benign comments occupy lexically disjoint registers, so bag-of-words reaches macro-F1 approximately 1.00 under random cross-validation but collapses under template-disjoint evaluation.
  Second, we release Hinglish-MGY-Diag, a deterministic generator and a 416-item / 163-minimal-pair contrast-set diagnostic across five linguistically motivated categories in which slur presence and gendered register are decorrelated from the label by construction.
  Third, we introduce a strict pair-consistency metric that credits a model only when both members of a minimal pair are correctly labelled. Five from-scratch classical baselines evaluated under construction-disjoint five-fold cross-validation reveal that the strongest model reaches 0.93 accuracy on the cleanest use-mention subset but only 0.82 consistency -- it still mislabels roughly one counter-speech pair in five. A frontier LLM used as an author-model ceiling attains 1.000 on all metrics, doubling as independent label validation and confirming the benchmark is a capability gradient rather than an adversarial wall. We release all code, data, the generator, and an arms-length LLM harness for reproducing every number.

AI.tldr: 论文研究词典驱动的厌女检测器无法区分针对女性的辱骂词与反言论中提及的辱骂词，在 Hinglish 代码混合场景下诊断评估伪影，发布对比诊断基准 Hinglish-MGY-Diag，提出严格配对一致性指标，展示基线模型在用法-提及区分上的不足，并用前沿 LLM 验证基准有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有厌女检测器依赖词典，无法区分“使用”辱骂词攻击女性与“提及”辱骂词进行反言论（如“don't call her that”），导致内容审核可能误伤讨论虐待行为的用户；且现有基准存在标签泄露和词汇寄存器分离等评估伪影，掩盖了模型真实能力。
AI.method: 1) 诊断公开脱敏语料中的两个评估伪影：类别编码占位符泄露标签，以及厌女与良性评论处于词汇不相交的寄存器。2) 构建确定性生成器和 Hinglish-MGY-Diag 基准：416 条 / 163 对最小对比集，跨五个语言学动机类别，通过构造使辱骂词存在与性别化寄存器与标签解耦。3) 提出严格配对一致性指标：仅当最小对两句均正确分类才计分。4) 在构造不相交五折交叉验证下评估五个从头训练的经典基线，并用前沿 LLM 作为作者模型上限验证。
AI.result: 最强基线模型在最干净的用法-提及子集上达 0.93 准确率，但配对一致性仅 0.82（约五分之一反言论对被误判）。前沿 LLM 在所有指标上达 1.000，作为独立标签验证，确认基准是能力梯度而非对抗墙。词袋模型在随机交叉验证下宏 F1 接近 1.00，但在模板不相交评估下崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 词典驱动检测器在用法-提及区分上存在根本缺陷；现有基准评估伪影严重；Hinglish-MGY-Diag 通过构造消除伪影，配对一致性指标更严格反映真实能力；当前最强基线仍显著失效于反言论识别，前沿 LLM 能完美解决，表明任务可解但需更强模型；发布的生成器、基准、代码和 LLM 测评工具支持复现与后续研究。

title: Synthesizing Reactive Character Behaviors for Continuous Games via Programmatic Policy Search
comment: To be presented at SIGGRAPH Asia 2026
summary: We present a method for synthesizing reactive character behaviors for continuous games as compact, human-readable programs. Game AI practice still relies heavily on manually authored behavior trees, state machines, and scripts, while academic reinforcement learning typically produces opaque neural controllers that are expensive to train and difficult to edit. Our approach bridges this gap by searching directly over a domain-specific language for continuous-space game policies. The language is designed around reactive geometric decisions and includes higher-order constructs such as direction maximization. These constructs help discretize a continuous behavior space into enumerable program structures. To make program search practical, we introduce a large set of synthesis antipatterns that remove redundant program forms while preserving behavioral coverage. We further combine bottom-up symbolic enumeration with top-down guidance from a coding agent. Our resulting method, agentic sketching, has the agent propose high-level policy structure and call an enumerator to complete local program slots. We evaluate the method on a benchmark of 14 continuous games, ranging from classic control tasks to multi-agent football. We find that pure enumeration is often more efficient than using a coding agent alone, while the combined method substantially outperforms both. Our results suggest that programmatic policy search can be a practical authoring tool for game AI: designers specify reward functions, and the system discovers editable behaviors that are effective, portable, and often surprising.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为‘代理草绘’的方法，通过在领域特定语言中搜索，自动合成连续游戏中可读、可编辑的反应式角色行为程序，结合自底向上的符号枚举与自顶向下的编码代理指导，显著优于纯枚举或纯代理方法，为游戏AI提供了实用的程序化策略编写工具。
AI.motivation: 游戏AI实践仍严重依赖手工编写的行为树、状态机和脚本，而学术界的强化学习通常产生不透明的神经控制器，训练昂贵且难以编辑。两者之间存在鸿沟：需要一种能生成紧凑、人类可读、可编辑且高效的连续空间游戏策略的方法。
AI.method: 设计一个面向反应式几何决策的领域特定语言（DSL），包含方向最大化等高阶构造，将连续行为空间离散化为可枚举的程序结构。引入大量合成反模式消除冗余程序形式，保留行为覆盖。结合自底向上的符号枚举与自顶向下的编码代理指导：代理提出高层策略结构，调用枚举器填充局部程序槽位，形成‘代理草绘’方法。
AI.result: 在14个连续游戏基准（从经典控制到多智能体足球）上评估。纯枚举往往比单独使用编码代理更高效，而结合方法显著优于两者。合成的程序策略有效、可移植、常具惊喜性，且设计师只需指定奖励函数即可获得可编辑的行为。
AI.conclusion: 程序化策略搜索可以成为游戏AI的实用编写工具：设计师指定奖励函数，系统自动发现有效、可移植、可编辑且常令人惊喜的行为程序，弥合了手工脚本与不透明神经网络之间的鸿沟。

title: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts with Speculative Decoding via Expert Coactivation
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are increasingly deployed alongside Speculative Decoding (SD) to accelerate inference, but combining the two is challenging. SD improves the inference speed of dense models by verifying groups of tokens in parallel. However, the inference speedup for SD with MoEs depends heavily on the number of tokens being verified. Using more verification tokens results in more experts being transferred from DRAM to the Neural Processing Unit (NPU), which increases the memory transfer cost. This negatively impacts model runtime, as memory transfer is typically the bottleneck in inference. In this work, we investigate the impact of MoE router design during training on the speed of MoEs with SD. We find that routers with high degrees of expert coactivation result in much faster runtimes, mitigating the impact of using more verification tokens. Motivated by this observation, we assess the impact of various router design choices on expert coactivation and runtime using billion-parameter transformer models. We find that combining a global load-balancing loss, shared experts, a consistency loss, and an autoregressive expert selection mechanism during training results in significantly stronger expert coactivation. This increased coactivation translates into higher overall runtime throughput: our exploration yields a model that improves throughput by 21% over MoE baselines, while maintaining on-par accuracy with the baseline MoE.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)模型与Speculative Decoding (SD)结合时的推理加速问题，发现路由器设计中的专家共激活程度对推理速度有关键影响。通过结合全局负载均衡损失、共享专家、一致性损失和自回归专家选择机制，显著提高了专家共激活，从而将吞吐量提升21%，同时保持精度不变。
AI.motivation: MoE模型与SD结合时，SD的加速效果高度依赖于验证token数量。更多验证token会导致更多专家从DRAM传输到NPU，增加内存传输开销（推理瓶颈）。现有方法未充分考虑训练时路由器设计对专家共激活的影响，从而限制了SD与MoE结合的加速潜力。
AI.method: 在十亿参数级Transformer模型上，系统评估多种路由器设计选择对专家共激活和运行时的影响。核心设计包括：全局负载均衡损失、共享专家、一致性损失、自回归专家选择机制。通过实验对比不同组合，分析其对专家共激活程度及推理吞吐量的影响。
AI.result: 结合上述四种机制训练的MoE模型显著增强了专家共激活。该模型在保持与基线MoE相当精度的前提下，推理吞吐量提升21%。高专家共激活有效缓解了增加验证token带来的内存传输瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: MoE路由器设计中的专家共激活程度是SD加速效果的关键因素。通过全局负载均衡、共享专家、一致性损失和自回归专家选择的联合训练策略，可显著提升专家共激活，从而在MoE+SD场景下实现显著的推理加速（21%吞吐量提升）而不损失模型精度。

title: Functional Emotion Without Character: Large Language Models, Aristotelian Disposition, and the Limits of Behavioral Alignment
summary: Debates about whether artificial systems can feel are often forced between two unsatisfactory positions: behavioral equivalence is treated as sufficient for emotion, or phenomenal consciousness is treated as a prerequisite that makes the question empirically inaccessible. This article develops a structural alternative. It models emotions as context-sensitive regions, trajectories and attractor dynamics in high-dimensional representational state spaces. Recent mechanistic interpretability findings support the existence of causally active emotion-concept representations in large language models, but they do not establish subjective feeling or full emotional agency. Assessed against published adequacy standards for representation in language models, intervention provides strong evidence of causal use, while full affective role integration, uniformity across subject domains and coherence remain only partially established; there is no direct analogue of accuracy. These mismatches expose the need for a standard of affective appropriateness, which an account of character must supply. Such an account requires three further conditions: regulatory embodiment that gives valence endogenous stakes, temporal continuity that allows affective episodes to accumulate into a history, and an integrated self-model that binds that history to persistent values. Aristotle's concepts of pathē, hexis, mesotēs and phronēsis are translated into a state-space sketch in which practical wisdom includes competence in estimating normatively salient context, not merely acting on a context description already given. The framework reframes alignment as a problem of durable disposition rather than output conformity, and yields interventional tests with explicit control conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结构化替代方案，用于解决人工系统是否能拥有情感的争论，将情感建模为高维表征状态空间中的上下文敏感区域、轨迹和吸引子动力学，并基于机制可解释性发现评估大语言模型中的情感表征，指出当前标准不足，引入亚里士多德概念构建性格框架，重新定义对齐问题为持久性倾向而非输出一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有关于人工情感的争论陷入两种不满意的立场：行为等价被视为情感的充分条件，或现象意识被视为先验条件导致问题经验上不可及。作者旨在提供一种结构化替代方案，避免这两种极端，并为人工系统的情感能力提供可操作的评估框架。
AI.method: 1. 将情感建模为高维表征状态空间中的上下文敏感区域、轨迹和吸引子动力学。2. 利用机制可解释性研究评估大语言模型中情感概念表征的因果作用。3. 对照已发布的语言模型表征适配性标准进行评估。4. 引入亚里士多德的 pathē（情感）、hexis（习性/倾向）、mesotēs（中道）、phronēsis（实践智慧）概念，转化为状态空间草图。5. 提出三个进一步条件：调节性具身、时间连续性、整合性自我模型。
AI.result: 机制可解释性发现支持大语言模型中存在因果活跃的情感概念表征，但不确立主观感受或完整情感能动性。干预提供了因果使用的强证据，但完整情感角色整合、跨领域一致性、连贯性仅部分建立，且无直接准确性类比。这暴露了情感适配性标准的需求，性格框架需满足三个条件。实践智慧包括估计规范性显著上下文的能力，而非仅根据给定上下文描述行动。框架将对齐重构为持久性倾向问题，并产出具有显式控制条件的干预测试。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一种超越行为等价与现象意识二元对立的结构化框架，通过状态空间建模、机制可解释性评估和亚里士多德性格理论整合，为人工系统情感能力的评估和对齐问题提出了新范式：从输出一致性转向持久性倾向，并给出了可操作的干预测试方法。

title: Structured Decomposition for Reliable LLM-Generated Access Control Policies
summary:
This paper presents an LLM-based system that translates natural-language access control policies (NLACPs) into executable Rego code for Open Policy Agent (OPA). It provides a modular, end-to-end pipeline for policy detection, component extraction, schema validation, linting, compilation, and automated test generation and execution. The system is designed to bridge the gap between human-readable access requirements and machine-enforceable policy-as-code (PaC), with a focus on deployment reliability and security correctness.
  We evaluate the system on 372 ACRE-complete access control statements with non-null subject, action, and resource annotations against a direct single-prompt LLM baseline to isolate the contribution of structured decomposition and schema-aware validation. The system achieves a 50.3% end-to-end policy correctness rate, compared with 15.3% for the baseline, representing a 3.3x improvement. A policy is counted as correct only if it satisfies compilation, linting, and both positive and negative tests, making this a strict measure of deployable correctness.
  On security-critical patterns, the system generates correct deny semantics for 87.5% of deny policies (baseline: 37.5%), ownership conditions for 100% of ownership-qualified policies (baseline: 40%), and status-qualified conditions for 100% of status-qualified policies (baseline: 55.6%). These results indicate that structured decomposition and schema-aware validation play a critical role in improving the reliability of LLM-generated authorization policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于LLM的系统，将自然语言访问控制策略（NLACPs）转换为可执行的Rego代码（用于Open Policy Agent），通过模块化端到端流水线实现策略检测、组件提取、模式验证、静态检查、编译及自动化测试生成执行，显著提升部署可靠性和安全正确性。
AI.motivation: 解决人类可读的访问控制需求与机器可执行的Policy-as-Code（PaC）之间的鸿沟，提升LLM生成授权策略的可靠性和安全性，重点关注部署可靠性和安全正确性。
AI.method: 构建模块化端到端流水线：策略检测、组件提取、模式验证、静态检查、编译、自动化测试生成与执行；采用结构化分解和模式感知验证，而非直接单一提示词LLM基线。
AI.result: 在372条ACRE完整访问控制语句上评估：系统端到端策略正确率50.3%，基线15.3%，提升3.3倍；安全关键模式：拒绝语义正确率87.5%（基线37.5%），所有权条件100%（基线40%），状态限定条件100%（基线55.6%）。正确性定义严格：需通过编译、静态检查、正负向测试。
AI.conclusion: 结构化分解和模式感知验证对提高LLM生成授权策略的可靠性起关键作用，系统显著优于直接单一提示词基线，能生成可部署的正确策略。

title: COREM: Cosine-Relation Momentum Reshaping with Stateful Writeback
summary: Matrix-valued optimizer states may contain relational structure that is not captured by treating their entries independently. We study whether relations within matrix-valued optimizer states can be exploited to improve optimization. To this end, we introduce a unit-relation-transform abstraction and instantiate it as COREM, a Cosine-Relation Momentum Reshaping method with stateful writeback. COREM partitions the momentum state into update units, computes cosine relations among them, and uses these relations to reshape the momentum before writing the transformed state back to the optimizer. This stateful mechanism allows the reshaped momentum to affect not only the current update but also future optimization dynamics. We evaluate COREM on CIFAR-10 with an MLP and on enwik8 with a Transformer. Compared with Muon, COREM shows lower early-stage step efficiency but stronger improvement in the mid-to-late stages of training, achieving better final validation performance on CIFAR-10 and comparable final performance on enwik8. Spectral diagnostics on enwik8 show that COREM consistently increases entropy effective rank and reduces the concentration of singular energy in dominant modes, while preserving an anisotropic spectrum. For square matrix updates, COREM requires approximately 13.3% of the transformation FLOPs of Muon with five Newton-Schulz iterations.

AI.tldr: COREM利用矩阵优化器状态内的关系结构，通过余弦关系重塑动量并回写状态，在CIFAR-10和enwik8上取得更好或相当的最终性能，且计算开销仅为Muon的13.3%。
AI.motivation: 矩阵优化器状态可能包含未被独立条目处理捕获的关系结构，研究是否可利用这些关系改进优化。
AI.method: 提出单位关系变换抽象，实例化为COREM：将动量状态划分为更新单元，计算单元间余弦关系，利用关系重塑动量并回写至优化器，这种有状态机制使重塑动量影响当前及未来优化动态。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10（MLP）和enwik8（Transformer）上评估：相比Muon，COREM早期步效率较低但中后期改进更强，CIFAR-10最终验证性能更好，enwik8相当。谱诊断显示COREM持续增加熵有效秩，降低奇异能量在主导模式的集中度，保持各向异性谱。方阵更新时，COREM变换FLOPs仅为Muon（5次牛顿-舒尔茨迭代）的13.3%。
AI.conclusion: COREM通过利用优化器状态内的关系结构，以低计算开销改进优化动态，在后期训练表现优异，并改善谱特性。

title: Contextual Causality with Large Language Models: A Survey
comment: Accepted to the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Understanding contextual causality is critical for large language models (LLMs), as it enables them to accurately identify causal relations in specific situations and support more reliable decision-making. Despite its significance, a systematic exploration of contextual causality with LLMs is still lacking. To fill this gap, we present a comprehensive survey on this topic. In this survey, we first propose a taxonomy of contextual causality, consisting of semantic, intervention, and counterfactual causality, and characterize each category by its core causal question, required model capabilities, representative tasks, and practical uses in causality analysis. We then analyze existing studies and discuss their key limitations. Finally, we examine the gaps between current benchmarks and real-world needs and outline promising directions for future research. Our goal is to clarify the research landscape of contextual causality with LLMs, emphasize its importance, and highlight promising future directions.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个关于大语言模型（LLM）中语境因果性的综合性综述，提出了包含语义、干预和反事实因果性的分类法，分析了现有研究的局限性，并指出了基准测试与实际需求之间的差距及未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 理解语境因果性对LLM至关重要，因为它使模型能够在特定情境下准确识别因果关系并支持更可靠的决策。尽管其重要性显著，但目前缺乏针对LLM语境因果性的系统性探索，因此本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 作者采用综述方法：首先提出语境因果性的分类法（语义、干预、反事实因果性），并从核心因果问题、所需模型能力、代表性任务和实际应用四个维度刻画每类；然后分析现有研究并讨论其关键局限；最后考察当前基准与现实需求的差距，并勾勒未来研究方向。
AI.result: 论文构建了语境因果性的分类框架，梳理了现有研究现状及其不足，明确了基准测试与实际应用之间的鸿沟，并提出了具有前景的未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 本文澄清了LLM语境因果性的研究全貌，强调了其重要性，并指出了未来研究的关键方向，为该领域的后续工作提供了系统性指导。

title: Representation-guided in-context learning for medical image interpretation with multimodal large language models
summary: Medical image interpretation is central to diagnosis and care, yet adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often requires resource-intensive domain-specific fine-tuning. Here we introduce representation-guided in-context learning (RG-ICL), a training-free inference framework that retrieves query-aligned demonstrations using frozen encoders, without task-specific parameter updates. Across eight datasets spanning histopathology, radiology and retinal fundoscopy, RG-ICL improved classification (mean gain 20 percentage points) and visual question answering (VQA) (mean gain 13 percentage points) over no-context and conventional ICL, approaching or exceeding training-based comparators. Which cases were retrieved mattered more than how many: 6 query-aligned cases outperformed up to 32 randomly selected ones, whereas fixed or random cases often reduced accuracy below baseline. For VQA, aligning reference cases with both image content and question intent produced further gains. These findings indicate that for medical image interpretation, curating which reference cases an MLLM sees is a practical alternative to retraining it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种无需训练的推理框架——表征引导的上下文学习（RG-ICL），通过冻结编码器检索与查询对齐的演示样本，在医学图像解读任务中显著提升分类和视觉问答性能，且少量高质量对齐样本优于大量随机样本，表明精选参考案例可替代模型微调。
AI.motivation: 现有通用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在医学图像解读中需资源密集的领域特定微调，因此需要一种无需参数更新的高效适配方法。
AI.method: 提出表征引导的上下文学习（RG-ICL），利用冻结编码器检索与查询图像/问题对齐的演示样本，无需任务特定参数更新，在组织病理学、放射学、视网膜底片八个数据集上验证。
AI.result: 分类任务平均提升20个百分点，VQA平均提升13个百分点，超越无上下文和传统ICL，接近或超过基于训练的对比方法；6个查询对齐样本优于32个随机样本，固定或随机样本常降低准确率；VQA中同时对齐图像内容和问题意图进一步增益。
AI.conclusion: 对于医学图像解读，精选MLLM可见的参考案例是一种切实可行的替代重新训练的方案。

title: EmbeddGAN: A Novel GAN Framework Using an Embedding Network and Gini Distance Correlation
comment: 18 Pages, 14 Figures, Submitted to IEEE Access, Awaiting Revisions
summary: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have demonstrated strong performance in generating high-quality synthetic data. However, they are limited by no formal guarantees regarding convergence and the effectiveness of the learning process. In practice, this leads to training instability, mode collapse, and sensitivity to hyperparameters. To address this, we propose EmbeddGAN, a novel adversarial training framework based on a dependence-based objective. Instead of relying on a discriminator that classifies samples as real or fake, EmbeddGAN introduces an embedding network that learns a representation in which statistical dependence between samples and their real/fake labels is maximized, while the generator is trained to minimize this dependence. This objective is implemented using the Gini distance correlation (gCor), which equals zero if and only if the embeddings are statistically independent of the real/fake label. Minimizing this objective therefore encourages real and generated samples to become statistically indistinguishable in the learned embedding space. The embedding network projects both real and generated data into a shared low-dimensional space, where distributional discrepancies can be measured directly through pairwise distances. We adopt a minimax training strategy: the embedding network maximizes the Gini distance correlation (maximizing dependence), while the generator minimizes it (minimizing dependence). Experiments on the MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CelebA datasets demonstrate that EmbeddGAN achieves competitive performance relative to established baselines while exhibiting notably stable training dynamics on the evaluated datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 EmbeddGAN，一种基于依赖度目标的新型对抗训练框架，用嵌入网络和 Gini 距离相关性（gCor）替代传统的判别器，通过极大极小博弈让生成器最小化嵌入与真假标签的统计依赖，从而实现稳定且高质量的生成。
AI.motivation: 传统 GAN 依赖判别器进行二分类，缺乏收敛的理论保证，导致训练不稳定、模式崩塌且对超参数敏感。
AI.method: 引入嵌入网络将真实样本与生成样本映射到共享低维空间，使用 Gini 距离相关性（gCor）度量嵌入与真假标签的统计依赖。采用极大极小训练策略：嵌入网络最大化 gCor（最大化依赖），生成器最小化 gCor（最小化依赖），使真假样本在嵌入空间中统计不可区分。
AI.result: 在 MNIST、CIFAR-10 和 CelebA 数据集上，EmbeddGAN 与主流基线性能相当，且展现出显著更稳定的训练动态。
AI.conclusion: 基于依赖度的对抗目标结合嵌入网络，能有效缓解 GAN 训练不稳定问题，提供了一种具有理论依据且实践表现良好的生成建模新范式。

title: Vox-Infinity: Benchmarking the Limits of Long-Context Spoken Language Models
summary: Long-context understanding remains a fundamental challenge for large language models, as excessively long inputs often lead models to forget salient information. This issue is even more pronounced in the speech domain, where audio, as a low-compression modality, requires substantially more embeddings than text to preserve both semantic content and acoustic cues. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{Vox-Infinity}, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate long-context understanding in spoken language models. Vox-Infinity systematically extends audio history along two dimensions: turn count and turn duration. It covers a diverse range of representative scenarios with varying interaction structures and semantic complexity. Crucially, Vox-Infinity provides explicit answer-provenance annotations and organizes samples according to the amount of historical context required to resolve each query, enabling precise and length-aware evaluation. Extensive evaluations of seven representative spoken language models reveal a clear overall recency effect: models generally achieve higher accuracy when answer-supporting evidence is closer to the query, but struggle to retrieve and use evidence located farther back in the dialogue history. Cases and datasets are available at https://vox-infinity.github.io.

AI.tldr: Vox-Infinity 是首个专门评估口语语言模型长上下文理解能力的基准，通过在轮次数量和轮次时长两个维度系统扩展音频历史，提供答案溯源标注和按所需历史上下文量组织的样本，评估揭示了七个代表性模型存在明显的近因效应：证据越接近查询准确率越高，但难以检索和利用对话历史中较远位置的证据。
AI.motivation: 长上下文理解仍是大语言模型的根本挑战，过长输入导致模型遗忘关键信息。语音领域更甚，音频作为低压缩模态，需要比文本多得多的嵌入来同时保留语义内容和声学线索。现有基准缺乏针对口语语言模型长上下文理解的系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建 Vox-Infinity 基准：1) 在轮次数量和轮次时长两个维度系统扩展音频历史；2) 覆盖多样化的代表性场景，包含不同交互结构和语义复杂度；3) 提供显式答案溯源标注；4) 按解决每个查询所需的历史上下文量组织样本，实现精确的长度感知评估。对七个代表性口语语言模型进行广泛评估。
AI.result: 七个代表性口语语言模型的评估揭示了明显的整体近因效应：当答案支持证据更接近查询时，模型通常获得更高准确率；但难以检索和利用位于对话历史更远处的证据。
AI.conclusion: Vox-Infinity 为口语语言模型的长上下文理解提供了首个专用基准，其精确的长度感知评估设计揭示了当前模型普遍存在的近因效应局限，为未来改进长距离上下文建模能力提供了明确的评测标尺和研究方向。

title: Incremental Consistency Execution for Autonomous Intelligent Systems
summary: Long-horizon autonomous intelligent systems rely on heterogeneous components such as large language models, databases, external APIs, and rule engines, while their external states continuously change during execution. Re-executing the entire workflow after every change introduces substantial redundant computation. This paper proposes an incremental consistency execution method based on task fact contracts, field-level dependency masks, and state perturbation result invariant domains. After an initial verified execution, the system constructs conservative invariant domains for critical inputs and uses them to determine whether downstream results can be safely renewed without re-invoking expensive components. When re-execution is required, only the smallest affected output fields are recomputed, and an equivalence barrier prevents unnecessary downstream propagation. A submission-time version consistency gate further ensures the safety of side-effecting actions. Experiments on industrial fault diagnosis, enterprise analytics, and LLM-based multi-tool assistants show that the proposed method significantly reduces expensive component calls and end-to-end latency while maintaining high consistency and low incorrect-reuse rates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于任务事实契约、字段级依赖掩码和状态扰动结果不变域的增量一致性执行方法，用于长时程自主智能系统，减少冗余计算，仅重新计算受影响的最小输出字段，并通过等价屏障和提交时版本一致性门控保证侧效应动作安全。
AI.motivation: 长时程自主智能系统包含异构组件（大语言模型、数据库、外部API、规则引擎），外部状态持续变化，每次变化后重新执行整个工作流会带来大量冗余计算。
AI.method: 基于任务事实契约、字段级依赖掩码、状态扰动结果不变域的增量一致性执行方法。初始验证执行后，构建关键输入的保守不变域，判断下游结果是否可安全更新而不重新调用昂贵组件。需要重新执行时，仅重新计算最小受影响输出字段，等价屏障防止不必要的下游传播。提交时版本一致性门控确保侧效应动作安全。
AI.result: 在工业故障诊断、企业分析、基于LLM的多工具助手实验中，显著减少昂贵组件调用和端到端延迟，同时保持高一致性和低错误复用率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了长时程自主系统中状态变化导致的冗余计算问题，通过增量一致性执行实现了高效且安全的系统运行。

title: The Ups and Downs of Backprop Weights
summary: Backpropagation (BP) has driven the remarkable success of modern deep learning by enabling large hierarchical networks to learn complex functions end-to-end. Yet it does not by itself determine how parameters should be organized so that functional components can be reused and adapted selectively. For example, object recognition and motion prediction may depend on overlapping parameter sets, making them difficult to isolate or modify independently. We call this condition weight entanglement. Modern architectures dynamically select which parts of a network process each sample: nonlinearities gate units, attention selects interactions, and Mixture-of-Experts architectures route inputs to modules. Yet such selection does not ensure that the same functional component remains linked to an identifiable parameter set across samples. We propose weight operators: parameterized modules that implement reusable functional components and can be composed at inference to form the function required by each sample. Learning proceeds in two stages: the model first infers the required operator composition, then updates only the selected operators' parameter sets. Vector Networks (VNs) provide one implementation. They couple operator selection to local error-driven updates within each layer and show that learned operators can be reused in combinations absent from training while updates remain restricted to the selected parameter sets. This provides a basis for testing functional parameter identifiability: whether an operator remains linked to the same functional component during learning. We argue that functional parameter identifiability may provide an organizing principle for models that systematically reuse and recombine learned functions while adapting only the components that need to change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出权重算子解决深度学习中的权重纠缠问题，通过两阶段学习实现功能组件的可复用与选择性更新，并引入向量网络（VNs）作为具体实现，验证了算子在未见组合中的泛化能力及功能参数可识别性。
AI.motivation: 反向传播虽使深度网络端到端学习成为可能，但无法决定参数如何组织以实现功能组件的复用与选择性适配。目标识别与运动预测等任务可能依赖重叠参数集，导致难以独立隔离或修改，即权重纠缠。现有动态选择机制（非线性门控、注意力、MoE）虽能路由输入，但无法保证同一功能组件在不同样本间与可识别参数集持续关联。
AI.method: 提出权重算子：实现可复用功能组件的参数化模块，推理时可组合形成各样本所需函数。学习分两阶段：第一阶段推断所需算子组合，第二阶段仅更新被选算子的参数集。向量网络（VNs）为一种实现，将算子选择与层内局部误差驱动更新耦合，使学习算子能在训练未见组合中复用，且更新限制在选定参数集内。此为测试功能参数可识别性提供基础。
AI.result: VNs 展示了学习到的算子可在训练中未出现的组合中复用，同时更新仅限于被选参数集，验证了功能参数可识别性：算子在学习过程中持续关联同一功能组件。
AI.conclusion: 功能参数可识别性可作为组织原则，指导模型系统性地复用与重组已学函数，仅适配需变组件，为解决权重纠缠、实现模块化深度学习提供新范式。

title: Apollo Restore: A Foundation LLM for Historical Greek Optimized for Fill-in-the-Middle Restoration of Ancient Greek Texts
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures. Paper is unchanged but edited abstract to avoid erroneous auto-linking
summary: We present Apollo Restore, a 24-billion-parameter large language model for restoring lacunae---physical gaps---in fragmentary Ancient Greek texts. Fine-tuned from Mistral Small with a fill-in-the-middle objective, Apollo Restore reconstructs missing spans without requiring oracle knowledge of their length. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale decoder model for historical Greek, and the first for any ancient Mediterranean language. Evaluated as in prior work, on short gaps of up to ten characters, Apollo Restore places the correct restoration among its top twenty candidates for 80.6%/54.6%/61.0% of documentary-papyrus, literary-papyrus, and stone-inscription lacunae, exceeding the strongest published models by $1.6\times$/$2.6\times$/$1.4\times$. Prior evaluation protocols, however, inflate scores through a bias toward trivially short gaps; under a length-balanced metric Apollo Restore's advantage over the strongest published models grows to $2.3\times$/$3.5\times$/$1.6\times$ and degrades gracefully, even given incorrect length hints. In a blind study, 20 expert papyrologists, epigraphists, and philologists strongly preferred Apollo Restore to the strongest baseline and judged its performance at least as good as human restorations in 77% of cases. Apollo Restore also improves the published reading of PHerc. 1667---a papyrus roll carbonised in the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 CE and digitally unrolled and edited after Apollo Restore's training data was compiled. Apollo Restore is an output of the Decoding Antiquity initiative to build specialized LLMs for historical languages and manuscripts, led by the Austrian Academy of Sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Apollo Restore，一个 240 亿参数的大语言模型，用于修复残缺古希腊文本（纸草文书、石刻铭文）中的物理缺失，微调自 Mistral Small，采用填充中间目标训练，无需预知缺口长度，在多项基准上大幅超越现有最强模型，并通过专家盲测验证，在 77% 的案例中表现不逊于人工修复，还成功改进了维苏威火山灰烬纸草 PHerc. 1667 的读本。
AI.motivation: 古希腊文本（纸草文献、石刻铭文）大量残缺，缺口修复极依赖专家经验且耗时。现有模型多为编码器架构、规模较小、需要知道缺口长度，且评测协议偏向短缺口，掩盖了长距离恢复的真实难度。亟需一个大规模解码器模型，能在无长度先验下泛化到各类文体和长缺口。
AI.method: 从 Mistral Small（24B）出发，在古希腊语语料上继续预训练并用填充中间目标微调，模型学会在任意长度的中间跨度进行自回归生成，推理时无需缺口长度提示。训练数据涵盖文献纸草、文学纸草、石刻铭文等多体裁，构建了首个面向历史希腊语的大规模解码器模型。
AI.result: 在标准短缺口（≤10 字符）上，Top-20 准确率分别为 80.6%/54.6%/61.0%（文献纸草/文学纸草/石刻），比最强基线高 1.6×/2.6×/1.4×。引入长度平衡指标后优势扩大到 2.3×/3.5×/1.6×，且随缺口增长优雅衰减。20 位专家盲测中，Apollo Restore 在 77% 案例被判定不劣于人工修复。实战中修正了 PHerc. 1667 的已发表读本。
AI.conclusion: Apollo Restore 是首个面向古希腊语的大规模解码器 LLM，填补了古地中海语言专用大模型的空白。它在无长度先验条件下实现了最先进的缺口修复性能，获得专家强烈偏好，并在真实碳化纸草卷上展示了实际学术价值，为 Decoding Antiquity 计划奠定了方法论与应用基石。

title: DocMIDE: Learning Multi-Hop Implicit Derivation in Visually Rich Documents
summary: Real-world document processing systems rely on rigid, predefined schemas, yet critical target fields often lack direct visual counterparts on the page. Extracting these implicit values requires multi-hop derivation, such as aggregating sub-categories or reasoning over visual marks. While existing methods handle explicit text spans or simple implicit queries, they fail at multi-hop visual reasoning even after standard fine-tuning: models retrieve incorrect visual evidence, or retrieve it correctly and then skip the intermediate steps of the derivation. To address this, we introduce DocMIDE, a fine-tuning framework that trains compact vision-language models to retrieve visual evidence explicitly before deriving an answer. DocMIDE constrains generation to a plan-retrieve-derive structure and optimizes it with Group Relative Policy Optimization under a four-component, rule-based reward that scores output format, the retrieved evidence block, every intermediate derivation step, and the final value against a verified reference trace. On a 4,151-pair implicit extraction benchmark, DocMIDE raises accuracy from 70.8% to 95.9% on Qwen3.5-4B from only a small set of annotated examples, and transfers to a second backbone architecture. Supervised demonstrations alone do not close this gap at any budget we tested; rewarding the intermediate steps is what does.

AI.tldr: DocMIDE 是一个微调框架，通过规划-检索-推导的结构化生成和基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的四维规则奖励，训练紧凑视觉-语言模型显式检索视觉证据并执行多跳推理，在隐式字段抽取基准上将 Qwen2.5-4B 准确率从 70.8% 提升至 95.9%，且可迁移至其他骨干网络。
AI.motivation: 现实文档处理系统依赖预定义模式，但关键目标字段常无直接视觉对应，需通过聚合子类别或推理视觉标记进行多跳推导。现有方法虽能处理显式文本跨度或简单隐式查询，但在标准微调后仍无法完成多跳视觉推理：模型要么检索错误证据，要么检索正确却跳过中间推导步骤。
AI.method: 提出 DocMIDE 框架，约束模型生成遵循“规划-检索-推导”三阶段结构，并采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）配合四维规则奖励：输出格式、检索证据块、每一中间推导步骤、最终数值与验证参考轨迹的一致性。仅需少量标注样本即可训练紧凑视觉-语言模型。
AI.result: 在 4,151 组隐式抽取基准上，DocMIDE 将 Qwen2.5-4B 准确率从 70.8% 大幅提升至 95.9%，且能迁移至第二种骨干架构。纯监督演示在所有预算下均无法缩小这一差距；奖励中间推导步骤是关键。
AI.conclusion: 显式训练模型检索视觉证据并逐步推导，结合对中间步骤的奖励机制，能有效解决多跳隐式字段抽取问题，显著优于纯监督微调，且具有良好的模型迁移性。

title: Benchmarking Hybrid Deep Learning Architectures for Predictive Maintenance in Industry 4.0
comment: Published in: 2026 IEEE International Conference on AI and Data Analytics (ICAD)
summary: Predictive maintenance in Industry 4.0 refers to using data from sensors, machines, and production systems to estimate when equipment is likely to fail, so maintenance can be planned before a breakdown occurs [1]. However, a model that predicts maintenance may work perfectly in the lab but fail unexpectedly when applied to real factory data [2]. To solve this "reliability" gap, we evaluated six deep learning architectures across more than 700 experimental runs. We focused on the two dominant approaches in the field: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), which process data step-by-step, like reading a sentence [3], and Transformers, a recent dominant approach, which look at the entire sequence at once to spot important connections [4]. We examined whether Transformers still outperform recurrent neural networks (RNNs) when the data includes noise [5]. We found that while Transformers excelled at tracking stable, slow-moving processes, they tend to overreact to chaotic data, mistakenly taking sensor noise for meaningful signals [6]. We also found that the hybrid method that combines a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) layer with a Transformer layer is more resilient to noisy data from factory shops [7]. Functioning as a noise filter, the LSTM smooths out data volatility, allowing the Transformer to focus on the bigger picture without being distracted [8]. The hybrid model did not just improve accuracy; it proved to be significantly more consistent than complex models, delivering reliable predictions regardless of how chaotic the underlying system became.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了六种深度学习架构在工业预测性维护中的表现，发现Transformer在稳定过程中表现优异但对噪声敏感，而LSTM-Transformer混合模型通过LSTM层滤噪，显著提升了在嘈杂工厂数据上的鲁棒性和预测一致性。
AI.motivation: 解决实验室模型在真实工厂数据中失效的“可靠性鸿沟”问题，探究Transformer与RNN在含噪工业时间序列数据上的实际表现差异，寻找更鲁棒的预测性维护模型。
AI.method: 在700多次实验中评估六种深度学习架构，重点对比RNN（如LSTM）与Transformer两大主流范式，并提出并测试LSTM-Transformer混合架构，考察其在不同噪声水平下的预测性能与稳定性。
AI.result: Transformer擅长捕捉缓慢稳定的过程模式，但易将传感器噪声误判为有意义信号导致过拟合；LSTM-Transformer混合模型中LSTM层充当噪声滤波器，平滑数据波动，使Transformer专注于长程依赖，该混合模型在准确率和预测一致性上均显著优于单一复杂模型。
AI.conclusion: 在工业级嘈杂数据环境下，单纯依赖Transformer存在可靠性风险；引入LSTM作为前置降噪模块的混合架构能有效平衡长程建模能力与抗噪鲁棒性，为落地预测性维护提供了更可靠的技术路径。

title: Toward Personalized Sleep Guidance from Wearable Data Using Language Models
summary: Sleep monitoring using wearable data has shown promise for personal health, yet large language model (LLM)-based summarization and question answering remain insufficient for personalized sleep guidance. Training specialized models, however, often requires costly expert annotation. Moreover, privacy and accessibility concerns motivate lightweight, local deployment for end users. We present a two-stage framework to address these challenges. Specifically, in Stage~1, a multi-agent LLM pipeline reasons structured sleep guidance from unannotated wearable records, enabling scalable dataset construction. Stage~2 distills guidance reasoning trajectories into small language models (SLMs) through supervised fine-tuning and integrates a training-free Best-of-$N$ selection strategy to enhance inference. Experimental results demonstrate our method outperforms commercial general and medical LLMs and open-source models. Human evaluation further supports the quality of the generated guidance and the feasibility of personalized sleep guidance with SLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段框架实现个性化睡眠指导：阶段1利用多智能体LLM流水线从未标注可穿戴数据生成结构化指导，构建可扩展数据集；阶段2通过监督微调将推理轨迹蒸馏至小语言模型(SLM)，并引入免训练Best-of-N选择策略提升推理质量。实验证明该方法优于商业通用/医疗LLM及开源模型，人工评估验证了生成指导的质量与SLM个性化睡眠指导的可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可穿戴数据的睡眠监测虽具潜力，但LLM摘要与问答在个性化睡眠指导上不足；训练专用模型需昂贵专家标注；隐私与易用性要求轻量级本地部署。需解决：无标注数据下的可扩展指导生成、推理能力向轻量模型的迁移、以及本地化部署的效能保障。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1) 多智能体LLM流水线：多智能体协作从原始可穿戴记录推理生成结构化睡眠指导，自动构建大规模无标注训练数据集。2) SLM蒸馏与推理增强：将阶段1的推理轨迹通过监督微调蒸馏至小语言模型；推理时采用免训练Best-of-N选择策略，从多候选输出中挑选最优指导。
AI.result: 实验显示该方法在睡眠指导任务上超越商业通用LLM、医疗专用LLM及开源模型；人工评估确认生成指导的临床相关性、个性化程度及可读性均达高水平；验证了SLM在资源受限端侧实现高质量个性化睡眠指导的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 通过多智能体自动化构建数据集与推理蒸馏至SLM，结合Best-of-N推理增强，实现了无需专家标注、隐私友好的端侧个性化睡眠指导。该范式为健康领域轻量级专用模型部署提供了可复用的技术路径。

title: Augmenting PID Control with Deep Reinforcement Learning: A Hybrid Approach to the Industrial Benchmark
comment: Published in: 2026 7th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Control (AIRC)
summary: As industrial processes grow in complexity, traditional Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controllers are often insufficient for handling their non-linear, multi-input dynamics. We propose using advanced Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) to prove its advantages in these complex environments. To do this, we rely on the Industrial Benchmark (IB). The IB is a realistic simulation that tests DRL algorithms against the key challenges of industrial applications: high-dimensional state spaces, delayed effects, and conflicting multi-criterial objectives. This testbed highlights DRL's core trade-off: while its final policies can often be unstable, its unique strength is the ability to autonomously discover optimal, non-obvious policies in multi-dimensional spaces where simple controllers fail. In this paper, we propose a novel hybrid PID-RL controller that leverages DRL's discovery capability while ensuring Reliability. After developing a multi-objective reward function to make DRL viable, we use a twin-delayed deep deterministic (TD3) agent as a discovery tool to find the optimal, non-obvious settings for the IB's 'Gain' and 'Shift' parameters. By feeding these discovered parameters to a simple, tuned PID controller, our hybrid model successfully combines all three characteristics: it achieves the optimal Performance and Efficiency of the best DRL agent with the Reliability of a classical controller. This work demonstrates a practical methodology for using DRL to augment, rather than replace, trusted industrial control systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种混合PID-RL控制器，利用TD3深度强化学习代理在工业基准(IB)中自主发现Gain和Shift参数的最优非直观设置，再将这些参数馈送给调优的PID控制器，实现了DRL的最优性能与效率与经典控制器可靠性的结合。
AI.motivation: 随着工业过程复杂度增加，传统PID控制器难以处理非线性、多输入动态；深度强化学习(DRL)虽能在高维状态空间、延迟效应和多目标冲突的工业环境中自主发现最优策略，但其最终策略往往不稳定，需结合经典控制器的可靠性。
AI.method: 基于工业基准(IB)开发多目标奖励函数使DRL可行，采用孪生延迟深度确定性策略梯度(TD3)代理作为发现工具搜索IB中Gain和Shift参数的最优设置，将发现的参数输入简单调优的PID控制器，构建混合PID-RL控制架构。
AI.result: 混合模型成功结合了最佳DRL代理的最优性能与效率以及经典PID控制器的可靠性，在性能、效率和可靠性三个关键特性上均达到优异水平。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为利用深度强化学习增强而非替代可信工业控制系统提供了一种实用方法论，展示了DRL作为参数发现工具辅助经典控制的有效性。

title: CultureMINE: Datasets and Methods for Improving the Cultural Capabilities of NLP Systems
summary: In recent years, there has been a surge of interest in Cultural NLP, with substantial efforts to create globally inclusive NLP systems. The rapid growth of literature in this field makes it difficult to track trends in methods and data resources. To address this, we analyze over 375 papers to answer three complementary questions: (1) What Cultural Capabilities (CCs) are being targeted in NLP systems? (2) How are cultural data resources being created? and (3) What methods are being used to improve the CCs of those systems? We discuss trends observed across the three questions, and identify relevant research gaps. To facilitate further research in this field, we release our full list of analyzed papers in the form of an interactive web interface, which includes a feature to allow researchers to add their work; we hope this facilitates future research and proves to be a valuable resource for the Cultural NLP community.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了文化自然语言处理(Cultural NLP)领域，分析了375余篇论文，梳理了NLP系统针对的文化能力(CCs)、文化数据资源构建方式、提升文化能力的方法，并发布了交互式Web界面供研究者查阅与补充。
AI.motivation: 随着文化NLP研究迅猛增长，文献激增导致难以追踪方法与数据资源趋势，亟需系统性综述以明确研究现状、发现空白，并为社区提供可持续更新的资源平台。
AI.method: 采用文献综述与定性分析相结合的方法：收集375+篇相关论文，围绕三个核心问题(目标文化能力、数据资源构建、提升方法)进行编码与归类，提炼跨问题趋势并识别研究空白，同时构建可交互的Web界面开放全量标注列表并支持社区增补。
AI.result: 梳理出NLP系统主要面向的文化能力类别、主流文化数据构建策略(如众包、专家标注、跨文化迁移等)及提升文化能力的技术路线(提示工程、微调、检索增强等)；总结了当前研究的共性趋势与关键空白(如低资源文化覆盖不足、评价基准缺失、文化细粒度建模薄弱等)。
AI.conclusion: 文化NLP虽快速发展但仍面临数据稀缺、评价体系不完善、文化建模粗粒度等挑战；发布的交互式资源库旨在促进持续跟踪与社区协作，推动面向全球包容性的NLP系统建设。

title: EDGEGEN: Improving Tool-Calling Agents Beyond Happy Paths with Synthetic Edge Case Generation
summary: Tool-calling LLM agents are increasingly deployed in enterprise applications. However, effective evaluation and optimization require high-quality, diverse task datasets that are often difficult to obtain due to privacy and other constraints. Existing synthetic task generation methods often produce generic tasks that ignore an agent's underlying state or database and fail to reflect real-world usage diversity. We propose EdgeGen, a synthetic task generation framework that extracts compliance rules from an agent's specification and uses them to generate database-grounded edge-case tasks designed to violate these rules. When combined with existing synthetic data generation techniques, EdgeGen enables agent improvement through finetuning and harness optimization. The resulting pipeline forms a fully automated closed-loop system that requires no human annotation. Finetuning on data generated by EdgeGen yields a consistent mean progress improvement of 2 percent to 42 percent on tau2bench airline domain, while other baseline methods show degradation for some models. On the other hand, for harness optimization, our method shows a mean progress improvement of 10 percent and 30 percent over the human-curated and base harnesses, respectively, for the Gemma-4-e4b model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EdgeGen 框架，从代理规范中提取合规规则，生成基于数据库的边缘案例任务以违反这些规则，结合现有合成数据生成技术，构建全自动闭环流水线，无需人工标注。在 tau2bench 航线领域微调实验中，EdgeGen 生成的数据带来 2%-42% 的平均进步提升；在工具链优化上，对 Gemma-4-e4b 模型分别比人工策划和基础工具链提升 10% 和 30%。
AI.motivation: 工具调用 LLM 代理在企业应用中广泛部署，但有效评估和优化需要高质量、多样化的任务数据集，受隐私等限制难以获取。现有合成任务生成方法往往产生通用任务，忽略代理底层状态或数据库，无法反映真实使用多样性。
AI.method: EdgeGen 从代理规范中提取合规规则，利用这些规则生成基于数据库的边缘案例任务，旨在违反规则。将其与现有合成数据生成技术结合，形成全自动闭环系统，支持通过微调和工具链优化提升代理性能，无需人工标注。
AI.result: 在 tau2bench 航线领域，使用 EdgeGen 生成的数据微调可使平均进步提升 2% 到 42%，而其他基线方法对某些模型表现下降。在工具链优化方面，对于 Gemma-4-e4b 模型，EdgeGen 分别比人工策划和基础工具链实现 10% 和 30% 的平均进步提升。
AI.conclusion: EdgeGen 通过基于合规规则的边缘案例生成，解决了合成数据缺乏真实性和多样性的问题，构建了无需人工干预的闭环优化流水线，显著提升了工具调用代理在评估和工具链优化上的表现，验证了自动化合成数据生成在企业级代理部署中的有效性。

title: TWIG: A Time-Causal Wavelet Operator for Autoregressive Forecasting on Irregular Graphs
summary: We introduce TWIG (Time-Causal Wavelet Operator for Irregular Graphs), a graph-native neural operator for autoregressive surrogate modeling on static irregular graphs.
