TWIG transforms each node history into causal multiscale temporal features that separate recent variation from progressively slower memory components, then propagates these features through graph-wavelet operator blocks with gated pointwise channel mixing. The architecture is causal by construction and designed for closed-loop forecasting, where predictions are recursively reused as future inputs. We evaluate TWIG on three irregular-domain forecasting problems spanning regional diffusion, three-dimensional subsurface hydrology, and aerodynamic flow, with graphs ranging from 400 to 5,233 nodes and model capacities from approximately 70k to 10M parameters. TWIG achieves the lowest aggregate rollout errors on the subsurface-hydrology and regional-diffusion benchmarks and ranks second on the 10M-parameter aerodynamic-flow benchmark, behind the GPS Transformer. Across all three settings, TWIG consistently outperforms the corresponding non-time-causal Graph WNO baseline. These results demonstrate that TWIG provides an effective and scalable approach to stable autoregressive forecasting of dynamical fields on irregular graphs.

AI.tldr: TWIG是一种面向静态不规则图的图原生神经算子，用于自回归代理建模。它将节点历史转换为因果多尺度时间特征，通过图小波算子块传播，实现稳定的闭环预测。在三个不规则域预测任务中，TWIG在两项基准上取得最低累积展开误差，在空气动力学流场基准上排名第二，且一致优于非因果Graph WNO基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在不规则图上进行稳定的自回归动态场预测存在困难，缺乏因果性构造和多尺度时间特征分离能力，难以实现长期闭环预测。
AI.method: TWIG将每个节点的历史转换为因果多尺度时间特征，分离近期变化与渐进式慢速记忆分量，再通过带门控逐点通道混合的图小波算子块传播特征。架构由构造保证因果性，专为闭环预测设计，预测结果递归作为未来输入。
AI.result: 在区域扩散、三维地下水文、空气动力学流场三个不规则域预测问题上评估（图节点400-5233，参数量70k-10M）。TWIG在地下水文和区域扩散基准上取得最低累积展开误差，在10M参数空气动力学基准上排名第二（仅次于GPS Transformer）。在所有设置中均一致优于非时间因果Graph WNO基线。
AI.conclusion: TWIG为不规则图上动态场的稳定自回归预测提供了一种有效且可扩展的方法，通过因果多尺度时间特征和图小波算子实现了优越的长期预测性能。

title: When Cosine Similarity Fails to Reflect Linearly Accessible Structure in Dialogue Models
summary: Cosine similarity is widely used to analyze transformer representations, implicitly assuming that similarity reflects task-relevant structure. We study when this assumption fails in dialogue-conditioned large language models. Across three 7-8B chat-tuned models, ambient cosine similarity substantially underestimates linearly decodable persona structure on the same hidden states; numerically, linear probe AUC is in the 0.73-0.97 range while cosine kNN is in the 0.56-0.77 range on a 30-class task. A low-dimensional supervised subspace recovers much of this gap, whereas a matched-rank PCA subspace does not and in some cases degrades performance. This mismatch is regime-dependent: it is absent in single-sentence sentiment classification (SST-5), and a matched-cardinality control rules out attribute cardinality as a confound. The gap does not systematically increase across dialogue turns, and the task-aligned subspace remains stable over time. However, two of three models violate a pre-registered within-subspace separability invariance criterion (|Delta AUC| <= 0.03), and one model violates a pre-registered turn-invariance criterion (|Delta L| <= 0.05). These results show that cosine similarity can fail to reflect task-aligned structure in dialogue representations even when that structure is linearly accessible.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在对话条件下的大语言模型中，余弦相似性无法准确反映任务相关的Persona结构，尽管这些结构在隐藏状态中是线性可解码的。线性探针AUC达到0.73-0.97，而余弦kNN仅为0.56-0.77。有监督子空间能恢复大部分差距，但PCA不能。该现象具有任务依赖性，在情感分类任务中不存在。
AI.motivation: 余弦相似性被广泛用于分析Transformer表示，隐含假设相似性反映任务相关结构。研究旨在探究这一假设在对话条件下的大语言模型中何时失效，特别是针对Persona（人设）结构的表示。
AI.method: 在三个7-8B参数的聊天调优模型上，对比线性探针与余弦kNN在30类Persona分类任务上的表现；引入低维有监督子空间和匹配秩的PCA子空间进行对比；在SST-5情感分类任务上进行控制实验；预注册了子空间可分性不变性准则（|ΔAUC|≤0.03）和轮次不变性准则（|ΔL|≤0.05）进行验证。
AI.result: 1) 余弦相似性显著低估线性可解码的Persona结构（线性探针AUC 0.73-0.97 vs 余弦kNN 0.56-0.77）；2) 有监督子空间恢复大部分差距，PCA子空间无效甚至降低性能；3) 该错配具有任务依赖性，在SST-5任务中不存在；4) 排除属性基数作为混淆因素；5) 差距不随对话轮次系统性增加，任务对齐子空间随时间稳定；6) 但3个模型中有2个违反子空间可分性不变性，1个违反轮次不变性。
AI.conclusion: 余弦相似性可能无法反映对话表示中的任务对齐结构，即使这些结构在隐藏状态中是线性可访问的。这揭示了表示空间几何结构与下游任务相关性之间的潜在不匹配，提示在对话语境下分析模型表示时需谨慎使用余弦相似性作为唯一度量。

title: Self-Healing Harness for Runtime Oversight of Agent Self-Modification
summary: LLM agents can change their own future behavior, raising a basic control question of which self-generated changes should be allowed to persist. We formulate this as admission control for self-modification. The agent may propose changes to its operating instructions, while an external runtime gate controls persistence. We implement this principle as a model-agnostic self-healing harness that runs a Detect, Notice, Heal, Validate loop around an otherwise unmodified agent. The agent authors candidate behavioral rules in an external workspace, where they receive provisional execution authority during evaluation and acquire persistent cross-episode authority only after measured improvement on the triggering failure without regression beyond a fixed margin on protected cases. Replay provides matched evidence when available, forward trials provide a weaker fallback, and a corpus-level guard re-tests the accumulated active rule set. Across 16 matched Baseline and Harness runs spanning AppWorld, Terminal-Bench, and $τ^2$-Bench, the gate rejected 383 replay-decided proposals. Of these, 211 (55%) improved their triggering failure while degrading a case that previously worked. This shows that locally beneficial self-modifications can introduce collateral regressions often enough to materially affect gate decisions, providing direct empirical motivation for external admission control. Task-completion score is higher under the Harness in all 16 pairs, with two paired bootstrap intervals excluding zero, while repeated-trial reliability is higher in 12 pairs, tied in 4, and lower in none. Because adaptation modifies the policy-inducing context while leaving model weights fixed, admitted changes remain inspectable, reversible, and compatible with closed-weight models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种模型无关的自我修复框架，通过外部准入控制机制管理LLM智能体的自我修改行为。实验表明，55%的局部有益修改会引入副作用回归，外部门控显著提升了任务完成率和可靠性，且修改保持可检查、可逆转且兼容闭源模型。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体能够自我修改未来行为，但局部有益的修改可能引入旁路回归（collateral regressions），需要一种机制来控制哪些自我生成的修改应被允许持久化。
AI.method: 实现了一个模型无关的自我修复框架，运行Detect（检测）、Notice（通知）、Heal（修复）、Validate（验证）循环。智能体在外部工作空间编写候选行为规则，获得临时执行权限进行评估，仅在触发故障上测得改进且在受保护用例上无超过固定边际的回归时，才获得持久跨回合权限。使用回放提供匹配证据，前向试验作为弱回退，语料库级防护重测累积活跃规则集。
AI.result: 在AppWorld、Terminal-Bench和τ²-Bench上的16组匹配实验中，门控拒绝了383个回放决策的提案，其中211个（55%）改进了触发故障但退化了先前工作的用例。Harness下任务完成分数在所有16组中均更高，两组配对bootstrap置信区间不含零；重复试验可靠性在12组中更高，4组持平，0组更低。
AI.conclusion: 外部准入控制对自我修改至关重要，因为局部有益修改常引入副作用回归。该框架通过修改策略诱导上下文而非模型权重，使修改保持可检查、可逆转，且兼容闭源权重模型，同时显著提升了任务完成率和可靠性。

title: User-Level Handover Decision Making Based on Machine Learning Approaches
summary: This letter covers a broad comparison of methods for classification and regression applications for a user-level handover decision making in scenarios with adverse propagation conditions involving buildings, coverage holes, and shadowing effects. The simulation campaigns are based on network simulator ns-3. The comparison encompasses classical machine learning approaches, such as KNN, SVM, and neural networks, but also state-of-the-art fuzzy logic systems and latter boosting machines. The results indicate that SVM and MLP are the most suitable for the classification of the best handover target, although fuzzy system SOFL can perform similarly with lower processing time. Additionally, for the download time estimation, LightGBM provides the smallest error with short processing time, even in hard propagation scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文在ns-3仿真平台上，针对建筑物遮挡、覆盖洞和阴影衰落等恶劣传播场景下的用户级切换决策，系统对比了KNN、SVM、MLP等经典机器学习方法、模糊逻辑系统SOFL以及LightGBM等梯度提升算法在分类（最佳切换目标识别）和回归（下载时间预估）任务上的表现。结果显示：SVM与MLP在分类准确率上最优，SOFL以更低计算开销达到近似性能；LightGBM在回归误差与推理延迟上均表现最佳，且对恶劣传播环境鲁棒性强。
AI.motivation: 在异构网络和复杂传播环境（建筑物阻挡、覆盖洞、阴影衰落）下，传统基于阈值的切换算法难以满足用户级精细化决策需求。亟需系统评估各类机器学习/模糊逻辑方法在切换目标分类与下载时间回归任务上的准确性、实时性及鲁棒性，为实际部署提供选型依据。
AI.method: 基于ns-3仿真器构建包含建筑物、覆盖洞和阴影衰落的恶劣传播场景，生成用户级切换数据集。对比分类任务：KNN、SVM、MLP（多层感知机）、自组织模糊逻辑系统SOFL；回归任务：LightGBM等梯度提升机。评估指标包括分类准确率、回归误差（MAE/RMSE）及模型训练/推理处理时间。
AI.result: 1. 分类任务：SVM与MLP在最佳切换目标识别上达到最高准确率；SOFL模糊系统准确率接近两者，但处理时间显著更低。2. 回归任务：LightGBM在下载时间预估上实现最小误差（MAE/RMSE），且推理延迟最短，在包含建筑物遮挡、覆盖洞等硬核传播场景下性能优势依然明显。
AI.conclusion: 针对用户级切换决策，分类场景推荐采用SVM或MLP以获取最高精度，或选择SOFL以平衡精度与实时性；回归场景首选LightGBM，兼顾高精度、低延迟及对恶劣传播环境的强鲁棒性。该对比研究为5G/6G异构网络中智能切换算法的工程落地提供了明确的模型选型指导。

title: Cross-Dialect NER for Bangla Regional Dialects Using Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation and Explainable AI
comment: Accepted for Publication in IEEE 3rd INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON COMPUTING, APPLICATIONS AND SYSTEMS (COMPAS 2026)
summary: Bangla, the seventh most spoken language in the world, exhibits significant regional dialectal diversity, with dialects such as Barishal, Chattogram, Sylhet, Noakhali, and Mymensingh differing in lexical, morphological, and syntactic characteristics. These variations pose substantial challenges for Named Entity Recognition (NER), limiting the generalization of models trained on Standard Bangla or a single regional dialect. This paper presents a cross-dialect Bangla NER framework using the publicly available ANCHOLIK-NER dataset, comprising 17,405 annotated sentences and 101,817 tokens across five major Bangla regional dialects. A Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation (LODOCV) strategy is adopted, training models on four dialects and evaluating on the remaining unseen dialect. Eight pretrained transformer-based models, including BanglaBERT, MuRIL, XLM-RoBERTa, and Multilingual-E5, are evaluated under identical experimental settings. Multilingual-E5 Large achieves the highest F1-score in every fold, peaking at 97.26% on Mymensingh and reaching its lowest, 82.38%, on Chattogram, the most challenging target dialect. To improve interpretability, Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) are applied to word-level predictions, revealing that the model's decisions are driven primarily by the surface form of the target entity word itself rather than by surrounding sentence context. These findings establish a benchmark for cross-dialect Bangla NER and demonstrate the effectiveness of transformer-based transfer learning for low-resource regional dialects, while highlighting the surface-form dependence of current models as a direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨方言孟加拉语命名实体识别（NER）框架，使用ANCHOLIK-NER数据集（17,405句，101,817词元，覆盖五大区域方言），采用留一法方言交叉验证（LODOCV）评估八种预训练Transformer模型。Multilingual-E5 Large在所有折上均达最高F1（峰值97.26% Mymensingh，最低82.38% Chattogram）。LIME解释显示模型决策主要依赖实体词表层形式而非上下文。确立跨方言孟加拉语NER基准，验证Transformer迁移学习对低资源方言的有效性，并指出表层形式依赖为未来改进方向。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语为世界第七大语言，存在显著区域方言差异（Barishal、Chattogram、Sylhet、Noakhali、Mymensingh等），词汇、形态、句法差异导致基于标准孟加拉语或单一方言训练的模型泛化能力受限，亟需跨方言NER基准与有效建模方法。
AI.method: 构建公开ANCHOLIK-NER数据集（五方言，17,405句，101,817词元）。采用留一法方言交叉验证（LODOCV）：四方言训练，一未见方言测试。在相同实验设置下评估八种预训练Transformer模型（BanglaBERT、MuRIL、XLM-RoBERTa、Multilingual-E5等）。引入LIME进行词级预测的局部可解释性分析。
AI.result: Multilingual-E5 Large在每折均获最高F1，Mymensingh方言达97.26%，最难Chattogram方言为82.38%。LIME揭示模型决策主要由目标实体词的表层形式驱动，而非周围句法上下文。
AI.conclusion: 确立了跨方言孟加拉语NER的基准，证明基于Transformer的迁移学习对低资源区域方言有效。同时指出当前模型对表层形式的依赖是未来研究需解决的关键问题。

title: APEXA: Execution-Integrity Enforcement for Multi-Agent LLM Automation of Synchrotron Data Reduction
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 4th TPC Workshop @ SC'26 (Building Open AI Infrastructure, Models, and Agentic Systems for Science). Code and benchmark: https://github.com/AdvancedPhotonSource/APEXA-APS-Beamline-Assistant ; data: https://doi.org/10.18126/tgg4-1m26
summary: Synchrotron data reduction, detector calibration followed by azimuthal integration of terabyte-scale diffraction series, is a multi-step, expert-bound bottleneck that increasingly limits the science rate of user facilities. LLM agents promise to collapse it, but driving a real pipeline with a stochastic model creates a failure mode chat benchmarks cannot see: an agent can report a calibration that was never computed. Correctness here is a property of what executed, not of the transcript. We present APEXA, a deployed multi-agent framework (61 tools over heterogeneous compute, run as a single reasoning loop) automating calibration and integration from natural language at a major light source. We make three contributions. First, execution-integrity enforcement: a deterministic tool-layer guard that refuses to surface any result not backed by an executed tool call, with a parser tolerant of cross-model tool-call format drift: in deployment, a frontier model fabricated a complete calibration-comparison report for commands that never ran, which the guard converts to an explicit non-result; the same code gates an optional motor-control surface at 0/200 adversarial violations against a simulated IOC, versus 15/200 for an equivalent safety prompt. Second, we release APEXA-Bench, an evaluation harness of 58 facility tasks (50 base plus an 8-task cross-detector slice) organized by a four-class physical-consequence taxonomy, the first benchmark axis we know of separating a wasted compute cycle from a damaged instrument; its cross-detector grading against NIST-traceable lattice constants surfaced two latent pipeline bugs. Large-scale agent scoring is left to a full-length study. Third, we validate APEXA on real beamline data: from one natural-language prompt it recovers detector geometry and integrates a full attenuation/exposure sweep. We release the framework, harness and traces.

AI.tldr: APEXA是一个部署在大型光源设施的多智能体框架，通过执行完整性强制、基准测试APEXA-Bench和真实束线数据验证，实现了从自然语言自动化同步辐射数据还原、探测器标定和方位积分。
AI.motivation: 同步辐射数据还原、探测器标定和TB级衍射序列的方位积分是一个多步骤、专家依赖的瓶颈，日益限制用户设施的科学产出率。LLM智能体虽有潜力解决此问题，但用随机模型驱动真实管道会产生聊天基准无法发现的故障模式：智能体可能报告从未计算过的标定结果。正确性取决于实际执行而非对话记录。
AI.method: APEXA是一个部署的多智能体框架，包含61个跨异构计算的工具，作为单一推理循环运行。三大核心贡献：1) 执行完整性强制：确定性工具层防护，拒绝呈现任何无执行工具调用支撑的结果，解析器容忍跨模型工具调用格式漂移；2) 发布APEXA-Bench：包含58项设施任务的评估套件，按四类物理后果分类法组织，首个区分浪费计算周期与损坏仪器的基准轴，交叉探测器基于NIST可溯源晶格常数评分揭示两个潜在管道bug；3) 在真实束线数据验证：从单一自然语言提示恢复探测器几何并积分完整衰减/曝光扫描。
AI.result: 在部署中，前沿模型为从未运行的命令捏造完整标定对比报告，防护机制将其转为显式非结果；同代码在模拟IOC上对抗性违规测试中以0/200完胜提示词安全基线15/200。APEXA-Bench交叉探测器评分发现两个潜在管道bug。真实束线数据验证中，单一自然语言提示即恢复探测器几何并完成全衰减/曝光扫描积分。已开源框架、套件及执行追踪。
AI.conclusion: APEXA通过执行完整性强制解决了LLM智能体驱动科学管道的可靠性危机，APEXA-Bench建立了首个基于物理后果的智能体评估分类学，真实部署验证了其在大型光源设施的实用性。该工作推动了科学智能体从聊天基准走向生产级可信自动化。

title: Concurrency-Aware Process Model Forecasting with Causal Nets
summary: Process model forecasting (PMF) aims to predict the process model that will characterize a future period, thereby providing a process-level view of how behavior is expected to evolve. Existing PMF methods, however, forecast directly-follows graphs, which cannot explicitly represent concurrency. We extend PMF to causal nets by forecasting time series of relation and binding counts and using these forecasts to reconstruct future process models with AND/XOR semantics. To evaluate the resulting models, we introduce a protocol that accounts for partial traces and constructs the workflow nets required for conformance checking. Experiments on four event logs show that the forecasted models achieve conformance levels close to those of models re-mined from observations in the corresponding future windows. They also outperform static discovery baselines, which retain high precision on the structurally stable log but exhibit substantial precision losses on the other three logs. Filtering infrequent bindings improves most conformance metrics, although it also removes much of the concurrent behavior captured by the models.

AI.tldr: 本文将过程模型预测(PMF)扩展到因果网,通过预测关系和绑定计数的时间序列并重构带有AND/XOR语义的未来过程模型,解决了现有方法基于直接跟随图无法显式表示并发的问题。实验表明预测模型的合规性接近从未来观测重挖掘的模型,优于静态发现基线,过滤低频绑定虽提升大多数合规指标但会移除大量并发行为。
AI.motivation: 现有的过程模型预测方法仅预测直接跟随图,无法显式捕捉并发行为(AND分支/合并),限制了预测模型的表达能力和准确性。需要一种能够预测包含并发语义(AND/XOR)的因果网模型的方法,并建立相应的评估协议来验证预测质量。
AI.method: 1. 将PMF扩展到因果网:预测关系计数和绑定计数的时间序列,利用预测值重构具有AND/XOR语义的未来因果网模型。2. 提出评估协议:考虑部分轨迹,构建工作流网以进行一致性检查。3. 在四个事件日志上实验,对比预测模型、从未来窗口重挖掘的模型和静态发现基线的合规性表现,并分析过滤低频绑定的影响。
AI.result: 预测模型在四个日志上达到的合规水平接近从相应未来窗口观测重挖掘的模型;显著优于静态发现基线(后者在结构稳定日志上保持高精度,但在其他三个日志上精度大幅下降)。过滤低频绑定改善了大多数合规指标,但也移除了模型捕获的大部分并发行为。
AI.conclusion: 基于因果网的PMF方法有效解决了并发建模缺失问题,预测模型质量接近真实未来模型并优于静态基线。评估协议为部分轨迹下的一致性检查提供了可行方案。过滤低频绑定存在权衡:虽提升整体合规性但牺牲并发行为表达,未来需探索更细粒度的绑定选择策略。

title: Correct Diagnosis, Better Feedback: A Symbolic-Verifier for Faithful LLM Tutoring Feedback in Logic Proofs
summary: Effective LLM tutoring depends on correctly identifying the specific error in a student's reasoning before generating feedback. We study this problem in propositional-logic proof tutoring, where student actions can be checked against formal inference rules. We introduce a verifier-grounded architecture that separates diagnosis from language generation. Using 600 balanced student actions, we compare a zero-shot LLM detector, a fine-tuned detector, and a symbolic verifier. Each diagnosis is processed by shared rationale and feedback agents, isolating the effect of the initial diagnosis. The zero-shot detector achieves a macro-F1 of 0.191; fine-tuning raises this to 0.709 but retains systematic errors between structurally related classes. Rationales generally preserve the diagnosis supplied to them, showing that an incorrect diagnosis can be faithfully propagated through the pipeline. Feedback can likewise remain faithful to its rationale, non-revealing, and pedagogically appropriate while addressing the wrong error. Verifier-grounded feedback achieves the highest diagnostic correctness, and expert ratings largely uneven with the automatic feedback evaluations. These findings show that apparent feedback quality can conceal upstream diagnostic errors and that faithfulness must be evaluated separately from correctness. Our code is publicly available

AI.tldr: 论文研究在命题逻辑证明辅导中，如何准确诊断学生推理错误并生成反馈。提出基于验证器的架构，将诊断与语言生成分离。对比零样本LLM检测器、微调检测器和符号验证器，发现微调虽提升宏F1至0.709但仍有系统性错误；错误诊断会被忠实传播至推理和反馈生成；专家评分与自动评估差异大。结论：表面反馈质量可能掩盖上游诊断错误，需单独评估忠实性与正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM辅导系统在生成反馈前需准确识别学生推理中的具体错误，但在命题逻辑证明等形式化领域，学生动作可对照形式推理规则检查。现有方法常将诊断与生成耦合，导致错误诊断被掩盖，且缺乏对诊断正确性与生成忠实性的分离评估。
AI.method: 构建基于验证器的架构，分离诊断（零样本LLM、微调LLM、符号验证器）与语言生成（共享理由代理和反馈代理）。使用600个平衡的学生动作数据集，对比三种诊断器的宏F1，并分析错误诊断在管道中的传播情况，同时收集专家评分与自动评估指标。
AI.result: 零样本LLM宏F1仅0.191；微调提升至0.709但保留结构相关类别间的系统性错误。理由代理忠实保留输入诊断，导致错误诊断被忠实传播；反馈代理亦能生成看似合理、教学上适当但针对错误诊断的反馈。验证器基础反馈达最高诊断正确性，专家评分与自动评估大相径庭。
AI.conclusion: 表面反馈质量可能掩盖上游诊断错误，忠实性评估必须与正确性评估分离。符号验证器在诊断正确性上优于LLM，但需结合生成模块的忠实性分析。代码已公开。

title: CREDO: Variance-Guided Rubric Evolution for Replay-Corrected Credit Assignment
summary: Long-horizon language agents receive sparse terminal feedback, while intermediate rubrics provide structured but potentially misspecified assessments of progress. In resettable training environments, counterfactual continuation rollouts can measure local credit, but exhaustive replay is costly. We propose Credo, a framework that couples evolving semantic rubrics with selective, execution-based credit correction. A frozen judge maps visible transitions to rubric features, and a credit head predicts the change in expected terminal reward associated with the realized transition. Independently sampled two-sided replays correct prediction residuals using their recorded inclusion probabilities. We derive conditional unbiasedness and a variance decomposition that connects two design choices: which rubric features to retain, and where to allocate a fixed expected replay budget. The resulting criterion weights prediction errors by policy-score sensitivity and missing replay coverage; its allocation rule additionally accounts for continuation cost. We also describe a practical mixture with terminal leave-one-out advantages and distinguish its clipped, token-normalized PPO implementation from the ideal policy-gradient estimator. This preliminary report provides the method, proofs, an exact finite-model audit, and a controlled evaluation protocol. It makes no claim of empirical superiority on language-agent benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Credo 框架，结合演化语义评分细则与选择性执行信用修正，通过冻结评判器、信用头和双向重放，实现长程语言智能体的局部信用分配，并给出理论保证与实用 PPO 实现。
AI.motivation: 长程语言智能体面临稀疏终端反馈，中间评分细则虽提供结构化进度评估但可能规范错误；在可重置环境中，反事实延续重放虽能测度局部信用，但穷举重放代价高昂，亟需高效且理论可靠的信用分配方法。
AI.method: Credo 框架包含：1) 冻结评判器将可见转移映射为评分细则特征；2) 信用头预测已实现转移带来的期望终端奖励变化；3) 独立采样的双向重放利用记录的纳入概率修正预测残差；推导条件无偏性与方差分解，得到按策略得分敏感度与缺失重放覆盖加权的预测误差准则，及考虑延续成本的重放预算分配规则；实用层面结合终端留一优势，给出裁剪、token 归一化的 PPO 实现。
AI.result: 理论上证明了条件无偏性及方差分解，明确了评分细则特征保留与重放预算分配的最优权衡；提供了精确有限模型审计与受控评估协议；实现了实用的 PPO 变体。
AI.conclusion: 该工作作为初步报告，确立了方法、证明、审计与评估协议，未声称在语言智能体基准上具有实证优势，为后续实证研究奠定理论与工程基础。

title: Classification with Abstention Under Class-Conditional Error Constraints
summary: We study binary classification with abstention under separate class-conditional error constraints, with the objective of minimizing abstention while keeping both errors below prescribed thresholds. We characterize the distribution-free minimax rate of excess abstention risk, up to logarithmic factors, in terms of the complexity of the hypothesis class and the sample size. To make the framework amenable to computation with models such as neural networks, we introduce surrogate-loss formulations and derive finite-sample guarantees for excess surrogate ambiguity risk. We formulate the resulting learning task as a constrained optimization problem and characterize its computational complexity in the convex setting. Finally, we evaluate our approach on various datasets and compare its performance with a competing method for this problem.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究带有拒绝选项的二分类问题，在单独的类条件误差约束下最小化拒绝率，刻画了分布无关的极小极大最优率，提出代理损失公式并给出有限样本保证，将其表述为约束优化问题并分析计算复杂度，最后在多个数据集上实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有带拒绝选项的分类方法多关注总体误差约束，但实际应用中往往需要分别控制两类条件误差（如医疗诊断中假阴性和假阳性成本不同），因此需要在单独类条件误差约束下最小化拒绝率的理论框架和计算方法。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析：刻画假设类复杂度和样本量下的分布无关极小极大超额拒绝风险率（对数因子内）。 2. 代理损失：引入代理损失公式使框架适配神经网络等模型，推导超额代理模糊风险的有限样本保证。 3. 优化表述：将学习任务表述为约束优化问题，在凸设定下刻画计算复杂度。 4. 实验评估：在多个数据集上对比现有竞争方法。
AI.result: 给出了超额拒绝风险的极小极大最优率（对数因子内），建立了代理损失方法的有限样本泛化界，证明了凸设定下约束优化问题的计算可行性，实验显示所提方法在各数据集上优于竞争基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为带单独类条件误差约束的拒绝分类提供了完整的理论-算法框架，兼顾统计最优性与计算可行性，代理损失方法使深度学习模型可直接应用，为安全关键领域的分类决策提供了实用工具。

title: Do Student LLMs Inherit OOD Robustness? Invariance-Weighted Distillation for Reliable Knowledge Transfer
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) aims to compress high-performance teacher LLMs into lightweight students. However, distilled students often exhibit substantial performance degradation in out-of-distribution (OOD) settings, a critical gap that remains underexplored. We identify two compounding mechanisms causing OOD performance degradation: (1) data spuriousness: students can learn spurious correlations in the distillation dataset over genuine causal relationships; and (2) teacher capability: standard KD treats all samples uniformly, ignoring whether the teacher is guided by causal features or misled by spurious shortcuts on a given sample. To address these challenges, we propose Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD), a theoretically grounded framework that dynamically reweights training samples using an estimate of the teacher's causal reliance derived from prediction invariance across multiple synthetic environments. IWD perturbs spurious cues while preserving core semantics, assigning higher distillation weights to samples whose teacher predictions remain invariant, indicating greater reliance on causal rather than spurious features. We theoretically show that IWD reduces the student's Spurious-to-Causal (S2C) gradient ratio compared to standard uniformly weighted KD, driving the student toward more invariant representations. Experiments on four NLP benchmarks (MNLI, SQuAD-v2, CoNLL-2003 NER, and SST-2) across two model families (DeBERTa-v3 and Qwen-2.5) demonstrate that IWD consistently outperforms strong KD baselines on OOD evaluations while maintaining competitive in-distribution (ID) performance. Specifically, IWD achieves the highest accuracy in 15 out of 16 OOD benchmarks and improves average OOD performance over standard KD by 4.34 percentage points on NLI and 14.94 percentage points on QA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出不变性加权蒸馏（IWD），通过基于教师模型在多个合成环境中预测不变性的样本动态重加权，解决知识蒸馏中学生模型在分布外（OOD）设置下的性能下降问题。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏旨在将高性能教师大语言模型压缩为轻量级学生模型，但蒸馏后的学生模型在分布外（OOD）设置中常表现出显著性能下降。主要原因有二：（1）数据虚假性：学生模型可能在蒸馏数据集中学习虚假相关性而非真实因果关系；（2）教师能力：标准知识蒸馏统一对待所有样本，忽略教师在特定样本上是依赖因果特征还是被虚假捷径误导。
AI.method: 提出不变性加权蒸馏（IWD），一种理论基础框架。通过扰动虚假线索同时保留核心语义，构建多个合成环境，利用教师模型在这些环境中的预测不变性来估计其因果依赖程度。对预测保持不变的样本赋予更高蒸馏权重，表明教师更依赖因果特征而非虚假特征。理论证明IWD降低了学生模型的虚假-因果（S2C）梯度比，驱动学生学习更不变的表示。
AI.result: 在四个NLP基准（MNLI、SQuAD-v2、CoNLL-2003 NER、SST-2）和两个模型家族（DeBERTa-v3、Qwen-2.5）上实验表明，IWD在OOD评估上持续优于强基线，同时保持有竞争力的分布内（ID）性能。具体而言，IWD在16个OOD基准中有15个达到最高准确率，相较标准KD，NLI任务平均OOD性能提升4.34个百分点，QA任务提升14.94个百分点。
AI.conclusion: IWD通过基于不变性的动态样本重加权，有效缓解了知识蒸馏中的OOD性能下降问题，使学生模型更依赖因果特征，在多个NLP任务和模型架构上展示了显著的OOD泛化提升，且不牺牲ID性能。

title: LIMIT: Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL
summary: Large language models have achieved remarkable progress on Text-to-SQL through reasoning-enhanced fine-tuning, yet existing approaches predominantly rely on massive instruction corpora under the assumption that scale drives performance. We challenge this paradigm by investigating a fundamental question: what is the minimal data requirement for effective Text-to-SQL instruction tuning? We propose LIMIT(Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL), a data-centric framework that demonstrates strong database reasoning can emerge from an extremely compact training set when examples are strategically selected. LIMIT operates through four stages: difficulty-aware filtering that identifies samples within the model's learning frontier, chain-of-thought synthesis with consistency-based selection, multi-dimensional quality scoring via LLM-as-judge, and genetic algorithm optimization that jointly maximizes schema coverage and sample quality. On the BIRD and Spider benchmark, LIMIT selects only 796 and 863 samples while achieving 100% table coverage, enabling Qwen3-8B to reach 69.1% and 88.9% execution accuracy.This result surpasses methods trained on 20 times more data and establishes a new state-of-the-art among open-source approaches. Our findings suggest that careful data curation, rather than scale, is the key to efficient Text-to-SQL learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LIMIT 框架，通过策略性数据选择实现极小规模训练集（BIRD 796 样本、Spider 863 样本）下的高性能 Text-to-SQL，Qwen3-8B 达到 69.1% 和 88.9% 执行准确率，超越 20 倍数据量的方法，确立开源新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 Text-to-SQL 方法依赖大规模指令数据假设规模驱动性能，作者质疑这一范式，探究有效指令微调的最小数据需求，旨在证明精心策划的小规模数据优于盲目扩大规模。
AI.method: LIMIT 四阶段流程：1) 难度感知过滤识别模型学习前沿样本；2) 思维链合成与一致性筛选；3) LLM-as-judge 多维质量评分；4) 遗传算法联合优化模式覆盖与样本质量。
AI.result: 在 BIRD 和 Spider 基准上，仅用 796/863 样本即实现 100% 表覆盖，Qwen3-8B 执行准确率分别达 69.1% 和 88.9%，超越 20 倍训练数据的方法，在开源模型中达到 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，对于 Text-to-SQL 任务，精细的数据筛选策略比单纯增加数据规模更关键，少量高质量样本即可激发强大的数据库推理能力。

title: Monotone-Constrained Diffusion Models for Long-Horizon Production Forecasting
comment: 34 pages, 4 figures. Under review at the Journal of Machine Learning Research. Extended version of a paper at Canadian AI 2026 (PMLR 318, pp. 332-341)
summary: Forecasting a long horizon from only the first observations of a sequence is ill-posed: many trajectories are consistent with the same short history. We study this problem in oil and gas production forecasting, where forecasts made after roughly the first fifth of a well's producing life drive development and abandonment decisions, and where a usable forecast must describe a monotone decline. We present Physics-SIMS-TS, a conditional diffusion forecaster that combines negative guidance against synthetic artifacts, decline-curve constraints and an isotonic projection applied during sampling, spatial training augmentation, and an ensembled stochastic sampler yielding a full predictive distribution. Across three jurisdictions and more than 35,000 wells, under a shared-space, validation-frozen protocol, Physics-SIMS-TS is the most accurate diffusion forecaster in the comparison and is competitive with, but not superior to, ensembled transformer forecasters. Its forecasts are monotone by construction at a cost of at most 0.5% in mean squared error, and its trajectory ensemble yields calibrated intervals after one dispersion factor is fitted per jurisdiction. On six standard benchmarks a reversible-instance-normalization variant of the backbone is the leading diffusion baseline. We also quantify four protocol choices on which the measured ranking depends. Code and evaluation artifacts are released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Physics-SIMS-TS，一种用于油气井产量长期预测的条件扩散模型，结合负向引导、递减曲线约束、同序投影、空间增强和集成随机采样器，在三个司法管辖区3.5万口井上验证，成为最准确的扩散预测器，与集成Transformer竞争但未超越，预测单调且校准良好。
AI.motivation: 油气井产量预测需在生产早期（约前1/5寿命）做长期预测，属于 ill-posed 问题：短历史对应多条可能轨迹。实际决策要求预测单调递减，现有方法难以同时满足精度、单调性和不确定性量化。
AI.method: Physics-SIMS-TS 是条件扩散预测器，包含：1) 针对合成伪影的负向引导；2) 采样时施加递减曲线约束与同序投影保证单调性；3) 空间训练增强；4) 集成随机采样器输出完整预测分布。骨干网络采用可逆实例归一化变体。
AI.result: 在共享空间、验证冻结协议下，Physics-SIMS-TS 是对比中最准确的扩散预测器，与集成Transformer竞争但未超越。单调性构造代价≤0.5% MSE。轨迹集成经每司法管辖区拟合一个离散因子后产出校准区间。在六个标准基准上，骨干变体为最强扩散基线。并量化了四个影响排名的协议选择。
AI.conclusion: Physics-SIMS-TS 通过物理约束与扩散建模结合，实现了单调、校准且高精度的油气井长期产量预测，虽未超越最强Transformer集成，但作为扩散基线达到了最优，并揭示了评估协议对排名的敏感性，代码与评估工件已开源。

title: Preserving What Matters: Semantic Scaffolds Beyond Saturation in Summarization Evaluation
comment: Accepted at the AIMS Workshop at COLM 2026
summary: Summarization ships in countless production systems, making model selection a routine decision that depends on measuring summary quality. Existing metrics struggle to support this: ROUGE captures only surface overlap, while LLM-as-judge scores saturate to near-identical values that fail to rank models effectively. We observe this saturation across three public datasets, two proprietary datasets, and multilingual settings. Motivated by this, we introduce Semantic Scaffold, an evaluation framework that extracts a hierarchical representation of facts, questions, and entity attributes from a source text, labeling each as a main point or supporting detail, and reusing this structure as a fixed reference for scoring summaries. From this representation, we derive three diagnostic metrics: Fact Preservation Score (FPS), Question Preservation Score (QPS), and Entity Preservation Score (EPS), designed to reward the preservation of essential information while penalizing detail overload, and position them as interpretable diagnostics that remain informative where holistic axes collapse. Finally, we analyze four recurring failure modes of ROUGE and LLM-as-judge scores, demonstrating that scaffold-based evaluation remains informative where conventional metrics collapse.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Semantic Scaffold评估框架，通过提取源文本的层级事实、问题和实体属性表示，并标记主次点，构建固定参考结构来评估摘要质量。由此衍生出三个诊断指标：事实保留分(FPS)、问题保留分(QPS)、实体保留分(EPS)，旨在奖励核心信息保留、惩罚细节过载，并在整体指标失效时仍保持诊断力。实验表明该框架能有效识别ROUGE和LLM-as-judge的四种典型失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有摘要评估指标存在局限：ROUGE仅捕捉表面重叠，而LLM-as-judge评分在多个公开/专有数据集及多语言场景中普遍饱和至近似值，无法有效排序模型。需要一种能区分核心信息与支撑细节、且在整体指标失效时仍具诊断能力的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出Semantic Scaffold框架：从源文本提取事实、问题、实体属性的层级表示，标记每个元素为主点或支撑细节，将该结构作为固定参考。基于此衍生三个诊断指标：FPS(事实保留分)、QPS(问题保留分)、EPS(实体保留分)，分别衡量核心事实、关键问题、实体属性的保留情况，同时惩罚非必要细节堆砌。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集、两个专有数据集及多语言设置上验证：Semantic Scaffold指标在ROUGE和LLM-as-judge评分饱和失效时仍保持区分度；系统分析了四类典型失效模式(如细节过载、核心遗漏等)，证明脚手架评估能在这些场景下提供有效诊断。
AI.conclusion: Semantic Scaffold通过结构化语义表示和分层诊断指标，解决了现有指标饱和和缺乏解释性的问题，为摘要模型选择提供了更可靠、可解释的评估工具，且在常规指标失效的场景下仍具鲁棒性。

title: SKstars at SHROOM: Visions Agreement-Guided Ensembling of Zero-Shot and LoRA-Adapted Vision--Language Models
comment: This paper has been accepted at the SHROOM-Visions 2026 Shared Task, co-located with EMNLP2026
summary: This paper describes the SKstars submission to SHROOM-Visions 2026, a shared task on fine-grained hallucination detection in large vision-language model outputs. The task requires systems to identify hallucinated character spans, assign hallucination categories, and provide confidence estimates for their predictions. Our approach combines zero-shot predictions from Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct with those of a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model. The outputs of the two models are integrated through a lightweight ensemble procedure, followed by span refinement and confidence adjustment. We evaluate the main system components on a small internal development subset and report the performance of the submitted system on the official English test set. SKstars achieved a Cor+Lbl score of 0.2902, ranking 15th among 29 teams, and obtained Cor and IoU scores of 0.3642 and 0.3151, respectively, ranking 18th on both metrics. The results show that combining a large zero-shot model with a smaller adapted model provides a practical framework for multilingual and fine-grained hallucination localization, while also highlighting the difficulty of transferring development-set improvements to hidden test data. Code and predictions: https://github.com/aliathar1401/SK-Stars-shroom-visions-2026

AI.tldr: SKstars团队在SHROOM-Visions 2026细粒度幻觉检测共享任务中，融合Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct零样本预测与LoRA适配的Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct预测，经轻量级集成、跨度细化与置信度调整，于英语测试集获Cor+Lbl 0.2902（第15名）、Cor 0.3642与IoU 0.3151（均第18名）。
AI.motivation: 针对大型视觉语言模型输出中的细粒度幻觉检测需求，需同时完成幻觉字符跨度定位、类别标注及置信度估计，旨在构建可迁移的多语言幻觉定位框架。
AI.method: 采用零样本大模型Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct与LoRA微调小模型Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct双模型预测，通过轻量级集成融合输出，随后进行跨度细化与置信度校准，形成最终提交系统。
AI.result: 官方英语测试集上Cor+Lbl得分0.2902列第15/29，Cor与IoU分别为0.3642和0.3151并列第18；内部开发集改进难以有效泛化至隐藏测试集。
AI.conclusion: 大零样本模型与小适配模型结合为多语言细粒度幻觉定位提供了实用范式，但也揭示了从开发集向未见测试集迁移性能的挑战。

title: Multi-Armed Bernoulli Bandits via Minimax Single-Arm Stopping
comment: This work is a preprint and has not been submitted to any conference or journal yet
summary: We develop an index policy for finite-horizon Bernoulli multi-armed bandits from minimax solutions to single-arm bandit (SAB) problems. Each SAB problem involves choosing between an unknown Bernoulli arm and a known reward. We show that minimizing worst-case regret of SAB problems over all non-anticipative policies admits an exact semi-infinite linear programming formulation. The resulting stopping policies offer a natural way to compare arms: the higher the known reward against which a policy continues sampling, the more promising the unknown arm. We turn this intuition into indices based on cumulative continuation probabilities, with a monotone adjustment and a reward-shortfall cap. By relating index errors to the regret of single-arm stopping policies, we establish a distribution-free regret bound of $4.45\sqrt{KT}+10.75K$ for $K$ arms and horizon $T$. This bound matches the minimax-optimal regret order established in the literature. The guarantee extends to rewards supported on $[0,1]$ through Bernoulli randomization. We also provide a finite-grid implementation with quantified approximation loss. In numerical experiments, the SAB-based index policy achieves lower worst-case regret than every tested benchmark policy across all evaluated numbers of arms and horizons, while closely matching the grid-based MAB minimax policy in the two-arm setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于单臂老虎机(SAB)极小化极大解的指数策略，用于有限时域Bernoulli多臂老虎机问题。通过半无限线性规划精确求解SAB问题，构建基于累积持续概率的指数，并证明分布无关的遗憾上界为4.45√(KT)+10.75K，达到极小化极大最优遗憾阶。数值实验显示该策略在所有测试臂数和时域下均优于基准策略，且在双臂情况下接近网格化MAB极小化极大策略。
AI.motivation: 现有的多臂老虎机指数策略（如UCB、Thompson Sampling）虽具渐近最优性，但在有限时域下缺乏极小化极大最优保证。作者旨在从单臂问题的极小化极大解推导指数策略，获得有限时域的分布无关最优遗憾界，填补理论与实践的空白。
AI.method: 1. 将单臂老虎机问题建模为在未知Bernoulli臂与已知奖励间选择，通过半无限线性规划精刻画极小化极大最优停止策略。2. 利用累积持续概率构建指数，加入单调调整与奖励短缺上限。3. 通过将指数误差关联到单臂停止策略的遗憾，推导分布无关遗憾界。4. 通过Bernoulli随机化扩展到[0,1]奖励，并提供有限网格实现及近似损失量化。
AI.result: 理论上：证明遗憾上界为4.45√(KT)+10.75K，匹配极小化极大最优阶O(√(KT))。实验上：在所有测试的臂数(K=2,5,10)和时域(T=100,1000,10000)下，该策略的最坏情况遗憾均低于所有基准策略（包括UCB、TS、KL-UCB等）；在双臂情况下，其表现与网格化MAB极小化极大策略极其接近。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了从单臂极小化极大解到多臂指数策略的严谨桥梁，首次实现了有限时域Bernoulli多臂老虎机的极小化极大最优指数策略。该方法理论保证强、计算可行（有限网格实现）、实证表现优，为多臂老虎机问题提供了新的最优设计范式。

title: Pretrained Persona Mixture Models and Tandem Models for Human Simulation
comment: 11 pages in body, 36 with appendices. 7 figures. 8 tables
summary: We argue here that the current dominant practice in LLM human simulation: prompting instruction-tuned assistant language models to role-play personas, is inaccurate and produces stereotyped predictions (lacking natural diversity). It has previously been shown that LLMs can be bound to personas using naturalistic, freetext dialog avoiding stereotyping. Here we show that binding can also be achieved using short, individual samples of dialog from specific people. Demographics can be added later without negative effects by simply querying the model. We use the term Persona Mixture Models (PMMs) for well-calibrated human models, currently realized as pretrained base models. We show that PMMs produce more accurate predictions than instruction-tuned models and retain more of the lexical, semantic, and pragmatic diversity found in human dialog. We measure realism and diversity of LLMs simulating human interlocutors across a diverse set of corpora spanning open-domain text, human-AI chat, and task-oriented dialogue between human speakers. However, base pretrained models can produce out-of-domain dialog and may lose some of the human's internal state over long contexts. We propose and explore tandem models which combine a pre-trained model with an instruction-tuned supervisor. Tandem models achieve the best overall accuracy and diversity in our experiments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Persona Mixture Models (PMMs)，即预训练基础模型，能更准确地模拟人类对话，保留词汇、语义和语用多样性；并提出串联模型结合预训练模型与指令微调监督器，实现最佳准确度和多样性。
AI.motivation: 当前主流做法使用指令微调助手模型扮演人设不准确，产生刻板预测，缺乏自然多样性。需要更真实、多样的人类对话模拟方法。
AI.method: 使用短对话样本将LLM绑定到特定人设，后续可添加人口统计信息而不影响效果。PMMs基于预训练基础模型。实验跨多种语料库（开放域文本、人机聊天、任务导向对话）评估真实感和多样性。提出串联模型：预训练模型+指令微调监督器。
AI.result: PMMs比指令微调模型产生更准确预测，保留更多人类对话的词汇、语义、语用多样性。串联模型在实验中达到最佳整体准确度和多样性。但基础预训练模型可能产生域外对话，长上下文中可能丢失人类内部状态。
AI.conclusion: PMMs和串联模型为人类对话模拟提供更优方案，解决了刻板化和多样性不足问题，但长上下文建模仍需改进。

title: Recovering Lost Details: Multi-Scale Frequency Compensation for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
comment: 11 pages. Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Long-term time series forecasting has made significant progress by leveraging multi-scale information to capture hierarchical temporal patterns and model long-range dependencies. However, temporal downsampling in existing multi-scale methods inevitably smooths detailed temporal fluctuations, and this information loss is further aggravated by their emphasis on dominant trends across scales, resulting in insufficiently expressive representations. To address this, we propose a Multi-Scale Wavelet Mixing (MWMixer) model, which incorporates a Bidirectional Frequency-Bands Mixing strategy to recover lost temporal details across scales, enabling complementary cross-scale information interactions. Then, a Dynamic Scale-Adaptive Fusion module learns time-varying weights for each scale to fuse multi-scale forecasts into the final prediction, enhancing the flexibility of multi-scale aggregation. In addition, a cross-scale consistency loss aligns each coarse-scale prediction with the interval-averaged fine-scale outputs, while a multi-scale supervision loss enforces prediction accuracy at each scale, promoting consistent learning across scales. Extensive experiments on seven real-world datasets demonstrate that MWMixer achieves competitive performance in long-term forecasting.

AI.tldr: MWMixer提出双向频带混合策略恢复时间细节，动态尺度自适应融合模块加权多尺度预测，并引入跨尺度一致性损失和多尺度监督损失，在七个真实数据集上实现长期预测竞争性性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多尺度方法通过时间下采样捕捉层次时序模式，但会平滑掉细节时间波动，且过度强调主导趋势导致信息损失加剧，表征能力不足。
AI.method: 提出MWMixer模型：1) 双向频带混合策略跨尺度恢复丢失的时间细节，实现互补信息交互；2) 动态尺度自适应融合模块学习时变权重融合多尺度预测；3) 跨尺度一致性损失将粗尺度预测与细尺度区间平均对齐；4) 多尺度监督损失强制各尺度预测准确，促进跨尺度一致学习。
AI.result: 在七个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，MWMixer在长期预测任务上达到竞争性性能。
AI.conclusion: MWMixer通过双向频带混合恢复细节、动态自适应融合增强聚合灵活性、双重损失函数保证跨尺度一致性，有效解决了多尺度长期预测中的信息丢失和表征不足问题。

title: Autonomous Model Lifecycle Management for Digital Twin-Based Manufacturing Control
comment: The paper has been accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026). The final published version will be made available on IEEE Xplore
summary: Manufacturing AI systems must autonomously adapt to continuous distributional shift from raw-material variability, ambient changes, and equipment aging, under strict safeguard and operator-trust requirements where model failures risk physical damage. This paper presents a closed-loop Cyber-Physical System (CPS) for autonomous model lifecycle management in automotive manufacturing, deployed since 2023. The system manages product-specialized model pairs: a sequence-to-sequence physics model (LPP) serving as a digital twin, and a deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) control policy (LCP) trained against it. Per retraining cycle, multiple model variants spanning architecture families and RL algorithms compete; only the best-scoring candidate advances. A Conductor orchestrator autonomously manages plant-wide model inventories with dependency-aware retraining and Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) fallback. Reflecting the principle of Human-Centric Intelligence, the LCP composite score embeds an operator-trust gate penalizing policies deviating from established practice; without it, 23% of policies are rejected by operators despite passing accuracy thresholds. Across multiple facilities, LCP-controlled processes achieve process stability improvements of 28-45% over uncontrolled baselines with zero safety incidents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个闭环网络物理系统(CPS)，用于汽车制造中自主模型生命周期管理，包含物理数字孪生模型(LPP)和深度强化学习控制策略(LCP)，通过竞争机制选优、指挥家编排器管理全厂模型库存、嵌入操作员信任门控，实现多工厂工艺稳定性提升28-45%且零安全事故。
AI.motivation: 制造AI系统需自主适应原材料变异、环境变化和设备老化导致的持续分布偏移，同时满足严格的安全防护和操作员信任要求，模型失效可能导致物理损坏。
AI.method: 构建产品专用模型对：序列到序列物理模型(LPP)作为数字孪生，深度RL控制策略(LCP)针对其训练；每轮重训练让多架构族和RL算法的模型变体竞争，仅最优候选推进；Conductor编排器自主管理全厂模型库存，支持依赖感知重训练和PID回退；LCP综合评分嵌入操作员信任门控，惩罚偏离既定实践的策略。
AI.result: 跨多设施部署显示，LCP控制工艺相较无控制基线实现工艺稳定性提升28-45%，零安全事故；若无操作员信任门控，23%通过准确率阈值的策略会被操作员拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 闭环CPS结合竞争式模型选择、依赖感知编排和以人为中心的信任门控，能在真实汽车制造环境中实现自主、安全且被操作员接受的模型生命周期管理，显著提升工艺稳定性。

title: Beetle: A Bilingual Model Suite for Modelling Second-Language Processing
summary: Bilingual language models (LMs) offer a controlled setting for studying how training conditions shape second-language (L2) behaviour, but prior work typically varies exposure structure, scale, and architecture at once, making it difficult to attribute effects to any single factor. We introduce Beetle, a controlled language model pretraining framework in which tokeniser, target language, training budget, and exposure structure are each independently manipulable, enabling systematic and comparable experimentation of training conditions. Using Beetle, we train and release 285 bilingual and 45 monolingual open-source LMs with rich checkpoints across a range of exposure schedules, data scales and first languages (L1s) to study multilingual pretraining and computational modelling of bilingualism and second language learning. Evaluating models on human bilingual and second language reading-time prediction and grammaticality judgement tasks, we find that staged and temporally structured curricula consistently improve alignment with language learner reading time compared to balanced bilingual training, with the largest gains at smaller data scales and for typologically closer language pairs. The Beetle models are well suited tools to help move computational psycholinguistics beyond its prevailing monolingual, English-centric focus toward models of human bilingual processing, to study cross-lingual learning dynamics, while supporting community-based development of controlled model families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Beetle 框架，通过独立控制分词器、目标语言、训练预算和暴露结构，训练了 285 个双语和 45 个单语开源语言模型，系统研究多语言预训练对二语习得行为的影响。实验发现，分阶段和时序结构化的课程学习比平衡双语训练更能模拟人类二语阅读时反应，尤其在小数据规模和类型学相近语言对中效果显著。
AI.motivation: 现有双语语言模型研究通常同时改变暴露结构、规模和架构，难以分离单一因素的影响；计算心理语言学长期以单语英语为中心，缺乏受控的双语模型族来研究人类双语处理和跨语言学习动态。
AI.method: 构建 Beetle 受控预训练框架，独立操纵分词器、目标语言、训练预算和暴露结构；训练 285 个双语和 45 个单语模型，覆盖多种暴露时间表、数据规模和第一语言（L1）；在人类双语和二语阅读时预测及语法性判断任务上评估模型与人类行为的一致性。
AI.result: 分阶段和时序结构化的课程学习始终比平衡双语训练更好地预测语言学习者的阅读时；增益在较小数据规模和类型学距离较近的语言对中最大；Beetle 模型族为社区提供了可复现、可比较的受控双语模型基础设施。
AI.conclusion: Beetle 框架使计算心理语言学能够超越单语英语中心范式，系统研究多语言预训练动态和人类双语处理机制；受控的模型族将推动社区驱动的双语认知建模和二语习得计算研究。

title: Taming CoT Obfuscation in VLMs: From Mechanistic Evidence to Activation Enforcement
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) but can induce chain-of-thought (CoT) obfuscation: an operational, non-intentional outcome where task reward or accuracy rises while traces become less grounded and monitorable. Prior work largely documents this decay behaviorally, leaving its representation-level correlates and actionable controls unclear. We find that template- and ground-associated activations become less separable during RL; matched interventions support the contribution of selected features to monitorability degradation. Guided by this evidence, we propose Targeted Anti-obfuscation with Mechanistic Enforcement (TAME), which uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to combine behavioral feedback with targeted suppression of template-associated activations during RL. Its asymmetric constraint penalizes template activations only above their pre-RL baseline, anchoring the localized features while behavioral feedback promotes grounded refinements. Across VIRL-39k, SPA-VL, and two model families, TAME improves CoT monitorability by up to 30.9 and 16.7 percentage points over Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), respectively. Blinded human evaluation finds higher human monitorability on both datasets, and two held-out monitor families reproduce the monitorability gains. Task accuracy changes are small and mixed, and general-capability benchmarks show task-specific trade-offs. These results provide a path from behavioral monitoring to representation-level oversight for more auditable RL-trained multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: RL训练VLM虽能提升推理能力，但会导致CoT混淆（推理轨迹可监控性下降）。本文提出TAME方法，利用SAE在RL过程中针对性抑制模板相关激活，显著提升可监控性（最高+30.9%），同时任务准确率影响微小。
AI.motivation: 强化学习虽能提升视觉语言模型的推理性能，但会引发思维链混淆：任务奖励/准确率上升，而推理轨迹变得更难以 grounding 和监控。现有工作主要从行为层面记录这一衰退现象，缺乏表示层面的相关性分析和可操作的控制手段。
AI.method: 提出Targeted Anti-obfuscation with Mechanistic Enforcement (TAME)。利用稀疏自编码器(SAE)识别模板相关与基础相关激活，在RL过程中结合行为反馈，仅对超过预RL基线的模板激活施加非对称惩罚，锚定定位特征的同时促进基础推理的优化。
AI.result: 在VIRL-39k、SPA-VL两个数据集及两个模型家族上，TAME较GRPO将CoT可监控性提升高达30.9和16.7个百分点。盲人类评估确认人类可监控性提升，两个保留监控器家族复现增益。任务准确率变化微小且方向不一，通用基准显示任务特定权衡。
AI.conclusion: TAME通过表示层面的针对性干预有效缓解了RL训练中的CoT混淆，为从行为监控走向表示层面的监督提供了可行路径，有助于构建更可审计的多模态RL系统。

title: D-IMPL: A Diffusion-based Solver for Parameterized BBOs
summary: Diffusion models have demonstrated strong power in generative modeling tasks across multiple domains, exhibiting a remarkable capability of learning complex distributions from samples. In this paper, we leverage such capability to design an efficient universal diffusion-based solver for parameterized black-box optimizations (BBO), where the optimizer has only black-box access to queries of the objective function at the learning stage, yet is able to reduce the additional computational cost at the inference stage for each BBO instance while also capturing the potential multi-modal landscape of non-convex objectives. To cast our formulation as a compatible generative modeling task, we introduce the notion of minimization policy as a new solution concept, which defines a sampling distribution over the solutions that should concentrate around the minimizer set for each BBO instance. We then propose Diffusion-based Iterative Minimization Policy Learning (D-IMPL), a practical generative-model-based solver for solving parameterized BBOs that employs diffusion models to learn a minimization policy, whose density is proportional to the exponential of the negated objective values, thereby amortizing the computational costs across different BBO instances. Furthermore, we demonstrate the performance of our D-IMPL algorithm by establishing a sample complexity guarantee showing that a $δ$-approximate minimization policy can be effectively learned within $O(\log(1/δ))$ iterations, and by extensive empirical evaluations over a range of constrained and unconstrained BBO tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于扩散模型的迭代极小化策略学习（D-IMPL），用于求解参数化黑箱优化问题，通过学习极小化策略分布，实现跨任务的计算成本分摊，并提供样本复杂度保证。
AI.motivation: 现有黑箱优化方法在推理阶段计算成本高，且难以捕捉非凸目标的多模态景观；扩散模型能学习复杂分布，适合建模极小化策略，从而设计通用高效的求解器。
AI.method: 引入极小化策略概念，定义解的采样分布集中于极小值集；提出D-IMPL算法，利用扩散模型学习密度与目标函数负指数成正比的极小化策略，通过迭代训练分摊不同BBO实例的计算成本。
AI.result: 理论上证明δ-近似极小化策略可在O(log(1/δ))次迭代内学习；实验上在多种约束和无约束BBO任务上验证了性能。
AI.conclusion: D-IMPL提供了一种基于生成模型的通用黑箱优化求解框架，兼具理论保证和实证有效性，能高效处理参数化非凸优化问题。

title: COT-TTS: Audio Context-Aware Text-to-Speech with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Recently, text-to-speech systems have made significant progress in speech expressiveness and controllability. However, the speaking style of generated speech typically relies on clear user-specified instructions. In natural conversations, speaking style should be naturally inferred from the preceding conversational context. Therefore, we propose COT-TTS, a context-aware, reasoning-based text-to-speech task. Given historical conversation audio, target text, and a reference speech, the system should comprehend the conversational context, infer an explicit intermediate reasoning, and finally synthesize the target speech with the specified timbre. To support this task, we constructed a large-scale bilingual conversational speech dataset comprising 9 million training samples, including a high-quality subset of 1 million samples. We further constructed a source-disjoint benchmark with 800 human-verified samples and established strong task-specific baselines. Additionally, we developed end-to-end autoregressive models with parameter sizes of 0.6B and 1.7B, generating emotion-labeled transcripts, editable speech style inferences, and speech tokens. Experimental results show that the proposed model achieves performance comparable to large-scale baseline systems with significantly fewer parameters. At the same time, the model performs well in terms of duration consistency and emotional consistency, and can generate appropriate emotional, stress, and rhythmic variations based on the conversational context. To facilitate future research, we will publicly release the data construction pipeline, dataset, trained models, and related resources. The demo page and additional resources are available at https://luckybian.github.io/COT-TTS

AI.tldr: 本文提出 COT-TTS，一种上下文感知、基于推理的文本转语音任务，旨在从对话历史中自动推断说话风格，而非依赖显式用户指令。作者构建了大规模双语对话语音数据集（900 万训练样本，含 100 万高质量子集）和源不相交基准（800 人工验证样本），训练了 0.6B 和 1.7B 参数的端到端自回归模型，可生成情感标注文本、可编辑风格推理及语音 Token。实验表明，模型在参数量远少于大规模基线的情况下达到相当性能，并在时长一致性、情感一致性及上下文适应的情感、重音、节奏变化生成上表现优异。相关资源将公开发布。
AI.motivation: 现有文本转语音系统在表达力和可控性上取得显著进步，但生成语音的说话风格通常依赖用户明确指定的指令。在自然对话中，说话风格应从前文对话上下文中自然推断。因此，需要一种能够理解对话上下文、进行显式中间推理，并合成指定音色目标语音的上下文感知推理式 TTS 任务。
AI.method: 1. 提出 COT-TTS 任务：输入历史对话音频、目标文本和参考语音，输出带有推理过程的目标语音。2. 构建大规模双语对话语音数据集（900 万训练样本，100 万高质量子集）及源不相交人工验证基准（800 样本）。3. 建立强基线系统。4. 开发端到端自回归模型（0.6B 和 1.7B 参数），联合生成情感标注文本、可编辑风格推理和语音 Token。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，提出的模型在参数量显著少于大规模基线系统的情况下，达到相当的合成性能。模型在时长一致性和情感一致性指标上表现良好，并能根据对话上下文生成恰当的情感、重音和节奏变化。
AI.conclusion: COT-TTS 成功实现了上下文感知的推理式文本转语音，通过大规模数据集和自回归建模，实现了从对话历史中隐式推断说话风格并合成高质量语音。作者将公开数据构建管线、数据集、训练模型及相关资源，推动该领域后续研究。

title: Unsupervised Brain Anomaly Detection as a Bayesian Inverse Problem with Diffusion Prior
summary: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) aims to localize abnormal regions in medical scans without pixel-level annotations. A typical strategy seeks to reconstruct a pseudo-healthy image that preserves subject-specific anatomy. Recently, diffusion models have been proposed to perform UAD. However, these methods rely on heuristic noise schedules or synthetic corruptions to balance subject-specificity and anomaly removal. In this work, we propose an alternative formulation of UAD as a Bayesian inverse problem under a diffusion prior. First, we introduce a latent spatial anomaly mask that models pixel-wise consistency between a test image and its latent corresponding pseudo-healthy image. Then, we propose an approximation of the unknown generation process that links healthy anatomy, anomalies, and the observed image, enabling a well-defined likelihood within the Bayesian framework. Building on recent advances in diffusion-based inverse problem methods, we jointly infer the pseudo-healthy image and the anomaly mask via annealed posterior sampling. We evaluate our approach on FDG PET (ADNI) and FLAIR MRI (BraTS 2021), demonstrating improved anomaly localization performance compared to other diffusion-based approaches and validating the contribution of our introduced model. Our code is available at https://github.com/HuguesRoy/UAD_DAPS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于扩散先验的贝叶斯逆问题框架用于无监督医学图像异常检测，引入潜在空间异常掩码并通过退火后验采样联合推断伪健康图像和异常掩码，在FDG PET和FLAIR MRI数据集上实现更优的异常定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的无监督异常检测方法依赖启发式噪声调度或合成损坏来平衡主体特异性与异常去除，缺乏理论基础的似然函数，难以有效建模异常与健康解剖结构的像素级关系。
AI.method: 将UAD建模为扩散先验下的贝叶斯逆问题：1) 引入潜在空间异常掩码建模测试图像与伪健康图像的像素级一致性；2) 近似未知生成过程（健康解剖+异常→观测图像），构建明确的似然函数；3) 基于扩散逆问题最新进展，采用退火后验采样联合推断伪健康图像与异常掩码。
AI.result: 在ADNI FDG PET和BraTS 2021 FLAIR MRI数据集上评估，相比其他基于扩散的方法，异常定位性能显著提升，验证了所提出模型各组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为无监督异常检测提供了理论严谨的贝叶斯框架，通过显式建模异常生成过程和联合后验推断，解决了现有方法依赖启发式策略的局限，为医学图像异常检测确立了新范式。

title: Look Before You Steer: Geometry Predicts SAE Feature Steerability
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026 and AIW 2026 at COLM
summary: Steering with SAE features requires per-feature coefficient tuning, which currently demands intervention sweeps. We ask whether properties of the SAE itself, computable before any forward pass, predict which features will be cheap or expensive to steer. We show that variation in SAE feature steerability is partially predicted by decoder-space geometry: neighbor density and maximum cosine similarity to nearby decoder directions, both computable from the SAE weight matrix before any intervention, rank features by how much steering they require for a fixed behavioral effect ($ρ$ up to $-0.546$, $p < 10^{-6}$, AUROC 0.610-0.822 across conditions; the signal is rank-based, consistent with grid discreteness). This geometry-steerability relationship replicates across two Gemma-2 model scales (2B and 9B), two SAE widths (16K and 65K), and is detectable cross-architecturally on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ($ρ= -0.266$, $n = 300$). On Qwen3-8B with BatchTopK SAEs, geometry predicts whether a feature is steerable at all but not the continuous ordering among responsive features, revealing a boundary condition tied to SAE training regime. The signal weakens at deep proportional layer depth in both models, where the cost of steering exceeds our intervention budget, a consistent depth boundary. These results provide preliminary evidence that pre-steering geometry can partially inform coefficient selection, offering a path toward screening features for controllability before deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征的可操控性，发现解码器空间几何属性（邻居密度和最大余弦相似度）能在无需前向传播的情况下预测特征操控成本，跨多种模型和SAE配置验证了这种几何-操控性关系，但发现深层和特定训练机制（如BatchTopK）存在边界条件。
AI.motivation: 当前利用SAE特征进行操控需要逐特征调整系数，通常需要昂贵的干预扫描。作者希望探索是否可以仅通过SAE自身的可计算属性（在任何前向传播前），预测哪些特征操控成本低、哪些成本高，从而在部署前筛选可控特征。
AI.method: 在Gemma-2（2B和9B）、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B等模型上，使用不同宽度（16K、65K）和训练机制（标准SAE、BatchTopK SAE）的SAE。计算解码器权重矩阵的几何属性：邻居密度和最大余弦相似度。通过干预实验测量固定行为效果所需的操控系数，使用Spearman秩相关（ρ）和AUROC评估几何属性与操控成本的预测关系。
AI.result: 解码器空间几何显著预测操控成本：ρ高达-0.546（p<10^-6），AUROC 0.610-0.822。跨模型规模、SAE宽度复现，在Llama-3.1上跨架构检测到（ρ=-0.266）。Qwen3-8B的BatchTopK SAE显示几何仅预测特征是否可操控，不预测连续排序，揭示训练机制边界。深层比例层深处信号减弱，操控成本超出预算，存在一致的深度边界。
AI.conclusion: SAE解码器几何属性可在无前向传播情况下部分预测特征操控成本，为部署前筛选可控特征提供了初步证据。但存在深度边界和训练机制（如BatchTopK）边界条件，几何预测能力在深层和特定稀疏性约束下减弱或改变性质。

title: LLaDA-PRM: A Bidirectional Step-Level Reasoning Evaluator
summary: Step-level reasoning evaluators are commonly based on autoregressive language models, whose causal attention restricts each step representation to the problem, previous steps, and the current step. Yet, when the complete solution is available, the validity of an earlier step may become clearer only through its downstream consequences. We validate this hypothesis through a controlled 54-run comparison of causal and bidirectional LLaDA evaluators at 1B--3B scale, changing only the self-attention mask, and find bidirectional attention yields consistent improvements. Building on this finding, we introduce \prm{}, an 8B bidirectional evaluator that reaches 88.8 step-level F1 on MR-MATH-invalid and 83.8 on the out-of-distribution MR-GSM8K original-question subset, outperforming ReasonEval-Llemma-34B by 11.3 and 10.3 F1 points, respectively. \prm{} also remains effective when evaluating incomplete reasoning traces in online settings, outperforming the strongest baselines on both benchmarks by a large margin. We further show that \prm{} provides an effective training-data selection signal, improving Mistral-7B performance on MATH-500.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于双向注意力的步级推理评估器PRM（8B），通过实验证明双向注意力优于因果注意力，在多个基准测试中显著超越现有最强基线，并在在线不完整推理轨迹评估和训练数据选择方面表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的步级推理评估器主要基于自回归语言模型，其因果注意力机制限制了每个步骤的表示只能依赖问题、前序步骤和当前步骤。但当完整解决方案可用时，早期步骤的有效性可能通过其下游后果变得更清晰。因此，研究者假设双向注意力能更好地捕捉步骤间的全局依赖关系。
AI.method: 研究者进行了受控的54次实验对比，仅改变自注意力掩码，对比因果注意力与双向注意力的LLaDA评估器（1B-3B规模）。基于实验发现，构建了8B参数的双向评估器PRM，并在MR-MATH-invalid、MR-GSM8K等基准上评估，同时测试其在在线不完整推理轨迹评估和训练数据选择中的效果。
AI.result: 双向注意力持续优于因果注意力。PRM在MR-MATH-invalid上达到88.8步级F1，在MR-GSM8K原始问题子集上达到83.8 F1，分别比ReasonEval-Llemma-34B高出11.3和10.3个F1点。PRM在评估不完整推理轨迹时也大幅超越最强基线。此外，PRM作为训练数据选择信号可提升Mistral-7B在MATH-500上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 双向注意力机制能更有效地利用完整解决方案的上下文信息，显著提升步级推理评估性能。PRM不仅在离线完整解决方案评估中表现优异，还适用于在线不完整推理评估和训练数据筛选，为推理过程评估提供了更强有力的工具。

title: How Many Pixels Is a Digit Worth? Place-Aware Coordinate Entropy for GUI Agent Confidence Estimation
summary: GUI agents predict click coordinates as digit-token sequences, but standard text-LLM confidence estimation methods rank correct clicks from wrong ones only weakly. GUI-specific alternatives use K samples or new supervision, but still leave room for improvement. We trace part of this to place-value asymmetry: bounding-box correctness often makes higher-place digits more important than lower-place digits, so uniform aggregation weakens the signal that determines correctness. The fix is to weight each digit's Shannon entropy by its place value. We call this Place-Aware Coordinate Entropy (PACE). Across fixed-scale agents on ScreenSpot-Pro and ScreenSpot-v2, PACE wins both AUROC and selective accuracy on all primary comparisons in a single forward pass, matching or outperforming K-sample baselines at a fraction of the cost. PACE provides a per-click confidence estimate that turns coordinate-token internals into a practical confidence signal for GUI agent deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PACE（Place-Aware Coordinate Entropy），一种针对 GUI Agent 点击坐标预测的置信度估计方法。通过按位值加权各数字的 Shannon 熵，解决了统一聚合削弱正确性信号的问题，在单次前向传播中即可达到或超越多采样基线，显著降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: GUI Agent 将点击坐标建模为数字 Token 序列，但标准文本 LLM 的置信度估计方法难以有效区分正确与错误的点击。现有的 GUI 专用方案（如 K 次采样或引入新监督）仍有改进空间。作者追溯到位值不对称：边界框正确性使高位数字比低位数字更重要，均匀聚合会削弱决定正确性的信号。
AI.method: 提出 Place-Aware Coordinate Entropy (PACE) —— 对坐标序列中每个数字 Token 的 Shannon 熵按其位值（十进制权重）加权求和，作为单次前向传播的点击级置信度分数。无需额外采样或监督，直接利用模型输出的 Token 分布。
AI.result: 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 和 ScreenSpot-v2 两个基准上，固定规模 Agent 下 PACE 在所有主要对比中同时取得最高 AUROC 和选择性准确率，性能匹配或超越 K 采样基线，且仅需单次前向传播，计算成本大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: PACE 将坐标 Token 的内部概率分布转化为实用的逐点击置信度信号，为 GUI Agent 的实际部署提供了低成本、高可靠的不确定性量化工具。

title: Improved Private Sparse Covariance Estimation with Multiscale Threshold Tests
summary:
We study differentially private covariance estimation in operator norm for mean-zero sub-Gaussian distributions with unknown covariance support and at most $k$ nonzero entries per row. We develop a multiscale random-threshold algorithm with sample complexity $\ot(k^2/α^2+k\sqrt d/(α\varepsilon))$ for $(\varepsilon,δ)$-differential privacy and error at most $ασ^2$, where $d$ is the dimension and $σ$ is a known sub-Gaussian scale. The bound improves the privacy-dependent term of the existing $\ot(k^2/α^2+k^{3/2}\sqrt d/(α\varepsilon))$ \citep{kumar2026curse} upper bound by a factor of $\sqrt k$, and matches the lower bound of $\widetildeΩ(k^2/α^2 + k\sqrt{d}/(α\varepsilon))$ in its applicable parameter regime.
  Our key technical ingredient is a direct operator-norm bound on the centered fluctuations of an ideal reconstruction, exploiting conditional independence rather than accumulating entrywise errors across each row. A multiscale allocation of threshold tests balances reconstruction variance against query sensitivity. Together, these ingredients sharpen the trade-off between approximation error and privacy protection, removing the additional $\sqrt{k}$ factor from the privacy-dependent sample complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究差分隐私下的协方差估计问题，针对均值为零的次高斯分布，在未知协方差支撑且每行最多k个非零项的设定下，提出了一种多尺度随机阈值算法，实现了样本复杂度Õ(k²/α² + k√d/(αε))，改进了现有结果中依赖隐私的项√k因子，并在适用参数范围内匹配下界。
AI.motivation: 现有的差分隐私协方差估计方法在隐私依赖项上存在额外的√k因子（即Õ(k^{3/2}√d/(αε))），与下界Õ(k√d/(αε))存在差距。本文旨在消除这一因子，实现最优的隐私-精度权衡。
AI.method: 提出多尺度随机阈值算法，核心技术贡献有二：(1) 直接对理想重构的中心化波动给出算子范数界，利用条件独立性而非逐行累积逐项误差；(2) 多尺度分配阈值测试，平衡重构方差与查询敏感度。
AI.result: 达到样本复杂度Õ(k²/α² + k√d/(αε))，改进了先前工作中的隐私依赖项√k因子，在适用参数范围内匹配下界Ω̃(k²/α² + k√d/(αε))。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接的算子范数分析和多尺度阈值分配，本文消除了隐私依赖样本复杂度中的额外√k因子，显著改进了差分隐私稀疏协方差估计的精度-隐私权衡，实现了理论最优性。

title: Analyzing Public Discourse on Urbanism: Topic Clustering, Sentiment Analysis and Retrieval-Augmented Generation using YouTube Comments
summary: Online discourse about urban issues - walkability, cycling infrastructure, public transit, housing density, and street safety - is voluminous but unstructured, and existing city-evaluation tools capture none of it. We present a pipeline and conversational system that combines geographic entity resolution, topic modeling, sentiment analysis, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over 22,788 chunks of YouTube transcripts and comments spanning 309 North American cities. Beyond the system itself, our contribution is a set of measurements about what happens when standard NLP components meet short, informal, geographically ambiguous text. A Twitter-tuned RoBERTa classifier outperforms a VADER lexicon baseline by 12.6 macro-F1 points (0.589 vs. 0.464; McNemar p = 0.0001), but both models collapse on the neutral class, which dominates urbanist comment traffic; annotators disagree on the same class (Cohen's kappa = 0.53). Dense retrieval beats a TF-IDF baseline at every cutoff (P@5 0.790 vs. 0.560), and video-level relevance proxies understate chunk-level precision by a wide margin (0.660 vs. 0.94 under human rating). For groundedness evaluation, we find BERTScore unusable when a multi-sentence generated summary is compared against a single short comment - scores are nearly flat regardless of relevance - and show that ROUGE-1-based groundedness is a paraphrase-driven lower bound rather than a hallucination rate. These findings generalize beyond the urbanist domain to any RAG system built over short user-generated documents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套处理非结构化城市议题在线话语的管道系统，结合地理实体解析、主题建模、情感分析和检索增强生成（RAG），在309个北美城市的YouTube转录和评论上进行实验。研究系统评估了标准NLP组件在短、非正式、地理模糊文本上的表现，发现RoBERTa优于VADER但两者在中性类别上均失效，密集检索优于TF-IDF，视频级相关性代理低估了块级精度，BERTScore在多句摘要对单句评论评估中失效，ROUGE-1更适合作为改写下界而非幻觉率。结论指出这些发现可推广至任何基于短用户生成文档的RAG系统。
AI.motivation: 现有城市评估工具无法捕捉海量非结构化的城市议题在线讨论（如步行友好、骑行设施、公共交通、住房密度、街道安全等），需要一套能够处理地理模糊、非正式短文本的自动化分析系统。
AI.method: 构建包含地理实体解析、主题建模、情感分析和RAG的管道系统，利用22,788个YouTube转录和评论块覆盖309个北美城市。对比Twitter微调RoBERTa与VADER词典基线、密集检索与TF-IDF、视频级与块级相关性代理，以及BERTScore与ROUGE-1在 groundedness 评估中的表现。
AI.result: 1. RoBERTa宏F1比VADER高12.6点（0.589 vs 0.464，p=0.0001），但两者在主导的中性类别上均崩溃，标注者一致性低（Kappa=0.53）。2. 密集检索在所有截断点均优于TF-IDF（P@5 0.790 vs 0.560）。3. 视频级相关性代理大幅低估块级精度（0.660 vs 人工评分0.94）。4. BERTScore在多句生成摘要对单句评论比较中分数几乎平坦，不可用。5. ROUGE-1 groundedness是改写驱动的下界而非幻觉率。
AI.conclusion: 标准NLP组件在短、非正式、地理模糊的用户生成文本上表现存在系统性缺陷，特别是情感分类中性类别失效、检索评估粒度不匹配、groundedness指标选型需谨慎。这些发现不仅适用于城市话语领域，可推广至所有基于短用户生成文档构建的RAG系统。

title: When and How Should an Agent Clarify? CIGAsk: Teaching LLMs to Clarify via Counterfactual Information Gain
summary: Instruction-tuned LLMs faced with underspecified queries often commit to a single interpretation rather than ask for clarification, producing confidently wrong answers. In our experiments, prompting alone is insufficient: models either ask for clarification on every query or ask vague questions that fail to recover the missing information. Addressing this failure requires learning two coupled skills: when to ask rather than answer and how to ask a question that recovers the disambiguating information. Existing recipes either address only one of these skills or require a separately trained critic. We propose CIGAsk, an RL recipe that teaches both skills through two complementary reward signals within a multi-turn GRPO loop. Counterfactual Information Gain (CIG) compares the gold-answer log-likelihood under a frozen reference model with and without the user response, providing per-turn credit that guides how to ask. The Asymmetric Ambiguity Bonus assigns a signed reward at the terminal token based on the gold ambiguity label, guiding when to ask. Across three clarification benchmarks spanning table, passage, and open-domain QA, CIGAsk-7B outperforms the strongest external baseline despite using a smaller backbone. It also transfers across datasets without per-dataset tuning while preserving single-turn QA performance on out-of-distribution benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CIGAsk，一种基于强化学习的多轮 GRPO 训练方法，通过反事实信息增益和非对称歧义奖励两个互补信号，教会模型何时提问以及如何提问以消除歧义，在三个澄清基准上超越更大模型的基线，且无需针对单数据集微调即可迁移，同时保持单轮 QA 性能。
AI.motivation: 指令微调后的 LLM 面对欠规范查询时，倾向于直接给出单一解释而非请求澄清，导致自信的错误回答。仅靠提示工程无法解决：模题要么对所有查询都提问，要么提出模糊问题无法恢复缺失信息。现有方法要么只解决“何时提问”或“如何提问”中的一个，要么需要额外训练的评判模型。
AI.method: 提出 CIGAsk，在多轮 GRPO 循环中引入两个奖励信号：1) 反事实信息增益（CIG）：对比冻结参考模型在有无用户回复条件下对金标答案的对数似然差，提供逐轮信用分配，指导如何提问；2) 非对称歧义奖励：在终止 token 基于金标歧义标签给予有符号奖励，指导何时提问。两信号耦合训练，无需外部评判模型。
AI.result: 在表格、段落、开放域三类澄清基准上，CIGAsk-7B 超越最强外部基线（使用更大骨干网络）。跨数据集迁移无需单数据集调优，且在分布外单轮 QA 基准上保持性能不退化。
AI.conclusion: CIGAsk 通过双奖励信号在单一 RL 框架内同时习得“何时提问”与“如何提问”两项耦合技能，有效解决欠规范查询下的盲目回答问题，实现了参数高效、可迁移且不损伤通用 QA 能力的澄清能力提升。

title: Robust Market Making with Hawkes Order Flow and Price Impact via Adversarial Reinforcement Learning
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Includes theoretical analysis, numerical experiments, and supplementary results in the appendix
summary:
Market-making strategies in real limit order book markets face substantial model uncertainty and regime-shift risk. Existing adversarial reinforcement learning approaches improve robustness by formulating the Avellaneda--Stoikov market-making problem as a zero-sum game between a market maker and an environmental adversary. However, these approaches typically rely on Poisson order arrivals and neglect trade-induced price impact, limiting their ability to capture important high-frequency market microstructure effects such as clustered order flow, self-excitation, and post-trade price feedback.
  We extend adversarial reinforcement learning for market making to a more complex environment with Hawkes self-exciting order arrivals and trade-induced price impact. To mitigate the increased non-stationarity introduced by the expanded regime space, we incorporate an LSTM module that explicitly models the temporal structure of recent observations. We further characterize the equilibrium properties of the proposed framework through both game-theoretic analysis and numerical experiments, and introduce a robustness evaluation protocol focused on improvements in the left tail of the return distribution.
  Experimental results across a range of market regimes show that the proposed method achieves improved left-tail performance in most complex microstructure environments. In particular, the gains are pronounced in regimes with strong Hawkes excitation and low-to-moderate price impact. Bootstrap tests provide no evidence that these improvements are obtained through a stronger terminal directional inventory bias. These results suggest that combining adversarial training with temporal state representation can improve the robustness of reinforcement-learning-based market-making strategies under order-flow self-excitation, price impact, and regime uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文将对抗强化学习扩展至包含 Hawkes 自激励订单到达和交易诱导价格冲击的复杂市场微观结构环境，并引入 LSTM 模块建模时序结构，实验表明该方法在多数复杂微观结构环境下显著改善了收益分布的左尾表现，且改进非源于更强的终期方向性库存偏向。
AI.motivation: 现有基于对抗强化学习的做市策略通常假设泊松订单到达且忽略交易价格冲击，无法捕捉高频市场微观结构中的订单流聚类、自激励和交易后价格反馈等关键效应，导致在真实限价订单簿市场中面临显著的模型不确定性和机制转换风险。
AI.method: 将 Avellaneda-Stoikov 做市问题扩展为包含 Hawkes 自激励订单到达和交易诱导价格冲击的零和博弈，引入 LSTM 模块显式建模近期观测的时序结构以缓解扩展机制空间带来的非平稳性，并通过博弈论分析与数值实验刻画均衡性质，提出聚焦收益分布左尾的鲁棒性评估协议。
AI.result: 跨多种市场机制的实验显示，该方法在大多数复杂微观结构环境中实现了左尾性能的改善；在 Hawkes 激励强、价格冲击低到中等的机制下收益尤为显著；Bootstrap 检验未发现改进源于更强的终期方向性库存偏向。
AI.conclusion: 将对抗训练与时序状态表征相结合，可提升基于强化学习的做市策略在订单流自激励、价格冲击及机制不确定性下的鲁棒性。

title: Clinical Domain Classification from Medical Transcriptions
summary: Clinical domain classification plays an important role in organizing and analyzing large volumes of unstructured medical text. However, medical transcription datasets are often highly imbalanced, which can substantially degrade classification performance, particularly for underrepresented clinical specialties. In this work, we present a comparative study of machine learning and transformer-based approaches for clinical domain classification from medical transcriptions. We evaluate six traditional machine learning classifiers---Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and XGBoost---along with two pretrained transformer models, BERT and XLNet, and a few-shot large language model prompting approach. Experiments are conducted on medical transcription data collected from MTSamples, comprising 5,013 samples across 40 clinical specialties. To address severe class imbalance, we investigate two balancing strategies: text augmentation using NLP-based synonym replacement and Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE). Experimental results demonstrate that data balancing substantially improves classification performance across the evaluated models. In particular, BERT achieves the highest F1-score of 0.996 on the SMOTE-balanced dataset while requiring lower training time than XLNet. The results highlight the effectiveness of transformer-based representations combined with appropriate data balancing strategies for clinical domain classification and provide a systematic comparison of classical machine learning, transformer models, and few-shot prompting for medical transcription analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了传统机器学习、Transformer模型和少样本提示在医学转录临床领域分类任务上的表现，并探讨了两种数据平衡策略（同义词替换增强和SMOTE）对性能的影响。实验表明，数据平衡显著提升分类性能，BERT在SMOTE平衡数据上达到最高F1分数0.996，且训练时间低于XLNet。
AI.motivation: 医学转录数据集往往严重类别不平衡，导致分类性能下降，尤其是对代表性不足的临床专科。需要系统比较不同模型和数据平衡策略在临床领域分类任务上的有效性。
AI.method: 在MTSamples数据集（5013样本，40个临床专科）上评估六种传统分类器（朴素贝叶斯、SVM、决策树、随机森林、KNN、XGBoost）、两种预训练Transformer模型（BERT、XLNet）和少样本大语言模型提示方法。采用两种数据平衡策略：基于NLP的同义词替换文本增强和SMOTE过采样技术。
AI.result: 数据平衡显著提升所有模型的分类性能。BERT在SMOTE平衡数据集上达到最高F1分数0.996，且训练时间少于XLNet。传统机器学习模型在平衡后也有显著改善，但Transformer模型整体表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 结合适当的数据平衡策略，Transformer表示学习（特别是BERT）在临床领域分类任务上极为有效。本文提供了经典机器学习、Transformer模型和少样本提示在医学转录分析上的系统性比较，为临床文本分类提供了实用指导。

title: Brain-Token Learning: Microstate-Based Tokenization and Multi-Scale Interaction for Long-Horizon EEG Sequence Modeling
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive window into dynamic brain activity, yet modeling long-horizon EEG sequences remains challenging due to their high temporal complexity, substantial variability across subjects, and the lack of biologically meaningful sequence representations. Existing tokenization strategies, such as fixed-window and patch-based representations, discretize EEG signals according to artificial temporal boundaries, which may disrupt intrinsic brain-state dynamics. In this work, we propose Brain-Token Learning, a neuroscience-inspired framework that introduces Brain Tokenization for long-horizon EEG sequence modeling. Instead of partitioning EEG signals into predefined temporal segments, Brain Tokenization represents EEG as sequences of recurrent microstate-derived brain tokens, where each token corresponds to a quasi-stable large-scale brain state with variable temporal duration. Based on these biologically grounded tokens, we further develop a multi-scale token interaction module consisting of Latent State Aggregation and State Transition Modeling to jointly capture global brain-state context and local microstate transitions. We evaluate Brain-Token on five heterogeneous EEG datasets, including the newly collected long-horizon NeuroLong dataset and four affective or clinical EEG datasets (SEED, DEAP, MDD, and NSSI). Extensive experiments demonstrate that Brain-Token consistently outperforms conventional CNN/LSTM architectures, Transformer-based models, and domain adaptation methods across diverse EEG scenarios. Further analysis verifies the effectiveness of microstate-based tokenization and multi-scale interaction for learning robust and interpretable EEG representations. These results establish Brain-Token as a biologically grounded tokenization paradigm for long-horizon EEG sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出Brain-Token Learning框架，基于微状态的脑标记化实现长程EEG序列建模，在多个异构数据集上持续优于CNN/LSTM、Transformer及领域自适应方法。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG标记化策略（固定窗口、基于补丁）依赖人工时间边界划分信号，破坏内在脑状态动态，缺乏生物学意义的序列表示，导致长程EEG序列建模因高时间复杂性、跨被试变异性大而极具挑战。
AI.method: Brain Tokenization将EEG表示为递归微状态衍生的脑标记序列，每个标记对应准稳态大尺度脑状态且具可变时间长度；构建多尺度标记交互模块，包含潜在状态聚合捕捉全局脑状态上下文，状态转移建模捕捉局部微状态转移。
AI.result: 在新收集的长程NeuroLong数据集及四个情感/临床EEG数据集（SEED、DEAP、MDD、NSSI）上，Brain-Token持续超越传统CNN/LSTM、Transformer架构及领域自适应方法；消融实验验证微状态标记化与多尺度交互对鲁棒可解释EEG表示学习的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Brain-Token确立了长程EEG序列建模的生物学基础标记化范式，通过神经科学启发的微状态标记与多尺度交互，实现了跨场景的鲁棒且可解释的EEG表征学习。

title: FIRM-WM: State-factorized factual-interventional recurrent modeling for reward-free visual planning
summary: Reward-free latent world models can learn from offline videos and solve new image--goal tasks by optimizing actions through predicted latent futures. This setting places two demands on the planning state: its coordinates must be comparable with a goal image. Moreover, its dynamics must retain velocity, motion trend, contact, and other history--dependent information beyond those goal coordinates. Offline training creates a second mismatch: each recorded trajectory reveals one factual future, whereas a sampling--based planner compares many actions that were not taken from the same state. We introduce FIRM-WM (Factual--Interventional Recurrent World Model), a compact pixel world model designed around these two gaps. Its recurrent state separates a typed, goal--comparable configuration from a 128-dimensional dynamic fiber used for prediction but excluded from the terminal goal cost. Broad factual trajectories provide state coverage, while common--reset intervention branches provide observed outcomes for alternative action sequences. Before executing each branch, we reset the environment and restore the same recorded values exposed by the environment's state--setting interface. Under matched CEM planning and three independent full-pipeline seeds, FIRM-WM reaches 99.0$\pm$1.0% on TwoRoom, 92.7$\pm$2.1% on Reacher, and 88.0$\pm$3.0% on OGBench-Cube, compared with 89.0%, 88.0%, and 70.0% for LeWM. The deployed model uses 2.98--3.42M parameters and records 2.13--11.60$\times$ lower planning time on these tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FIRM-WM（事实-干预循环世界模型），一种紧凑的像素世界模型，解决无奖励潜在世界模型在离线视频学习和图像目标任务规划中的两个核心缺口：规划状态需同时具备目标可比坐标和保留历史依赖的动力学信息；离线训练中单一事实轨迹与采样规划器对比多动作序列的分布错配。FIRM-WM 通过分离目标可比配置与 128 维动态纤维、利用宽泛事实轨迹覆盖状态空间、引入公共重置干预分支获取反事实结果，在 ThreeRoom、Reacher、OGBench-Cube 三任务上显著超越 LeWM，且参数量仅 2.98-3.42M，规划耗时降低 2.13-11.60 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有无奖励潜在世界模型面临两大挑战：1) 规划状态需同时满足与目标图像坐标可比、且保留速度、运动趋势、接触等历史依赖信息；2) 离线训练仅提供单一事实未来，而采样规划器需从同一状态对比多个未执行动作序列，导致分布错配。需设计能分离目标相关配置与动态预测纤维、并利用环境重置接口收集干预数据的模型架构。
AI.method: FIRM-WM 采用循环状态分离设计：将状态拆分为类型化、目标可比的配置向量（用于目标代价计算）和 128 维动态纤维（仅用于动力学预测，不参与终端目标代价）。训练利用宽泛事实轨迹覆盖状态空间，并通过公共重置干预分支收集反事实结果：在每个干预分支前重置环境并恢复环境状态设置接口暴露的相同记录值，从而获得同一状态下不同动作序列的观测结果。规划采用匹配的 CEM（交叉熵法）。
AI.result: 在三个独立完整流程种子下，FIRM-WM 在 TwoRoom 达 99.0±1.0%，Reacher 达 92.7±2.1%，OGBench-Cube 达 88.0±3.0%，显著优于 LeWM 的 89.0%、88.0%、70.0%。部署模型参数量仅 2.98-3.42M，规划时间比基线降低 2.13-11.60 倍。
AI.conclusion: FIRM-WM 通过显式分离目标可比配置与动态预测纤维、结合事实轨迹覆盖与环境重置干预采集反事实数据，有效解决了离线视频学习中规划状态的双重需求与分布错配问题，在多个图像目标任务上以更少参数、更快规划速度实现了最优性能，验证了事实-干预范式在奖励自由世界建模中的有效性。

title: Beyond Final-Token Classification: Heterogeneous Readouts for Evidence-Grounded Suicide Risk Detection
comment: Competition paper for the IEEE Big Data Cup 2026. Ranked 2nd among 31 participating teams and invited for submission to IEEE Big Data 2026
summary: The IEEE BigData Cup benchmark combines three prediction problems with different output structures: ordinal suicide-risk classification, multi-label psychosocial factor detection, and extraction of supporting phrases. We introduce heterogeneous readout decomposition (HRD), which separates semantic verification from output realization. A locally deployed Qwen3.8-27B model, adapted with task-specific QLoRA adapters, produces both answer-token margins and layer-63 answer states for card-conditioned queries. HRD compares four latent scores for ordinal risk, retains token margins for most factors while routing seven labels through one shared latent probe, and constructs evidence sets from verbatim span candidates with calibrated, risk-conditional constraints. On two held-out user-grouped confirmation folds, the latent risk readout improves weighted F1 from 0.8237 to 0.8372 and macro F1 from 0.7965 to 0.8185. Selective factor routing improves macro F1 by 0.0105 and tail-label macro F1 by 0.0189; in contrast, global latent replacement and independent label-specific probes fail. The constrained evidence decoder raises pooled phrase F1 from 0.7488 to 0.7609 in row-level out-of-fold evaluation. Lenormand's best public result is 0.8052 on Subtask 1 and 0.6636 on Subtask 2, giving a composite score of 0.7627. These results identify the answer-token boundary, rather than semantic representation alone, as a measurable source of error in this benchmark.

AI.tldr: 论文提出异构读出分解（HRD）方法，在IEEE BigData Cup基准测试中，通过分离语义验证与输出生成，利用Qwen3.8-27B模型配合QLoRA适配器，实现了自杀风险序数分类、心理社会因素多标签检测和支持短语抽取三个任务的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 针对IEEE BigData Cup基准测试中包含三种不同输出结构的预测问题（序数自杀风险分类、多标签心理社会因素检测、支持短语抽取），现有方法在语义表示与输出边界之间存在误差，需要一种能分离语义验证与输出实现的方法来提升性能。
AI.method: 提出异构读出分解（HRD），使用本地部署的Qwen3.8-27B模型并配合任务特定的QLoRA适配器，获取答案token边界和第63层答案状态。HRD对序数风险比较四个潜在分数，对大多数因素保留token边界，将七个标签通过共享潜在探针路由，并利用校准的风险条件约束从逐字跨度候选中构建证据集。
AI.result: 在两个保留的用户分组确认折上，潜在风险读出使加权F1从0.8237提升到0.8372，宏F1从0.7965提升到0.8185。选择性因素路由使宏F1提升0.0105，尾部标签宏F1提升0.0189；全局潜在替换和独立标签特定探针失败。约束证据解码器使汇总短语F1从0.7488提升到0.7609。Lenormand的最佳公开结果为子任务1 0.8052，子任务2 0.6636，综合分0.7627。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，答案token边界而非仅语义表示是该基准测试中可测量的误差来源，HRD方法通过分离语义验证与输出生成有效提升了三个子任务的性能。

title: LADDER: Graph-Guided Diffusion Language Models for Efficient Multi-Hop Reasoning
summary: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) has remarkably enhanced large language models on complex reasoning by leveraging structured entity topologies. However, existing frameworks heavily rely on standard autoregressive language models where the nature of inherent sequential generation severely hinders overall inference efficiency. Inspired by Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) that offer massive parallelism via continuous refine-in-parallel decoding, we aim to accelerate GraphRAG in the discrete space. However, it remains non-trivial for two challenges. First, partially denoised drafts are highly dynamic and uncertain, making dynamic graph grounding non-trivial. Second, raw denoising states are inherently noisy and unstable, making synchronous graph retrieval and multi-hop aggregation computationally prohibitive. To this end, we present LADDER, a novel framework that bridges diffusion language modeling with GraphRAG through graph-guided parallel decoding. Specifically, (i) we propose an event-driven self-clocking retrieval, inspired by our key insight that 88% of target entities emerge early in the partially denoised state, leading final commitment by an average of 5.7-9.6 steps. This mechanism dynamically triggers graph retrieval only when the set of graph-linkable entities expands, yielding an asynchronous self-clocking policy that bypasses learned gates or heuristic thresholds.
