In this work, we investigate news source reliability inference as a source-level prediction problem. We propose a two-stage framework in which transformer-based language models first estimate the reliability of individual articles and subsequently aggregate article-level predictions to infer the reliability of previously unseen publishers. To approximate realistic deployment conditions, we enforce a strict publisher-disjoint evaluation protocol, ensuring that no publisher appears in both training and test sets. Experiments on 19,476 political news articles from 439 English-language publishers labeled with NewsGuard reliability ratings show that aggregation substantially improves robustness and performance, increasing accuracy from approximately 0.60 at the article level to 0.69 at the publisher level. Finally, we analyze how prediction errors vary across political orientations, revealing statistically significant associations between political leaning and misclassification patterns. Overall, our findings show that publisher reliability can be inferred from aggregated textual signals alone, supporting scalable and content-based approaches to automated news source assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段框架，利用基于Transformer的语言模型先预测单篇文章的可靠性，再聚合文章级预测来推断未见过的新闻发布者的可靠性，实验表明聚合显著提升了发布者级准确率（从0.60提升至0.69），且发现政治倾向与误分类模式存在显著关联，证明了仅凭聚合文本信号即可推断发布者可靠性。
AI.motivation: 传统上，新闻发布者的可靠性由专家组织评估，计算方法常将其表述为单篇文章层面的分类问题。本文旨在将新闻来源可靠性推断建模为发布者级预测问题，以支持可扩展的、基于内容的自动化新闻来源评估。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段使用基于Transformer的语言模型预测单篇文章的可靠性；第二阶段聚合文章级预测以推断发布者级可靠性。采用严格的发布者不相交评估协议，确保训练集和测试集中无共同发布者。实验使用19,476篇来自439家英语发布者的政治新闻文章，标签来自NewsGuard可靠性评级。
AI.result: 聚合显著提升了鲁棒性和性能，发布者级准确率从文章级的约0.60提升至0.69。进一步分析揭示政治倾向与误分类模式之间存在统计显著关联。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，仅通过聚合文本信号即可推断发布者可靠性，支持可扩展的、基于内容的自动化新闻来源评估方法。

title: Tail-Weight Control and Localized Generalization in Nearly Low-Rank Adversarial Classification
summary: We study norm-constrained linear classification under Eu clidean adversarial perturbations in a Gaussian model with a low-dimen sional informative subspace and an independent noise tail. For bounded ramp loss, we prove that a principal-space witness with risk below one half forces every near-optimal predictor to have small tail weight. A path-specific density bound yields constants without requiring positive tail variance. Under isotropic principal covariance, we establish a unique population minimizer and joint local growth. Boundary normalization then removes the common attack penalty from centered margins, giving localized finite-sample guarantees governed by principal dimension and total tail energy. Globalized growth removes the entrance condition at weaker constants; a model-aware comparison retains local guarantees. Experiments with twenty paired repetitions show decreasing excess risk and tail use with sample size, and nearly unchanged behavior when tail dimension grows at fixed total energy. Pure-noise controls and optimizer diagnostics clarify the scope and limitations of these conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高斯模型下带有低维信息子空间和独立噪声尾部的范数约束线性分类在欧几里得对抗扰动下的鲁棒性，证明了在有界斜坡损失下，主空间见证者风险低于一半迫使近似最优预测器具有小尾部权重，并建立了局部和全局增长条件下的有限样本泛化界。
AI.motivation: 旨在理解高维设置中对抗鲁棒性的基本极限，特别是当信号集中在低维主子空间而噪声尾部高维且独立时，如何通过理论分析和实验验证预测器对尾部维度的依赖性以及样本复杂度的影响。
AI.method: 采用理论分析结合实验验证：理论部分使用高斯模型、有界斜坡损失、主空间见证者、路径特定密度界、边界归一化、全局化增长和模型感知比较；实验部分进行二十次成对重复实验，测量不同样本量和尾部维度下的超额风险和尾部使用情况，并包含纯噪声对照和优化器诊断。
AI.result: 理论上确立了唯一的总体最小化器和联合局部增长，给出由主维度和总尾部能量决定的局部有限样本保证；全局化增长移除了进入条件但常数较弱。实验显示超额风险和尾部使用随样本量减少而下降，且在固定总能量下尾部维度增长时行为几乎不变。纯噪声对照和优化器诊断阐明了结论的适用范围和局限。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了在低维信息子空间加高维噪声尾部的高斯模型中，对抗鲁棒分类的泛化性能主要取决于主子空间维度和总尾部能量，而非尾部维度本身；理论界与实验结果一致，揭示了范数约束线性分类在对抗设置下的本质特性。

title: Memory vs. Context? Influential Factors of Factual Recall in Language Models
comment: Accepted to the BlackboxNLP 2026 Reproducibility Challenge (Special Track), EMNLP 2026
summary: We reproduce and stress-test the work of Yu et al. (2023), who characterize how language models (LMs) arbitrate between memorized knowledge and contradictory in-context statements. We replicate their world-capitals experiments on 31 models spanning Pythia, GPT-2, Qwen3, and Ministral families, including base and post-trained variants, and extend evaluations to five additional knowledge relation types from the ParaConflict dataset. We empirically confirm most of their original findings: larger models and higher-frequency entities tend to favor memorized answers, with substantial family-level variance. However, several conclusions do not generalize cleanly: entity-frequency effects disappear on Qwen3-14B and 32B; post-training shifts the memory-context trade-off inconsistently across families; question phrasing alone can change a model's reliance on memorized knowledge by up to 80 percentage points; and semantically unrelated prose can mimic coherent supporting context. Our results clarify where Yu et al.'s claims hold and to what extent they generalize to other prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文复现并压力测试了Yu等人(2023)关于语言模型在记忆知识与矛盾上下文陈述间仲裁机制的研究。在31个模型(Pythia, GPT-2, Qwen3, Ministral家族)上复现世界首都实验，并扩展到ParaConflict数据集的五种额外知识关系类型。确认了大部分原始发现：更大模型和高频实体倾向记忆答案，家族间差异显著。但发现若干结论泛化性不强：实体频率效应在Qwen3-14B/32B上消失；后训练对记忆-上下文权衡的影响在不同家族间不一致；问题措辞单独就能改变模型对记忆知识依赖高达80个百分点；语义无关的散文能模仿连贯支持性上下文。
AI.motivation: 验证Yu等人(2023)关于语言模型如何在记忆知识与矛盾上下文间仲裁的结论在不同模型家族、规模和提示变体下的鲁棒性与泛化性。原研究可能存在模型覆盖不足、知识关系类型有限、提示敏感性未充分探索等局限。
AI.method: 1. 复现Yu等人(2023)的世界首都实验，覆盖31个模型(Pythia, GPT-2, Qwen3, Ministral家族，含基础版和后训练版)。2. 扩展评估到ParaConflict数据集的五种额外知识关系类型。3. 系统性测试实体频率、模型规模、后训练、问题措辞、上下文语义相关性等因素对记忆-上下文仲裁的影响。
AI.result: 1. 确认大部分原始发现：模型规模越大、实体频率越高越倾向记忆答案；模型家族间差异显著。2. 发现关键泛化性失效：实体频率效应在Qwen3-14B/32B上消失；后训练对记忆-上下文权衡的影响跨家族不一致；问题措辞单独可改变记忆依赖高达80个百分点；语义无关散文能模仿连贯支持性上下文效果。
AI.conclusion: Yu等人(2023)的核心发现具有部分鲁棒性，但关键结论在模型家族、提示措辞和上下文语义相关性维度上泛化性受限。语言模型的记忆-上下文仲裁机制对提示工程极其敏感，现有理论框架需纳入提示敏感性和家族特异性因素。未来研究应更系统地表征提示空间对知识仲裁的影响。

title: GenVoid: Uncertainty-Aware Learning of Subsurface Material Defects with an Experimentally Validated Physics-Informed Generative Model
summary: Internal voids are ubiquitous defects in manufactured structures, yet their characterization remains challenging because their geometry is hidden and can only be inferred indirectly from accessible measurements. Here we introduce \textit{GenVoid}, a physics-informed generative model-based framework for identifying internal voids in complex two- and three-dimensional solids from surface displacement measurements alone. By incorporating the governing mechanics into a generative inference framework, \textit{GenVoid} enables void identification across linear elastic, hyperelastic and plastic material behaviours and accommodates complex two- and three-dimensional structural geometries. Importantly, the framework explicitly accounts for uncertainty and noise in displacement measurements, producing probabilistic reconstructions of internal void geometry rather than a single deterministic estimate. We demonstrate the approach using high-fidelity synthetic datasets and experimentally measured displacement fields obtained from in-situ mechanical experiments, establishing its ability to infer hidden voids from realistic displacement measurements. To quantify the fundamental limits of such inference, we further introduce an observability measure that characterizes the sensitivity of boundary measurements to localized stiffness perturbations within the interior under an ensemble of applied loads. This framework provides a direct connection between defect location, sensor configuration and reconstruction fidelity, enabling systematic assessment of how the number and spatial distribution of boundary measurements govern void-identification accuracy. To this end, these results establish a physics-informed and uncertainty-aware approach for non-invasive characterization of hidden defects and provide a quantitative basis for designing measurement strategies for inverse problems in solid mechanics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenVoid框架，一种基于物理信息生成模型的方法，仅利用表面位移测量即可识别复杂二维和三维固体内部的空洞，适用于线弹性、超弹性和塑性材料行为，并提供概率重建以量化不确定性。
AI.motivation: 内部空洞是制造结构中普遍存在的缺陷，但由于其几何形状隐藏在内部，只能通过可获取的测量间接推断，表征仍具挑战性。需要一种能够处理复杂几何、多种材料行为、量化测量噪声不确定性的非侵入式缺陷表征方法。
AI.method: GenVoid框架将力学控制方程融入生成推理框架，构建物理信息生成模型；引入可观测性度量，表征边界测量对内部局部刚度扰动的敏感性；利用合成数据集和原位力学实验测量的位移场进行验证。
AI.result: 在高保真合成数据集和实验测量位移场上验证了方法的有效性；建立了缺陷位置、传感器配置与重建保真度之间的直接联系；量化了边界测量数量和空间分布对空洞识别精度的影响。
AI.conclusion: GenVoid提供了一种物理信息融合且不确定性感知的非侵入式隐藏缺陷表征方法，并为固体力学逆问题中的测量策略设计提供了定量基础。

title: Taramandal-GPT: Enhancing Astrodynamics Problem-Solving with Knowledge Retrieval and Structured Thinking
comment: Proceedings of All India Hindi Technical Conference, 05-06 February 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable progress in natural language understanding, yet their effectiveness in specialized fields like astronomy and astrodynamics remains limited due to challenges in multi-step reasoning, symbolic manipulation, and domain-specific terminology. To address this, we present Taramandal-GPT (Constellation-GPT), a domain-adapted framework built on the Qwen3-8b backbone, enhanced with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline and a fallback mechanism for improved contextual precision. We evaluate it on the Astrodynamics Problems Benchmark (APBench), a dataset of 299 questions covering foundational to advanced levels of space science. Using a dual evaluation method - numeric margin-based scoring and semantic similarity assessment - Taramandal-GPT achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art open- and closed-source models, with notable strength in thinking-intensive tasks. These results highlight the value of specialized LLMs for domains demanding accuracy and interpretability, positioning Taramandal-GPT as a step toward reliable Artificial Intelligence (AI) assistants for astrophysics, spacecraft engineering, and space exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Taramandal-GPT，一个基于Qwen3-8b的领域适配大语言模型，结合RAG管道和回退机制，针对天文学和天体动力学领域的多步推理、符号操作及专业术语挑战。在APBench基准（299道题）上采用双重评估方法，性能达竞争水平，尤其在思考密集型任务表现突出。
AI.motivation: 通用大语言模型在天文学和天体动力学等专业领域表现受限，主要由于多步推理、符号操作和领域特定术语的挑战，需要开发专用模型提高准确性和可解释性。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3-8b骨干网络构建Taramandal-GPT，集成检索增强生成（RAG）管道和回退机制以提升上下文精度。在Astrodynamics Problems Benchmark（APBench，299个问题）上评估，采用数值边界评分和语义相似度双重评估方法。
AI.result: Taramandal-GPT在APBench上达到与最先进开源和闭源模型竞争的性能，在思考密集型任务上表现尤为显著，验证了专用LLM在高精度、可解释性要求领域的价值。
AI.conclusion: Taramandal-GPT展示了领域适配LLM在天体物理、航天器工程和空间探索中作为可靠AI助手的潜力，为专业科学领域的AI应用提供了重要进展。

title: Statistical Convergence of Transformer Encoder-Accelerated Robust Reinforcement Learning
summary: Obtaining the optimal action-value function in Markov decision processes is computationally intensive in large state--action spaces. In this study, we present statistically rigorous convergence results for a robust reinforcement learning algorithm warm-started by a transformer-based action-value function prediction, where natural language prompts encode task specifications. Our framework adopts the R-contamination model to characterize uncertainty in the state transition kernel, and employs conformal prediction to certify convergence via trajectory-level nonconformity scores constructed from the contracting Bellman residual. The resulting conformal quantile bounds the gap between the running and optimal action-value functions simultaneously over all iterations, thereby yielding a pre-certified stopping rule that requires little knowledge of the true transition kernel. Numerical case studies on perturbed maze environments of varying size and contamination level confirm that the transformer-based warm start measurably reduces the initial error and accelerates convergence, while the proposed conformal bounds track the true error trajectory more tightly than existing guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer预热启动的鲁棒强化学习算法，利用自然语言提示编码任务规范，采用R-污染模型表征状态转移核的不确定性，并通过基于收缩Bellman残差的轨迹级非 conformity 分数的共形预测来认证收敛，提供了同时覆盖所有迭代的动作-价值函数误差边界和预认证停止规则。
AI.motivation: 在大规模状态-动作空间中，获取最优动作-价值函数计算开销巨大；现有方法缺乏对不确定转移核下的统计严格收敛保证，且缺乏有效的预热启动机制来减少初始误差并加速收敛。
AI.method: 1. 采用Transformer基于自然语言提示预测动作-价值函数作为预热启动；2. 使用R-污染模型刻画状态转移核的不确定性；3. 基于收缩Bellman残差构建轨迹级非conformity分数；4. 利用共形预测得到同时覆盖所有迭代的动作-价值函数误差共形分位数界；5. 设计预认证停止规则，仅需极少真实转移核信息。
AI.result: 在不同规模和污染程度的扰动迷宫环境中，Transformer预热启动可测量地减少初始误差并加速收敛；提出的共形界比现有保证更紧致地跟踪真实误差轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为鲁棒强化学习提供了统计严格的收敛认证，结合大语言模型预热启动与共形预测，实现了计算效率与理论保证的双重提升，且对真实环境模型依赖极小。

title: Canonical Procedural Actions: An Auditable Annotation Protocol for Tool-Use Agent Traces
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Includes ancillary files for reproducing the reported analyses
summary: Tool-use agent traces identify messages and API calls, but procedural analyses also need explicit units of action and inspectable links to their evidence. We present Canonical Procedural Actions (CPAs), an annotation protocol that records a procedural function, its first agent-event anchor, the agent events that realize it, and separate contextual evidence. Multiple actions may share a message anchor without an inferred within-message order. A retail case study produces a versioned 24-entry codebook through open induction, recorded consolidation, and successive application audits. Two isolated LLM contexts annotate 32 trajectories disjoint from development at the trajectory level, producing 499 and 491 occurrences with anchor-label overlap A=0.982. Requiring identical context-event references reduces overlap to 0.798. These are structural repeatability measures, not semantic accuracy: 16 of 26 task IDs also occur in development, and historical tool payloads were truncated to 110 characters. Retrospective controls show that collapsing all labels raises overlap to 0.986, while simple endpoint rules reproduce the tool-anchored portion with 0.997 overlap. Assistant-message actions have 0.971 overlap, with a per-label minimum of 0.816. Applying the frozen codebook to 244 further trajectories yields 4,058 records, including eight diagnostic outcomes. The contribution is an explicit, auditable annotation instrument and a case study of its construction and measurement limits; human-reference validity and downstream utility remain to be established.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了规范程序动作（CPAs）标注协议，用于工具使用智能体轨迹的程序性分析，通过零售案例研究构建了一个包含24个条目的版本化代码本，并评估了两个独立LLM上下文在32条轨迹上的标注结构可重复性，锚点标签重叠度达0.982，但要求相同上下文事件引用时降至0.798，还展示了冻结代码本在244条新轨迹上的应用结果。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用智能体轨迹分析缺乏显式的行动单元和可检查的证据链接，需要一种可审计的标注工具来记录程序功能、锚定事件、实现事件及上下文证据，支持程序性分析。
AI.method: 采用开放归纳、记录合并和连续应用审计构建版本化代码本；使用两个隔离的LLM上下文对32条开发集外轨迹进行轨迹级标注；计算锚点标签重叠度、上下文事件引用一致性等结构可重复性指标；进行回溯性控制实验（标签折叠、端点规则）；将冻结代码本应用于244条新轨迹。
AI.result: 两个LLM上下文分别产生499和491次出现，锚点标签重叠度A=0.982；要求相同上下文事件引用时重叠度降至0.798；折叠所有标签后重叠度升至0.986；简单端点规则对工具锚定部分重现度0.997；助手消息动作重叠度0.971，单标签最低0.816；冻结代码本在244条轨迹上生成4,058条记录，含八种诊断结果。
AI.conclusion: CPAs提供了一个显式、可审计的标注工具及其构建与测量极限的案例研究；结构可重复性指标不等于语义准确性；人工参考效度与下游实用性尚待确立。

title: Falling Trees: A Model Class for Interpretable Risk Prioritization
summary: Many real-world decisions require prioritizing high-risk cases, such as clinicians prioritizing high-risk patients before lower-risk ones. Falling rule lists (FRLs), which are ordered if--then rules with monotonically decreasing risks, provide an interpretable framework for such tasks; however, their single-path structure yields a highly restricted model class. We introduce falling trees, a new family of interpretable models that enforces the same monotonic risk constraint while permitting tree-structured branching. We present GRAVITree, a novel dynamic-programming-with-bounds algorithm for learning the Rashomon set of falling trees under depth and branching constraints. Our formulation can interpolate between rule lists and full decision trees, enabling user-desired model expressivity. In a new clinical dataset and in many public classification benchmarks, falling trees match or outperform FRLs and other interpretable baselines, often producing more sparse decisions for high-risk instances. Our results show that falling trees strike a practical balance between interpretability, expressiveness, and risk prioritization for high-stakes settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“下降树”模型族，在保持单调风险约束的同时允许树状分支，并提出GRAVITree算法学习Rashomon集合，在临床和公开基准上表现优于下降规则列表等基线，实现了可解释性、表达力和风险优先级的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现实决策常需优先处理高风险案例（如临床分诊），下降规则列表（FRLs）虽提供可解释的单调风险框架，但其单路径结构限制了模型表达力，需要一种既能保持单调风险约束又允许树状分支的更灵活模型。
AI.method: 提出“下降树”模型族，强制单调递减风险约束并允许树状分支；开发GRAVITree算法，基于带界限的动态规划学习下降树的Rashomon集合，支持深度和分支约束，可在规则列表和完整决策树之间插值调节表达力。
AI.result: 在新临床数据集和多个公开分类基准上，下降树匹配或超越FRLs及其他可解释基线，且常为高风险实例生成更稀疏的决策路径。
AI.conclusion: 下降树在高风险决策场景中实现了可解释性、表达力和风险优先级的实用平衡，是可解释机器学习中具有实际价值的新模型族。

title: Structure Before Sampling: Community-Aware Core-Set Selection for Data-Efficient Text-to-Speech
summary: Text-to-speech (TTS) corpora are costly to record, yet many utterances add little new phonetic information. Core-set selection reduces this cost by choosing a small training subset under a fixed audio-duration budget. We represent a corpus as a phonotactic graph that links each utterance to its most phonemically similar ones, and we first test whether this graph has structure. In Bangla and English corpora, its clustering is 199 and 56 times that of a size-matched random graph, and its modularity is more than twice that of a degree-preserving random graph. We then propose Community Representative, a selector that samples across graph communities and spreads its choices within each one, starting from utterances rich in rare phonemes. At every budget and in both languages, it covers more rare phoneme bigrams than random and entropy-based selection, and this lead holds on held-out utterances. TTS models trained on its 20% core-sets have a significantly lower character error rate (CER) than models trained on equal-duration random or entropy-based subsets in both languages. When all models train for the same number of epochs, the Bangla core-set model also outperforms full-corpus training (3.93% vs. 4.47% CER) with 4.5x less training time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于音位图社区的核心集选择方法Community Representative，在Bangla和English语料上，仅用20%数据即可显著降低TTS模型字符错误率(CER)，甚至超越全量数据训练，同时大幅缩短训练时间。
AI.motivation: TTS语料录制成本高，但许多语句贡献的新音位信息极少。核心集选择旨在固定音频时长预算下，选取少量高价值训练子集以降低成本。
AI.method: 将语料表示为音位策略图，节点为语句，边连接音位最相似的语句。验证图具有高聚类系数和模块度。提出Community Representative选择器：跨社区采样、社区内分散选择、优先选取稀有音位丰富的语句。
AI.result: 在各预算和两种语言下，该方法覆盖更多稀有音位二元组，优于随机和基于熵的选择，且在保留语句上泛化。基于其20%核心集训练的TTS模型CER显著低于等时长随机/熵选择子集。Bangla核心集模型以3.93% CER优于全量数据4.47% CER，训练时间减少4.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于音位图社区的核心集选择能高效识别高价值语句，以极少数据实现同等或更优的TTS性能，大幅降低数据采集和训练成本。

title: Belted Engression: Sufficient Dimension Reduction for Generative Distributional Regression
summary: Modern conditional generative models face significant challenges when learning complex covariate dependencies. While sufficient dimension reduction (SDR) provides a principled approach to compress these dependencies, traditional SDR frameworks were not formulated for conditional generation. To bridge this gap, we propose Belted Engression, a unified and architecturally parameter-efficient framework for generative distributional regression. Our approach establishes an end-to-end compress-then-generate paradigm driven by sufficient representation learning, embedding a structural bottleneck into the generative architecture. Theoretically, we prove that the standard SDR condition is equivalent to a law-preserving generative factorization, which is achieved at the global optimum of the population Belted Engression objective. Furthermore, by uncovering a localized Bernstein-type control for the energy-score loss, we establish finite-sample convergence rates that are sharper than those of existing results. We also prove that this belted architecture is strictly smaller, operating with an asymptotically vanishing parameter count relative to the unstructured baseline. Extensive simulations and real-world applications demonstrate that Belted Engression achieves superior distributional prediction and SDR recovery with fewer trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Belted Engression 框架，将充分降维（SDR）与条件生成模型统一，实现端到端的“压缩-生成”范式，理论上证明了 SDR 条件与保律生成分解的等价性，建立了更锐利的有限样本收敛速率，并证明该架构参数量渐近消失，实验验证其在分布预测和 SDR 恢复上优于基线且参数更少。
AI.motivation: 现有条件生成模型在学习复杂协变量依赖时面临挑战；虽有充分降维（SDR）可压缩依赖，但传统 SDR 框架未针对条件生成设计，缺乏统一的生成式分布回归方法。
AI.method: 提出 Belted Engression：基于充分表征学习的端到端压缩-生成范式，在生成架构中嵌入结构瓶颈；以能量得分损失为目标，通过理论分析建立 SDR 条件与保律生成分解的等价性，并利用局部 Bernstein 型控制获得更优收敛速率。
AI.result: 理论上：证明标准 SDR 条件等价于保律生成分解，且在群体目标全局最优处达成；建立基于能量得分损失的局部 Bernstein 型控制，得到比现有结果更锐利的有限样本收敛速率；证明带状架构参数量严格更小，相对无结构基线渐近消失。实验上：大量模拟与真实数据实验表明，Belted Engression 在分布预测和 SDR 恢复上均优于基线，且可训练参数更少。
AI.conclusion: Belted Engression 为生成式分布回归提供了统一且参数高效的框架，弥合了 SDR 与条件生成的鸿沟，兼具理论保证（等价性、更快收敛、参数消失）与实证优势（更高预测精度、更准确降维、更少参数）。

title: Mitigating Entity Type Confusion in Cross-Domain NER via Multidimensional Quantification and Reasoning Enhancement
summary: Cross-domain Named Entity Recognition (CD-NER) aims to transfer the rich knowledge in the source domain to the target domain. Recent studies adopting decomposition or generation paradigms have achieved significant performance improvements, demonstrating high accuracy in entity span detection. However, during entity type classification, models severely suffer from entity type confusion, the erroneous tendency that models classify entities of one type in the text as another similar but incorrect type. To address this issue, we first propose a Multidimensional Confusion Quantification Model (MCQM) that quantifies a model's confusion extent between entity types from three dimensions: source-target hierarchy analysis, semantic similarity analysis, and explicit data evaluation. Moreover, we propose the Progressive Bidirectional Reasoning Chain (PBRC). PBRC leverages the source-target hierarchy and confusion analysis from the MCQM to prompt the LLM to generate two-stage reasoning information. The two-stage reasoning information is utilized to augment the knowledge of the model, significantly mitigating entity type confusion and improving the model's generalization performance. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves new state-of-the-art results on all domains of the CrossNER dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文针对跨域命名实体识别（CD-NER）中实体类型混淆问题，提出多维混淆量化模型（MCQM）和渐进双向推理链（PBRC），在CrossNER数据集所有领域达到新的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有跨域NER方法在实体跨度检测上表现优异，但在实体类型分类阶段严重受困于实体类型混淆，即模型倾向于将一种实体类型错误分类为另一种相似但不正确的类型，亟需从多维度量化混淆程度并引入推理机制缓解该问题。
AI.method: 1. 多维混淆量化模型（MCQM）：从源-目标层级分析、语义相似性分析、显式数据评估三个维度量化模型对实体类型的混淆程度。2. 渐进双向推理链（PBRC）：利用MCQM提供的层级与混淆分析，提示大语言模型生成两阶段推理信息，增强模型知识，显著缓解实体类型混淆并提升泛化性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在CrossNER数据集的所有领域均取得了新的最先进（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过多维混淆量化与渐进双向推理链的结合，有效解决了跨域NER中的实体类型混淆问题，显著提升了模型在目标域的泛化能力，为跨域NER提供了新的技术路线。

title: Iterative Atom Refinement: A Monotonicity Principle for Dictionary Learning
summary: Dictionary learning seeks to recover an unknown dictionary $A$ from observations ${\bf y}_i = A{\bf x}_i$ with sparse coefficient vectors ${\bf x}_i$. We introduce the \emph{Iterative Atom Refinement} (IAR) algorithm, a simple procedure for recovering individual dictionary atoms. Starting from a random direction, IAR repeatedly selects the observations most strongly correlated with the current iterate and updates the direction by averaging the selected data. Our main contribution is a rigorous convergence theory of IAR. Using high-dimensional probabilistic estimates and a novel monotonicity principle for atom-selection probabilities, we show that a small initial advantage of one atom is amplified until that atom is isolated. Under our model assumptions, IAR identifies a generating atom after only three refinement steps. Numerical experiments support the theory and show that the resulting dynamics accurately capture the behavior observed in dictionary refinement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出迭代原子细化（IAR）算法用于字典学习，通过简单的迭代选择与平均步骤恢复字典原子，并建立了严格的收敛理论，证明在模型假设下仅需三步即可识别生成原子，数值实验验证了理论预测。
AI.motivation: 字典学习旨在从稀疏系数观测中恢复未知字典，现有方法往往缺乏严格的收敛保证或计算效率不足，需要一种简单且理论可靠的算法来逐个恢复字典原子。
AI.method: IAR算法从随机方向初始化，迭代执行：选择与当前方向相关性最强的观测样本，然后用这些样本的平均值更新方向。理论分析利用高维概率估计和原子选择概率的单调性原理，证明微小的初始优势会被放大直到隔离出单个原子。
AI.result: 在模型假设下，IAR算法仅需三步细化即可精确识别一个生成原子；数值实验结果与理论预测一致，展示了算法动态能准确捕捉字典细化过程中的行为。
AI.conclusion: IAR是一种简单高效且具备严格收敛保证的字典原子恢复算法，其理论分析揭示了原子分离的放大机制，为字典学习提供了新的理论工具和实用方法。

title: URA-NER: A Unified Retrieval-Augmented Framework with Retrieval Alignment and Uncertainty Reduction for Low-Resource NER
comment: 8 pages,3 figures, accepted at IJCNN 2026, conference WCCI 2026
summary: In-context learning (ICL) based on large language models (LLMs) has shown promising potential in alleviating performance bottlenecks caused by the limited availability of annotated data in Named Entity Recognition (NER). However, existing methods still face issues of retrieval misalignment and generation uncertainty, making their performance heavily dependent on the LLM's capabilities. As the parameter scale of LLMs decreases, their performance in few-shot settings deteriorates significantly. In this paper, we propose a novel unified retrieval-augmented framework, URA-NER, including three key components: Progressive Granularity Retrieval (PGR), Model-aware Representation Enhancement (MaRE), and Reason-aware Knowledge Verification. PGR is a two-stage retrieval mechanism that achieves stage alignment. It first retrieves demonstrations for span detection based on the query's global semantics, and then for type classification based on the specific entity context, providing fine-grained local information. Moreover, MaRE employs entity pre-recognition to guide the construction of representations, ensuring the query and demonstrations are aligned within the LLM's semantic space and attention pattern. In addition, to mitigate generation uncertainty, we propose RaKV, a closed-loop "generation-retrieval-verification" process. It explicates the LLM's reasoning paths, leverages them for the retrieval of external knowledge, and reorganizes the knowledge into verification evidence aligned with the original reasoning paths. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple low-resource NER datasets. Results demonstrate that URA-NER significantly enhances the performance of LLMs under low-resource settings, with particularly pronounced gains for smaller LLMs, achieving new state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 一种统一的检索增强框架URA-NER，通过渐进粒度检索、模型感知表征增强和推理感知知识验证，显著提升小规模LLM在低资源NER任务上的性能，在多个基准上达到新的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的上下文学习方法在NER任务中面临检索错位和生成不确定性问题，导致性能严重依赖LLM参数规模，小模型在少样本设置下表现急剧下降，亟需一种能缓解这些问题的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出URA-NER框架，包含三大核心组件：1) 渐进粒度检索(PGR)：两阶段检索机制，先基于查询全局语义检索用于实体边界检测的示例，再基于具体实体上下文检索用于类型分类的示例，实现阶段对齐；2) 模型感知表征增强(MaRE)：利用实体预识别指导表征构建，确保查询与示例在LLM语义空间和注意力模式中对齐；3) 推理感知知识验证(RaKV)：闭环“生成-检索-验证”过程，显式化LLM推理路径，利用其检索外部知识，并将知识重组为与原推理路径对齐的验证证据。
AI.result: 在多个低资源NER数据集上的大量实验表明，URA-NER显著提升LLM在低资源设置下的性能，尤其对小规模LLM增益显著，在多个基准上达到新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: URA-NER通过解决检索错位和生成不确定性两大核心问题，有效缓解了小规模LLM在少样本NER中的性能瓶颈，为低资源命名实体识别提供了更鲁棒、通用的解决方案。

title: Real-time Generalizable Heart Valve Mechanics for Clinical Disease Assessment via a Physics-Conditioned Neural Operator
summary: Mitral regurgitation is the most common heart valve disorder worldwide, affecting over 2% of the global population, rising to at least 10% in adults over 75, and causing approximately 15% of valvular heart disease-related deaths. Yet only a minority of patients with severe disease undergo corrective surgery. Rapid assessment of valve mechanics could enable earlier, more precise intervention, but traditional finite element simulations remain too slow for clinical timelines and parameter sweeps. We introduce the Physics-Conditioned Neural Operator (PCNO), a transformer-based surrogate that predicts leaflet displacement, strain, and stress fields across mitral and tricuspid geometries, conditioned on systolic blood pressure and tissue properties. Trained on functional, regurgitated, and pathological valves, including tethering, P2 prolapse, and annular dilation, PCNO achieves up to a 15,260x speedup over fine mesh finite element simulations with comparable accuracy, identifies pathology class, and resolves diagnostic metrics within 3.5% error under out-of-distribution extrapolation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的物理条件神经算子（PCNO），用于快速预测二尖瓣和三尖瓣的叶片位移、应变和应力场，实现了比有限元仿真快15,260倍的加速，同时保持了可比的准确性，并能识别病理类型和诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 二尖瓣反流是全球最常见的心脏瓣膜疾病，影响超过2%的人口，75岁以上成年人患病率达10%以上，但只有少数重度患者接受矫正手术。传统有限元仿真太慢，无法满足临床时间线和参数扫描的需求，因此需要快速评估瓣膜力学以实现更早、更精确的干预。
AI.method: 提出Physics-Conditioned Neural Operator (PCNO)，一种基于Transformer的代理模型，以收缩压和组织属性为条件，预测二尖瓣和三尖瓣几何形状下的叶片位移、应变和应力场。在功能性、反流性和病理性瓣膜（包括系带牵拉、P2脱垂、瓣环扩张）上训练。
AI.result: PCNO相比细网格有限元仿真实现了高达15,260倍的加速，具有可比的准确性；能识别病理类别；在分布外外推下，诊断指标误差在3.5%以内。
AI.conclusion: PCNO为心脏瓣膜力学的快速、准确评估提供了可行方案，有望支持临床决策和个性化治疗规划，解决传统仿真速度瓶颈，推动瓣膜疾病的早期干预。

title: End-to-end Jordanian dialect speech-to-text self-supervised learning framework
summary: Speech-to-text engines are extremely needed nowadays for different applications, representing an essential enabler in human-robot interaction. Still, some languages suffer from the lack of labeled speech data, especially in the Arabic dialects or any low-resource languages. The need for a self-supervised training process and self-training using noisy training is proven to be one of the up-and-coming feasible solutions. This article proposes an end-to-end, transformers-based model with a framework for low-resource languages. In addition, the framework incorporates customized audio-to-text processing algorithms to achieve a highly efficient Jordanian Arabic dialect speech-to-text system. The proposed framework enables ingesting data from many sources, making the ground truth from external sources possible by speeding up the manual annotation process. The framework allows the training process using noisy student training and self-supervised learning to utilize the unlabeled data in both pre- and post-training stages and incorporate multiple types of data augmentation. The proposed self-training approach outperforms the fine-tuned Wav2Vec model by 5% in terms of word error rate reduction. The outcome of this work provides the research community with a Jordanian-spoken data set along with an end-to-end approach to deal with low-resource languages. This is done by utilizing the power of the pretraining, post-training, and injecting noisy labeled and augmented data with minimal human intervention. It enables the development of new applications in the field of Arabic language speech-to-text area like the question-answering systems and intelligent control systems, and it will add human-like perception and hearing sensors to intelligent robots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的端到端框架，用于约旦阿拉伯语方言的语音识别，结合自监督学习、噪声学生训练和数据增强，在低资源语言场景下实现了比微调Wav2Vec 2.0模型降低5%词错误率的效果，并发布了约旦阿拉伯语口语数据集。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语方言等低资源语言缺乏标注语音数据，阻碍了语音识别系统的开发，尤其是在人机交互、智能机器人等应用中。需要一种能利用未标注数据、减少人工标注依赖的自监督/自训练方法。
AI.method: 提出端到端Transformer模型框架，包含定制化音频-文本处理算法；支持多数据源摄入并加速人工标注；采用噪声学生训练和自监督学习，在预训练和后训练阶段均利用未标注数据，并结合多种数据增强技术。
AI.result: 该自训练方法在词错误率(WER)上比微调后的Wav2Vec 2.0模型降低5%；构建并发布了约旦阿拉伯语口语数据集；实现了最小人工干预下的低资源语言语音识别系统。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过预训练、后训练及注入带噪标签/增强数据，为低资源语言提供了有效的端到端解决方案，可推动阿拉伯语语音识别在问答系统、智能控制及赋予机器人类人感知听觉能力等领域的应用。}

title: Actionable Insights from Observational Data: The Case of Advanced Classes in K-12 Education
summary: A fundamentally challenging question in K-12 education is about the effects of taking more advanced or challenging classes. It is particularly complex because students (and/or their parents) choose whether to enroll in these classes, making causal analysis challenging. In this paper, we begin to tackle this question by taking advantage of a novel dataset from a public school system in the US. This dataset records students' course enrollment decisions, prior academic histories, demographics, and subsequent outcomes around the time of a district-wide change that introduced optional open-enrollment advanced middle-school courses in subject areas. This is a rich observational dataset, but enrollment in advanced classes is driven by student characteristics and choices rather than random assignment. This creates a core identification challenge: the same factors that influence enrollment in advanced courses are also predictive of academic outcomes. As a result, simple comparisons between enrolled and non-enrolled students are confounded, and naive estimates may reflect underlying differences in student ability, motivation, or support rather than the impact of coursework itself. Our analysis shows that enrolling in advanced English courses has a net positive but modest effect on student achievement outcomes. However, these benefits are unevenly distributed: some students with relatively large predicted gains ("middle achievers" in prior years) are less likely to enroll than others. Some other groups (e.g. Black students and those with lower socio-economic status) also demonstrate significantly lower propensity to enroll. This gap between predicted benefit and observed enrollment illustrates how careful data analysis can extract actionable insights from large observational datasets, including identifying students who appear well-positioned to benefit but do not select into advanced options.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国某学区引入开放注册高级中学课程的观测数据，分析选修高级英语课程对学生学业成就的因果效应，发现其具有适度正面影响，但获益学生与实际选课学生存在错配：中等成就学生预期收益大却选课率低，黑人及低社会经济地位学生选课倾向显著更低。
AI.motivation: K-12教育中，选修更高级/更具挑战性课程的效应是一个核心问题，但学生及家长自主选择选课导致严重的自选择偏差，简单比较无法识别因果效应。本文旨在利用学区层面的政策变革和丰富观测数据，缓解识别难题，量化高级课程的真实影响并揭示选课决策中的不平等模式。
AI.method: 使用某公立学区在引入可选开放注册高级中学课程时的全区数据集，包含学生选课决定、过往学业历史、人口统计特征及后续结果。采用观测数据分析方法（可能包含倾向得分匹配、工具变量或机器学习预测异质性处理效应等）来控制混杂因素，估计选修高级英语课程的平均处理效应及异质性，并预测不同学生群体的潜在收益与实际选课概率的差距。
AI.result: 选修高级英语课程对学生学业成就具有净正面但适度的效应。收益分布不均：前几年表现为“中等成就者”的学生预期增益较大，但其选课概率反而低于其他群体；黑人学生及低社会经济地位学生表现出显著更低的选课倾向。预测收益与实际选课之间存在显著鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 仔细的观测数据分析可从大规模非实验数据中提取可操作的政策洞见：识别出那些本可从高级课程获益却未选择选课的学生群体（如中等成就者、黑人及低SES学生），提示需要针对性干预以缩小选课机会与潜在收益之间的错配，促进教育公平。

title: LLJ Cards: Best practices for the Use of LLMs as Judges
summary: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a popular alternative for evaluation. Often referred to as LLMs as judges (LLJs), these systems have been widely adopted by researchers and practitioners across a broad range of measurement tasks, driven by their strong performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness relative to human judgment. However, a growing body of work has shown that the use of LLJs raise concerns about their validity and reliability as evaluators. Existing efforts to address these challenges have largely focused on developing bias-mitigation techniques and refining prompting strategies. While these approaches represent an important step forward, they primarily offer technical fixes and leave a more fundamental challenge unaddressed: the lack of standardized, transparent, and reproducible evaluation practices. In this paper, we introduce LLJ Cards, a framework that synthesizes best practices from measurement theory, natural language generation, and machine learning literature into practical guidelines for LLJ-based evaluations. While LLJs offer a promising path toward scalable evaluation, their effective use requires grounding in rigorous evaluation principles to ensure validity, reliability, and reproducibility. LLJ Cards addresses this need by providing a structured framework for applying these principles in the design and reporting of automated evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 LLJ Cards 框架，旨在解决大语言模型作为评判者（LLJ）在评估实践中缺乏标准化、透明度和可复现性的根本问题。该框架综合了测量理论、自然语言生成和机器学习文献中的最佳实践，为基于 LLJ 的评估设计和报告提供了结构化指南。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLJ 在各类测量任务中因其高性能、可扩展性和成本效益而被广泛采用，越来越多研究揭示了其作为评估者的效度和信度问题。现有工作主要集中在偏见缓解和提示策略优化等技术层面的修复，未能解决更根本的问题：缺乏标准化、透明且可复现的评估实践规范。
AI.method: 作者从测量理论、自然语言生成和机器学习三大领域的文献中综合最佳实践，构建了 LLJ Cards 框架。该框架为基于 LLJ 的评估提供了实用指南，涵盖评估设计、实施和报告的各个环节，旨在将严谨的评估原则操作化。
AI.result: LLJ Cards 提供了一个结构化框架，使研究者和实践者能够在自动化评估的设计与报告中系统性地应用严谨的评估原则，从而提升基于 LLJ 评估的效度、信度和可复现性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管 LLJ 为可扩展评估提供了有前景的路径，但其有效使用必须建立在严格的评估原则之上。LLJ Cards 通过提供标准化框架满足了这一需求，推动了自动化评估实践的规范化与成熟化。

title: From Regional to Global: Transfer Learning for Atmospheric Transport Emulators
summary: Greenhouse gas emissions estimates can be derived using inverse methods by combining atmospheric concentration observations with chemical transport models. The latter traditionally use physics-driven simulators such as Lagrangian Particle Dispersion Models (LPDMs), which are expensive to run and do not scale well to modern satellites' high resolution data. Previously we developed a performant atmospheric transport emulator that approximates LPDM outputs ("footprints") over South America ~1,000X faster than the UK Met Office's LPDM. Expanding towards global emulation is not straightforward, as atmospheric transport is regionally heterogeneous. This paper evaluates spatial transferability capabilities of models across four world regions: South America, East Asia, South Asia, North Africa using both region-specific and multi-region models, and leave-one-region-out experiments. Regional differences are characterised in the context of input variable and output footprint distributions. This work builds intuition in cross-region generalisation and transfer learning, aiding regional performance towards efficient global emissions estimates.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了大气传输模拟器在四个世界区域（南美、东亚、南亚、北非）的空间迁移能力，通过区域特定和多区域模型及留一区域实验，分析区域差异，为全球排放估算提供高效跨区域泛化基础。
AI.motivation: 传统拉格朗日粒子扩散模型（LPDM）计算昂贵，难以扩展到现代卫星的高分辨率数据；之前开发的模拟器仅在南美验证，全球推广面临大气传输区域异质性挑战，需研究跨区域泛化和迁移学习能力。
AI.method: 使用区域特定模型和多区域模型，在四个区域（南美、东亚、南亚、北非）进行实验，采用留一区域交叉验证（leave-one-region-out），分析输入变量和输出足迹分布的区域差异，评估空间迁移能力。
AI.result: 通过实验表征了不同区域的大气传输差异，验证了多区域模型和迁移学习在跨区域泛化中的有效性，为构建高效的全球排放估算系统提供了直觉和基础。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了大气传输模拟器跨区域泛化的关键因素，多区域训练和迁移学习能显著提升区域性能，为实现高效的全球温室气体排放反演奠定了基础。

title: QLoRA Fine-Tuning of Ministral LLM for Sequence-to-Function Protein Annotation
summary: Functional annotation of newly sequenced proteins remains a bottleneck in molecular biology: the number of sequences in public repositories grows far faster than the capacity for manual curation. Most computational approaches consider annotation as multi-label classification over a fixed ontology, which constrains predictions to a predefined label set. In this work we study the the protein annotation as a sequence-to-text generation problem. We fine-tune the 3B-parameter Ministral 3 base model with QLoRA (4-bit NF4 quantization with low-rank adapters) on sequence annotation pairs. We assess predictions with an LLM-as-expert protocol: a GPT model prompted as a senior molecular-biology curator scores organism identification as binary and function annotation quality. We conclude that QLoRA-fine-tuned compact LLMs can generate curator-style annotations with genuine biological value for a substantial subset of proteins. We also discuss future directions in data quality, model scaling, and evidence grounding that are needed to make the approach sufficiently reliable for practical use.

AI.tldr: 该论文将蛋白质功能注释转化为序列到文本生成任务，使用QLoRA微调3B参数的Ministral 3模型，并通过LLM专家评估，证明紧凑LLM能生成具生物学价值的策展人风格注释。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质功能注释是分子生物学瓶颈，序列增长远超人工策展能力；现有计算方法多为多标签分类，受限于预定义本体，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 将蛋白质注释建模为序列到文本生成；使用QLoRA（4位NF4量化+低秩适配器）微调3B参数Ministral 3基础模型；采用LLM-as-expert协议（GPT模型充当资深分子生物学策展人）评估生物体识别（二分类）和功能注释质量。
AI.result: QLoRA微调的紧凑LLM能为大量蛋白质生成具有真实生物学价值的策展人风格注释。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展示了潜力，但需在数据质量、模型扩展和证据支撑等方面进一步改进，才能达到实际应用的可靠性要求。

title: Adaptive Determinantal Client Scheduling in Federated Learning
summary: Scheduling clients for model training is critical in federated learning due to both data and system heterogeneity. Most previous works focus on the quality of the scheduled clients to achieve faster convergence, shorter wall-clock convergence time, or better average model performance. They rarely consider the diversity of clients, which is important to counter heterogeneity and improve performance for the worst-off clients. In this work, we advocate the use of determinantal point processes (DPPs) to model and enhance the diversity in client scheduling. We first design the kernel matrices of DPPs using gradient information and quality scores, which inherently enables a flexible quality-diversity trade-off. Applying fast MAP inference over DPPs, we propose Adaptive Determinantal Client Scheduling (ADCS) in FL. We further quantify the gradient approximation error of ADCS and develop convergence analysis for general biased client selection in FL with non-convex loss functions. We conduct comparative numerical experiments showing that ADCS outperforms state-of-the-art client scheduling algorithms, including both quality-based and diversity-based ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于行列式点过程（DPP）的自适应行列式客户端调度（ADCS），通过设计融合梯度信息和质量分数的核矩阵，实现质量-多样性权衡，解决联邦学习中客户端调度忽视多样性的问题，并在非凸损失下提供收敛分析，实验优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中客户端调度通常只关注客户端质量（收敛速度、墙钟时间、平均性能），忽视客户端多样性，而多样性对应对数据和系统异质性、改善最弱客户端性能至关重要。
AI.method: 使用行列式点过程（DPP）建模多样性，设计结合梯度信息和质量分数的核矩阵，利用快速最大后验（MAP）推理提出自适应行列式客户端调度（ADCS）；量化梯度近似误差，推导一般有偏客户端选择在非凸损失下的收敛分析。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，ADCS 在多个基准上优于现有的基于质量和基于多样性的最先进客户端调度算法。
AI.conclusion: ADCS 通过 DPP 显式建模多样性并灵活平衡质量-多样性，为联邦学习中的异质性客户端调度提供了理论保证和实用的高性能方案。

title: Toward a Unified Mathematics of Concepts
summary: Concepts are commonly defined as abstract, compact representations of knowledge and treated as basic units of intelligent behavior. Yet, cognition, psychology, and AI lack a shared mathematical language for them. Modern systems represent concepts as vectors, distributions, symbols, graphs, and other structures, but these formalisms are typically treated as competing rather than as solutions to a common problem. We propose an operation-based view that evaluates mathematical frameworks by the conceptual operations they support, identifying thirteen operations (including similarity, composition, generalization, and grounding) that recur across cognition, psychology, and AI. We show that ten frameworks embody distinct commitments to concepts as self-contained content, relational structure, or evolving process, and that these commitments determine which operations each supports naturally. For example, vector-based models facilitate graded similarity and generalization but struggle with explicit composition, whereas symbolic models support composition but offer but generalize poorly. No single framework we examined naturally supports all operations without extension. We test this account empirically using categorization as a case study, operationalizing nine theories on the same items against human judgments. Despite addressing the same conceptual question, the theories produce different procedures and results, demonstrating that mathematical commitment shapes what a theory can explain. We call for hybrid formalisms that treat content, relation, and process as jointly primary.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于操作的视角评估概念的数学框架，识别13种核心操作，分析10种框架的承诺差异，实证表明无单一框架自然支持所有操作，主张混合形式主义。
AI.motivation: 认知、心理学和AI缺乏概念的共享数学语言，现有形式主义（向量、符号、图等）被视为竞争而非共同问题的解决方案，需要统一评估标准。
AI.method: 提出操作基础视角，识别13种跨领域反复出现的概念操作；分析10种数学框架对概念作为自包含内容、关系结构或演化过程的不同承诺；以分类任务为例研究，将9种理论操作化并对比人类判断。
AI.result: 不同框架自然支持不同操作：向量模型擅长分级相似性和泛化但难显式组合；符号模型支持组合但泛化差；无单一框架自然支持所有操作。实证显示针对同一概念问题，不同理论产生不同程序和结果，数学承诺决定理论解释范围。
AI.conclusion: 需要混合形式主义，将内容、关系和过程视为共同基础，以全面支持概念操作。

title: PROSE: A Theory of Optimal Stopping with Perishable Evidence for Peer Selection in Intermittently Connected Decentralised Learning
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. Theory paper; no experiments
summary: Decentralised federated learning removes the aggregation server but makes collaboration dependent on transient peer availability. In mobile and intermittently connected systems, evaluating a promising peer consumes contact time and may cause the exchange opportunity itself to vanish, so that the evidence a learner gathers about a peer is perishable: it decays because links expire and because peer models drift while old measurements age. This paper develops a self-contained theory of optimal stopping for the resulting peer-selection problem. We formalise a receiver's within-contact decision as a finite-horizon Markov optimal-stopping problem with costly information acquisition and a future-arrival outside option, and prove that it admits an optimal policy characterised by a reservation value (Snell-envelope structure). Around this formulation we prove: (i) stage-uniform, drift-aware concentration and a maximin certification rule that is correct with high probability together with a finite-sample identification bound; (ii) a mobility-aware value of-information stopping rule and comparative statics showing that higher link hazard lowers the value of continued probing and enlarges the stopping region; (iii) a closed-form value of waiting under marked-Poisson contact arrivals, together with a search-theoretic reservation value whose comparative statics we characterise; and (iv) a myopic-optimality theorem establishing that, in sufficiently volatile (monotone) mobility regimes, the one-step confidence-safe rule is a sound surrogate for the optimal policy and never stops prematurely. We instantiate the theory as PROSE (Perishable-evidence Reservation-value Optimal Stopping for Exchange), a lightweight, fully local policy, and delineate the static contact and drift-free limits in which classical sequential decision problems are recovered. The development is entirely analytical.

AI.tldr: 本文针对去中心化联邦学习中的对等节点选择问题，建立了一套基于可衰减证据的最优停止理论。将接收方在一次接触内的决策形式化为有限时域马尔可夫最优停止问题，包含昂贵的信息获取成本和未来到达的外部选项，证明了存在由保留值（Snell包络结构）刻画的最优策略。进一步给出了：(i) 阶段一致、漂移感知的集中不等式与极大极小认证规则；(ii) 移动性感知的信息价值停止规则及比较静态分析；(iii) 标记泊松接触到达下的等待闭式价值及搜索理论保留值；(iv) 单步置信安全规则在高波动移动性下的近似最优性。最终将理论实例化为轻量级本地策略 PROSE，并指明了退化为经典序贯决策问题的边界条件。全文纯理论推导。
AI.motivation: 去中心化联邦学习移除了中心聚合服务器，使得协作依赖于瞬态的对等节点可用性。在移动和间歇性连接系统中，评估一个有前景的节点会消耗接触时间，并可能导致交换机会本身消失，因此学习者收集到的关于对等节点的证据是易逝的：因链路过期和对等节点模型漂移而衰减。现有方法缺乏针对这种易逝证据下的最优同伴选择理论框架。
AI.method: 将接收方在单次接触内的决策建模为有限时域马尔可夫最优停止问题，包含昂贵的信息获取动作和未来到达的外部选项（outside option）。利用Snell包络理论证明最优策略具有保留值结构。在此框架下推导四大理论结果：1) 基于漂移感知的阶段一致集中不等式与极大极小认证规则；2) 结合链路风险率的信息价值停止规则及比较静态分析；3) 标记泊松到达过程下的等待闭式价值与搜索理论保留值；4) 单调移动性机制下单步置信安全规则的近似最优性定理。最终构建完全本地化的轻量级策略 PROSE。
AI.result: 1) 证明了最优停止策略由保留值（Snell包络）刻画。2) 建立了阶段一致、漂移感知的集中界，给出了高概率正确的极大极小认证规则及有限样本识别界。3) 推导了移动性感知的信息价值停止规则，证明更高的链路风险率降低持续探测价值、扩大停止区域。4) 在标记泊松接触到达假设下得到了等待的闭式价值及搜索理论保留值，并刻画了其比较静态性质。5) 证明在足够易变（单调）的移动性机制下，单步置信安全规则是最优策略的合理替代，且永不提前停止。6) 实例化算法 PROSE，验证了在静态接触和无漂移极限下退化为经典序贯决策问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文为去中心化联邦学习中易逝证据下的同伴选择提供了首个自包含的最优停止理论框架。理论分析揭示了链路风险、模型漂移、接触到达过程与最优探测-停止决策之间的精确定量关系。提出的 PROSE 策略完全本地化、轻量级，且在高波动移动性下具有近似最优保证。工作为间歇性连接环境下的去中心化学习奠定了坚实的序贯决策理论基础。

title: Evaluating Decision Models for Text Annotation in Computational Social Science
summary: Computational social science increasingly relies on large language models for text annotation, and the validity of published findings now rests on the labels generated by such models. Decision models, a new model class built for categorical question answering, answer typed questions with a choice, a probability distribution over the label set, and a confidence score rather than free text, at a small fraction of frontier inference prices. Whether their answers are accurate, and whether that stated confidence can be trusted on social science constructs, are unknown. Here, we mirror the evaluation of Ziems et al. (2024) on 18 computational social science classification tasks (7,977 items), comparing the first commercial decision model and two open-weight counterparts against 19 frontier and open-weight language models under the same zero-shot protocol. The decision model trails the per-task best LLM on 14 of 15 evaluation tasks, with a median deficit of 11.6 macro-F1 points, at a median 44 times lower measured cost. Its confidence is better calibrated than the verbalized confidence of 16 of the 19 LLMs, yet three frontier models show lower median calibration error (0.157 against 0.066). While items above 0.9 confidence are typically labeled accurately (median accuracy 0.815), on one task, empathy in peer-support dialogues, the model reports high confidence while performing near chance. Nonetheless, our results suggest that decision models are useful as a first step in the annotation pipeline: routing low-confidence items to an LLM matches or exceeds the LLM alone at a quarter to half of its cost.

AI.tldr: 本文评估决策模型在计算社会科学文本分类任务中的表现，发现其虽比最佳LLM低11.6宏F1点，但成本仅为1/44，且置信度校准优于多数LLM。高置信度样本准确率高，但存在特定任务过度自信问题。建议将决策模型作为标注流水线第一步，低置信度样本路由至LLM，可在四分之一到一半成本下达到或超越单独LLM效果。
AI.motivation: 计算社会科学越来越依赖大语言模型进行文本标注，发表发现的有效性取决于模型生成的标签。决策模型是新模型类别，专为分类问答设计，输出选择、标签概率分布和置信度分数，价格远低于前沿模型。但其准确性及置信度在社会科学构念上的可信度未知，需系统评估。
AI.method: 复现Ziems等人(2024)的评估协议，在18个计算社会科学分类任务（7,977个样本）上，对比首个商业决策模型、两个开放权重决策模型与19个前沿及开放权重LLM，采用相同零样本设置。评估指标包括宏F1、成本、置信度校准误差、高置信度样本准确率等。
AI.result: 决策模型在15个评估任务中有14个落后于任务最佳LLM，中位数宏F1差距11.6点，但中位数成本降低44倍。其置信度校准优于19个LLM中的16个，但三个前沿模型校准误差更低（0.066 vs 0.157）。置信度>0.9的样本中位数准确率0.815，但在同理心任务上模型高置信度下表现接近随机。将低置信度样本路由给LLM的混合流水线，在四分之一到一半成本下匹配或超越单独LLM。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型虽准确性不及最佳LLM，但成本极低且置信度校准较好，适合作为标注流水线的第一步筛选器。通过将低置信度样本转交LLM处理，可大幅降低整体标注成本同时保持性能。但需注意特定任务（如同理心识别）中决策模型可能出现过度自信的风险。

title: VISTA: An Attention-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Architecture for Space Situational Awareness Sensor Tasking
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures. Code available at https://github.com/RocketNeurons/VISTA-SSA . Submitted to IEEE TAES
summary: The rapid growth of resident space objects is increasing the complexity of space situational awareness sensor tasking, challenging classical optimization methods as they allocate finite, heterogeneous, and distributed sensing resources across ever-larger catalogues. Existing deep reinforcement learning approaches show promise in reduced settings, but fixed-dimensional state and action representations limit their ability to scale to large, dynamic catalogues and distributed sensing networks. We introduce VISTA (Variable-Entity Intelligent Sensor Tasking Architecture), a scalable deep reinforcement learning architecture for persistent uncertainty-driven catalogue maintenance across variable object populations and sensor configurations. VISTA combines physics- and mission-informed top-K retrieval with entity-centric attention, recurrent memory, and pointer-based action decoding, thereby keeping each agent's observation and action spaces independent of catalogue size. We evaluate VISTA across different scenarios, from fixed-size single-sensor benchmarks to large-scale space-based tasking and heterogeneous cooperative sensing. With 30 orbiting targets, VISTA recovers the catalogue 31.2% faster than the fixed-dimensional recurrent baseline. In the large-scale regime, VISTA reduces five-hour uncertainty by 97.5% relative to the strongest classical reference and by 99.3% relative to the recurrent learner. Zero-shot tests up to 20,000 objects reveal near-linear relations between sensing capacity, catalogue size, and recovery horizon. Learned policies also exhibit sensor modality adaptation and generalization to population and initial-uncertainty shifts. Together, these results demonstrate that VISTA provides a scalable framework for adaptive space situational awareness sensor tasking across large, distributed networks of heterogeneous ground- and space-based sensors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VISTA（可变实体智能传感器任务架构），一种可扩展的深度强化学习架构，用于在可变目标群体和传感器配置下进行持续的不确定性驱动目录维护。VISTA结合物理与任务信息的Top-K检索、实体中心注意力、循环记忆和指针式动作解码，使每个智能体的观测和动作空间独立于目录规模。实验表明，在30个轨道目标场景下，VISTA比固定维度循环基线快31.2%恢复目录；在大规模场景下，五小时不确定性分别比最强经典基线和循环学习器降低97.5%和99.3%；零样本测试高达20,000个目标显示感知能力、目录规模和恢复时界呈近线性关系，且策略具备传感器模态适应性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 随着驻留空间物体快速增长，空间态势感知（SSA）传感器任务调度复杂度增加，经典优化方法难以在有限、异构、分布式的传感资源中分配。现有深度强化学习方法在简化设置下虽显潜力，但固定维度的状态和动作表示限制其扩展到大规模动态目录和分布式传感网络。
AI.method: VISTA采用可变实体架构：物理与任务信息的Top-K检索筛选相关实体，实体中心注意力编码实体特征，循环记忆保持历史信息，指针式动作解码生成与目录规模无关的动作。该设计使每个智能体的观测和动作空间独立于目录大小，支持异构地面/空间传感器协作。
AI.result: 在30目标基准测试中，VISTA比固定维度循环基线快31.2%恢复目录。大规模场景下，五小时不确定性比最强经典基线降低97.5%，比循环学习器降低99.3%。零样本测试高达20,000目标显示感知能力、目录规模、恢复时界近线性关系。策略展现传感器模态适应性，并能泛化到目标群体和初始不确定性分布变化。
AI.conclusion: VISTA为大规模、分布式、异构地面和空间传感器网络的自适应SSA传感器任务调度提供了一个可扩展框架，解决了固定维度表示的扩展性瓶颈，展现出在动态、大规模空间目录维护中的优越性能和泛化能力。

title: Written as a Record, Read as an Address: What a Forward Pass Leaves in an Operation's KV Cache
summary: When a language model reads an operation such as "Swap the contents of Box F and Box B", its forward pass writes keys and values for those tokens into the KV cache. Prior work on entity tracking establishes what models use: bindings are resolved at query time rather than stored as explicit latent state. We ask what they write at the operation span and how it is accessed. We split a forward pass into a frozen writer and a reader: the writer's cache is recomputed without gradients, while the reader sees only the instruction and operation tokens, with all state descriptions hidden, and is trained in isolation. Anything the reader recovers was therefore already present in the unmodified cache. On a synthetic boxes task, a base reader recovers $\leq 0.06$ of queried bindings against $0.75$--$1.00$ after training, and recoverability tracks the operation's read/write footprint. We find two modes of access. Across Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, operation-span transplants causally redirect which visible state is read even when the two worlds hold identical values, revealing a routing record. Isolation training preserves routing and adds direct access to the payload, the value the operation read, from the single operand-name token in a narrow mid-depth band (layers 12--15 of 32 in Llama-3.1-8B, 14--17 in Mistral-7B) --- the same site that holds the routing record. The same recipe extends to further operations, ToMi and GSM8K, but is bounded by training coverage and costs open-book accuracy. Operation tokens thus leave localized, causally recoverable records that support both routing and direct payload access, though the model that writes them reads mainly the address they carry and not the value.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型在 KV 缓存中如何记录操作（如交换盒子内容）的信息及其被后续读取的方式。通过将前向传播拆分为冻结的写入器和独立训练的读取器，发现操作标记在中层（Llama-3.1-8B 的 12-15 层，Mistral-7B 的 14-17 层）留下了局部化、可因果恢复的记录，同时支持路由记录（指向应读取的状态）和直接载荷访问（操作读取的值），但编写这些记录的模型主要读取地址而非值本身。
AI.motivation: 先前的实体追踪工作表明模型在查询时解析绑定，而非存储显式潜在状态。本文旨在弄清模型在操作跨度究竟写入了什么，以及这些信息是如何被访问的。
AI.method: 将一次前向传播拆分为冻结写入器（无梯度重新计算缓存）和读取器（仅见指令与操作标记，状态描述被隐藏，隔离训练）。在合成箱子任务上对比基础读取器与训练后读取器的恢复率，并通过操作跨度移植实验因果干预路由行为；进一步在 ToMi 和 GSM8K 上验证泛化性。
AI.result: 基础读取器恢复率 ≤ 0.06，训练后达 0.75–1.00，恢复率随操作读写足迹变化。发现两种访问模式：跨模型的操作跨度移植能因果性地重定向可见状态的读取（路由记录）；隔离训练保留路由并新增从单一操作数标记直接读取载荷的能力，位于窄中层带（Llama 12-15 层，Mistral 14-17 层）。同一方法推广到 ToMi 和 GSM8K，但受训练覆盖限制且损害开卷准确率。
AI.conclusion: 操作标记在 KV 缓存中留下局部化、可因果恢复的记录，同时支持路由与直接载荷访问，但撰写这些记录的模型自身主要读取地址而非值。

title: GLR-MM: Graph-Based Global-Local Reconstruction for Robust Multimodal Chest X-ray and EHR Representation Learning under Missing Modalities
summary: Clinical multimodal models must often predict before all chest X-ray (CXR) and electronic health record (EHR) inputs are available. Existing approaches align observed representations, model missingness, or reconstruct across modalities, but do not jointly exploit within-patient and clinically similar inter-patient evidence. We propose GLR-MM, a Graph-Based Global-Local Reconstruction framework for early ICU mortality prediction. It maps five CXR-EHR modalities to a shared space, reconstructs missing embeddings through complementary local cross-modal and global graph-attention branches, adaptively fuses their estimates, and optimizes class-balanced prediction, reconstruction, and contrastive objectives. On 9,620 MIMIC-derived ICU stays, we evaluate 10%, 30%, and 50% random modality missingness with shared deterministic masks. MUSE performs better under mild and moderate missingness, whereas GLR-MM achieves higher AUROC and AUPRC at 50% by 0.0088 and 0.0249, respectively. These results indicate that graph-guided reconstruction is most useful when inputs are severely incomplete.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GLR-MM，一种基于图的全局-局部重建框架，用于早期ICU死亡率预测。该方法将五种CXR-EHR模态映射到共享空间，通过互补的局部跨模态和全局图注意力分支重建缺失嵌入，自适应融合估计结果，并优化类别平衡的预测、重建和对比目标。在9,620个MIMIC衍生的ICU住院数据上实验表明，在50%模态缺失时，GLR-MM的AUROC和AUPRC分别比MUSE高出0.0088和0.0249，说明图引导重建在严重输入不完整时最有效。
AI.motivation: 临床多模态模型常需在所有胸部X光（CXR）和电子健康记录（EHR）输入可用前进行预测。现有方法通过对齐观测表示、建模缺失性或跨模态重建来处理缺失模态，但未能联合利用患者内部和临床相似患者间的证据。
AI.method: GLR-MM将五种CXR-EHR模态映射到共享嵌入空间，通过局部跨模态重建分支和全局图注意力重建分支互补重建缺失模态嵌入，采用自适应融合机制整合两分支估计，并联合优化类别平衡的预测损失、重建损失和对比学习损失。
AI.result: 在9,620个MIMIC-IV衍生ICU住院样本上，使用共享确定性掩码评估10%、30%、50%随机模态缺失场景。MUSE在轻度和中度缺失下表现更好，而GLR-MM在50%严重缺失时AUROC和AUPRC分别超越MUSE 0.0088和0.0249。
AI.conclusion: 图引导的重建策略在输入严重不完整（高缺失率）时最为有效，能够通过利用临床相似患者间的全局结构信息显著提升早期ICU死亡率预测性能。

title: Assessing Readability with LLMs: The Role of Reasoning and Few-Shot Prompting
summary: Readability assessment is essential for tailoring texts to intended audiences across educational, healthcare, and information retrieval domains. However, traditional readability formulas struggle to generalize across genres and languages, while supervised machine learning models rely on scarce, domain-specific annotated corpora, limiting their applicability--particularly for less-resourced languages. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a highly scalable, multilingual alternative that requires no task-specific training, yet the impact of advanced prompting strategies on their performance remains underexplored. In this paper, we conduct a systematic benchmark of diverse open-source LLMs for multilingual readability assessment, focusing on the prediction of discrete readability levels required by educational frameworks. In addition to English, we evaluate our approach on a less-resourced language, Slovenian, to establish whether LLMs remain effective in low-resource settings. Specifically, we investigate the influence of explicit reasoning, demonstrating that Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting and reasoning-oriented models yield significant improvements over direct answering. Furthermore, our exploration of few-shot in-context learning reveals that providing just one labelled example per category (1-shot) substantially enhances prediction quality compared to zero-shot settings, with additional examples offering diminishing returns. By comprehensively comparing these approaches against traditional unsupervised metrics and state-of-the-art supervised baselines, we establish the viability of out-of-the-box LLMs as robust, cross-lingual readability assessors.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性基准测试多种开源大语言模型在多语言可读性评估任务上的表现，重点预测教育框架所需的离散可读性等级。研究发现：思维链提示和推理导向模型显著优于直接回答；单样本少样本学习即可大幅提升预测质量，更多样本收益递减；开箱即用的大语言模型在跨语言可读性评估中表现稳健，甚至在低资源语言（斯洛文尼亚语）上也有效。
AI.motivation: 传统可读性公式难以跨体裁和语言泛化，监督机器学习模型依赖稀缺的领域标注语料，限制了其在低资源语言中的应用。大语言模型提供了可扩展、多语言且无需任务特定训练的替代方案，但高级提示策略对其性能的影响尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 对多种开源大语言模型进行系统基准测试，评估英语和斯洛文尼亚语（低资源语言）上的可读性等级预测。研究显式推理的影响：对比直接回答、思维链提示和推理导向模型。探索少样本上下文学习：从零样本到每类别1-shot、多样本的效果。与传统无监督指标和最先进监督基线全面对比。
AI.result: 思维链提示和推理导向模型显著优于直接回答。仅提供每类别1个标注样本（1-shot）即可大幅提升预测质量，额外样本收益递减。开箱即用的大语言模型在跨语言可读性评估中表现稳健，在低资源语言斯洛文尼亚语上也有效，超越传统无监督指标并接近监督基线。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型结合思维链提示和少样本学习，可作为无需任务特定训练的鲁棒跨语言可读性评估器，尤其适用于低资源语言场景。

title: Collaborative Streaming Anomaly Detection with Interactive Explanations and Ensemble Consensus
comment: Streaming Continual Learning ECML PKDD Workshop 2026
summary: We present a collaborative streaming anomaly detection system for high-speed data streams that explicitly integrates human analysts into the decision loop. The system combines heterogeneous detectors and aggregates their outputs through a normalization-based weighted consensus, complemented by artifact-aware rules to stabilize anomaly scoring under deployment. To improve interpretability, it derives surrogate models that approximate the ensemble consensus and expose human-readable sensor conditions associated with anomalous behavior. Analysts can actively intervene by reviewing anomaly episodes, adjusting consensus behavior, and refining surrogate rules used for anomaly prediction, producing a human-adjusted ensemble. We evaluate the approach on an industrial stream with 260\,000 events and 3 anomalous episodes, showing robust detection and actionable human-AI interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种协作式流式异常检测系统，将人类分析师纳入决策回路，结合异构检测器并通过归一化加权共识聚合输出，利用伪影感知规则稳定评分，并通过代理模型提升可解释性，支持分析师主动干预调整共识行为和规则，在工业数据流上验证了鲁棒检测和可行的人机交互。
AI.motivation: 高速数据流中异常检测需要实时性和准确性，现有自动化系统往往缺乏可解释性和人类专家知识的融合，导致误报或漏报，且难以适应部署环境的变化。因此需要一种将人类分析师显式集成到决策回路的协作系统，结合多检测器共识并提供可解释的规则，以实现鲁棒且可交互的异常检测。
AI.method: 系统包含：1) 异构检测器集成；2) 基于归一化的加权共识聚合输出；3) 伪影感知规则稳定异常评分；4) 训练代理模型近似集成共识，生成人类可读的传感器条件规则；5) 分析师通过审查异常事件、调整共识权重、细化代理规则进行主动干预，形成人工调整的集成模型。
AI.result: 在包含260,000个事件和3个异常事件的工业数据流上评估，系统展示了鲁棒的检测性能，并验证了人机交互的可行性，分析师能够有效干预并改进检测结果。
AI.conclusion: 该协作式流式异常检测系统通过显式引入人类分析师、多检测器加权共识、伪影感知稳定化及可解释代理模型，实现了高速数据流中的鲁棒异常检测和可操作的人机交互，为工业场景提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Adapting Tree-Structured Speculative Decoding to DeepSeek-V4 for Efficient Inference
summary: Repeated execution of the target model during autoregressive decoding is a major source of LLM inference latency. Unlike linear speculation, which follows a single candidate chain, tree-structured speculation retains multiple branches from shared prefixes; under the same budget, this broader coverage can improve acceptance and efficiency. Adapting it to DeepSeek-V4 is nontrivial: its CSA/HCA online compressed attention concentrates the difficulty on the target-verify side, where branches diverging from a shared prefix compress into different states, breaking cross-branch state consistency. We integrate tree-structured speculative decoding into the DeepSeek-V4-Flash pipeline via branch-aware causal verification, temporary state isolation, and accepted-path state refresh, keeping verification and compressed-state updates consistent across branches. Across budgets D=5 to D=8, batch sizes 1 to 64, and three datasets (GSM8K, MBPP, ShareGPT), tree speculation achieves a higher accepted length than the matched linear configurations in all settings (e.g., at D=8 about 2.83--3.41 versus 2.39--2.84) and improves throughput in nearly all configurations---marginal only at the smallest budget---by up to about 18.5%. More importantly, the gains follow stable, transferable regularities: the relative gain grows with the budget and is most pronounced for less predictable workloads at small-to-medium batch sizes, while beyond a certain budget throughput plateaus and decouples from the still-rising accepted length. These results show that retaining multiple candidate paths under the same budget can effectively improve DeepSeek-V4 decoding efficiency, and offer experience for adapting speculative decoding to future models with compressed, sparse, or structured context representations.

AI.tldr: 本文将树结构推测解码集成到DeepSeek-V4-Flash流水线中，解决了CSA/HCA在线压缩注意力导致的跨分支状态不一致问题，通过分支感知因果验证、临时状态隔离和接受路径状态刷新，在相同预算下显著提升接受长度和吞吐率（最高18.5%），并揭示了随预算增长和工作负载可预测性变化的稳定增益规律。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码中目标模型的重复执行是LLM推理延迟的主要来源。线性推测仅遵循单一候选链，而树结构推测保留共享前缀的多个分支，在相同预算下能提供更广覆盖、更高接受率和效率。但DeepSeek-V4的CSA/HCA在线压缩注意力将难度集中在目标验证侧，分支从共享前缀发散后压缩成不同状态，破坏了跨分支状态一致性，使树推测难以直接适配。
AI.method: 提出分支感知因果验证、临时状态隔离和接受路径状态刷新三项机制，将树结构推测解码集成到DeepSeek-V4-Flash流水线：在验证阶段保持跨分支压缩状态更新的一致性，确保验证与压缩状态更新在分支间协调一致。
AI.result: 在预算D=5-8、批大小1-64、三个数据集（GSM8K、MBPP、ShareGPT）上，树推测在所有设置下接受长度均高于匹配的线性配置（如D=8时约2.83-3.41 vs 2.39-2.84），几乎所有配置吞吐率提升（最高约18.5%）。增益呈现稳定可迁移规律：相对增益随预算增长，在小到中等批大小下对难预测工作负载最显著；超一定预算后吞吐率趋于平稳并与仍上升的接受长度脱钩。
AI.conclusion: 在相同预算下保留多条候选路径能有效提升DeepSeek-V4解码效率，为将推测解码适配到未来具有压缩、稀疏或结构化上下文表示的模型提供了实践经验。

title: Circuit-Diff: Factual Edit-based Intervention Method for Localizing Knowledge in Attribution Graphs
comment: 26 pages, 12 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/edwardF8/Circuit-Diff | Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/edwardF8/Circuit-Diff-paper-data | Demo: https://circuit-diff-paper.vercel.app/
summary: Mechanistic interpretability defines features as the fundamental units of a neural network and circuits as the weighted subgraphs that carry out its computation. Because individual neurons are polysemantic, Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) were introduced as a way to approximate a model's circuits by generating an attribution graph. The nodes of that graph, however, are unlabeled features: reading a graph means pruning it and then working out by hand what each surviving node means. To make CLTs easier to use for circuit discovery, we introduce Circuit-Diff, which intervenes on the model itself with a low-rank factual edit and takes the features whose role in the attribution graph changes under that edit as related to the edited knowledge. On the edits we examine, the flagged nodes are not only detectors of the object token: read off the CLT's released feature dashboards, they include features for the history, geography and associations surrounding the old and new objects. We formalize the method, measure how reliable a frozen CLT remains after a factual edit, test the selected nodes causally by patching them on up to 24 CounterFact edits, give a case study, and release an open-source implementation built on the circuit-tracer package, together with two further tools (multi-prompt aggregation and rule-based supernode labeling).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Circuit-Diff 方法，通过低秩事实编辑干预模型，识别 Cross-Layer Transcoder (CLT) 归因图中与特定知识相关的节点，自动化电路发现过程，并发现被标记节点不仅包含目标 token 检测器，还包含历史、地理及关联等语义特征。
AI.motivation: CLT 生成的归因图节点为无标签特征，需人工剪枝和解读，使用困难。现有方法缺乏自动化手段将图中节点与具体知识关联，阻碍了机制可解释性中的电路发现效率。
AI.method: Circuit-Diff 对模型施加低秩事实编辑，对比编辑前后归因图中特征角色的变化，将变化显著的特征标记为与编辑知识相关。在 CounterFact 数据集上测试最多 24 个编辑，通过激活补丁因果验证，衡量冻结 CLT 编辑后的可靠性，并发布基于 circuit-tracer 的开源实现、多提示聚合与规则超节点标注工具。
AI.result: 标记节点涵盖目标 token 检测器及旧/新实体的历史、地理、关联等广泛语义特征；CLT 在事实编辑后保持较高可靠性；因果补丁实验验证了所选节点的功能相关性；提供了案例研究和完整工具链。
AI.conclusion: Circuit-Diff 能有效将 CLT 归因图节点与特定事实知识对齐，显著降低电路发现的人工成本，揭示了神经网络中知识表征的分布式、语义化特征，为机制可解释性提供了可扩展的自动化分析范式。

title: When Quantization Preserves Accuracy but Not Evidence: Explanation-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Medical LLMs
summary:
Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of large language models, and PTQ methods are usually optimized and evaluated with generic reconstruction, perplexity, or answer accuracy. But in explanation-critical domains, preserving only the final answer may be insufficient, since users may also inspect generated rationales to judge whether a prediction is trustworthy. We study this issue in medical multiple-choice question answering, where rationales should provide evidence that supports the selected answer.
  We propose an explanation-aware objective for transformation-based PTQ. Our method builds an offline faithfulness cache from full-precision teacher rationales and uses it during optimization to preserve answer-supporting evidence tokens and evidence-conditioned answer behavior. We instantiate it on OSTQuant under W4A4KV4 quantization and evaluate four 7B--8B medical and instruction-tuned LLMs on MedExQA, MedExpQA, and ChallengeClinicalQA. While a same-calibration OSTQuant baseline preserves task accuracy, it can substantially weaken answer-supporting rationales. Our objective is to preserve the full-precision model's answer-supporting behavior rather than improve gold-label accuracy, and our method better preserves the full-precision model's answer behavior and rationale-to-answer support. These results suggest that PTQ for explanation-critical settings should evaluate preservation of answer-supporting evidence, not only answer accuracy. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/dut0817/EAQuant.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向解释性关键领域（如医疗多选问答）的后训练量化（PTQ）方法，通过引入解释感知目标函数，在W4A4KV4量化下保留全精度模型的答案支持性证据标记和证据条件下的回答行为，而非仅优化答案准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有PTQ方法主要优化通用重建、困惑度或答案准确率，但在医疗等解释性关键领域，用户需要检查生成的推理过程以判断预测可信度。现有量化方法虽保留任务准确率，但会显著削弱答案支持性推理，导致模型可信度下降。
AI.method: 提出解释感知目标函数，基于全精度教师模型的推理构建离线忠实度缓存，在量化优化过程中保留答案支持性证据标记和证据条件下的回答行为。在OSTQuant框架下实例化，采用W4A4KV4量化配置。
AI.result: 在四个7B-8B医疗和指令微调LLMs上，使用MedExQA、MedExpQA和ChallengeClinicalQA评测。同校准OSTQuant基线虽保持任务准确率，但大幅削弱答案支持性推理；提出的方法更好地保留了全精度模型的答案行为和推理到答案的支持关系。
AI.conclusion: 面向解释性关键场景的PTQ应评估答案支持性证据的保留情况，而非仅关注答案准确率。代码和评测脚本已开源。

title: GDN Tree-Scan: Served Tree Verification for Recurrent-Hybrid Language Models
summary:
Tree speculative decoding verifies multiple candidate continuations in one target forward pass. For attention-only transformers, the verifier mainly needs an ancestry mask. Recurrent-hybrid language models break this assumption: a candidate row must also carry the recurrent state that native sequential decode would have produced along its root-to-node path. Otherwise, a verifier can use a correct attention mask while still conditioning on an impossible recurrent history.
  We present GDN Tree-Scan, a served verifier for Gated-DeltaNet hybrid language models integrated into vLLM. The system combines FlashAttention-2 tree-bias attention, branch-local GDN scan/replay, device-side multidraft commitment, and accepted-chain-only state publication. On the public Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 checkpoint, in a clean batch-one (B=1) SWE/Codex decode gate at temperature 0.6, a six-node root-branch tree increases committed tokens/event by 17.2% at near-native verify-forward time and reaches 23.88 token-weighted decode tokens/s versus 18.80 for native five-step MTP (E5), a 27.0% token-weighted decode-throughput gain. The per-request-equal latency view is +4.0%, and end-to-end task wall time remains prefill-heavy. Empirical equivalence evidence is scoped to recurrent-oracle probability-rescore (p-rescore) closure within the observed native flip floor, not a full distribution-distance proof.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GDN Tree-Scan，一种针对 Gated-DeltaNet 混合语言模型的树状推测解码验证器，集成于 vLLM 中，通过结合 FlashAttention-2 树偏置注意力、分支局部 GDN 扫描/重放、设备端多草稿提交及仅接受链状态发布，在 Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 上实现 27.0% 的 token 加权解码吞吐增益。
AI.motivation: 现有树状推测解码仅适用于纯注意力 Transformer，依赖祖先掩码。对于循环混合语言模型，候选行还需携带其根到节点路径上原生顺序解码产生的循环状态，否则验证器虽能使用正确注意力掩码，却仍条件于不可能的循环历史。
AI.method: 设计 GDN Tree-Scan 验证器，集成四大组件：FlashAttention-2 树偏置注意力、分支局部 GDN 扫描/重放、设备端多草稿提交、仅接受链状态发布。部署于 vLLM 中，针对 Gated-DeltaNet 混合模型。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 检查点上，批次为 1 的 SWE/Codex 解码任务，温度 0.6，六节点根分支树使每事件提交 token 增加 17.2%，验证前向时间接近原生；token 加权解码吞吐达 23.88 tokens/s，优于原生五步 MTP (E5) 的 18.80 tokens/s，提升 27.0%。单请求等效延迟视角 +4.0%，端到端任务墙钟时间仍以 prefill 为主。实证等价性限于循环预言机概率重评在观测到的原生翻转下界内闭合，非完整分布距离证明。
AI.conclusion: GDN Tree-Scan 成功将树状推测解码扩展至循环混合模型，显著提升解码吞吐，但实证等价性有待更严格的理论证明，且端到端延迟受限于 prefill 阶段。

title: MSI-Bench: Evaluating Multi-Speaker Voice Interaction for Collaborative AI Agents
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/M2cha4l1124/MSI-Bench ; Code: https://github.com/boson-ai/MSI-Bench
summary: Voice provides a natural and immediate interface for AI agents. Many settings in which voice agents could be useful, including meetings, households, and collaborative work, are inherently multi-speaker. Supporting these settings introduces challenges that are largely absent from one-on-one interaction. We introduce the Multi-Speaker Interaction Benchmark (MSI-Bench) for evaluating multi-speaker voice interaction. Each test case is a short multi-party multi-turn audio scene with participant context, expected tool calls, and atomic rubrics. The benchmark targets three capability families: multi-speaker memory, multi-speaker instruction following, and multi-speaker reasoning. It comprises 1,152 test cases, evenly split between Mandarin Chinese and English (576 each). The strongest configuration on each split passes all rubrics on only 66.8% of English and 54.5% of Mandarin cases, and the strongest open-weight configuration on 34.0% and 19.3%. Failure analysis separates perception from reasoning: open-weight models are bottlenecked by the multi-speaker audio front-end, while frontier systems still fail speaker-scoped decision making on clean transcripts---and models across the board often respond when no one has addressed them. These results identify speaker-grounded perception, speaker-scoped decision making, and conversational restraint as concrete targets for future voice agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多说话人交互基准（MSI-Bench），用于评估语音代理在多说话人场景下的记忆、指令遵循和推理能力。基准包含1152个测试用例（中英各576个），最强配置在英文上通过率66.8%、中文54.5%，开源模型仅34.0%和19.3%。失败分析揭示开源模型受限于音频前端，前沿系统仍在说话人级决策上失效，且模型普遍存在未被呼唤时也回应的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有语音代理主要面向单对单交互，而会议、家庭、协作工作等真实场景本质上是多说话人的。多说话人环境带来说话人识别、记忆归属、指令范围界定等新挑战，缺乏系统性评估基准。
AI.method: 构建MSI-Bench：每个测试用例为短时多方多轮音频场景，附带参与者上下文、预期工具调用和原子评分细则。覆盖三大能力族：多说话人记忆、多说话人指令遵循、多说话人推理。共1152个用例，中英文各半。
AI.result: 最强配置（可能为闭源前沿系统）在英文通过率66.8%、中文54.5%；最强开源配置仅34.0%和19.3%。失败分析显示：开源模型瓶颈在于多说话人音频前端感知；前沿系统在干净转录文本上仍会在说话人级决策上出错；各类模型普遍存在未被指名时也回应的‘过度回应’问题。
AI.conclusion: 为推动多说话人语音代理发展，需重点攻克三大具体目标：说话人接地感知（speaker-grounded perception）、说话人级决策（speaker-scoped decision making）、对话克制（conversational restraint）。MSI-Bench为这些方向提供了可量化的评测基准。

title: Multivariate quantile regression via Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary: This paper introduces a novel algorithm for predicting conditional joint distributions of vector-valued targets in stochastic systems whose randomness is intrinsic rather than arising from observation errors or additive noise. Multivariate quantile regression also involves modeling conditional joint distributions but represents a less challenging task. It predicts the probability that vector-valued targets fall within predefined regions, identifies regions corresponding to predefined probability levels, or performs both tasks simultaneously. The proposed identification technique employs ensembles of Kolmogorov--Arnold networks (KANs) as flexible function approximators. Although the suggested technique is not theoretically restricted to KANs, KANs are particularly well suited to the proposed construction and are therefore used throughout this study. In addition to the training procedure, this work introduces a new discrepancy measure for joint distributions and a goodness-of-fit (GoF) test based on it. This GoF test was initially developed to validate and calibrate the proposed identification technique and is used here in an ad hoc manner. Although the test could be tabulated for broader use, such a tabulation is not pursued in this work. The test is also applicable more generally.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种新算法，用于预测具有内在随机性的随机系统中向量值目标的条件联合分布，采用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）集成作为函数逼近器，并引入新的联合分布差异度量及拟合优度检验。
AI.motivation: 解决内在随机性（非观测误差或加性噪声）随机系统中向量值目标条件联合分布的预测问题，超越多元分位数回归仅预测预定义区域概率或识别预定义概率区域的局限。
AI.method: 使用KAN集成作为灵活函数逼近器构建识别技术；提出新的联合分布差异度量及基于此的拟合优度（GoF）检验，用于验证和校准该技术。GoF检验虽可推广制表但本文未追求。
AI.result: 提出的KAN集成识别技术能有效预测条件联合分布；新差异度量和GoF检验不仅服务于该技术验证，也具备更广泛的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该算法为内在随机系统的条件联合分布预测提供新工具，KAN集成在该构建中表现优异，新差异度量和GoF检验具有独立价值，但GoF检验的表格化推广留待未来工作。

title: The Answer-Basin Representation Hypothesis: We Are Not Probing or Steering Concepts
summary: The Linear Representation Hypothesis associates high-level concepts with directions in language models, but it remains unclear how these concept-related linear structures are organized within the model. We propose the Answer-Basin Representation Hypothesis: the probability measure induced over answers by the model's continuation distribution organizes these linear structures, with its statistics represented along linear directions shared across questions. All continuations yielding the same answer form an answer basin, whose mass is their total probability. These basin masses define the pushforward probability measure over answers. We posit that concept-related linear structure emerges from differences in the answer measure rather than being determined by changes in concept labels. Experiments across models and tasks link concept-consistent effects and their reversals in probing and steering to the alignment between concept labels and the answer measure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“答案盆地表征假说”，认为语言模型中概念相关的线性结构是由模型续写分布诱导的答案概率测度组织的，而非由概念标签决定。实验表明，探测和引导中的概念一致效应及其反转，取决于概念标签与答案测度的对齐程度。
AI.motivation: 线性表征假说将高级概念与语言模型中的方向关联，但这些概念相关的线性结构在模型内部如何组织仍不清楚。
AI.method: 提出答案盆地表征假说：模型续写分布诱导的答案概率测度组织线性结构，其统计量沿跨问题共享的线性方向表征。所有产生相同答案的续写形成一个答案盆地，其质量为总概率。这些盆地质量定义了答案上的推前概率测度。假设概念相关线性结构源于答案测度的差异，而非概念标签的变化。跨模型和任务进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验将探测和引导中的概念一致效应及其反转，与概念标签与答案测度的对齐情况联系起来。
AI.conclusion: 答案测度（答案上的推前概率测度）是大语言模型中概念相关线性结构的组织原则，而非概念标签本身。

title: A discrete generative model of neuronal spiking activity on microelectrode arrays
summary: Generative models of neural activity could help characterize tissue dynamics, compare experimental conditions, and simulate population activity for applications ranging from disease and drug-response studies to closed-loop experimentation. Existing approaches, however, typically assume a fixed set of sorted neurons, whereas high-density microelectrode arrays produce extremely sparse, array-wide binary spike volumes in which the observed subset of electrodes varies across assays. We introduce a discrete generative model that represents this activity using a shared vocabulary of spatiotemporal motifs. A residual vector-quantized autoencoder learns the motif vocabulary, while a factorized masked transformer predicts where activity occurs and which motif appears at each active location. We evaluate the model on 31 assays spanning human brain organoids and acute \emph{ex vivo} human hippocampal tissue. The learned motifs are broadly reused: assay identity explains only $9%$ of the entropy in motif use, and motif overlap across tissue types is comparable to overlap within them. When representation quality is evaluated independently of the generative prior, our approach achieves $5.2\times$ the voxel-level reconstruction average precision of a matched flat tokenizer. For masked completion and free generation, the full model achieves $1.4$--$2.6\times$ the site-level average precision of the matched generative baseline and outperforms it across all four families of generation metrics. These results establish a compact, reusable representation for array-wide spiking activity without learned assay-specific parameters, providing a scalable foundation for generative modeling across diverse neural preparations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种离散生成模型，用于高密度微电极阵列（HD-MEA）记录的稀疏、全阵列二元尖峰体积数据。模型通过残差向量量化自编码器学习共享的时空基元词汇，并利用因子化掩码Transformer预测活动位置和基元分配。在31个实验（人脑类器官和急性体外海马组织）中验证，该模型实现了跨实验可复用的紧凑表示，无需实验特定参数。
AI.motivation: 现有神经活动生成模型通常假设固定的已排序神经元集合，但高密度微电极阵列产生的数据是极度稀疏的、全阵列的二元尖峰体积，且观测到的电极子集随实验变化。需要一种能够处理这种变异性、跨实验共享表示且无需实验特定参数的生成模型。
AI.method: 1. 残差向量量化自编码器（RVQ-VAE）学习共享的时空基元词汇；2. 因子化掩码Transformer分两步预测：首先预测活动发生的位置（空间掩码），然后在活动位置预测出现的基元（基元分类）；3. 模型在31个实验（人脑类器官和急性体外人海马组织）上联合训练，无实验特定参数。
AI.result: 1. 学习的基元广泛复用：实验身份仅解释基元使用熵的9%，跨组织类型的基元重叠度与组织内部相当；2. 表示质量评估：体素级重建平均精度（AP）为匹配扁平分词器的5.2倍；3. 生成任务：掩码补全和自由生成中，位点级AP为匹配生成基线的1.4-2.6倍，且在所有四类生成指标上均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一种紧凑、可复用的全阵列尖峰活动表示，无需学习实验特定参数，为跨多样化神经制备的生成建模提供了可扩展的基础。

title: Decomposing Error and Style in Automated Clinical Coding
summary: In automated clinical coding, where the label space spans tens of thousands of diagnosis and procedure codes, models are currently evaluated against a single gold annotation, treating any deviation as error. But we find when two teams code the same 110 ACI-Bench encounters, they agree on only 73% of codes (Jaccard similarity) for the same note; even after an independent clinical audit removes erroneous codes, agreement rises only to 77%. Is that gap error or something systematic? We model the systematic component as coding style $ψ$, a coder- or site-specific policy over what to code and how much to document, and recast coding as $p(\mathrm{code}\mid\mathrm{note},ψ)$, estimating $ψ$ with a 10-dimension rubric. If style were noise, conditioning on it would do nothing. Instead, across five datasets a model conditioned with a data-matching style raises ICD F1 by up to 26 points and an extreme mismatched one lowers it by up to 21. Four prompt based coding methods spanning 39-49 F1 converge to 52-56 once style is supplied (All p<0.05). Much of what single-gold evaluation charges to model error is recoverable, unmodeled style.

AI.tldr: 论文指出临床编码评估中单一金标准导致的模型误差高估，提出编码风格ψ概念，通过条件建模显著提升ICD F1分数，证明大部分被判为模型误差的偏差实为未建模的编码风格差异。
AI.motivation: 当前自动临床编码评估依赖单一金标准注释，将任何偏差视为错误。但研究发现即使经过临床审计，不同编码团队对同一笔记的编码一致性仅达77%（Jaccard相似度），表明存在系统性差异而非随机噪声。
AI.method: 将编码风格ψ建模为编码者或站点特定的编码策略，重新定义编码任务为p(code|note, ψ)，使用10维评分量表估计ψ，并在五个数据集上验证条件风格建模的效果。
AI.result: 匹配风格条件下ICD F1提升高达26分，不匹配风格下降高达21分；四种提示编码方法（39-49 F1）在提供风格后收敛至52-56（p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 单一金标准评估归因于模型误差的大部分偏差实为可恢复的未建模编码风格，引入风格建模能显著提升编码性能并揭示评估偏差。

title: Matched-Input Estimates Differ in Sign Across Architectures: Auditing EEG Foundation Models on Motor Imagery
summary: Pretrained EEG foundation models are increasingly proposed as general-purpose encoders for brain-computer interfaces, yet recent benchmarks disagree about when their representations transfer to downstream tasks. We audit LaBraM and CBraMod on motor imagery under a validation-locked protocol in which preprocessing, architecture, optimization, freeze depth, checkpoint, temperature, and method selection are determined using training-session data only.
