On four-class BCI Competition IV-2a, every supervised comparator evaluated here outperforms every foundation-model configuration, including validation-selected fine-tuning. We then examine a key confound: foundation models and task-specific decoders are normally evaluated using different input pipelines. Retraining three supervised architectures on the broadband arrays consumed by the foundation models produces matched-input accuracy differences of opposite sign across architectures: broadband input improves ATCNet by 0.078 accuracy while reducing EEG Conformer accuracy by 0.088. None of the three individual matched-input terms is significant after multiple-comparison correction at n = 9, so we treat the sign variation descriptively rather than as a formal architecture-by-pipeline interaction. These observed sign differences suggest that a single comparator may not provide an architecture-invariant decomposition of a pretrained-versus-supervised performance gap. The four-class deficit also does not reproduce uniformly across motor-imagery datasets: on two-class BNCI2014-004 we cannot detect the same separation between fine-tuned CBraMod and the supervised comparators. Finally, validation-fitted temperature scaling returns foundation-model calibration error to the supervised range despite substantially lower four-class accuracy.

AI.tldr: 预训练EEG基础模型（LaBraM、CBraMod）在运动想象任务上整体落后于监督学习基线；输入管道差异导致不同架构的性能变化方向相反，单一比较器无法架构不变地分解预训练与监督的性能差距；温度缩放可修正校准但无法弥补准确率劣势。
AI.motivation: 当前基准对预训练EEG基础模型何时能迁移至下游任务存在分歧，需在严格控制的验证锁定协议下审计其真实迁移性能，并剖析输入管道差异这一关键混淆因素。
AI.method: 采用验证锁定协议（仅用训练会话数据决定预处理、架构、优化、冻结深度、检查点、温度及方法选择），在四分类BCI Competition IV-2a和二分类BNCI2014-004上对比LaBraM、CBraMod与监督基线；将三种监督架构在基础模型使用的宽带数组上重新训练以消除输入管道混淆；应用验证拟合的温度缩放评估校准。
AI.result: 四分类任务中，所有监督基线均显著优于所有基础模型配置（含微调）；消除输入管道差异后，ATCNet准确率提升0.078，EEG Conformer下降0.088，三个匹配输入项经多重比较校正均不显著；二分类任务未复现相同分离；温度缩放将基础模型校准误差拉回监督范围，但四分类准确率仍大幅落后。
AI.conclusion: 预训练EEG基础模型在运动想象任务不具备一致的迁移优势；预训练与监督的性能差距受架构与输入管道交互影响，无法用单一比较器给出架构不变的分解；校准可通过温度缩放改善，但准确率劣势依然存在，提示需更深入理解预训练表示在特定下游任务的适用边界。

title: The Copy Ceiling: An Input-Exposure Control for Ontology-Grounded Generation over Curated Corpora
summary: When a language model answers from a curated corpus via graph-based retrieval, a large grounding uplift does not establish reasoning over the retrieved structure: the context may already expose the gold answers. We propose exposure accounting, which classifies each gold item by whether the shown context exposes it and whether the answer recovers it. Its scalar reference is the copy ceiling, the recall a verbatim copy of the context achieves; signed gain over copy measures the model's recall relative to this deterministic, judge-free baseline. Across ten models, unaided recall averages 0.26 and grounded recall 0.92, yet gain over copy is uniformly negative (-0.067 to -0.022). Of 11,360 gold-item observations, representing 1,136 target instances evaluated under ten models, only three unexposed items receive lexical credit. A stratified model-judged audit of 423 observations, with a symmetric quotation-verification policy, estimates that 97.1% of credited items assert the requested relation; all three unexposed credits fail relational adjudication. On targets the scaffold does not expose, lexical recovery falls from 0.121 unaided to 0.004 grounded; adjudication validates 71 of the 92 unaided credits and none of the three grounded credits, without establishing full-frame relational recovery rates. Rephrasing questions outside the graph's title vocabulary reduces exposure from 0.964 to 0.328, while an absence-triggered fallback activates on only 2 of 506 questions. A paired production study improves judged quality by +0.27 pooled, but negative controls do not establish content specificity beyond a well-formed on-corpus block. These results support exposure accounting as a standing control for corpus-derived evaluations. The accounting distinguishes exposed-item omissions from beyond-exposure recoveries; it does not determine whether reasoning occurred.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“曝光核算”方法，用于评估语言模型在基于图检索的语料库问答中是否真正进行推理，还是仅复制上下文。实验显示，尽管 grounding 将召回率从 0.26 提升至 0.92，但相对于逐字复制基线的增益均为负值，且仅有 3 个未曝光项获得词汇学信用，经裁决均失败。重述问题可大幅降低曝光率，配对生成研究虽提升判断质量，但负控制未证明内容特异性。结论：曝光核算可作为语料库衍生评估的常设控制，能区分曝光项遗漏与超曝光恢复，但无法判定是否发生推理。
AI.motivation: 当前基于图检索的语言模型问答中， grounding 带来的大幅召回提升可能仅源于上下文已直接暴露金标准答案，而非模型真正进行结构化推理。缺乏一种无需人工判断的基线来区分“复制上下文”与“超越上下文的恢复”，导致难以评估模型的实际推理能力。
AI.method: 提出曝光核算框架：将每个金标准项按上下文是否曝光、回答是否恢复分类；引入“复制天花板”作为标量基线，即逐字复制上下文所能达到的召回率；计算相对于该基线的有符号增益。在十个模型上评估 1,136 个目标实例（共 11,360 个金标准项观测），并对 423 个观测进行分层模型裁决审计，采用对称引用验证策略。另通过重述问题（移出图标题词汇）降低曝光率，测试缺席触发回退机制，并进行配对生成研究比较判断质量。
AI.result: 十模型无协助召回均值 0.26，grounded 召回 0.92，但相对于复制天花板的增益均为负（-0.067 至 -0.022）。11,360 观测中仅 3 个未曝光项获词汇学信用，裁决显示 97.1% 获信用项断言目标关系，但这 3 个未曝光信用均失败。未曝光目标上，词汇恢复从无协助 0.121 跌至 grounded 0.004；裁决确认 92 个无协助信用中的 71 个，而 3 个 grounded 信用全无。重述问题使曝光率从 0.964 降至 0.328，回退机制仅在 506 问题中触发 2 次。配对生成研究汇总判断质量提升 +0.27，但负控制未建立超越良好语料库块的内容特异性。
AI.conclusion: 曝光核算可作为语料库衍生评估的常设控制手段，能有效区分曝光项遗漏与超曝光恢复，但不能据此断定模型是否发生了推理。实证表明，当前 grounding 提升主要源于上下文曝光，模型在未曝光条件下几乎无法恢复目标关系，且缺乏稳健的回退机制。

title: The Neural Forcing for Three-Dimensional Incompressible Navier-Stokes finite time blowup
summary: We present a two-part neural framework for forced three-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes flow. Part~I develops the computational forcing system. A physics-informed neural model generates structured external-force trajectories, candidates are optimized through differentiable PDE rollouts or PPO-Clip, and selected forcings are frozen and checked by independent fixed-force replay. Part~II provides the mathematical certification layer. It separates neural candidate discovery from continuum analysis, derives integrated reciprocal-vorticity criteria that imply Riccati-type growth and finite-time loss of smooth continuation, develops a validated computational-to-continuum transfer strategy, and establishes a conditional positive-probability closure for a nondegenerate neural output law. The proof is complete at the continuum level.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双部神经框架研究强迫三维不可压缩 Navier-Stokes 流：第一部分构建计算强迫系统，利用物理信息神经模型生成结构化外力轨迹，经可微 PDE 推演或 PPO-Clip 优化并通过固定力重放验证；第二部分提供数学认证层，将神经候选发现与连续体分析分离，导出积分倒数涡量判据暗示 Riccati 型增长与有限时间光滑延拓失效，建立经验证的计算到连续体迁移策略，并确立非退化神经输出律的条件正概率闭包，在连续体层面完成证明。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决三维 Navier-Stokes 方程在强迫条件下是否存在有限时间爆破（光滑解失效）这一核心开放问题，通过神经网络发现候选强迫场，再以严格数学分析认证其导致的有限时间奇性，实现从计算发现到连续体证明的完整管线。
AI.method: 分两部：第一部为计算强迫系统——物理信息神经网络生成结构化外力轨迹，候选经可微 PDE 推演或 PPO-Clip 强化学习优化，入选强迫冻结后经独立固定力重放验证；第二部为数学认证层——将神经发现与连续体分析解耦，导出积分倒数涡量判据以推导 Riccati 型增长并证明有限时间光滑延拓失效，开发经验证的计算到连续体迁移策略，建立非退化神经输出律的条件正概率闭包。
AI.result: 成功构建出完整的‘神经发现—数学认证’双部框架，在连续体层面完成了强迫三维不可压缩 Navier-Stokes 流有限时间光滑解失效的条件性证明，实现了从计算候选到严格数学结论的跨越。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将深度学习驱动的强迫场发现与严格 PDE 连续体分析相结合，为 Navier-Stokes 正则性问题提供了一条可行的‘计算导向证明’新范式，证明在连续体层面完备。

title: OSWorld-Pro: Process-based Evaluation for Computer Use Agents
summary: Evaluation of Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) is often limited to the final deliverables they create (at the end of hundreds of steps) and assessed with functional verifiers, as seen in OSWorld. However, such evaluation of end-state performance lacks transparency into how and why agents fail in various tasks, obfuscating critical insight for subsequent improvement. For instance, agents that err during keyboard inputs would require a different mitigation strategy from those that fail to precisely provide click-based inputs on the graphical UI. We introduce OSWorld-Pro: a set of over 300 tasks containing over 2800 subgoals to enable the procedural evaluation of CUAs grounded in over 67,000 human annotations. We use robust human-aligned LLM-Judges to evaluate the fulfillment of OSWorld-Pro subgoals and thereby reveal the progress that models make throughout a series of sequentially dependent subgoals. Our findings reveal that OSWorld-Pro is challenging even for state-of-the-art LLMs, with top performers like Claude Opus 5 achieving only 75.7% vs. 83.4% on OSWorld. Furthermore, we identify critical process-focused failure modes of various models (e.g. subgoal-irrelevant actions and click-based mistakes) to provide insights to improve performance and efficiency of CUAs.

AI.tldr: OSWorld-Pro 是一个新的基准测试，通过 300 多个任务、2800 多个子目标和 67,000 多个人工标注，实现对计算机使用代理 (CUA) 的过程式评估，揭示了模型在顺序依赖子目标中的进展及关键失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有的 CUA 评估（如 OSWorld）主要关注最终交付物的功能验证，缺乏对代理在数百步骤中如何及为何失败的透明度，导致无法针对不同失败类型（如键盘输入错误与点击输入错误）制定针对性改进策略。
AI.method: 构建包含 300 多个任务、2800 多个顺序依赖子目标的 OSWorld-Pro 基准，基于 67,000 多个人工标注；采用与人类判断对齐的 LLM-Judges 评估每个子目标的完成情况，从而追踪模型在过程中的进展。
AI.result: OSWorld-Pro 对最先进 LLM 构成显著挑战：顶级模型 Claude Opus 5 在 OSWorld-Pro 上仅得 75.7%，而 OSWorld 上为 83.4%；同时识别出关键的过程导向失败模式，如子目标无关动作和基于点击的错误。
AI.conclusion: 过程式评估能揭示端到端评估无法捕捉的细粒度失败模式，为提升 CUA 的性能和效率提供可行见解；OSWorld-Pro 填补了当前评估体系在透明度和诊断能力上的空白。

title: MGRD: Compact morphology-gated residual diffusion for variance-aware cross-domain neurite forecasting
summary: Tracking neurite morphology over time helps characterize structural changes during neuronal development and deterioration, but long-term time-lapse imaging is resource-intensive and difficult to scale. Forecasting future morphology could reduce this burden. Existing neurite digital-twin models such as gated spatiotemporal attention (gSTA) produce a single deterministic forecast without representing variability among plausible futures. We introduce Morphology-Gated Residual Diffusion (MGRD), a compact stochastic surrogate that jointly forecasts twenty future neurite-morphology frames from ten observed frames while conditioning on morphology features derived from the latest observation. On controlled phase-field trajectories, MGRD reduces trajectory-wise mean MAE by 9.7% relative to a matched control while updating 4.46 times fewer parameters. On human iPSC-derived neuron microscopy, MGRD improves all four reported metrics over gSTA, including a 39.6% reduction in trajectory-wise mean MAE and a 45.3% increase in skeleton F1. Without mouse-domain retraining or fine-tuning, MGRD also improves MAE and skeleton F1 on mouse cortical-neurosphere microscopy across 10-40-min sampling intervals and forecast horizons beyond 13 hours. Repeated sampling provides a case-level variance score for ranking forecast difficulty. Retaining approximately 60% of the lowest-variance cases reduces mean MAE by 17.6% on iPSC microscopy and 16.8% on simulation data. MGRD uses 1.01% of gSTA's parameters, requires less than one tenth of its training-update time, and generates a 50-step DDIM trajectory 7.9% faster when morphology features are cached. These results establish MGRD as a compact stochastic surrogate for neurite-morphology forecasting and case prioritization across simulation and microscopy datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Morphology-Gated Residual Diffusion (MGRD)，一种紧凑的随机代理模型，用于神经突形态预测。MGRD 从 10 帧观测联合预测 20 帧未来形态，并基于最新观测的形态特征进行条件控制。在相场仿真轨迹、人 iPSC 来源神经元显微镜及小鼠皮层神经球显微镜数据上，MGRD 均显著优于确定性基线 gSTA：轨迹级平均 MAE 降低 9.7%~39.6%，骨架 F1 提升 45.3%，参数量仅为 gSTA 的 1.01%，训练更新时间不足十分之一，且无需微调即可泛化到跨物种、跨采样间隔的长时程预测。重复采样提供的方差评分可用于案例难度排序，保留低方差 60% 样本可进一步降低 MAE 约 17%。
AI.motivation: 长期延时成像追踪神经突形态资源消耗大、难以规模化；现有数字孪生模型（如 gSTA）仅给出单一确定性预测，无法表征合理未来的多样性。因此需要一种轻量级、随机的代理模型，能在少量观测条件下联合预测多帧未来形态，并量化预测不确定性以支持案例优先级排序。
AI.method: Morphology-Gated Residual Diffusion (MGRD)：基于残差扩散的紧凑随机模型，输入最近 10 帧观测，提取最新帧的形态特征作为条件，通过形态门控机制引导去噪过程，一次性生成 20 帧未来预测。采用 DDIM 加速采样，支持重复采样以获得案例级方差评分。模型参数极少（仅为 gSTA 的 1.01%），训练更新高效。
AI.result: 1. 相场仿真轨迹：轨迹级平均 MAE 降低 9.7%，参数更新量减少 4.46 倍。2. 人 iPSC 神经元显微镜：四项指标全面超越 gSTA，轨迹级平均 MAE 降低 39.6%，骨架 F1 提升 45.3%。3. 小鼠皮层神经球显微镜：无需重训练/微调，在 10-40 分钟采样间隔及 13 小时以上预测时程上均改善 MAE 和骨架 F1。4. 不确定性量化：重复采样得方差评分，保留最低方差 60% 案例可使 iPSC 数据 MAE 降 17.6%，仿真数据降 16.8%。5. 效率：参数量 1.01%，训练更新时间 < 1/10，缓存形态特征后 50 步 DDIM 采样快 7.9%。
AI.conclusion: MGRD 确立了一个紧凑的随机代理模型，能在仿真与多种显微镜数据上实现高精度、长时程、跨域的神经突形态联合预测，同时提供可靠的不确定性估计以支持案例优先级排序，显著降低计算与标注负担。

title: Human-LLM Deliberation as Interactive Proof: Conditions for Verifiability Without Transparency
summary: When an LLM supplies an argument that a user could not readily construct, how can the user decide whether to accept its claim? Inspired by interactive proofs, we model human-LLM deliberation as an interaction between a prover with unrestricted internal search and a resource-bounded human verifier. The verifier requests and checks supporting details without access to the LLM's internal state. Passed checks accumulate evidence toward an acceptance threshold. We prove anytime-valid soundness against adaptive provers: the probability of ever accepting a false claim is at most a chosen error level, provided the task supplies bounds on false passes and human checking errors that remain valid after every relevant history. A finite-horizon completeness bound additionally requires bounds on the adequacy of honest responses and sufficient diagnostic progress. Further checks can strengthen the evidence for acceptance, but each requires another adequate response and reliable human effort. Whether this tradeoff permits certification depends on the verifier's effort budget, cognitive load, expertise, and fatigue. We identify conditions under which the supplied bounds certify a specified sequence of local checks but not a specified global check under the same resource budgets.

AI.tldr: 该论文将人类与大语言模型的交互建模为交互式证明系统，其中LLM作为拥有无限制内部搜索能力的证明者，人类作为资源受限的验证者。通过请求和检查支持细节，验证者积累证据以决定是否接受声称。论文证明了对抗自适应证明者的任意时刻有效可靠性，并给出了有限视界完备性界限。
AI.motivation: 当LLM提供用户难以自行构建的论证时，用户如何决定是否接受其声称？受交互式证明启发，研究者旨在为人类-LLM协商建立形式化的可信度保证框架，解决验证者资源受限且无法访问证明者内部状态的现实约束。
AI.method: 将交互建模为证明者-验证者协议：证明者（LLM）拥有无限制内部搜索，验证者（人类）请求并检查支持细节。通过了检查累积证据向接受阈值靠拢。利用任意时刻有效（anytime-valid）统计方法，在每个相关历史后保持虚假通过界和人类检查误差界的有效性，证明对抗自适应证明者的可靠性。完备性分析需要诚实响应充分性界和足够的诊断进展界。
AI.result: 证明了任意时刻有效的可靠性：接受虚假声称的概率至多为选定误差水平。有限视界完备性要求诚实响应充分性界和诊断进展界。进一步检查可增强接受证据，但每次都需要额外的充分响应和可靠人力。能否认证取决于验证者的精力预算、认知负荷、专业知识和疲劳。识别出在相同资源预算下，提供的界可认证指定的局部检查序列但不能认证指定的全局检查的条件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为人类-LLM交互提供了理论基础，量化了验证资源与认证能力的权衡。结果揭示了局部检查可认证而全局检查不可认证的内在张力，为设计可信AI辅助决策系统提供了指导原则。

title: Simpler Methods Work Better for L1 Penalized Logistic Models and Large Datasets
comment: To appear in The 13th IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Advanced Analytics (DSAA 2026)
summary: Linear models with an $L_1$-norm penalty remain state-of-the-art for high-dimensional ($d > 1,000,000$) tasks, offering a straightforward method for solving real-world industry problems. Despite their widespread use in industry and utility, many $L_1$ solvers are not effective for general use, are prohibitively slow, and are ineffective in parallelization. This makes them difficult to train in an MLOps pipeline on large industry-scale corpora. In this work, we test several proposed ``state-of-the-art'' solutions from the literature and find that older methods are currently far superior for general use. We also identify several recommendations for academics to perform research that avoids erroneously overconfident results, which can prevent the transition to production use. Equally surprising, we find that a new and simple baseline, using LBFGS on a sub-gradient, is highly effective with minor tweaks, despite being dismissed in the literature for theoretical non-convergence. In practice, we find it is an easier-to-support and easier-to-scale method for production use.

AI.tldr: 论文评估了用于高维任务（d > 1,000,000）的 L1 正则化线性模型求解器，发现较老的方法在实际应用中远优于文献中宣称的“最新”求解器，并提出了一种基于子梯度的 LBFGS 简单基线，尽管理论上不收敛，但在工业生产环境中表现优异且易于扩展。
AI.motivation: L1 正则化线性模型在工业界广泛用于高维稀疏问题，但现有求解器普遍存在速度慢、难以并行化、难以集成到 MLOps 流水线等问题，阻碍了大规模生产部署。
AI.method: 作者系统测试了文献中多个号称“最先进”的求解器，并与经典方法对比；同时设计了一种新的简单基线——在子梯度上应用 LBFGS 并配合少量工程调整，尽管该方法在理论上被认为不收敛。
AI.result: 实验表明：1) 经典的旧方法在通用性、速度和并行化上全面优于新提出的复杂求解器；2) 子梯度 LBFGS 基线在实际大规模数据上表现极佳，且更易于工程维护和水平扩展；3) 总结了学术界避免产生过度自信、难以落地结论的若干建议。
AI.conclusion: 在工业级大规模高维场景下，简单、成熟且工程友好的求解器（包括改进的子梯度 LBFGS）比理论更优但工程复杂的新算法更具实用价值；学术研究应更关注实际生产环境下的有效性，以缩小理论与落地的鸿沟。

title: ToneCL: Contrastive Learning for Few-Shot Syllable-Level Tone Classification
summary: Tone languages constitute over 50-70% of the world's languages, but the vast majority are low-resource, lacking the large transcribed corpora needed for automatic tone classification. Existing datasets are typically collected at the sentence level, whereas field linguists require fine-grained syllable-level annotations. We propose ToneCL, a lightweight contrastive learning framework for few-shot syllable-level tone classification. We simulate low-resource conditions on Mandarin and Vietnamese, limiting labeled data to tens of examples per tone class. ToneCL is pretrained on unlabeled speech with augmentations that preserve tonal identity, then fine-tuned on few-shot examples. Experiments show our method consistently outperforms baselines, achieving 91.6% on six-speaker Mandarin at 10 shots. Cross-lingual transfer is also effective: pretraining on Vietnamese and fine-tuning on Mandarin reaches 91.0\% accuracy at 10 shots. Ablation confirms that frequency band rejection is the most critical augmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出 ToneCL，一种轻量级对比学习框架，用于少样本音节级声调分类，在普通话和越南语上实验，10-shot 下分别达 91.6% 和 91.0% 准确率，跨语言迁移有效，频带抑制增强最关键。
AI.motivation: 声调语言占世界语言 50-70%，但绝大多数为低资源语言，缺乏大规模标注语料；现有数据集多为句子级，而语言学实地工作者需要细粒度音节级标注，因此需要一种少样本、音节级的声调分类方法。
AI.method: ToneCL：在无标签语音上用保持声调身份的数据增强（如频带抑制、时间掩码等）进行对比学习预训练，再在极少标注样本（每类几十个）上微调，实现音节级声调分类。
AI.result: 在六人普通话 10-shot 下达 91.6% 准确率，持续优于基线；跨语言迁移（越南语预训练 → 普通话微调）10-shot 达 91.0%；消融实验证实频带抑制是最关键增强。
AI.conclusion: ToneCL 通过自监督对比学习有效利用无标签语音，结合声调保持增强，在极低资源条件下实现高精度音节级声调分类，且具备跨语言迁移能力，为低资源声调语言研究提供可行方案。

title: Misaligned Clinical Risk Classification and Cost Asymmetry in Open-Weight Large Language Models
summary: How large language models (LLMs) integrate patient risk with clinical cost tradeoffs remains poorly understood. We investigated how four open-weight LLMs (Qwen-2.5-7B/32B and Llama-3.1-8B/70B) internally represent cost tradeoffs, how these representations relate to clinical predictions, and whether decisions shift as predicted by the specified cost direction and magnitude. Using a public diabetes dataset, we varied 11 false-negative (FN) to false-positive (FP) cost ratios across three phrasings and examined representations and behavioral outputs. Patient risk was linearly recoverable on par with conventional classifiers (AUC $\approx 0.83$), and cost direction was recoverable in every model. However, representational shifts in cost direction tracked output changes only in the two larger models, and responses to cost magnitude were predominantly direction-agnostic. Only 2 of 12 model-phrasings showed both opposing responses to increasing FN versus FP costs and cost-correct ordering. Representationally, a direction fitted on one cost side did not invert when transferred to the other, as expected under mirror-symmetric encoding. These findings suggest that LLMs encode risk and cost information but do not reliably integrate them into cost-correct decisions. Clinical evaluations should therefore include tradeoff tests, phrasing sensitivity, and default operating points alongside predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了大语言模型（LLMs）如何内部表征临床决策中的假阴性（FN）与假阳性（FP）成本权衡，以及这些表征是否能可靠地转化为符合成本方向和幅度的决策。实验发现：模型能线性恢复患者风险（AUC≈0.83）并编码成本方向，但仅大模型（32B/70B）的表征变化能追踪输出变化；对成本幅度的响应多为方向无关，仅2/12 模型-措辞组合表现出成本正确的排序。结论：LLMs 虽编码风险与成本信息，但难以可靠整合为成本正确决策，临床评估需包含权衡测试、措辞敏感性及默认操作点。
AI.motivation: 当前对大语言模型如何将患者风险与临床成本权衡相整合的理解尚浅。临床决策需在 FN 与 FP 成本之间权衡，而 LLMs 在医疗场景的部署前，需明确其内部表征是否能支持成本敏感的可靠决策。
AI.method: 使用公开糖尿病数据集，测试四款开放权重 LLMs（Qwen-2.5-7B/32B、Llama-3.1-8B/70B）。在三种提示措辞下，系统变换 11 种 FN:FP 成本比率，提取模型内部表征并分析其与风险预测、成本方向及幅度的关系，同时考察行为输出随成本变化的模式。
AI.result: 1. 患者风险可线性恢复，AUC≈0.83，与传统分类器相当。2. 所有模型均可恢复成本方向。3. 仅两大模型（32B/70B）的表征方向变化能追踪输出变化。4. 对成本幅度的响应多为方向无关。5. 12 个模型-措辞组合中仅 2 个同时表现出：FN 与 FP 成本增加时的相反响应、且成本排序正确。6. 表征层面，一方向拟合的成本编码在另一侧不翻转，不符合镜像对称预期。
AI.conclusion: LLMs 虽能编码风险与成本信息，但未能可靠地将二者整合为成本正确的临床决策。临床评估除预测性能外，必须纳入成本权衡测试、提示措辞敏感性分析及默认操作点校准。

title: SocioVerse2: A Longitudinal Dynamic Social Simulation Framework under a Human-AI Co-evolutionary Paradigm
summary: Social simulation offers the social sciences an experimental instrument that the real world cannot supply, and generative agents have transformed it by acting as silicon samples that unite agent-based modeling with real behavioral data. Existing platforms verify collective behavior, align simulated populations with real societies in cross-sections, and employ autonomous agents for the research process. However, two social science requirements remain without systematic support: intervention in the content of a simulation and the researcher's control over the process that produces it. We present SocioVerse2, which extends SocioVerse 1.0 into a human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm built from two loops and one infrastructure. The longitudinal simulation loop simulates the target population with evolving environments and forks counterfactual branches via interventions. The controllable research loop takes the study itself as an editable state and updates state versions via controllable editing. The social science agentic infrastructure carries both loops through composable skills with researcher checkpoints, a population service over five persona pools, and an environment service over 21 real-world signal sources with point-in-time guarantees. We validate SocioVerse2 across three case families and seven case studies, from reproducing canonical agent-based models to modeling policy processes on real records and nowcasting macro-economic indices beyond the response model's knowledge cutoff. With the human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm, these cases go beyond system demonstrations to become substantive studies that investigate frontier questions in their respective disciplines. Code, data services, and a workbench are released as open-source resources.

AI.tldr: SocioVerse2 是一个面向社会科学的人机协同进化仿真平台，通过纵向仿真环路与可控研究环路，以及具备研究者检查点、五大人设池与 21 个实时环境信号源的基础设施，实现对仿真内容的干预与研究过程的可控编辑，并在经典 ABM 复现、政策过程建模与宏观经济指标即时预测等七项实证研究中验证了其超越演示、直指学科前沿的实质性研究能力。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式代理仿真平台虽能验证集体行为、对齐横截面人口并自主化研究流程，但缺乏对仿真内容进行干预（如反事实分支）以及研究者对研究生成过程进行版本化、可控编辑的系统性支撑，导致难以满足社会科学对因果推断与研究过程可复现的双重需求。
AI.method: 提出“人机协同进化”双环一基建架构：① 纵向仿真环路——在演化环境中模拟目标人群，支持通过干预分叉反事实分支；② 可控研究环路——将研究本身视为可编辑状态，通过受控编辑生成版本化研究状态；③ 社会科学智能体基建——提供可组合技能与研究者检查点、五大人设池的人口服务、以及 21 个具备时间点保证的真实世界信号源环境服务，承载上述双环。
AI.result: 在三大案例族、七项实证研究中验证：成功复现经典基于代理模型；基于真实记录建模政策过程；在知识截止点之外即时预测宏观经济指标。所有案例均从系统演示升级为实质性学科前沿研究，代码、数据服务与工作台已开源。
AI.conclusion: SocioVerse2 通过双环协同与可审计基建，填补了生成式代理仿真在干预与过程控制上的空白，实现了从“自主仿真”到“人机共治研究”的范式跃迁，为社会科学提供了可干预、可复现、可持续演进的新型实验仪器。

title: ShapeLex: Decoupling Local Shape Symbolization and Global Scale Modeling for Text-Controlled Time Series Generation
summary: Text-controlled time series generation aims to synthesize sequences that follow natural-language descriptions while remaining faithful to real data distributions. Existing paradigms often couple semantic understanding and sequence modeling in a single continuous latent space, lacking explicit local semantic anchors and separation between global continuous attributes and local discrete shapes. As a result, key local structures may be smoothed, missed, or misplaced. We propose Shape Lexicon (ShapeLex), which decouples text-to-sequence generation into discrete symbolization of local shapes and continuous modeling of global attributes. ShapeLex first induces a reusable vocabulary of discrete shape units, such as rises, spikes, and sharp drops, from training data, forming an interpretable symbolic space. An autoregressive generator then selects shapes according to the textual description, adjusts attributes such as position and duration, and composes them in temporal order into a shape skeleton. Finally, a mixture-density scale head models and samples the overall level and volatility to restore realistic global scale. Experiments on twelve public datasets, real user-written text, and downstream forecasting tasks show that ShapeLex generates series that better match real data distributions than existing methods. In addition, paired supervision is automatically synthesized from the learned vocabulary, avoiding annotation costs that grow with dataset size and improving scalability.

AI.tldr: ShapeLex 通过将文本到序列生成解耦为离散局部形状符号化和连续全局属性建模，实现了更符合真实数据分布的时间序列生成，并自动合成成对监督避免标注成本。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将语义理解和序列建模耦合在单一连续潜在空间中，缺乏显式局部语义锚点和全局连续属性与局部离散形状的分离，导致关键局部结构被平滑、遗漏或错位。
AI.method: 提出 ShapeLex：首先从训练数据诱导可复用的离散形状词汇（如上升、尖峰、急跌），形成可解释符号空间；然后自回归生成器根据文本描述选择形状、调整位置和持续时间等属性，按时间顺序组合成形状骨架；最后混合密度尺度头建模并采样整体水平和波动率以恢复真实全局尺度。
AI.result: 在十二个公开数据集、真实用户文本和下游预测任务上实验表明，ShapeLex 生成的序列比现有方法更好地匹配真实数据分布；同时从学习词汇自动合成成对监督，避免随数据集增长的标注成本，提升可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: ShapeLex 通过解耦离散局部形状符号化与连续全局属性建模，有效解决了文本控制时间序列生成中的局部结构保真和全局尺度还原问题，实现了高质量、可解释且可扩展的生成。

title: Linguistic Features for Interpretable Textual Entailment
summary: Despite the success of neural models in natural language processing, their black-box nature limits interpretability and conceals the linguistic phenomena underlying their predictions. We present SLITE, an explainable hybrid model for Recognizing Textual Entailment that integrates two complementary layers of semantic analysis: a structural-relational layer, based on semantic compatibility and incompatibility between compositional entities, and a distributional-informational layer, based on structured patterns of information change between embedding-based representations of the premise and the hypothesis. We propose 17 features that combine entity-level semantic relations, polarity-sensitive lexical matching, and alignment measures over semantic sub-representations of the similarity matrix, including measures based on entropy and transfer entropy. A logistic regression trained on these features achieves an accuracy of 83% on three-class SICK and 96% on SICK-CE, outperforming IsoLex by 4 percentage points and falling within 2 percentage points of RoBERTa with a fraction of its computational complexity. Ablation studies and SHAP analysis confirm that structural-relational features are the primary drivers of classification, while distributional-informational features provide essential complementary contributions, particularly for detecting neutrality and contradiction. Our results demonstrate that further exploration of hybrid approaches is a viable and scientifically productive alternative to massive neural architectures, and we hope they will strengthen the dialogue between linguistic theory and computational modeling of inference

AI.tldr: 本文提出SLITE，一种用于文本蕴含识别的可解释混合模型，结合结构关系层和分布信息层两个互补的语义分析层，设计17个特征并通过逻辑回归实现分类，在SICK和SICK-CE数据集上分别达到83%和96%准确率，接近RoBERTa性能但计算复杂度大幅降低，消融实验和SHAP分析证实结构关系特征为主要驱动因素，分布信息特征提供关键补充。
AI.motivation: 神经模型在自然语言处理中虽取得成功，但其黑盒特性限制了可解释性，掩盖了预测背后的语言学现象。现有方法要么依赖大规模神经架构缺乏可解释性，要么基于符号方法覆盖面有限。需要一种结合语言学理论与计算建模的混合方法，既保持高性能又提供可解释性。
AI.method: 提出SLITE混合模型，包含两个互补层：1) 结构关系层：基于组合实体间的语义兼容性与不兼容性；2) 分布信息层：基于前提与假设嵌入表示间结构化的信息变化模式。设计17个特征，融合实体级语义关系、极性敏感词汇匹配、相似度矩阵语义子表示的对齐度量（含熵和转移熵）。使用逻辑回归进行分类。
AI.result: 在三分类SICK上达到83%准确率，在SICK-CE上达96%，比IsoLex高4个百分点，与RoBERTa差距仅2个百分点，但计算复杂度仅为其很小一部分。消融实验和SHAP分析显示：结构关系特征是分类的主要驱动因素，分布信息特征提供必要的补充贡献，尤其在检测中性和矛盾类别时效果显著。
AI.conclusion: 混合方法是大规模神经架构的可行且科学富有成效的替代方案，能够强化语言学理论与推理计算建模之间的对话。研究证明结合显式语言学特征与分布表示的方法，在保持竞争性性能的同时实现了更好的可解释性和计算效率。

title: Graph-to-Grid (G2G): Continuous-Coordinate Feature Painting for Soccer Pass Surfaces
summary: Dense pass surfaces give, for every pitch cell, whether a pass played there would arrive, whether the carrier would choose it, and what the possession would then be worth. The networks that draw them read the state as a raster of per-cell counts, losing where inside a cell each player stands. LiDAR detectors, bird's-eye-view perception and graph weather models move entity features onto a grid, binning each entity to a cell or learning the transfer. We evaluate the interpolated form: each player's features are scattered bilinearly onto the grid at the player's measured coordinates, so the surface loss trains the per-player encoder end to end. Those systems adopt an interface; this paper measures one. On 53,628 passes from the 2022 World Cup, painting improves selection likelihood over the same core fed rasters alone by about a quarter of a nat: in every match of an eight-fold cross-validation, with every arm tuned over five seeds, and after retraining on seven Bundesliga and 2. Bundesliga matches from another provider. Thirteen pre-specified studies locate the gain: painting the nine raw player features with no encoder carries three quarters of it, and the learned encoder and message passing add a smaller, resolved increment. Painting also helps the original SoccerMap and a canonical U-Net, whereas offset channels, a finer raster, an attention painter and a raster-free decoder do not. Frozen across the provider boundary the likelihood advantage is lost; injected tracking error compresses it. These results concern observed-endpoint prediction, not calibrated evaluation of hypothetical passes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“绘画”插值方法将球员特征双线性散射到网格，端到端训练逐球员编码器，在 53,628 个世界杯传球上使选择似然提升约 0.25 nat，主要增益来自原始特征绘画，跨数据提供商泛化性受限。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密传球面网络将状态读作每格计数的栅格，丢失格内球员精确位置；LiDAR、鸟瞰感知等将实体特征栅格化，但分箱或学习传递损失亚格子信息。需要评估插值形式：将球员特征按实测坐标双线性散射到网格，使表面损失能端到端训练逐球员编码器。
AI.method: 提出“绘画”插值：将每个球员的 9 维原始特征按测量坐标双线性散射到网格，结合可学习编码器和消息传递。在 2022 世界杯 53,628 次传球上实验，八折交叉验证，五种随机种子调参，并在德甲/乙 7 场比赛重新训练。对比基线栅格输入、偏移通道、更细栅格、注意力绘画、无栅格解码器等消融。
AI.result: 绘画使选择似然比纯栅格提升约 0.25 nat，每场比赛交叉验证均提升。13 个预设实验定位增益：仅绘画 9 维原始特征无编码器已获四分之三增益，编码器和消息传递仅增小量。绘画也提升 SoccerMap 和 U-Net；偏移通道、更细栅格、注意力绘画、无栅格解码器无效。跨数据提供商冻结模型优势消失；注入跟踪误差压缩优势。
AI.conclusion: 插值绘画能有效保留亚格子球员位置信息，显著提升观测端点预测的似然，但增益主要来自原始特征绘画而非复杂编码器；跨提供商泛化和鲁棒性受限，结果仅针对观测端点预测，不涉及假设性传球的校准评估。

title: Jev for Scientific Decisions: Evaluating Semantic Choices and Their Consequences
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Includes references and appendices
summary: Scientific workflows often require choosing among known relations before a deterministic calculation can proceed. Whether observations share a culture, treatment or reference standard can change the scientific meaning of the resulting count or comparison. We evaluate Jev as a semantic decision component using a harness that follows its documented guidance and assigns arithmetic to code. The study compares twelve model configurations on twenty source-grounded Choices across ten scientific cases, each repeated five times. We measure semantic selections, downstream outputs and final claim labels separately. Jev matched five other configurations at complete semantic correctness and achieved the lowest observed median latency among successful responses. Across three comparison models, seven wrong selections on one culture-history question changed downstream counts while preserving the correct final label. These results identify a useful role for Jev in prepared scientific decision tasks and show why evaluating that role requires checking the relations and quantities that a workflow will reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了 Jev 作为语义决策组件在科学工作流中的表现，对比了12种模型配置在10个科学案例中的20个源接地选择，Jev 达到完全语义正确并具有最低中位延迟，但错误选择可能改变下游计数而保持最终标签正确，揭示了评估需检查工作流复用的关系和量。
AI.motivation: 科学工作流在确定性计算前需在已知关系中选择，观测是否共享培养、处理或参考标准会改变计数或比较的科学意义，因此需要评估语义决策组件的准确性及其对下游结果的影响。
AI.method: 使用遵循文档指导并将算术分配给代码的测试桩，对比12种模型配置在10个科学案例中的20个源接地选择，每个重复5次，分别测量语义选择、下游输出和最终声明标签。
AI.result: Jev 与其他五种配置达到完全语义正确，并在成功响应中实现最低中位延迟；在三个比较模型中，一个培养历史问题上的七次错误选择改变了下游计数，但最终标签保持正确。
AI.conclusion: Jev 在准备好的科学决策任务中具有实用价值，评估其作用需要检查工作流将复用的关系和量，因为错误的语义选择可能改变中间计算而不影响最终结论。

title: Q-DEQ: Discrete Solving and Quantization for Deep Equilibrium Models in Time Series Forecasting under Edge Deployment Coding Constraints
summary: Edge deployment motivates forecasting models with compact parameter storage and low-bit representations. Deep equilibrium models (DEQs) obtain implicit depth by repeatedly applying a shared layer, reducing the parameter cost of explicit layer stacking. Their usual Anderson solver, however, searches for update coefficients in the continuous real domain. We propose Q-DEQ, which formulates local updates in DEQ forward solving as discrete optimization problems. Candidate directions are constructed from the current state and iteration history, and a local quadratic residual model is used to evaluate their combinations. Binary encoding of the direction coefficients yields a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problem that can be solved by simulated annealing (SA) or a coherent Ising machine (CIM). After fixed-point solving, a re-forward pass applies W8A8 fake quantization to the shared layer's weights and activations. We evaluate Q-DEQ with an iTransformer backbone on five multivariate time series forecasting datasets. Relative MSE differences from the explicit multi-layer baseline range from $-1.16\%$ to $+2.90\%$, with lower MSE on two datasets. DEQ parameter sharing reduces parameter counts by factors of $1.80\times$--$3.82\times$; combined with W8A8, static weight storage is reduced by factors of $4.3\times$--$12.8\times$. Local QUBO problems solved using CPU-based SA and the Kaiwu CIM physical backend produce closely matching downstream forecasts. These results establish local discrete solving as a viable component of DEQ time series forecasting and provide a route for executing fixed-point updates through different combinatorial optimization backends.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Q-DEQ，将深度平衡模型（DEQ）的前向求解局部更新建模为离散优化问题，利用二进制编码将方向系数转化为 QUBO 问题，通过模拟退火或相干伊辛机求解，并结合 W8A8 量化，在多变量时间序列预测任务上实现参数量和存储大幅压缩，且预测精度与显式多层基线相当。
AI.motivation: 边缘部署需要参数存储紧凑、低比特表示的预测模型。DEQ 通过共享层隐式增加深度降低参数量，但其常用的 Anderson 求解器在连续实数域搜索更新系数，难以直接部署到离散优化硬件（如伊辛机）上，且缺乏量化友好的离散求解机制。
AI.method: 提出 Q-DEQ：1) 将 DEQ 前向求解的局部更新构造为离散优化问题，利用当前状态和迭代历史构建候选方向，采用局部二次残差模型评估组合；2) 对方向系数进行二进制编码，转化为二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题，可由模拟退火（SA）或相干伊辛机（CIM）求解；3) 定点求解后，通过重前向传播对共享层权重和激活施加 W8A8 伪量化。
AI.result: 在五个多变量时间序列预测数据集上，相对显式多层基线的 MSE 差异为 -1.16% 至 +2.90%，两个数据集上 MSE 更低。DEQ 参数共享使参数量减少 1.80×–3.82×，结合 W8A8 量化后静态权重存储减少 4.3×–12.8×。基于 CPU 的 SA 与 Kaiwu CIM 物理后端求解 QUBO 得到的下游预测结果高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 局部离散求解可作为 DEQ 时间序列预测的有效组件，为通过不同组合优化后端执行定点更新提供了可行路径，同时实现了显著的模型压缩和硬件友好部署。

title: DolphinBench: Mapping the Pareto Frontier of Agent Memory
summary:
Agents today often take real-world actions that depend on long-term memory and context recall over time. However, most current memory benchmarks are built for a conversational question-answer format, where the question itself signals that some fact must be retrieved, and often which one. Moreover, benchmarks rarely require anything beyond accuracy from submissions, allowing memory systems to make unreasonable cost/time tradeoffs to achieve higher scores.
  We present DolphinBench, a benchmark that evaluates memory directly through an agent's task completion. DolphinBench includes three knowledge-work personas with roughly 500k tokens of user messages per persona and evaluates agents on tasks that depend on information from that history. We verify all 200 tasks per persona by running an agent with and without the relevant history, requiring success with it and failure without it.
  Finally, we require all evaluations to report total cost and latency alongside accuracy, which enables us to evaluate agent memory systems holistically. No existing memory benchmark combines all three. The dataset and evaluation code are available at https://dolphinbench.ai.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DolphinBench，一个通过任务完成直接评估智能体长期记忆能力的基准，包含三个知识工作者人设（每人设约50万token历史记录）和每人设200个任务，要求报告准确率、总成本和延迟，实现对记忆系统的整体评估。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆基准多基于对话式问答格式，问题本身暗示需检索何种事实，且仅关注准确率，允许系统通过不合理的成本/时间权衡提高分数，无法反映真实场景下智能体依赖长期记忆和上下文回溯执行任务的能力。
AI.method: 构建三个知识工作者人设及其约50万token的用户消息历史；设计每人设200个依赖历史信息的任务；通过有/无相关历史运行智能体验证任务（要求有历史成功、无历史失败）；强制评估报告准确率、总成本和延迟三项指标。
AI.result: 发布了首个结合任务导向评估、严格有/无历史验证、以及成本/延迟报告要求的记忆基准；数据集和评测代码已开源至 dolphinbench.ai。
AI.conclusion: DolphinBench 解决了现有基准的三大缺失：任务导向而非问答导向、严格验证记忆必要性、整体评估准确率/成本/延迟，为智能体记忆系统提供了更真实、全面的评估标准。

title: FlashBoB: I/O-Efficient Exact Backward-over-Backward for Softmax Attention
summary: Transformer models built on the attention mechanism have become a central building block in modern deep learning, yet softmax attention remains a major bottleneck for long-context workloads. While FlashAttention makes the forward and first backward passes I/O-efficient, it does not support backward-over-backward (BoB), which enables exact differentiation through the backward pass for applications such as second-order optimization, test-time training, gradient-based memory, and meta-learning. Existing BoB implementations either materialize large intermediate tensors or exhaust GPU memory at long sequence lengths. We present FlashBoB, an exact, I/O-efficient algorithm for BoB in softmax attention that keeps computation within on-chip tiles and avoids all $N \times N$ intermediate tensors, where $N$ is the sequence length. The key insight is a hierarchical affine structure in the softmax double backward: two row-wise scalars determine all outputs through affine transformations. This yields a two-pass schedule with bounded on-chip static random-access memory (SRAM) usage and minimal off-chip high-bandwidth memory (HBM) traffic. FlashBoB achieves $Θ(N^2 d^2/M)$ HBM traffic ($d$ is the head dimension and $M$ is the memory size) and, within the standard FlashAttention-style score-recomputation model, matches the inherited large-cache lower bound for exact forward attention. Empirically, it scales exact attention BoB to $N=262\text{K}$ on a single A100 80GB GPU, where prior PyTorch exact baselines fail by $N=16\text{K}$, and is up to $6.3\times$ faster than FlashBack. These results make exact second-order attention practical at long-context sequence lengths where prior implementations cannot run efficiently.

AI.tldr: FlashBoB 是一种针对 softmax 注意力机制的精确、I/O 高效的 backward-over-backward (BoB) 算法，通过层次化仿射结构避免 N×N 中间张量，实现长序列下的精确二阶优化。
AI.motivation: 现有 FlashAttention 虽优化了前向和一阶反向传播，但不支持 BoB，而 BoB 对二阶优化、测试时训练、梯度记忆、元学习等应用至关重要。现有 BoB 实现要么物化大型中间张量，要么在长序列下耗尽显存。
AI.method: 提出 FlashBoB 算法，利用 softmax 二阶反向传播中的层次化仿射结构：两个行级标量通过仿射变换决定所有输出。采用两遍调度，将计算限制在片上 SRAM 瓦片内，避免所有 N×N 中间张量，实现 I/O 高效的精确 BoB。
AI.result: 理论上达到 Θ(N^2 d^2/M) HBM 流量，匹配精确前向注意力的大缓存下界。实验上在单张 A100 80GB GPU 上将精确 BoB 扩展到 N=262K，而先前基线在 N=16K 即失败，比 FlashBack 快达 6.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: FlashBoB 使精确二阶注意力在长上下文序列长度下成为可能，解决了先前实现无法高效运行的问题。

title: onPanda: Efficient Annotation of On-Policy Alignment Data for LLMs and Agents via Token-Level Correction
summary: We present onPanda, an interactive tool for efficiently annotating LLM alignment data and agent trajectories. onPanda adopts token-level correction as its core interaction: while reading a model response, the annotator locates the first inappropriate token and either picks a substitute from the model's candidate tokens or types the correct text via free-form editing. The system then truncates everything after that position and continues generation from the corrected prefix, repeating this locate-correct-continue loop until a satisfactory response is obtained. This mechanism lets annotators precisely steer model outputs at low cost: a small controlled study suggests that onPanda reduces median annotation time by 52% over manual post-editing. Since the vast majority of tokens in the final response are generated by the model itself, the resulting data largely preserves the model's sampling distribution and is well suited for constructing on-policy SFT and preference data. Furthermore, the token-level corrections recorded during annotation provide fine-grained supervision with precise positions and naturally paired positive--negative samples. onPanda also connects to external tools and harnesses, enabling interactive trajectory annotation in realistic environments. In addition, we release Panda-CVL, a dataset annotated with onPanda, together with a benchmark for token-level correction.

AI.tldr: onPanda 是一种基于 token 级修正的交互式标注工具，通过定位-修正-继续循环高效生成 LLM 对齐数据和智能体轨迹，显著降低标注时间并保留模型原始分布，适合构建 on-policy SFT 和偏好数据。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 对齐数据标注方式（如人工后编辑）耗时长、破坏模型采样分布，且缺乏细粒度监督信号；需要一种能精准干预模型输出、保留 on-policy 特性并提供 token 级正负样本对的标注工具。
AI.method: 核心交互为 token 级修正：标注员阅读模型回复，定位首个不当 token，从候选集选择替换或自由编辑；系统截断后续内容并从修正前缀继续生成，循环直至满意。工具还集成外部工具与环境，支持交互式轨迹标注。
AI.result: 受控研究显示中位标注时间较人工后编辑减少 52%；最终回复绝大多数 token 由模型生成，保留原始采样分布；修正过程天然产生带精确位置的 token 级正负样本对。发布了 Panda-CVL 数据集及 token 级修正基准。
AI.conclusion: onPanda 通过 token 级修正循环实现了高效、分布保真、细粒度监督的对齐数据标注，为 on-policy SFT、偏好学习及智能体轨迹标注提供了实用工具与基准资源。

title: Reinforcement Learning under State and Outcome Uncertainty: A Foundational Distributional Perspective
comment: Accepted to the RLC 2025 Finding the Frame Workshop
summary: In many real-world planning tasks, agents must tackle uncertainty about the environment's state and variability in the outcomes of any chosen policy. We address both forms of uncertainty as a first step toward safer algorithms in partially observable settings. Specifically, we extend Distributional Reinforcement Learning (DistRL)-which models the entire return distribution for fully observable domains-to Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs), allowing an agent to learn the distribution of returns for each conditional plan. Concretely, we introduce new distributional Bellman operators for partial observability and prove their convergence under the supremum p-Wasserstein metric. We also propose a finite representation of these return distributions via psi-vectors, generalizing the classical alpha-vectors in POMDP solvers. Building on this, we develop Distributional Point-Based Value Iteration (DPBVI), which integrates psi-vectors into a standard point-based backup procedure-bridging DistRL and POMDP planning. By tracking return distributions, DPBVI lays the foundation for future risk-sensitive control in domains where rare, high-impact events must be carefully managed. We provide source code to foster further research in robust decision-making under partial observability.

AI.tldr: 该论文将分布式强化学习扩展到部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），提出新的分布式贝尔曼算子、psi向量表示和分布式基于点的价值迭代（DPBVI）算法，为部分可观测环境下的风险敏感控制奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 现实世界规划任务中，智能体面临环境状态不确定性和策略结果变异性两种不确定性。现有的分布式强化学习仅适用于全可观测域，缺乏处理部分可观测性的理论框架，需要一种能同时应对这两种不确定性的安全算法。
AI.method: 1. 引入适用于部分可观测性的新分布式贝尔曼算子，并在supremum p-Wasserstein度量下证明收敛性。2. 提出psi向量作为回报分布的有限表示，推广经典POMDP求解器中的alpha向量。3. 开发分布式基于点的价值迭代（DPBVI），将psi向量集成到标准基于点的备份过程中，连接分布式强化学习与POMDP规划。
AI.result: 建立了理论框架：分布式贝尔曼算子在p-Wasserstein度量下收缩；psi向量提供回报分布的有限参数化表示；DPBVI算法成功整合分布式表示与点值迭代。代码已开源促进鲁棒决策研究。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为部分可观测环境下的风险敏感控制奠定基础，通过跟踪完整回报分布而非仅期望值，使智能体能更审慎地管理罕见高影响事件，推动安全强化学习在现实应用中的发展。

title: SPeaR: Test-Time Adaptation with Steering Primitives for Realigning Representations
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses distribution shift using only unlabeled test data. Existing methods typically adapt pretrained models by updating their parameters, limiting both what is adapted and where adaptation can occur within the network. We instead keep the pretrained network frozen and steer its intermediate representations. We introduce SPeaR (Steering Primitive for Realigning Representations), which inserts lightweight learnable modules at stage boundaries and optimizes them directly from the test stream, requiring neither source data nor supervised warm-up. Each primitive is optimized using a gated objective that reduces uncertainty only when adaptation is beneficial, along with a diversity regularizer to prevent collapse, and a multi-depth anchor to stabilize adaptation. We show that steering early representations is the most effective strategy, and that the same primitive transfers across convolutional and Transformer architectures. Across CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C, and ImageNet-C, SPeaR consistently matches or outperforms methods that adapt orders of magnitude more parameters, remains robust across a wide range of batch sizes, and preserves source-domain performance during continual adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出SPeaR（Steering Primitive for Realigning Representations），在冻结预训练网络的前提下，仅在阶段边界插入轻量可学习模块，通过门控目标、多样性正则化和多深度锚点直接从测试流优化，实现无需源数据和监督预热的测试时适应，且在多个基准上以极少参数量达到或超越全参数更新方法。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时适应（TTA）方法通常通过更新预训练模型参数来应对分布偏移，这限制了适应的范围和位置，且往往需要源数据或监督预热。本文旨在探索冻结主干网络、仅引导中间表示的策略，以更高效、更通用的方式解决测试时分布偏移问题。
AI.method: SPeaR在预训练网络的阶段边界插入轻量级可学习模块（primitives），保持主干冻结。每个primitive采用门控目标函数——仅在适应有益时降低不确定性；引入多样性正则化防止表示坍塌；利用多深度锚点稳定适应过程。直接从未标记测试流优化primitives，无需源数据和监督预热。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C和ImageNet-C上，SPeaR以极少参数量持续匹配或超越更新数量级更多参数的方法；适应早期表示效果最佳；同一primitive可在卷积和Transformer架构间迁移；在广泛批量大小下保持鲁棒，且持续适应过程中保留源域性能。
AI.conclusion: 冻结预训练网络并引导早期中间表示是一种高效且通用的测试时适应范式。SPeaR通过轻量级primitives、门控目标、多样性正则化和多深度锚点，实现了无需源数据、无监督预热、跨架构迁移且参数极少的强鲁棒适应，为TTA提供了新的设计思路。

title: PAC-Bayesian Meta-Learning for Few-Shot Identification of Linear Dynamical Systems
comment: Accepted at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. J2C Certification
summary:
Identifying linear time-invariant (LTI) dynamical systems is challenging when trajectories are short, noisy, or high-dimensional. Traditional system identification typically treats each system independently and cannot exploit shared structure across related systems. We propose PBML-LTI, a PAC-Bayesian meta-learning framework for few-shot LTI system identification that learns a transferable prior over task-specific dynamics while preserving task heterogeneity. Each task corresponds to an unknown LTI system, and the meta-learner uses training trajectories to learn a data-dependent prior over transition matrices. For a new system with limited data, PBML-LTI performs Bayesian adaptation under this prior to obtain a task-specific posterior, providing accurate estimates and principled uncertainty quantification.
  A key challenge is temporal dependence, since LTI trajectories violate the i.i.d. assumptions underlying most PAC-Bayes meta-learning analyses. We address this with a martingale PAC-Bayes analysis for dependent trajectory losses and derive a support-query predictive-risk bound that motivates a fit-KL meta-training objective. The bound clarifies the roles of empirical fit, posterior complexity, and prior quality in few-shot adaptation under sequential dependence. We further derive corollaries for transition-matrix recovery and multi-step trajectory prediction, connecting uncertainty-aware meta-identification with finite-sample guarantees for dependent dynamical data.

AI.tldr: 提出 PBML-LTI，一种 PAC-贝叶斯元学习框架，用于小样本 LTI 系统辨识。通过元学习可迁移先验分布，在新任务上进行贝叶斯适应获得任务特定后验，实现准确估计与原则性不确定性量化，并针对时序依赖数据给出有限样本理论保证。
AI.motivation: 传统系统辨识独立处理每个系统，无法利用相关系统间的共享结构；且短轨迹、噪声、高维等因素使 LTI 辨识极具挑战。需要一种能从多任务中学习可迁移先验、保留任务异质性、并提供不确定性量化的方法。
AI.method: PBML-LTI 框架：元训练阶段利用多任务轨迹学习数据依赖的先验分布（过渡矩阵先验）；新任务到来时，在该先验下进行贝叶斯适应得到任务特定后验。理论上采用马丁格尔 PAC-贝叶斯分析处理时序依赖，推导 support-query 预测风险界，设计 fit-KL 元训练目标。
AI.result: 推导了依赖轨迹损失的 PAC-贝叶斯泛化界，明确了经验拟合、后验复杂度和先验质量在小样本适应中的作用；给出了转移矩阵恢复和多步轨迹预测的推论，建立了不确定性感知元辨识与依赖动力学数据有限样本保证的联系。
AI.conclusion: PBML-LTI 实现了跨任务知识迁移，在短、噪、高维 LTI 系统辨识中提供准确估计和原则性不确定性量化，并为依赖数据下的元学习提供了理论保证。

title: CLOOPD: Closing the Learner Loop in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) pays twice for each fresh batch: the student generates trajectories and a stronger teacher scores them. Existing methods improve which trajectories are scored and how the teacher signal is constructed, but usually consume it with one actor update. We introduce CLOOPD, a closed-loop framework separating teacher-signal acquisition from student-side realization. CLOOPD selects an adaptive $α$ waypoint inside a KL envelope, freezes the scored batch and its advantages, re-forwards the student after each actor pass, measures realization, and allocates actor work under a separate token budget. The framework includes deterministic two- and three-pass policies, token-priced CLOOPD-TPMR, and a budget-matched control. Across six 300-step runs on an 8-H20 node, every CLOOPD policy improves the one-pass TOP-D anchor at comparable teacher-token scale: macro accuracy rises from 15.41 to 17.78 with CLOOPD-Fixed2 and 19.36 with CLOOPD-Fixed3. At step 100, CLOOPD-Fixed3 reaches 15.35, nearly matching TOP-D at step 300 while using 67.2% fewer teacher-scored tokens and 28.0% fewer GPU-hours. Earlier 8-A100 ablations show adaptive $α$ eliminates observed trust-envelope violations; a third pass adds headroom. These results position CLOOPD as a framework for budgeting how fully students learn from teacher-scored tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLOOPD，一种闭环框架，将教师信号获取与学生侧实现解耦，通过自适应α路径点、冻结评分批次、多轮前向传播与token预算分配，显著提升在线策略蒸馏的样本效率与训练效率。
AI.motivation: 现有在线策略蒸馏（OPD）每批次需双重开销：学生生成轨迹、教师打分，但通常仅用一次actor更新消费教师信号，导致教师token利用率低、训练成本高。
AI.method: CLOOPD在KL包络内选取自适应α路径点，冻结教师评分批次及其优势估计，每轮actor更新后重新前向传播学生以测量实现程度，并在独立token预算下分配actor工作量。框架包含确定性二/三轮策略、token定价的CLOOPD-TPMR及预算匹配基线。
AI.result: 在8张H200上六次300步实验中，所有CLOOPD策略均超越单轮TOP-D基线：宏准确率从15.41提升至17.78（Fixed2）和19.36（Fixed3）。步数100时Fixed3达15.35，接近TOP-D步数300的性能，教师token减少67.2%，GPU小时减少28.0%。8张A100消融显示自适应α消除信任包络违规，第三轮提供额外余量。
AI.conclusion: CLOOPD确立了为教师评分token分配学生学习深度的预算框架，通过闭环多轮实现机制大幅提升样本与算力效率，为在线蒸馏提供了可扩展的优化范式。

title: Luck Is Not Skill: When Do Paired Rollouts Help Group-Relative RL of LLM Agents?
comment: 24 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Code, task pools, pre-registration and numerical summaries: https://github.com/TheDeadcoder/paired-rollouts
summary: Group-relative reinforcement learning compares rollouts of the same prompt, but independent environment noise can obscure these comparisons. We study paired rollouts, which share an event-keyed noise schedule within each group while preserving each rollout's marginal distribution. Pairing removes the between-schedule component of reward-contrast variance, but need not reduce gradient variance. For one-sided grader noise, we derive an exact condition for reduction and give a counterexample in which reward contrasts improve while gradient variance increases. A controlled study trains a 2B tool-use agent under tool faults and grader flips, with three seeds per design. The protocol was registered with a disclosed, previously completed pilot. Under tool faults, pairing improves final noisy-test success by +5.1 percentage points on average, with all three seed differences positive, but misses the registered learning-curve criterion. The criterion is also missed under grader flips: the validation-AUC difference is +0.003 (95% interval [-0.029, +0.033]). A gradient probe on eight distinct checkpoints from two fault-trained trajectories finds lower mean-centered covariance traces under both noise types: 21 to 30% for grader flips and 40 to 63% for tool faults. These finite-sample measurements support the variance mechanism without establishing a general learning-speed benefit. The results distinguish improving reward comparisons, reducing estimator variance, and improving learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究成对采样在组相对强化学习中的效果：通过共享事件键控噪声调度来减少奖励对比方差，但梯度方差不一定降低。实验在工具故障和评分器翻转两种噪声下训练 2B 工具使用智能体，成对采样虽改善奖励对比并降低梯度协方差迹（21-63%），但在注册的学习曲线指标上未达显著提升，表明改善奖励对比、降低估计量方差与提升学习速度是不同概念。
AI.motivation: 组相对强化学习通过对比同一提示的多个采样来估计优势，但独立的环境噪声会干扰这些对比。现有方法未区分奖励对比方差与梯度方差，且缺乏理论条件说明何时成对采样真正降低梯度方差。
AI.method: 提出成对采样：组内采样共享事件键控噪声调度，保持边缘分布不变。理论分析单侧评分器噪声下梯度方差降低的精确条件，并构造反例。实验在工具故障与评分器翻转两种噪声下训练 2B 参数工具使用智能体，三随机种子，预注册协议含先导实验。测量最终测试成功率、验证 AUC、八个检查点的梯度均值中心协方差迹。
AI.result: 工具故障下：成对采样平均提升最终噪声测试成功率 +5.1 个百分点，三种子均为正向，但未达预注册学习曲线标准。评分器翻转下：验证 AUC 差异 +0.003 (95% CI [-0.029, +0.033])，亦未达标。梯度探针显示两种噪声下均值中心协方差迹降低：评分器翻转 21-30%，工具故障 40-63%。有限样本支持方差机制，但未证明普遍学习加速收益。
AI.conclusion: 成对采样能改善奖励对比并降低梯度估计器方差，但这不等同于提升学习速度或最终性能。研究揭示了三个不同层面：改善奖励对比、降低估计量方差、提升学习效果，三者在实证上可分离。

title: Mind or Message? Auditing Theory of Mind in Multi-Agent Social Simulation
summary: Language model agents are increasingly used to simulate social interaction, and the resulting transcripts read as though the agents understand one another. We ask whether that appearance rests on a model of the partner's mind or on the surface record of what the partner said. We build a social simulation in which both questions have exact answers: 40 multi-issue negotiations whose hidden preference weights and whose full Pareto frontier are known by construction. Two model families negotiate across 160 dyads, every transcript is frozen before any measurement, and 2880 counterfactual probes then hold the evidence byte identical while moving one factor at a time: the reader's own stake, the partner's tone, an identity label, and the order of recursion. The agents are socially fluent and economically poor. They reach agreement in 96.2% of dyads with 0 protocol failures, yet only 0.7% of deals land on the Pareto frontier, they leave 20.5% of the available joint value unclaimed, and they miss the one issue on which their interests are perfectly aligned in 76.6% of deals; on the frontier and on that aligned issue, a package drawn at random from the set both sides would accept does as well. The probes locate the failure. Swapping only the reader's own payoff sheet, while the partner's words and offers stay identical, moves the inferred top priority by 15.0 percentage points, which is egocentric projection rather than inference, while a tone rewrite moves it by 5.3 percentage points and an identity label by 0.0. Most tellingly, an agent predicts what its partner believes about it 72.5% of the time while that partner's belief is itself correct only 51.2% of the time: the agents track the conversation far better than they track the mind behind it.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建已知偏好权重和帕累托前沿的多议题谈判模拟，系统评估语言模型代理的社会推理能力。结果显示代理虽表现出高社会流畅性（96.2%达成协议），但经济表现极差：仅0.7%交易达帕累托最优，放弃20.5%联合价值，且76.6%错过完全利益一致的议题。反事实探针揭示代理主要依赖自我中心投射（自身收益表变动导致推断优先级偏移15个百分点），而非伴侣心智建模；代理对话跟踪准确率（72.5%）远高于心智追踪准确率（51.2%），表明其“理解”仅停留在表层记录而非深层心智推断。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型代理越来越多用于模拟社会互动，其生成的对话看似展现相互理解，但尚不清楚这种表象是基于对伴侣心智的真实建模，还是仅基于伴侣言语的表层记录。本文旨在通过可控实验剥离这两种机制，量化代理社会推理的真实深度。
AI.method: 构建40个多议题谈判场景，隐藏偏好权重和完整帕累托前沿由构造已知。两个模型家族在160对代理中谈判，冻结所有对话记录后，设计2880个反事实探针：在保持证据字节完全相同前提下，单独操纵读者自身利益、伴侣语气、身份标签、递归阶数四个因素，测量代理推断优先级的变化。
AI.result: 代理社会流畅但经济低效：达成率96.2%，零协议失败，却仅0.7%落在帕累托前沿，留存20.5%联合价值，76.6%错过完全对齐议题。探针显示：仅交换读者自身收益表即导致推断优先级偏移15.0个百分点（自我中心投射），语气重写偏移5.3个百分点，身份标签无影响。代理预测伴侣对其信念准确率72.5%，而伴侣信念自身正确率仅51.2%，证实代理更擅长跟踪对话而非跟踪心智。
AI.conclusion: 当前语言模型代理在社会模拟中表现出的“理解”主要源于对对话表层统计的拟合，而非真正的心智理论推理。其经济决策质量极低，且推理过程易受自我中心偏见主导。未来需开发显式心智建模机制，而非仅依赖扩大模型规模或对话数据。

title: Acceptance-Aware Draft Model Training for Speculative Decoding
summary:
Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to generate multiple candidate tokens that are verified by the target model in a single forward pass. Its speedup is largely determined by the acceptance length, yet existing draft-model training methods mainly optimize cross-entropy or Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence as proxies. These objectives encourage distribution matching but do not directly optimize acceptance length, and the acceptance mechanism also differs between greedy and sampling-based decoding.
  In this work, we propose acceptance-length-aware training losses that directly optimize the expected number of accepted tokens within a speculative window. For greedy verification, we derive an expected accepted length (EAL) loss that explicitly maximizes expected acceptance length. For sampling-based decoding, we introduce a window total variation (WTV) loss that optimizes the overlap between temperature-scaled draft and target distributions while accounting for sequential acceptance dependencies. Both objectives can be further combined with a group-relative reinforcement learning stage (GRPO) using simulated acceptance length as the reward.
  Experiments across different target and draft models, tasks, and decoding settings show that our losses consistently improve acceptance length over KL-based training. WTV provides particularly strong gains under sampling-based decoding, while EAL better matches greedy verification. These results show that directly optimizing the acceptance objective, with losses tailored to the decoding mode, is more effective than conventional distribution-matching objectives.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对推测解码中草稿模型训练目标与接受长度不匹配的问题，提出直接优化预期接受长度的EAL损失（贪婪解码）和WTV损失（采样解码），并结合GRPO强化学习进一步提升，实验表明显著优于KL散度代理目标。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码草稿模型训练主要优化交叉熵或KL散度作为代理目标，这些分布匹配目标并不直接优化接受长度，且接受机制在贪婪和采样解码下不同，导致加速效果受限。
AI.method: 提出两种接受长度感知损失：1) EAL损失显式最大化贪婪验证下的预期接受长度；2) WTV损失优化温度缩放草稿与目标分布重叠并考虑顺序接受依赖，适用于采样解码。两者均可结合GRPO强化学习，以模拟接受长度为奖励进一步优化。
AI.result: 跨不同目标/草稿模型、任务和解码设置实验显示，提出损失一致提升接受长度，优于KL训练。WTV在采样解码下增益显著，EAL更适配贪婪验证。
AI.conclusion: 直接针对解码模式定制的接受目标优化，比传统分布匹配代理目标更有效，为推测解码草稿模型训练提供了更原则性的方法。}

title: H-Spec: Parallel Speculative Decoding Without a Drafter-Side KV Cache
summary: Speculative decoding losslessly accelerates large language model inference by having a lightweight draft model predict future tokens for verification by the target model. Recent block diffusion drafters further reduce drafting latency by predicting multiple tokens in parallel. However, existing block drafters project target hidden states at every input position into a separate drafter-side KV cache, incurring per-request memory and KV-write overhead that grow with concurrency; directly reusing target KVs in place removes this cache but fails to sustain draft quality throughout the block. We propose a hybrid target-context injection method that complements direct target KV reuse with target hidden states only at the last input position, requiring no separate drafter-side KV cache. Building on this design, we propose H-Spec, a hybrid Mamba-attention parallel drafter that consumes the two target-context sources through complementary modules. Mamba modules are initialized with projected last-token target hidden states, while attention modules reuse target KVs in place. Despite its recurrent formulation, Mamba's parallel scan allows H-Spec to preserve block-parallel drafting. Across three target models and diverse tasks, H-Spec improves over the best baseline by 5.0--13.3% in mean accepted length and 5.3--12.6% in batch-size-1 inter-token latency speedup. Under concurrent serving, H-Spec consistently achieves higher throughput while maintaining lower KV cache utilization than baselines across evaluated concurrency levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 H-Spec，一种混合 Mamba-Attention 并行草稿模型，通过结合目标模型最后位置的隐状态投影与原地复用目标 KV 缓存，在无需额外草稿端 KV 缓存的情况下实现高质量的块级并行推测解码，显著提升接受长度、降低延迟并减少并发服务时的 KV 缓存占用。
AI.motivation: 现有块级推测解码草稿模型需在每个输入位置将目标隐状态投影至独立的草稿端 KV 缓存，导致随并发度增长的显存与 KV 写入开销；直接原地复用目标 KV 虽消除额外缓存，但无法在整个块内维持草稿质量。需要一种无需额外缓存且能持续保持草稿质量的上下文注入机制。
AI.method: 提出混合目标上下文注入：仅在最后一个输入位置投影目标隐状态，其余位置原地复用目标 KV。基于此设计 H-Spec，包含互补的 Mamba 模块（用投影的最后位置隐状态初始化）与 Attention 模块（原地复用目标 KV）。利用 Mamba 的并行扫描特性保持块级并行起草能力。
AI.result: 在三个目标模型及多样任务上，H-Spec 相比最强基线平均接受长度提升 5.0–13.3%，batch-size-1 时 token 间延迟加速 5.3–12.6%。并发服务场景下，在所有评测并发级别上持续实现更高吞吐且 KV 缓存占用更低。
AI.conclusion: H-Spec 通过混合上下文注入与 Mamba-Attention 混合架构，在消除草稿端独立 KV 缓存的同时保持高质量块级并行起草，有效解决了并发推测解码的显存与延迟瓶颈，为大模型高效推理提供了实用的新范式。

title: Opinion Leader Dynamics: How Sparse Attention Shapes Token Clustering
summary: Sparse attention reduces the quadratic cost of global self-attention while retaining strong empirical performance, but how its restricted interactions shape the evolution of token representations remains theoretically underexplored. Modeling tokens as particles on the unit sphere, we introduce opinion leader dynamics, a framework that identifies two mechanisms through which token groups converge internally while maintaining distinct limiting directions. In the explicit model, fixed representatives induce a potential that attracts tokens toward distinct local maxima. In the implicit model, disconnected interaction groups evolve toward separate consensus directions. We formulate both models as reverse Wasserstein gradient flows and establish exponential convergence under suitable conditions. We further connect these theoretical predictions to token evolution in frontier sparse-attention LLMs that motivate our framework. Across four benchmarks, Kimi-K3, MiniMax-M3, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash consistently exhibit clearer cluster separation and higher clustering scores than the dense-attention model GLM-4.7-Flash in projected token representations. These observations support the relevance of the predicted multiple-group structure to trained frontier LLMs, while finite-particle simulations illustrate the theoretical convergence behavior. Together, our results connect restricted token interactions to distinct group-level attractors, providing a dynamical account of how sparse attention can support alignment within groups while preserving separation between them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出观点领袖动力学框架，从理论上分析稀疏注意力机制下token表示的演化动态，揭示稀疏注意力如何通过显式和隐式两种机制实现组内对齐与组间分离，并通过实验验证前沿稀疏注意力LLM的token表征符合理论预测的多群结构。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意力虽然降低了全局自注意力的二次计算成本并保持了强实证性能，但其受限交互如何塑造token表示的演化在理论上仍缺乏深入探索。
AI.method: 将token建模为单位球面上的粒子，引入观点领袖动力学框架：1) 显式模型：固定代表诱导势函数吸引token向不同局部极大值收敛；2) 隐式模型：断开的交互组演化向独立共识方向。两种模型均表述为反Wasserstein梯度流，并在适当条件下证明指数收敛。实验对比Kimi-K3、MiniMax-M3、DeepSeek-V4-Flash等稀疏注意力模型与GLM-4.7-Flash密集注意力模型在四个基准上的投影token表征聚类效果。
AI.result: 稀疏注意力模型在投影token表征中表现出更清晰的簇分离和更高的聚类得分，支持理论预测的多群结构与训练好的前沿LLM的相关性。有限粒子模拟进一步展示了理论收敛行为。
AI.conclusion: 研究将受限token交互与不同的群级吸引子联系起来，提供了稀疏注意力如何在保持组间分离的同时支持组内对齐的动力学解释。

title: Displacement Geometry Captures Platonic Shared Reality Across Models and Modalities
summary:
The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) claims that independently trained models converge on a shared statistical model of reality, yet recent work finds only weak pointwise similarity between models. In this paper, we show that what models share is not the location of samples in representation space, but the directions (displacement vectors) between them. Under a single orthogonal alignment--rotation and reflection only--these displacement vectors are substantially preserved across 44 independently trained vision and language encoders spanning modalities and asymmetric capability pairs, consistent with the PRH evidence. The samples' absolute positions are not, consistent with recent counter-evidence. Both arise from a single decomposition: representations split into a shared semantic component that is linearly aligned across models, and a private capability component that is not. We trace this geometry to concept-level structure: within a model, parent concepts are orthogonal to their child variation vectors; across models, concept displacements are parallel. Our theory falsifiably predicts (and experiments confirm) that fine-tuning preserves pointwise similarity but collapses displacement, and that relational distillation does the opposite.
  A major implication is that, because semantics align linearly but capabilities do not, capabilities can be imported from one model to another using a single cached forward pass through the source. We call this Shadow Casting. As a proof of concept, our SHADOWCLIP instantiation outperforms strong fine-tuned baselines at orders of magnitude less compute. A cache can be released alongside open model weights, letting one model's capabilities be downloaded and imported into any number of other models without fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 论文证明了独立训练的模型在语义层面共享位移向量而非绝对位置，提出 Shadow Casting 方法通过单次前向传播即可跨模型迁移能力，实现无需微调的能力导入。
AI.motivation: 回应柏拉图表示假设与近期弱点对齐证据的矛盾：模型是否真正共享现实的统计结构？研究旨在揭示跨模态、跨架构模型表示空间的共性几何结构，并据此实现高效的能力迁移。
AI.method: 在 44 个独立训练的视觉语言编码器上进行单正交对齐（仅旋转和反射），分析表示空间中的位移向量几何性质；将表示分解为跨模型线性对齐的共享语义成分与不对齐的私有能力成分；基于概念层级结构（父概念正交于子变化向量，跨模型概念位移平行）构建理论预测；提出 Shadow Casting 机制，通过缓存源模型前向传播实现能力导入，构建 SHADOWCLIP 验证。
AI.result: 位移向量在单正交对齐下显著跨模型保持，绝对位置不保持；微调保持点对点相似度但崩塌位移，关系蒸馏则相反；SHADOWCLIP 在极低计算量下超越强微调基线，证明能力可通过单次缓存前向传播跨模型导入。
AI.conclusion: 语义在模型间线性对齐，能力则不，这使得能力可通过 Shadow Casting 高效跨模型迁移。开放模型权重可附带缓存发布，让任意模型无需微调即可下载导入其他模型的能力，为模型复用与协作开辟新范式。

title: Adaptive Forgetting for Nonstationary Optimization: Towards Robust EEG Decoding
summary:
Electroencephalography (EEG) provides non-invasive monitoring of brain activity and is widely used in emotion recognition, motor imagery and sleep staging. Although within-subject decoding has achieved considerable progress, cross-subject generalization remains a central challenge in practical applications. EEG decoders are typically trained with Adam/AdamW under a fixed second-moment decay coefficient, even though cross-subject learning involves low signal-to-noise ratios, subject variability, and gradient nonstationarity. A fixed coefficient implicitly assumes that gradient statistics are homogeneous across layers and time, which can limit model's adaptability to cross-subject EEG signals and degrade generalization. To address these issues, we propose AFOR, a tensor-wise adaptive optimizer that converts the fixed second-moment decay coefficient into a dynamic coefficient estimated online from local gradient state. AFOR combines a Residual-Alignment Signal Scorer (RASS) and an Adaptive Forgetting Controller (AFC). RASS summarizes local gradient residuals and directional agreement into a signal-quality score, and AFC maps this score through self-referential normalization to a bounded per-step decay coefficient, with cumulative-product initialization correction maintaining consistency under time-varying decay.
  Under a strict cross-subject protocol on three EEG benchmarks that cover three representative fields, AFOR achieves the best average performance among the compared optimizers, improving the mean test accuracy over Adam by 3.00%, 2.07%, and 4.38%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 论文针对跨被试EEG解码中固定二阶矩衰减系数的局限性，提出张量级自适应优化器AFOR，通过残差对齐信号评分器(RASS)和自适应遗忘控制器(AFC)动态调整衰减系数，在三个EEG基准上显著提升跨被试泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 跨被试EEG解码面临低信噪比、被试间变异性大、梯度非平稳等挑战。现有优化器(Adam/AdamW)使用固定二阶矩衰减系数，隐含假设梯度统计特性跨层和跨时间同质，限制了模型对跨被试EEG信号的适应性，降低泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出AFOR优化器，包含两个核心组件：1)残差对齐信号评分器(RASS)，汇总局部梯度残差和方向一致性生成信号质量分数；2)自适应遗忘控制器(AFC)，通过自引用归一化将分数映射为有界逐步衰减系数，并采用累积乘积初始化修正保持时变衰减下的一致性。
AI.result: 在严格跨被试协议下，于覆盖情绪识别、运动想象、睡眠分期三大领域的三个EEG基准测试中，AFOR在对比优化器中取得最佳平均性能，相较Adam分别提升平均测试准确率3.00%、2.07%、4.38%。
AI.conclusion: AFOR通过张量级自适应动态调整二阶矩衰减系数，有效解决了跨被试EEG解码中的梯度非平稳和异质性问题，显著提升了跨被试泛化能力，为EEG实际应用提供了更鲁棒的优化方案。

title: Hessian Rank Constraint for Learning Structure of Nonlinear Latent Variable Models
summary: Uncovering latent variables and their causal relations from observed data is a fundamental yet challenging problem. Existing methods often rely on restrictive assumptions, such as linear relations or invertible mixing functions. To better address this problem under general nonlinear mixing procedures, we propose a condition called the cross-Hessian Rank Constraint (HRC), which serves as a primitive rank-based tool for nonlinear latent causal discovery. In particular, we show that a rank-based property arises from the cross-Hessian of the observed-data log-density in the nonlinear case, revealing information about the latent variables, and reduces to the Tetrad constraints in the linear Gaussian case. More specifically, when two groups of observed variables are d-separated by a set of lower-dimensional latent variables, the rank of this cross-Hessian is equal to the dimension of the latent variables, under a mild affine derivative assumption on the conditional log-density derivatives. This assumption can be naturally satisfied when the noise level is low or the relevant nonlinearity is moderate. As a downstream application, we instantiate HRC in the pure one-factor measurement setting for locating latent variables and recovering their causal structure up to Markov equivalence. Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets support the theoretical claims.

AI.tldr: 论文提出交叉海森秩约束(HRC)作为非线性潜在因果发现的基于秩的原语工具，通过观测数据对数密度的交叉海森矩阵秩揭示潜变量维度，在纯单因子测量模型中实现潜变量定位及因果结构恢复(至马尔可夫等价类)。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在因果发现方法多依赖线性关系或可逆混合函数等限制性假设，难以应对一般非线性混合过程，亟需一种更通用的非线性潜在因果发现工具。
AI.method: 提出交叉海森秩约束(HRC)：利用观测数据对数密度的交叉海森矩阵秩性质，证明在温和的仿射导数假设下，当两组观测变量被低维潜变量d-分离时，交叉海森秩等于潜变量维度；该假设在低噪声或中等非线性下自然满足。将HRC实例化于纯单因子测量模型，用于定位潜变量并恢复其因果结构至马尔可夫等价类。
AI.result: 理论上，HRC在非线性情况下揭示潜变量信息，退化为线性高斯情况下的Tetrad约束；实验在合成数据和真实数据集上验证了理论主张，支持HRC的有效性。
AI.conclusion: HRC为非线性潜在因果发现提供了一个通用的基于秩的工具，在低噪声或中等非线性条件下能有效识别潜变量维度并恢复因果结构，扩展了潜在因果发现的适用范围。

title: Reinforcement Learning Inspired Black-box Adversarial Attacks for Computer Vision
summary: Neural networks, both convolution or transformer based, are essential for modern computer vision systems. However, they are vulnerable to small perturbations, almost imperceptible to humans, which significantly alter the model's prediction. These adversarial attacks are often considered to be a significant threat to the implementation of neural networks in safety-critical applications. Most attacks utilize the white-box threat model and therefore require full access to the target model, making them unrealistic to use in practice. We propose a novel approach under the more realistic black-box threat model that utilizes concepts from reinforcement learning to optimize perturbations with a non-differentiable target model. Reinforcement learning algorithms have already been optimized to be query efficient, making them an ideal starting point when designing black-box adversarial attacks. We show the success of our reinforcement learning inspired black-box adversarial attack (RIBA) in generating adversarial perturbations using only a small number of queries to the target model, by comparing it to state of the art attacks on different models on the Cifar10 and ImageNet data sets. RIBA takes $25.4\%$ fewer median queries to generate attacked images against a ResNet-18 on Cifar10 and $22.5\%$ fewer median queries to fool a Vit-B/16 model on ImageNet. Additionally, we demonstrate that RIBA can match the performance of white-box attacks on an adversarially trained model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的黑盒对抗攻击方法（RIBA），在仅需少量查询目标模型的情况下，能高效生成对抗样本，性能优于现有最先进的黑盒攻击，甚至可媲美白盒攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗攻击多基于白盒威胁模型，需完全访问目标模型，实际部署中不切实际；黑盒攻击更符合真实场景，但查询效率低。强化学习算法在查询效率上已有优化，适合作为黑盒攻击的基础。
AI.method: 利用强化学习思想，将对抗扰动生成建模为序列决策问题，通过与目标模型交互（仅查询输出）优化扰动，提出 RIBA（Reinforcement learning Inspired Black-box Adversarial attack）算法，适用于不可微分的目标模型。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10 上攻击 ResNet-18，RIBA 中位查询次数比现有最优方法减少 25.4%；在 ImageNet 上攻击 ViT-B/16，中位查询次数减少 22.5%。此外，RIBA 在对抗训练模型上表现可匹配白盒攻击性能。
AI.conclusion: RIBA 验证了强化学习在黑盒对抗攻击中的有效性，显著降低了查询复杂度，同时保持高攻击成功率，为实际场景下的对抗鲁棒性评估提供了更实用的工具。

title: Explainable Predictive Condition-based Maintenance of Naval-Propulsion Systems using Fuzzy Logic
comment: Accepted at the 30th Pan-Hellenic Conference on Informatics (PCI 2026)
summary: The shipping industry has a significant impact on the global economy, emphasizing the need for operational availability and safety through the use of effective maintenance techniques. During the last decades, predictive maintenance (PdM) has emerged as a promising solution compared to the existing conventional maintenance systems. This is because it offers several advantageous functions, such as damage predictions for vessel components, reduced downtime, improved and extended life of machinery, as well as higher safety during voyages. However, existing methodologies developed for performing PdM do not provide explanations of their results to users, so that they can understand the failures that may occur. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a novel framework based on a fuzzy decision tree and a deep residual neural network, aiming to perform explainable PdM on naval vessels. The proposed framework is able to generate fuzzy local rules based on the dataset used, and can provide explanations of its outcomes, using cause-and-effect relationships, in a way that are understandable to users, thereby gaining their trust. Experiments using a publicly available dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, as it achieves an accuracy of 99.24%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于模糊决策树和深度残差神经网络的可解释性预测性维护框架，用于海军舰艇，实现99.24%准确率并提供因果解释。
AI.motivation: 航运业对全球经济影响大，需通过有效维护技术保障运营可用性和安全性。预测性维护(PdM)虽具优势，但现有方法缺乏结果解释，用户难以理解潜在故障，阻碍信任建立。
AI.method: 提出融合模糊决策树与深度残差神经网络的新框架，能从数据集生成模糊局部规则，利用因果关系提供用户可理解的解释，实现可解释性PdM。
AI.result: 在公开数据集实验中，框架达到99.24%准确率，验证其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架解决了PdM解释性不足问题，兼顾高精度与可解释性，增强用户信任，为海军舰艇维护提供可靠工具。

title: MemCalib: Benchmarking and Optimizing Memory Use in LLM Agents
summary: The effectiveness of agent memory ultimately depends on whether the underlying LLM gives each memory in context an appropriate degree of influence over its response. Yet this capability has remained largely overlooked. To assess this capability, we introduce MemCalib, a benchmark grounded in realistic memory-system scenarios for evaluating memory use and advancing optimization algorithms. Results on the MemCalib test set reveal that frontier open- and closed-source models struggle to use memory appropriately. They frequently over-use or under-use memory rather than matching each proposition's actual use to its target level, leading to biased, low-quality responses. Experiments with common post-training algorithms, including group relative policy optimization and on-policy self-distillation, further reveal a clear directional skew: trained models improve in one direction while deteriorating in the other. We therefore propose MemCalib-RL, an ordered bidirectional counterfactual credit-assignment algorithm that separates over- and under-use signals and localizes their credit to response tokens through exact atom ablation. Results across model families and scales (Qwen3-8B, Ministral-3-8B-Instruct, and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) show that MemCalib-RL achieves the best overall performance while better balancing over-use and under-use, with gains generalizing beyond MemCalib in external benchmark evaluation. Further experiments support its design choices and robustness and provide insight into its training dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MemCalib 基准评估 LLM 代理记忆的使用能力，发现先进模型存在过度使用或使用不足记忆的问题，并提出 MemCalib-RL 双向反事实信用分配算法，通过原子级消融分离过度/不足使用信号，在多个模型家族和规模上实现最佳整体性能并平衡两类误差，泛化至外部基准。
AI.motivation: 代理记忆的有效性取决于底层 LLM 能否给予上下文中每条记忆适当的影响程度，但这一能力长期被忽视。现有模型在现实记忆系统场景中难以恰当使用记忆，常表现为过度使用或使用不足，导致响应偏见和低质量。常见后训练算法（如 GRPO、on-policy self-distillation）呈现单向偏斜：改善一方向却恶化另一方向。
AI.method: 1. 构建 MemCalib 基准：基于现实记忆系统场景评估记忆使用。2. 提出 MemCalib-RL：有序双向反事实信用分配算法，将过度使用与使用不足信号分离，并通过精确原子消融将信用定位到响应 token 级别。3. 在 Qwen3-8B、Ministral-3-8B-Instruct、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 等模型家族和规模上实验验证。
AI.result: MemCalib-RL 在多模型家族和规模上达到最佳整体性能，同时更好地平衡过度使用和使用不足，性能增益泛化至外部基准评估。进一步实验支持其设计选择的鲁棒性，并揭示训练动态洞察。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了 LLM 代理记忆使用中的校准难题，提出的 MemCalib 基准和 MemCalib-RL 算法有效解决了过度/不足使用的双向权衡，为记忆增强型代理的可靠部署提供了关键方法论进展。

title: High-Dimensional Online Change Point Detection with Adaptive Thresholding and Interpretability
summary: Change point detection (CPD) identifies abrupt and significant changes in sequential data, with applications in human activity recognition, financial markets, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and autonomous systems. Traditional CPD methods often face computational challenges in high-dimensional settings and typically provide limited explanations for detected changes, which can restrict their practical usability. This paper introduces a CPD framework that improves scalability and interpretability by leveraging the Sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance. Our contributions are fourfold: (1) we transform multivariate sequential data into one-dimensional scores using the SW distance, making the resulting representation compatible with existing CPD methods; (2) we analyze the distributional behavior of random slices of the SW distance and show that, under suitable assumptions, they can be approximated by a Gamma distribution, providing a principled basis for threshold calibration; (3) we propose a self-adapting online CPD algorithm that combines this SW-based score with an adaptive quantile-based threshold; (4) we introduce a model-specific framework for generating contrastive explanations for annotated change points. Empirically, our method reduces false positives by at least $48\%$ on average compared with popular online and offline CPD baselines, while maintaining competitive or superior detection performance. Code is available at https://github.com/jsve96/SWCPD_Code. At the same time, it produces interpretable change-point annotations, making it practical for deployment in high-stakes applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于切片 Wasserstein (SW) 距离的变点检测 (CPD) 框架，解决了高维数据下的计算挑战和可解释性不足问题。该方法将多元序列数据通过 SW 距离转化为一维分数，利用 Gamma 分布近似随机切片的分布行为来校准阈值，提出自适应在线检测算法和对比式解释框架，在减少误报至少 48% 的同时保持优异的检测性能，并提供可解释的变点标注。
AI.motivation: 传统变点检测方法在高维设置下面临计算挑战，且通常无法为检测到的变化提供解释，限制了其在高风险应用中的实用性。需要一种既能提高可扩展性又能增强可解释性的 CPD 方法。
AI.method: 1) 利用切片 Wasserstein (SW) 距离将多元序列数据转化为一维分数，兼容现有 CPD 方法；2) 分析 SW 距离随机切片的分布行为，在适当假设下用 Gamma 分布近似，为阈值校准提供理论依据；3) 提出自适应在线 CPD 算法，结合 SW 分数与自适应分位数阈值；4) 引入模型特定的对比式解释框架，为标注的变点生成解释。
AI.result: 在经验实验中，该方法平均比流行的在线和离线 CPD 基线减少至少 48% 的误报，同时保持具有竞争力或更优的检测性能，并能产生可解释的变点标注，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 基于 SW 距离的 CPD 框架有效解决了高维变点检测的可扩展性和可解释性问题，通过理论分析和自适应算法设计实现了显著的误报降低，为高风险应用场景提供了实用的部署方案。

title: TTSE: A Two-Track Online Self-Evolution Framework
summary: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents are applied in continuously interactive environments, driving the evolution of their own capabilities becomes a core problem for achieving long-term autonomy. Currently, environmental knowledge is typically treated as an external fixed input rather than as part of the agent's ongoing evolution. Reinforcement learning methods usually optimize policies through environmental interaction but tend to adapt only to fixed task distributions or single environments. This paper proposes TTSE (Two-Track Self-Evolution), a dual-track online self-evolution framework that separates evolving knowledge into FACT (environmental facts, whose reliability is continuously verified through interaction evidence) and TIP (task-conditioned implementation procedures). From a decision-theoretic perspective, we decompose the agent's excess risk into environment-representation regret and conditional-execution regret, characterize the conditions under which environment-conditioned policies strictly outperform condition-agnostic policies, and bound the downstream risk in terms of FACT identification error and cross-condition mismatch cost. In practice, TTSE's ablation experiments on GDPevo validate the advantage of dual-track evolution. On the classic agent task benchmarks ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, TTSE further demonstrates superior task adaptation. Moreover, TTSE is broadly compatible with existing skill self-evolution methods; combined with the Bayesian-Agent algorithm, a single-track ablation validates the dual-track advantage, substantially improving the aggregate score across the five major domains of SOPBench over three independent repetitions. Finally, on the real end-to-end task benchmark PinchBench, TTSE is integrated into a general agent framework via retrieval-based injection and stably outperforms the baseline across three independent runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TTSE（双轨自我进化）框架，将 LLM 智能体的进化知识拆分为环境事实（FACT）与任务条件化实现过程（TIP），从决策理论角度分解超额风险，证明环境条件化策略优于无条件策略的条件，并在多个基准上验证了双轨进化的优势。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在持续交互环境中缺乏长期自主进化能力：环境知识通常作为固定外部输入，而非智能体持续进化的一部分；强化学习方法仅适应固定任务分布或单一环境，无法实现跨任务、跨环境的持续自我进化。
AI.method: 提出 TTSE 双轨在线自我进化框架：1) FACT 轨：维护环境事实，通过交互证据持续验证其可靠性；2) TIP 轨：维护任务条件化实现过程。从决策理论视角，将智能体超额风险分解为环境表示遗憾与条件执行遗憾，刻画环境条件化策略严格优于无条件策略的条件，并用 FACT 识别误差与跨条件错配成本界定下游风险。实践中采用检索式注入方式集成至通用智能体框架。
AI.result: 在 GDPevo 消融实验中验证双轨进化优势；在 ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 经典智能体任务上展现更强任务适应性；与 Bayesian-Agent 算法结合后，在 SOPBench 五大领域聚合得分上三次独立重复均显著提升；在真实端到端任务基准 PinchBench 上，三次独立运行稳定超越基线。
AI.conclusion: TTSE 通过将环境知识内化为可验证的 FACT 与任务条件化的 TIP 双轨机制，实现了 LLM 智能体在持续交互环境中的长期自主进化，理论与实验均表明其优于单轨或无条件进化方法，并兼容现有技能自我进化算法，为构建持续自主智能体提供了通用框架。

title: KV-COBRA: KV Cache Compression via Co-Optimized Bit-Rank Allocation
summary: What limits KV-cache compression at extreme bit-rates? We argue that it is not the choice of compression scheme, but how its budget is allocated across attention heads. Existing methods apply rank and bit-width uniformly, ignoring that each head has a different optimal mix of rank truncation and quantization. We show that co-optimizing rank and bit-width per head, using only standard low-rank projection and scalar quantization, dominates uniform allocation, with the largest gains at low bit-rates. Our method, KV-COBRA (Co-Optimized Bit-Rank Allocation), formalizes this as a resource-allocation problem: it balances rank-truncation loss against quantization loss within each head, then redistributes budget across heads to minimize total distortion. A fused Hadamard rotation equalizes per-channel variance, and reordering the SVD basis by attention-KL importance makes the solver query-aware. The same allocator extends to joint $K{+}V$ compression. On perplexity, zero-shot, and long-context benchmarks from $0.5$ to $4$ bits per dimension (bpd), KV-COBRA shows the smallest accuracy degradation among evaluated methods at low bpd, with no per-token overhead.

AI.tldr: 论文提出KV-COBRA方法，通过逐头协同优化低秩投影秩与量化比特宽度，解决极低比特率下KV缓存压缩的性能瓶颈，实现了在0.5-4 bpd范围内最小精度损失且无逐token开销。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩方法在极低比特率下受限于统一分配秩和比特宽度，忽略了不同注意力头对秩截断与量化的敏感度差异，导致资源分配次优。
