AI.method: 将压缩建模为资源分配问题：在每个头内平衡秩截断损失与量化损失，再跨头重新分配预算以最小化总失真。引入融合Hadamard旋转均衡通道方差，按注意力KL重要性重排SVD基使求解器具备查询感知能力，并扩展至K/V联合压缩。
AI.result: 在困惑度、零样本及长上下文基准上（0.5-4 bpd），KV-COBRA在低比特率下表现出最小精度退化，且无逐token计算开销。
AI.conclusion: KV缓存压缩的极限在于跨头预算分配而非压缩方案本身；逐头协同优化秩与比特宽度的资源分配策略能显著提升极低比特率下的压缩效果。

title: SupportCal: Label-Free Calibration of Post-Trained LLMs via Reference Support and Corroboration
summary: Post-training often improves task performance but can degrade confidence calibration, leaving post-trained language models (PoLMs) more overconfident than their corresponding pretrained language models (PLMs). Because task-specific labeled calibration data can be costly or unavailable, the corresponding pretrained PLM provides a natural label-free reference for post-hoc calibration. Prior agreement-gated PLM-referenced calibration fits a scalar temperature using only examples on which the PoLM and its PLM reference agree, excluding disagreement examples because direct alignment can drive the fitted temperature excessively high and induce under-confidence. We revisit this binary treatment. A controlled reintroduction diagnostic reveals a non-monotonic aggregate effect: admitting a moderate fraction of disagreement examples can improve calibration, whereas the benefit diminishes as unit-weight inclusion approaches the full disagreement set. We introduce SupportCal, a label-free post-hoc method that retains agreement examples at unit weight and assigns disagreement examples continuous weights based on the own-base PLM's relative support and corroboration from pretrained references selected from a size-compatible candidate pool. We further characterize when the resulting weighted objective admits a finite optimal temperature. Across MedMCQA and MathQA, SupportCal yields lower ECE than the agreement-only baseline for nearly all evaluated target-model configurations; supplementary TweetEval Sentiment results show the same pattern on a fixed-label classification task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SupportCal，一种无标签的后处理校准方法，通过加权利用预训练模型（PLM）在后训练模型（PoLM）与 PLM 不一致样本上的相对支持度和佐证，改进基于一致性门控的温度缩放校准，在 MedMCQA、MathQA 及 TweetEval 上显著降低 ECE。
AI.motivation: 后训练虽提升任务性能，但会恶化置信度校准，使 PoLM 比对应的 PLM 更过度自信。由于任务特定标注校准数据获取昂贵或不可用，PLM 成为天然的无标签参考。现有基于一致性门控的 PLM 参考校准仅使用 PoLM 与 PLM 预测一致的样本拟合标量温度，完全排除不一致样本，因为直接对齐会导致拟合温度过高引发欠自信。本文旨在重新审视这种二元处理，探索如何有效利用不一致样本。
AI.method: 提出 SupportCal：保留一致样本单位权重，为不一致样本分配连续权重。权重基于自基础 PLM 的相对支持度，并结合从规模兼容候选池中选取的多个预训练参考模型的佐证。进一步理论刻画加权目标函数存在有限最优温度的条件。
AI.result: 在 MedMCQA 和 MathQA 上，SupportCal 对几乎所有评估的目标模型配置均比一致性基线实现更低的 ECE；补充实验在 TweetEval Sentiment（固定标签分类任务）上观察到相同模式。
AI.conclusion: 受控重引入诊断揭示非单调聚合效应：适度引入不一致样本能改善校准，但效益随单位权重包含比例增加而递减。SupportCal 通过连续加权机制有效平衡了一致与不一致样本的利用，提供了一种更稳健的无标签后处理校准方案。

title: The Undetected Damage of Quantization on Retrieval and How to Fix It
comment: 5 figures, 4 tables in the main paper
summary: We show that a quantized model that keeps its classification accuracy still changes $14$ to $46\%$ of its top-1 retrieval results, and that aggregate ranking metrics reveal only part of this damage. We tie this failure to the gap between the two highest scores and use that gap to decide when a quantized answer can be trusted and where additional precision should be spent. We show that the top-1 result is guaranteed to survive quantization only when this gap exceeds twice the largest rounding error. In classification, scores are the logits, and the loss function pushes the correct class away from other classes, encouraging this gap. In retrieval, scores are query-document scores, and nothing separates the top-1 item from the second. This gap can be measured without labels. Before deployment, it predicts which models will break under quantization, and at deployment time it tells, per input, whether the quantized answer still matches the full-precision answer. Most classification inputs have a gap wide enough to trust the quantized answer, but few retrieval queries do. That gap motivates a different fix in each task. In retrieval, spending extra bit-width on the layers whose quantization moves the gap most recovers up to three-quarters of an extra bit's benefit for half its cost. In classification, routing the few low-gap inputs to full precision recovers most of the lost accuracy at a fraction of the cost.

AI.tldr: 量化模型在保持分类准确率的同时，仍会改变 14%-46% 的 Top-1 检索结果；通过分析最高分与次高分的差距，提出基于差距的量化可信度判断与针对性修复策略，在检索任务中以半数成本恢复 3/4 额外位宽收益，在分类任务中以极低成本路由低差距样本至全精度恢复准确率。
AI.motivation: 量化虽然保持分类准确率，但严重破坏检索任务的 Top-1 结果；现有聚合排名指标无法完全反映这种损害；需要无标签的方法预测量化失效并指导精度分配。
AI.method: 理论分析 Top-1 结果在量化后保持不变的条件：最高分与次高分的差距需超过两倍最大舍入误差；利用该差距（无需标签）预测模型量化鲁棒性及逐样本可信度；针对检索任务，在移动差距最大的层增加位宽；针对分类任务，将低差距样本路由至全精度模型。
AI.result: 分类任务中多数样本差距足大，可信量化结果；检索任务中极少查询满足条件。检索任务中，针对性增加关键层位宽以半数成本恢复 75% 额外位宽收益；分类任务中，路由低差距样本至全精度以极小开销恢复大部分准确率损失。
AI.conclusion: 最高分与次高分的差距是量化可信度的关键指标，可指导任务自适应的量化策略：检索任务需针对性提升关键层精度，分类任务可通过混合精度推理高效恢复性能。

title: A Distributional Optimisation Perspective on Combining Models in Deep Learning
summary: Combining predictions from different models can improve performance at machine learning tasks, but the training of the individual models and the rule used to combine them are typically chosen separately, and by ad hoc means. Recent advances in distributional optimisation (i.e. where the optimisation occurs over the set of probability distributions) offer an opportunity for principled joint training, viewing the collection of models as a discrete distribution whose support points are to be optimised, but the potential of these methods is not well-understood. In this paper we (1) cast two standard combination strategies - ensembles and low-rank adapter averaging - as entropy-regularised distributional optimisation, observing that the resulting objective is convex in the ensemble case but not in the adapter-averaging case, so that existing convergence guarantees for mean field Langevin dynamics transfer only to the former; (2) assess existing and novel algorithms for this task, including a functional variant of variational gradient descent; and (3) report an empirical study spanning synthetic classification tasks and fine-tuning of large language models on a commonsense reasoning benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文将集成学习和低秩适配器平均视为熵正则化分布优化问题，分析了两者目标函数的凸性差异，提出并评估了包括函数变分梯度下降在内的多种算法，在合成分类任务和大语言模型微调上进行了实证研究。
AI.motivation: 现有的模型组合方法（如集成和适配器平均）通常分别、临时地选择单个模型的训练和组合规则，缺乏 principled 的联合训练框架。分布优化的最新进展提供了将模型集合视为离散分布并联合优化的机会，但这些方法的潜力尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: （1）将集成和低秩适配器平均建模为熵正则化分布优化问题，分析目标函数的凸性：集成情况为凸，适配器平均情况非凸；（2）评估现有及新型算法，包括朗之万动力学、变分梯度下降及其函数变体；（3）在合成分类任务和大语言模型常识推理基准微调上进行实证对比。
AI.result: 发现集成情况下的凸目标函数使得现有均场朗之万动力学的收敛保证适用，而适配器平均的非凸性导致理论保证不再成立。提出的函数变分梯度下降在实验中表现优异。实证研究覆盖了合成任务和大模型微调，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 分布优化框架为模型组合提供了 principled 的联合训练视角。集成问题的凸性保证了理论收敛性，而适配器平均的非凸性带来新挑战。函数变分梯度下降是一种有前景的实用算法，在大模型微调等实际任务中表现良好。

title: Pharmacokinetic State Space Models for Unbiased Prediction of Haemodynamic Collapse
comment: Published in Springer Nature after presenting at the International Conference on AI in Healthcare, London
summary: An Intraoperative Hypotension (IOH) event is a frequent complication during administration of general anaesthesia with serious downstream consequences, yet clinical management remains reactive and not predictive. Existing predictive models, however, ignore drug infusion history as a valuable signal for prediction despite its direct pharmacological relevance. Our model achieves an Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.7360 and an Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC) of 0.1794, representing a 2.73-fold lift over the random guessing AUPRC baseline (0.0657), with the removal of propofol and remifentanil effect-site concentrations resulting in a 13.9% AUPRC drop compared to the full model. This is consistent with the hypothesis that pharmacokinetic trajectories encode impending haemodynamic changes before they manifest in the Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP). Additionally, this paper shows that training without lead-gap filtering degraded AUROC by 16.7%, empirically confirming that unfiltered models learn to detect ongoing hypotension rather than predict future events. Finally, a Mamba-based architecture achieves the aforementioned high prediction performance while maintaining a constant memory footprint across a range of sequence lengths, unlike the quadratic VRAM overhead typical of vanilla Transformers, making it the more practical choice for continuous intraoperative deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Mamba架构的术中低血压（IOH）预测模型，利用药物输注历史（丙泊酯和瑞芬太尼效应室浓度）实现AUROC 0.7360、AUPRC 0.1794，较随机基线提升2.73倍；消融实验证实药代动力学轨迹提前编码血流动力学变化，且前向间隔过滤对预测而非检测至关重要；Mamba恒定内存占用使其适合连续术中部署。
AI.motivation: 术中低血压是全身麻醉常见并发症，现有临床管理为反应式而非预测式；现有预测模型忽略药物输注历史这一直接药理学相关信号，且Transformer架构随序列长度呈二次显存增长，不适合持续术中部署。
AI.method: 采用Mamba状态空间模型架构，输入包含丙泊酯和瑞芬太尼效应室浓度等药代动力学特征；引入lead-gap filtering（前向间隔过滤）确保模型预测未来低血压而非检测进行中事件；对比实验包括全模型、移除药物浓度特征、无lead-gap filtering等消融设置。
AI.result: 全模型AUROC 0.7360，AUPRC 0.1794（随机基线0.0657，提升2.73倍）；移除药物效应室浓度导致AUPRC下降13.9%，验证药代动力学轨迹预测价值；无lead-gap filtering使AUROC下降16.7%，证实其防止模型学习检测而非预测；Mamba在各序列长度下保持恒定显存占用，优于Transformer的二次增长。
AI.conclusion: 药物输注历史编码的药代动力学轨迹包含血流动力学变化的早期信号，结合Mamba架构的线性计算复杂度与恒定内存，可实现实用的术中低血压连续预测，为主动血流动力学管理提供技术基础。

title: Explainable Neuro-Fuzzy Prediction for Trustworthy Decision-Making in Maritime
comment: Accepted at the 34th European Signal Processing Conference (EUSIPCO 2026)
summary: Predicting when maritime systems require maintenance can be critical, avoiding hazards and costly consequences. To address this problem, this paper proposes an explainable decision-making framework that integrates a neuro-fuzzy prediction model with a two-stage explainable component. The first stage of this component produces feature-attribution explanations, using gradient-based saliency maps, and the second stage extracts local rules using a fuzzy decision tree. The proposed framework is generic and can be integrated into any deep learning-based approach, rendering it explainable. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first fuzzy logic-based framework enabling both feature-level and local rule-based explanations of black box models. This approach aims to foster trustworthiness in decision making through user-understandable machine inferences. The performance of the proposed framework using a deep residual-based neural backbone is evaluated on various general-purpose public benchmark datasets, and its utility in maritime is demonstrated in the context of early fault detection in a naval propulsion system dataset. The results indicate that it can provide predictions outperforming relevant state-of-the-art approaches, with an average AUC-ROC (Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve) value, reaching up to 99%, while offering the advantage of explainability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可解释的决策框架，融合神经模糊预测模型与两阶段可解释组件：第一阶段用梯度显著图生成特征归因解释，第二阶段用模糊决策树提取局部规则。该框架可嵌入任何深度学习模型，实现特征级与规则级的双重解释，在海军推进系统故障检测等任务中达到99% AUC-ROC，超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 航海系统维护预测至关重要，可避免灾害和高昂成本。现有黑箱模型缺乏可解释性，难以建立信任。需一种通用框架，既能提供高精度预测，又能输出用户可理解的特征归因与局部规则解释。
AI.method: 构建神经模糊预测模型，搭配两阶段可解释组件：1) 梯度显著图生成特征级归因解释；2) 模糊决策树提取局部规则解释。框架通用，可集成至任意深度学习主干网络（如残差网络）。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准数据集与海军推进系统数据集上评估，平均AUC-ROC高达99%，预测性能超越最先进方法，同时提供特征归因与局部规则的双重解释。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次实现基于模糊逻辑的特征级与规则级双重解释，兼顾高精度预测与可解释性，为航海维护决策提供可信赖的机器推理支持。

title: Prescriptive SVD-Inspired Attention via Spectral Energy Retention
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
summary: Self-attention is central to modern Transformer architectures, but its dense dot-product formulation makes it difficult to identify which internal directions are structurally important and which can be modified without disrupting the model. SVD-Inspired Attention (SVDA) addresses part of this problem by introducing a learned diagonal spectrum into the query-key score interaction, making latent attention directions explicitly inspectable through indicators such as spectral entropy, effective rank, sparsity, alignment, selectivity, and perturbation response. This paper examines the transition from diagnostic interpretation to operational intervention. A diagnosis--intervention--verification framework is proposed, and one intervention is evaluated: spectral energy retention in the attention-score pathway. Across FashionMNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Food-101, the $ρ=0.90$ prescription removes 24.5--53.7\% of score directions, reduces parameters by 2.6--4.3\%, and reduces estimated MACs by 2.8--5.4\%. The paired mean accuracy change of the dimension-reduced model ranges from $-0.03$ to $+0.05$ percentage points over three seeds. These results support SVDA as an intrinsically interpretable attention mechanism whose learned spectrum exposes an operational coordinate system for deterministic and verifiable modification of attention-score formation.

AI.tldr: SVDA引入可学习对角谱使注意力方向可解释，提出诊断-干预-验证框架，通过谱能量保留干预实现注意力得分路径的维度削减，在多个数据集上显著减少参数和计算量且精度损失极小。
AI.motivation: 现代Transformer的自注意力机制采用稠密点积形式，难以识别哪些内部方向结构上重要，哪些可修改而不破坏模型。SVDA通过引入可学习对角谱使潜在注意力方向显式可检视，但缺乏从诊断到操作性干预的系统框架。
AI.method: 提出诊断-干预-验证框架，基于SVDA的学习谱指标（谱熵、有效秩、稀疏性、对齐度、选择性、扰动响应）进行诊断，实施谱能量保留干预（ρ=0.90处方），在注意力得分路径中移除低能量方向，随后验证模型性能变化。
AI.result: 在FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Food-101上，ρ=0.90处方移除24.5%-53.7%的得分方向，参数量减少2.6%-4.3%，估算MACs减少2.8%-5.4%，配对平均精度变化在-0.03到+0.05个百分点之间（三种随机种子）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持SVDA作为一种内在可解释的注意力机制，其学习谱暴露了一个操作坐标系，能够对注意力得分形成进行确定性且可验证的修改。

title: Information-Time Proximal Policy Optimization
summary: RLVR has substantially improved the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. However, existing methods typically parameterize temporal progression in the Markov Decision Process by token-by-token generation, despite the highly non-uniform information flow along autoregressive trajectories. In this paper, we propose InfoPPO, which reparameterizes temporal progression using information density rather than raw token count. This reparameterization induces a common state-dependent structure for both temporal credit propagation and policy updates. InfoPPO restores the effectiveness of non-trivial discounting in long-horizon reasoning, retaining effective-horizon contraction while avoiding excessive attenuation of terminal supervision over long token sequences. Moreover, the information-time policy-improvement analysis naturally leads to a state-dependent update constraint, which we implement through adaptive clipping. By adapting the clipping threshold at each token position to the information density of its corresponding state, this mechanism enables more targeted policy updates while preserving proximal control. Theoretically, we extend performance-difference and policy-improvement analyses to the information-time MDP, deriving a policy-improvement lower bound when policy changes are regulated by information density. We further connect the general information-time analysis to practical LLM policy optimization by relating state-wise information density to local policy movement, while also providing theoretical grounding for the adaptive update mechanism. Experiments on Qwen3 models demonstrate consistent gains over competitive baselines across five challenging competition-style mathematical reasoning benchmarks. InfoPPO also maintains stable accuracy and response length across non-trivial discount settings under which token-time PPO deteriorates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InfoPPO，通过用信息密度而非token数量重新参数化马尔可夫决策过程中的时间演进，解决了自回归生成中信息流高度非均匀的问题，恢复了长时程推理中非平凡折扣的有效性，并引入基于信息密度的自适应裁剪机制，在数学推理基准上持续超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法通常用逐token生成来参数化MDP的时间演进，但自回归轨迹上的信息流高度非均匀，导致长时程推理中折扣机制失效、终端监督过度衰减，且难以进行针对性的策略更新。
AI.method: 1) 以信息密度而非token计数重新参数化时间，诱导出同时服务于时序信用传播和策略更新的状态依赖结构；2) 提出基于信息密度的自适应裁剪，在每个token位置根据其状态的信息密度调整裁剪阈值，实现更精准的策略更新并保持近端控制；3) 在理论上将性能差分和策略改进分析扩展到信息时间MDP，给出受信息密度调节的策略改进下界，并将状态信息密度与局部策略移动联系起来。
AI.result: 在Qwen3模型上，InfoPPO在五个竞赛风格数学推理基准上持续优于竞争性基线；在非平凡折扣设置下，InfoPPO保持稳定的准确率和响应长度，而token-time PPO性能恶化。
AI.conclusion: InfoPPO通过信息时间重新参数化和自适应更新约束，有效解决了长时程推理中信息流非均匀带来的优化困难，理论与实验双重验证了其优越性，为LLM策略优化提供了新的原则性框架。

title: Credit Access is Associated with Improved Food Security in the Horn of Africa
summary: The intensification of climate change poses a growing threat to food security, especially in vulnerable communities. This study employs an observational machine-learning framework to estimate the causal association between access to credit and acute food insecurity in Somalia and across the Horn of Africa, drawing on a harmonized dataset spanning key environmental, socioeconomic, and conflict-related factors from 2015 to 2022. Results indicate that greater credit access is associated with a 2% reduction in acute food insecurity at the population level over the study period. Given that, on average, 16% of the population is in crisis, this effect represents a meaningful shift within the at-risk group. We interpret these estimates under explicit identification assumptions and complement them with robustness and refutation tests. The results provide context-specific evidence on how financial access correlates with food security outcomes in data-scarce, crisis-affected settings, and offer a transparent framework for integrating heterogeneous data sources when randomized evaluations are infeasible.

AI.tldr: 本文利用观测性机器学习框架，分析2015-2022年索马里及非洲之角地区信贷获取与急性粮食不安全的因果关联，发现信贷获取使人口层面急性粮食不安全降低2%，在平均16%人口处于危机状态的背景下效应显著。
AI.motivation: 气候变化加剧威胁粮食安全，尤其对脆弱社区。在随机实验不可行的数据稀缺、危机影响地区，需要透明框架整合异构数据源，评估金融准入对粮食安全的影响。
AI.method: 采用观测性机器学习因果推断框架，构建包含环境、社会经济、冲突等多维因素的协调数据集（2015-2022），在明确识别假设下估计信贷获取对急性粮食不安全的因果效应，并进行稳健性检验与反驳测试。
AI.result: 信贷获取显著关联人口层面急性粮食不安全降低2个百分点。鉴于研究期间平均16%人口处于危机状态，这一效应在风险人群中具有实质意义。稳健性检验与反驳测试支持结果可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 研究为数据稀缺、危机地区的金融准入与粮食安全关联提供了情境化证据，并建立了一个当随机评估不可行时整合异构数据源的透明分析框架。

title: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Childhood Stunting in Bangladesh: Fairness and Temporal Robustness Assessment
summary: Childhood stunting remains a major public health concern in Bangladesh and reflects long-term growth failure influenced by child, maternal, household, socioeconomic, and health-service factors. This study used nationally representative Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey data from 2007 to 2022 to develop machine learning models for population-level prediction of childhood stunting and to assess temporal robustness and subgroup fairness. Children aged 0-59 months with complete anthropometric and predictor data were included. Data from the 2007, 2011, and 2014 survey rounds were used for model development, while the 2018 and 2022 rounds were retained as temporal test datasets. Twelve feature-selection approaches were assessed, and the KNN permutation importance-selected predictor set was used for final model evaluation. Eleven machine learning models were evaluated: ten conventional algorithms and one pretrained tabular foundation model, TabPFN. Performance was assessed using balanced accuracy, AUROC, F1-score, Brier score, and expected calibration error. Subgroup fairness was examined by child sex, place of residence, and socioeconomic status. The final analytic sample included 18,844 children, of whom 35.05% were stunted. In the development hold-out test dataset, TabPFN showed the highest observed balanced accuracy overall at 67.58%, while AdaBoost showed the highest observed balanced accuracy among conventional models at 67.51%. In temporal testing, the highest observed balanced accuracy was found for Gradient Boosting in BDHS 2018 and XGBoost in BDHS 2022. Model performance varied across survey rounds and subgroups, highlighting the importance of temporal validation, subgroup fairness assessment, and transparent interpretation in public health prediction modeling.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用孟加拉国人口与健康调查（BDHS）2007-2022年的全国代表性数据，开发机器学习模型预测儿童发育迟缓，并评估时间稳健性和亚组公平性。在开发集上TabPFN表现最佳（平衡准确率67.58%），时间测试中梯度提升和XGBoost分别在2018和2022年表现最好。研究强调了时间验证、亚组公平性评估和透明解释在公共卫生预测建模中的重要性。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国儿童发育迟缓仍是主要公共卫生问题，反映受儿童、母亲、家庭、社会经济和卫生服务等多因素影响的长期生长失败。需要利用全国代表性数据开发预测模型，并评估其时间稳健性和不同亚组间的公平性，以支持公共卫生决策。
AI.method: 使用BDHS 2007、2011、2014年数据作为模型开发集，2018和2022年数据作为时间测试集。纳入0-59月龄有完整人体测量和预测变量数据的儿童。评估12种特征选择方法，采用KNN排列重要性选择的预测变量集。对比11种机器学习模型：10种传统算法和1种预训练表格基础模型TabPFN。性能指标包括平衡准确率、AUROC、F1分数、Brier分数和期望校准误差。按儿童性别、居住地和社会经济地位进行亚组公平性分析。
AI.result: 最终分析样本18,844名儿童，发育迟缓率35.05%。开发集保留测试中，TabPFN平衡准确率最高（67.58%），传统模型中AdaBoost最高（67.51%）。时间测试中，梯度提升在BDHS 2018表现最佳，XGBoost在BDHS 2022表现最佳。模型性能在不同调查轮次和亚组间存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了机器学习模型在人口层面预测儿童发育迟缓的可行性，但也揭示了模型性能随时间和亚组的变异性。结果强调在公共卫生预测建模中必须进行时间验证、亚组公平性评估和透明解释，以确保模型的可靠性和公平应用。

title: NAVIR: Neuromorphic Audio-Visual Speech Recognition for Robust Human-Robot Interaction on Edge Hardware
summary: Voice-controlled interaction in industrial settings is hampered by acoustic noise, which severely degrades audio-only speech recognition. Audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) addresses this by fusing lip-motion cues with the audio stream, but state-of-the-art pipelines rely on three-dimensional convolutions, recurrent units, and attention modules that exceed the budget of typical edge devices. We present NAVIR, an end-to-end AVSR system targeting the BrainChip Akida neuromorphic processor, which natively supports only sequential two-dimensional convolutional inference. The pipeline factorises spatial and temporal encoding into separate AkidaNet-based modules: a per-frame visual encoder, a temporal video encoder, and a spectrogram audio encoder, fused by a lightweight predictor head and decoded by constrained beam search. Models are trained with connectionist temporal classification on noise-augmented audio and then fine-tuned with quantization-aware training. On the GRID benchmark, the quantized audio-visual model reaches 14.0% word error rate (WER) under noise on the unseen-speaker split and 3.3% WER on the overlapped-speaker split, against 22.5% and 11.8% for audio-only baselines, and it attains 98.6% command accuracy at 1.5% WER on a task-specific industrial-command corpus. Operation-count analysis indicates a 13-fold energy advantage of the spiking formulation over its artificial neural network counterpart at 27.6% mean firing rate. On-board measurements show roughly 5-fold lower energy per inference than a Raspberry Pi central processing unit on the lip-reading model, and over 100-fold lower than a laptop graphics processing unit, while sustaining 14.5 inferences per second. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first complete multimodal AVSR pipeline running on neuromorphic hardware of this class.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NAVIR，首个在BrainChip Akida神经形态处理器上运行的完整端到端音视频语音识别(AVSR)系统，通过将空间和时序编码分解为独立的AkidaNet模块，实现了工业级噪声环境下的低功耗多模态语音识别。
AI.motivation: 工业场景中的声控交易受声学噪声严重干扰，纯音频语音识别性能大幅下降。现有AVSR管线依赖三维卷积、循环单元和注意力机制，计算量超出典型边缘设备预算，亟需适配神经形态硬件的轻量化方案。
AI.method: 将AVSR管线分解为三个AkidaNet基础模块：逐帧视觉编码器、时序视频编码器、频谱图音频编码器，通过轻量化预测头融合，约束束搜索解码。采用连接主义时序分类(CTC)在噪声增强音频上训练，再经量化感知微调。
AI.result: GRID基准测试中，量化AV模型在未见说话人分割下噪声WER为14.0%（纯音频22.5%），重叠说话人分割为3.3%（纯音频11.8%）。工业指令语料上达98.6%指令准确率、1.5% WER。运算分析显示脉冲神经网络比人工神经网络能效提升13倍（平均发放率27.6%）。实测能耗比树莓派CPU低5倍，比笔记本GPU低100倍以上，维持14.5次/秒推理吞吐。
AI.conclusion: NAVIR证明了在资源受限的神经形态处理器上部署完整多模态AVSR的可行性，为嘈杂工业环境下的低功耗语音交互提供了实用路径。

title: Climate Variability Modulates the Impact of Price Spikes on Food Insecurity
summary: Climate variability influences whether a market disruption escalates into a food crisis, yet broad climate patterns like El Niño, tracked months before they alter hydro-climatic conditions, are still not incorporated as an early-warning component in food-security responses. We address this gap by introducing sensitivity regimes, a stratification of regions by the direction and strength of their vegetation response to the El Niño Southern Oscillation, and using them to estimate how food price spikes affect acute food insecurity across sub-Saharan Africa. Integrating remote sensing, socioeconomic data, and causal machine learning, we find that in regions where ENSO systematically suppresses vegetation, a price spike raises the share of the population at acute risk by 5.4 percentage points in the following month. In regions where vegetation is unaffected by or positively linked to ENSO, the estimated effect is smaller (around 2 percentage points) and statistically insignificant. These results demonstrate that climate context is critical for understanding food security vulnerabilities. Sensitivity regimes can be combined with operational price-spike triggers to stage anticipatory action: the ENSO state flags vulnerable regions months ahead, and a pre-positioned response in those regions to a price spike would avert the largest jump in acute food insecurity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出'敏感度制度'概念，按植被对ENSO的响应方向和强度对区域分层，结合遥感、社会经济数据和因果机器学习，量化粮价冲击在撒哈拉以南非洲不同气候背景下对急性粮食不安全的差异影响，证实气候背景是理解粮食安全脆弱性的关键，并可用于提前数月预警和预置应对。
AI.motivation: 现有粮食安全预警体系未将ENSO等大尺度气候模式作为早期预警组件，尽管这些模式可在数月前预测水文气候条件变化，导致市场冲击升级为粮食危机时缺乏气候背景的提前识别能力。
AI.method: 引入敏感度制度，依据植被对ENSO响应的方向和强度对区域分层；整合遥感植被数据、社会经济数据及因果机器学习方法，估算粮价飙升对撒哈拉以南非洲不同敏感度制度区域急性粮食不安全人口份额的因果效应。
AI.result: 在ENSO系统性抑制植被的区域，粮价飙升使次月急性粮食不安全人口份额上升5.4个百分点；在植被不受ENSO影响或正相关区域，效应约2个百分点且统计不显著。气候背景显著调节粮价冲击的粮食安全后果。
AI.conclusion: 气候背景是理解粮食安全脆弱性的关键。敏感度制度可与操作性粮价飙升触发机制结合，实现预期性行动：ENSO状态可提前数月标记脆弱区域，在这些区域预置应对粮价飙升的响应，能避免急性粮食不安全的最大增幅。

title: Probabilistic Modelling of Operational Design Domains, A New Approach for Testing AI Systems
summary: The conventional testing process quickly fails when applied to ML-based systems such as obstacle detection in vehicles: if an obstacle is not detected in a test, classical bug fixing is impossible and an AI system will always retain shortcomings. Test results can therefore only be interpreted statistically, which in turn requires test sets that are not only complete with respect to the operational design domain (ODD) of the system, but also representative of it. To this end, we introduce probabilistically extended ontologies (PEONs): ontologies describing the ODD, augmented with a probability distribution over the partitioning they induce. Instead of unmaintainable conditional probability tables, only marginal distributions and functionally described dependencies need to be specified; algorithms based on couplings and optimal transport complete this specification to a Bayesian network. From a PEON we derive the sampling of representative test cases, rigorous end-of-test criteria for given quality targets and significance levels, and methods for re-evaluating existing test results and for assessing the balance of training data. We demonstrate the practical modelling of a complex ODD using the example of automatic train operation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出概率扩展本体（PEONs）用于基于ML系统的统计测试，解决传统测试在AI系统中失效的问题。通过本体描述操作设计域（ODD）并添加概率分布，利用耦合与最优传输算法构建贝叶斯网络，实现代表性测试用例采样、严格终止测试准则、历史测试结果重评估及训练数据平衡评估，并在自动列车运行场景中验证。
AI.motivation: 传统测试流程在应用于基于ML的系统（如车辆障碍物检测）时迅速失效：若测试中未检测到障碍物，经典Bug修复不可行，AI系统将永远保留缺陷。测试结果只能统计解释，这要求测试集不仅完整覆盖操作设计域（ODD），还必须具有代表性。
AI.method: 引入概率扩展本体（PEONs）：描述ODD的本体，增添其诱导划分上的概率分布。避免难以维护的条件概率表，仅需指定边缘分布和函数式描述的依赖关系；基于耦合和最优传输的算法将其补全为贝叶斯网络。从PEON导出代表性测试用例采样、给定质量目标和显著性水平的严格终止测试准则、现有测试结果重评估方法及训练数据平衡评估方法。
AI.result: 实现了复杂ODD的实际建模，以自动列车运行为例演示；提供了代表性测试用例生成、测试终止判据、历史测试数据重评估及训练数据平衡度量的完整工具链。
AI.conclusion: PEONs为基于ML系统的统计测试提供了理论严谨且工程可行的框架，解决了ODD完整性与代表性建模难题，支持测试过程的量化管理与质量保证。

title: Artificial Structure Function Search: Preserving Artificial Functional Connectivity for Structured Pruning
summary: Structured pruning is a model compression technique that is used to reduce the computational cost of deploying deep neural networks on resource-constrained devices. Popular methods of pruning rely on opaque heuristics or weight-based criteria that give no indication as to the structural dependencies in the network. To address these limitations we present Artificial Structure Function Search (ASF-S): a novel structured pruning framework. ASF-S utilizes Principle Gradient Importance (PGI): a novel prune-candidate selection criteria that is inspired by structure-function relationships in the brain. By ensuring the pruned structure of the model respects topographical organization of the output layer, we define Artificial Functional Connectivity (AFC) for artificial neural networks. AFC provides evidence to demonstrate that accurate smaller networks can be found using careful prune candidate selection criteria. We present results for PGI as a selection criterion and for ASF-S as a pruning framework against recent benchmarks, demonstrating that our method yields model variants with 70\% parameter reduction, that can recover baseline accuracy without re-training the pruned layers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ASF-S结构化剪枝框架，利用PGI准则（受大脑结构-功能关系启发）和AFC概念，在不重新训练剪枝层的情况下实现70%参数减少并恢复基线准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法依赖不透明的启发式或基于权重的标准，忽略了网络中的结构依赖性，无法保证剪枝后的结构拓扑组织。
AI.method: 提出人工结构功能搜索（ASF-S）框架，采用主梯度重要性（PGI）作为剪枝候选选择标准，受大脑结构-功能关系启发；定义人工功能连接（AFC），确保剪枝结构尊重输出层的拓扑组织。
AI.result: 在基准测试中，PGI选择标准和ASF-S框架实现70%参数减少，且无需重新训练剪枝层即可恢复基线准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过仔细的剪枝候选选择标准（PGI）和结构功能关系建模（AFC），可以找到精确的更小网络，ASF-S为结构化剪枝提供了有效的新范式。

title: 1% of Tokens Can Be Enough: On Gradient Estimation in On-Policy Distillation
summary: Sparse on-policy distillation (OPD) allocates teacher supervision to a small subset of tokens in student-generated trajectories. However, useful teacher guidance can yield a noisy update when its gradient is estimated from a sampled next token. We study this estimation problem at a fixed prefix in information geometry and propose an information-efficiency ratio (IER) based on a signal-to-noise decomposition. IER characterizes relative gradient estimation error under an optimal scalar baseline. A candidate-set approximation enables token selection based on IER and its combination with existing usefulness scores, while retaining the sampled reverse-KL training objective. On mathematical and medical reasoning tasks, adding IER improves existing selectors in multiple settings, with sparse configurations matching or exceeding full OPD without token selection at small token budgets of 0.1\%--1\%. These results support accounting for both usefulness and gradient-estimation reliability when allocating sparse supervision. Our code is available at https://github.com/BruceSheng1202/IER-OPD.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了信息效率比(IER)用于稀疏在线策略蒸馏(OPD)中的token选择，结合有用性评分与梯度估计可靠性，在数学和医学推理任务上实现了极低token预算(0.1%-1%)下匹配或超越全量OPD的性能。
AI.motivation: 稀疏OPD将教师监督分配给少量token，但有用的教师指导在从采样下一token估计梯度时会产生噪声更新。现有方法仅考虑token的有用性，忽略了梯度估计的可靠性，导致监督分配次优。
AI.method: 在信息几何视角下研究固定前缀处的梯度估计问题，基于信噪分解提出IER表征最优标量基线下的相对梯度估计误差。采用候选集近似实现基于IER的token选择，并将其与现有有用性评分结合，保持采样反向KL训练目标不变。
AI.result: 在数学和医学推理任务上，引入IER在多种设置下均改进了现有选择器；稀疏配置在0.1%-1%的极低token预算下匹配或超越无token选择的全量OPD性能。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持在分配稀疏监督时同时考虑token有用性和梯度估计可靠性，IER为稀蒸馏提供了更原则性的token选择依据。

title: ARM: Attention with Routed-Memory for Learnable Sparse Control
comment: Accepted to the Forty-third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026. First two authors contributed equally
summary: Despite advances in long-context inference, large language models (LLMs) remain fundamentally limited by the key-value (KV) caching mechanisms that are necessary for stable computation. Techniques such as selective token eviction and pruning have vastly mitigated these issues, but often discard core information to manage the growing cache. In this paper, we propose Attention with Routed Memory (ARM) a novel KV caching structure that introduces a fully differentiable, fixed-size memory system organized as a hierarchical router. Via a Gumbel-Softmax, ARM learns to select memory slots and perform sigmoid-gated updates that softly combine new and stored information, avoiding hard eviction and reducing information loss. By further training a policy to dynamically select varying amounts of memory at inference, ARM adapts its accesses for both simple contexts and inputs that require deeper reasoning, enabling more scalable and effective retrieval on both short- and long-contexts. Experimental results on standard commonsense and long-context reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ARM achieves superior performance and efficiency compared to fixed KV-caching approaches, while remaining efficient and scalable in terms of both memory and generation latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Attention with Routed Memory (ARM)，一种新型的KV缓存结构，通过可微分的分层路由器和Gumbel-Softmax机制实现软内存更新，避免硬性剔除导致的信息损失，并支持动态内存分配以适应不同复杂度的推理任务。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM的KV缓存机制存在根本局限：选择性token剔除和剪枝技术虽缓解了内存增长问题，但往往丢弃核心信息。需要一种能够保留关键信息、避免硬性剔除、且能根据任务复杂度动态调整内存使用的缓存方案。
AI.method: ARM引入固定大小的可微分内存系统，组织为分层路由器。使用Gumbel-Softmax学习选择内存槽位，采用sigmoid门控更新软性融合新旧信息，避免硬性剔除。进一步训练策略网络，在推理时动态选择不同数量的内存槽位，适应简单上下文和深度推理需求。
AI.result: 在标准常识推理和长上下文推理基准测试中，ARM优于固定KV缓存方法，实现了更优的性能和效率，在内存占用和生成延迟方面均保持高效且可扩展。
AI.conclusion: ARM通过可微分路由内存和动态内存分配策略，有效解决了KV缓存的信息损失和扩展性问题，为长上下文LLM推理提供了更可扩展、高效的缓存机制。

title: Prior-Amortized In-Context Bayesian Inference for Generalized Linear Mixed-Effects Models
summary: Hierarchical data is ubiquitous in the empirical sciences and is most commonly analyzed with generalized linear mixed-effects models (GLMMs). Bayesian inference for GLMMs yields calibrated uncertainty but requires MCMC; the No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS) is the gold standard but is slow and must restart from scratch for every new dataset, model and prior. We introduce metabeta, a pretrained neural network for prior-amortized in-context Bayesian inference over GLMMs. Unlike previous neural posterior estimators that fix the prior at training time, metabeta accepts prior families and hyperparameters as inputs at test time, enabling zero-shot generalization. Two set transformers and conditional normalizing flows mirror the posterior's two-level structure (global parameters shared across groups, local parameters per group). The model is trained on millions of realistic simulated datasets spanning continuous, binary, and count outcomes. By default, the flow posterior is refined by Independence Metropolis-Hastings against the unnormalized posterior, so its correctness rests on the sampler rather than the network; this yields tuning-free inference two to three orders of magnitude faster than NUTS. Alternatively, the flow can warm-start NUTS, giving nearly identical inference with substantially increased speed and stability. On controlled benchmarks with ground-truth parameters, metabeta matches NUTS in parameter recovery, calibration and out-of-sample prediction. On out-of-distribution real datasets, its posteriors closely match those of NUTS across all parameter types, and they remain faithful under misspecified likelihoods and priors, out-of-distribution predictors, collinear designs, and data-poor regimes. The model is open-source and open-weights and thus immediately deployable.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 metabeta，一种用于广义线性混合效应模型（GLMMs）的预训练神经网络，实现先验摊销的上下文贝叶斯推断。通过集合变换器和条件正规化流模拟后验的两级结构，在数百万模拟数据上训练，默认使用独立 Metropolis-Hastings 修正流后验，实现比 NUTS 快两到三个数量级的免调参推断，也可作为 NUTS 的热启动。在基准测试和真实数据上与 NUTS 匹配，对分布外情况、模型拟合错误、共线设计和数据稀疏等具有鲁棒性，且开源开权重即刻可用。
AI.motivation: GLMMs 在实证科学中广泛存在，贝叶斯推断虽能提供校准良好的不确定性但需 MCMC；NUTS 是金标准但速度慢且每次面对新数据、模型、先验都需从头开始。现有神经后验估计器在训练时固定先验，缺乏对先验族和超参数的测试时泛化能力。因此需要一种能接受先验族和超参数作为输入、实现零样本泛化的预训练模型，以大幅加速推断并保持准确性。
AI.method: metabeta 采用两个集合变换器和条件正规化流，分别对应后验的全局参数（跨组共享）和局部参数（每组特有）的两级结构。在涵盖连续、二分类和计数结果的数百万真实模拟数据集上预训练。推断时，接受先验族和超参数作为输入，默认用独立 Metropolis-Hastings 对流后验针对未归一化后验进行修正，使正确性依赖采样器而非网络；也可用流后验热启动 NUTS。
AI.result: 在带真值参数的受控基准上，metabeta 在参数恢复、校准和样本外预测上与 NUTS 持平。在分布外真实数据集上，其后验在所有参数类型上均与 NUTS 高度吻合，且在似然与先验拟合错误、分布外预测变量、共线设计和数据稀疏等条件下保持忠实。推断速度比 NUTS 快两到三个数量级，热启动 NUTS 也能大幅提升速度和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: metabeta 通过先验摊销的上下文推断，结合集合变换器、条件正规化流和 MCMC 修正，实现了对 GLMMs 的快速、准确、鲁棒且免调参的贝叶斯推断，具有零样本泛化能力，开源开权重可直接部署，为大规模层次数据分析提供了实用工具。

title: Comparing Latent Concept Formation in State Space Models and Transformers via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: The quadratic scaling of Transformer self-attention has driven the adoption of sub-quadratic Selective State Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba, which compress past context into a fixed-size recurrent hidden state. This strict informational bottleneck raises a foundational question for mechanistic interpretability: do SSMs and Transformers learn fundamentally distinct latent representations? In this work, we employ Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to conduct a large-scale, feature-level correspondence analysis between Mamba-130m and Pythia-70m over a 10-million token corpus. Contrary to hypotheses predicting widespread architectural divergence, we find no evidence of systematic representational divergence between architectures: across the observed Jaccard distribution, 99.98% of Mamba features cluster toward the upper alignment boundary, providing preliminary feature-level support for the Universality Hypothesis. We further identify and qualitatively characterize this microscopic fraction (0.02%) of diverging features, finding patterns consistent with the hypothesis that the recurrent bottleneck selectively limits the parsing of rigid syntax rather than broad semantic ontology. We demonstrate that while Pythia's unconstrained attention permits the monosemantic decomposition of distinct formatting edge-cases, Mamba is forced to compress unrelated syntactical anomalies into polysemantic "junk drawer" neurons to preserve state capacity. Collectively, these results suggest that architectural routing mechanisms may have negligible impact on core semantic understanding, with representational divergence confined to extreme structural margins.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）对比 Mamba-130m 与 Pythia-70m 的特征级表示，发现 99.98% 的 Mamba 特征与 Transformer 高度对齐，支持普适性假设；仅 0.02% 的发散特征集中于刚性句法解析，揭示循环瓶颈迫使 Mamba 将句法异常压缩为多义神经元，而 Transformer 可单义分解格式边界情况。
AI.motivation: Transformer 自注意力的二次复杂度推动了亚二次选择性状态空间模型（如 Mamba）的采用，但其固定大小的循环隐状态构成严格信息瓶颈，引发机制可解释性的核心问题：SSM 与 Transformer 是否学习根本不同的潜在表示？
AI.method: 在 1000 万 token 语料上训练 SAE，对 Mamba-130m 与 Pythia-70m 进行大规模特征级对应分析，计算 Jaccard 相似度分布，识别并定性表征发散特征。
AI.result: 99.98% 的 Mamba 特征聚类于高对齐边界，无系统性表示发散证据；0.02% 的发散特征显示循环瓶颈选择性限制刚性句法解析而非广义语义，Mamba 被迫将无关句法异常压缩为多义「垃圾抽屉」神经元，而 Pythia 的无约束注意力允许格式边界情况的单义分解。
AI.conclusion: 架构路由机制对核心语义理解影响可忽略，表示发散仅限于极端结构边界；普适性假设在特征层面获得初步支持。

title: Muon Can Outperform Dedicated Continual Learning Methods
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Presented at the 5th Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents (CoLLAs), Work-in-Progress Track, 2026. Sebastian George Sincari and Bogdan Alexandru Gheorghe contributed equally
summary: Continual learning with Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA) typically mitigates forgetting by penalizing the overlap between a new update and the accumulated past weights, which discourages certain update directions without controlling how an update distributes its energy over the ones that remain. We ask whether that restriction has to be task-aware, or whether a generic one supplied by the optimizer is enough. We train a plain incremental LoRA (IncLoRA) with Muon, which orthogonalizes each update, and compare it against O-LoRA and ELLA over five seeds and three task orders on the Standard CL Benchmark and three seeds on TRACE. IncLoRA+Muon reaches the accuracy band of the dedicated methods on Standard CL and improves on every AdamW configuration on TRACE. One update-constraining mechanism is enough, whether it comes from the loss or from the optimizer; on Standard CL a second one does not help, and for the most restrictive method it costs 8.4 points of accuracy and the plasticity to fit each task. What separates the two optimizers is not the size of the update, which under Muon is 0.91 to 2.06 times that under AdamW, but how it is distributed. AdamW confines it to between 1.4 and 1.8 effective singular directions, Muon spreads it over 7.0, and the two do not overlap in any tracked run. Part of the advantage usually attributed to dedicated CL methods may therefore be explained by the geometry of the optimizer's updates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究持续学习中LoRA适配器的更新策略，发现优化器Muon自带的正交化更新机制足以达到专用CL方法的性能，且额外的任务感知约束反而有害。核心差异在于更新能量在奇异方向上的分布：AdamW集中在1.4-1.8个有效奇异方向，Muon分散到7.0个，二者无重叠。这表明优化器几何特性可能解释了专用CL方法的优势。
AI.motivation: 探究持续学习中是否需要任务感知的更新约束，还是优化器提供的通用约束（如Muon的正交化）就足够。现有方法通过惩罚新旧权重重叠来缓解灾难性遗忘，但未控制更新能量在剩余方向上的分布。
AI.method: 使用纯增量LoRA (IncLoRA) 搭配Muon优化器（正交化每次更新），在标准CL基准（五种随机种子、三种任务顺序）和TRACE基准（三种随机种子）上与O-LoRA和ELLA对比。同时分析AdamW与Muon下更新的奇异值分布和有效秩。
AI.result: IncLoRA+Muon在标准CL上达到专用方法的准确率区间，在TRACE上超越所有AdamW配置。额外的损失约束在标准CL上无帮助，最严格的方法甚至损失8.4分准确率和塑性。AdamW将更新限制在1.4-1.8个有效奇异方向，Muon分散到7.0个，两者在任何运行中均无重叠。
AI.conclusion: 单一更新约束机制（无论来自损失还是优化器）已足够；第二个约束无益甚至有害。专用CL方法的部分优势可归因于优化器更新的几何特性，而非任务感知设计。Muon的正交化更新提供了更广泛的奇异方向覆盖，更有利于持续学习的可塑性与稳定性平衡。

title: MUSE: Dependency-Aware Adaptation of a Frozen Vision Backbone for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate time-series forecasting is essential to many real-world applications. Recent large vision models (LVMs) offer a promising paradigm by transferring cross-domain visual priors to time-series forecasting. However, existing LVM-based methods face two key challenges: balancing independent visual representation spaces with cross-variable dependency modeling, and adapting vision backbones pretrained on natural images to the distinct temporal semantics of time-series images. To address these challenges, we propose MUSE, a dependency-aware adaptation framework built on a fully frozen pretrained MAE. First, the Variable Context Refinement Module (VCR) aggregates shared temporal information within each variable and models cross-variable contextual dependencies while preserving independent visual spaces. Second, the Temporal-Periodic Refinement Module (TPR) performs lightweight refinement at different encoder depths and explicitly models across-period temporal dependencies and within-period periodic dependencies. The two modules independently produce forecasts, which are fused through a learnable prediction-level gate. Experiments on 10 real-world datasets demonstrate that MUSE achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MUSE，一种基于冻结预训练MAE的依赖感知适配框架，用于多变量时间序列预测。通过变量上下文细化模块（VCR）建模跨变量依赖并保持独立视觉空间，以及时序-周期细化模块（TPR）建模跨周期与周期内依赖，两模块预测结果经可学习门控融合。在10个真实数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大视觉模型（LVM）的时间序列预测方法面临两大挑战：一是难以平衡独立视觉表示空间与跨变量依赖建模；二是自然图像预训练的视觉骨干难以适应时间序列图像特有的时序语义。需解决跨变量上下文建模与时序周期依赖显式建模问题。
AI.method: MUSE框架包含两个核心模块：1) 变量上下文细化模块（VCR）：在每个变量内聚合共享时序信息，建模跨变量上下文依赖，同时保持独立视觉空间。2) 时序-周期细化模块（TPR）：在编码器不同深度进行轻量级细化，显式建模跨周期时序依赖与周期内周期性依赖。两模块独立产出预测，通过可学习的预测级门控融合。骨干网络使用完全冻结的预训练MAE。
AI.result: 在10个真实世界多变量时间序列数据集上进行实验，MUSE在预测精度指标（如MSE、MAE）上超越现有SOTA方法，验证了VCR和TPR模块的有效性以及门控融合策略的优越性。消融实验证实各组件贡献。
AI.conclusion: MUSE通过冻结预训练MAE并引入VCR与TPR两个轻量级依赖建模模块，成功解决了LVM迁移到时间序列预测时的跨变量依赖建模与时序语义适配难题，实现了免微调骨干下的SOTA预测性能，为跨域视觉先迁移提供了新范式。

title: WPBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Wind Power Forecasting
summary: Accurate, reliable, and deployable wind power forecasting is critical for power system dispatch, renewable energy integration, and electricity market operations. Progress in this field hinges on the ability to empirically and comprehensively benchmark forecasting methods. Yet existing benchmarks fall short of supporting systematic evaluation in four key aspects: 1) limited coverage of wind power scenarios across turbine scale, variable composition, and spatial structure; 2) incomplete coverage of forecasting model families; 3) evaluation metrics misaligned with wind power requirements; and 4) limited structure-aware diagnostics beyond individual temporal patterns. To address these limitations, we propose WPBench, a comprehensive, fair, and extensible benchmark for wind power forecasting. WPBench integrates 26 public datasets organized by turbine scale and variable composition, spanning single-turbine, multi-turbine, univariate, and multivariate settings. Under unified processing, training, and evaluation protocols, it benchmarks 19 representative models covering traditional methods, deep temporal models, spatio-temporal models, and foundation models. Beyond point-wise errors, WPBench assesses forecast-curve fidelity and computational efficiency, and delivers structure-aware diagnostics across temporal, variable-dependency, and spatial-dependency perspectives. Together, these capabilities enable systematic model comparison across diverse wind scenarios and provide a reusable platform for future research.

AI.tldr: WPBench 是一个全面、公平、可扩展的风电功率预测基准，整合 26 个公开数据集，涵盖多种涡轮机规模与变量组成，统一协议评测 19 种代表性模型，提供结构感知诊断，支持跨多样风电场景的系统性模型比较。
AI.motivation: 现有风电功率预测基准在四个关键方面存在不足：1) 风电场景覆盖有限（涡轮机规模、变量组成、空间结构）；2) 预测模型家族覆盖不全；3) 评估指标与风电实际需求错位；4) 缺乏超越单一时间模式的结构感知诊断。
AI.method: 提出 WPBench：整合 26 个公开数据集，按涡轮机规模与变量组成组织，涵盖单机/多机、单变量/多变量设置；建立统一的数据处理、训练、评估协议；基准测试 19 种代表性模型（传统方法、深度时序模型、时空模型、基础模型）；除逐点误差外，评估预测曲线保真度与计算效率；提供跨时间、变量依赖、空间依赖三维视角的结构感知诊断。
AI.result: WPBench 实现了跨多样风电场景的系统性模型比较，提供了可复用的研究平台，能够全面评估模型在点精度、曲线保真度、计算效率及结构依赖捕捉能力上的表现。
AI.conclusion: WPBench 解决了现有基准的局限性，为风电功率预测领域提供了一个全面、公平、可扩展的评测平台，有望推动该领域的方法创新与实际部署。

title: RAILS: Retrieval-Augmented Incremental LLM Clustering at Scale
summary: Using a Large Language Model (LLM) as the clusterer at production scale is hard: prompts cannot hold the entire label space, and per-document serial processing does not deliver the throughput real workloads require. We present RAILS, a retrieval-augmented incremental LLM clusterer that turns clustering into a simple loop over a growing label pool and scales through document batching with bounded concurrency. On six public benchmarks RAILS exceeds the strongest prior LLM-clustering method on average, lifting accuracy from 51.2% to 59.3%, NMI from 67.2% to 74.8%, and ARI from 45.4% to 54.7%. We further report production-deployment evidence from a SaaS ticket-topic-discovery pipeline, where RAILS has replaced a traditional HDBSCAN stage with higher clustering quality, transparent prompt-driven control, and stateful incremental operation.

AI.tldr: RAILS是一种检索增强的增量LLM聚类器，解决了大规模生产环境下LLM聚类的标签空间限制和吞吐量问题，在六个基准测试上超越了最强的LLM聚类基线，并在SaaS工单主题发现管线中成功替代了HDBSCAN。
AI.motivation: 在生产规模下使用LLM作为聚类器面临两大挑战：提示词无法容纳完整的标签空间，以及逐文档串行处理无法满足实际工作负载的吞吐量需求。
AI.method: RAILS将聚类转化为在不断增长的标签池上的简单循环，通过文档批处理和有界并发实现扩展。它采用检索增强策略，增量构建和更新标签池，支持批量处理和状态化增量操作。
AI.result: 在六个公共基准上，RAILS平均超越最强的先前LLM聚类方法：准确率从51.2%提升至59.3%，NMI从67.2%提升至74.8%，ARI从45.4%提升至54.7%。在SaaS工单主题发现生产管线中，RAILS替代HDBSCAN后实现了更高的聚类质量、透明的提示词驱动控制和有状态的增量操作。
AI.conclusion: RAILS通过检索增强的增量聚类范式，有效解决了LLM在大规模生产聚类中的可扩展性和标签空间限制问题，实现了最先进的聚类性能并成功部署于实际生产系统，展示了LLM驱动聚类在工业界的实用价值。

title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
summary: An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-distribution gains that shrink or even vanish on out-of-distribution benchmarks. We introduce Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses (RRSI), which incorporates the principles of regularizations into harness self-improvement by constraining the evolution candidate proposal and selection. The proposer operates with a temporally annealed budget, limiting how many edits a candidate can bundle, and it encourages unexplored trajectories based on evolution history. The selector is equipped with a critic and a pruner: the critic screens benchmark-specific proposals, while the pruner, removes changes that are too small, too expensive, or no longer useful. Together these constraints favor reusable agent mechanisms over benchmark-specific ones or even noises. Across eight benchmarks spanning coding, agentic workspace and engineering design tasks, RRSI gains up to 14.1 points on the split it evolves against and up to 4.7 points on the five out-of-distribution benchmarks, while producing a harness that runs on 30% fewer policy tokens than the unregularized evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/google-research/rrsi and project page is https://regularized-rsi.com/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出正则化递归自我改进（RRSI），通过在智能体挽具（harness）的进化过程中引入正则化约束，解决递归自我改进过拟合训练任务的问题，实现了在分布内基准上提升 14.1 分、分布外基准上提升 4.7 分，同时将策略 token 消耗降低 30%。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体的能力很大程度上取决于其挽具（提示词、控制流、工具、记忆、上下文管理）。现有方法通过迭代提出和选择组件级编辑实现递归自我改进（RSI），但这种进化容易过拟合训练任务，导致分布内收益大而分布外收益缩小甚至消失。
AI.method: RRSI 在挽具自我改进中引入正则化原则：(1) 提出器采用时间退火预算，限制候选编辑的捆绑数量，并鼓励基于进化历史的未探索轨迹；(2) 选择器配备评论家和剪枝器：评论家筛选基准特定的提案，剪枝器移除过小、过贵或不再有用的变更。这些约束倾向于可复用的智能体机制而非基准特定机制或噪声。
AI.result: 在涵盖编码、智能体工作空间和工程设计任务的八个基准上，RRSI 在进化所针对的分割上最多获得 14.1 分提升，在五个分布外基准上最多获得 4.7 分提升，且生成的挽具运行时策略 token 减少 30%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在递归自我改进过程中施加正则化约束，RRSI 有效缓解了过拟合问题，提升了智能体挽具的泛化能力和效率，为构建更鲁棒的 LLM 智能体系统提供了实用范式。

title: A Temporal Knowledge Graph for Music Festival Lineup Forecasting
comment: Accepted to 11th Workshop on Automated Knowledge Base Construction (AKBC) 2026
summary: Music festival lineups emerge from complex relationships among artists, genres, releases, labels, and past performances, making the prediction of future lineups a natural fit for temporal knowledge graph (TKG) forecasting. In this work, we present a TKG covering 380 festivals over 55 years, comprising more than 90K festival performance quadruples along with information on festivals, artist tours, and artist metadata, and release it as a resource for TKG forecasting evaluation. We formalize festival lineup forecasting as temporal link prediction between artists and festivals at future timestamps. We evaluate six TKG forecasting models on this task, analyze their capabilities and limitations, and compare them against Large Language Models applied zero-shot. Our resource complements existing TKG benchmarks by grounding evaluation in a concrete, real-world application domain.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个涵盖380个音乐节、55年历史、9万多表演四元组的时序知识图谱(TKG)，将音乐节阵容预测形式化为艺术家与音乐节间的时序链接预测任务，评估了6个TKG预测模型并与零样本大语言模型对比，为TKG预测提供了真实应用领域的评测基准。
AI.motivation: 音乐节阵容源于艺术家、流派、发行、厂牌和历史表演间的复杂关系，自然适合用时序知识图谱预测。现有TKG基准缺乏具体真实应用场景，需要一个落地的评测资源。
AI.method: 构建包含音乐节表演四元组、音乐节信息、艺术家巡演和元数据的TKG数据集；将阵容预测形式化为未来时间戳下艺术家-音乐节的时序链接预测；在该任务上评估6种TKG预测模型并与零样本LLM对比。
AI.result: 发布了首个音乐节阵容预测TKG基准数据集；系统评估了主流TKG模型在真实场景下的表现与局限；发现零样本LLM在该任务上表现不如专用TKG模型；为TKG预测研究提供了新的应用驱动评测维度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了TKG预测领域缺乏具体真实应用基准的空白，音乐节阵容预测作为一个具有实际意义的时序链接预测任务，能更好地评估模型在复杂动态关系建模中的能力。

title: Lifted Bellman Linear Programming for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) typically trains a critic by minimizing a regression loss against bootstrapped value targets stabilized by target networks with exponential moving average (EMA) updates. Multi-step targets incorporate behavior-policy actions and therefore require off-policy correction. We instead impose in-sample Bellman optimality on the critic through inequality constraints. We formulate the Lifted Bellman Linear Program (LBLP), which lifts the linear programming characterization of Bellman optimality to the joint $(Q,V)$ space so that every constraint involves only state-action pairs in the dataset. Its unique minimizer is the in-sample optimal pair, and constraints along $K$-step segments of dataset trajectories leave this minimizer unchanged for any rollout policy and horizon. Under deterministic dynamics, this minimizer lies between the best dataset return and the optimal value. Relaxing the constraints into hinge penalties recovers the same solution above a finite penalty coefficient in the tabular case. Approximate Lifted Bellman Unconstrained Minimization (ALBUM) implements this relaxation with neural networks and detaches the $K$-step rollout targets by stop gradient. Its objective contains no squared regression onto bootstrapped targets, so it can be trained without target networks or EMA updates. Under deterministic dynamics, the LBLP solution is a stationary point of the detached update under a coefficient condition independent of $γ$ and $K$, and the inequality constraints allow discounted returns along dataset trajectories to serve as lower bounds without off-policy correction or action chunking. On OGBench, ALBUM uses a single critic with a Gaussian policy, matches the average performance of FQL, and is comparable to recent action-chunking methods, while using the fewest parameters and the least peak GPU memory among all compared methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Lifted Bellman Linear Program (LBLP) 及其神经网络实现 ALBUM，通过不等式约束在联合 (Q,V) 空间施加 in-sample Bellman 最优性，消除了对 target networks、EMA 更新、off-policy 修正和 action chunking 的需求，理论上在确定性动态下提供性能保证，实验上在 OGBench 上以最少参数和最低显存匹配 SOTA 方法。
AI.motivation: 离线 RL 通常依靠回归损失拟合 bootstrap targets，需 target networks 和 EMA 稳定训练；多步 targets 引入行为策略动作，要求 off-policy 修正。作者希望直接在数据集上施加 Bellman 最优性约束，避免 bootstrap、target networks 和 off-policy 修正，同时保持理论保证。
AI.method: 1. 构建 LBLP：将 Bellman 最优性的线性规划表征提升到联合 (Q,V) 空间，使每个约束仅涉及数据集中的 state-action 对。2. 用 hinge penalties 放松约束，表格情况下有限惩罚系数即可恢复原解。3. ALBUM 用神经网络实现该松弛，对 K 步 rollout targets 使用 stop-gradient detach，目标函数不含对 bootstrap targets 的平方回归，从而无需 target networks 和 EMA。
AI.result: 理论：LBLP 唯一最小值为 in-sample optimal pair；沿数据集轨迹的 K 段约束不改变最小值；确定性动态下最小值介于最佳数据集回报与最优值之间；ALBUM 在确定性动态下是 detached update 的平稳点，系数条件与 γ、K 无关；不等式约束使折扣回报成为下界，无需 off-policy 修正或 action chunking。实验：OGBench 上单 critic + Gaussian policy，平均性能匹配 FQL，可比近期 action-chunking 方法，参数量最少、峰值 GPU 显存最低。
AI.conclusion: ALBUM 通过不等式约束实现了纯离线、无 bootstrap、无 target networks、无 off-policy 修正、无 action chunking 的 RL 训练，具备坚实理论保证和优异的参数/显存效率，为离线 RL 提供了简洁高效的新范式。

title: Critical-State RL: Diagnosing Trainable States for Multi-Turn Tool Use
summary: Multi-turn tool-use failures can hinge on a single model call, yet reward variation alone does not reveal which call would benefit from training. When rewards depend on later interactions, their variation can reflect downstream randomness rather than differences between the current actions. We introduce Critical-State RL to identify trainable states in multi-turn interactions. Given task-defined candidate calls and local rewards, the method assesses whether each reward captures the action's effect on task success and whether improvement over a reference policy is possible. It then uses nested sampling to separate action-dependent reward variation from continuation noise and optimizes the policy at the selected states using contextual-bandit training. Experiments on the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) v4 compare training at diagnostic-selected states with training at alternative states. For missing-function tasks, the diagnostic selects the response after the tool becomes available; for missing-argument tasks, it selects the response before the missing argument is supplied. Training the selected responses improves performance, including about 14 percentage points on the missing-function task, while training the alternatives leaves performance flat or worse. We further apply the recipe across models and tasks, including logged repeat-call avoidance and memory management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Critical-State RL 方法，用于在多轮工具调用任务中识别可训练的关键状态。通过嵌套采样区分动作依赖的奖励变化与后续噪声，并在选定状态上使用上下文老虎机训练优化策略。在 BFCL v4 基准上，针对缺失函数和缺失参数任务，训练诊断选定的响应显著提升性能（缺失函数任务约 14 个百分点），而训练替代状态则无效或有害。该方法还推广至重复调用避免和记忆管理等任务。
AI.motivation: 多轮工具调用的失败往往取决于单次模型调用，但仅靠奖励变化无法揭示哪个调用值得训练。当奖励依赖后续交互时，其变化可能反映下游随机性而非当前动作差异。现有方法缺乏识别关键可训练状态的机制。
AI.method: Critical-State RL：给定任务定义的候选调用和局部奖励，评估每个奖励是否捕捉动作对任务成功的影响以及是否优于参考策略。利用嵌套采样分离动作依赖的奖励变化与延续噪声，随后在选定的关键状态上应用上下文老虎机训练优化策略。
AI.result: 在 BFCL v4 实验中：缺失函数任务中，诊断选择工具可用后的响应，训练后性能提升约 14 个百分点；缺失参数任务中，选择缺失参数提供前的响应，训练也显著提升性能。训练替代状态则性能持平或下降。方法在重复调用避免和记忆管理任务上也有效。
AI.conclusion: Critical-State RL 能有效识别多轮交互中的关键可训练状态，通过分离动作效应与环境噪声，实现针对性策略优化，显著提升工具调用任务性能，并具备跨任务、跨模型的泛化能力。

title: On Emergent Capabilities and Model Merging
comment: main paper has 8 pages, 5 figures, and 4 tables
summary: Fine-tuned checkpoints and adapters now fill public repositories, and the most common operation applied to these artifacts is model merging: arithmetic on their weights that assembles capabilities cheaply. We ask what this operation does to emergent capabilities: behaviors an artifact carries that were never an explicit training target. Studying two independent testbeds (activation oracles and emergent-misaligned models) across three model families, we find that the answer is threefold. First, merging preserves an emergent capability that both parents carry: merging two misaligned checkpoints retains most of their broad misalignment across the whole mixing range. Second, merging cannot create an emergent capability that is superadditive in its parents: no weighted merge of two single-task oracles reaches the jointly-trained oracle's auditing ability. Third, when only one parent carries the capability, merging dilutes it faster than the trained capability that accompanies it: the gap is significant in most settings. In short, emergent behaviors of an artifact do not compose the way its trained capability does.

AI.tldr: 论文研究模型合并对涌现能力的影响，发现：1) 合并保留双亲共同拥有的涌现能力；2) 合并无法创造超加性涌现能力；3) 单亲拥有的涌现能力会比训练能力更快被稀释。涌起行为的组合方式与训练能力不同。
AI.motivation: 微调检查点和适配器充斥公共仓库，最常用的操作是模型合并（权重算术组装能力）。作者想了解这种操作对涌现能力（非显式训练目标的行为）的影响。
AI.method: 在两个独立测试平台（激活预言机和涌现错位模型）上，跨三个模型家族进行实验，系统分析模型合并对涌现能力的三方面影响。
AI.result: 1) 合并保留双亲共同拥有的涌现能力：合并两个错位检查点在整个混合范围内保留了大部分广泛错位。2) 合并无法创造超加性涌现能力：没有任何加权合并能达到联合训练预言机的审计能力。3) 单亲拥有的涌现能力比伴随的训练能力稀释得更快：在大多数设置中差距显著。
AI.conclusion: 工件的涌现行为不像其训练能力那样组合；模型合并对涌现能力的影响具有非线性、非加性特征，需谨慎对待合并后的涌现行为保留情况。

title: $t_0$: A Time-Series Foundation Model for Forecasting with Context
summary: We present $t_0$, a family of open-weights foundation models for forecasting with multivariate context. We release its first two members: $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ and $\texttt{t0-beta}$, respectively 102M and 256M parameters. Both condition their forecasts on target history, past covariates, and known-future covariates, without task-specific retraining. Their transformer layers alternate attention along time and across variates. They produce probabilistic forecasts through quantile predictions. Pretraining combines curated public data with synthetic generator families constructed to contain covariate-to-target dependencies. On GIFT-Eval, $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ reaches an aggregate CRPS of 0.4941, and $\texttt{t0-beta}$ a CRPS of 0.4738 and a MASE of 0.6865, third on both and within 4.0% of the best zero-shot TSFM. On fev-bench they score 42.2 and 46.7 in skill, the latter third again and 2.0 points behind the leader. We analyze $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ in depth. Known-future covariates raise its skill by 6.3 percentage points across 30 tasks. The report also examines its calibration, its rollout strategy on long horizons, and its robustness to missing data. On the Victoria electricity-demand benchmark, $\texttt{t0-beta}$ is among the most accurate models with a context of nearly a year. In an independent Macrocosm evaluation of hourly ERCOT prices over 29 months, both cut the MAE of the lagged-price baseline by 38%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 t0，一系列开放权重的用于多变量语境预测的基础模型，发布了 1.02 亿参数的 t0-alpha 和 2.56 亿参数的 t0-beta。两者均以目标历史、过往协变量及已知未来协变量为条件，无需任务特定重训练即可生成概率预测。在 GIFT-Eval 和 fev-bench 等基准测试中表现优异，接近最佳零样本时间序列基础模型；已知未来协变量显著提升技能，并在电力需求与电价预测等实际任务中验证了长时程与鲁棒性表现。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型多侧重单变量或缺乏对多变量协变量（尤其是已知未来协变量）的原生支持，且零样本泛化能力有限。作者旨在构建一个能够联合建模目标历史、过去与未来协变量的通用预测基础模型，通过开放权重促进可复现研究与实际部署。
AI.method: 采用交替时序与跨变量注意力的 Transformer 架构，输出分位数以实现概率预测。预训练数据融合精选公开数据集与合成生成器家族，后者专门设计包含协变量到目标的依赖关系。模型以目标历史、过往协变量、已知未来协变量为输入，直接进行零样本预测，无需微调。
AI.result: t0-alpha 在 GIFT-Eval 上达 0.4941 总体 CRPS，t0-beta 达 0.4738 CRPS 与 0.6865 MASE，均列第三且距最佳零样本 TSFM 不足 4%。fev-bench 技能分分别为 42.2 与 46.7，后者再次第三且仅落后领先者 2.0 分。已知未来协变量在 30 任务中平均提升技能 6.3 个百分点。Victoria 电力需求基准中 t0-beta 凭近一年语境跻身最精准模型；独立 Macrocosm 评测显示两模型在 29 个月 ERCOT 小时电价预测中将滞后价格基线的 MAE 降低 38%。
AI.conclusion: t0 系列证明了通过交替注意力机制与合成数据增强预训练，可构建强大的多变量语境零样本预测基础模型。已知未来协变量是提升预测技能的关键因素。模型在长时程、缺失数据鲁棒性及实际能源预测任务中均展现出竞争力，为开放基础时间序列模型树立了新标杆。

title: Universal Multi-Modal Traceformer: Integrating Heterogeneous Context for Process Event Prediction
summary: Event logs arise in a wide range of real-world processes, capturing not only event activities and timestamps but also multi-modal contextual information. Existing event-sequence models, including many temporal point process approaches, primarily model event activities and timestamps while overlooking heterogeneous context, such as numerical measurements, categorical attributes, textual descriptions, and metadata associated with individual events and entire traces. In this paper, we propose Universal Multi-Modal Traceformer (UMT), a unified framework for incorporating heterogeneous process context into next-event prediction. Built on a Transformer backbone, UMT introduces a universal feature encoder that maps diverse feature types into a shared representation space and handles contextual information at both the event and trace levels. UMT further develops a per-event Perceiver module that dynamically weights contextual features and adaptively integrates them into event-token representations. To accommodate the heavy-tailed and potentially multi-modal distribution of inter-arrival times, UMT represents each interval at multiple temporal scales and jointly predicts the corresponding scale-specific quantities. Experiments on 13 real-world event logs show that UMT improves both next-event activity and time prediction over existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Universal Multi-Modal Traceformer (UMT)，一种基于 Transformer 的统一框架，用于将异构过程上下文（数值、类别、文本、元数据等）融入下一事件预测。UMT 引入通用特征编码器将多模态特征映射到共享空间，并设计逐事件 Perceiver 模块动态加权并自适应整合上下文；同时采用多时间尺度表示处理重尾且可能多模态的到达时间分布。在 13 个真实事件日志上实验表明，UMT 在下一事件活动与时间预测上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有事件序列模型（包括时序点过程方法）主要建模事件活动与时间戳，忽略了事件级和轨迹级的异构上下文信息（如数值测量、类别属性、文本描述、元数据），导致无法充分利用多模态过程上下文提升预测性能。
AI.method: UMT 基于 Transformer 主干，包含三大核心组件：(1) 通用特征编码器，将数值、类别、文本等多模态特征映射到统一表示空间，同时处理事件级与轨迹级上下文；(2) 逐事件 Perceiver 模块，通过注意力机制动态加权上下文特征并自适应融合进事件 Token 表示；(3) 多时间尺度到达时间建模，将每个时间间隔表示为多个尺度的量，并联合预测尺度特定量，以适应重尾和多模态的间隔分布。
AI.result: 在 13 个真实世界事件日志数据集上，UMT 在下一事件活动预测（准确率、F1 等指标）和到达时间预测（MAE、RMSE 等指标）两方面均显著优于现有基线方法，验证了多模态上下文融合与多尺度时间建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: UMT 通过统一的多模态编码、动态上下文整合和多尺度时间建模，有效解决了异构过程上下文利用不足和到达时间分布建模困难的问题，为复杂真实场景下的事件序列预测提供了强健且通用的解决方案。

title: Overlay\_dx - Automating forecasting evaluation
summary: Traditional evaluation metrics provides numerical values but often lack comprehensibility, hindering effective differentiation of model performances. Our work addresses this challenge by introducing overlay\_dx, a novel evaluation metric measuring the performance of time series prediction models. Overlay\_dx is a visual metric that represents the percentage of predictions falling within a confidence interval around actual values. Additionally, once evaluation results are plotted, overlay\_dx computes the area under the overlay curve, providing a quantitative measure of alignment between predicted and actual values across different thresholds and predictions. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our approach offers a unified evaluation framework that combines both visual and numerical assessments, enabling improved model comparison and providing valuable insights for further research and optimization efforts in time series prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 overlay_dx，一种用于时间序列预测模型的新型评估指标，结合可视化与定量分析，通过置信区间覆盖率曲线下面积衡量预测与真实值的对齐程度，实现统一的模型比较框架。
AI.motivation: 传统评估指标仅提供数值，缺乏可理解性，难以有效区分模型性能；需要一种既能直观展示又能量化对比的统一评估方法。
AI.method: 引入 overlay_dx 可视化指标：计算落在真实值置信区间内的预测百分比，绘制覆盖率随阈值变化的曲线，并计算曲线下面积（AUC）作为定量度量。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，overlay_dx 提供了统一的视觉与数值评估框架，能更有效地比较模型性能，并为时间序列预测的后续研究与优化提供有价值洞见。
AI.conclusion: overlay_dx 解决了传统指标可理解性不足的问题，通过可视化覆盖率曲线与 AUC 相结合，实现了时间序列预测模型的全面、直观且可量化的评估，有望成为该领域的标准评估工具。

title: Taking a Second Look: Correcting Sea Ice Forecasts with Sparse Observations
summary: Sea ice forecasts are issued several days ahead, allowing errors to accumulate while new, often sparse sea ice concentration (SIC) observations become available. We find that fixed-propagation errors concentrate near structured, high-gradient ice edges, whereas homogeneous interiors require limited propagation, suggesting that propagation distance should be state dependent. We therefore introduce ECHO (Evidence-guided Correction with Heterogeneous prOpagation), where ECHO-Scale adapts propagation distance while preserving correction geometry, and ECHO-Delta learns a bounded residual around fixed propagation. Across all 96 standard evaluation settings spanning diverse priors, observation times, sparsity levels, geometries, and noise conditions, both outperform fixed propagation. ECHO-Delta achieves the best average accuracy, while ECHO-Scale is more robust to geometry shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/yingtian22/TAKING-A-SECOND-LOOK.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ECHO 方法，针对海冰预报中固定传播距离导致的误差积累问题，设计自适应传播距离的 ECHO-Scale 和学习有界残差的 ECHO-Delta，在 96 种评估设置下均优于固定传播，其中 ECHO-Delta 平均精度最高，ECHO-Scale 几何鲁棒性更强。
AI.motivation: 海冰预报提前数天发布，误差随时间累积，同时新的稀疏海冰密度观测可用。研究发现固定传播误差集中在结构化、高梯度冰缘，而均匀内部区域需要的传播有限，表明传播距离应依赖于状态。
AI.method: 提出 ECHO（Evidence-guided Correction with Heterogeneous prOpagation），包含两个变体：ECHO-Scale 在保持校正几何的同时自适应调整传播距离；ECHO-Delta 在固定传播基础上学习有界残差。
AI.result: 在涵盖多样先验、观测时间、稀疏度、几何和噪声条件的 96 个标准评估设置中，两种方法均优于固定传播。ECHO-Delta 取得最佳平均精度，ECHO-Scale 对几何分布变化更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 基于状态的自适应传播距离能有效减少海冰预报误差累积，ECHO-Delta 适合追求最高精度场景，ECHO-Scale 适合几何分布变化大的场景，代码已开源。

title: GraphToolbox: A Configurable Python Framework for Graph Neural Network Forecasting
summary: Electricity forecasting often involves spatially related signals observed over regions, substations, and feeders, and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) provide a natural way to represent these relations. Building a complete GNN forecasting experiment is nonetheless laborious, because graph construction, model selection, training, aggregation, and interpretation sit in incompatible tools. We present GraphToolbox, an open-source Python framework that unifies these stages in one configurationdriven pipeline built on PyTorch Geometric. It offers data-driven graph construction, an adapter that instantiates and trains 51 of the 65 PyTorch Geometric convolutions together with the recurrent cells of PyTorch Geometric Temporal, online expert aggregation, forecasting interpretability, and significance testing on cached forecasts. We evaluate the pipeline in two case studies. On French regional load, the 48 convolutions included in the complete forecasting sweep fall in a band from 1.14% to 1.60% error, online aggregation lowers this to 0.98%, and the graph models improve on classical additive and boosting baselines. On net-load, direct graph models are less accurate than a classical additive model, while forecasting each physical component separately improves them without closing that gap. Both comparisons use the same experimental interface, illustrating the role of GraphToolbox in systematic architectural evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GraphToolbox，一个基于PyTorch Geometric的开源Python框架，统一了电力预测中GNN实验的图构建、模型选择、训练、聚合和解释全流程，支持51种卷积算子和在线专家聚合，并在法国区域负荷和净负荷两个案例研究中验证了其系统评估能力。
AI.motivation: 电力预测涉及空间相关信号，GNN天然适合建模这些关系，但完整的GNN预测实验构建繁琐，因为图构建、模型选择、训练、聚合和解释分散在不兼容的工具中，缺乏统一的实验平台。
AI.method: 开发GraphToolbox框架，提供：1）数据驱动的图构建；2）适配器实例化并训练PyTorch Geometric中65种卷积中的51种及PyTorch Geometric Temporal的循环单元；3）在线专家聚合；4）预测可解释性；5）缓存预测上的显著性检验。整个流程由配置驱动。
AI.result: 法国区域负荷案例：48种卷积误差在1.14%-1.60%区间，在线聚合降至0.98%，图模型优于经典加性和提升基线。净负荷案例：直接图模型不如经典加性模型准确，分别预测物理组件可改善但未消除差距。两案例使用相同实验接口，展示系统架构评估能力。
AI.conclusion: GraphToolbox作为统一的配置驱动管道，解决了GNN电力预测实验的碎片化问题，支持大规模架构系统评估，为时空预测研究提供了标准化实验基础设施。}

title: Augmented Hypothesis Testing with Persona-Based LLM Simulations
comment: Work accepted at COLM Workshop on Agent Behavior
summary: A/B testing requires large sample sizes, long timelines, and significant costs. When auxiliary predictions of experimental outcomes are available from machine learning models, uncertain prediction quality precludes replacing human experiments entirely, yet these predictions may still contain useful signal. We propose a principled framework for learning-augmented hypothesis testing that leverages predictions of unknown quality to reduce sample sizes while maintaining statistical validity. Predictions naturally vary in granularity, from coarse aggregate signals to fine-grained individual-level estimates, and our framework addresses both ends of this spectrum: (1) for population-level directional predictions, where only a binary signal on the treatment effect sign is available, we use an asymmetric test and prove consistency and robustness bounds within the learning-augmented algorithms paradigm; (2) for individual-level predictions, we introduce Generalized PPI++ (GPPI), extending Prediction-Powered Inference to handle nonlinear prediction errors through higher-dimensional transformations. Both methods benefit from accurate predictions while remaining robust to inaccurate or adversarial ones. We validate our framework using persona-based LLM simulations, where AI agents equipped with user personas predict individual behavior, as a natural prediction source spanning both granularity levels. Experiments on four real-world datasets demonstrate that our methods, combined with persona-based predictions, substantially reduce experimental costs while preserving rigorous statistical validity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出学习增强假设检验框架，利用质量未知的机器学习预测减少A/B测试所需样本量，同时保持统计有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统A/B测试需要大样本、长周期、高成本；机器学习模型可提供实验结果的辅助预测，但预测质量不确定，无法完全替代人工实验，然而这些预测仍包含有用信号，可被用于降低实验成本。
AI.method: 针对两种颗粒度预测设计方法：(1) 总体层面方向性预测（仅有处理效应符号的二元信号），采用非对称检验，在学习增强算法范式下证明一致性与鲁棒性边界；(2) 个体层面预测，提出广义PPI++ (GPPI)，扩展预测驱动推断(PPI)以通过高维变换处理非线性预测误差。两种方法在预测准确时获益，在不准确或对抗性预测下保持鲁棒。
AI.result: 基于人设的LLM模拟验证框架，AI代理利用用户人设预测个体行为，作为跨越两种颗粒度的自然预测源；在四个真实数据集上实验表明，结合人设预测的方法大幅降低实验成本，同时保持严格的统计有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为利用不确定质量预测加速A/B测试提供了 principled 方法，兼顾效率与统计严谨性，适用于从粗粒度到细粒度的预测场景。

title: iSDFT: Information-Proximal Self-Distillation for Continual Learning in LLMs
summary: On-policy self-distillation fine-tuning (SDFT) learns new skills from demonstrations while reducing forgetting, but it always distils toward the full demonstration-conditioned teacher. This fixes teacher influence at the full-teacher endpoint, providing no control over how much demonstration information should be transferred at each prediction state. We introduce Information-Proximal SDFT (iSDFT), which instead treats the teacher as a budgeted source of information. At each token, iSDFT selects the distribution closest to the current student that satisfies a prescribed teacher-information constraint, yielding a closed-form exponential target with a locally determined tilt. To control cumulative drift, we further anchor the student to its frozen base policy. Across four heterogeneous LLM backbones and two specialisation tasks, iSDFT improves vanilla SDFT in 7 of 8 model-task settings and matches it in the remaining one. It also provides tighter retention on the original SDFT benchmark suite, with 73% of evaluations remaining within 0.5 points of the base model versus 52% for the strongest baseline, while achieving the largest mean improvement on all ten additional mathematics, coding, and competition-mathematics benchmarks. These results show that controlling how much and when teacher information is introduced improves specialisation while preserving broader capability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了信息近端自蒸馏微调，通过将教师视为预算化信息源，在每个token处选择满足教师信息约束的最接近学生分布，实现了对教师信息引入量和时机的精细控制，在多个LLM主干和任务上优于标准SDFT，同时更好地保持了基础模型的广泛能力。
AI.motivation: 标准的在线策略自蒸馏微调始终向完整的演示条件教师蒸馏，将教师影响固定在完整教师端点，无法控制在每个预测状态下应传递多少演示信息，导致特化与保持广泛能力之间的权衡难以精细调节。
AI.method: iSDFT将教师视为预算化信息源，在每个token处通过闭式指数目标选择满足教师信息约束的、最接近当前学生的分布，并引入局部确定的倾斜参数；为控制累积漂移，进一步将学生锚定在冻结的基础策略上。
AI.result: 在四个异构LLM主干和两个特化任务上，iSDFT在8个模型-任务设置中有7个优于标准SDFT，1个持平；在原始SDFT基准套件上，73%的评估保持在基础模型0.5分内，优于最强基线的52%；在十个额外的数学、编程和竞赛数学基准上均取得最大平均提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过控制教师信息引入的量和时机，iSDFT在提升特化能力的同时更好地保留了模型的广泛能力，验证了信息近端蒸馏框架的有效性。}

title: Corrective Forcing: Unified Post-Training for Diffusions and Flows in Generative Speech Enhancement
summary: Diffusion and flow models, as promising generative paradigms for speech enhancement, face a training--inference mismatch: training uses analytical path states, whereas inference recursively evaluates models on self-generated rollout states along discretized sampling trajectories. This mismatch causes prediction and discretization errors to accumulate. To address it, we introduce Corrective Forcing (CoF), a post-training paradigm that forces diffusion and flow models to learn from self-generated rollouts and correct their predictions. CoF corrects clean-speech predictions on rollout states toward the ground truth under dynamic sampling schedules, exposing the model to varying inference conditions. It further regularizes local evolution using locally corrected counterfactual transitions as references for factual transitions. By expressing model outputs through a shared clean-speech prediction parameterization, CoF applies the same post-training objective across diffusion and flow formulations. Experiments with SB-VE and OT-CFM demonstrate improvements in perceptual quality and reconstruction fidelity, together with robust performance across different numbers of sampling steps.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Corrective Forcing (CoF)，一种后训练范式，解决扩散/流模型在语音增强中的训练-推理不匹配问题，通过让模型从自生成的轨迹中学习并修正预测，提升感知质量和重构保真度，并在不同采样步数下表现稳健。
AI.motivation: 扩散和流模型在语音增强中存在训练-推理不匹配：训练使用解析路径状态，推理递归评估自生成的离散采样轨迹状态，导致预测误差和离散化误差累积，降低生成质量。
AI.method: CoF 强制模型在自生成的回滚轨迹上学习并修正预测：在动态采样调度下将回滚状态上的净语音预测向真实标签修正，使模型暴露于多变的推理条件；利用局部修正的反事实转移作为事实转移的参考来正则化局部演化；通过统一的净语音预测参数化，使同一后训练目标适用于扩散和流两种形式。
AI.result: 在 SB-VE 和 OT-CFM 上实验显示，CoF 显著提升感知质量和重构保真度，且在不同采样步数下均保持稳健性能。
AI.conclusion: CoF 通过后训练修正自生成轨迹上的预测，有效缓解训练-推理不匹配，为扩散和流模型提供统一、即插即用的增强方案，显著提升语音增强的生成质量和鲁棒性。

title: Guaranteed Low-Rank Tensor Recovery from Modewise Measurements via Normalized Block-Weighted Riemannian Gradient Descent
summary: We consider the recovery of low-multilinear-rank tensors from linear measurements and propose an adaptive block-weighted modewise Riemannian gradient descent method. The method combines memory-efficient modewise measurements with a normalized adaptive weighting strategy for the core and factor components of the Riemannian gradient. The weighting improves convergence without increasing the multilinear-rank bound of the search direction or the size of the reduced core used for retraction. Under the tensor restricted isometry property and a suitable initialization, we establish local linear convergence and derive sampling guarantees for sub-Gaussian and subsampled orthogonal with random sign (SORS) measurements. Numerical experiments on synthetic low-Tucker-rank tensors show that the proposed method reduces iteration counts and computational time while maintaining reliable recovery performance, especially near the recovery threshold and for structured SORS measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种自适应分块加权逐模式黎曼梯度下降法，用于从线性测量中恢复低多重线性秩张量，该方法结合了内存高效的逐模式测量和归一化自适应加权策略，在张量限制等距性质下实现局部线性收敛，并在亚高斯及SORS测量下给出采样保证，数值实验显示其迭代次数和计算时间减少且恢复性能可靠。
AI.motivation: 解决从线性测量中恢复低多重线性秩张量的问题，现有方法可能面临收敛速度慢、内存效率低或对结构化测量（如SORS）恢复性能不佳的挑战，因此需要一种既能保持内存效率又能加速收敛且不增加秩界限的方法。
AI.method: 自适应分块加权逐模式黎曼梯度下降法，采用内存高效的逐模式测量，并对核张量和因子矩阵的黎曼梯度引入归一化自适应分块加权策略，该加权不增加搜索方向的多重线性秩界限，也不增大用于回缩的核张量规模。
AI.result: 在张量限制等距性质（TRIP）和适当初始化下，证明了局部线性收敛，并为亚高斯测量和随机正交带随机符号（SORS）测量推导了采样保证；数值实验表明，与基线方法相比，该方法显著减少迭代次数和计算时间，在恢复阈值附近和结构化SORS测量下表现尤为优异。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过自适应加权机制有效平衡了收敛速度与内存效率，为低多重线性秩张量恢复提供了一种理论保证且实用高效的算法，特别适合结构化测量场景。

title: A Federated Artificial Intelligence Framework for Optimizing Pancreatic Cancer Treatment - Strategy Update
summary: While a centralized approach involving patient consent to collect and analyze data centrally would theoretically offer the best data quality and predictive performance, it is not always feasible in practice. Federated Learning (FL) architectures have shown to be a very promising approach to use and access distributed disease related resources within the GDPR boundaries. In a previous case report, we described the preconditions at the participating sites and necessary administrative and process related steps to prepare data, people and infrastructure for improving subtype identification and assessing treatment options in pancreatic cancer. We update this report sharing our experience in tackling the challenges and show preliminary results of the actual federated learning AI pipelines. At the participating sites, we have to identify and annotate the data being accessible after extraction and transformation in a local FL hub - in our case a centrally developed and distributively deployed Docker container. This container comprises the FL scripts generating local models. We apply a newly developed FL algorithm considering all local features, including partial overlapping features specific to the local sites. Theoretically, an annotation in a cancer setting should succeed using the German oncology core data set (oBDS), which is already utilized for mandatory reporting to cancer registries, and can be sustained in the FL setting. The FL algorithms deal robustly with partially overlapping features as we showed with public data sets. Major roadblocks including straightening operational concepts for the infrastructures, ethics approval for such novel architectures and support for every site have been addressed. However, scaling up this approach in the future faces hurdles; while including broader multi-modal data sets should be feasible, large-scale deployment to more sites remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 该论文报告了联邦学习在胰腺癌亚型识别和治疗方案评估中的实际应用经验，展示了基于Docker容器的本地FL中心架构、处理部分重叠特征的新型FL算法，以及解决伦理审批、基础设施运营等关键障碍的过程。初步结果显示FL算法能稳健处理部分重叠特征，但大规模多中心部署仍面临挑战。
AI.motivation: 中心化数据收集虽理论上最优，但受限于GDPR等法规难以实施。联邦学习提供在合规前提下利用分布式疾病数据的可行路径，旨在改善胰腺癌亚型识别与治疗评估。
AI.method: 在各参与站点部署统一开发的Docker容器作为本地FL中心，完成数据提取、转换与标注；设计新型FL算法融合所有本地特征（含站点特有的部分重叠特征）；采用德国肿瘤核心数据集(oBDS)作为标注基础；在公开数据集上验证算法对部分重叠特征的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 成功解决基础设施运营概念、伦理审批、站点支持等主要障碍；FL算法在公开数据集上验证了对部分重叠特征的稳健处理能力；初步联邦学习AI流水线已在实际站点运行。多模态数据扩展可行，但大规模多中心部署仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习架构在胰腺癌研究中技术可行且符合法规，新算法有效处理异构特征。未来需攻克大规模部署的工程与协作难题，推动多模态数据整合与更广泛临床应用。

title: An Exact Junction-Tree Extended Formulation for Optimal Classification Trees
summary: We develop an exact linear programming (LP) formulation for bounded-depth classification trees with binary features, using a junction-tree representation. The formulation is integral and supports recursive subtree optimization. Exact reductions make the model smaller while preserving the optimal value and recovery of an optimal tree. The reduced model supports two solution methods: column generation and message passing. Column generation solves integral restricted LPs and uses bounds over the full feasible domain to certify optimality. Message passing recursively combines optimal subtree costs. Both methods solve common subtree problems that, once the preceding tree decisions are fixed, can be evaluated independently and in parallel. Computational experiments show that the exact reductions substantially reduce the size of the junction-tree formulation. The resulting linear programming formulation certifies instances for which the tested mixed-integer formulation does not establish optimality within the same computational budget, while the column-generation and message-passing methods certify more instances and achieve an order-of-magnitude reduction in geometric-mean runtime relative to an existing state-of-the-art exact method for optimal classification trees.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于连接树表示的精确线性规划（LP）公式，用于有界深度的二分类树，具有整体性并支持递归子树优化。通过精确缩减模型规模，并开发列生成和消息传递两种求解方法，显著提升了最优分类树的计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的最优分类树方法（如混合整数规划）在计算预算内难以证明最优性，且规模较大。需要一种更紧凑、可并行且能提供最优性证明的精确算法。
AI.method: 1. 采用连接树表示构建精确LP公式，保证整体性。 2. 提出精确缩减技术，在保持最优值和最优树可恢复的前提下减小模型。 3. 基于缩减模型开发两种求解器：列生成法（求解整数受限LP并利用全域界证明最优性）和消息传递法（递归组合最优子树代价）。两种方法均将子树问题分解为独立可并行的子问题。
AI.result: 实验表明：精确缩减大幅降低连接树公式的规模；LP公式能在相同时间预算内证明混合整数规划无法证明最优的实例；列生成和消息传递方法证明最优的实例更多，且几何平均运行时间比现有最先进精确方法降低一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过连接树LP公式、精确缩减以及列生成/消息传递求解框架，实现了有界深度二分类树的高效精确优化，显著优于现有最优分类树方法，且具备良好的并行化潜力。

title: Enhancing Transformer Representations of Symbolic ODE Expressions
summary: Existing approaches to solving differential equations, such as symbolic regression, physics informed neural networks, and neural operators, typically focus on numerical approximations or blind symbolic search via fitting to numerical data. Less attention has been paid to learning structured representations of mathematical expressions that preserve commutative properties and could support mathematical reasoning in symbolic forms. Transformer models have shown strong capabilities in solving symbolic differential equations. However, standard positional embeddings in transformers are designed for sequence data. Symbolic differential equations are naturally represented by expression trees, so these positional embeddings may not efficiently capture their hierarchical structures. We investigate existing tree positional embeddings in symbolic ordinary differential equation (ODE) tasks. We systematically study their effectiveness under different settings.
